docs.text:
{{Unobtainable}}''Not to be confused with [[Cog]].'' {{Consumables|image=7 cog.png|description=A component used in mysterious electronics. |cooldown=N/A }} {{Color|7-Pronged Cog}} is a special [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates|11/23/2020 update]] for the [[Ready Player Two]] event. It was used as one of the two ingredients to craft the [[Strange Goggles]].

To obtain the {{Cost|7-Pronged Cog||4=}}, the player would need to redeem seven [[codes]], discovered by various riddles scattered across the map.

'''NOTE''': These codes are now expired. docs.title: Ability Tokens
docs.text:
[[File:AbilityTokens.png|thumb|300px|An array of Ability Tokens,]] '''Ability Tokens''' are tokens generated by [[bees]], which can be collected to activate special abilities and buffs. Almost all bees spawn ability tokens, with the exceptions being ungifted [[Basic Bee]] and [[Brave Bee]] without [[Beequip]]s. If the player doesn't collect a token within a certain amount of time, it fades away. Players can't collect the tokens generated by other players' bees and vice versa, as the tokens are client sided. Prior to the [[Updates#2018.05.07|May 7th, 2018 update]], other players' tokens were visible, but still couldn't be collected by others.

[[File:Focus Bee token.gif|thumb|A [[Looker Bee]] generating a focus token.]] Ability tokens can be generated in 3 situations: '''Gathering:''' Ability tokens that can be generated when the bees are collecting [[pollen]]. Most ability tokens that can be generated under this situation can collect pollen and/or boost pollen collection. '''Combat:''' Ability tokens that can be generated when the bees are targeting/attacking [[Mobs|mob]]. Most ability tokens that can be generated under this situation can inflict damage or [[Buffs & Debuffs|debuffs]] to enemies and boost bees' combat process. *'''Idle:''' Ability tokens that can be generated when neither the bees are collecting pollen or in combat situation. Some ability tokens can be generated under 2 or 3 different situations. Gathering and combat situations are known as "active" situations.

Some tokens aren't generated by the player's bees (such as honey tokens from flowers). The player can tell apart the two types of tokens by the fact that tokens dropped by bees give off gold sparkles, while tokens generated through other means do not sparkle. Also, tokens dropped by someone else's bees are not visible to the player, which means every visible token is collectible (although there is a bug where some loot tokens cannot be collected, usually at the end of a Honeystorm or Snowstorm. Check the [[Glitches]] page for more information).

Each ability token has a use cooldown, a trial cooldown and a trial success rate. When a bee reaches a flower, it checks if its use cooldown for each token is off. When its use cooldown for a token is off, the bee will check if its trial cooldown for the token is off every time it reaches a flower and attempts to summon the token if it can. If it successfully summons the token, it goes back into its use cooldown.

A list of ability tokens and their cooldowns can be found here: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hj235xRqhqGlKhkUYtoxloC5aAgJDRqMpQgpjtBndBQ/edit?usp=sharing Ability Token Spreadsheet]

TOC ==Ability Token Stats== These are stats which affect the characteristics of ability tokens. ===Bee Ability Rate=== Bee Ability Rate determines the increment or decrement of use cooldown and trial cooldown of bees' ability tokens, by dividing the original cooldown and trial cooldown, and will also increment the trial success rate. For example: a 200% bee ability rate will reduce the cooldown to 50% of the original cooldown (100% ÷ 200%), and will increase the success rate by 100% (or double it).

===Ability Token Lifespan=== Ability Token Lifespan extends the duration of uncollected ability tokens generated by bees before they despawn. It can be boosted by a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Stubborn Bee]] and [[Cog Amulet]] and by the [[Paper Angel]] and [[Paperclip]] beequips. The maximum amount currently possible is 144%.

===Ability Duplication Chance=== [[File:Dupe token.gif|thumb|An ability token being duplicated and that token being collected]] When there is a chance, ability tokens will spawn its duplicated/duped variants randomly on a field. Duped tokens hover over the field and last for double the tokens' lifespan, and that lifespan is further increased by 5% per [[Digital Bee|Digital Bee's]] level. Duped tokens can be collected/activated by standing beneath it for 1 second.

Ability duplication chance can be increased by [[Buffs & Debuffs|field corruption]] from Digital Bee's [[#Glitch|Glitch]] and [[#Map Corruption|Map Corruption]] ability tokens. It also can be be increased from [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] Digital Bee. Other than from Digital Bees, ability duplication chance can also be increased by the 'Corrupt' upgrade purchasable from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] and only applies during that challenge. It can also be provided by [[Science Bear]] during his "Corrupting The Glitched Drive" quest.

{{clear}} ==Bee Ability Tokens== ===Bomb=== [[File:AllBombs.png|left|thumb|203px|'''Red Bomb''' (left), '''Blue Bomb''' (middle), and '''Buzz Bomb '''(right).]] '''Bomb''' collects pollen from flowers in an area. '''Buzz Bombs''' collect 7 pollen from all types of flowers. '''Red Bombs''' and '''Blue Bombs''' collect 10 pollen from only matching-color flowers. The amount of pollen collected increases by 10% per level (e.g., 200% on a level 20 bee). Normal Bomb tokens collect from 13 surrounding flowers while Bomb+ tokens collect from 29 surrounding flowers. This is increased by .25x a stack (Up to 10 stacks for 2.5x bomb pollen). It is to be noted that any and all bombs count towards the stack.

Bomb tokens can be collected to increase their power. Collecting multiple tokens increases Bomb power without regard to size or color; however, the color limitations still are prevalent.

Red Bomb is granted by [[Rascal Bee|Rascal]], [[Demon Bee|Demon]], and [[Shy Bee|Shy]] Bees. Red Bomb+ is granted by [[Fire Bee|Fire]], [[Demon Bee|Demon]], and Festive Bees. Blue Bomb is granted by [[Bumble Bee|Bumble]], [[Bubble Bee|Bubble]], and [[Buoyant Bee|Buoyant]] Bees. Blue Bomb+ is granted by [[Frosty Bee|Frosty]], [[Ninja Bee|Ninja]], and [[Vicious Bee|Vicious]] Bees. Buzz Bomb is granted by [[Bomber Bee|Bomber]], [[Commander Bee|Commander]], and [[Exhausted Bee|Exhausted]] Bees. Buzz Bomb+ is granted by [[Demo Bee|Demo]], [[Lion Bee|Lion]], and [[Fuzzy Bee|Fuzzy]] Bees. Balloons during a surprise party also have a chance to generate a Blue and a Buzz Bomb token.

If [[#Bomb Sync|Red Bomb Sync]] is on, all red Bombs collect white pollen. If [[#Bomb Sync|Blue Bomb Sync]] is on, all blue Bombs collect white pollen. If both Syncs are active, all Bombs collect any color of pollen.

When [[#Pollen Haze|Pollen Haze]] is active, all Bomb ability tokens are automatically collected, and they may also [[Pollination|pollinate]] flower patches that they collect from.

All types of Bomb tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated while collecting pollen. The stacking time (the amount of time a player has to collect another Bomb token for its effects to be combined with the previous Bomb) is 5 seconds.

{{clear}} ===Boost=== [[File:RedBlueBoost.png|left|thumb|185px|'''Red Boost''' (left) and '''Blue Boost''' (right).]] [[File:White Boost Token.png|thumb|90x90px|'''White Boost.''']]'''Boost''' grants x1.2 pollen per stack from matching-color flowers for 15 seconds. Each color can stack up to 10 times. The pollen boost applies to the flowers themselves, so it benefits both the player and their bees. When collected, red/blue (depending on the type) and white sparkles appear on the player's bees and their character.

Red Boost is granted by [[Rad Bee|Rad]], [[Riley Bee|Riley]], and [[Shy Bee|Shy]] Bees, also by [[Festive Bee|Festive Bee's]] [[#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] and [[#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]] abilities, and by unactivated targets from [[Precise Bee|Precise Bee's]] [[#Target Practice|Target Practice]] ability. Blue Boost is granted by [[Frosty Bee|Frosty]], [[Cool Bee|Cool]], [[Bucko Bee|Bucko]], [[Diamond Bee|Diamond]], and [[Tadpole Bee|Tadpole]] Bees. White Boost is granted by [[Windy Bee]]. White Boost and Blue Boost tokens can also be generated by balloons during a [[#Surprise Party|Surprise Party]].

Sometimes flowers generate Boost tokens instead of Honey tokens. These tokens look almost identical to Boost tokens generated by bees, except the latter have gold sparkles while the former does not. Boost tokens from flowers take more time to fade away. These Boost tokens generated by flowers do not count for Ability Token quests and badges. Token Links collect Boost tokens generated by the player's bees, but not tokens spawned by the field.

Boost tokens produced by bees take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated while collecting pollen. The stacking time is the same as the effect duration, 15 seconds. Adding another token resets the timer to 15 seconds, i.e. it does not add another 15 seconds.

{{Clear}} ===Haste=== [[File:Haste Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Haste Image]] [[File:F5099004-9E64-45E4-86F6-C471EB506FCF.jpeg|thumb|102px|A ''Haste+'' effect (left) and ''Haste'' effect (right).]] '''Haste''' grants +10% player movement speed for 20 seconds. It can be stacked up to 10 times, granting 2x (not +100%). Haste does not affect the speed of bees or of players while using the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]]. The [[Honey Dispenser]], the [[Treat Dispenser]], the [[Blueberry Dispenser]], and the [[Strawberry Dispenser]] grant x5 Haste. The [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] grants x10 Haste.

The Haste buff is consumed by the player's Tornado ([[#Tornado|see below]]) to improve the summoned tornado.

Haste is granted by [[Hasty Bee|Hasty]], [[Shocked Bee|Shocked]], [[Ninja Bee|Ninja]], and [[Photon Bee|Photon]] Bees. It can also be granted by bees that equip a [[Toy Drum|toy drum]] [[beequip]], a [[Whistle]], and balloons during a surprise party.[[File:Capture818218328657923564764.JPG|thumb|139px|Ninja Bee with a Haste Token.]]

Haste tokens have a use cooldown of 4.5 seconds, a trial cooldown of 4.5 seconds and a trial success rate of 25%. It takes 4 seconds to fade away and can be generated at any time. The stacking time is the same as the effect duration, 20 seconds. Adding another token resets the timer to 20 seconds, i.e. it does not add another 20 seconds.

Some [[codes]] have given the '''Haste+''' ability, which doubles movement speed. This was originally planned as one of Ninja Bee's abilities but was abandoned as it was too overpowered. The only area that gives out the Haste+ Ability (excludes codes) is the Free Royal Jelly Dispenser inside the [[Star Hall]]. This type of Haste also stacks with the normal Haste tokens produced by the bees and given by dispensers which grant up to x4 speed. Haste+ lasts for 1 minute.

The [[Stick Bug Challenge#Splinter Trap|Splinter Trap]] from the [[Stick Bug Challenge]] has the same effect icon as Haste+, but instead of getting a speed boost, the player takes 3 damage every second while also receiving a quarter reduction in movement speed and jump power. The player receives a Splinter Trap when either the Stick Bug jumps into the flowers, when Stick Bug moves to another field, or anytime when Stick Bug reaches level 12. Instead of having a duration, the player must collect pollen to remove the Splinter Trap or eventually die.

The following audio plays when the token is collected:[[File:Haste sound-effect.mp3]]

{{clear}}

===Honey Gift=== [[File:Honey Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Honey Gift image]] [[File:HoneyGift.png|thumb|A Honey Gift token, which can be spawned by either a Honey Bee or Diamond Bee|alt=|181x181px]] [[Honey Bee]] occasionally generates a '''Honey Gift''' token worth 100 [[honey]] multiplied by bee [[Bond|level]] squared. [[Diamond Bee]] also sometimes generates a '''Honey Gift+''' token worth 250 honey multiplied by bee level squared. These amounts '''cannot''' be increased by [[Loot Luck]] and they depend on the player's [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey from Tokens]] statistic. (There is no visual difference between Honey Gift and Honey Gift+ tokens).

Honey tokens take 10 seconds to fade away. Honey Gift tokens (i.e., those dropped by bees) can be generated anytime.

{{clear}}

===Focus=== [[File:Focus Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Focus Token image.]]'''Focus''' grants +3% [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]] for 20 seconds. It is activated only while the player is collecting pollen or fighting. It can be stacked up to 10 times. Critical hits increase pollen and damage by 100%. When collected, green and white sparkles appear on the player's bees and their character.

Focus is granted by [[Looker Bee|Looker]], [[Commander Bee|Commander]], and [[Music Bee|Music]] Bees. It can also be granted by [[Puppy Bee]] if it equips a [[Reindeer Antlers|reindeer antlers]] [[beequip]]. Other than from bees, Focus can be granted by activated targets from [[Precise Bee|Precise Bee's]] [[#Target Practice|Target Practice]] ability, and the buff can be granted with 80% chance from collecting a Target Practice token outside of a field.

Focus tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and can only be generated by active bees. The stacking time is the same as the effect duration, 20 seconds. Adding another token resets the timer to 20 seconds, i.e. it does not add another 20 seconds.

The following audio plays when the token is collected:[[File:Focus.ogg]]

Note: The audio in-game in sped up and the pitch is increased.

{{clear}} ===Token Link=== [[File:Token Link Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Token Link image.]] A '''Token Link''' collects all other ability tokens (except for other Token Links) and grants 25 honey and an additional 10 honey per level for each other token collected this way (e.g. 175 honey per token collected on level 15 bee).

For stacking purposes, note that the ability tokens created first, get used first. If two or more link tokens are collected at the same time, they may link the same tokens. The other tokens activate once, but the player gets two sets of honey from link tokens.

Token Link tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated by active bees.

Token Link are generated by [[Exhausted Bee|Exhausted]], [[Rage Bee|Rage]], [[Shocked Bee|Shocked]], and [[Music Bee|Music]] Bees. It can also be generated by bees that have the [[Paper Angel]] [[beequip]] equipped and balloons during a surprise party.

A Token Link can also collect Honey Gift tokens generated by [[Honey Bee]], [[Diamond Bee]], honey tokens from [[Vicious Bee|Vicious Bee's]] Impale, [[treat]] tokens from [[Puppy Bee|Puppy Bee's]] Fetch ability, tokens from [[Festive Bee|Festive Bee's]] Festive Gift ability, tokens from Cub Buddy gifts, or tokens from mobs. However, it does not collect honey tokens generated by [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|Coin Scatter]], [[Passive Abilities|Gummy Star]] or Target Practice.

{{clear}} ===Mark=== [[File:Marks Token Repicture2.png|thumb|left|185px|'''Pollen Mark''' (left) and '''Honey Mark''' (right).]] A '''Mark''' token deploys a Mark in a random area on a field that grants a specific buff when the player stands in its range. '''Pollen Mark''' increases all pollen by 50% (+50% per stack). The buff can stack with other pollen boosting buffs such as Baby Love, Bear Morph, and Inspire. '''Honey Mark''' grants 2 conversion links (lets 2 bees convert from your backpack) and x1.25 convert rate (+2 and x1.25 per stack respectively). '''Precise Mark''' increases Critical Chance and Super-Crit chance by 7%. A normal Mark lasts for 7 seconds (+0.2s per level) with a 4-tile-radius range (The mark is activated if the player stands within 4 tiles of it.) while Mark+ lasts for 8 seconds (+0.25s per level) with a 5-tile-radius range. When the player stands in a Mark range, the Mark glows and the light on top turns green.[[File:PollenMark.png|thumb|200px|A Pollen Mark on a field.]]

Each Mark can be stacked to increase its effect, up to 3 stacks. Marks can only stack if two or more Marks are linked. Marks can be linked by overlapping each other. If the player stands in a Mark that is linked to another one, all linked Marks are activated.

When the player walks off the Honey Mark's range, conversion links remain, and bees still convert honey normally until they finish converting.[[File:Linked Pollen Mark.png|thumb|200px|Two Pollen Marks stacked above each other.]]

Pollen Mark is granted by [[Stubborn Bee|Stubborn]] and [[Carpenter Bee|Carpenter]] Bees. Pollen Mark+ is granted by [[Vector Bee]]. Honey Mark is granted by [[Honey Bee|Honey]] and [[Festive Bee|Festive]] Bees. Honey Mark+ is granted by [[Carpenter Bee]]. It can also be generated by balloons during a surprise party.

The player can see other people's Marks, but they can't see those Marks' range, the Marks don't grant buffs to them, they can't be linked with their Marks, and vice versa (except for festive marks).

Connecting 10 marks in a row gives the Saturn [[sticker]].

All Mark token types take 8 seconds to fade away and are only generated while collecting pollen.

The following audio plays when a mark pops up:[[File:Marktoken.ogg]]

{{clear}} ===Rage=== [[File:Rage Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Rage Token Image]] [[Rage Bee]] and [[Spicy Bee]] generate '''Rage''' tokens that grant bees +1 [[System Page#Bee Attack|attack]] for 45 seconds, which can be stacked up to 4 times. When collected, an angry war scream can be heard, which happens in increasing pitch with higher stacks of Rage.

Rage tokens take 24 seconds to fade away and are only generated while in combat. The stacking time is the same as the effect duration, 45 seconds. Adding another token resets the timer to 45 seconds, i.e. it does not add another 45 seconds.

The following audio plays when the token is collected [[File:RageAbilitySound.ogg]]

Note: The audio in-game is sped up and the pitch is increased.

{{clear}} ===Baby Love=== [[File:Baby Love Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Baby token Image]] [[Baby Bee]] and [[Tadpole Bee|Gifted Tadpole Bee]] generate '''Baby Love''' tokens that grant x2 pollen and +50% [[Loot Luck]] for 30 seconds. Loot Luck increases the player's chances of getting items from mobs. When collected, a baby's laugh can be heard, and pink and white sparkles appear on the player's character. Baby Love does not stack, though collecting another Baby Love token resets the timer to 30 seconds. The doubled pollen ''does'' stack with the Bear Morph, Inspire, and Pollen Marks. Additionally, there is a rare chance for {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers|4=0}} to have the ability if a {{Cost|Caustic Wax|4=0}} is used on it.

Baby Love tokens take 8 seconds to fade away and can be generated at any time.

The following audio plays when the token is collected: [[File:Giggle.ogg]]

Note: The audio in-game is cut, sped up and the pitch is increased.

{{clear}}

===Melody=== [[File:Melody.png|left|thumb|90x90px|Melody token image]] [[Music Bee]] generates a '''Melody''' token that grants +100% [[Critical Power]] for 30 seconds. Critical Power increases the pollen and damage of critical hits. When collected, black and white sparkles appear on the player's bees and their character. Melody can also be generated by [[#Surprise Party|Surprise Party]]. Certain bees can generate Melody if they have a {{Cost|Toy Horn|4=0}} or a {{Cost|Kazoo|4=0}} [[Beequip]]. Rarely, {{Cost|Whistle}} or {{Cost|Charm Bracelet}} can also allow bees to generate Melody.

Melody does not stack but collecting a second Melody token while theMelody is still active resets the timer to 30 seconds.

Melody tokens take 8 seconds to fade away and are only generated by active bees.

The following audio plays when the token is collected: [[File:Melody.ogg]]

{{Clear}}

===Inflate Balloons=== [[File:Inflate balloon.png|left|thumb|90px|Inflate Token image]] [[Buoyant Bee]] generates an '''Inflate Balloons''' token. When collected, Buoyant Bee increases the pollen stored inside the [[Balloon]]s on the field you are in by +5%, which increases by +0.01% per level. It then summons a Blue Balloon that floats around the field for 20 seconds (+2s per level) with capacity that scales with the player's capacity, this bee's level, and currently active [[field boost]] stacks. Pollen collected from flowers within the balloon area (shaded flowers) is added to the balloon instead of the container. Upon reaching max capacity or reaching the time limit, the balloon floats back to the player's hive. Converting from a balloon at the hive grants bonus Capacity and Honey at Hive for 1 hour.

Standing in a balloon aura grants x1.02 Pollen and +2% Honey from Tokens which stacks up to 10 times.

If Buoyant Bee is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]], there is a 5% (+0.5% per lvl), doubled if the field is boosted, chance to summon a Gold Balloon instead. Gold Balloons have x1.25 capacity of blue Balloon, gain bonus pollen, and will float to nearby Bubbles to transform them into Gold Bubbles, which collect 50% more pollen and have a chance to spawn Honey Tokens.

Inflate Balloons tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated when collecting pollen.

The following audio plays when the token is collected:

[[File:Bububub.mp3|left|thumb]]

{{Clear}}

===Surprise Party=== [[File:Surprise Party Token.png|left|thumb|90px|Surprise Party token image]] [[Buoyant Bee|Gifted Buoyant Bee]] generates Surprise Party tokens that summons a Gold Balloon (+1 every 5 lvls) for all players, then causes all Balloons to spawn random ability tokens for a few seconds. Gold Balloons gain bonus pollen and transform nearby Bubbles into Gold Bubbles, which collect 50% more pollen and have a chance to spawn Honey Tokens. Once a player collects the token, a big party popper appears with a server-wide message announces: "🎉Surprise balloons from [Player's display name]!"

'''Ability tokens spawned by balloons through Surprise Party include:'''

[[#Boost|Blue Boost]] White Boost [[#Bomb|Blue Bomb]] Buzz Bomb [[#Mark|Pollen Mark]] Honey Mark [[#Haste|Haste]] [[#Token Link|Token Link]] *[[#Melody|Melody]]

If you triggered Surprise Party within the last 8 minutes, it instead performs Inflate Balloons that guarantees a Gold Balloon. The cooldown only applies to you, meaning that after you trigger a Surprise Party, other players can also trigger a Surprise Party before your cooldown ends.

Surprise Party take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated when collecting pollen.

The following audio plays when the token is collected: [[File:PartyMusic.ogg|left|thumb]]

{{Clear}}

===Fuzz Bombs=== [[File:Fuzz Bombs Token.png|thumb|left|Fuzz Bomb token image]] [[File:FuzzyAbility.png|thumb|Summoned fuzz bombs on a field.]] [[Fuzzy Bee]] generates a '''Fuzz Bombs''' token which summons 2 fuzz bombs (+1 every 5 levels). Fuzz bombs wander around the field in a zigzag path on which they are spawned for 8 seconds. When touched by players, tornadoes, or [[Petal Wand|Petal Shurikens]], it collects pollen from 29 surrounding flowers and may [[Pollination|pollinate]] nearby [[flowers]]. It also grants the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|bomb combo buff]] which increases bomb power. The amount of pollen collected scales with [[System Page#Buzz Bomb Pollen|Buzz Bomb multiplier]] and bee level.

Fuzz Bombs tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated when collecting pollen.

Onett said in Discord that Fuzz Bombs used to be called "Dust Bunnies".

The following audio plays when the token is collected:[[File:Fuzzbombtoken.ogg]]

The following audio plays when a fuzz bomb is hit:[[File:Fuzzbombhit.ogg]]

{{Clear}}

===Pollen Haze=== [[File:Pollen Haze Token.png|thumb|left|Pollen Haze token image]] [[Fuzzy Bee|Gifted Fuzzy Bee]] generates a '''Pollen Haze''' token that summons a haze over the field for 30 seconds. During that time, up to 30 random [[flowers]] [[Pollination|pollinate]] every second, flowers grow faster, and Bomb Tokens are automatically collected and have a chance (0.8) to pollinate flowers.

If there has been a Pollen Haze over the field within the last 3 minutes, it acts as a Fuzz Bombs token instead.

Pollen Haze tokens take 8 seconds to fade away and are only generated when collecting pollen.

The following audio plays when the token is collected:

[[File:Pollen haze.wav]]

{{Clear}}

===Target Practice=== [[File:Target Pratice Token.png|left|thumb|Target Practice token image]] [[Precise Bee]] generates a '''Target Practice''' token. When collected on a field, it causes the bee to fly above the field you're in and face the part of the field it is opposite from. Then it projects 3 targets, from the closest to farthest from the bee for a few seconds. Walking on and passing the target(s) activates it which then will shortly be shot by the bee, spawning a [[#Focus|Focus]] token and collecting pollen from 29 surrounding flowers. The amount of pollen collected is equal to x2 Precise Bee's [[Bee Attack|attack]] and increased by +10% per level, and with [[Buffs & Debuffs|Flame Heat]] the shot gains up to x4 pollen and up to +50% instant conversion. If the targets aren't activated, they spawn [[#Boost|red boost]] tokens instead.

If the player is shot while standing on a target, it collects all ability tokens and consumes all Flame Heat to instantly convert pollen from the player's container, with half of that turning into 5 honey tokens. The amount of pollen converted is equal to 50% [[System Page#Total Convert|total conversion]] + x10 Precise Bee's convert amount and increased by up to x10 with consumed Flame Heat and up to x3 with [[field boost]] stacks.

When all 3 targets are activated, it collects all ability tokens and grants a stack of [[Buffs & Debuffs|Precision]], which grants +2% [[System Page#Super-Crit Chance|super-crit chance]] for 60 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Super-crits only occur when performing a critical hit, which doubles and instantly converts pollen collected, while attack damage is increased by 33% of pollen from a super-crit.

If Precise Bee is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]], the farthest target appears in purple. When only the farthest target is activated, it will summon a Precise Mark for 12 seconds (+0.5s per level) with a 5-tile-radius range. Precise Marks grant +7% critical chance and super-crit chance that stacks up to 3 times.

If the player collects a Target Practice token that is outside of a field, they will immediately be granted either the Precision or Focus buff. The chances of getting the Precision buff are 20%, and 80% for Focus buff.

Target Practice tokens take 8 seconds before fading away and are only generated by active bees.

The following audio plays when a target is shot: [[File:Rec-tab.mp3|left|thumb]]

{{clear}}

===Inferno=== [[File:Inferno Token.png|thumb|left|Inferno token image]] [[Spicy Bee]] generates an '''Inferno''' token, which summons 6 flames in circle form, and then summons 2 [[Fire Bee]]s that last for 15 seconds (Increased by 1 second per level of Spicy Bee) with levels equal to 2 less than the bee that summoned them. Flames collect pollen, deal damage to enemies ignoring defense and critical hits, and grant [[Buffs & Debuffs|Flame Heat]] when the player stands nearby.

If the Spicy Bee is [[gifted Bee|gifted]], each summoned Fire Bee has a 10% (+1% per lvl) chance of being gifted.

Inferno tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated by active bees.

The following audio plays when the token is collected:[[File:Inferno1.ogg]]

{{clear}}

===Flame Fuel=== [[File:Flame Fuel Token.png|thumb|left|Flame Fuel token image]] [[Spicy Bee|Gifted Spicy Bee]] generates a '''Flame Fuel''' token that increases flame duration by 50% for 15 seconds. During that time, oil will be tossed to every newly created flame, causing them to convert 50,000 pollen + 10% of the player's total hive convert. Oil will also be tossed to every newly created dark flames even if they were from the same flames.

Flame Fuel tokens take 4 seconds to fade away and are only generated by active bees.

The following audio plays when the token is collected:[[File:Flamefuel2.ogg]]

{{clear}}

===Summon Frog=== [[File:Summon Frog Token.png|thumb|left|Summon Frog token image]] [[Tadpole Bee]] generates a '''Summon Frog''' token, which summons a [[Frog]] that hops around and creates Bubbles. Festive Mark lasts for 12 seconds (+0.5s per level) and has a 6-tile radius. [[File:Festive Mark Image.jpg|thumb|A Festive Mark on a field.]]

Unlike other marks, Festive Mark also grants boosts to other players and its range can be seen by other players. It also can link with other players' marks. Despite showing (x1) when hovering over the buff, the Festive Mark cannot be stacked even if two overlap each other.

When Festive Mark is active, it summons random gifts within its range that can be collected by any player and flashes colors cycling through red, blue, green and yellow at the top of the pole. Rarer gifts appear more likely with bee level and certain gifts are only obtainable when Festive Bee is gifted. Every 4th token generated by the festive mark is always a Red Boost token.

'''The gifts include:''' {{Cost|Red Boost Token}}. {{Cost|Treat}}. {{Cost|Strawberry}}. {{Cost|Pineapple}}. {{Cost|Blueberry}}. {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}. {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}}. {{Cost|Ticket|4=0}}. {{Cost|Gumdrops}}. {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Magic Bean|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Blue Extract|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Red Extract|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Glue|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Oil|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Glitter|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Enzymes|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Field Dice}} (Rare). {{Cost|Micro-Converter|4=0}} (Rare). {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=0}} (Very rare). {{Cost|Festive Bean|4=0}} (Exceptionally rare). *{{Cost|Flying Festive Bee Sticker|4=0}} (Beesmas only, Unbelievably rare in red fields, odds increase with bee's level)

Festive Mark tokens take 16 seconds to fade away and are only generated while collecting pollen.

docs.title: Aged Gingerbread Bear
docs.text:
{{Unobtainable}} {{Consumables |image=Gingerbread Bear.png |description=This cookie has aged an entire year or more! Gives 500 bond to the fed bee and has a 1.1% chance to turn that bee Gifted. }}

Not to be confused with {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}.

An {{Color|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} is a type of [[Treats|treat]] that was added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]]. When fed to a bee, it raises its [[bond]] by 500 and has a 1.1% chance of turning the bee gifted. Unused {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} would transform into aged gingerbread bears after the next [[Beesmas]] has started. These cannot be used to purchase items from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]].

The formula for the chance of turning a bee gifted is as follows: ([1 - 0.989^x]* 100)\%, where x is the number of {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} fed to a bee.

== Ways to Obtain == * The only intended way to obtain Aged Gingerbread Bears is by saving {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} until the start of the next Beesmas.

=== Outdated Ways === *Collecting the Gingerbread Bear token hidden next to the cave in the Retro Swarm Challenge sometime after Beesmas Winter 2024 began.

== Gallery == Agedgb.png|Aged Gingerbread Bears in a player's inventory.

== Trivia == * This, along with {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} and {{Cost|Star Treat}}, are the only items that can turn [[Bees/Event|Event bees]] gifted (as they lack favorite treats.) * {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} do not apply for quests that ask for the player to feed {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} to their bees, such as [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] "Snow Cub Reformation (2/5)" quest. * If you got the free Gingerbread Bear from the Retro Swarm Challenge before Winter Beesmas 2024, even if it wasn’t a year before, when Beesmas started, that Gingerbread Bear immediately turned into an Aged one. * Feeding 100 Aged Gingerbread Bears to a bee does not guarantee to turn it gifted. The chance of it becoming gifted is about 67%. {{Inventory}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Treats]]

==History==

SDMittens was #1 for over 11 months before being surpassed by Gumaden on 6/11/2019, meaning she had the record of being #1 the longest. Gumaden surpassed her due to SDMittens playing other games besides [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. This record was broken by e_lol, he had been #1 for 1 year, 10 months, and 4 days. Gumaden was #1 for only roughly 1–3 hours before being surpassed by zlib. But then a few days later, Gumaden took back the #1 spot. Gumaden kept that spot for over 6 months before once again being passed by zlib. zlib kept the #1 spot for just under 1 month before being surpassed by Gumaden. On 12/31/2019, zlib broke the world record of most honey in a day, making over 8 trillion honey (excluding exploiters). On 1/9/2020, he broke that record, as he made over 10 trillion honey in a single day. On 8/22/2020, IcedMizu made 28 trillion honey in a single day. On 8/26/2020, e_lolYouTube made 116 trillion honey in a single day. On 2/17/2021, Gifted_Ty made 383 trillion honey in a single day (he was later removed from the leaderboard for abusing glitches). On 2/27/2022, OnettsStepSis made 1 Quadrillion honey in a single day. On 10/05/2022, FragileSilence made 2 Quadrillion honey in a single day. On 2/27/2021, Gifted_Ty was blocked from the All-Time Top Honeymakers leaderboard due to glitch abusing. This put e_lolYouTube in first place, riaz1987 in 2nd place and MrMocito in 3rd place at the time. On 3/01/2022, e_lolYouTube hit 10 Quadrillion honey, but the leaderboard reached its limits of displaying more than 10 quadrillion. It was later fixed on 3/03/2022. On 3/03/2022, A player named "moivnvodich" made 2.5 quintillion honey through exploiting. On 3/04/2022, User "moivnvodich" got their data resetted and was banned from BSS. In an interview with the 2 users behind the "moivnvodich" account, they revealed that they had modified the old infinite honey exploit (involving the wind shrine), in order to not get leaderboard banned. The reason they didn't show up prior to 3/04/22 is because leader boards previously didn't support numbers with more than 17 digits (10 quadrillion). On 3/11/2022, Three players named "123404az", "ProSupHeo" and "Grete_HD" made a large amount of honey through exploiting, with 123404az making 9.2 Quintillion honey, ProSupHeo making 2.4 Quintillion honey and Grete_HD making 550 Quadrillion honey. Interestingly, 9.2 Quintillion honey is the 64-bit integer limit. On 3/13/2022, Six players appeared on the leaderboard, with honey amounts ranging from 22 quadrillion honey to 9 Quintillion honey. Interestingly, three of said exploiters had the exact same amount of honey, at around 9.2 quintillion. On 3/14/2022, Three players appeared on the leaderboard, with honey amounts of 60 Quadrillion, 1 Quintillion and 2.28 Quintillion (when rounded off). They exploited their way through the leaderboard, and were removed the next day. On 12/29/2022, BuyKocmoc, GRANNY5556665, and six other players went up the leaderboard by exploiting with honey amounts of 175 Quadrillion, 55 Quadrillion, and other amounts. They were later removed and then Onett went on #1 of the leaderboard. On 3/29/2023, e_lol is the first player to be #1 for an entire year. *On 12/20/2023, e_lol hit 100 quadrillion honey for the first time. * On 1/12/2024, due to the honey being gathered during a round in Robo Bear Challenge counted in general honeymaking. Every player's honey made during the Robo Bear Challenge was fixed and the total honey displayed in the leaderboard was reduced by the calculated amount of honey made in all of the players' Robo Bear Challenge sessions.

  • On 01/31/2024, e_lol hit 100 quadrillion honey for the first time after losing several quadrillions of honey 19 days prior.
  • On 2/01/2024, FragileSilence passed e_lol. That put him in 1st place on the leaderboard.

==Trivia== This leaderboard and the Daily Top Honeymakers leaderboard were the only leaderboards to have abbreviated numbers before the 1/12/2024 update. This leaderboard is one of two leaderboards to be in the game since its release date, the other one is the [[Global Top Battlers (Most Battle Points)|Global Top Battlers]] leaderboard.

docs.title: Amulet
docs.text:
An '''amulet''' is an item introduced in the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]]. They grant several [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] to the player and/or their [[bees]], and can be obtained by completing special challenges, which are defeating the [[King Beetle]], discovering [[Gifted Bee|gifted bee]] types, participating in the [[Ant Challenge]], using the [[Moon Amulet Generator]] (requires 100 [[Moon Charm|moon charms]] to activate), defeating the [[Stump Snail]], having at least 1 million (1,000,000) score and at least a level 5 [[Stick Bug]] in the [[Stick Bug Challenge]], or beating at least 5 levels in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]].

== Scheme Of Table == [[File:Scheme-0.png|thumb|246px|The scheme for the Ant Amulet.]] [[File:Amulet disconnection message.png|thumb|The message that appears when a player joins a server after disconnecting with an undecided amulet.]] Collecting an amulet will bring up a table with the old and new amulets' stats, and the option the keep old amulet or replace it. The scheme on the left shows an example table, with the player's amulet type as well as other rewards. If the player has obtained the amulet from the Ant Challenge or Stick Bug Challenge, their score will be shown above the rewards.

Clicking "'''Keep Old'''" will cause the player to keep their current amulet and clicking "'''Replace'''" will cause the player to receive a confirmation message asking if they want to replace it. If the player has agreed to replace their amulet after the confirmation message, the player's old amulet will be replaced with the new one. '''This cannot be reversed'''. Note that the drops will still be received even if the player didn't replace their amulet. If two or more tables are shown, the previous table(s) are closed, and the newest table is displayed.

As of the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]], a confirmation message will now pop up if the player tries to replace an amulet if they already had that type of amulet.

As of the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]], disconnecting while a recently generated amulet is undecided gives the player another chance to choose upon going back in a server. [[File:Equipnewamulet.png|thumb|The confirmation message that appears when the player wants to replace their amulet.]]

==Trivia== *Supreme amulets are the only amulets that change color slightly.

docs.text:
The '''Ant Amulet''' is an [[amulet]] that is always obtained from participating in the [[Ant Challenge]].

The amulet gives the player buffs and will always boost [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]]. There are five tiers of Ant Amulets, each awarded at a certain amount of points in the Ant Challenge: {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Requirement(s) !Amulet |- |0-24 Points |[[File:Bronze Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Bronze Ant Amulet |- |25-49 Points |[[File:Silver Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Silver Ant Amulet |- |50-99 Points |[[File:Gold Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Gold Ant Amulet |- |100-149 Points |[[File:Diamond Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Diamond Ant Amulet |- |150+ Points |[[File:Supreme Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Supreme Ant Amulet |}

The buffs for each amulet are generated randomly. Higher tiers of amulets award more and stronger buffs, starting with three buffs for Bronze and reaching six buffs for Supreme. The quality of the buffs increase with the player’s score until a score of 400, so a score of 99 will have better buffs than a score of 55.

[[File:Antchallengeinfo.png|alt=|thumb|The Ant Challenge Info.]] The '''Ant Challenge Info''' is located behind the [[Ant Gate]] and to the right of the [[Ant Challenge]]. == Dialogue == {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Dialogue |- |Welcome to the Ant Challenge! Spend {{Cost|Ant Pass|1}} to enter the Ant Field. Collect pollen and honey to fill the meter on the ant hill. When it reaches the top, ants will pop out. Each ant you defeat grants 1 point. Defeat as many ants as you can in 5 minutes to increase your reward! Rewards include: [Royal Jellies], special treats, Honey, and [Ant Amulets]. Amulets are special items that offer a variety of boosts. The higher your score, the better your [Ant Amulet] will be. 0-24 Points: Bronze Ant Amulet. 25-49 Points: Silver Ant Amulet. 50-99 Points: Gold Ant Amulet. 100-150 Points: Diamond Ant Amulet. 150+ Points: Supreme Ant Amulet. [Removed dialogue]: (There’s something else written here...) » ☺ While traveling from east to west, this could require urgent rest. |}

docs.title: Ant Challenge
docs.text:
[[File:Antchalnewest.png|thumb|The interior of the Ant Challenge area.]] [[File:Antchalexteriornew.png|thumb|The exterior of the Ant Challenge area.]]

The '''Ant Challenge''' is a [[:Category:Challenges|challenge]] found past the [[Ant Gate]], with the objective being to defeat as many ants as possible.

== Accessing and Participating == The player needs 20 [[bees]] in order to pass the Ant Gate and play the Ant Challenge. An [[Ant Pass|ant pass]] is also required each time to participate in the challenge. The player can obtain a free {{Cost|Ant Pass|||0}} every two hours by using the [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]] behind the Ant Gate. If players wish to get more ant passes, they can purchase another one for {{Cost|Ticket|10}} each at the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]]. [[Panda Bear]] also gives ant passes in his [[quests]] sometimes.

== Gameplay == Upon entering, the remaining [[pollen]] in a player's bag is instantly converted. The player has 5 minutes to defeat as many ants as they can. The timer on the right side of the anthill shows the time remaining for the challenge. The ants come in waves, starting with level 1 and 2 ants, and they increase in level with each wave. Each wave launches an assortment of ants that contain [[Regular Ant]]s, [[Fire Ant]]s, [[Army Ant]]s, and/or [[Flying Ant]]s. Every 5th wave always contains a [[Giant Ant]], with the exception of every 40th wave, which contains 2 giant ants. Each ant defeated grants 1 point.

To progress, fill the meter on the anthill by gathering pollen. The amount of pollen needed to progress to the next wave starts at 4,000 and increases by at least 2,000 more than the previous requirement for each wave. [[File:Lawn Mower.png|thumb|150px|A lawnmower during the Ant Challenge.]]

Upon reaching wave 8, the white doors on the sides will start flashing red. This indicates that a lawnmower is about to come out and pass through the lane the door directs to. Move away from the targeted lane to avoid getting damaged. Getting hit by a lawnmower deals 50 base damage.

Lawnmowers will move faster and appear more frequently as the challenge progresses, with multiple lawnmowers running simultaneously possible near the end of the challenge.

The challenge ends upon the player's death, leaving the challenge, or when the 5 minutes are up, whichever happens first. While having the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Haste+]] buff, if the player walks up the ant hill, the player may leave the challenge. This is a common glitch.

==Rewards== After the challenge ends, a message box pops out on the player's screen presenting the rewards.

{| class="article-table" !Guaranteed Rewards List |- |{{I|Supreme Ant Amulet}} [[Ant Amulet]]{{Cost|Royal Jelly}}{{Cost|Honey}} |}

{| class="article-table" !One of the rewards from this list |- |{{Cost|Treat}}{{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}{{Cost|Strawberry}}{{Cost|Blueberry}}{{Cost|Pineapple}}{{Cost|Neonberry}}{{Cost|Jelly Beans}}{{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}}{{Cost|Bandage|4=0}}{{Cost|Bottle Cap|4=0}}{{Cost|Candy Ring|4=0}}{{Cost|Camphor Lip Balm|4=0}}{{Cost|Poinsettia|3=(Only During Beesmas)|4=0}}{{Cost|Left Facing Ant Sticker||(Very Rare)|0}} {{Cost|Ant Field Stamp Sticker||(Unfathomably Rare)|0}} {{Cost|x2 Convert Speed Voucher|3=(Nearly Impossible)|4=0}} |}

The rewards increase in quality and quantity relative to the player's score. A higher score will also give players higher-tier Ant Amulets: {| class="sortable article-table" !Requirements !Amulet |- |0-24 Points |[[File:Bronze Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Bronze Ant Amulet |- |25-49 Points |[[File:Silver Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Silver Ant Amulet |- |50-99 Points |[[File:Gold Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Gold Ant Amulet |- |100-149 Points |[[File:Diamond Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Diamond Ant Amulet |- |150+ Points |[[File:Supreme Ant Amulet.png|40px]] Supreme Ant Amulet |}

If the player already has an existing Ant Amulet, they may choose to keep their old one or replace it with the new one, depending on which one has better/more favorable buffs.

==Tips== Try to collect as many [[token]]s ([[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]], [[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|Baby Love]], [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]], etc.) as possible before participating in the challenge. [[Rage]] tokens can be used to take out ants faster, as they increase [[System Page#Bee Attack|Bee Attack]]. Certain [[mutation]]s on [[bees]] that increase attack will also help in defeating ants faster. Higher [[Bond|level]] bees will be able to make the later waves easier to get through. Bees with higher attack and/or speed will also prove to be more effective than those with lower attack and/or speed. A high-level [[Vicious Bee]] is vital, as the spikes from its ability, [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]], can deal significant damage to multiple ants. In addition, wait to activate the ability when many ants are in the arena to maximize it effectively. * A [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Stubborn Bee]] can help in this case as it increases the lifespan of ability tokens, giving the player more time to spawn ants before activating abilities. [[Windy Bee|Windy Bee’s]] [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|Tornado]] can be even more effective than Impale in the Ant Challenge. Not only does it collect pollen, but it also deals massive area damage (which cannot miss) and collects tokens. However, haste stacks and powerful [[sprinklers]] are required to maximize their potential. {{Cost|Honey}} tokens can be used to fill the progress meter on the anthill, so the player may consider using [[Honey Bee]]s or [[Diamond Bee]]s to spawn [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|Honey Gift]] tokens, or using a [[Festive Bee]] to collect honey tokens from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gifts]]. Having [[amulet]]s that boost bee attack damage, a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Brave Bee]], and a Gifted [[Rage Bee]] makes it easier to defeat ants. The [[Fire Mask]] and [[Demon Mask]] will boost attack and add [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Flames|Flame-generating passives]]. Well placed Flames will grant Flame Heat, collect pollen, and do damage to nearby ants. Using {{Cost|Stinger}} will boost attack for a short time, which helps clear ants faster and deal with higher-level ants. The player can also use {{Cost|Red Extract||Red}} and {{Cost|Blue Extract}}, {{Cost|Oil}}, {{Cost|Glue}}, {{Cost|Tropical Drink}}, and {{Cost|Gumdrops}}. This will help with honey production and boost bee capabilities but isn't necessary to get a good score. {{Cost|Coconut}} can prove to be an unpredictable but powerful tool to take out clusters of ants. {{Cost|Coconut}} can deal incredible amounts of damage, are capable of damaging high-level ants, and collect decent amounts of pollen. If the player has [[Coconut Clogs]], catching coconuts will also grant [[Passive Abilities#Coconut Haste|Coconut Haste]], which temporarily makes the player and their bees faster. This can be useful to escape dangerous areas. To maximize the score, defeat as many ants as possible in the first three minutes, as later waves get more difficult and the lawnmowers appear more frequently and move faster. Tools are the best way to fill up the honey meter, this because your bees will be attacking and won't be able to collect pollen. If there is too many ants and the bees can't deal with them, the player shouldn't use their Tool because it will fill up the honey meter (if in the field) and summon more ants. ** Since the player has 100% [[Instant Conversion]] in the Ant Challenge, don't try to go after tokens from [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|Coin Scatter]] or coconuts, since they won't have much value, as they have nothing to convert from, making them virtually useless. Sprinklers can be useful for regenerating flowers and making pollen collection easier, especially when ants and lawnmowers cut the player off from certain areas of the field. During any beesmas, try to play the ant challenge with the Honeyday Buff, this will increase how fast the meter fills Using the [[Glider]] can help as the player can glide over ants and fire trails, escaping from certain situations. Zoom out all the way to see where all the ants are and where lawnmowers may be coming from. When new ants spawn, it is a good idea to go as far away from the ant hill as possible, to avoid being hit by an incoming ant. [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]], a [[Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulet]] passive, is very effective at defeating ants and collecting pollen. Standing near the side of the field where the lawnmowers come out can make the lawnmowers easier to avoid. The player use the small gap between the field and the wall to avoid running over fire trails, though lawnmowers and ants can still damage the player. If a [[Honeystorm]] is summoned during the challenge, it is a good idea to go after the honey tokens in earlier waves or when there aren't too many ants since the honey tokens collected can contribute significantly to the honey meter when a large number of tokens are collected. * While the [[Coconut Canister]]’s ability, Emergency Coconut Shield, is active, getting hit by the lawnmowers will heal the player instead of damaging them. Wear the Gummy Mask and intentionally activate [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] during harder stages of the challenge, as this grants +300 attack to Gummy Bee. Intentionally activate the Emergency Coconut Shield 2–4 minutes before starting the challenge to avoid wasting it in early levels. * Though the ants spawned during the challenge are random, it is possible to predict what ants might spawn. During the first 15 rounds, flying ants are generally more common than army ants. After 15 rounds, army ants become much more common. Giants ants spawn every 5 waves, and always come with either fire ants or regular ants. This information can be helpful when dealing with quests that require defeating specific types of ants. Having {{I|Invigorating Nectar}}[[Nectar|Invigorating Nectar]] can help buff bee attack.

==Music== [[File:Antmarch1.ogg]]

==Trivia== If the player uses a {{Cost|Whirligig|4=0}} during an Ant Challenge, it will teleport the player to the starting platform after teleporting to the hive, thus ending the challenge and granting an amulet with the score the player left with. Despite being lawnmowers, they actually do not affect any of the flowers when they pass through. Since the [[Egg Hunt 2019]] update, the player can get {{Cost|Jelly Beans}} as a reward from the Ant Challenge. If the player uses jelly beans while inside or right outside the Ant Challenge, no jelly bean tokens will appear.[[File:Ant Pass AntChallenge.png|thumb|163px|The Ant Challenge instant conversion buff.]] Upon entering the arena, the player's bag will instantly be converted, and the player will gain a boost of +100% [[Instant Conversion]]. The boost is represented by the {{Cost|Ant Pass|||0}} icon. There used to be a visual glitch that when leaving the ant challenge, the player would still have this buff. It was only a visual glitch, so the player did not actually have a +100% Instant Conversion boost active. Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], a Haste token with an expired timer would represent the boost is now represented as the {{Cost|Ant Pass|||0}} icon. There is an ant pass token hidden behind the Ant Challenge area. To get it, go behind the [[All-Time Top Ant Exterminators|leaderboard]] and follow the hallway around the corner. This also leads to the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]]. If the player has equipped their tool and dies right when the Ant Challenge is about to end, they will respawn without their pollen collector equipped. However, the character's arm will be positioned to look like it’s actually holding it. There used to be a bug where the pollen meter displayed the cumulative total instead of the total required to reach the next wave. This was fixed in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]]. Players are able to glitch into the [[Ant Field]] without triggering the actual challenge. This can only be achieved by having a slow internet connection or [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|bear morph]] and/or [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Haste+]]. If the player leaves their sprinkler(s) in the field and the challenge ends without the player dying, the sprinklers remain in the field. If a player glitches inside and then someone starts it, then the player who glitched in will be kicked out. There is a rare [[Glitches#Ants Stuck in Wall|glitch]] where an Ant or a Fire Ant can get stuck on the wall where the lawnmowers come from. There was a glitch prior to February 2022, where sometimes, when the player starts the challenge, they won't actually be teleported inside, forfeiting the challenge instantly. Giant Ants will give the player's bees 3 bond, being the least efficient way to level up bees. * There seems to be a maximum of 100 possible waves for the player to go through. This is because it takes about three seconds to progress to the next wave and there is a total time limit of 5 minutes (300 seconds). 300 seconds divided by 3 seconds would be 100 waves. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Challenges]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

{{Field|fieldcolor=Assorted|bees=20|width=32|height=12|image=AntField1.png}}The '''Ant Field''' is a [[Fields|field]] located past the [[Ant Gate]] and near the [[Top Ant Exterminators]] leaderboard. It can only be accessed by starting the [[Ant Challenge]] which will summon waves of [[ants]].

This is a 12×32 field, containing 384 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, and the only natural size in single. {| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Red ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |72 |''{{Hover|20%|19.95%}}'' |138 |''{{Hover|35.6%|35.57%}}'' |174 |''{{Hover|44.5%|44.47%}}'' |384 |'''''100%''''' |- !Double |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |'''''0%''''' |- !Triple |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |'''''0%''''' |- !Total |'''83''' |'''''{{Hover|20%|19.95%}}''''' |'''148''' |'''''{{Hover|35.6%|35.57%}}''''' |'''185''' |'''''{{Hover|44.5%|44.47%}}''''' |'''384''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can produce [[honey]] and [[ticket]] tokens while collecting [[pollen]].

The only [[Bees|bee]] that likes the Ant Field is [[Lion Bee]]. There are no bees that dislike the Ant Field.

[[Planter]]s cannot be planted in this field, although [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] has stated that the Ant Field contains [[Nectar|Invigorating Nectar]].

== Obtaining Boosts ==

  • Using an [[Ant Pass]] to start the Ant Challenge will give 100% Instant Ant Field Conversion.
  • There is no possible to way to boost the pollen for the Ant Field.
  • The flowers can still be [[Pollination|pollinated]].

== Gallery == Ant Field Icon.png|An unused Ant Field boost icon. Antchallengenewsurroundings.png|The Ant Field next to the Ant Pass Dispensers, the Top Ant Exterminators leaderboard and the [[Hive Hub|Hive Hub Portal]] viewed from the Ant Gate. Ticket from ant challenge.jpg|A player getting a ticket from the Ant Field. Hivesticker ant field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]]. File:Sussy ah ant field glitch.png|A player in the Ant Field without starting the challenge.

== Trivia ==

  • You can collect pollen from the Ant Field outside the challenge by using the [[Sticker-Seeker]] or spawning flames with the [[Scythe]].
  • The Ant Field is the only [[fields|field]] that does not have its own [[badges|badge]].
  • [[Lion Bee]] is the only bee to like the Ant Field; all other bees are neutral to this field.
  • The Ant Field is the only field to have exclusively single [[flowers]]. ** The flowers on this field contain 50 pollen per flower, and instead of going up by 15 pollen per tier, go up 10 per [[pollination]] tier up to 90, although pollen multiplier remains the same as regular flowers.
  • The Ant Field is the only field that can't be boosted with [[glitter]], the only field where a [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] cannot be planted, the only field where [[clouds]] cannot be summoned, the only field that had no Market Boost from the [[Boost Market]], the only field that can't get [[Field Wind|winds]] from the [[Wind Shrine]], and the only field where [[planter]]s cannot be planted.
  • The Ant Field is the smallest field in the game with 384 flowers, smaller than the [[Pumpkin Patch]] with 561 flowers and the [[Stump Field]] with 563 flowers.
  • The Ant Field is one of the 5 fields that are exclusively used for a challenge. The others are: Mixed Brick Field, White Brick Field, Blue Brick Field and Red Brick Field.
  • Players are able to glitch into the Ant Field without triggering the actual challenge. This can only be achieved by having a slow internet connection or [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|bear morph]] and/or [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|haste+]].
  • Despite being impossible to boost, the Ant Field has an unused [[Field Boost]] icon. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Fields]] [[Category:Locations]]

{{Bee Gate|title1 = Ant Gate|image1 = NewAntGate.png|caption1 = The Ant Gate |mobs = * [[Regular Ant|Ant]] * [[Army Ant]] * [[Flying Ant]] * [[Giant Ant]] * [[Fire Ant]] |shops = * [[Ant Pass Dispenser]] * [[Stinger Shop]] |fields = * [[Ant Field]] |extras = * [[Ant Challenge]] * [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]] * [[Ant Challenge Info]] * [[Top Ant Exterminators]] * [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] * [[Hive Hub|Hive Hub Portal]]}}The '''Ant Gate''', also called the '''20 Bee Gate''', is a [[:Category:Gates|gate]] that requires 20 [[bees]] to pass through. It is found near the [[Noob Shop]], behind the traveling/event bear (e.g. [[Sun Bear]]) area. The gate gets its name from the large [[Army Ant]] on it.

== Music == During [[Day/Night Cycle|daytime]], the audio "Wax" plays here.

[[File:Wax.ogg]]

During [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]], the audio "Drone" plays during daytime instead.

[[File:Drone.ogg]] == Trivia == This gate and the [[Bear Gate]] are the only gates that don't have a bee to represent them. This gate and the [[Windy Bee Gate]] are the only gates in the game that don't have a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} token in the area behind it. However, the Windy Bee Gate has a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} token, making this the only gate without any royal jelly tokens at all. This gate and the Windy Bee Gate are also the only gates that is designed based on a component of the zone (e. g. The Ant Gate has the [[Ant Challenge]] in it). The [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] is near this gate, to the side of the Ant Gate closest to the [[hive]]s. There is a {{Cost|Ticket|||0}} token on top of the gate. The [[Army Ant]] on top of the gate has glowing eyes, but in the [[Ant Challenge]], Army Ants (and all the other [[ants]]) do not have glowing eyes. As of the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], you will get teleported back to spawn if you manage to bypass the gate. There is a secret path behind the Global Top Ant Exterminators Leaderboard, which leads to an {{Cost|Ant Pass|||0}} and the Gummy Bee Egg Claim. This gate indirectly has a temporary quest giver, being [[Gummy Bear]] and his quest "Gummy Bear's Goo Years Beacon". This and the [[Basic Bee Gate]] are the only gates that lead to an area where there is nothing able to be purchased with {{Cost|Honey}}. *This is the only gate to have a [[Mobs|mob]] representing it. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Gates]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

{{Consumables |image = Ant pass.png |description = Grants you 1 admission to the Ant Challenge. |cooldown = No cooldown |cap = 10 }}

An '''Ant Pass''' is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates|7/11/2018 update]]. You must use one in order to participate in the [[Ant Challenge]]. Players can only have a maximum of 10 ant passes in their inventory at a time (unless they had more than 10 passes before the 4/5/2019 update, purchased them from [[Robux Shop|Robux packs]], or received them from quests).

An ant pass can be used by stepping on the pad in front of the Ant Challenge and pressing "E" on the player's keyboard or by clicking on the prompt.

== Methods of Obtaining == * There is a [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]] past the [[Ant Gate]] which can be used every two hours. * There is also an [[Ant Pass Dispenser]] to the right of the Free Ant Pass Dispenser which gives an ant pass for 10 [[ticket]]s with no cooldown. ** If the player already has 10+ ant passes, they cannot claim a free ant pass from the Free Ant Pass Dispenser or use the Ant Pass Dispenser. * Completing [[Panda Bear#Star Treat Quests/Ant Quests (15)|Panda Bear's Ant Questline]] rewards an ant pass after every [[Quests|quest]]. (Excluding Ultimate Ant Annihilation 5) * A possible reward from a [[Ladybug]], [[Aphid#Rage Aphid|Rage Aphid]], [[King Beetle]], and [[Tunnel Bear]] when defeated. * Defeating the [[Commando Chick]] will reward ant passes if the player reaches certain milestones. * Ant passes are sometimes available in the [[Robux Shop]], generally combined with other things in sale packs. * There are two ant pass tokens hidden in the game. ** Behind the Ant Challenge (go behind the [[Top Ant Exterminators]] Leaderboard, then go through the tunnel and exit out through the other side). ** At the very back of the [[Star Hall]] behind the Supreme Star Amulet Generator.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Oodlesofnoodles (Granted {{Cost|Ant Pass|1}} and other stuff). ** ExtraPass (Granted 1 Ant Pass). ** SecretProfilecode (Granted {{Cost|Ant Pass|1}} and other stuff). * Finishing [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee Man's]] B.B.M. Mission quest rewarded an ant pass.

== Gallery == AntPassToken.png|An ant pass token. Morethantenantpasses.png|A player with more than 10 ant passes in their inventory at once. File:Antpassinstarhall.png|An ant pass in the Star Hall before the Supreme Star Amulet was added.

== Trivia == * If the player finds an ant pass token, it will say "You found '''a''' Ant Pass" instead of "You found '''an''' Ant Pass." ** The plural of the ant pass is incorrectly spelled as "Ant Passs".

{{Mob |title=Ant |location=[[Ant Field]] while the [[Ant Challenge]] is active. |hp=25 base; Increases by level |damage=40 |points=None |bond=None |honey=None |level=1-16 (Varies with Wave) |image=ant-0.png }} ''Not to be confused with [[Ants]], the family of mobs that includes Ants along with the other ant types.''

An '''Ant''' is one of five mobs that is part of a family called Ants that are exclusively found in the [[Ant Challenge]], past the [[Ant Gate]].

This is the first Ant Challenge [[Mobs|mob]] that the player will encounter, appearing on the very first wave.

Ants move in a fixed straight line and are the most generic ant. They are the most common ant and will always appear in the first few waves. They are the easiest ant to deal with due to how basic they are compared to the other ants.

An ant's level can increase depending on what wave of the Ant Challenge the player is on. They can range from level 1 up to level 16.

They are by far the least threatening of the five ant types, as they are often easily and completely avoidable.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |25 |- |2 |35 |- |3 |45 |- |4 |75 |- |5 |105 |- |6 |135 |- |7 |165 |- |8 |205 |- |9 |245 |- |10 |295 |- |11 |335 |- |12 |385 |- |13 |435 |- |14 |485 |- |15 |545 |- |16 |605 |}

== Strategies ==

  • Ants move in predetermined straight lines and are quite slow. This enables to player to easily dodge any coming their way.
  • Standing near the ant will allow your bees to quickly target the ant to quickly deal damage and defeat it.
  • Ants will come out in groups and they could overwhelm the player if they are collecting pollen quickly to advance to the next waves. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control with their [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Ability_Tokens?so=search#Impale Impale] and [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Ability_Tokens?so=search#Tornado Tornado] abilities which could greatly help counter the large amounts of Regular Ants landing on the field. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many ants at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

== Gallery == File:RegularAnt1.png|An ant near a falling Coconut. File:RegularAnt2.png|A group of four ants. File:RegularAnt3.png|An ant stunned by Digital Bee's Mind Hack.

== Trivia ==

  • The [[Ant Amulet|Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond Ant Amulets]] represent an ant.
  • This is the only mob to have the same name as a group of mobs.
  • They have the same health per level as [[Fire Ant]]s. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

docs.title: Ants
docs.text:
[[File:AntGateStatue.png|thumb|224px|A statue of an Army Ant on the Ant Gate.]] '''Ants''' are [[mobs]] exclusively found in the [[Ant Field]] during the [[Ant Challenge]], past the [[Ant Gate]]. In the Ant Challenge, the player fights waves of ants before the timer runs out. The level and health of the ants gradually increase as the player completes more rounds in the Ant Challenge.

== Types == There are 5 types of ants. Giant Ants, Army Ants, and Flying Ants are the only types that give [[bond]] upon defeat. Giant Ants give 3 bond each, while army ants and flying ants give 1 bond to each of the player's bees (not accounting for [[System Page#Bond From Battle|Bond From Battle]], though it is usually too small of a boost to change the amount). The bond from ants don't appear as a notification.

All ants deal 40 damage on contact except the giant ant, which deals 60 damage.

=== Ants === {{Main|Ant}}[[File:Ant-0.png|thumb|150px|An Ant.]] '''Ants''' move in a predetermined straight line and are the most generic ant. They only have around 25 health at level one and are by far the least threatening of the five ant types, as they are often easily and completely avoidable. They are the most common ant and will always appear in the first few waves.

=== Army Ants === {{Main|Army Ant}}[[File:ArmyAnt.png|thumb|150px|An Army Ant.]] '''Army Ants''' have army helmets on their heads and will pursue the player. They have the ability to pounce, have a higher damage output, and have a little more health than normal and fire ants (about 35 at level one). Less damage is dealt to these ants because of their defense. Army Ants can spawn as early as the first wave, but they usually start appearing at around the second or third waves. If they appear, they occasionally spawn in waves, but not always.

=== Flying Ants === {{Main|Flying Ant}}[[File:FlyingAnt.png|thumb|150px|A Flying Ant.]] '''Flying Ants''' are ants with wings that track the player. They are the fastest out of the five ant types and have the ability to pounce on players from a considerably farther distance than the army ant. However, the twist is that they also have low health, similar to the amount of an Army Ant or even sometimes a normal one. Flying Ants can spawn as early as the first wave, but they usually start appearing at around the second or third wave. They deal higher damage than a normal ant.

=== Giant Ants === {{Main|Giant Ant}}[[File:Giant_Ant.png|thumb|150px|A Giant Ant.]] '''Giant Ants''' are enormous versions of the normal ant that relentlessly pursue the player. They are relatively slow, ensuring that if the player constantly moves away, it cannot reach them. However, they have large amounts of health (about 10 times the health of an ordinary ant) and high attack power to compensate. Because of their high health, they can 'tank' hits from bees and allow their smaller, faster comrades to attack the player without any chance of being defeated. Their size makes them harder to avoid. A Giant Ant will spawn every five waves (5th, 10th, 15th, etc.)

=== Fire Ants === {{Main|Fire Ant}}[[File:FireAnt.png|thumb|150px|A Fire Ant.]] '''Fire Ants''' are colored red and act the same as regular ants, but they leave a damaging fire trail behind them as they move. Their flames deal 30 damage if touched. The flames will linger even after the Fire Ant that left it is defeated. The fire disappears after a short amount of time. Fire Ants typically spawn in the later waves, such as after the first Giant Ant. Noted by [[Panda Bear]], the fire from a Fire Ant is not affected by [[System Page#Defense|Defense]], but this seems to be untrue. However, having 100% defense (though [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]]) will nullify the damage.

== Use in Quests == * After completing [[Panda Bear#Gold Egg Quests|Panda Bear's Gold Egg questline]], Panda Bear has 15 [[Panda Bear#Star Treat Quests/Ant Quests|Ant Quests]]. Each of these quests requires the player to defeat several ants, with an occasional other requirement added in. Each ant quest grants at least one [[ticket]] and one [[Ant Passes|Ant Pass]]. Most of the quests also grant [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]]. The main prizes from the questline are a [[Egg#Diamond Egg|Diamond Egg]] (after five ant quests), [[Egg#Star Egg|Star Egg]] (after ten), and [[Star Treat]] (after all 15). * Each of [[Onett|Onett's]] five Star Journey quests requires the player to defeat ants along with several other requirements. * In [[Sun Bear|Sun Bear's]] second visit, he has some quests that require the player to defeat normal Ants and Giant Ants. * [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] "Limits of Language" quest requires defeating ants along with several other requirements. * [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Gifted Bucko Bee's]] "Bombard" and "Picnic" quests require the player to defeat Ants and Army Ants. * [[Gifted Riley Bee|Gifted Riley Bee's]] "Rampage" and "Picnic" quests require the player to defeat Fire Ants. * [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] Beesmas 2020 quest, "Gummy Bear's Goo Years Beacon", requires the player to defeat 75 ants. This quest is no longer obtainable.

== Tips == * Jumping usually helps get away from Army Ants, Flying Ants, and Giant Ants (a [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]] helps in this strategy). * Bees will focus on one ant at a time. If the player wants a specific ant defeated, they just have to get closer to it than any other ant, which will cause the bees to attack it. **In this regard, prioritizing defeating Fire Ants is a good choice, since their flames can easily become extremely disruptive. * Getting higher level bees will make sure that the bees will land their hits. * Bees with high attack like [[Lion Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Brave Bee]], etc., are very helpful in dealing good damage. * [[Gifted Bee]]s do extra damage and can provide bonuses (e.g., Brave Bee give +1 [[Bee Attack|Attack]], [[Looker Bee]] gives +25% [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/System_Page#Critical_Power Critical Power], and [[Commander Bee]] give +25% [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/System_Page#Critical_Chance Critical Chance]). * [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control, especially since ants often come in pairs or packs. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many ants at once, and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]]. * When a wave starts, the player should stay by the glass wall opposite the anthill to avoid ants pouncing/landing on them when they spawn.

== Trivia == * Normal and Fire Ants, along with [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], [[Mondo Chick]], [[Stick Bug]], and [[Stick Nymph|stick nymphs]] are the only mobs that do not grant [[Battle Points|battle points]] when defeated. * All ants, along with the [[Coconut Crab]], [[Cave Monster]]s, [[Robo Bear Challenge]] mobs and [[Snowbear]] are the only mobs to not drop [[Honey]] upon defeat. * Ants and Stick Bug don't have a respawn timer or time range, unlike other mobs. The only way to spawn them is by starting a [[:Category:Challenges|Challenge]]. * The amount and types of ants vary for each round, and it's possible to get a different score each time. * Ants, [[aphid]]s, [[chicks]], [[Stick Nymph]]s ([[Festive Nymph]]s), [[Mechsquito]]s, [[Cogmower]]s, [[Cogturret]]s, and [[Mega Mechsquito]]s are the only mobs that come in different varieties. * All types of ants, Mechsquitos, Cogmowers, Cogturrets, and Mega Mechsquitos are the only mobs to not drop any loot upon defeat. * The Supreme Ant Amulet is the only Ant Amulet that resembles a Flying Ant while the others are normal Ants.

docs.title: Aphid
docs.text:
{{Mob|title = Aphid|image = Aphid.png|location = Leaves; every field in game (except the Ant Field, Hub Field and Stump Field).|timer = N/A; small chance from leaves.|hp = Varies between the level and type|damage = Varies on the type|points = 10 If normal; 20 If Rage, Armored or Diamond|bond = Varies between the level and type|honey = Varies between the level and type|level = 1-20}}

'''Aphids''' are hostile [[mobs]] that have a 0.932% chance (1 in 107) of spawning from collecting [[leaves]], with the chances increasing when a Field is experiencing a period of low activity (i.e. players are not visiting said field very often). Their level and health correlate to which [[field]] the aphid spawns in, like [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]. Sharing a similar trait with [[Tunnel Bear]], [[Coconut Crab]], [[Chicks#Chick|Chicks]], [[Chicks#Hostage Chick|Hostage Chicks]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]], and [[Puffshroom]]s, players have a limited time (30 seconds) to defeat an aphid. After the time is up, the aphid despawns. The timer is shown above its health. Aphids attack in a similar matter to [[Stick Nymph]]s and [[Ants|Giant Ants]], following the nearest player around slowly. Aphids are public mobs, meaning that anyone can collect the drops regardless of whether or not they attacked it.

Defeating an aphid awards 10 [[Battle Points]] (20 if defeating one of the 3 rare types), [[Bond]], and various other rewards. Some rewards have a cooldown, meaning that they will not be obtainable for a while after receiving them once, regardless of the level or type. However, you can still get them through other players spawning an aphid with said rewards at the expense of applying the same cooldown to them also.

== Types ==

Aphids always appear as 1 of 4 different variants: Normal, Rage, Armored, and Diamond. Different types of aphids may spawn at different encounter rates. Rewards vary between these types. {{Cost|Honey|}} amounts depend on the aphid's level and player's honey per token boost.

{{Tabber |Normal Aphid|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}Normal Aphid{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:NormalAphild.png{{!}}left{{!}}200px]] This is the most common aphid that can be encountered. They possess the least amount of health and deal the least amount of damage out of all aphids. It has a green body with red eyes and neon yellow-green legs and antennae. {{clear}}

{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table" !Possible Drops List {{!}}- {{!}}10 [[Battle Points]]{{Cost|Honey}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter}}{{Cost|Magic Bean}}{{Cost|Gumdrops}}{{Cost|Treat}}{{Cost|Soft Wax}} (Guaranteed){{Cost|Field Dice}} (Rare){{Cost|Ticket}} (Rare){{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} (Beesmas Only){{Cost|Forward Facing Aphid Sticker|||0}} (Rare) {{!}}} |Rage Aphid|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}Rage Aphid{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:RageAphild.png{{!}}left{{!}}200px]] The Rage Aphid is one of the 3 rare types of aphids, the others being Armored Aphid and Diamond Aphid. The Rage Aphid has a higher chance to spawn in fields with red flowers. The Rage Aphid has higher health and deals the most damage out of all the aphids. They are colored similar to a [[Gifted Bee{{!}}Gifted]] [[Rage Bee]] or Gifted [[Spicy Bee]], with red bodies and green eyes, legs, and antennae. {{clear}}

{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table" !Possible Drops List {{!}}- {{!}}20 [[Battle Points]]{{Cost|Honey}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter}}{{Cost|Magic Bean}}{{Cost|Gumdrops}}{{Cost|Strawberry}}{{Cost|Pineapple}}{{Cost|Bitterberry}}{{Cost|Stinger}}{{Cost|Red Extract|1-5||1}}{{Cost|Enzymes}}{{Cost|Ant Pass}}{{Cost|Hard Wax}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|||0}} (Beesmas Only){{Cost|Red Wailing Cry Sticker|||0}} (Extremely Rare) {{!}}} |Armored Aphid|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}Armored Aphid {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:ArmoredAphild.png{{!}}left{{!}}200px]] The Armored Aphid is one of the 3 rare types of aphids, the others being Rage Aphid and Diamond Aphid. The Armored Aphid has a higher chance of spawning in mixed fields and fields with white flowers. The Armored aphid has higher defense compared to other types of aphids, allowing it to survive for a longer amount of time. It has a metallic gray body with red eyes and black legs and antennae. {{clear}}

{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table" !Possible Drops List {{!}}- {{!}}20 [[Battle Points]]{{Cost|Honey}}{{Cost|Treat}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter}} (Increments of 1 and 5){{Cost|Magic Bean}}{{Cost|Gumdrops}} (Increments of 3){{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}{{Cost|Stinger}}{{Cost|Coconut}} (Increments of 1 and 5){{Cost|Oil}} (Increments of 1 and 3){{Cost|Enzymes}}{{Cost|Glue}}{{Cost|Robo Pass}}{{Cost|Hard Wax}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Snowflake}} (Beesmas exclusive){{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} (Beesmas exclusive){{Cost|Small Shield Sticker|||0}} (Extremely Rare) {{!}}} |Diamond Aphid|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}Diamond Aphid{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:DiamondAphild.png{{!}}left{{!}}200px]] The Diamond Aphid is one of the 3 rare types of aphids, the others being Rage Aphid and Armored Aphid. The Diamond Aphid has a higher chance to spawn in fields with blue flowers. The Diamond aphid possesses more health than the other aphids, which allows it to survive for a longer period of time. It looks similar to a [[Diamond Bee]], with a sky-blue body and white eyes, legs, and antennae. {{clear}}
