==Tips== Jumping and/or running around aphids will prevent them from attacking effectively since they slowly follow players. If players cannot defeat an aphid due to higher level and health, leveling up bees and having bees specialising in attack, such as [[Vicious Bee]], will help kill the aphid faster. *Using various [[:Category:Consumables|consumables]] and [[Passive Abilities|passives]] such as {{Cost|Stinger}}, {{Cost|Coconut}}, {{Cost|Oil}}, or [[Passive Abilities|Star Saw]] can help defeat aphids faster.

== Gallery == File:ImageImage.jpg|An aphid in [[Mountain Top Field]]. File:ArmoredAphid.png|An Armored Aphid in the [[Coconut Field]]. File:Rage Aphid Rose Field.png|A Rage Aphid in the [[Rose Field]]. File:Diamond aphid.png|A Diamond Aphid in the Mountain Top Field. ==Trivia==

  • Aphids can spawn in the Retro Swarm Challenge.
  • [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Meteors]] and [[Wild Windy Bee]] collecting leaves can also spawn aphids. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]]

docs.title: Army Ant
docs.text:
An '''Army Ant''' is one of five mobs that is part of a family called [[Ants]] that are exclusively found in the [[Ant Challenge]], past the [[Ant Gate]].

{{Mob|title=Army Ant|image=ArmyAnt.png|location=[[Ant Field]] while the [[Ant Challenge]] is active.|hp=50 base; Increase by level|damage=40|points=None|bond=1|honey=None|level=1-16 (Varies with Wave)}}

This is one of the first Ant Challenge [[mobs]] that the player will encounter, capable of appearing on the very first wave. Despite being able to appear on the first wave, Army Ants usually start appearing at around the second or third waves.

Army Ants have army helmets on their heads and will pursue the player. They have the ability to pounce on the player and have a little more health than most other ants. Less damage is dealt to these ants because of their defense.

An Army Ant's level can increase depending on what wave of the Ant Challenge the player is on. They can range from level 1 up to level 16.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |50 |- |2 |60 |- |3 |70 |- |4 |100 |- |5 |130 |- |6 |170 |- |7 |210 |- |8 |250 |- |9 |300 |- |10 |350 |- |11 |400 |- |12 |460 |- |13 |520 |- |14 |580 |- |15 |640 |- |16 |710 |}

== Strategies ==

  • Army Ants are quite slow which gives the player time to react and dodge before they pounce on the player.
  • Jumping past the Army Ant will enable your bees to lock onto the Army Ant while letting the player get around the Army Ant without getting pounced on.
  • If they appear, they occasionally spawn in waves, but not always. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control with their abilities which could greatly help counter the large amounts of Army Ants landing on the field. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Army Ants at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

== Gallery == File:ArmyAnt1.png|An Army Ant next to a Gifted Frog. File:ArmyAnt2.png|A pair of Army Ants next to a Fire Ant. File:ArmyAnt3.png|An Army Ant getting hit by Vicious Bee's Impale. File:AntGateStatue.png|A statue of an Army Ant on the Ant Gate. File:Ant pass.png|An Army Ant being depicted on the Ant Pass.

== Trivia ==

  • These are the only mobs to wear equipment that gives defense against attacks.
  • There is a [[:Category:Gates|gate]] dedicated to it, which is the Ant Gate.
  • This mob is depicted on the [[Ant Pass]]. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

Mask''', or '''Bubble Bee Man Mask''', is a [[:Category:Hats|mask]] that was obtainable by completing [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee Man's]] [[Quests|quest.]], "Helping B.B.M." in Beesmas 2018. Mask are the only masks that cannot be purchased, and the only ones that do not have a description. * After the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 Update]], this mask became unobtainable as the NPC that provided it, Bubble Bee Man, was removed from its former location behind the Global Top Battlers leaderboard. This and the Mondo B.B.M. Mask are the only unobtainable accessories in the game. * The stats of the B.B.M. Mask have been changed three times. * Wearing the B.B.M. Mask does not give access to [[Dapper Bear's Shop]].

docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Baby_Bee.png |image-gifted = BabyBee Gifted.png |description = This little bee isn't very good at bee tasks yet, but it's guaranteed to bring you joy (and luck). |rarity = Legendary |color = Colorless |energy = 15 |energylabel = less |speed = 10.5 |attack = 0 |skincolor1 = #f1f1f1 |skincolor2 = #88dce8 |skincolor3 = #1b2a35 }}'''Baby Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bee]].

Baby Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Strawberry}}.

Baby Bee likes the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Sunflower Field]], [[Mushroom Field]], and the [[Blue Flower Field]]. It dislikes the [[Rose Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Pine Tree Forest]], [[Spider Field]], [[Pepper Patch]] and the [[Stump Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 5 seconds. * Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 5 seconds. * -25% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]] and [[Energy]]. Can't attack. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +25% [[System Page#Loot Luck|Loot Luck]].

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|[Baby Love]]]''' Grants x2 [[System Page#Pollen|Pollen]] and +50% Loot Luck for 30 seconds. Loot Luck increases your chance of obtaining prizes from defeating enemies.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 5|honey = 80|honeytime = 5|rarity = legendary|color = blue}}

== Gallery == BabyBee Hive.png|Baby Bee's old hive slot design. Gifted Baby Bee hive.png|A Gifted Baby Bee hive slot. BabyFace.png|Baby Bee's face. BabyBeeEggs Inventory.png|{{Cost|Baby Bee Egg}} in a player's inventory. File:BabyLove.png|Baby Love Token. File:Baby bee from Lid art.jpg|A Baby Bee summoned by [[Onett's Lid Art]]. File:Specific baby bee art.jpg|A close-up of Baby Bee from Onett’s Lid Art.

== Trivia == * Baby Bee has the second-lowest base energy (lowest being [[Tadpole Bee]]), second-lowest base [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]] (lowest being [[Fuzzy Bee]]), and the lowest base gather amount in the game. Baby Bee also has the second-slowest base gather speed, 1 second faster than Tadpole Bee and Fuzzy Bee. * Baby Bee and Tadpole Bee tie for the smallest [[bees]] in the game. They are also the only two bee types to have a different size compared to other bees. * Baby Bee is the only bee that has 0 base attack. Because of that, it cannot attack any [[mobs]], even if it has an attack mutation. ** Baby Bee used to be able to attack and could do damage if the player had any damage boosts. After the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 Update]], this is no longer the case. ** According to [[Black Bear]], the reason why they don't attack is because "They're too dumb to notice" the mobs. ** Even though it says, "0 attack", attack added to baby bee still counts towards total attack, which can buff [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]]. * Baby Bee, [[Bumble Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], and [[Exhausted Bee]] are tied as the slowest bees in the game. * Baby Bee has the most field preferences in the game. It also dislikes the most [[fields]]. ** Baby Bee prefers the lower-tier fields (Dandelion, Blue Flower, Sunflower, etc.) and dislikes the higher-tier fields (Rose, Cactus, Pine Tree Forest, etc.). * Baby Bee is the only bee that isn't red to like the Mushroom Field. *Baby Bee and [[Stubborn Bee]] are the only [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] bees that like strawberries. * Baby Bee and [[Rage Bee]] are the only bees with three unique colors on their skins. Baby Bee is also the only gifted bee with three unique colors on its skin. * There is a small chance that a Baby Bee egg will drop from [[Tunnel Bear]]. * Before 11/25/2018 update, the Gifted Hive Bonus of Baby Bee was +5% Loot Luck, which was then changed to +10% in said update. This was then changed to +20% Loot Luck in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 Update]] and once again to +25% Loot Luck in the Beesmas 2019 update. * Onett paid $2 for the laughing baby sound that Baby Love uses. It can be bought [https://audiojungle.net/item/baby-laughing/21354817 Here]. * This is one of the only 4 bees that has a specific egg obtainable from mob drops, with the others being a Rascal Bee egg from ladybugs, a Bumble Bee egg from rhino beetles, or a Honey Bee egg from cave monsters. * Baby Bee, [[Basic Bee]], and Bumble Bee are the only bees shown on [[Onett's Lid Art]]. * When gifted and in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Sunflower Field]], [[Mushroom Field]], or [[Blue Flower Field]] it has a very rare chance to find a {{Cost|Pale Heart Sticker|4=0}}.

docs.text:
[[File:BadgerBearersGuild2024.png|alt=The Badge Bearer's Guild.|right|200x200px]] The '''Badge Bearer's Guild''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located near the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. The player will need at least 15 [[badges]] of any rank past Junior to be permitted to enter the shop.

The shop sells a set of tools called [[sprinklers]]. There are currently 5 sprinklers that can be bought in the shop. The player can also find the [[Blender]] here, where they can [[Crafting|craft]] certain [[items]] from other materials. There is a [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|Star Jelly]] token on top of the Blender that requires an [[:Category:Accessories|accessory]] that boosts [[System Page#Jump Boost|Jump Boost]] or [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear morph]] activated to reach it. The [[Memory Match#Mega Memory Match|Mega Memory Match]] can also be found inside of this building.

On the opposite side of where the sprinklers are is a gate that requires 1 Ace Badge to pass through. Behind it, the player will discover another shop. This shop sells the [[Honeycomb Belt]], [[Crimson Guard]], [[Cobalt Guard]], and [[Honey Mask]], which appear to be hanging inside of a large honeycomb. In front of the honeycomb, there is another Star Jelly token. Behind the honeycomb, there is a secret glass-like passage that cannot be entered. It leads to a void-like area below the map.

Outside, it is decorated with the Badge icon in the menu on top of the entrance, along with a large [[Basic Sprinkler]] on the roof. The large sprinkler is not solid and can be walked through. The [[Mythic Meteor Shower]] Summoner also resides on the roof.

docs.title: Badges
docs.text:
[[File:BadgeIcon.png|thumb|180x180px|The badge icon.]] '''Badges''' are part of the achievement system of [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. There are currently 155 badges in Bee Swarm Simulator (including inactive badges). 30 of the badges are currently unobtainable.

Most of these badges are based on collecting a certain amount of [[pollen]] from a certain [[Fields|field]]. Obtaining a non-event badge awards {{Cost|Ticket}} and a permanent boost. Boosts in the same category do not stack - earning a higher-ranked badge overwrites the old boost with the new one. The number of {{Cost|Ticket}} earned depends on the rank of the badge earned.

The player needs the Goo Hotshot badge to enter [[Gummy Bear's Lair]], 15 badges of any tier to enter the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]], and one ace badge to access the special room in the Badge Bearer's Guild.

Certain badges also unlock the chance to obtain special one-time badge rewards from the [[Wind Shrine]] called Badge Shivers, which can be obtained by donating specific items. The more items you donate, the higher chance you have of a Badge Shiver.

To get more {{Cost|Coconut}} from the [[Coconut Dispenser]], the player must get better Coconut Badges, and to get more {{Cost|Glue|4=0}} from the [[Glue Dispenser]], better Goo Badges are needed.

Event badges are the only badges that don't give any tickets, permanent buffs, or even show up in the badge menu, but the Beesmas badges allow the player to get two different masks with some buffs (the [[B.B.M. Mask]] and the [[Mondo B.B.M. Mask]]), and the [[Egg Hunt 2019]], [[Egg Hunt 2020]], and the [[Ready Player Two]] badges each gave an item for the player's Roblox avatar. The only exception to this were the fifteen badges from [[Roblox: The Classic|The Classic]], the eight badges from [[The Games]], and the 2 badges from the [[Winter Spotlight]]. which didn't give any avatar items, but counted as currency in the event hubs.

Upon claiming any non-event badge, it will be announced in the server publicly, and a cheerful audio will play in the background, saying:

{{Notification|Honey|🥇 {Username} earned the {Badge Name} - {Badge Rank} 🥇|16}}

==Trivia== The [[Ant Field]] is the only field that doesn't have a badge. In the [[Updates#2018.06.02|6/2/2018 update]], {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}} prizes for badges were increased. If the player had already claimed these badges, they received the extra {{Cost|Ticket||4=}} when they logged back in. Even though Grandmaster Badges were added in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], their icons still show images of the map prior to the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]]. After the badges were released in the [[Updates#2018.05.12|5/12/2018 update]], the Clover Badge was bugged and did not give any loot luck. In the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], this has been fixed. The [[Hub Field|Hive Hub Badge]], [[Coconut Field|Coconut Badge]], [[Pepper Patch|Pepper Badge]] and the [[Mountain Top Field|Mountain Top Badge]] are the only badges that need more pollen than the other badges (10,000,000 pollen for Hive Hub Cadet, 50,000,000 pollen for Coconut Cadet and Pepper Cadet and 100,000,000 pollen for Mountain Top Cadet, rather than 250,000 for the other fields). Badges can be used to get badge shivers from the [[Wind Shrine]]. These can give good loot. However, each shiver can only be obtained once. As of 5/24/2024, the obtainable badges with the least amount of people to achieve them are the Hive Hub Grandmaster and the Mountain Top Grandmaster Badges, with only 15 and 1 players respectively. These milestones have been ruined when [[Onett]] accidentally uploaded debug tools into the main game on 6/6/2024. The Grandmaster [[Sticker Stack|Sticker Stack]] Badge is impossible to obtain due to the number of Stickers required (500) is larger than the number of Stickers in the game (288). docs.title: Bags
docs.text:
'''Bags''' are [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] that can be bought in the various [[:Category:Shops|shops]] around the map. The main purpose of bags is to store [[pollen]] gathered by the player until it is full, to which the player will need to go to their [[hive]] and convert it into [[honey]], use a Coconut, use an [[Instant Converter]], use a [[Micro-Converter]], use a [[Honeysuckle]] (only converts some) or admire [[Black Bear|Black Bear's]] [[Honey Wreath]] (only during Beesmas). When the player's bag is full, the following message is displayed: "Pollen container full. Go to your hive to make honey." They may use an [[Instant Converter]] to instantly get all their honey (costs 1 ticket) or use a micro-converter. Certain bags are intended to give the player additional boosts other than capacity, such as [[System Page#Instant Conversion|Instant Conversion]], [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]], [[Bee Attack]] and even [[Passive Abilities|Passives]] (currently only from the [[Coconut Canister]]). There are other accessories (such as [[:Category:Belts|belt bags]]) that increase capacity. The Pouch bag is given automatically to new players. There are currently 12 bags in the game.

docs.title: Balloon
docs.text:
'''Balloons''' are items that hold [[pollen]] for players and bring it back to the [[hive]] to convert into [[honey]] later. There are 6 types of balloons: pink, red, white, black, blue and gold. [[Pink Balloon|Pink]], [[Red Balloon|red]], [[White Balloon|white]], and [[Black Balloon|black]] balloons are summoned with [[items]]. Blue and gold balloons are summoned by [[Buoyant Bee]]'s abilities. The balloons return to the hive after reaching full capacity or after reaching their time limit. Capacity and time limit depends on the balloon type.

== In Fields == Balloons float around the [[Fields|field]], similar to [[Clouds]], and cast a 5-tile radius shadow on flowers underneath them. Pollen collected from these flowers is absorbed by the balloons above them. If multiple balloons have control over the same flower, the pollen is absorbed by the balloon with the lowest pollen amount in it. Balloons cannot absorb pollen from other players.

The pollen in balloons can also be increased by Buoyant Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Inflate Balloons|Inflate Balloons]] ability, though this can only happen 10 times maximum per balloon.

Standing underneath any player's balloon grants a stack of the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Balloon Aura]] buff. Each balloon the player is in radius of gives 1 stack of the buff, capping at x10 Balloon Aura. Each stack gives x1.02 pollen and +2% honey from tokens, capping at x1.2 pollen and +20% honey from tokens.

Gifted [[Ability Tokens#Summon Frog|Frogs]] from [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Tadpole Bee]], the [[Tide Popper]]'s waves and [[Windy Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|Tornado]] can also convert some pollen in the player's balloon into honey tokens. If the balloon is returning to the hive, it can still be converted from, and will drop its tokens around its last location on the field.

When a [[Ability Tokens#Surprise Party|surprise party]] activates, all balloons (regardless of color) will generate random ability tokens for a few seconds. These can be white and blue boost tokens, buzz and blue bombs, marks, Haste, Token Link, and Melody tokens. The boost tokens spawned seem to be based off the primary color of the field.

== Hive Balloon == When a balloon reaches the player's hive, it becomes part of the "Hive Balloon". The Hive Balloon will float in place, waiting to be converted. Once the player begins converting, their [[bees]] will first convert anything in their [[Items#Bags|bag]] before beginning to convert the hive balloon.

The hive balloon grants [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Balloon Blessing]] when fully converted, which grants [[System Page#Capacity|Capacity]] and [[System Page#Honey At Hive|Honey at Hive]]. The buffs given increase as the pollen needed for another stack increases. It takes 10 trillion pollen stored in the Hive Balloon to reach the maximum stack (x100) of Balloon Blessing, which grants x4 Capacity and x2.5 Honey at Hive. When granting the buff, it displays " 🎈The hive balloon granted you x{stacks} of Balloon Blessing! "

If the blessing of hive balloon is lower than what the player currently has, fully converting it it will instead refresh their balloon blessing timer, with the message " 🎈The hive balloon refreshed your Balloon Blessing! ".

Pollen in the hive balloon will begin to deplete depending on how big it is relative to the player's capacity. The slowest it will shrink is 20% per hour, and the fastest it will shrink is 99.99% in 10 minutes (if it contains over 100x the player's capacity). Keep in mind that this does not happen all at once, but rather gradually overtime until it reaches a sustainable level of pollen.

== Gold Balloon == Gold balloons are able to buff [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|bubbles]] that they pass over, turning them into [[Passive Abilities#Gathering bubbles|gold bubbles]]. Gold bubbles collect 1.5x more pollen, contribute 50% more time to [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|Bubble Bloat]] and have a 25% chance to create a honey token equal to the amount of pollen the bubble collected.

== Balloon Stats == {| class="article-table" ! ! style="text-align:center" |[[Pink Balloon]][[File:Pink Balloon.png|link=Pink Balloon|thumb|center|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" |[[Red Balloon]][[File:Red Balloon.png|link=Red Balloon|thumb|center|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" |[[White Balloon]][[File:White Balloon.png|link=White Balloon|thumb|center|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" |[[Black Balloon]][[File:Black Balloon.png|link=Black Balloon|thumb|center|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" |Blue Balloon ! style="text-align:center" |Gold Balloon |- |'''Count'''(How many can be on the field at once) |1 per player |1 per player |1 per player |1 per player |Unlimited |Unlimited |- |'''Capacity'''(How much pollen the balloon can hold) |Player's Capacity x1 |Player's Capacity x5 |Player's Capacity x10 |Player's Capacity x25 |Player's Capacityx0.1666... |x1.25 Blue Balloon (From own bee)Player's Capacity x0.05 (1/20) (From another player) |- |'''Time Limit'''(How long before the balloon returns to the hive) |3 minutes |3 minutes |5 minutes |5 minutes |20 seconds (+2 per level) |20 seconds (+2 per level) {{Clear}} 20 seconds (From another player) |- |'''Boost'''(How much pollen is boosted when going into the balloon) |x2 |+10% (+20% if red) (assumed) |+10% (+20% if white) (assumed) |x4 |+10% (+20% if blue) |Unknown (increases with level) |- |'''Obtainment''' (How each balloon is obtained) |Drop from [[Mobs]] |Drop from [[Mobs]] |Drop from [[Mobs]] |Drop from [[Mobs]] |Summoned by [[Buoyant Bee|Buoyant Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Inflate Balloons|Inflate Balloons]] |Summoned by [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] Buoyant Bee's Inflate Balloons or [[Ability Tokens#Surprise Party|Surprise Party]] |}

== Audio == [[File:Ballooninflate.ogg]][[File:Ballooninflate2.ogg]]The sounds Inflate Balloons make.

== Gallery == Ballon.png|A blue balloon summoned by a [[Buoyant Bee]]. GoldenBalloon.png|A gold balloon summoned by a Surprise Party. Red Balloom.webp|A red balloon summoned by a player. Black Balloom.webp|A black balloon summoned by a player. Pink balloon.webp|A pink balloon summoned by a player. White Balloom.webp|A white balloon summoned by a player. BalloonAura.png|The Balloon Aura icon. Blessing.png|The Balloon Blessing icon.

== Trivia == * If a balloon of any color is used and the player leaves the game, the balloon will disappear. * Balloons are the only non-limited/event items that aren't in [[crafting]] recipes. They also cannot be donated. * No matter what color balloon is used, when it arrives at the hive it will always turn blue. * Balloons are currently only obtainable through quests and mobs. * When converting at the hive, it is possible to glitch the Balloon Blessing. When converting the balloon, wait for the balloon to disappear, but leave the hive before it is finished converting. This will make the game put back the balloon in the hive with the same Balloon Blessing, yet give the Balloon Blessing buff, effectively duplicating the balloon. * Balloons at the hive are always blue, regardless of what balloons were used to add to it.

docs.title: Bamboo Field
docs.text:
{{Field |image = BambooField2.png |fieldcolor = Blue |bees = 5 |width = 39 |height = 18 }}The '''Bamboo Field''' is a [[field]] located past the [[Basic Bee Gate]], to the right of the [[Spider Field]], and 2 fields away from the [[Strawberry Field]]. It is protected by two [[Rhino Beetle]]s, one being level 2 and the other level 3.

This is an 18×39 field, containing 702 [[flowers]]. The flowers are blue and white, in sizes of single, double, and triple. {| class="article-table" !Flowers !White !Blue !Red !Total |- !Single |5% |15% |0% |20% |- !Double |18.75% |56.25% |0% |75% |- !Triple |1.25% |3.75% |0% |5% |- !Total |25% |75% |0% |100% |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. However, the percentages are theoretically correct and were confirmed by Onett.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[blueberry]], [[ticket]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|blue boost]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], and [[Blue Extract|blue extract]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Bamboo Field are [[Cool Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]], [[Carpenter Bee]], and [[Ninja Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Bamboo Field are [[Riley Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], & [[Windy Bee]].

This field grants Comforting [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

== Obtaining Boosts == [[File:Bamboo Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Bamboo Field Boost icon.]]

Using the [[Blue Field Booster]] may give a Bamboo [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +100% Bamboo Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[Glitter]] will add 100% Bamboo Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the boost isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|Field dice]], [[Smooth Dice]], or [[Loaded Dice]] may add +100% to 300% of Bamboo Field pollen for 15 minutes based on what type of dice is used, and also based on the current stack before the boost is added. Bamboo [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Bamboo Field conversion and give +5% instant Bamboo Field conversion and +15% Bamboo Field pollen for each stack. Bamboo Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. *It can be boosted by the [[King Beetle Amulet]]. If it has a Bamboo Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +100%.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

Giving a present to certain [[:Category:NPC|NPC]]s (2018): [[Panda Bear]] gave Bamboo Field Boost x4 and other [[items]]. [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] gave Bamboo Field Boost x3 and other boosts and items. [[Onett]] gave Bamboo Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. Giving a present to Panda Bear during Beesmas 2020 gave Bamboo Boost x3 and other items. Panda Bear gave Bamboo Field Boost x3 and other [[items]] during Beesmas 2021. * Redeeming certain expired codes: PandaPower (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x1 + other stuff). Teespring (Gives Bamboo Field Boost x3 + Bamboo Field Winds x3 + other stuff). 500mil (Gives Bamboo Field Boost x3 + other stuff). 1MLikes (Gives Bamboo Field Boost x1 + other stuff). WeekExtension (Gives Bamboo Field Boost x3 + Bamboo Field Winds x10 + other stuff). ** Friday (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x5 + other stuff). RobziRobot (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** 1mFavorites (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ExoExtract (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x3 + other stuff). August (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x3 + other stuff). FestiveFrogs (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x3 and Bamboo Field Winds x3 + other stuff). FestiveFinale (Gave Bamboo Field Boost x3 and Bamboo Field Winds x2 + other stuff). BlackFriday (Activated Bamboo Field Code Buff + other stuff). Purchasing a Bamboo Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Bamboo [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Bamboo Field Pollen, x1.1 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]].

== Gallery == hivesticker bamboo field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia==

  • This is one of six fields that [[fireflies]] can travel to, with the others being [[Cactus Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Rose Field]], Spider Field, and Strawberry Field.
  • The player can find 2 [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]] near the Bamboo Field, one in a nook under the ramp to the [[Brave Bee Gate]], and the other at the end of an [[Obstacle Courses#Bamboo Obby|obstacle course]], starting in between this field and the Spider Field.
  • The bamboo stems have claw marks on them, presumably from Panda Bear.
  • If a player stands on the corner of the Bamboo Field closest to the Spider Field while a [[Snowbear]] is summoned, the Snowbear can throw snowballs and damage the player. *The three bees that dislike the Bamboo Field also have another disliked field (Riley Bee and Precise Bee; Pine Tree Forest, Windy Bee; Strawberry Field)

docs.text:
{{Bee Gate|title1 = Basic Bee Gate|image1 = 5819DB6E-0C21-4C7E-83BE-A5A197D5FBA0.jpeg|caption1 = The Basic Bee Gate.|mobs = * 1 [[Spider]]. * 2 [[Rhino Beetle]]s. * 2 [[Ladybug]]s.|bears = * [[Panda Bear]].|shops = * [[Gumdrop Shop]].|fields = * [[Spider Field]]. * [[Bamboo Field]]. * [[Strawberry Field]].|extras = * [[Brave Bee Gate]]. * [[Honey Bee Gate]]. * [[Global Top Battlers Leaderboard]]. * [[Vicious Bee Egg Claim]]. * [[Moon Amulet Generator]]. * [[Obstacle Courses#Bamboo Field Obby|Bamboo Field Obby]].}}The '''Basic Bee Gate''', also called the '''5 Bee Gate''', is the first [[:Category:Gates|gate]] a player is tasked with unlocking. The gate requires you to own 5 [[bees]] or more to pass through.

It gets its name from the large [[Basic Bee]] that's on top of it.

The audio known as "[[Music|bpatrol]]" plays in the daytime while you are past this gate.

== Trivia ==

  • This is the only gate to have more than one gate directly leading from it, with those being the [[Brave Bee Gate]] and the [[Honey Bee Gate]].
  • This gate requires the least amount of bees to pass through.
  • This and the [[Ant Gate]] are the only gates that lead to a zone where there is nothing that can be purchased with [[Honey]].
  • [[Bubble Bee Man]] used to be behind the [[Global Top Battlers]] leaderboard. However, he was removed after Beesmas 2018.
  • Before the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]], [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] was located next to the ramp.
  • Underneath the ramp, on the side facing the [[Blue HQ]], there is a [[ticket]] token, previously a [[Plastic Egg]].
  • Due to a glitch, the [[Easter Eggs#Onett NPC|Onett statue]], located near the hives could have been seen near this gate. This glitch is now patched.
  • This gate is the only gate that cannot have a [[Wild Windy Bee]] spawn in any of its fields (without the assistance of [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]], during Beesmas or flying there from another field) (not counting the [[Ant Gate]] as it has only a challenge field or [[Bear Gate]] as the Bear Gate does not have any fields).
  • During Beesmas 2021, the Basic Bee model is seen wearing a festive Santa hat. ** This also makes the Basic Bee Gate the only gate that changes the bee's appearance during an event.

[[File:BasicGateXmas.png|thumb|The Basic Bee on top of the gate with a Santa hat on during Beesmas.]]

==Trivia== Basic Bee is the only type of Common bee. Due to the large number of appearances Basic Bee makes within the game and thumbnails, it is considered the main mascot of Bee Swarm Simulator. Basic Bee is one of three bees to have an official plushie on the [https://shop.beeswarm.com/ Official Bee Swarm Simulator Website], the others being Tabby Bee and Vicious Bee. The statistics for all other [[bees]] are described in terms of their difference from Basic Bee’s statistics. For example, +20 collection means that the bee it's describing has collected 20 more pollen than Basic Bee. Basic Bee and [[Brave Bee]] are the only bees without abilities. However, if they are in their [[Gifted Bee|gifted]] forms, they still can produce [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire tokens]]. And specific [[Beequip]]s grants abilities like [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] or [[Ability Tokens#Melody|Melody]] tokens. Because of this, during [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] "Ability Token Tidings" quest [[Bee Bear]] refers to Basic Bee and [[Brave Bee]] as "Poor little merely mortal bees". Bee Bear also says they aren't magic due to this fact. Basic Bee and [[Bees/Event|Event Bees]] are the only types of bee that cannot be obtained from a normal royal jelly since Basic Bee is a Common Bee. The [[Codes|code]], "DontUseThisJelly" (expired) gave a [[Royal Jelly#Royal Jelly Variants|Basic Bee jelly]] that could be used on a bee to transform any bee into a Basic Bee. Basic Bee and [[Demo Bee]] share the same skin color pattern when they are not in their gifted forms. Basic Bee and [[Honey Bee]] possess the same colors but in a different pattern. Basic Bee's gifted bonus used to give +20% [[System Page#Pollen|Pollen]], but it later got buffed after the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]] into x1.2 Pollen, so it can now increase with any additional pollen multipliers that the player has. An image of a winking Basic Bee face appears at the end of the White Tunnel. This may refer to the currently valid code called "Wink". This also appeared in the thumbnail of the [[Updates#2018.06.02|6/2/2018 update.]] Basic Bee is the only kind of bee to appear in every different version of the thumbnail for the game. Basic Bee, along with Tabby Bee and [[Rascal Bee]], are all of [[Onett (Developer)|Onett's]] favorite bees. This was revealed through Onett's dialogue. Basic Bee's face appears on the bee menu icon, found near the top left corner of the screen. Its face is also visible on {{Cost|Treat}}, {{Cost|Ticket}}, and the [[Beequip|beequip case]]. The chances of getting a Gifted Basic Bee from sunflower seeds is 1 in 12,000. ** The same chances apply to Legendary Bees if you feed them their favorite treats. The chances of hatching a Gifted Basic Bee from a Basic Egg is 0.348% (1 out of 287.35632184). On very rare occasions, Basic Bee's face would disappear on most surfaces that use its texture. *Basic Bee, [[Tadpole Bee]], Tabby Bee, [[Lion Bee]], Puppy Bee, and Bear Bee are the only bees to represent realistic animals. ** But only the [[Tadpole Bee]], Tabby Bee, [[Lion Bee]], Puppy Bee, and Bear Bee represent realistic animals if Basic Bee is not counted since all the bees in this game are bees. {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Common]] [[Category:Colorless]] [[Category:Bees]] [[zh-tw:基本蜂]] [[Category:Bee Swarm Simulator]]

{{Accessory |image1=Basic Boots.png |description=Collect pollen as you walk through flowers! |cost=4,400 [[Honey]], 3 [[Sunflower Seed]]s, and 3 [[Blueberry|Blueberries]]. |stats=+4 Player Movespeed+2 Movement Collection }} {{Quote|Collect [[pollen]] as you walk through [[flowers]]!}} The '''Basic Boots''' are a pair of [[:Category:Boots|boots]] that were added in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]]. They can be bought from the [[Noob Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|4,400}}{{Cost|Sunflower Seed|3}}{{Cost|Blueberry|3}} |}

==Trivia== These could've been obtained from [[Sun Bear]] by completing his first 5 [[quests]] before he left on 10/8/2018. These are the only boots that don't grant [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]]. Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], this item, the [[Hiking Boots]], and the [[Beekeeper's Boots]] didn't require any [[crafting]] materials. Unlike the [[Gummy Boots]] and [[Coconut Clogs]], these, along with the Hiking Boots and Beekeeper's Boots, were obtainable from quests. *These boots are used to obtain the [[Sticker#Sticker Index|Yellow Wiggly Walking Person Sticker]], by walking over a certain flower in the Starter, 5, and 10 bee zones (Flower is different for every player).

docs.title: Basic Egg Shop
docs.text:
[[File:Egg Shop.png|thumb|308x308px|The Basic Egg Shop.]] The '''Basic Egg Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located next to the [[Sunflower Field]] and behind an [[Instant Converter]]. It sells {{Cost|Basic Egg}} for increasing amounts of [[honey]].

The cost begins at 1,000 honey and increases exponentially (see [[#Formula|Formula section]] below), eventually capping off at 10,000,000 honey for the 22nd egg and beyond.[[File:EggPrices2.png|right|430x430px|alt=|A chart for the eggs' price.]] {| class="article-table" !{{Cost|Basic Egg}} !{{Cost|Honey}} |- |1 |1,000 |- |2 |2,500 |- |3 |4,250 |- |4 |6,708 |- |5 |10,313 |- |6 |15,669 |- |7 |23,670 |- |8 |35,648 |- |9 |53,596 |- |10 |80,506 |- |11 |120,858 |- |12 |181,378 |- |13 |272,151 |- |14 |408,304 |- |15 |612,527 |- |16 |918,857 |- |17 |1,378,348 |- |18 |2,067,580 |- |19 |3,101,426 |- |20 |4,652,191 |- |21 |6,978,337 |- |22+ |10,000,000 |}

==Formula== The cost of egg number N is calculated as follows: base = 1000 cost = base i = 0 while i < N-1 do cost = 1.5cost + base/(i+1) i = i + 1 end This comes out roughly exponential, but there isn't a "nice neat numbers" exponential formula. Base = 1000 t = Base i = 0 NN = 21 For [i=0; t= Base, i < NN, i++, t=1.5t+Base/(i+1);{Print[Floor[t+0.5]]}] This does not work for Term 22, as the price caps out at 10,000,000 honey.

==Trivia== *The Basic Egg Shop and stacking the [[Sticker#Stickers|Round Basic Bee sticker]] are the only ways to obtain a {{Cost|Basic Egg|4=0}}, other than the one given to the player at the start of the game. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Shops]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]] [[Category:Starter Zone]] [[zh-tw:基本蜂卵商店]]

docs.title: Basic Sprinkler
docs.text:
{{Sprinkler |image1 = Basic Sprinkler.png |requires = 10 Cadet Badges |cost = 1,111,111 Honey |description = When planted in the ground, causes ''[sic]'' nearby flowers to regrow faster! |count = 1 |radius = 7 |power = 7 |rate = 5 seconds |setup = 6 seconds }} The '''Basic Sprinkler''' is the lowest tier [[Sprinklers|sprinkler]] available for purchase in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]]. To unlock it, the player must obtain 10 different [[Badges|Cadet badges]]. Once the player unlocks it, they can purchase it for {{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|1,111,111|~1.1 million}}|4=0}}. Its description reads, "When planted in the ground, causes ''[sic]'' nearby flowers to regrow faster!"

The Basic Sprinkler is comprised of an individual sprinkler, meaning the player is able to place down only one sprinkler at any moment. Previous sprinklers are removed if a new one is placed.

Its radius extends to 7 [[Flowers|flower]] tiles, its rate is 5 seconds, and its power is 7.

== Audio == When a sprinkler is placed in a field, the following audio plays: [[File:Sprinklerbuild.ogg]]

When a sprinkler regenerates flowers, the following audio plays: [[File:Sprinklerwater.ogg]]

== Trivia == * The Basic Sprinkler is currently the cheapest sprinkler in the game. * The Basic Sprinkler takes the longest amount of time to setup at 6 Seconds.

docs.title: Battle Points
docs.text:
[[File:GlobalTopBattlersOctober5th2019.png|thumb|The Global Top Battlers leaderboard.]] '''Battle Points''' are points used for [[Global Top Battlers Leaderboard]] rankings and the [[Badges#Battle Badge|Battle Badge]]. They are obtained by defeating certain [[mobs]].

The player can see how many battle points they have by stepping on the pad in front of the Global Top Battlers Leaderboard or by looking in your [[Badges]] and scrolling down to the Battle Badge.

== Battle Points per Mob == * [[Robo Bear Challenge#Mobs|Robo Bear Challenge Mobs]], [[Ants]], [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], [[Stick Bug]], [[Stick Nymph|Stick nymphs]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], and [[chicks]]: No points. * [[Ladybug]]s, [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetles]], and [[Cave Monster|cave monsters]]: 1 point. * [[Mantis]]es and [[scorpion]]s: 5 points. * [[Spider]]s: 10 points. * [[Aphid]]s: 10 points if normal, 20 if rage, armored, or diamond. * [[Werewolf|Werewolves]]: 25 points. * [[King Beetle]]: 150 points. * [[Tunnel Bear]]: 200 points. * [[Coconut Crab]]: 400 points. * [[Stump Snail]]: 500 points.

== Trivia == * The first player to get the Battle Master Badge was DB4444. * The first player to get the Battle Grandmaster Badge was MunkNull. [[Category:Mechanics]]

docs.title: Bean Bug
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Bean Bug |image =Bean.png |location = All fields except the [[Ant Field]]. |timer = Every ~30 minutes, or can be spawned through the Wind shrine. Higher chance to spawn using 50-100 basic eggs or a Honey Bee egg. |hp = N/A (can't be damaged) |damage = N/A (can't attack players) |points = N/A |bond = N/A |honey = N/A |level = N/A }}

The '''Bean Bug''' is a passive [[Mobs|mob]] that can randomly appear in any [[Field]] (except the [[Ant Field]]), be spawned through the [[Wind Shrine]] by donating 50-100 [[eggs]] or be manually spawned by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]]. They often spawn in one field in groups of 3 or more, and later split up.

When they spawn, they spit 1-3 {{Cost|Jelly Beans}} tokens in volleys over the field which any player can pick up, or can also spit out a Standing Bean Bug [[Sticker]] very rarely. Then they hop to another location on the field and spit more. The tokens only last for a few seconds, much less time than the tokens spawned from regular Jelly Beans. After 7-15 volleys of Jelly Beans, the Bean Bugs hop to other fields to spit Jelly Beans. This process repeats until they despawn after a while.

Bean Bugs can aid the player in collecting [[Pollen]]/[[Honey]], as Jelly Bean tokens can boost the player’s pollen collection, [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]], [[System Page#Instant Conversion|Instant Conversion]], and other stats.

The beans were used for the limited time [[Sun Bear]] questline to receive 250 [[Ticket]]s and for the limited 2019 [[Bee Bear]] questlines. They are also used for [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] questline, and also used for Bee Bear's questline. Sun Bear and Bee Bear's Bean Bug questlines could only be received as a part of an event.

Players are unable to damage it, nor can it damage players, hence why it is a passive mob.

== Gallery == Stuck Bean Bugs at Bamboo Field.png|Bean Bugs stuck in the Bamboo Field. Fagioli.png|Bean Bugs stuck in the Cactus Field. Pumpkin Beanos.PNG|A group of Bean Bugs that spawned in the large pumpkin. RobloxScreenShot20200919 155007587.png|A group of Bean Bugs in the Sunflower Field. Bean bugs.png|thumb|Bean Bugs in Mushroom Field. Bean Bug Caged.png|A Bean Bug inside a cage. Strawberry Bean Bugs.png|Bean Bugs stuck in a strawberry in the Strawberry Field. Rospo.png|Sun Bear's Bean Bug outside of its cage. File:D2840387-1CCB-42C1-B4B0-4E12079708E5.jpeg|A Bean Bug at the 5 Bee Gate. Jelly bean token.jpg|Jelly Bean tokens from Bean Bug. Screenshot 2022-03-31 154147.png|The Bean Bug Brigade. Screenshot 2022-03-31 154539.png|The Bean Bug Brigade in the Mountain Top Field at the end of Beesmas 2021. File:Screenshot 2024-10-27 at 1.04.54 PM.png|A Bean Bug stuck on the Vicious Bee Egg Claim. == Trivia == * Bean Bugs, [[Frog]]s, [[Fireflies]], [[Chicks#Chick|Chicks]], [[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted Chicks]], and [[Chicks#Hostage Chick|Hostage Chicks]] are the only passive mobs in the game, as they cannot deal damage to players. * They were first introduced in the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]] when Sun Bear accidentally released the Bean Bugs. * Sometimes, they can get stuck in various areas, including the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Basic Bee Gate]], the [[Vicious Bee Egg Claim]] and [[fields]] that have solid object(s) while jumping. If they get stuck, they can’t change course and will remain useless until de-spawning. Onett joked about this being "natural selection". * These and fireflies are the only passive mobs that are able to produce [[Ability Tokens|tokens.]] * This, [[Stick Bug]], [[Snowbear]]s and [[Mechsquito]]s are the only mobs being able to spawn a [[Buffs & Debuffs#Debuffs|debuff]]. Stick Bug can spawn the Splinter Trap, Snowbear can Freeze with its Snowballs, Mechsquitos can apply Mechsquito Toxin by firing at the player, and Bean Bugs can spawn spoiled Jelly Beans. * As confirmed by Bee Bear, Bean Bugs have small brains and cannot understand the concept of naughty or nice. * At the end of Beesmas 2020, Onett spawned them as "The Bean Bug Brigade". They then returned at the end of Beesmas 2021 as they "Awoke from Hibernation". *Bean Bugs are the first mob that use jumping to move around, with frogs being the second. While technically Chicks jump when they go inside their egg, this is the only time they do so.

docs.title: Bear Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Bear_Bee.png |image-gifted = BearBee Gifted.png |description = A friendly bee who periodically transforms you into a bear! |rarity = Event |color = Colorless |energy = 35 |energylabel = more |speed = 14 |attack = 5 |skincolor1 = #a05f41 |skincolor2 = #232313 |skincolor3 = #a05f41 }}''This article is about the bee called the "Bear Bee." For the [[:Category:Bears|Bear]] NPC of a similar name, see "[[Bee Bear]]."''

'''Bear Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]]. You can get this bee by redeeming a {{Cost|Bear Bee Voucher|||0}}, which can be obtained by purchasing in the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|800}}, from trading, as an incredibly rare drop from [[Tunnel Bear]] and very rarely from the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]].

Similar to all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and can only become [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] if the player bought it during its release, by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Bear Bee likes the [[Pumpkin Patch]] and the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. It dislikes the [[Blue Flower Field]].

== Stats== Collects 15 [[Pollen]] in 2 seconds. * Makes 200 [[Honey]] in 2 seconds. +75% [[Energy]], +50% gather and convert speed, +5 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +120 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +4 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. *🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +10% [[System Page#Pollen|Pollen]].

===Abilities=== *'''[[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|[Bear Morph]]]''' Transforms you into a random bear! Grants ×2 Pollen and boosts [[System Page#Movespeed|Speed]] and [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]]. If Gifted, has a 20% chance to transform the player into a rare bear that gives special boosts (either [[Mother Bear]], which gives x2.5 Pollen and an additional x1.5 [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Pollen from Bee Gathering]] or [[Science Bear]], which adds +1 Conversion Link).

{{Stat|pollen = 15|pollentime = 2|honey = 200|honeytime = 2|rarity = event}}

== Gallery== BearFaceOutline.png|Bear Bee's face. BearBee Hive.png|Bear Bee's old hive slot design. Super bear bee.png|A [[First Edition Bee|First Edition Gifted Bear Bee]]. Bear bee purchase.png|The promo for the Bear Bee. BearBeeTimer.png|Bear Bee's purchase timer icon from the game's launch. BearBeePromoTab.png|Bear Bee's purchase timer icon but without the outline (unused). RobloxScreenShot20181002 165621081.png|A Gifted Bear Bee hive slot. BearMorphs-0.png|Bear Morph Tokens. Bear Bee Gamepass.png|The Bear Bee Gamepass logo. File:Hivesticker bear bee offer.png|The Bear Bee Offer [[sticker]].

==Trivia== * Bear Morph’s extra jump power and speed can give early access to things such as [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]] and [[ticket]]s that can normally only be accessed later in the game. The First-edition [[Robux Shop|Bear Bee Pack]] was available in the first month of the game's release for 650 Robux. Later, when it went on sale again, it cost 1,000 Robux. It currently costs 800 Robux. This was the first Event bee added to the game and the only Event bee which was in the original release. This was the first bee that is obtainable with Robux, the second being [[Festive Bee]], the third being [[Windy Bee]], the fourth being [[Fuzzy Bee]], the fifth being [[Puppy Bee]], the sixth and seventh being [[Precise Bee]] and [[Buoyant Bee]], the eighth being [[Digital Bee]]. This bee, Festive Bee, [[Gummy Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], Windy Bee, and Digital Bee are the only Event bees obtainable without spending tickets. Gummy Bee was previously purchasable with tickets and the Festive Bee is currently purchasable for 500 tickets. * This bee, Gummy Bee, [[Tabby Bee]], Puppy Bee, Festive Bee, Windy Bee, and Digital Bee are the only bees that can be a First Edition Bee. Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], Bear Bee's [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|Gifted Hive Bonus]] was +20% [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]]. It was later changed to +40% White Pollen and then to +5% Pollen. The current [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|Gifted Hive Bonus]] is +10% Pollen. * This bee, Tabby Bee, Puppy Bee, [[Tadpole Bee]], and [[Lion Bee]] are the only bees based on real life animals other than bees. This bee, Festive Bee, Gummy Bee, [[Photon Bee]], and Tabby Bee are the only bees to have a gifted bonus that affects its signature ability. This enhanced Bear Morph in the gifted hive bonus, adding Science Bear and Mother Bear morphs, was added in the [[Updates#2019.04.17|4/17/2019 Update]]. * This bee is the only bee who can transform the player into a bear, and one of three ways to do so. The other ways are by using the [[Gummy Mask]], which can transform the player into [[Gummy Bear]], and redeeming certain expired [[codes]]. This is the only Event bee that can become gifted without the use of a star treat or gingerbread bear, as all First Edition Bear Bees become automatically gifted when the owner joins the game if they are not gifted yet. * There is a glitch in which dying with bear morph active will leave the player's character without a head when it deactivates. There is a [[sticker]] that can be obtained by Bear Bee, that being the Bear Bee Offer Sticker, which can be obtained by a Gifted Bear Bee while gathering in the [[Pineapple Patch]], or a 1/3 (approx. 33.3%) chance by feeding a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}} to an already Gifted Bear Bee.

{{Bee_Gate|title1 = Bear Gate|image1 = RobloxScreenShot20230730_135247422 (2).png |bears = * [[Onett]]

  • [[Robo Pass Dispenser]] }} The '''Bear Gate''', also known as the '''30 Bee Gate''', is a [[:Category:Gates|gate]] added in the [[Updates#2018.07.11|2018/7/11 update]] that requires 30 [[bees]] to pass through. It is located past the [[Mountain Top Field]], between the [[Ticket Shop]] and the Mountain Top [[Instant Converter]].

It is given its name because of the orange bear head silhouette around it.

Underneath the platform in the gate, there is a {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} token and [[Shadow Bear]] behind it. To reach the egg token, equip either the [[Parachute]] or the [[Glider]]. The player should make sure their [[Bags|bag]] is empty so they don't lose any [[Pollen]] or by using a {{Cost|Whirligig|||0}} after getting the diamond egg token to escape it, although this is very risky if players are not fast enough.

==Music== The following soundtrack "[[Music#Overflowin4|overflowin4]]" plays past this gate and the [[Windy Bee Gate]], as well as in the Ready Player 2 Event:

[[File:Overflowin4.ogg]]

==Gallery == 30beezonefromthetop.png|Past the Bear Gate, from a bird's eye view. (Before the Beesmas 2021 update.) Behind30beegate.png|The old Bear Gate viewed from behind and at nighttime. New bear gate.PNG|The Bear Gate design during Beesmas events. Enzymes.PNG|The {{Cost|Enzymes}} token inside the Bear Gate. File:RobloxScreenShot20230730 140033303 (2).png|Shadow Bear with the {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} token.

==Trivia==

  • The Bear Gate is the largest gate in the game in terms of size.
  • The Bear Gate requires the second largest number of bees to pass through, only behind the Windy Bee Gate.
  • During [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]], the Bear Gate has a gigantic star on top of it.
  • This is the only gate that does not have a [[Fields|field]] behind it. It is also the only gate without the requirement pad and the egg sign, and the only gate without a blue arch around it.
  • This gate, along with the [[Windy Bee Gate]] and the [[Ant Gate]], are the only gates in the game that didn't exist at launch. These three gates, along with the [[Brave Bee Gate]], also don’t lead to any other gate in the game.
  • This gate and the Windy Bee Gate are the only gates where buying [[Hive Slot|hive slots]] is a requirement to pass through them.
  • This gate, along with the Ant Gate, are only gates that do not have a bee model on top of it.
  • The area beyond the gate is indoors, not outdoors. This means that even though there appears to be an opening to the sky, it is blocked by an invisible barrier because otherwise, it would be accessible through the [[Red Cannon]].
  • The player used to be able to get into the Bear Gate's crown, but this has been patched.
  • There used to be a glitch where if the player respawned and ran to the red cannon, they could use the Cannon to enter the gate without dying if they were quick enough using the [https://developer.roblox.com/en-us/api-reference/class/ForceField forcefield] applied on respawn. This glitch has since been patched.
  • The [[Boost Market]] used to be inside the Bear Gate. It got replaced by the [[Nectar Pot]] on the [[Updates|26/12/2021 update]]. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Gates]] [[Category:Locations]]

docs.title: Bee Attack
docs.text:
[[File:MantisGettingAttacked.jpg|thumb|[[Bees]] attacking a [[mantis]].]] '''Bee Attack''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that causes [[bees]] to attack [[mobs]] in a radius. When attacking, bees will deploy a small red laser (presumably a stinger) to deal damage based on the amount of [[System Page#Bee Attack|bee attack power]] they possess. Bee attack boosts are split into five categories, regular bee attack, colorless bee attack, red bee attack, blue bee attack, and bee attack multiplier.

Regular bee attack, or known as just 'bee attack,' improves bee attack to all bees. [[System Page#Colorless Attack|Colorless]], [[System Page#Red Attack|red]], and [[System Page#Blue Attack|blue]] bee attack improves bee attack to matching bees. [[System Page#Attack Multiplier|Bee attack multiplier]] improves bee attack to all bees by multiplication after the sum-up of other bee attack statistics. Base bee attack refers to the total attack of one bee before any multipliers but after add additive bonuses. For example a [[Lion Bee]] with 10 bee attack with items that give +3 bee attack and +1 colorless bee attack has a base bee attack of 14.

The starting bee attack of all bees ranges from 0 to 10, although attack can be increased beyond that. The bee with the highest starting bee attack is Lion Bee with 10 attack, and the bee with the lowest starting bee attack is [[Baby Bee]] with 0 attack, however even if Baby Bee's attack is raised, it will still be unable to attack mobs.

For an increased bee attack stat, first the additives (+ bee attack and + colourless, blue or red bee attack) is added and then, the Bee attack multiplier is added. For example, for a gifted [[Brave Bee]] of a player wearing the [[Porcelain Port-O-Hive]] with no amulets, guards and belt, since the base attack of a Brave Bee is 5, the +2 bee attack from the said bee’s Gifted Hive Bonus and Porcelain Port-O-Hive are first added, making the bee attack till now 7. With the x1.5 bee attack of the Gifted buff, its bee attack is 10.5. Thus, the Brave Bee’s attack stat will be displayed as 10.5 in the stats menu of the said bee.

== Improving Bee Attack == Bee attack can be improved in many ways, every type of bee attack can be improved depending on the player's regular bee attack, colorless bee attack, red bee attack, blue bee attack, and bee attack multiplier.

=== Regular Bee Attack === * Collecting a [[Ability Tokens#Rage|rage]] ability token grants a bonus +1 bee attack, stacking up to 4 times, for a maximum of +4 bee attack. * [[Brave Bee|Gifted Brave Bee]] grants a bonus +1 bee attack. * [[King Beetle Amulet]], [[Ant Amulet]], and [[Stick Bug Amulet]]s have a chance to grant +1 bee attack. * The [[Hiking Boots]] and [[Beekeeper's Boots]] both grant a bonus +1 bee attack. * The [[Coconut Clogs]] grant a bonus +2 bee attack. * The [[Gummy Boots]] grant a bonus +3 bee attack.

=== Colorless Bee Attack === * The [[Mondo Belt Bag]], [[Honeycomb Belt]] and [[Petal Belt]] all grant a bonus +1 colorless bee attack. * The [[Brave Guard]] grants a bonus +1 colorless bee attack. * The [[Cog Amulet]] (Gold+) has a chance to grant +1 or +2 colorless bee attack.

=== Red Bee Attack === * The [[Red Guard]] and [[Elite Red Guard]] both grant a bonus +1 red bee attack, the [[Riley Guard]] grants +2 red bee attack, and the [[Crimson Guard]] grants +3 red bee attack. * The King Beetle Amulet has a chance to grant +1 red bee attack. * The Stick Bug Amulet has a chance to grant +1 or +2 red bee attack. * The Cog Amulet (Gold+) has a chance to grant +1 or +2 red bee attack.

=== Blue Bee Attack === * The [[Blue Guard]] and [[Elite Blue Guard]] both grant a bonus +1 blue bee attack, the [[Bucko Guard]] grants +2 blue bee attack, and the [[Cobalt Guard]] grants a bonus +3 blue bee attack. * The King Beetle Amulet has a chance to grant +1 blue bee attack. * The Stick Bug Amulet has a chance to grant +1 or +2 blue bee attack. * The Cog Amulet (Gold+) has a chance to grant +1 or +2 blue bee attack. * Adding the Cop and Robber to the Sticker Stack grants +0.5 Blue Bee Attack.

=== Bee Attack Multiplier === * [[Rage Bee|Gifted Rage Bee]] grants +10% bee attack multiplier. * Using a [[stinger]] grants x1.5 bee attack multiplier for 30 seconds. * [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|Flame heat]] grants a bonus +5-25% bee attack multiplier depending on how high the stack is. * The [[Fire Mask]] grants a bonus +15% bee attack multiplier. * The [[Demon Mask]] grants a bonus +25% bee attack multiplier. * The Stick Bug Amulet has a chance to grant +1-10% bee attack depending on the tier of the amulet. * The Cog Amulet has a chance to grant +3-15% bee attack depending on the tier of the amulet. * Activating the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]] grants x1.25 bee attack multiplier for 10 seconds. * The Coconut Combo buff gives up to +50% bee attack at 100 stacks. * The [[Boost Market|Rose Field Market Boost]] grants +10% bee attack multiplier along with other buffs for 30 minutes. (unobtainable) * Invigorating Nectar grants a bonus of +1% to +10% bee attack multiplier. * Certain [[Beequip]]s. (Example: Icicles) * Adding the Foward Facing Aphid to the Sticker Stack grants +1% Bee Attack. * Adding the Walking Stick Nymph to the Sticker Stack grants +1% Bee Attack. * Adding the Theatrical Intruder to the Sticker Stack grants +1% Bee Attack. * Adding the Tough Potato to the Sticker Stack grants +1% Bee Attack * Adding the Festive Pea to the Sticker Stack grants +1% Gifted Bee Attack. * Adding the Cyan Hilted Sword to the Sticker Stack grants +2% Bee Attack. * Adding the Stick Cub Skin to the Sticker Stack grants +1% Bee Attack. * [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Other|Festive Nymph Blessing]] gives % bee attack, up to +5%.

=== Robo Bear Challenge Upgrades === The [[Robo Bear Challenge]] provides increases or decreases Bee Attack in the form of adding or multiplying depending on which upgrade you purchase with Cogs. These buffs last until your Robo Bear Challenge ends, however they are only active when you are doing a round.

  • Common Upgrades: ** Sharpen: This upgrade starts at x1.2 Bee Attack and maxes at 10 upgrades with x3 Bee Attack.
  • Rare Upgrades: ** Blue Screen: This upgrade grants x1.03 Bee Attack and Blue Bee Attack for every blue boost stack you have, maxing out at x1.3 Bee Attack and Blue Bee Attack. ** Equalize: This upgrade grants +1 Bee Attack and x1.25 Ungifted Bee Attack. ** Saturate: This upgrade starts at x1.25 Blue and Colorless Bee Attack, but x0.8 Red Bee Attack, it maxes at 3 upgrades with x1.75 Blue and Colorless Bee Attack and x0.4 Red Bee Attack. ** SSD: White: This upgrade ''lowers'' Bee Attack, starting at x0.8 Bee Attack and maxes at 3 upgrades with x0.6 Bee Attack.
  • Epic Upgrades: ** Fission: This upgrade grants +1 Bee Attack. ** Furnace: This upgrade does not improve Bee Attack, but it grants x1.5 Flame Damage. ** Inject: This upgrade grants +2 Blue Bee Attack, +1 Colorless Bee Attack, and x1.25 Impale Damage. ** Malware: This upgrade starts at +3 Bee Attack and maxes at 3 upgrades with +9 Bee Attack. ** NFT: This upgrade ''lowers'' Bee Attack, it grants -3 Bee Attack. ** Pop-Up: This upgrade grants +2 Blue Bee Attack.
  • Legendary Upgrades: ** Bluetooth: This upgrade gives x2 Blue Bee Attack. ** Codec: This upgrade ''lowers'' Bee Attack, it grants x0.8 Bee Attack.

=== Others === These ways are to improve certain bees' attacks which don't count up to regular bee attack, colorless bee attack, red bee attack, blue bee attack, nor bee attack multiplier. * [[Critical Hits|Critical hits]] increase the damage outcome of bees by the amount of [[System Page#Critical Power|Critical Power]]. (minimum of 100% more damage) ** Super-crits increase the damage outcome of critical hits by the amount of Super-Crit Power, but it is only 33% as powerful as a pollen super-crit. * Every gifted bee gains x1.5 bee attack for themselves. * Certain [[mutation]]s increase the individual bee's attack by 1 or a multiplier (%). * Activating [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] grants +300 bonus bee attack only to [[Gummy Bee]], along with other buffs. * Adding the Flying Brave Bee to the Sticker Stack grants +2 Rare Bee Attack. * Adding the Coiled Snake to the Sticker Stack grants +1 Epic Bee Attack. * Adding the Evil Pig to the Sticker Stack grants +1 Epic Bee Attack. * Adding the Left Facing Ant to the Sticker Stack grants +1 Legendary Bee Attack. [[Category:Mechanics]] [[zh-tw:蜜蜂攻擊力]]

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} '''Bee Bear's Catalog''' is a limited-time shop that players could use to purchase various products during [[Updates#12.25.2020|Beesmas 2020]], 2021, 2022, Summer 2024, and Winter 2024. It can be accessed through a side tab on the right side of the screen. Its description is: "Beesmas event shop! Purchase items for Gingerbread Bears and Snowflakes."

It would show the countdown until [[Beesmas]] ends, the countdown was located below the gingerbread icon used to open the shop.

The shop sells [[Egg|eggs]], bundles, Star and Atomic [[Treats]], [[Beequip|Beequips]], and [[Royal Jelly|Royal Jelly Variants]]. The player cannot purchase an item or bundle more than once.

Buying items from the Catalog was sometimes required in NPC quests like [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's.]]

You could only buy items in this shop with {{Cost|Snowflake}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}.

Grants many boosts for 20 minutes! |} ==Gallery== BeeBearCatalog.png|The countdown timer. ==Trivia ==

Items from the Bee Bear's Catalog are all one-time purchases, meaning that the player can only buy them once and can't buy them again. * In order to buy all the items from the catalog, the player would have needed: {{Cost|Snowflake|29,460}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1,118}} during Beesmas 2020. {{Cost|Snowflake|55,571}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1,195}} during Beesmas 2021. {{Cost|Snowflake|107,635}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1,379}} during Beesmas 2022. {{Cost|Snowflake|111,729}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1,546}} during Beesmas 2024 of Summer. {{Cost|Snowflake|153,857}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1,619}} during Beesmas 2024 of Winter. Shortly after Beesmas Summer 2024 released, Onett reduced sticker requirements for some quests and made a few stickers purchasable in the catalog as well as making a few of them more common. Since Onett didn't update every single server, some servers don't have the new sticker offers in the catalog. The next day, Onett updated the Hive Hubs to fix Bee Bear's 15th quest. Because all of these servers are updated to the latest version, you can easily go to the Hive Hubs if you don't want to keep looking for a server with the updated catalog. If the player bought something from the catalog, the system would say +[Item Name] (From [Item Name]). This was changed in Beesmas 2022 to simply say +[Item Name]. This was the very first limited time shop or catalog in the game to exist. The 2020 Beesmas Pinecone Bundle used to have a scripting error, where it gave {{Cost|Glue|30}} instead of {{Cost|Enzymes|30}}. This was the only non-robux shop to have bundles sold in it. During Beesmas 2021, The Catalog's timer was extended with the release of Beesmas Part 2 to give the players more time to complete the new quests, since the Beesmas Part 2 update came late. Items bought in the Bee Bear's Catalog can exceed the items cap. Only Gingerbread Bears obtained in the same year as that year's Bee Bear Catalog can be used to buy items there. For example, leftover Gingerbread Bears from Beesmas 2020 cannot be used as currency in 2021's catalog, while those obtained in Beesmas 2021 can. {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} from last year's Beesmas turn into {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} when the next Beesmas event starts. {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} do not change in the beesmas event following them becoming aged meaning they do not become two-year aged gingerbread bears This, the [[Gift Boxes|Mondo Gift Box]] and the [[leaderboards]] are the only non-robux ways to obtain a Gifted Mythic Egg. Its description has changed from "Winter" to "Beesmas" during [[Updates|Beesmas 2024]], most likely due to it releasing in the summer. During the summer of Beesmas 2024, the price on the Percussive Bundle of {{Cost|Snowflake|808}} (and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|8}}) is a reference to the Roland TR-808 drum machine, commonly referred to simply as an "808". The 808 is the most popular drum machine in the history of music, being initially used in '80s new wave music, and since then, in nearly every rap or hip hop song ever made. Similarly, the 8 Gingerbread Bears are likely a reference to the Roland TR-08 Rhythm Composer, which is a digital re-release of the original drum machine, and/or it may refer to the Roland TR-8S, which also uses the same percussive sound. The format for the timer is DD:HH:SS (D for Days, H for Hours, and S for Seconds). *The button is placed on the same place the Bear Bee Offer was placed during release, and has a similar appearance. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Shops]] [[zh-tw:蜜蜂熊的商品目錄]] [[Category:Removed Content]]

{{Group |title1=[https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592 Bee Swarm Simulator Club] |image1=Basic Bee OriginalIcon.png |owner=Onett |roles=Members, Silenced, Community Contributor, Moderator, Admin, Group Manager, Omelette |members=16M+ (as of February 2025) |games=None (Bee Swarm Simulator is not owned by this group) }} The '''[https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592 Bee Swarm Simulator Club]''' is a Roblox group with over 14 million members. Joining it grants access to the [[Honey Dispenser]], the [[Treat Dispenser]], the [[Strawberry Dispenser]] and the [[Blueberry Dispenser]]. Redeeming certain [[codes]] also require the player to be in the group (I.E. ClubConverters).

==Description== Bee Swarm Simulator: https://www.roblox.com/games/1537690962/Bee-Swarm-Simulator

==Trivia== During [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] 2020 & 2021, [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] required the usage of the Honey Dispenser in order to complete their Beesmas quest. This meant that users who wanted to complete Beesmas were forced to join the group. Science Bear also forces players to join the club in order to get all the translators due to his quest, “The Power of Information” which requires the use of both the Strawberry Dispenser and the Blueberry Dispenser. The Bee Swarm Simulator Club has the fifth most members of all groups on Roblox. The group with the most members is "BIG Games Pets". *The Bee Swarm Simulator Club used to have the most members in a group on all of Roblox, until it got overtaken by Scriptbloxian Studios in 2021. [[File:Basic Bee OriginalIcon.png|thumb|The most used icon for Bee Swarm Simulator.]] [[File:Site-logo.png|thumb|Bee Swarm Simulator's logo.]] '''[https://www.roblox.com/games/1537690962/ Bee Swarm Simulator]''' is an online multiplayer game made in '''[[w:c:roblox:Roblox|Roblox]]''' by '''[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]]'''. The purpose of the game is to hatch [[bees]] to make a swarm, collect [[pollen]], and make it into [[honey]]. The game was created on March 21, 2018 and was released to the public on March 23, 2018.

'''''Please note that this page does not need much expansion or information as this wiki is dedicated to the game. Please check out the other pages for more info.'''''

==Gameplay== The player starts off with the [[Tutorial]], an optional 36-page slideshow which can be accessed again at any time from the “?” button on the top right corner of the screen. After that, they can claim any of the 6 unclaimed [[hive]]s by pressing 'E' or clicking on the large blue button on the top of the screen when you are near your hive. New players will automatically receive a {{Cost|Basic Egg|4=0}}, a [[Pouch]], and a [[Scooper]]. The player can use their tool to collect pollen from any [[Fields]] available. Their bag will store the pollen collected, and their bee(s) can convert the pollen into honey while the player is at their hive. The honey can be used to purchase new [[:Category:Tools|Tools]], [[:Category:Accessories|Accessories]], [[Egg]]s, and various other [[Items]] to progress further into the game.

The player can also receive [[Quests]] from [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]], which mainly focus on collecting pollen and defeating [[Mobs]], but can also have other, more advanced objectives, like collecting [[Ability Tokens|Ability tokens]] and [[Goo]].

==Private Servers== Private servers cost {{Cost|Robux|150}} per month. Owners of private servers have access to the following commands: "/kick PlayerName" - Kicks the given player. PlayerName must be their true Roblox username, the one that displays over their hive (not their Display Name). "/ban PlayerName" - Kicks the named player and automatically kicks them if they attempt to rejoin the server. This ban will remain until the server is closed or "/unban" is used. *"/unban PlayerName" - Removes the named player from the ban list.

{{Accessory |image1 = Beekeeper's Boots.png |description = Practical and stylish boots that aid in the beekeeping process. |cost = 15,000,000 [[Honey]], 5 [[Oil]], 3 [[Red Extract]]s, and 3 [[Blue Extract]]s. |stats = +25% Bee Gather Pollen+6 Player Movespeed+20 Jump Power+10 Movement Collection+1 Bee Attack }} {{Quote|Practical and stylish boots that aid in the beekeeping process.}} The '''Beekeeper's Boots''' are a pair of [[:Category:Boots|boots]] that were added in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]]. The Beekeeper's Boots can be bought at the [[Mountain Top Shop]] for 15 million honey.

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|15,000,000}}{{Cost|Oil|5}}{{Cost|Red Extract|3}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|3}} |}

== Stats == * +25% [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]]. * +6 [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]]. * +20 [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]]. * +10 [[Movement Collection]]. * +1 [[Bee Attack]]. == Gallery == Beekeeper's Boots Buffs.png|The Beekeeper's Boots icon. == Trivia == * They could have been obtained from [[Sun Bear]] by completing his last quest before he left on 10/8/2018. *To craft these boots using the [[Blender]], a total of 15,000,000 honey, 110 [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]], 150 [[Strawberry|strawberries]], 150 [[Blueberry|blueberries]], and 250 [[Sunflower Seed|sunflower seeds]] must be collected. Also, keep in mind that crafting the materials requires a total of 55 minutes of playtime without speeding it up using [[ticket]]s. * [[Onett]] wears a pair of Beekeeper's Boots. He doesn't wear the [[Gummy Boots]] or the [[Coconut Clogs]] because they were added later in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]] and [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 updates]] respectively. ** Onett didn't wear any boots prior to the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], as boots weren't added then. Shortly after the 9/10/2018 update, this was changed to Onett's current gear today. * The version worn by Sun Bear is much bigger than the one the player wears to fit his model. * Prior to the 11/25/2018 [[Updates|update]], this item, [[Basic Boots]] and [[Hiking Boots]] didn't require any items as there was no [[crafting]] then. * After Sun Bear left, the Beekeeper's Boots were transferred over to the Mountain Top Shop for 33,000,000 (33 million) honey. ** The original price was changed to the current price (15,000,000 honey) in the 11/25/2018 update because of the new crafting materials needed to make it. * After the nerf of hats, these replaced the removed bonuses of the [[Beekeeper's Mask]], including the Movespeed bonus, which was 6, the Jump Power boost, and the Bee Gather Pollen boost, which was 25%. Now, both the mask and the boots are 30%, meaning that the boost for Bee Gather Pollen is larger when wearing both the Beekeeper's Mask and Beekeeper's Boots. * These were the highest-tiered boots in the game until the 11/25/2018 update when the Gummy Boots were introduced to the game. ** In the 9/28/2019 update, Coconut Clogs were added, also surpassing the Beekeeper's Boots. As a result, the Beekeeper's Boots are currently the third highest-tiered boots in the game, behind the Gummy Boots and Coconut Clogs.

docs.title: Beequip
docs.text:
[[File:Bear bee with pinecone.png|thumb|A Bear Bee with a Pinecone Beequip.]] A '''Beequip''' is a type of [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that can be worn by [[bees]]. When equipped to a bee, they alter its stats and can also give bonuses to the hive. Beequips can only be given to bees that are at or above the level of the Beequip. Some Beequips can only be given to certain bees or types of bees, for example, the {{Cost|Bubble Light|4=0}} requires a bee with an energy [[mutation]].

==Beequip Cases and Storage== [[File:Beequip Case.png|thumb|100px|The Beequip Case.|alt=]] When a Beequip is obtained, they are initially stored in a Beequip Case. The Beequip Case is obtained when the player first talks to [[Dapper Bear]] at his [[Dapper Bear's Shop|shop]]. The player starts off with five slots but can obtain additional slots from [[Dapper Bear]]'s quests and [[Bee Bear]]'s quests during Beesmas 2020, with the total amount of slots being 15 Beequips. Beequips in a case can be given to bees. {| class="sortable article-table" |+Extra storage slots (does not affect how many Beequips can be equipped) !{{Cost|Ticket}} !Total storage |- |100 |15 |- |250 |20 |- |450 |25 |- |800 |30 |- |1,250 |35 |- |1,850 |40 |- |2,550 |45 |- |3,400 |50 |- |4,400 |55 |- |5,550 |60 |- |6,800 |65 |- |8,250 |70 |- |9,800 |75 |- |11,550 |80 |- |13,400 |85 |- |15,450 |90 |- |17,650 |95 |- |20,000 |100 |- ! colspan="2" ; |Total: {{Cost|Ticket|123500}} |}

[[File:Beequip Storage.png|thumb|100x100px|The Beequip Storage.|alt=]] [[File:BeequipStorageIcon.png|thumb|The quest reward icon for the Beequip Storage.]] If all the slots of the Beequip case are filled, Beequips are moved to the Beequip Storage, located near the [[Dandelion Field]], or the [[Public Sticker Board]] in the Hive Hub. Beequips in the storage ''cannot'' be given to bees. By default, the storage has 10 slots. However, the player can purchase 90 additional slots, for a max total of 100, with a total of 123,500 tickets. Additional slots could have been obtained by completing some of Bee Bear's quests during Beesmas 2020. If both the storage and case are full, the Beequips are stored in the inbox. The inbox can store the player's 25 most recent Beequips, but they have a 48-hour time limit before being discarded automatically. If the player doesn't want a certain Beequip in the inbox to be deleted, they can empty a slot in the case, and then they can keep the Beequip.

There are special Beequips that are permanent and can be stored in the ‘permanents’ section of the Beequip Storage without taking up any space. However, those special Beequips will still require a case slot in order to be equipped to a bee. Currently, there are no permanent Beequips, since the ones that used to be (the [[Reindeer Antlers]] and [[Festive Wreath]]) were made normal Beequips, with Onett saying that he might get rid of the permanent Beequip feature.

Beequips can be moved around the Beequip case, storage, and inbox by dragging them to the location they would like to be put at.

==Potential== Beequips have a potential that can range from 0-5 stars. In-game, this value is stored as a float between 0 and 1; however, for simplicity, the wiki will represent this value as a number between 0 and 10 half-stars.

The potential of a Beequip '''cannot''' change.

When displayed, the potential will round to the nearest star (nearest half-circle in Dapper Bear’s shop).

The higher the potential a Beequip has, the higher chance the Beequip having better base stats, better upgrades and better chance of certain stats to increase when using [[Waxes]].

==Base Stats==

When a Beequip is first generated, or when a {{Cost|Swirled Wax|4=0}} is applied to it, it is given a new set of base stats.

Each possible stat on the Beequip has a chance of being in this new set of base stats, with a value between 2 pre-determined limits. The chance and limits are dependant on the stat and the Beequip.

Note that the base stats are not dependant on {{Cost|Caustic Wax}}, i.e. you can have an otherwise Caustic-only stat on a Beequip as its base stats.

==Waxes== Each type of wax has its own "Upgrades Value", which is essentially its amount of upgrade rolls. Each upgrade roll is an upgrade to one stat.This data was taken from the [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DFvWFNN7euft6ELtkif0BgORQIppZ3PnrLWwk0dfAEQ/edit?gid=690777983#gid=690777983 Beequip Spreadsheet]. {| class="article-table" !Wax !Upgrades Value |- |{{Cost|Soft Wax|||0}} |1 |- |{{Cost|Hard Wax|||0}} |2 |- |{{Cost|Caustic Wax|||0}} | 4 |- |{{Cost|Debug Wax|4=0}} | 4 |- |{{Cost|Swirled Wax|||0}} |0 |} * If the wax is successful, it applies a number of upgrade rolls to the Beequip, equal to the value given in the table above. Each upgrade roll improves a single stat once. * Each individual Beequip stat can only be improved a set number of times using the upgrade rolls. This number is dependant on the stat and the Beequip. When a stat reaches its maximum number of upgrade rolls, later upgrade rolls will ignore the stat. This means every Beequip stat has a maximum value it can reach. Some stats may only be improved by an upgrade roll given by a {{Cost|Caustic Wax|||0}}. Up to 5 waxes can be applied on a Beequip. As a result, it may be better to risk using waxes with a chance to fail in order to achieve better stats and/or have a better chance at getting the stat you need. * Each stat has a weight, which dictates the chance at which the stat is chosen by an upgrade roll. The chance at which a stat is chosen by an upgrade roll uses the formula: \frac{weight_of_stat}{sum_of_weights} \times 100\% Example: If a Beequip has two stats with a weight of 1, one stat with a weight of 0.1 and two stats with a weight of 0.02, the chance of an upgrade roll choosing the stat with the weight of 0.1 is \frac{0.1}{1+1+0.1+0.02+0.02} \times 100\% \simeq 4.67\%. Note that in the linked spreadsheet and on the wiki, a percentage is given instead of a number. The same formula can be applied. *This weight may be increased based on the Beequip's potential. If a stat is ignored, its weight is not included in the sum. This can happen due to the stat having reached its maximum number of upgrade rolls, or due to the upgrade roll not being given by a {{Cost|Caustic Wax|||0}}. * When a stat is chosen, it is improved by an amount equal to one of multiple different values. The amount is dependant on the stat and the Beequip. ** In some cases where there are more than 1 value present, a '''bias''' may be applied to make some values have better or worse chances of being chosen than others. This bias is based on the stat and the Beequip, especially its potential. The base bias is 2, though some stats multiply this by a separate value. For stats with exactly 2 values present, the chance for each value to be chosen can be calculated using formulas \frac{bias - potential \times \frac{bias - 1}{10}}{bias + 1} \times 100\% and \frac{1 + potential \times \frac{bias - 1}{10}}{bias + 1} \times 100\% respectively. *Example: If a stat has a potential of 2 stars (i.e. 4 potential), and a bias of 4, the chance for the first value is \frac{4 - 4 \times \frac{4-1}{10}}{4 + 1} \times 100\% = 56\% and the chance for the second value is \frac{1 + 4 \times \frac{4-1}{10}}{4 + 1} \times 100\% = 44\%. For stats with more than 2 values present, the formula is not known.
