docs.title: Bees
docs.text:
[[File:BeesFaceV3.png|thumb|The list of all the bees currently in the game as of the 12/26/2022 update.]] '''Bees''' are one of the main features of Bee Swarm Simulator. They follow the player around, collect [[pollen]] from [[fields]], and defend their beekeeper from [[mobs]] and bosses. Bees are one of the primary sources for collecting pollen, as they do it automatically, and most bees produce [[Ability Tokens]]. Upon returning to the [[hive]], they will convert pollen into {{Cost|Honey}}, the main [[:Category:Currency|Currency]] used in [[:Category:Shops|shops]] to buy [[items]]. The hive is also where bees sleep when they run out of [[Energy]], or where they rest if their beekeeper dies or resets, doing so for about 15 seconds before returning to work. When a bee runs out of energy, a message in the player’s notifications or chat will pop out: ”😴[Bee’s name] is out of energy! It’s going to sleep.”

Bees gather pollen, fight Mobs, and consume [[treats]] and other items. The bees' [[bond]] with their Beekeeper grows, increasing their level after reaching a certain threshold. Higher-level bees are capable of collecting and converting more pollen into honey and having more energy to work longer (except for [[Photon Bee]] and [[Exhausted Bee]], who both have unlimited energy), and being able to attack higher-level mobs.

Bees are hatched from [[egg]]s, with the probability of hatching a bee of a particular rarity or type depending on the rarity of the egg (i.e., a {{Cost|Gold Egg|4=0}} can hatch into an [[/Epic|Epic]], [[/Legendary|Legendary]], or [[/Mythic|Mythic]]). The player can change the type of an already-hatched bee by applying a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} or another egg. Once the 25 default [[Hive Slot]]s are filled up with bees, the player can expand their hive by buying extra hive slots from the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. While hive slots increase in price exponentially, this allows the player to have 25 different hive slots for a maximum of 50 bees. However, it is now possible to exceed the limit of 50 bees using mechanics that allow the player to have temporary bees, such as [[Onett's Lid Art]], [[Honeyday Candles]], and [[Gummy Siege]]. It is also possible through [[Spicy Bee|Spicy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Inferno|Inferno]].

The eight types of eggs are {{Cost|Basic Egg}}, {{Cost|Silver Egg}}, {{Cost|Gold Egg}}, {{Cost|Diamond Egg}}, {{Cost|Star Egg}}, {{Cost|Mythic Egg}}, specific bee eggs, and event bee [[egg]]s, along with gifted variants of silver/gold/diamond/mythic eggs and the {{Cost|Choose-A-Mythic Egg|4=0}}.

There are currently 46 bee types that can be discovered and collected. [[Bear Bee]] used to only be obtainable by spending Robux, but ever since the July 2024 update, you can now obtain a [[Sticker|voucher]] for the {{Cost|Bear Bee Egg|4=0}} as a reward from the [[Retro Swarm Challenge|retro challenge]], by killing the [[Tunnel Bear]], or by trading for it.

A [[Gifted Bee|gifted bee]] is a type of bee that has improved stats and gives the entire hive or the player a bonus which varies from bee to bee and cannot stack. Some gifted bees have their gifted abilities, and most Gifted Event bees have enhanced abilities, such as Photon Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Beamstorm|beamstorm]]. There is a 1/8000 (0.0125%) chance that feeding a [[/Rare|Rare bee]] its favorite treat will make it gifted, a 1/10000 (0.01%) chance for [[/Epic|Epic bees]], a 1/12000 (0.0083%) chance for both [[/Legendary|Legendary bees]] and [[/Common|Common bees]], and a 1/24000 (0.004%) chance for [[/Mythic|Mythic bees]]. In addition, there is a 1/287 chance of getting a gifted bee by using royal jelly or by hatching it from a {{Cost|Basic Egg|4=0}}. There is also a guaranteed chance of getting a gifted bee from a {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}}, feeding them a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, or hatching one from a star egg. There is also a 1% chance of getting a gifted bee from {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}, which is available in the [[Beesmas]] 2020+ event for a limited time. and a 1.1% chance from {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} is also available when they have not used the gingerbread bears in previous Beesmas events.

==Bee Rarities and Types== Bees/Common|Common|| Bees/Rare|Rare|| Bees/Epic|Epic|| Bees/Legendary|Legendary|| Bees/Mythic|Mythic|| Bees/Event|Event||

==Bee Stats Table== {{Bee Stats Table}}

== Summoned Bees == Summoned bees are temporary bees that play the role of a regular bee until despawning. They collect pollen and perform the regular functions of bees, and use a random hive slot to convert pollen into honey. Additionally, they have unlimited energy until they despawn, and they do not return to the hive if the player dies. Gifted summoned bees do not grant a hive bonus, nor contribute towards average hive level where it is calculated. They can contribute to passives but are not affected by passives.

The following table contains all the ways to obtain summoned bees. {| class="wikitable" !Summoner !Bees !Duration |- |[[Spicy Bee]]'s Inferno ability | * {{i|Fire Bee}}2 [[Fire Bee]]s (2 levels less than the summoner Spicy Bee's level) |15s (+1s per level) |- |[[Onett's Lid Art]] | * {{i|Bumble Bee}}[[Bumble Bee]] (Level 20) * {{i|Baby Bee}}[[Baby Bee]] (Level 1) * One of the following (Level 8): ** {{i|Lion Bee}}[[Lion Bee]] ** {{i|Music Bee}}[[Music Bee]] ** {{i|Cobalt Bee}}[[Cobalt Bee]] ** {{i|Crimson Bee}}[[Crimson Bee]] ** {{i|Festive Bee}}[[Festive Bee]] ** {{i|Tabby Bee}}[[Tabby Bee]] |30 minutes |- |[[Honeyday Candles]] | * Three bees of the following pool (Level 10): ** {{i|Fire Bee}}[[Fire Bee]] ** {{i|Demon Bee}}[[Demon Bee]] ** {{i|Spicy Bee}}[[Spicy Bee]] |30 minutes |- |[[Gummy Beacon]] | * {{i|Gummy Bee}}3 [[Gummy Bee]]s (Level 8-20) |5 minutes |- |[[Honey Wreath]] (after the completion of [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee's]] Beesmas quest) | * {{i|Honey Bee}}[[Honey Bee]] (Level 20) |30 minutes |}

== Gallery == File:BeeTypes2.png|All bees inside the “Info” Icon File:Beez2.png|A swarm of bees following a player. File:BeeMenuIcon.png|The icon for the Bee Menu. File:Ccft2.png|The face decal for a canceled bee.

==Trivia== The [[/Mythic|Mythic]] bee type is the first and only bee rarity type to be added in an [[Updates#2019.12.23|update]]. [[Buoyant Bee]] is the only bee to '''NOT''' dislike a field. If the player's internet is lagging (slow internet), the bees have a high chance of being slower at fighting mobs, making honey, and collecting pollen. If the player moves off the pad in front of their hive while converting honey, the bees will stop converting. However, they will not stop if the player only barely leaves the hive. Moving closer to the hive will cause bees to convert [[honey]] faster as they will not need to fly as far to get to the player and back. * If the player gets too far from their bees, they will fly to the player, ignoring every [[Flowers|flower]] and [[Mobs|mob]] in the way. When bees are sleeping in their [[Hive Slot|hive slot]], they emit faint "Z" particles for a little while until they wake. If the player jumps with over 20 [[System Page#Jump Power|jump power]] while their bees are making honey, they will stop converting. The higher the player's bees' level, the more effective they are at attacking, converting, and collecting. The average attack of a bee is approximately {{Hover|3|3.011628…}}. All event bees have only one disliked field (except for [[Windy Bee]], which dislikes two). A bee spins and emits white sparkles before a bee produces a token. However, if a bee gives off green sparkles, that means the bee is about to collect critical pollen or do critical damage. The [[Marshmallow Bee]] is the only "item bee." All bees of the [[/Legendary|legendary]] rarity or higher have a “special” physical feature (e.g., [[Lion Bee|Lion Bee’s]] mane, [[Festive Bee|Festive Bee’s]] “lid,” [[Tadpole Bee|Tadpole Bee’s]] size and trail, [[Gummy Bee|Gummy Bee's]] translucent body, etc.). Some Epic bees also have at least one feature (e.g., Commander Bee's helmet). Legendary and Mythic are the only rarities of bee that can be used to activate the special pads found around the map; Legendary for the [[Honeystorm]] and [[Special Sprout Summoner]], and Mythic for the [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteor Shower Summoner]]. The Common rarity is the rarity that contains the least number of bees, with only 1. The Epic bee's rarity is tied with the Event bee's rarity for having the most bees, being 11. [[Exhausted Bee]] and [[Photon Bee]] still return to the hive and rest when a player dies/resets, despite their unlimited energy. The maximum number of bees the player can have is 150. This can be achieved if the player has 50 Spicy Bees that all simultaneously produced inferno and 2 Fire Bees. This number can be further increased to 250 if the player is in a corrupted field while 50 Spicy Bees that all simultaneously produced inferno and each token was duplicated. During Beesmas 2020 and Beesmas 2021, the maximum number of bees the player can have at one time is 266. From the previous total of 250, 3 Gummy Bees can be summoned from the [[Gummy Siege]], three bees from [[Onett's Lid Art]] (including a level 20 Bumble Bee and a level 1 Baby Bee), a level {{Cost|Honey|20}} Bee from [[Honey Wreath|Honey Bee's Honey Wreath]], and a maximum of 9 bees from the [[Honeyday Candles]]. All summoned bees can convert pollen at the hive in a random slot. All gifted bees have a star on the model. Mythic bees are the only rarity not to have a gate representing them. The chance of getting a mythic bee from a basic egg is estimated to be 1 x 10^-32% (1 in 100 Nonillion). [[Lion Bee]] is the only bee to like the [[Ant Field]]. [[Sun Bear]] mentions that bees only have [[Ability Tokens|abilities]] on the Mountain. In order, the color of the hive slots according to rarity are: Bronze (Common). White (Rare). Yellow (Epic). Light Blue (Legendary). Purple (Mythic). Green (Event). *The color of a bee's face in their hive slot is dependent on their color with red bees having a red face, blue bees have a blue face, and colorless bees having a black face.

The bee(s) with the most: Base Attack: [[Lion Bee]] (10). Attack: [[Precise Bee]] (16) Base Speed: [[Ninja Bee]] and Photon Bee (21). Speed: [[Digital Bee]] [Max [[Drives]]] (21.9). Base Conversion: [[Diamond Bee]] (250/sec). Base Energy: [[Photon Bee]] and [[Exhausted Bee]] (Unlimited). Base Energy Excluding Unlimited: Lion Bee and [[Buoyant Bee]] (60) Base Gather Amount: [[Fuzzy Bee]] (16.7/sec). Conversion: [[Tabby Bee]] [1000x Tabby Love] (533/sec). Gather Amount: [[Tabby Bee]] [1000x Tabby Love] (25/sec). *Abilities: Fuzzy Bee, [[Spicy Bee]], Tadpole Bee, [[Buoyant Bee]] (4).

The bee(s) with the least: Base Attack: [[Baby Bee]] (0). Base Attack (Higher than 0): [[Basic Bee]], [[Bumble Bee]], [[Hasty Bee]], [[Looker Bee]], [[Rad Bee]], [[Diamond Bee]], [[Music Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], [[Digital Bee]] (No [[Drives|Red Drives]]) and [[Festive Bee]] (1) Base Speed: [[Baby Bee]], [[Bumble Bee]], [[Exhausted Bee]], and [[Demon Bee]] (10.5). Base Conversion: [[Fuzzy Bee]] (6.7/sec). Base Energy: [[Tadpole Bee]] (10). Base Gather Amount: [Tadpole Bee]. *Abilities: [[Basic Bee]] and [[Brave Bee]] (0).

docs.title: Bees/Event
docs.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Event Bees}}'''Event Bees''' are [[bees]] that can only be obtained by purchasing/acquiring their [[Egg#Event Bee Eggs|specific eggs]]. They are generally very expensive, costing either {{Cost|Robux}}, {{Cost|Ticket}}, or are time-consuming to acquire, requiring completion of a long series of [[quests]] or collection of [[items]]. Some could have been purchased as a [[First Edition Bee]], which are bees with a "1st" flag on top of them. The flags serve as decor and don't actually affect anything about the bee, as they perform the same compared to a non-First Edition bee. Event Bees have unique [[Ability Tokens|abilities]] that are not seen in any other type of bee and appear with a green background on the [[Hive Slot|hive slot]] they are in. There are currently a total of 11 Event Bees, composed of 7 [[:Category:Colorless|colorless]], 2 [[:Category:Red|red]], and 2 [[:Category:Blue|blue]]. Event Bees are a one-time purchase.

When hatching an Event Bee Egg, the egg turns into a special {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} that will always transform a bee into that specific Event Bee. Since a hive can only contain one of any given Event Bee, the special royal jelly only exists for the purpose of recovering the Event Bee if the player transformed it.

There is a strategy that takes advantage of the special Event Bee Jelly to essentially switch the [[bond]] of two bees around. For example, if the player had a level 1 [[Cobalt Bee]] and a level 7 bee, such as a [[Hasty Bee]], the player could use a royal jelly on the Cobalt Bee. This would make the special royal jelly available. If they use the special jelly on the Hasty Bee, the player would now have a level 7 Cobalt Bee and a random level 1 bee.

All Event Bees can become gifted, though none have a favourite treat. Giving an Event Bee a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} has a 100% chance to turn the bee gifted, a {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=0}} has a 1% chance of turning the bee gifted, and an {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear|4=0}} has a 1.1% chance to turn the bee gifted. Those currently are the only ways to get a gifted Event Bee (with the exception of the first edition [[Bear Bee]], which is automatically gifted), mentioned by quest-giving [[Onett]] past the [[30 Bee Gate]], as well as [[Panda Bear]] towards the end of his questline. Note that once an Event Bee becomes gifted, its Event Bee {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} becomes basically useless, since using a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} on a gifted bee will make it lose its gifted status. {| class="article-table" border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" |- ! style="width:20%" |Bee ! style="width:10%" |Icon ! style="width:40%" |Description |- |[[File:Bear_Bee.png|50px]] [[Bear Bee]] |{{Icon|Bear}} |A friendly bee who transforms you into different bears! |- |[[File:Cobalt_Bee.png|50px]] [[Cobalt Bee]] |{{Icon|Cobalt}} |A superhero and defender of all things Blue! Together with Crimson Bee it works to unite bees of all colors. |- |[[File:Crimson_Bee.png|50px]] [[Crimson Bee]] |{{Icon|Crimson}} |A superhero and defender of all things Red! Together with Cobalt Bee it works to unite bees of all colors. |- |[[File:Digital Bee.png|50px]] [[Digital Bee]] |{{Icon|Digital}} |A virtual bee with malfunctioning AI. It corrupts the game itself. |- |[[File:Festive Bee.png|50px]] [[Festive Bee]] |{{Icon|Festive}} |A jolly bee who loves giving gifts! It's purely motivated by the joy of others. |- |[[File:Gummy_Bee.png|50px]][[Gummy Bee]] |{{Icon|Gummy}} |A squishy bee who's sweet as sugar. == Trivia == This and the [[Bees/Common|Common]] rarity are the only bee rarities that cannot be obtained through normal {{Cost|Royal Jelly}}. This rarity has the least ways of getting a bee of this rarity with only two ways which are Event Bee Eggs and Event Bee Jellies. Bear Bee, Digital Bee, Gummy Bee, Vicious Bee, and Windy Bee are the only Event Bees that aren't obtained by tickets. Prior to the [[Updates#2019.04.05|04/05/19 update]], Gummy Bee was obtainable by tickets. The audio that plays when an Event Bee notification pops up is the same audio when a [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary Bee]] notification pops up. * Bear Bee and Gummy Bee are the only Event Bees that don't have an ability that directly collects pollen. Digital Bee & Bear Bee are the only Event Bees to have a gifted ability. Every Event Bee has 1-3 Ability Tokens that is unique to them. Event Bees share this trait with [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic Bees]]. *The Event Bees rarity is tied with the [[Bees/Epic|Epic bees]] rarity for having the most bees, being 11.

docs.title: Beesmas Feast
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Beesmas Feast2.png|alt=|thumb|170x170px|The Beesmas Feast's appearance after the player completes Polar Bear's Beesmas quest.]]The '''Beesmas Feast''' is a [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]]-exclusive machine which can be unlocked after completing [[Polar Bear|Polar Bear's]] Beesmas [[Quests|quest]].

It can be used every 90 minutes. When used, it grants the player [[bond]] for all of their [[bees]] and a variety of [[treats]]. It is positioned behind Polar Bear. The amount of bond and rewards are affected by the amount of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Polar Power]] the player currently has.

If a player walks onto the platform without completing his quest, it displays this message, "An empty plate... where’s the Beesmas Feast, Polar Bear?"

==Rewards== {| class="article-table" ! Reward ! | Amount |- |[[Bond]] (per bee) | | ~[[File:Polar Power.png|20px]] ^(3/2) |- |{{Cost|Treat}} (total) | | ~[[File:Polar Power.png|20px]] ^(3/2) |- |{{Cost|Bitterberry}} | | ~[[File:Polar Power.png|20px]] /(20) |- |One of the following:{{Cost|Strawberry}}{{Cost|Pineapple}}{{Cost|Blueberry}}{{Cost|Sunflower Seed}} | | formula unknown |}

==Gallery== RobloxScreenShot20220228 195119586.png|A player claiming tokens from the Beesmas Feast. File:BeesmasFeastPreComplete.jpg|The Beesmas Feast before completing Polar Bear's Beesmas quest.

==Trivia==

  • A variety of foods can be seen on the Beesmas feast. These include: ** Bitterberries. ** Treats. ** A floret of broccoli. ** A carrot. ** A stew that seems to contain chives, onions, corn, peas, and meat.

Polar Bear's feast design is reminiscent to Big Ol' Turkey Legs, a running gag within the [https://www.youtube.com/user/ThnxCya ThnxCya] community. Polar Bear's dialogue after you complete his Beesmas 2020 quest directly referenced this, with the phrase "''A big ol' turkey and treat...''". [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] stated on Discord that the Beesmas Feast was the Hostage Chicks from the [[Egg Hunt 2020]] event. The eating sound is a cut out section of the song "''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SMWi7CLoZ2Q Nom Nom Nom Nom Nom Nom Nom]''", made by Parry Grip. The Beesmas Feast used to drop all the 4 treats but was changed in Beesmas 2022. *It was introduced in [[Updates#12.25.2020|Beesmas 2020]], and has returned in every Beesmas since.

docs.title: Beesmas Lights
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:RobloxScreenShot20210215 150122914 (2).png|thumb|Beesmas Lights, unlocked after completing [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] Beesmas quest.]] '''Beesmas Lights''' would occasionally appear in fields as the player collects pollen after completing [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] Beesmas Lights [[Quests|quest]].

They would fall from the sky in a similar way to the [[Passive Abilities#Star Shower|Star Shower passive]], taking 2 seconds to fall. Whenever a Beesmas Light is caught, it would grant the [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire]] buff and converts based on the player's [[System Page#Convert Total|convert total]]. If the player didn't catch it, the light collects pollen instead. Beesmas Lights would spawn after collecting 25 Ability Tokens (with a 30 second cooldown), dropping 5 lights into the field. Beesmas Lights could spawn in any field, including the [[Ant Field]].

If the player approached the switch for the Beesmas Lights, located beside [[Science Bear]] and had not yet completed his quest, a text box will display reading the following text: "This [''sic''] Beesmas Lights aren't powering on..."

== Gallery == Screen Shot 2020-12-27 at 4.58.27 PM 3.png|A falling Beesmas Light. Screen Shot 2020-12-27 at 4.54.01 PM.png|A green circle, indicating where a Beesmas Light falls. RobloxScreenShot20210216 081419755 (2).png|The Beesmas Lights display in the map, turned on after the completion of Science Bear's Beesmas 2020 quest. File:Hivesticker green beesmas light.png|The {{Color|Green Beesmas Light Sticker}}. File:Hivesticker blue beesmas light.png|The {{Color|Blue Beesmas Light Sticker}}. File:Hivesticker red beesmas light.png|The {{Color|Red Beesmas Light Sticker}}. File:Hivesticker yellow beesmas light.png|The {{Color|Yellow Beesmas Light Sticker}}.

== Trivia == * Players were required to catch a certain amount of Beesmas Lights for [[Bee Bear]] and [[Onett]]'s quests. * The Beesmas Lights has the same function as the [[Passive Abilities#Star Shower|Star Shower passive]] with the difference of the fact that the star shower is more focused in a small area than Beesmas Lights. ** This means that if the passive is disregarded, the Beesmas Lights are the only way to get the inspire buff without [[Gifted Bee|gifted bees]] or redeeming certain [[codes]]. *Catching a falling Beesmas Light has a 1 in 10,000 chance to reward a Red/Blue/Green/Yellow Falling Beesmas Light [[sticker]] (depending on the color of the light). * Over the course of the removal of several Beesmas events, Beesmas Lights would still fall into fields a few days after Beesmas was over. ** [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s Beesmas quest dialogue also tends to take longer to be removed.

docs.title: Beesmas Tree
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} ''Not to be confused with [[Beesmas Tree Hat]], a [[Beequip]] with a similar name.'' [[File:Beesmastree.png|thumb|The Beesmas Tree.]] The '''Beesmas Tree''' is a feature that appeared during Beesmas 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2024. The Beesmas Tree allows the player to view their collected [[ornaments]], who they are from, and what boosts they give. The tree is located in front of the [[Ant Gate]], near the [[Noob Shop]], and next to the hives.

==Beesmas 2024 (Winter)== The Beesmas Tree made another return in 2024's Winter Beesmas, functioning the exact same way as during Summer Beesmas 2024. Conducting a gift exchange with an NPC would grant players an ornament that would grant special boosts on the Beesmas Tree.

The bottom row holds five ornaments. They are given, from left to right, from [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], and [[Science Bear]]. The second row of the tree holds another five ornaments. They are, from left to right, from [[Polar Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Onett]], [[Spirit Bear]], and [[Robo Bear]]. The third row of the tree holds four ornaments. They are, from left to right, from [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], [[Stick Bug]], and [[Sun Bear]]. The ornaments on the 4th row of the Beesmas Tree are currently unknown, though it can be assumed they are Honey Bee and Gummy Bear. The ornament on the top of the tree is [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s ornament.

There is a {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} token under the Beesmas Tree and 25 {{I|Snowflake}}{{Color|Snowflake|Snowflakes}} token at the top of the trunk of the Beesmas Tree.

==Beesmas 2024 (Summer)== {{RemovedContent}} The Beesmas Tree made another return in 2024's Summer Beesmas, functioning the exact same way as during Beesmas 2022. Conducting a gift exchange with an NPC would grant players an ornament that would grant special boosts on the Beesmas Tree.

The bottom row holds five ornaments. They are given, from left to right, from [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], and [[Science Bear]]. The second row of the tree holds another five ornaments. They are, from left to right, from [[Polar Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Onett]], [[Spirit Bear]], and [[Robo Bear]]. The third row of the tree holds three ornaments. They are, from left to right, from [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Stick Bug]]. The ornaments on the 4th row of the Beesmas Tree are currently unknown, though it can be assumed they are Honey Bee and Gummy Bear. The ornament on the top of the tree is [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s ornament.

There is a {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} and {{Cost|Whirligig|4=0}} token under the Beesmas Tree and a {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=0}} token at the top of the trunk of the Beesmas Tree.

==Beesmas 2022== {{RemovedContent}} The Beesmas Tree made another return in 2022, functioning the exact same way as during Beesmas 2021. Conducting a gift exchange with an NPC would grant players an ornament that would grant special boosts on the Beesmas Tree.

The bottom row holds five ornaments. They are given, from left to right, from [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], and [[Science Bear]]. The second row of the tree holds another five ornaments. They are, from left to right, from [[Polar Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Onett]], [[Spirit Bear]], and [[Robo Bear]]. The third row of the tree holds three ornaments. They are, from left to right, from [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Stick Bug]]. The ornaments on the 4th row of the Beesmas Tree are currently unknown, though it can be assumed they are Honey Bee and Gummy Bear. The ornament on the top of the tree is [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s ornament.

There is a {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} token under the Beesmas Tree and a {{Cost|Robo Pass|4=0}} token at the top of the trunk of the Beesmas Tree.

==Beesmas 2021== {{RemovedContent}} The Beesmas Tree made another return in 2021, functioning the exact same way as during Beesmas 2020. Conducting a gift exchange with an NPC would grant players an ornament that would grant special boosts on the Beesmas Tree.

The bottom row held five ornaments. They were given, from left to right, from [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Panda Bear]] and [[Science Bear]]. The second row of the tree held another four ornaments. They were, from left to right, from [[Polar Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Onett]], and [[Spirit Bear]]. The third row of the tree held three ornaments. They were, from left to right, from [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Stick Bug]]. An additional three ornaments could also be added to the tree, and they were, from left to top, [[Honey Bee (NPC)]], [[Gummy Bear]], and [[Bubble Bee Man]].

There is a Honeysuckle token at the bottom, a {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} to the left, a {{Cost|Whirligig|4=0}} token, and a {{Cost|Smooth Dice}} token above the Beesmas Tree.

==Beesmas 2020== {{RemovedContent}} The Beesmas Tree returned in 2020, and it functioned the same. To put ornaments on the tree the player needed to collect and give [[present]]s to each corresponding [[:Category:NPC|NPC]]. In exchange, the player would receive their ornament along with a few special boosts. [[File:Gingerbread bear under beesmastree.png|thumb|The Gingerbread Bear under the Beesmas Tree.]] The bottom row held four ornaments. They were given, from left to right, from [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], and [[Panda Bear]]. The second row of the tree held another four ornaments. They were, from left to right, from [[Science Bear]], [[Polar Bear]], [[Onett]], and [[Spirit Bear]]. The third row of the tree held three ornaments. They were, from left to right, from [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Stick Bug]]. An additional three ornaments could also be added to the tree, and they were, from left to top, [[Honey Bee (NPC)]], [[Gummy Bear]], and [[Bubble Bee Man]].

There was a {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=0}} token at the bottom and a {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} token at the top of the trunk of the Beesmas Tree.

== Beesmas 2019== {{RemovedContent}} To put ornaments on the tree, the player had to complete the [[Quests|quest]] of the corresponding [[:Category:NPC|NPC]], then talk to them. The ornament would then automatically go onto the tree.

[[File:BeesmasTree_SomeOrnaments.png|thumb|Some ornaments on the Beesmas Tree.]] The bottom row of the tree held four ornaments. They were given, in order from left to right, from [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], and [[Panda Bear]]. The second row of the tree held another four ornaments. They were, from left to right, from [[Science Bear]], [[Polar Bear]], [[Onett]], and [[Spirit Bear]]. The third row of the tree held three ornaments. They were, from left to right, from [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Stick Bug]]. The ornament placed on the highest row of the tree was from [[Bubble Bee Man]].

There was a {{Cost|Field Dice||4=0}}, {{Cost|Gumdrops|5|4=0}}, and {{Cost|Moon Charm|5}} located in the Beesmas Tree. On the top of its trunk, there were {{Cost|Bitterberry|10}}. To access the platform and the token on it, players had to glide down from on top of [[Noob Shop]] or drop down from the Ant Gate.

==Trivia== *The Beesmas Tree uses the same model as the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/42781787/Christmas-Tree Christmas Tree Roblox hat].

{{Consumables |image=Black Balloon.png |description=Floats over the field for 5m. Stores up to x25 your capacity and increases pollen inside 4x. |cooldown=15 min |cap=25}}

The {{Color|Black Balloon}} is a [[:Category:Consumables|consumable]] [[Items#Misc. Items|item]] that was added in the [[Updates|12/26/2021 update]]. Once used, it creates a black balloon over the [[Fields|field]] the player is in. The balloon floats over the field for 5 minutes before floating to the hive balloon, storing the [[pollen]] collected underneath it. The pollen collected below is multiplied by 4, and it holds up to 25 times the player's capacity. Only {{Cost|Black Balloon|1}} can be summoned in a field per player.

Black balloons have a cap of 25 in the player's [[:Category:Inventory|inventory]]. Obtaining one while already having 25 will not add a Black Balloon to the player's inventory, unless obtained from robux packs, [[quests]], or [[codes]].

== Ways to Obtain == * As a very rare drop from [[Tunnel Bear]]. * As an exceptionally rare drop from a [[Spider]]. * Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 12th quest rewards 1 black balloon and other items. * Sticking the Black Star Sticker to the Sticker Stacker rewards one Black Balloon.

Purchasing certain offers in the [[Robux Shop]]: Purchasing the Buoyant Pack for 800 robux gave 3 black balloons and other items. Purchasing the Cyber Monday Pack for 800 robux gave 1 black balloon and other items. [[File:Blender.Png|thumb|217x217px|The Blender, located in the Badge Bearer's Guild.]] The '''Blender''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] located in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]]. The machine's usage is to create [[:Category:Consumables|consumable]] [[items]] from pre-existing items. However, the player is only able to craft one type of item at a time. There is a total of 20 different items that the machine can craft.

== Crafting == [[File:Blendermenu.png|thumb|The Blender interface when crafting an item.]] Each item takes 5 minutes to craft and the timer only counts down when the player is in-game. The player can end the crafting process at any time by clicking on the "End Crafting" button. This will give the player all finished items, and all unfinished items will be turned back into their ingredients and given back to the player. If the button is green, then everything has been blended. If not (red button), then the Blender has not finished blending. The player can also speed up the blending for a varying amount of {{Cost|Ticket}}. For every 1 item being crafted, the Blender requires 1 more ticket to speed up. Except for {{Cost|Moon Charm}} and {{Cost|Gumdrops}}, for which each ticket serves for speeding up whole 10 items.

docs.title: Blue Cannon
docs.text:
[[File:Bluecannon2.png|thumb|220x220px|The Blue Cannon]] The '''Blue Cannon''' is located on a rock platform between the [[Pine Tree Forest]] and the [[Rose Field]], neighbouring the [[Royal Jelly Shop]]. It is available for use once the player has discovered 16 [[Bees|bee]] types. If used without certain [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] or [[items]], such as the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]], it will usually shoot the player to the 1 row of flowers of the [[Clover Field]] closest to [[Brown Bear]]; however, it may occasionally undershoot the player to the [[Slingshot]] or between the [[Mushroom Field|Mushroom]] and the [[Dandelion Field]]. It has a 5 second cooldown period.

It can be used in unison with either the Parachute or Glider to collect the [[Royal Jelly]] token on top of the tallest dandelion in the Dandelion Field. Players who have acquired either the Parachute or Glider can also use the Blue Cannon to reach the [[Star Hall]].

== Trivia ==

  • This is one of the four cannons in the game, which the other three cannons are [[Yellow Cannon]], [[Red Cannon]], and [[Gummy Cannon]]. ** This is one of the three transportational cannons in the game, which the other two cannons are [[Yellow Cannon]] and [[Red Cannon]].
  • The Blue Cannon has a cooldown of 5 seconds. While this is not normally possible to see during regular gameplay as the cannon launches the player too far to return in 5 seconds, the cooldown can be seen by using the Glider/Parachute glitch to stop all momentum as soon as the player exits the cannon. **This cooldown is shared by all the transportational cannons.

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Blue Extract.png |description = Grants x1.25 Blue Pollen for 10 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second }}'''Blue Extract''' is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. The purpose of it is to use it as material to craft equipment and accessories, or for a 10-minute boost that grants x1.25 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]]. The [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Items|buff]] cannot stack, and will only reset its timer if the player used a Blue Extract when the effect is already active. Using a {{Cost|Purple Potion|4=0}} or {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=0}} will override the buff. [[File:A blue extract token..png|thumb|right|A blue extract token.]]

== Ways to Obtain == * [[Crafting]] it via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Blueberry|50}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|10}} * Matching a pair of blue extracts in [[Memory Match#Mega Memory Match|Mega Memory Match]] (worth 1 blue extract) or [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]] (worth 3 blue extracts). * As a reward from the [[Wind Shrine]]. * Purchasing the Royal Blue Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gives 44 blue extracts + other items. * As a stack reward for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** {{Cost|Flying Ninja Bee Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. {{Cost|Blob Bumble Bee Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. {{Cost|Menacing Mantis Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. ** {{Cost|Small Blue Chick Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. ** {{Cost|Tadpole Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. {{Cost|Cool Backpack Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. {{Cost|Bubble Wand Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract. ** {{Cost|Tide Popper Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 blue extract.

=== Drops=== As a rare drop from [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetles]] and [[mantis]]es. As a common drop from [[King Beetle]] and [[Aphid#Diamond Aphid|Diamond Aphids]]. Farming in the [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Pine Tree Forest]], or the [[Stump Field]] can rarely drop blue extracts. A rare drop from [[leaves]] in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, or the Stump Field. As a rare drop from [[sprout]]s (the odds increase depending on the rarity of the sprout and if the sprout is located on the blue fields). As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] (if [[Festive Bee]] is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]) or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. As a rare gift from a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]]. As a drop from the certain [[Planters]]: ** The {{Cost|Blue Clay Planter|||0}}, and {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} are guaranteed to drop blue extracts when 100%. The {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} drops extra blue extracts in blue fields (the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, and the Stump Field). *** Planting the {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} in the Blue Flower Field, then the Bamboo Field, then the Pine Tree Forest, then the Stump Field results in an additional {{Cost|Blue Extract|100}} (36-day cooldown). Planters harvested in blue fields may drop blue extracts. Activating the [[target]] on the left wall of the Blue Flower Field.

===Quests=== Completing every [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Gifted Bucko Bee's]] quests will always reward one blue extract, and their 20th quest awards 10 blue extracts. [[Black Bear]] gives blue extracts on the following quests: Walk Through The Woods gives 1 blue extract and other items. Bamboo Boogie 2: Bamboo Boogaloo gives 1 blue extract and other items. You Blue It gives 1 blue extract and other items. Black Bear's repeatable quests occasionally give blue extracts. [[Science Bear]] gives blue extracts on the following quests: *Meticulously Crafted gives 1 blue extract and other items.

docs.text:
[[File:BlueFieldBooster2022.png|thumb|220px|The Blue Field Booster sitting in the Blue HQ.]] The '''Blue Field Booster''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] that provides a [[field boost]] to a random blue field for 15 minutes. It is located on the second floor of the [[Blue HQ]]. In order to use it, the player has to have discovered at least 5 different blue [[Bees|bee]] types. It has a cooldown of 45 minutes.

The following audio plays when the Blue Field Booster is activated: [[File:Fieldbooster.ogg]]

== Boosts == [[Blue Flower Field]]: +300% [[Pollen]] [[Bamboo Field]]: +100% Pollen [[Pine Tree Forest]]: +100% Pollen [[Stump Field]]: +100% Pollen (only if Stump Snail is on respawn cooldown.) == Gallery == Blue Flower Field Icon.png|The Blue Flower Field boost icon. Bamboo Field Icon.png|The Bamboo Field boost icon. Pine Tree Forest Icon.png|The Pine Tree Forest boost icon. Stump Field Icon.png|The Stump Field boost icon.

== Trivia == * This is one of the three field boosters in the game, along with the [[Field Booster]] and the [[Red Field Booster]]. ** The Blue Field Booster has the same design as the Field Booster and the Red Field Booster, with the only difference being the colors. * In an update, Bamboo Field Boost was nerfed from 200% to 100% pollen.

docs.title: Blue Flower Field
docs.text:
{{Field |image = BlueflowerField.png |fieldcolor = Blue |bees = None |width = 43 |height = 17 }}The '''Blue Flower Field''' is one of the five [[Starter Zone|starting]] [[fields]] any player can visit upon starting the game. It is the first blue field accessible in the game. It is protected by a level 1 [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetle]].

This is a 17×43 field made up of 731 [[flowers]]. The flowers are blue and white, in sizes of single and double.

On the north-east side of the field, a glass-like panel can be seen in the wall, with a blue lower leading into it. Making contact with it will teleport the player inside [[King Beetle's Lair]].

You can find the [[Blue HQ]] on the other side of the field. {| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Red ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |182 |''{{Hover|24.9%|24.89%}}'' |0 |''0%'' |484 |''{{Hover|66.2%|66.21%}}'' |'''666''' |'''''{{Hover|91.1%|91.11%}}''''' |- !Double |19 |''{{Hover|2.6%|2.59%}}'' |0 |''0%'' |46 |''{{Hover|6.3%|6.29%}}'' |'''65''' |'''''{{Hover|8.9%|8.89%}}''''' |- !Triple |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |'''0''' |'''''0%''''' |- !Total |'''201''' |'''''{{Hover|27.5%|27.49%}}''''' |'''0''' |'''''0%''''' |'''530''' |'''''72.5%''''' |'''731''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should, however, be roughly correct.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[blueberry]], [[neonberry]], [[ticket]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|blue boost]], [[Blue Extract|blue extract]], and [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Blue Flower Field include [[Bumble Bee]], [[Bubble Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], [[Frosty Bee]], [[Baby Bee]], [[Diamond Bee]], [[Ninja Bee]], and [[Buoyant Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Blue Flower Field include [[Rage Bee]], [[Bear Bee]], and [[Festive Bee]].

This field grants Refreshing [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Blue Field Booster]] may give a Blue Flower [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +300% Blue Flower Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Blue Flower Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], and [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - 300% Blue Flower Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Blue Flower [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Blue Flower Field conversion and gives +5% instant Blue Flower Field conversion and +25% Blue Flower Field pollen for each stack. Blue Flower Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. * Redeeming certain valid codes: *Luther (Activates Blue Flower Field Code Buff + other stuff). It can be boosted by the [[King Beetle Amulet]]. If it has a Blue Flower Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +100%.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

Giving a [[present]] to certain NPCs: [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] gave Blue Flower Field Boost x3 and other boosts and [[items]]. [[Onett]] gave Blue Flower Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. Completing [[Gifted Bucko Bee#Egg Hunt Quest 2019|Gifted Bucko Bee's Egg Hunt 2019 Quest]] gave Blue Flower Field Boost x7 (although the boost only went up to x5) and other items. Redeeming certain expired codes: AccentMaster (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x1 + other stuff). Xanthan (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x5 + other stuff). 1MLikes (Gives Blue Flower Field Boost x1 + other stuff). OodlesOfNoodles (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x5 + other stuff). Berlin (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x6 + other stuff). ** 1mFavorites (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ClubParty (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x6 + other stuff). AceUnhackedLoot (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x2 + other stuff). PingBoost (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x4 + other stuff). Discord50k (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x4 + other stuff). Buzzy (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x3 and Blue Flower Field Winds x3 + other stuff). ClubBasket (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x2 + other stuff). Gumaden10T (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x2 and Blue Flower Field Winds x3 + other stuff). *Buoyant (Gave Blue Flower Field Boost x3, Blue Flower Capacity x3, and Blue Flower Field Market Boost x3 + other stuff). * Purchasing a Blue Flower Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] and codes will give x1.5 Blue Flower [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Blue Flower Field Pollen, x1.5 [[System Page#Pollen From Bubbles|Bubble Pollen]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]].

== Gallery == IMG 1013.jpg|The entrance to the King Beetle Lair. RobloxScreenShot20180608 204950078.png|Patches of sparkles in the field. BlufGlitched.jpg|Blue Flower Field glitching when doing the Ready Player Two event. BlueFlowerFieldTheGames.png|The Blue Flower Field during [[The Games]]. Blue Extract from Blue Flower Field.png|A {{Cost|Blue Extract|||0}} received from collecting pollen in this field. Blue Flower Field Icon.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. Hivesticker blue flower field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * This field is adjacent to the [[Blue HQ]] and [[King Beetle's Lair]]. * Sometimes, the giant [[Bubble Wand]] model on the Blue HQ gets a face and will blow bubbles towards this field, along with the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Clover Field]], and [[Dandelion Field]], to produce [[sparkles]]. * In the early days of the game, the decorative flowers in this field used to face upwards. This was changed due to the player being able to stand on the flower and the Rhino Beetle only looking at them instead of attacking. ** However, you can still see the decorative flowers facing upwards in the tutorial. * According to [[Spirit Bear]], this field used to be the "Blueberry Field." * This is the only blue field that gives [[Nectar|Refreshing Nectar]].

docs.title: Blue HQ
docs.text:
{{Stores |image1 = BlueHQBeesmas2021.png |caption1 = Front view of the Blue HQ. |row1 = Behind the Blue Flower Field }}The '''Blue HQ''' is a two-story base with many features. The entrance can be found at the far end of the [[Blue Flower Field]], located in the [[Starter Zone]]. It has a [[Bucko Bee]] model above the entrance. To enter, the player must have discovered 4 different blue bee types. The Blue HQ is the blue counterpart to the [[Red HQ]].

On the roof, there is an enlarged [[Bubble Wand]]. This wand occasionally grows a face and blows [[sparkles]] to nearby fields. This includes the [[Clover Field]], [[Mushroom Field]], Blue Flower Field, and the [[Dandelion Field]].

== Interior == On the first floor, there are four different objects: * A [[Blue Teleporter]] that will teleport the player near the [[Ticket Tent]] and [[Red Cannon]], * A set of blue [[items]] for sale, (See the 'Store' section below.) * The [[Blueberry Dispenser]], which gives a varying amount {{Cost|Blueberry}} depending on the number of * blue bees the player has in their [[hive]] every 4 hours, * The [[All-Time Top Blue Collectors]] [[Leaderboards|leaderboard]], which shows the top 100 players who have collected the most blue pollen.

On the second floor, there are more features: * A {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} token located near the front window. * A [[Blue Field Booster]] that gives a 15-minute duration [[Field Boost|field boost]] for either the [[Pine Tree Forest]] (1 stack), [[Bamboo Field]] (1 stack), or the Blue Flower Field (3 stacks), and has a 45-minute cooldown. * [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], who will require a {{Cost|Translator|||0}} for it to hand out [[quests]], * The [[Top Bucko Bee Helpers]] leaderboard, which is located to the left of Gifted Bucko Bee and shows the top 100 players who have completed the most Bucko Bee quests, * The [[Daily Top Blue Collectors]] leaderboard, which is located to the right of Gifted Bucko Bee and shows the top 100 players who have collected the most blue pollen in a day.

== Store == There's a store in the Blue HQ that sells nine items. To open the store, press E when near the store's items and ''not'' on the Blue Teleporter, Blueberry Dispenser, the Leaderboards, or the second floor.

==Music== When inside of the Blue HQ, the [[Music|song]] "vendor" plays.

== Trivia == The Tide Popper is currently the most expensive item able to be bought in the Blue HQ. If the player goes to the corner of the ramp inside the Blue HQ closest to the [[Clover Field]], they will be able to hear the Crawlers music. Unlike the [[Riley Bee]] model on the [[Red HQ]], the wings of the Bucko Bee model don't have collision. On 01/01/22, there was a glitch where if the player attempted to view the Tide Popper, the game would freeze and they won't be able to exit the shop, except for rejoining the game. *The Blue HQ is also known as the "Blue Clubhouse." If the player does not have 4 blue bee types discovered, the top of their screen will say, "Discover 4 Blue Bee types to enter the '''Blue Clubhouse'''."

docs.title: Blue Teleporter
docs.text:
[[File:BlueHQTeleporter.png|thumb|200x200px|The Blue Teleporter pad in the Blue HQ.]] [[File:Newblueportaldestination.png|thumb|230px|The destination of the Blue Teleporter.]] The '''Blue Teleporter''' is a portal located inside the first floor of the [[Blue HQ]]. When activated, it will instantly teleport the player behind the [[Red Cannon]] and next to the [[Ticket Tent]]. The transportation is one-way; thus, the destination teleporter cannot be used to travel back into the Blue HQ.

To activate the Blue Teleporter, the player must walk onto the white teleport pad and press the "E" key on their keyboard if they are on PC or Laptop. However, if they are on mobile, then they must walk onto the pad and tap on the button that appears at the top of the screen.

== Trivia == * Like its [[Red Teleporter|Red Counterpart]], the Blue Teleporter used to have an animation where the rings would revolve in circles, but it can get bugged to the point where the rings will start to slow down until they completely stop. * There is a bug in which if you tap it multiple times in a very short timeframe, the number of times you go through the portal increases, even if you only go through it once.

docs.text:
[[File:59e0bfa22f7535eb183e532b87919406.png|thumb|The Blueberry Dispenser.]]

The '''Blueberry Dispenser''' is a [[Dispenser]] located on the first floor of the [[Blue HQ]], next to the [[Blue Teleporter]]. When used, it grants the player [[honey]], [[Ability Tokens#Haste|haste]] x5, [[Ability Tokens#Boost|blue boost]] x10, and 1 [[blueberry]] for each [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[bees|bee]] in the player's [[hive]].

It has a cooldown of 4 hours.

If the player does not have any blue bees in their hive, it will not grant any blueberries.

The player must be in the [[Bee Swarm Simulator Club]] in order to use this.

docs.title: Blueberry
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Blueberry.png |description=Increases your bond with a bee by 25. }} A {{Color|Blueberry}} is a type of [[Treats|treat]] that can be fed to a [[Bees|bee]] to raise its bond by 25. However, when fed to a [[Bumble Bee|Bumble]], [[Cool Bee|Cool]], [[Bubble Bee|Bubble]], [[Frosty Bee|Frosty]], [[Bucko Bee|Bucko]], [[Diamond Bee|Diamond]], [[Music Bee|Music]], [[Tadpole Bee|Tadpole]], or [[Buoyant Bee|Buoyant]] Bee, the amount of [[bond]] they gain is doubled. These bees also have a small chance of becoming gifted when fed blueberries, though this only happens with a 0.0125% (1 in 8,000) chance for [[Bees/Rare|Rare bees]], 0.01% (1 in 10,000) chance for [[Bees/Epic|Epic bees]], 0.0083% (1 in 12,000) chance for [[Bees/Common|Common]] and [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bees]], and 0.00417% (1 in 24,000) chance for [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bees]] per Blueberry.

== Ways to Obtain == * From using the [[Blueberry Dispenser]] inside the [[Blue HQ]]. * As a reward from the [[Ant Challenge]]. * Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]: ** 1MLikes (Gives 1 blueberry + other stuff). ** 15MMembers (Gives 15 blueberries + other stuff). * As a reward from [[Memory Match|memory matches]].

=== Drops === * Farming in the [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Pine Tree Forest]], and the [[Stump Field]]. ** Harvesting [[leaves]] in these fields may also yield blueberries. * As a drop from [[Rhino Beetle]]s, [[Mantis]]es, and [[King Beetle]]. * As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a gift from your [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddy.]] * As a reward for completely growing any [[sprout]] except for Moon, Gummy, and Debug sprouts. ** Planting a sprout in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, Pine Tree Forest, or Stump Field yields 6x more blueberries than other fields. * Harvesting [[sparkles]] (Higher chances in blue fields). * As a drop from [[Puffshroom]]s. * As a drop from planters in blue fields. ** Non-blue fields that contain a significant portion of blue flowers can drop Blueberries (Clover Field, Cactus Field, Mountain Top Field). ** When in blue fields, {{Cost|Paper Planter|||0}} drops multiple Blueberry tokens in increments of 1, 3, 5, and 10.

=== Quests === * Gifted Bucko Bee may reward the player blueberries as a special reward. * Spirit Bear gives blueberries on the following quest: ** Out-Questing Questions gives 1 blueberry.

docs.title: Bond
docs.text:
[[File:Screenshot_2018-07-11_at_9.48.02_PM.png|thumb|A bee's level up notification.]] '''Bond''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that is equivalent to the levelling system found in many other games. When [[bees]] have a high enough bond with the player, they will level up, gaining the following boosts per level above 1: * +10% [[Stats#Production Amount|production amount]]; * +10% [[Stats#Gather Amount|gather amount]]; * +5% [[energy]]; * +3% [[Stats#Speed|movespeed]].

Bond can be checked at any time by clicking on the bee's [[Hive Slot|hive slot]] and it will show the bee's bond and [[stats]].

A bee will automatically gain bond when collecting [[pollen]] in a [[Fields|field]]. When collecting pollen, each bee type has different opinions of each field and either likes, is neutral toward, or dislikes any given field. If a bee has a sad [[Emoticons|emoticon]] over its head, it means that the bee does not like that field and will gain only minimal bond from collecting pollen in that field. If it has a happy emoticon instead, it likes the field and will gain extra bond. If it doesn't have an emoticon at all, it's neutral towards that field and will gain the usual amount of bond. Bees can be fed [[treats]] to increase the bee's bond by 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, or 1000 depending on the type of treat the bee is fed. If the player feeds a bee its favorite treat, it will gain double the amount of bond it would otherwise get, as well as having a very low chance to become [[Gifted Bee|gifted]] or [[Mutation|mutated]]. Bond is also rewarded from defeating [[mobs]] and collecting a [[Ability Tokens#Puppy Love|Puppy Love]] token from [[Puppy Bee]].

A bee's bond does '''not''' reset after a level up; however, the information window only shows the bond required for the next level, so it can appear as if the bond went down to zero. (This is why when feeding a bee a treat, the server message on the lower right of the screen and the chat will have a different number than the bee information window.) A bee's rarity does not affect how much bond it needs to level up. Both a [[Bees/Common|Common]] and [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]] at level 1 would require 10 bonds to level up. Bond does not diminish when using [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] or replacing it with an [[egg]].

Mobs also have levels, which affects whether a bee will hit, or miss its attack. If the bee has the same or a higher level than the mob, it is guaranteed to hit. If the bee is one level lower than the mob, it has a {{Hover|50%|1/2}} chance to hit the mob. If the bee is two levels down, it only has a {{Hover|25%|1/4}} chance to hit, and so on.

The formula to calculate the chance of hitting a mob is: 1/[2^{(monster level - bee level)}]

The maximum level a bee can achieve is 25. It is generally difficult to reach levels above 20, but if a bee reaches the maximum level, the bee will still gain bond.

Levelling a full hive of 50 bees from level 0 to level 20 would cost {{Hover|1.25Qd|1,250,000,000,000,000}} (1.25 quadrillion) honey and costs {{Hover|1.041Qd|1,041,666,666,666,650}} (~1.041 quadrillion) honey in treats with gifted Puppy Bee. Levelling a full hive of 50 bees from level 0 to level 25 would cost 5.005Sx (~5.005 sextillion) honey in treats and 4.1708Sx (~4.1708 sextillion) honey in treats with gifted Puppy Bee. There was an exploit that allowed bees to reach level 25 instantly. There is no current way for bond to be subtracted from a bee. Temporary bees can still be levelled up. *The Max Bond from Treats (BFT) is 133%, 20% from Gifted Puppy Bee's Hive Bonus, 10% from Moon Amulet and 3% From Reindeer Antlers Beequip.

{{RemovedContent}} {{Stores |title1 = Boost Market |image1 = Boostmarket.png |row1 = Past the [[Bear Gate]] on the right. }} [[File:Boost_Market.jpg|thumb|The Boost Market page interface.]] The '''Boost Market''' was a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] that could have been found in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]]. Since the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] 2021 [[Updates|update]], it has been replaced by the [[Nectar Pot]].

Every 30 minutes, the shop allowed the player to purchase a market boost at a certain price. The price depended on the number of people who have purchased that specific boost, much like in a real [[Wikipedia:Stock Market|stock market]]. It cost both {{Cost|Ticket}} and {{Cost|Honey}} to purchase a boost. These boosts lasted for 30 minutes. Market boosts could also have been obtained from certain [[codes]], like RedMarket, or the ones used in the [[Ready Player Two]] event.

{{Consumables |image = Boxofrogs.png |description = Summons 3 Frogs that last for 3 minutes. |cooldown = None |cap = 15 }} {{Color|Box-O-Frogs}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2019.12.25|Beesmas 2019 update]]. When used, three regular/gifted [[frog]]s will be summoned in any [[Fields|field]] the player is currently standing in, which last for three minutes, that can collect [[Ability Tokens|tokens]], produce [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|bubbles]] around the field (if spawned in a field), and attack hostile [[mobs]].

It can also be used outside of a field, but the frogs summoned will aimlessly hop, which then won’t do anything unless one of the frogs is in the field. The frogs have infinite HP and cannot die.

==Ways to Obtain== Completing 111 [[Brown Bear]] quests rewards {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|5}}. Completing 333 Brown Bear quests rewards {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|3}}. Completing [[Black Bear]]’s "Bubble Trouble" quest rewards 1 Box-O-Frogs and other items. Completing Black Bear's "Boss Battles" quest rewards 3 Box-O-Frogs and other items. Donating the BBM From Below [[Sticker]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]. A low chance to drop from [[Onett's Lid Art]]. A low chance to drop from [[Stockings|Brown Bear's Stockings]]. Completing Bee Bear's "Cheering Up Gloomy Cub (4/5): Material Things?" rewards {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|3}} and other items. *Completing Bubble Bee Man's "B.B.M's Naughty List" during Winter Beesmas 2024 rewards {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|10}} and other items.

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | Completing [[Onett|Onett’s]] “Yard Art On The Lid” rewarded {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|1}} and other items. Completing Bubble Bee Man's "B.B.M's Naughty List" during Beesmas 2021 rewarded {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|11}} and other items. Completing Bubble Bee Man's "B.B.M's Naughty List" during Beesmas 2022 rewarded {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|12}} and other items. Giving Bubble Bee Man a present during Beesmas 2021 gave {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|5}} and other items. Purchasing the [[Robux Shop#Items|Stocking Stuffer Special pack]] for {{Cost|Robux|400}} in the [[Robux Shop]] gave {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|10}} and other items. * Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Shady Present]] gave {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|6}} and other items. Completing [[Bee Bear]]’s "Festive Wreath Workshop 8" quest rewarded {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|3}} and other items. Giving Bubble Bee Man a present during Beesmas 2020 gave {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|6}} and other items. Redeeming certain expired codes: FestiveFrogs (Gave {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|1}} + other items) 3YearParty (Gave {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|1}} + other items) *Completing Bee Bear's [[Beesmas|Beesmas 2022]] 9th quest gives {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs|1}}. |}

==Gallery== Box-O-Frogs Token.png|A Box-O-Frogs token. ==Trivia== Box-O-Frogs and {{Cost|Night Bell}} are the only two consumable items that summon mobs. * Box-O-Frogs are one of the two ways to summon a frog, the other being [[Tadpole Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Summon Frog|Summon Frog ability]]. Frogs summoned in the [[Gummy Bear's Lair]] fall through the floor. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Consumables]] [[Category:Inventory]] FORCETOC

{{Bee Gate|title1 = Brave Bee Gate|image1 = BraveBeeGate.png|caption1 = The Brave Bee Gate. |mobs = * [[Stump Snail]]. * [[Tunnel Bear]]. * [[Mantis]]. * [[Rhino Beetle]]. |bears = * [[Science Bear]]. * [[Dapper Bear]]. |shops = * [[Pro Shop]]. * [[Dapper Bear's Shop]]. * [[Magic Bean Shop]]. |fields = * [[Pineapple Patch]]. * [[Stump Field]]. |extras = * [[Yellow Cannon]]. * [[Memory Match]]. * [[Treat Dispenser]]. * [[Instant Converter]]. ** [[White Tunnel]]. * [[Mazes#Pro Shop Maze|Pro Shop Maze]]. *[[Beesmas Lights|Beesmas Lights (beesmas only)]] | }}The '''Brave Bee Gate''', also called the '''10 Bee Gate''', is a [[:Category:Gates|gate]] that requires 10 [[bees]] to pass.

It gets its name from the large [[Brave Bee]] on top of it.

== Trivia == * The player can reach the top of the [[Blue HQ]] if the gate is unlocked, by jumping off the ledge near [[Science Bear]]. This gives a shortcut to [[Brown Bear]], the [[Honeystorm|Honeystorm Summoner]], the [[Wealth Clock]], and [[Commando Chick's Hideout]]. This could also grant access to [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Bucko Bee's]] [[Snow Machine]] during Beesmas. * Formerly, the [[Slingshot]] could bypass the gate even if the player didn't have 10 bees, since it launched them past it. ** This was fixed in the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], as the player gets teleported back to spawn if they don't meet the requirements to enter an area. * This gate doesn't have any fields in which [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] can spawn.

docs.title: Brick Bloom
docs.text:
{{Stub}} [[File:BrickBloom1.png|thumb|A Brick Bloom.]] '''Brick Blooms''' are passive entities that can be spawned naturally in any of the four fields of the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]]. They are retro-styled flowers with a green stem with purple petals, and a yellow center. After a certain amount of pollen is collected in their radius, Brick Blooms burst into {{Cost|Brick|||0}} tokens. Brick Blooms spawn on rounds, 1, 3, 7, 12, 18, and may continue spawning on higher rounds. The first Brick Bloom always spawns in the Mixed Brick Field. In higher waves, multiple Brick Blooms may be active at the same time.

== Levels == There are multiple levels of Brick Blooms that can spawn. The later the round, the higher level a Brick Bloom will usually be when spawning. Similar to [[Puffshroom|Puffshrooms]], the higher level a Brick Bloom is, the larger it will appear. When a Brick Bloom is defeated, another one will spawn in a random field, one level higher. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Pollen Required |- |1 |1,000 |- |2 |10,000 |- |3 |50,000 |- |4 |100,000 |- |5 |250,000 |- |6 |500,000 |- |7 |1,000,000 |- |8 |2,500,000 |- |9 |5,000,000 |- |10 |10,000,000 |- |11 |25,000,000 |- |12 |50,000,000 |- |13 |100,000,000 |- |14 |250,000,000 |- |15 |500,000,000 |- |16 |1,000,000,000 |- |17 |2,500,000,000 |}

== Drops == The tokens that spawn from Brick Blooms are both local and global, so players always receive tokens from them regardless of whether they helped to destroy it or not. More bricks are rewarded when defeating higher level Brick Blooms.

  • {{Cost|Brick|4=1}}
  • {{Cost|Snowflake}} (Beesmas only)

== Strategies ==

  • Having multiple players can help with collecting the required amount of pollen faster.
  • With a team, one player can be designated for the managing of Brick Blooms.
  • Picking [[bees]] with extra pollen multipliers such as [[Gifted Bee|gifted bees]] can help out a lot.
  • Paying attention to which field the Brick Bloom spawned on and acting on that can help out. A player who is managing Brick Blooms but has a predominantly red hive, may have difficulty dealing with higher level Brick Blooms on the Blue Brick Field. Players can communicate to handle different fields to manage Brick Blooms more efficiently.
  • Using ranged weapons can allow a player to fend off mobs while the player's bees collect pollen for a Brick Bloom, not getting distracted by mobs.
  • Activating as many [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] as possible will help collection become optimal.

== Trivia ==

  • Despite having a level system, there is no way to "miss" a Brick Bloom, unlike with most [[mobs]]. ** This is due to the fact that a Brick Bloom is a passive mob, like Puffshrooms. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Passive Mobs]] [[Category:Mobs]]

{{Consumables|description=Used for purchases during the Retro Challenge|cooldown=N/A|image=Lego Brick.png}} The {{Color|Brick|||0}} is used as the main currency of the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]]. It is used to buy many utilities to fend off many waves of slimes and zombies during the challenge.

==Ways to Obtain ==

Farming in the Red, Blue, White, and Mixed Brick Field. Destroying [[Brick Bloom|Brick Blooms]] (Amount depends on the level). Slaying [[Slime|Slimes]] and [[Zombie|Zombies]] (Amount depends on the level). {{Cost|Brick|10}} can be purchased for honey near the hives. *{{Cost|Brick|100}} can be purchased for honey on the left side of the monster's spawn.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

Completing [[Bubble Bee Man|BBM's Naughty List]] during Summer Beesmas 2024 rewarded {{Cost|Brick|1||}}. Giving [[Bubble Bee Man]] a present during Summer Beesmas 2024 rewarded {{Cost|Brick|2}}.

It is possible to obtain {{Cost|Brick}} outside of the Retro Swarm Challenge, as they are rewarded by giving [[Bubble Bee Man]] a present or by completing his Beesmas 2024 quest. docs.title: Broken Drive
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Broken Drive.png |description = Looks like a poorly preserved computer part. Maybe someone can fix it... |cooldown=No cooldown}}

The {{Color|Broken Drive}} is an inventory [[Items|item]] that was introduced in the [[Updates|5/7/23 update]]. They can be used to activate [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] quest to repair [[Robo Bear]]. After completing Science Bear's quest the Broken Drive will be replaced with a [[Drives#White Drive|White Drive]].

A Broken Drive can be found behind the [[Robo Pass Dispenser]]s in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]], which is the only way to obtain one. == Gallery == File:Brokendrivetoken.jpg|Broken Drive Token File:Inventorybrokendrive.jpg|A Broken Drive in a player's inventory.

== Trivia ==

  • The Broken Drive is the only type of drive that can't be used during the [[Robo Bear Challenge]].
  • The Broken Drive is the only type of drive that can only be obtained once, as the others can be repeatedly earned through the Robo Bear Challenge and bought with [[cog]]s. ** This also means the Broken Drive is the only type of drive that cannot be used to craft a [[Drives|Glitched Drive]] or a [[Digital Bee]].
  • Players do not need to fix the Broken Drive if they have previously repaired Robo Bear during Beesmas 2022. {{Items}} [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Robo Bear Challenge]]

docs.text:
{{Bear |image =Brown.png |type = Quest Bear |location = Near the Clover Field and the Wealth Clock. |bees = None |basecoloramount=1 |basecolor1 = #634929 |shadecoloramount = 1 |shadecolor1 = #554026 |snoutcoloramount = 2 |snoutcolor1 = #634929 |snoutcolor2 = #C8A77F |torsocolor1 = #785d3d |torsocoloramount = 1 |armscolor = #94744e |legscolor = #634b2f |enableother = n }}'''Brown Bear''' is a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]] and one of eight permanent [[:Category:Bears|bears]] that can be accessed in the game, the others being [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], [[Science Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Polar Bear]], and [[Spirit Bear]]. He is located behind the [[Clover Field]] and next to the [[Wealth Clock]] and the [[Top Brown Bear Helpers]] leaderboard. His [[quests]] primarily focus on collecting [[pollen]] from randomized [[fields]]. After initiating a quest, a new one will be available in 1 hour.

== Normal Quests == Brown Bear is an infinite quest giver. His quests scale up in difficulty the more the player completes, with the reward also getting bigger the more difficult it gets. The fields required for a quest are only chosen from the fields the player has access to, with the exception of the [[Ant Field]]. Each quest always rewards a [[ticket]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], and increasing amounts of [[honey]] depending on the difficulty of the current quest. Certain thresholds may reward other items as well.

There are 5 different types of quests: * Quests that require 1 random field (ex. Brown Bear: Solo-Coco) * Quests that require 2 random fields (ex. Brown Bear: Dand-Bamb) * Quests that require colored pollen and 1 random Field (ex. Brown Bear: White-Cact) * Quests that require colored pollen and 2 random Fields (ex. Brown Bear: Blue-Mount-Bluf) * Quests that require 4 random fields (ex. Brown Bear: Sun-Rose-Spide-Pump)

== Previous Quests == {{RemovedContent}} The quests came in different levels with difficulty increasing depending on the number of bees in your [[hive]]. Each quest, regardless of level, gave one [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], and sometimes Brown Bear gave some extra rewards. All quests also rewarded at least one [[ticket]], with the higher-level quests giving two tickets. There used to be a 4-hour cooldown in between quests, as opposed to the current 1-hour cooldown.

==Trivia== Before the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/19/2020 Update]], Brown Bear's quests only focused on a single [[Fields|Field]] and were scaled relative to the number of bees in the player's hive. * Prior to the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], Brown Bear gave a "daily" quest every 16 hours. However, after the 9/10/2018 update, it changed to 4 hours. After the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/19/2020]] update, he gave a quest every hour. There is a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|}} token on a hill behind Brown Bear. The player can reach it by having high [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]] or by using the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]] and glide down to it from the top of the [[Blue HQ]] roof. He is one of the three permanent [[:Category:Bears|Bears]] that can be found in the [[Starter Zone]], the others being [[Black Bear]] and [[Mother Bear]]. Brown Bear, [[Polar Bear]], and Black Bear are the only three bears with infinite quests. Brown Bear is typically the first bear to start giving endless quests for new players. He is also one of the six quest givers that give repeating quests. Brown Bear is the only bear that guarantees royal jelly and tickets for the completion of each quest. Brown Bear uses the [https://roblox.com/catalog/734338331/Knight-Animation-Package Knight Animation Package], the same as [[Sun Bear]]. He, Black Bear, and Mother Bear were "Nice" in 2018, as stated by [[Bee Bear]] during the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas 2018 Event]]. If the player gave Brown Bear a [[Present]] during the Beesmas 2018 Event, he would give a star jelly and [[Clover Field]] [[Field Boost|Boost]] x4. *The Brown Cub rewarded for completing 300 of Brown Bear's quests is one of the six [[Cub Buddy]] skins. Lipsisas was the first player to get a Brown Cub Buddy skin. The Beesmas 2020 present dialogue is a merge of Beesmas 2018 and 2019. Brown Bear is the only NPC that you can give presents to that could receive the same present twice. Brown Bear is the only infinite quest bear whose quests scale in difficulty. Excluding event quests, Black Bear & Brown Bear are the only bears that ''only'' require pollen to be collected. If someone somehow gets the Brown Cub Buddy from Brown Bear without owning a Cub Buddy first, they will need to obtain the Black Cub as it only acts as "equipment" for the Cub Buddy. Brown Bear is stated to have known [[Spirit Bear]] since he was a cub. *Brown Bear is also stated by [[Spirit Bear]] to be very reserved - meaning he does not let on much to others. * Brown Bear is one of the 3 Bears along with Robo Bear and Bee Bear to give out a cub buddy * Brown Bear visited the Wind Shrine as revealed by [[Spirit Bear]]. It is unknown what he was doing, but he was not donating. * Brown Bear is stated by [[Black Bear]] to spend most of his time near the [[Clover Field]]. Coincidentally, the same field that is above [[King Beetle's Lair|King Beetle’s Lair]]. Black Bear also states that it could have something to do with his [[Royal Jelly]] stockpile. {{QuestNav}} [[Category:Bears]] [[Category:Quest Giver]] [[Category:NPC]] [[Category:Starter Zone]] [[zh-tw:棕熊]]

Bubble Bee Man is one of the four temporary quest givers, along with [[Sun Bear]], [[Gummy Bear]], and [[Bee Bear]].

He has given out a Beesmas quest almost every year since 2018.

== Trivia== Bubble Bee Man originated from [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Community:Mah_Bucket Mah_Bucket's] fan-event called "Beesmas", which [[Bee Swarm Simulator]] participated in. Bubble Bee Man is the only NPC to own two different NPC pads for itself, the other being behind the [[Global Top Battlers|Global Top Battlers Leaderboard]] near Panda Bear. However, it was removed during [[Updates#2019.12.23|Beesmas 2019]]. During Beesmas 2018, Bubble Bee Man also gave the player a quest after they obtained the first [[Badges#Event Badges .5BCurrently Unobtainable.5D|Beesmas Badge]] (Beesmas Believer) from [[Bee Bear]]. * Bubble Bee Man is the only NPC to have deliberate grammatical errors, typos and misspellings in their dialogue. *Bubble Bee Man is one of the two NPCs that rewards an [[:Category:Accessories|Accessory]] as a reward for completing his quests, along with [[Sun Bear]]. * Bubble Bee Man is actually a [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/17735318/Bubble-Bee-Man Roblox Hat]. Strangely, as the Roblox hat, both the texture and the model have the name: Bubble Bee Man. * Bubble Bee Man is the only NPC whose dialogue contains references to other Roblox games. Sometimes, the icon of the B.B.M. Mask will appear to be invisible, but hovering over where the icon should appear will still show its stats. * Bubble Bee Man is one of the six [[Quest Givers]] that are not bears, along with [[Onett]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], [[Gifted Riley Bee]], Honey Bee, and Stick Bug. Bubble Bee Man and Stick Bug is the only quest giver that requires the player to defeat the Stump Snail. In old servers, you can still see Bubble Bee Man giving his dialogue even if you did not complete his quest. Bubble Bee Man is the only quest giver that gives out two different kinds of hats. After the [[Updates#2019.02.01|2/1/2019 Update]], there is a royal jelly token in front of Bubble Bee Man and an enzyme token on the other side of the platform where one of the [[present]] tokens was previously located. Regarding the quests needed to get completed, including Bee Bear's quests, the five Gifted Riley Bee quests, the five Gifted Bucko Bee quests, and [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] quests to get the translators for delivering the presents, you needed to complete at least 100 quests in total in order to complete Bubble Bee Man’s Beesmas 2018 quest (B.B.M. Mission). During Beesmas 2018, if the player tried to talk to Bubble Bee Man before making a present with Bee Bear, he would say to come back later when they have made a present with Bee Bear, meaning they would need to earn the first Beesmas 2018 Badge (Beesmas Beeliever) before being able to start his quest. Bubble Bee Man’s quest during Beesmas 2019 (B.B.M's Ornament) was originally planned to require the player to pop 3,333 [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|Bubbles]], but this got changed before the release of the quest since Onett thought it would be a "great meme." He is the only quest giver that is solid. When finishing his Beesmas 2020 quest, he says that you can use the Naughty List every 22 hours, but you can actually use it every 8 hours. * He is the NPC that gives the least and most amount of Honey when finishing a quest (14 and 40,023,627,477,283 respectively). All of Bubble Bee Man's quests contain his initials B.B.M. or BBM. During Beesmas 2020, Bubble Bee Man stayed a week after the end of the event so some people could finish his quest (Snowbears, snowflakes, and Festive Nymphs stayed too as they were part of his Quest). Before they were removed, Bubble Bee Man was the only quest-giver to reward [[Eviction]]s. This is one of the only non-bear NPCs. This NPC is commonly abbreviated as "BBM". During Winter 2024, if you've claimed Bubble Bee Man's quest in a server on version 563+, but then joined a server which is on a version before 563, it will show only one requirement for B.B.M's Naughty List, that being "Make nf Honey." This, of course, is impossible to complete. * Bubble Bee Man's Beesmas quest dialogue tends to stay around after the end of its Beesmas event much longer than expected. {{QuestNav}} [[Category:NPC]] [[Category:Quest Giver]]
