docs.title: Bubble
docs.text:
'''Bubbles''' are objects that can be produced by certain [[tools]], [[Ability Tokens|abilities]], or [[Passive Abilities|passive abilities]]. Bubbles have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering. Bubbles spawn on the flower that the bee gathered and last for 4 seconds. When popped, they collect 4 red, 6 white, and 8 blue pollen from 29 surrounding flowers (+15% per gifted blue bee type, +5% per bee level) and cause nearby flowers to grow back to full.

Bubbles can be generated by [[Bubble Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], [[frog]]s, the [[Bubble Wand]], [[Bubble Mask]]'s Bubble Bombs passive, and the [[Passive Abilities|Pop Star]] passive.

Bubbles can be popped by other players, petal shurikens, tornadoes, [[Passive Abilities|Star Saw]], [[Ability Tokens#Fuzz Bombs|Fuzz Bombs]], the [[Dark Scythe]]'s trail, and the [[Tide Popper]]'s waves.

Popping bubbles helps to grow Pop Stars and will increase [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|Bubble Bloat]]. The bigger the Pop Star grows, the more bubbles it will spawn.

Even though another player pops your bubble, the pollen collected by the bubble is yours, no matter who pops it.

During Pop Star if someone else pops your bubble it will count for the growth of the Star.

When a bubble is popped, the following audio plays, with an increased pitch the more bubbles are popped in quick succession: [[File:Bubblepop.ogg|thumb]]

== Gathering Bubbles == The '''Gathering Bubbles''' passive gives a chance for a bee to spawn a bubble while gathering pollen from a field. Gathering Bubbles+ gives a higher chance for a bee to spawn a bubble.

There is a 25% chance (50% if gifted) for Bubble Bees' Gathering Bubbles passive to spawn a bubble while gathering, and a 65% (85% if gifted) chance for Tadpole Bees' Gathering Bubbles+ passive to spawn a bubble while gathering.

A [[Bead Lizard]] gives from +10% Gathering Bubbles chance to +12% Gathering Bubbles chance for an individual bee.

== Bubble Pollen == [[File:BubblePollenStat1.png|thumb|The Bubble Pollen stat in the System Page.]] '''Bubble Pollen''' is the amount of pollen that bubbles can collect. The player can check how much bubble pollen they have in the system page.

Bubble Pollen can be increased by a few ways.

  • The [[Diamond Mask]] gives a x1.5 Bubble Pollen multiplier.
  • The [[Bubble Mask]] gives a 1.25x Bubble Pollen multiplier.
  • [[Bubble Bee|Gifted Bubble Bee]] gives a x1.25 Bubble Pollen multiplier.
  • [[Beequip]]s: ** A Bead Lizard can give +1% Bubble Pollen as a hive bonus from waxing. ** A [[Bubble Light]] gives from +15% Bubble Pollen to +30% Bubble Pollen for an individual bee. Using [[waxes]] can increase the amount up to +60% Bubble Pollen. ** A Bubble Light can give +1% Bubble Pollen as a hive bonus. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +11% Bubble Pollen. ** A Camphor Lip Balm can give 15% Bubble pollen hive bonus. Using waxes can increase the amount up to 25% Bubble pollen.
  • [[Cog Amulet]]s: ** The Bronze Cog Amulet can give from +3% Bubble Pollen up to +5% Bubble Pollen. ** The Silver Cog Amulet can give from +5% Bubble Pollen up to +6% Bubble Pollen. ** The Gold Cog Amulet can give from +8% Bubble Pollen up to +9% Bubble Pollen. ** The Diamond Cog Amulet can give extra Bubble Pollen. ** The Supreme Cog Amulet can give from +15% Bubble Pollen up to +20% Bubble Pollen.
  • [[Robo Bear Challenge]]: ** Epic Upgrades: *** Pop-Up: This upgrade gives x2 Bubble Pollen. *** RGB: This upgrade gives x1.25 Bubble Pollen.

==Improving Bubbles== Aside from increasing the amount of pollen that bubbles can collect, the player can also improve bubbles a few other ways.

=== Golden Bubbles === A '''Golden Bubble''' is a special variant of a bubble that can only occur when a [[Balloon#Golden Balloon|golden balloon]] floats over a normal bubble or it can be summoned by a gifted frog.

When a golden bubble is popped, it collects +100% more pollen than a normal bubble per field boost stack, contributes 50% more time to Pop Star's bubble bloat than a normal bubble, has 100% [[Instant Conversion]] (unless going into a balloon), and has a 10% chance to spawn a honey token.

The only way to increase the Golden Bubble pollen besides [[Field Boost]] is with Camphor Lip Balm.

=== Instant Bubble Conversion === [[File:InstantBubbleConversionStat1.png|thumb|The Instant Bubble Conversion stat in the System Page.]] '''Instant Bubble Conversion''' is how much pollen collected by the bubbles is instantly converted. There are currently no ways to increase Instant Bubble Conversion.

=== Bubble Duration === '''Bubble Duration''' affects how long bubbles last before they disappear. The base duration is 4 seconds and can be increased to 5 seconds. There is currently only one way to increase Bubble Duration. Note that bubbles spawned from Bubbles Bombs last 8 seconds (10 seconds if one has a Gifted Tadpole bee).

  • Gifted Tadpole bee grants +25% Bubble Duration

=== Other Improvements === Certain upgrades from the Robo Bear Challenge can be used to improve bubbles.

  • Epic Upgrades: ** Invert: This upgrade makes bubbles collect x4 pollen from red flowers. ** Pop-Up: This upgrade gives x1.5 Bubble Lifespan.

==Gallery== 2019-12-23 (7).png|A bubble in a field. Bubbles.png|Two bubbles in the Spider Field. GoldenBubble.png|A golden bubble in a field. GoldenBubbles1.png|Multiple golden bubbles in the Pumpkin Patch. Bubblebloat.png|Bubble Bloat buff icon.

==Trivia== The maximum Bubble Pollen a player can have at a time is 925%. This can be achieved by having the Diamond Mask (x2), a Bead Lizard (+1%), three Bubble Lights (+33%), a camphor lip balm (+25%), a Supreme Cog Amulet (+20%), Gifted Bubble Bee (x1.25), activating the [[Sticker Stack]] with certain [[Sticker|stickers]] (+6%), Pop-Up upgrade (x2), RGB upgrade (x1.25). Popping a bubble has a 1/1,000,000 chance to spawn a Tadpole sticker. *Bubbles are the counterpart of [[flame]]s. [[Category:Mechanics]] [[zh-tw:泡泡]]

''This page is for the worker bee. Not to be confused with [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], an NPC.''{{Bee |image-orig = Bucko_Bee.png |image-gifted = BuckoBee Gifted.png |description = Leader of the Blue bees, and a long time rival of Riley Bee. Its tenacity is its greatest strength. |rarity = Epic |color = Blue |energy = 30 |energylabel = more |speed = 15.4 |attack = 5 |skincolor1 = #1b2a35 |skincolor2 = #3b8ed1 |skincolor3 = #1b2a35 }} '''Bucko Bee''' is a [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[Bees/Epic|Epic bee]].

Bucko Bee's favorite type of [[Treats|treat]] is {{Cost|Blueberry}}.

Bucko Bee likes the [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], and the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. It dislikes the [[Strawberry Field]], and [[Rose Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 17 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 3 seconds. * +10% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +50% [[Energy]], +4 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], +7 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +25% convert speed. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +20% Blue Field Capacity.

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Boost|[Blue Boost]]]''' Grants x1.2 pollen from blue [[Flowers]] for 15s. Stacks up to 10 times.

{{Stat|pollen = 17|pollentime = 4|honey = 80|honeytime = 3|rarity = epic|color = blue}}

== Gallery == BuckoBee Hive.png|Bucko Bee's old hive slot design. GiftedBuckoBeehive.PNG|A Gifted Bucko Bee hive slot. BuckoFace.png|Bucko Bee's face. Screenshot 2022-09-16 164205.png|Bucko Bee transformed into Gifted Bucko Bee. File:Buckingbea.png|Bucko Bee's original face.

== Trivia == As per the description, this [[Bees|bee]] is the rival and counterpart of [[Riley Bee]]. Both bees are the leaders of their respective colors. Bucko Bee and [[Bumble Bee]] have the same skin colors. [[Black Bear]] refers to Bucko Bee as '''"him"''' in the dialogue of the quest Azure Adventure, implying that Bucko Bee is a male. However, this could be referring to [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] specifically. There is a giant model of this bee on top of the entrance of the [[Blue HQ]]. A [[:Category:Quest Bees|Quest Bee]] represents the gifted version of it in the top floor of the Blue HQ. Bucko Bee is the third strongest blue bee, only behind Vicious Bee and Cobalt Bee. The [[Bucko Guard]] is based on Bucko Bee. Bucko Bee, [[Buoyant Bee]], and Bumble Bee are the only Blue bees to like at least three fields. **Bucko Bee is also the only Blue bee to dislike two fields.

docs.title: Buffs & Debuffs
docs.text:
{{Update}} '''Buffs and Debuffs''' are one of the core gameplay [[mechanics]]. The player can obtain them from [[amulet]]s, [[Quest Givers|quest givers]], [[items]], [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], [[codes]], and different dispensers. Some buffs and debuffs are exclusive to one source, such as the Splinter Trap can only be obtained from the [[Stick Bug Challenge]], while others can be obtained in different ways, such as [[Ability Tokens#Boost|blue boosts]] can be obtained from the [[Blueberry Dispenser]], [[bees]], and [[flowers]].

All status effects can be found in the top margin of the screen, above the main menu. The effects are sorted from left to right, with newer effects appearing on the right. Hovering over the icon for a buff/debuff will give information on the stack amount, effect, and duration (if possible). On certain devices, icons for [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] can also be found here instead of next to the hotbar.

==Trivia== The icon for the Frozen debuff is the asset of [[w:c:battlefordreamisland:Ice Cube|Ice Cube]], a character from the animated web series ''[[w:c:battlefordreamisland:Battle for Dream Island (series)|Battle for Dream Island]]''. The 3YearParty code (now expired) used to reward unlimited gumdrops for an hour, but there was a glitch where if the player left and rejoined the game, the buff would disappear. Onett later removed the buff from the code. The shortest buff is Coconut Haste Surge (2 seconds) while the longest is the Honeyday event, Launch Code Boost, and Galentine's Blessing (48 hours each). Speaking to [[Onett]] during [[Beesmas]] would give the player the Honeyday Event buff, even without claiming the hive (if it hadn't been claimed yet). The Splinter Trap icon is the same as the Haste+ icon, which is ironic since they have the opposite effect. Receiving more stacks of Robo Bear Challenge is less detrimental. For example, in round 2, the debuff is x0.12 capacity, which is better than x0.1 in round 1. [[Category:Mechanics]]

Bumble Bee has the same skin color as the [[Bucko Bee]]. Bumble Bee is the blue counterpart of the [[Rascal Bee]]. Defeated [[Rhino Beetle]]s will sometimes drop [[Egg#Specific Bee Eggs|Bumble Bee Eggs]]. A [[Royal Jelly#Royal Jelly Variants|special jelly]] that changes a bee into a Bumble Bee could have been obtained from [[Bubble Bee Man]] and the [[Codes|code]], 'BeeDay2019'and 'Cubly' (expired). Bumble Bee, [[Carpenter Bee]], and [[Honey Bee]] are named after their real-life counterparts. Bumble Bee, Bucko Bee, and [[Buoyant Bee]] are the only Blue bees to like at least three fields. Bumble Bee is the slowest rare bee. Bumble bees gifted stat used to be +20% blue bomb pollen and has since been changed.

docs.text:
{{Bee |color = Blue |rarity = Mythic |image-orig = Buoyant_Bee.png |image-gifted = Buoyant_Bee_Gifted.png |description = Just like a balloon, nothing can keep this bee down. It's always ready to party. |energy = 60 |speed = 14 |attack = 4 |skincolor1 =#1658bb |skincolor2 =#3fc1c3 |skincolor3 =#b6b619 }} '''Buoyant Bee''' is a [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]].

Buoyant Bee’s favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Blueberry}}.

Buoyant Bee likes the [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Mountain Top Field]], and [[Coconut Field]]. It does not dislike any Field.

== Stats ==

  • Collects 15 [[Pollen]] in 5 seconds.
  • Makes 150 [[Honey]] in 3 seconds.
  • +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], -25% Gather Speed, +5 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +25% Convert Speed, +80 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +200% [[Energy]]. *🌟[[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: x1.2 [[Capacity]].

=== Abilities ===

  • '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb|[Blue Bomb]]]''' Collects 10 pollen from 13 surrounding Blue [[Flowers]] (+10% pollen per Level). Combo with other bombs to increase power.
  • '''[[Ability Tokens#Inflate%20Balloons|[Inflate Balloons]]]''' Increases the pollen in [[Balloon]]s on your field by 5% (+0.01% per Level), then spawns a Blue Balloon for 20s (+2s per level) with capacity that scales with bee level and your capacity. ** Pollen collected from flowers near (the shaded ones) the balloon is increased by 10% (20% if blue) and added to the balloon instead of your [[Items#Bags|Container]]. Upon filling up or timing out, the balloon floats back to your [[Hive]]. Converting from a balloon at your hive grants bonus Capacity and [[System Page#Honey At Hive|Honey at Hive]] for 1 hour. ** Standing near a balloon grants a small bonus to Pollen, Blue Pollen, and {{Cost|Honey|}} from Tokens which stacks up to 10 times. ** If Gifted, this has a 5% (+0.5% per level, doubled when the field is boosted) chance to summon a Gold Balloon instead, which has x2 Capacity and an additional x1.25 Pollen instead.
  • '''[[Ability Tokens#Surprise%20Party|[🌟Gifted Ability: Surprise Party]]]''' Summons a Gold Balloon (+1 every 5 levels) for all players, then causes all Balloons to spawn random ability tokens for a few seconds. Gold Balloons gain bonus pollen (increases with bee level) and transform nearby [[Bubble|Bubbles]] into Gold Bubbles, which collect 50% more pollen and have a chance to spawn [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|Honey Tokens]]. If you have triggered a Surprise Party within the last 8 minutes, performs "Inflate Balloons" instead (always spawns a Gold Balloon). When a Surprise Party is activated, a server wide message will say "🎉Surprise Balloons from [Player's Display Name]."
  • '''[[Passive Abilities#Balloon%20Enthusiast|[Passive: Balloon Enthusiast]]]''' When converting from Balloons, this bee has x3 convert amount. Additionally, this bee's base attack scales up to x3 with [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Balloon Blessing]].

{{Stat|pollen = 15|pollentime = 5|honey = 150|honeytime = 3|rarity = mythic}}

== Trivia == * This bee, [[Digital Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], and [[Festive Bee]] are the only bees that can grant boosts to all the players on the server. * This bee, [[Commander Bee]] and [[Frosty Bee]] are the only 3 [[bees]] in the game that wear hats. ** As such, the Buoyant Bee is the only hat-wearing bee that is not an Epic. * This is the only bee to not dislike any field. **[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] stated on Discord that the reason why Buoyant Bee has no disliked fields is that it's supposed to be a "happy" bee. * The Buoyant Bee and the [[Lion Bee]] have the most amount of finite [[Energy]]. * The Buoyant Bee, [[Precise Bee]], and [[Fuzzy Bee]] are the only Mythic bees to be added since the release of the original three [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bees]]. * The Buoyant Bee and the Precise Bee are the only two bees to have their own {{Cost|Robux|}} pack in the same update. * The Buoyant Bee and [[Windy Bee]] are the only bees to be able to produce a White Boost token. Buoyant Bee, however, only produces it through Surprise Parties, meaning it has to be gifted in order to produce white boost tokens. * If you have a lot of Balloon Blessing, the bee will have the same attack as [[Lion Bee]] because of the Balloon Enthusiast passive. * If the player is not in a field when another player in the same server activates a Surprise Party, the subtitle for it will appear on the player's screen but won't summon any Golden Balloons. * Gifted Buoyant Bee's hat glows. * This bee’s gifted form is similar to [[Bumble Bee|Bumble Bee's]] gifted appearance. ** Coincidentally, both Buoyant Bee and Bumble Bee are the only bees to have gifted abilities that multiply a player’s base capacity.

docs.title: Cactus Field
docs.text:
{{Field |image = CactusField2.png |fieldcolor = Assorted |bees = 15 |width = 33 |height = 18 }}The '''Cactus Field''' is a [[field]] located past the [[Honey Bee Gate]] and lies right beside the [[Pumpkin Patch]]. It is protected by the [[Werewolf]].

This is a 33×18 field, containing 594 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of double and triple.

{ class="article-table" !'''Flowers''' !White !Red !Blue !Total - !Single 0% 0% 0% '''0%''' - !Double 4% 18% 22% '''44%''' - !Triple 3% 25% 28% '''56%''' - !'''Total''' '''7%''' '''43%''' '''50%''' '''100%''' } '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[treat]], [[strawberry]], [[blueberry]], [[ticket]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], [[bitterberry]], and [[stinger]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Cactus Field are [[Bomber Bee]], [[Hasty Bee]], [[Commander Bee]], [[Demo Bee]], and [[Vicious Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Cactus Field are [[Exhausted Bee]], [[Baby Bee]], [[Music Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], and [[Tabby Bee]].

This field grants Invigorating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

A Level 4-7 [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has a chance of spawning in this field.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a Cactus [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +100% Cactus Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Cactus Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out.[[File:Cactus Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Cactus Field Boost icon.]]Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], and [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - 300% Cactus Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't maxed out and is based on the type of dice used. * Cactus [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Cactus Field conversion and give s+5% instant Cactus Field conversion and +15% Cactus Field pollen for each stack. Cactus Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. *The [[Icicles]] [[Beequip]] can grant up to +10% Cactus Field pollen Redeeming certain valid codes: * It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Cactus Field Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +27% depending on the amulet rarity.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Giving a [[present]] to [[Onett]] gave Cactus Field Boost x1 and other boosts and [[items]] and giving [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee]] Man a present gave Cactus Field Boost x4 and other boosts and items. * Purchasing a Cactus Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] gave x1.25 Cactus Field Pollen along with x1.5 Cactus [[Field Capacity]], x1.5 [[System Page#Buzz Bomb Pollen|Buzz Bomb Pollen]], and +50 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]]. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Arizona (Gave Cactus Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** FourYearFiesta (Gives Cactus Field Boost x4 and Cactus Field Winds x15 + other items). ** GummyBoost (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** NikTacAttack (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** MoonMiracle (Gave Cactus Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** GummySausage (Gave Cactus Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** PingBoost (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** RebootCode (Gave Cactus Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** Poke (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** Breeze (Gave Cactus Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** Cactus4Now (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 and Cactus Field Winds x2). ** Reboot2020 (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 and Cactus Field Winds x3 + other stuff). ** BlackBearMythic (Gave Cactus Field Boost x3 and Cactus Field Capacity x3 + other stuff).

== Gallery == hivesticker cactus field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * This is the only field where three types of [[treats]] can be found naturally in the same place. * This is the fourth-smallest field in the game, the smaller ones being the [[Pumpkin Patch]], [[Strawberry Field]], and the [[Stump Field]]. * It is possible to hide behind the cactus closest to the [[Pine Tree Forest]] so the werewolf cannot attack the player. * This is one of six fields where [[fireflies]] travel to, with the others being [[Bamboo Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Rose Field]], [[Spider Field]], and Strawberry Field. * This is one of three fields that is protected by the werewolf, the others being the Pumpkin Patch and the Pine Tree Forest. * This is the only field in the Honey Bee gate which gives invigorating nectar.

docs.title: Capacity
docs.text:
'''Capacity''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that shows how much [[pollen]] the player can store at a time. Capacity can be increased in a variety of ways including [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]], [[items]], [[sticker]]s, and [[amulet]]s. Capacity can be increased by static amounts or by multipliers. Static increases can be shown simply through addition symbols (+) while multipliers can be shown through multiplication symbols (x) or percentages (%). The player's Capacity is displayed in the top-middle section, labelled as "Pollen" and also on the player's bag. The player can see how much their capacity is multiplied by looking for the Capacity Multiplier stat in the [[System Page]]. [[File:PollenCapacity1.png|frame]]

==Ways to Obtain==

===Bags=== Each [[Bags|bag]] adds a static amount of Capacity for the player. These are typically the bulk of the static amount of Capacity that the player can hold at once.

  • The [[Pouch]] gives +200 Capacity.
  • The [[Jar]] gives +750 Capacity.
  • The [[Backpack]] gives +3,500 Capacity.
  • The [[Canister]] gives +10,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Mega-Jug]] gives +25,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Compressor]] gives +50,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Elite Barrel]] gives +125,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Port-O-Hive]] gives +250,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Red Port-O-Hive]] gives +350,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Blue Port-O-Hive]] gives +350,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Porcelain Port-O-Hive]] gives +500,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Coconut Canister]] gives +1,000,000 Capacity.

===Belts=== Each belt adds a static amount of Capacity for the player. Three of the belts also give a Capacity Multiplier.

  • The [[Belt Pocket]] gives +5,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Belt Bag]] gives +25,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Mondo Belt Bag]] gives +100,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Honeycomb Belt]] gives +150,000 capacity. It also gives +25% Capacity.
  • The [[Petal Belt]] gives +250,000 capacity. It also gives +50% Capacity.
  • The [[Coconut Belt]] gives +350,000 capacity. It also gives +75% Capacity.

===Guards=== Each guard adds a static amount of Capacity for the player.

  • The [[Brave Guard]] gives +5,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Hasty Guard]] gives +5,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Bomber Guard]] gives +5,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Looker Guard]] gives +5,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Red Guard]] gives +25,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Elite Red Guard]] gives +75,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Riley Guard]] gives +150,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Blue Guard]] gives +25,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Elite Blue Guard]] gives +75,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Bucko Guard]] gives +150,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Crimson Guard]] gives +250,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Cobalt Guard]] gives +250,000 Capacity.

===Hats=== There are several hats/masks that add a static amount of Capacity or give a Capacity Multiplier for the player.

  • The [[Strange Goggles]] give +77 Capacity.
  • The [[B.B.M. Mask]] gives +75,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Mondo B.B.M. Mask]] gives +250,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Honey Mask]] gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The [[Fire Mask]] gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The [[Bubble Mask]] gives a x1.5 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The [[Gummy Mask]] gives a x1.5 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The [[Demon Mask]] gives a x1.5 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The [[Diamond Mask]] gives a x3 Capacity Multiplier.

===Amulets=== There are several amulets that add a static amount of Capacity for the player. Star Amulets give a Capacity Multiplier.

  • The [[Star Amulet]] gives a Capacity Multiplier depending on the tier. ** The Bronze Star Amulet gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Silver Star Amulet gives a x1.5 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Gold Star Amulet gives a x1.75 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Diamond Star Amulet gives a x2 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Supreme Star Amulet gives a x2.5 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The [[Moon Amulet]] gives +25,000 Capacity which can be upgraded to +250,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Stick Bug Amulet]] can give up to +300,000 Capacity depending on the tier. ** The Bronze Stick Bug Amulet gives from +25,000 Capacity up to +100,000 Capacity. ** The Silver Stick Bug Amulet gives from +100,000 Capacity up to +150,000 Capacity. ** The Gold Stick Bug Amulet gives from +150,000 Capacity up to +200,000 Capacity. ** The Diamond Stick Bug Amulet gives from +200,000 Capacity up to +300,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Cog Amulet]] can give up to +250,000 Capacity depending on the tier. ** The Bronze Cog Amulet gives from +22,500 Capacity up to +26,500 Capacity. ** The Silver Cog Amulet gives from +45,000 Capacity up to +51,500 Capacity. ** The Gold Cog Amulet gives from +90,000 Capacity up to +108,000 Capacity. ** The Diamond Cog Amulet gives from +127,500 Capacity up to +162,500 Capacity. ** The Supreme Cog Amulet gives from +200,000 Capacity up to +250,000 Capacity.

===Gifted Hive Bonuses=== There are two [[bees]] that give a Capacity Multiplier if [[Gifted Bee|gifted]].

  • Gifted [[Bumble Bee]] gives a x1.1 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Gifted [[Buoyant Bee]] gives a x1.2 Capacity Multiplier.

===Beequips=== There are a handful of [[beequip]]s that add a static amount of Capacity or give a Capacity Multiplier.

  • A {{Cost|Beret|||0}} gives from +6,000 Capacity up to +13,500 Capacity.
  • A {{Cost|Single Mitten|||0}} gives from +7,500 Capacity up to +10,000 Capacity. Using [[waxes]] can increase the amount up to +15,000 Capacity.
  • A {{Cost|Warm Scarf|||0}} can give from +1% Capacity to +10% Capacity from waxing.
  • A {{Cost|Beesmas Tree Hat|||0}} gives from +10,000 Capacity up to +25,000 Capacity. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +35,000 Capacity.
  • The {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers|||0}} can give from +1% Capacity to +20% Capacity from waxing.
  • The {{Cost|Festive Wreath|||0}} gives from +5,000 Capacity up to +10,000 Capacity. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +110,000 Capacity.

===Passives=== There are two [[Passive Abilities|passives]] that give a Capacity Multiplier. They can be obtained via a Diamond Star Amulet or Supreme Star Amulet. The Guiding Star Aura could also be obtained from [[Onett's Lid Art]] during Beesmas.

  • The Guiding Star passive gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Guiding Star Aura gives x2.5 Capacity to the player who summoned the star and x1.25 Capacity to other players.
  • The Star Shower passive give a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier.

===Buffs=== There are several ways to get a buff to capacity such as inventory items, [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], defeating [[mobs]], and redeeming [[codes]].

  • Using a {{Cost|Purple Potion|||0}} gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier. The buff can also be given from certain codes.
  • Using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} gives a x1.5 Capacity Multiplier. The buff can also be given from certain codes.
  • Using a {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|||0}} gives +50% Capacity. The buff can also be given from certain codes.
  • Using a {{Cost|Snowflake|||0}} or collecting the [[Ability Tokens#Snowglobe Shake|Snowglobe Shake]] ability token from the {{Cost|Snowglobe|||0}} Beequip gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Using a {{Cost|Glitched Drive|||0}} during the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Making combos with [[Ability Tokens#Fetch|Reindeer Fetch]] from [[Puppy Bee]] with the {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers}} Beequip equipped can give from a x1.01 Capacity Multiplier up to a x1.1 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Defeating the [[Mondo Chick]] for the Mondo Chick Blessing can give from a x1.02 Capacity Multiplier up to a x1.2 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Balloon Blessing can give from a x1.03 capacity multiplier up to a x4 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Galentine's Blessing (Beesmas only) gives +50% Capacity.
  • Beesmas Repentance (Beesmas only) gives a x1.05 Capacity Multiplier.
  • Defeating [[Festive Nymph]]s during Beesmas will guarantee a Festive Nymph Blessing token drop which can stack up to give from +1,000 Capacity up to +250,000 Capacity. The buff can also be given from certain codes.
  • Defeating Party Robots or completing a [[Robo Party]] during Beesmas can give Robo Party Blessing which can stack up to give from +1,000 Capacity up to +100,000 Capacity. The buff can also be given from certain codes.
  • The Guiding Star Aura gives x2.5 Capacity to the player who summoned the star and x1.25 Capacity to other players.
  • The Capacity Code buff, which is given by certain codes, gives a x2 Capacity Multiplier.

===Robo Bear Challenge Upgrades=== There are several upgrades that can be bought with [[cog]]s during the Robo Bear Challenge which can upgrade Capacity.

  • Common Upgrades: ** Defragment: This upgrades starts at x1.5 Capacity and maxes at 10 upgrades with x6 Capacity.
  • Rare Upgrades: ** Expansion: This upgrades starts at x1.25 Capacity and maxes at 100 upgrades with x25 Capacity. ** RAM: This upgrades starts at +75,000 Capacity and maxes at 10 upgrades with +750,000 Capacity.
  • Epic Upgrades: ** HDD: This upgrade gives x3 Capacity.
  • Legendary Upgrades: ** Optimize: This upgrades starts at x1.1 Capacity and maxes at 25 upgrades with x2.5 Capacity. ** The Cloud: This upgrades starts at x2.5 Capacity and maxes at 3 upgrades with x5.5 Capacity.

===Badges=== There are a handful of [[badges]] that add a static amount of capacity or give a Capacity Multiplier.

  • The [[Quests|Quest]] Badge gives a Capacity Multiplier depending on the badge rank. ** The Cadet Quest Badge gives a x1.25 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Hotshot Quest Badge gives a x1.5 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Ace Quest Badge gives a x1.75 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Master Quest Badge gives a x2 Capacity Multiplier. ** The Grandmaster Quest Badge gives a x2.25 Capacity Multiplier.
  • The Ability Badge can give up to +250,000 Capacity depending on the badge rank. ** The Cadet Ability Badge gives +25,000 Capacity. ** The Hotshot Ability Badge gives +50,000 Capacity. ** The Ace Ability Badge gives +100,000 Capacity. ** The Master Ability Badge gives +150,000 Capacity. ** The Grandmaster Ability Badge gives +250,000 Capacity.
  • The [[Sunflower Field|Sunflower]] Badge gives a Capacity Multiplier depending on the badge rank. ** The Cadet Sunflower Badge gives +10% Capacity. ** The Hotshot Sunflower Badge gives +20% Capacity. ** The Ace Sunflower Badge gives +30% Capacity. ** The Master Sunflower Badge gives +40% Capacity. ** The Grandmaster Sunflower Badge gives +50% Capacity.

===Sticker Stack Boosts=== A lot of [[sticker]]s can give capacity as a [[Sticker Stack|stack]] boost. They can give a static amount or a capacity multiplier.

  • +10,000 Capacity: ** Noob Cub Skin, Bee Cub Skin, Gingerbread Cub Skin, Snow Cub Skin, Peppermint Robo Cub Skin, Doodle Cub Skin, Wavy Doodle Hive Skin, Sitting Green Shirt Bear, Green Check Mark, Green Plus Sign, Thumbs Up Hand, Traffic Light, Doodle S, Play Button, and Gamer Chat Icon.
  • +15,000 Capacity: ** Launching Rocket.
  • +20,000 Capacity: ** Eviction, Hourglass, Abstract Color Painting, Ionic Column Top, Ionic Column Middle, and Ionic Column Base.
  • +1% Capacity: ** Sprout, Cool Backpack, Waxing Crescent Moon, Cordate Leaf, Cunate Leaf, Elliptic Leaf, Hastate Leaf, Lanceolate Leaf, Oblique Leaf, Reniform Leaf, Rhomboid Leaf, and Spatulate Leaf.

  • +2% Capacity: ** Auryn, Glowing Smile, Prehistoric Boar, Moai, Capricorn Star Sign, Aquarius Star Sign, Cancer Star Sign, Virgo Star Sign, Leo Star Sign, Sagittarius Star Sign, Gemini Star Sign, Libra Star Sign, Pisces Star Sign, Aries Star Sign, Taurus Star Sign, and Scorpio Star Sign.

  • Specific Bonuses: ** Forward Facing Spider - +10% Spider Field Capacity, Jack-O-Lantern - +10% Pumpkin Patch Capacity, Palm Tree - +10% Coconut Field Capacity, Built Ship - +2% Blue Field Capacity, Red Doodle Person - +2% Red Field Capacity, Fork And Knife - +2% White Field Capacity, Pearl Girl - +2% White Field Capacity.

==Downgrades== There is a debuff that reduces the Capacity of the player.

  • The Robo Bear Challenge Debuff reduces the Capacity by a depending on what round the player is on in the Robo Bear Challenge. At Round 1, it has a x0.1 Capacity Multiplier and increases by 0.015 per round to a total of a x0.46 Capacity Multiplier. There are certain upgrades that can be bought with cogs during the Robo Bear Challenge which can downgrade Capacity.

  • Common Upgrades: ** Overfit: Red: This upgrades starts at x0.9 Capacity and maxes at 10 upgrades with x0.5 Capacity. ** Sharpen: This upgrades starts at x0.95 Capacity and maxes at 10 upgrades with x0.75 Capacity.

  • Rare Upgrades: ** Crypto: This upgrades starts at x0.85 Capacity and maxes at 3 upgrades with x0.55 Capacity.
  • Epic Upgrades: ** Malware: This upgrades starts at x0.75 Capacity and maxes at 3 upgrades with x0.25 Capacity.
  • Legendary Upgrades: ** Overclock: This upgrade gives x0.75 Capacity.

==Gallery== Capacity.png|The icon used for certain codes that give capacity. CapacityMultiplier1.png|The Capacity Multiplier stat in the System Page. BackpackCapacity1.png|A player's Capacity displayed on their bag. PollenFullMessage1.png|The message for having full Capacity and attempting to collect more pollen.

==Trivia== * The highest static Capacity the player can have at a time if you were to remove all multipliers is 4,807,000. This is achieved by having: ** Mondo B.B.M. Mask (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}) ** Coconut Canister (+{{Hover|1M|1,000,000}}) ** Crimson Guard (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}) ** Cobalt Guard (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}) ** Coconut Belt (+{{Hover|350K|350,000}}) ** Moon Amulet (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}) ** Stick Bug Amulet (+{{Hover|300K|300,000}}) ** Cog Amulet (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}) ** Two Berets (+{{Hover|27K|27,000}}) ** Three Single Mittens (+{{Hover|45K|45,000}}) ** Three Beesmas Tree Hats (+{{Hover|105K|105,000}}) ** Festive Wreath (+{{Hover|110K|110,000}}) ** Festive Nymph Blessing (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}) ** Robo Party Blessing (+{{Hover|100K|100,000}}) ** RAM upgrade maxed (+{{Hover|750K|750,000}}) ** Grandmaster Ability Badge (+{{Hover|250K|250,000}}). ** All Sticker Stack Effects ({{Hover|+270K|150,000 From +10,000 & 120,000 From +20,000}}) *** If all +(%) multipliers are applied, the player would have a total of 15,704,500 Capacity. *** If all multipliers were applied, the player would have a total of 771,391,706,905,963 Capacity. * This Is achieved by having Most from above and: Replace Mondo B.B.M. Mask With Diamond Mask ({{Hover|-250k but x3|-250,000 but x3}}) Supreme Star Amulet ({{Hover|x2.5|x2.5}}) Gifted Hive Bonuses ({{Hover|x1.1 & x1.2|1.1 From Bumble Bee and 2.2 From Buoyant Bee}}) *** Replace one Beret With [[Beequip|Puppy Bee's Antlers]] * The lowest possible capacity the player can have is 0.7734357 but can not display it. By equipping the [[Pouch]] (+200) and having every upgrade that reduces capacity in the Robo Bear Challenge while having no other Capacity increasers or multipliers. * The Capacity Buff, Field Code Buff, Field Capacity Buff, and the x2 Pollen Boost are the only code exclusive buffs. It built its own body out of wood. |energy = 25 |speed = 11.2 |attack = 5 |energylabel = more |skincolor2 = #FFC812 |skincolor1 = #966A55 |skincolor3 = #966A55 }} '''Carpenter Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bee]].

Carpenter Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.

Carpenter Bee likes the [[Bamboo Field]], and [[Pine Tree Forest]]. It dislikes the [[Mountain Top Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 3 seconds. * Makes 120 [[honey]] in 4 seconds. * -20% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +25% [[Energy]], +25% gather speed, +40 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +4 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. * 🌟[[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +25% [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]].

== Abilities == * [[Ability Tokens#Mark|'''[Honey Mark+]''']] Marks a large random area on the [[Fields|Field]] for 8 seconds (+0.25s per level) that grants 2 Conversion Links and x1.25 [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]] while you stand on it. Stacks up to 3 times. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Mark|[Pollen Mark]]]''' Marks a random area on the field for 7 seconds (+0.2s per level) that increases all pollen up to 50% while you stand in it. Stacks up to 3 times.

{{Stat|color = Colorless|pollen = 10|pollentime = 3|honey = 100|honeytime = 4|rarity = legendary}}

== Gallery == CarpenterBeeFace.png|Carpenter Bee's face. File:CarpenterBeeJelly.png|A Carpenter Bee Jelly in a player's inventory. File:GiftedCarpenterBeeEgg.png|A Gifted Carpenter Bee Egg in a player's inventory.

== Trivia == * Just like [[Music Bee]], this bee originated from Number1Riker's Bee Swarm showcase. ** Carpenter Bee and Music Bee are also the only Legendary bees added in an [[Updates|Update]]. * This bee uses the Wood Texture and has a Hammer Mesh in its body. * This bee, [[Spicy Bee]], and [[Vector Bee]] are the only non-[[Bees/Event|Event Bees]] that have special body parts (Hammer Mesh). * This is one of two bees added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 Update]], along with [[Stubborn Bee]]. * One reason Carpenter Bee likes the Pine Tree Forest might be because pine trees are made of wood. ** One reason Carpenter Bee dislikes the [[Mountain Top Field]] might be because on the tops of tall mountains, there are no trees. * Carpenter Bee, along with [[Honey Bee]] and [[Bumble Bee]], are the only bees named after their real-life counterparts. * Carpenter Bee is the only bee that can generate the Honey Mark+ ability token. * This bee was one of the bees to have a specific jelly in the [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. The jelly was given as part of the Pinecone Bundle. * This bee is the only Legendary bee who can't find a [[sticker]] while gathering.

docs.title: Caustic Wax
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Causticwax.png |description=A glowing hunk of beeswax. Has a 25% chance to GREATLY improve a Beequip - but a 75% chance to DESTROY it!}} {{Color|Caustic Wax}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] and a type of [[Waxes|wax]] added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]] that can be used on a [[Beequip]] to boost its stats. Upon usage, it has a 25% chance of greatly improving the Beequip's stats; however, it has a 75% chance of permanently destroying the Beequip instead, destroying the Beequip and also wasting the Caustic Wax. This wax cannot be used on permanent Beequips. Caustic Wax has [[Beequip#Stats, Waxes, Chances|Upgrade Value]] of 4.

It also can be used to craft a variety of different items, such as [[planter]]s and [[tools]].

When successfully applying Caustic Wax to a bee's Beequip, a message pops up saying:{{Notification||The Wax improved the Beequip!}}

If the wax fails to upgrade the Beequip, a message will pop up saying:{{Notification|red|The Wax destroyed the Beequip...}}

Prior to the removal of Permanent Beequips, using a Caustic Wax on a {{Cost|Festive Wreath|||0}} or {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers}} results in the following message:{{Notification||Cannot use this wax on a Permanent Beequip}} == Ways to Obtain == Crafting it via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Hard Wax|5}} ** {{Cost|Enzymes|5}} ** {{Cost|Neonberry|25}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|5252}} * As a stack reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** {{Cost|Black Diamond Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 caustic wax. ** {{Cost|Prismatic Mushroom Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 caustic wax. As a reward from Gifted Riley Bee's [[Honeyday Candles|honeyday candles]]. (0.81%) Buying the Royal Winter Wonder Haul for 4,500 Robux awards 25 caustic wax. Purchasing deals in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]: 1 Caustic Wax is included in the Candlewax Bundle. 5 Caustic Wax are included in the Brilliant Beesmas Bundle. **10 Caustic Wax are included in the Triumphant Turp Pack.

=== Drops === * As a rare drop from Legendary and Mythic [[Puffshroom]]s. * As a very rare drop from sticker [[Sprout]]s. * As a drop from a lvl 17 [[Snowbear]]. * As a drop from certain [[Planter]]s. ** A {{Cost|Plastic Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Rose Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Mountain Top Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Blue Clay Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Clover Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Red Clay Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Clover Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Tacky Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Bamboo Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Pesticide Planter|||0}} placed in any field has a rare chance of dropping one. Some fields have higher chances of dropping one such as the [[Strawberry Field]] or the [[Bamboo Field]]. ** A [[Ticket Planter]] has a rare chance of dropping one. ** A {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Coconut Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Coconut Field]] guarantees one every month. ** A {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} placed in the [[Dandelion Field]] guarantees one every month. ** {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}} has a 33% chance of dropping one.

=== Quests === * [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] "Beesmas Quest - Goo Years Beacon" rewards 5 Caustic Wax and other items. * [[Dapper Bear]] gives a total of 3 Caustic Wax on the following quests: ** Dapper Bear's "The Long Haul" (#10) rewards one Caustic Wax and other items. ** Dapper Bear's "Ongoing Maintenance" (#13) rewards one Caustic Wax and other items. ** Dapper Bear's "More Than Myth" (#15) rewards one Caustic Wax and other items. * [[Polar Bear|Polar Bear's]] "⏳ Waiting With Sun Bear (4/6): and Polar Bear" rewards a Caustic Wax and other items.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * From certain [[Gift Boxes]]. ** The Emerald Gift Box from Beesmas 2021 gave 1 Caustic Wax + other items. ** The Tropical Gift Box from Beesmas 2022 gave 1 Caustic Wax + other items. * Completing [[Gifted Riley Bee|Gifted Riley Bee's]] Beesmas 2021 Quest rewarded 1 Caustic Wax + other items. * A rare chance of being a match from [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]]. * As a guaranteed Drop from a level 17 [[Snowbear]] during Beesmas 2022. * Purchasing the Mondo Robo Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|4500}} gave 25 Caustic Waxes + other items. * Purchasing the Candlelight Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] 2022 gave 10 Caustic Waxes + other items. * Players who defeated at least 25 out of the 50 [[Mega Mechsquito]]s required to be defeated in [[Stick Bug]]’s Beesmas 2022 quest before the nerf got 3 Caustic Waxes + other items as compensation. |}

== Crafting Uses == Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Caustic Wax|228}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Caustic Wax}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |3 |{{Cost|Honey|750,000,000}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|25}}{{Cost|Neonberry|25}}{{Cost|Glue|15}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|10}} |[[File:Pesticide Planter.png|80px|center|link=Pesticide Planter]]{{Color|Pesticide Planter}} |- |10 |{{Cost|Super Smoothie|10}}{{Cost|Star Jelly|100}}{{Cost|Honeysuckle|1000}} |[[File:Turpentine.png|80px|center|link=Turpentine]]{{Color|Turpentine}} |- |25 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|750B|750,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|75}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|750}}{{Cost|Soft Wax|500}}{{Cost|Turpentine|1}} |[[File:Hydroponic Planter.png|80px|center|link=Hydroponic Planter]][[Hydroponic Planter]] |- |50 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Red Extract|1,500}}{{Cost|Stinger|150}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|100}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Invigorating Vial|3}} |[[File:Dark_scythe.png|80px|center|link=Dark Scythe]][[Dark Scythe]] |- |50 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Glue|1,500}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|2,000}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Turpentine|5}}{{Cost|Satisfying Vial|3}} |[[File:Gummyballer.png|80px|center|link=Gummyballer]][[Gummyballer]] |- |100 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|100T|100,000,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|500}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|100}}{{Cost|Swirled Wax|100}}{{Cost|Turpentine|25}} |[[File:The Planter Of Plenty.png|80px|center|link=The Planter Of Plenty]]{{Color|The Planter Of Plenty}} |}

== Trivia == * Caustic Wax's raw ingredients cost: ** {{Cost|Honeysuckle|75}} ** {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|750}} ** {{Cost|Pineapple|1,750}} ** {{Cost|Bitterberry|165}} ** {{Cost|Neonberry|25}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|6,067}} or {{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|6.06B|6,067,000,000}}}} * The probability of Caustic Wax improving a Beequip 5 times in a row is 1/1024 or ~0.098%. Because of its low chances and its ability to destroy the Beequip, it is not recommended to try and use 5 Caustic Waxes on a Beequip when you are not prepared yet, instead people usually use {{Cost|Swirled Wax|||0}} right after getting 1 successful caustic, to get upgrade rolls in desired stats. * For some time, this wax could not be used on permanent Beequips. * This is the only wax that can destroy Beequips. * [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s Beesmas 2022 quest required players to destroy 31 Beequips with Caustic Wax. * Prior to the [[Updates#2024.12.25|12/25/2024 update]], this item used to share the same icon with the {{Cost|Debug Wax|4=0}}. ** Although the Debug Wax texture has been changed, both waxes do the same thing, just that Debug Waxes have a 100% chance of working. {{Items}} [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Waxes]] [[Category:Crafted]] [[Category:Consumables]]

docs.title: Cave Monster
docs.text:
{{Mob |title=Cave Monster |image=Cave_Monster.png |location=Inside [[Werewolf's Cave]] |timer=30 minutes |hp=400 |damage={{Hover|10 thousand|10,000}} |points=1 |bond=N/A |honey=None |level=11 }} ''Not to be confused with the [[Spider]], which has a similar appearance.''

The '''Cave Monster''' is a level 11 [[Mobs|mob]] that spawns inside the [[Werewolf's Cave]]. They look identical to a [[spider]], except that they lack eyes. Cave Monsters make eerie whispering noises when the player gets close to them. A [[Honeystorm]] and a [[Mythic Meteor Shower]] (and during the Beesmas events, a [[Snow Storm]]) can make it bright enough to see their bodies.

Their primary purpose is to guard a {{Cost|Gold Egg|4=1}} located at the end of the cave. The best way to reach it is to have [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste+]], Haste x5 or higher, or by using the [[glider]]. Be aware that the roof of the Cave is not very high, so it is easy to hit your head and slow you down.

It is possible to defeat the cave monster. However, they move very fast, so some slower [[bees]] will be unable to reach them. The best way to defeat them is by activating the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]] and running quickly toward the gold egg token. Cave Monsters are the only mobs to (albeit rarely) drop a [[Egg#Specific Bee Eggs|Honey Bee Egg]]. If the player does not have the [[Coconut Canister]], another method is to quickly move into and then out of their spawning zone. You can also use the [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]] passive ability from the [[Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulet]]. It takes 30 minutes for one to respawn and they don't count as spiders towards [[quests]] from [[bear]]s.

==Drops== *{{Cost|Honey Bee Egg|4=0}} (somewhat rare)

==Gallery== Cavespider.png|A cave monster in a honeystorm. Cave Monsters-0.jpg|The cave monsters seen from above. F30BBCA3-8C46-4306-AED7-FDF5BB9FD383.jpeg|A cave monster out of the dark. Cave Monsters.gif|A player being killed by the cave monsters.

==Trivia== [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] had stated that cave monsters have a rare drop and can only be obtained by defeating them, but he also said that the drop is not very useful. This was later confirmed to be a Honey Bee egg. Onett had also jokingly said that "Saving the [[Honey Bee|honey bee]] from the cave monsters was the ultimate goal of [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]." Their noises can be heard throughout the entire map, along with [[Mondo Chick]], [[Commando Chick]], and a few other things. Cave monsters were the first mobs that are able to instantly kill the player and one of two mobs that instantly kill the player upon touching them (the other being [[Tunnel Bear]]). This makes the cave monsters the most lethal non-boss mob in the game. Cave monsters have the second highest base level of any mob in-game, with the [[Coconut Crab]] having the highest. Cave monsters, [[King Beetle]], Tunnel Bear, [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], [[Stick Bug]], [[Robo Bear Challenge|RBC mobs]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[aphid]]s and [[Commando Chick]] are the mobs who don't belong to any particular fields. There used to be 4 cave monsters because the gold egg was once the rarest [[Items|item]] in the game. Cave monsters have one of the fewest possible amounts of drops in the game, only behind [[ants]], and [[Robo Bear Challenge|RBC mobs]], which have none. Cave monsters, Coconut Crab, [[Robo Bear Challenge|RBC Mobs]], [[Snowbear]], and ants are the only mobs that don't drop honey upon death. Cave monsters are currently the only mobs with a set respawn time that [[Quest Givers|quest givers]] do not require the player to defeat. Cave monsters are the only defeatable mobs that do not have a health bar. Between the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/18]] and the [[Updates#2018.12.25|12/25/18]] [[updates]], the Cave Monsters had a health bar that revealed they were level 11 and had 400 health. When donating the Honey Bee Egg to the [[Wind Shrine]], there is a decent chance it will spawn [[Bean Bug]]s. This makes killing the Cave Monster somewhat useful as some quests require collecting tokens from Bean Bugs. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]]

docs.title: Chicks
docs.text:
[[File:Normal Chicken.png|thumb|A Level 4 Chick, which is now removed.]] '''Chicks''' are [[mobs]] that were added in the [[Updates#2020.04.06|Egg Hunt 2020 Update]]. They could spawn in a variety of places depending on their type, and have a special ability to hide inside their eggshells, increasing their defense and the chance for a bee's attacks to be blocked.

There are five different types of chicks: Chicks, Hostage Chicks, Spotted Chicks, Commando Chicks, and Mondo Chicks. Chicks, Spotted Chicks and Hostage Chicks cannot deal damage to players while the Commando Chick and Mondo Chick can. When a chick loses all of its health points, it gets captured, and the game will notify the player in the chat. Chicks, Hostage Chicks, and Spotted Chicks were removed from the game at the end of Egg Hunt 2020.

== Chick == {{RemovedContent}} {{Mob |title = Chick |image = Chick_(2).png |location = [[Sunflower Field]] |timer = 30 seconds |hp = Varies |damage = 0 |points = 0 |bond = 130 |honey = X |level = 1-15 }} Normal '''Chicks''' were passive mobs that could have appeared in the [[Sunflower Field]] and would spawn randomly when players were collecting [[Pollen]]. The chicks could've spawned with a level range of 1-15. They could only spawn if the player had [[Black Bear#Egg Hunt Quest 2020|Black Bear's Sunflower Corral Quest]] active.

=== Drops === * [[Honey]] * [[Sunflower Seed|Sunflower seeds]] * [[Treats]]

== Hostage Chick ==

{{RemovedContent}} {{Mob |title = Hostage Chick |image = Hostagechick_(1).png |location = [[:Category:Mobs|Mob drops]] |timer = 30 seconds |hp = Varies |damage = 0 |points = 0 |bond = 0 |honey = Varies |level = 1-15 }} The '''Hostage Chicks''' were passive mobs that had a chance of spawning after defeating a hostile mob or a [[:Category:Bosses|Boss]] (Defeating [[Ants]] or other chicks would not spawn a hostage chick). They could spawn with a level range of 1-15 and would always despawn 30 seconds after spawning. Mobs that are more difficult to defeat, such as [[Tunnel Bear]], were more likely to cause a hostage chick to spawn. Hostage chicks that spawn from more difficult mobs will have higher health, level, and better rewards than ones that spawn from easier mobs.

[[File:Hostagechickegg.png|thumb|A hostage chick hiding in its egg.]]

== Spotted Chick == {{RemovedContent}} {{Mob |title = Spotted Chick |image =Spottedchick_(2).png |location = [[:Category:Shops|Shops]] |timer = 30 seconds |hp = Varies |damage = 0 |points = 0 |bond = 0 |honey = Varies |level = 3-9 }} The '''Spotted Chicks''' were passive mobs that could appear inside of the [[Noob Shop]], [[Pro Shop]], [[Ticket Tent]], and the [[Mazes#Blue Maze|Blue Maze]]. Spotted chicks could spawn with a level range of 3-9.

Capturing a spotted chick would cause another spotted chick to spawn in a different location. If a spotted chick was captured in the Noob Shop, another spotted chick would spawn in the Ticket Tent, and vice versa. Similarly, if a spotted chick was captured in the Pro Shop, another spotted chick will spawn in the Blue Maze, and vice versa. === Drops === * [[Honey]]. * [[Treat]]s. * [[Strawberry|Strawberries]].

== Commando Chick == {{Main|Commando Chick}}

{{Mob |title = Commando Chick |image =Commandochick.png |location = [[Commando Chick's Hideout]] |timer = 30:00 (25:30 with Gifted Vicious Bee) |hp = Varies on number of captures |damage = 20 (Colliding with the player), 50 (From grenade) |points = 0 |bond = 0 |honey = Varies on number of captures |level = 3-20 }} The '''Commando Chick''' is a [[:Category:Mini Bosses|mini-boss]] that spawns in [[Commando Chick's Hideout|its hideout]]. Its hideout is located to the left of [[Brown Bear]] and the [[Wealth Clock]]. To cut the vines, the [[Clippers]], [[Scissors]], [[Scythe]], or [[Dark Scythe]] needs to be equipped. Once the vines are cut, they will never grow back.

The Commando Chick has a respawn time of 30:00 (25:30 with [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]). When Commando Chick hides in its egg, it throws grenades (1 if it has more than 2/3 of its health, 2 if it has less than 2/3 of its health, 3 if it has less than 1/3 of its health, 4 if less than 1/100). The egg cracks after a few seconds, also causing it to stop moving for a few seconds.

The Commando Chick deals 20 damage when colliding with the player and 50 damage if the player is near a grenade when it explodes. Starting at 150 health and level 3, the chick increases in health and level with each successive capture, reaching level 6 by the fifth capture. The chick will grow another level after a progressively higher number of captures per level up.

== Mondo Chick == {{Main|Mondo Chick}}

{{Mob |title = Mondo Chick |image =MondoChicktransparent.png |location = [[Mountain Top Field]] |timer = 45 minutes - 1 hour |hp = 300,000 |damage = 75 |points = 0 |bond = 0 |honey = Varies |level = 8 }} The '''Mondo Chick''' is a level 8 [[:Category:Bosses|boss]] mob located in the [[Mountain Top Field]]. It respawns every hour at the full hour (1:00, 2:00, 3:00, etc; not in time zones that are a fractional number of hours away from UTC), and its respawn timer can be found on the side of the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. The respawn time is unaffected by the Monster Respawn Time stat. Its rewards are shareable between players.

The Mondo Chick will always spawn at level 8 with 300,000 health. It automatically takes 333 damage each second, causing its health to reach 300 after 15 minutes. If it isn't defeated within 15 minutes of spawning, it will despawn in a similar fashion of the Commando Chick. After despawning, a server-wide message will say "🐣Mondo Chick got away!🐣" Like the [[Coconut Crab]], the faster the Mondo Chick is defeated, the better the rewards will be. Due to its large hitbox and damage, it is recommended to put distance between the player and the Mondo Chick.

Sometimes, the Mondo Chick will hide in its egg, allowing it to block some attacks. However, when it is hiding, it stops moving until it comes out again. The egg can be cracked early by dealing 7500 damage to it.

When it runs out of time, it will jump out of the field towards the [[Lion Bee Gate]] entrance. {| class="article-table" !Time took to defeat the Mondo Chick !Amount of Mondo Chick Blessing |- |<5 seconds |x10 |- |6 – 10 seconds |x9 |- |11 – 15 seconds |x8 |- |16 – 20 seconds |x7 |- |21 – 30 seconds |x6 |- |31 – 59 seconds |x5 |- |1:00 - 2:30 |x4 |- |2:31 - 4:59 |x3 |- |5:01 - 10:00 |x2 |- |10:01 - 15:00 |x1 |}

=== Drops === * [[Honey]]. * [[Treat]]s. * [[Bitterberry|Bitterberries]]. * [[Snowflake]]s (Beesmas only). * [[Neonberry|Neonberries]]. * [[Field Dice|Field dice]]. * [[Micro-Converter|Micro-converters]]. * [[Magic Bean|Magic beans]] (Somewhat rare). * [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|Star jellies]] (Rare). * [[Snowglobe]]s (Rare, Beesmas only). * [[Egg#Diamond Egg|Diamond eggs]] (Very rare; chance varies depending on time). * Basic Pink Hive Skin (Very rare) * [[Eggs#Mythic Egg|Mythic eggs]] (Very rare; chance varies depending on time). * [[Star Treat|Star treats]] (Exceptionally rare; chance varies depending on time).

== Audio == The chirping sound made from a Chick, Spotted Chick, Hostage Chick, and Commando Chick: [[File:Chickchirp.ogg]]

When a Chick, Spotted Chick, Hostage Chick, or Commando Chick breaks out of its egg: [[File:Eggcrack.ogg]]

The chirping sound made from the Mondo Chick: [[File:Mondochickchirp.ogg]]

The following audio plays when the Mondo Chick breaks out of its egg: [[File:Mondochickhatch.ogg]]

The chirping sound made when the Mondo Chick is captured: [[File:Mondo Capture.ogg]]

== Trivia == * According to [[Sun Bear]], the chicks are invasive to the Mountain. Their eggs are also considered exotic.

  • According to [[Mother Bear]], the Spotted Chicks dislike the sun.

  • According to [[Black Bear]], Bees don't hurt chicks when attacking. They work together to calm them down and capture them as they are "frightened".

  • Although other player's Commando Chicks can't damage the player directly, their grenades can. A player's bees can also damage other players' Commando Chicks.

  • Interestingly, the Commando Chick is considered a mini-boss although every player has their “own” Commando Chick.

  • The Mondo Chick's noise can be heard throughout the entire map. ** This is also the case with the [[Cave Monster]]s.

  • The Mondo Chick is the only mob that has a fixed spawn point in the Mountain Top Field.

  • The Spotted Chick is the only mob in the game that spawned in [[:Category:Shops|shops]].

  • During the soft launch of the Egg Hunt 2020 update, the Mondo Chick only had 250,000 health. It was later changed to 300,000 the following day.

  • Because Rogue Vicious Bee's spikes can deal damage to mobs, it is possible for one to spawn in the Mountain Top Field and assist in killing the Mondo Chick.

  • If the player already has the Mondo Chick Blessing buff and defeats another Mondo Chick, the new blessing will override the old buff, resetting its timer and possibly degrading or upgrading the buff depending on the time took to defeat the Mondo Chick.

  • Mondo Chick, Stick Nymphs and Festive Nymphs are the only mobs in the game that take damage without any things attacking it.

  • Onett has said on discord that he dislikes Mondo Chick "on a personal level".

  • Based on one of Onett's discord messages, the Hostage Chicks may have been cooked for the 2020 [[Beesmas Feast]].

  • If a bee lands a critical hit on a chick that is hiding inside its egg, it will ignore the damage reduction and do the normal amount of critical damage.

  • If the Mondo Chick falls out of the Mountain Top field and into another field, when defeated, the rewards will spawn in that field it was defeated in. However if it dies outside of a field, their drops will form in a ring.

  • As of the Beesmas 2020 update, the Mondo Chick no longer drops [[Marshmallow Bee]]s.

  • There was a glitch where Commando Chick would stay in its egg and would not go out of its egg, even when it is moving. This can also make some player's bees keep on missing their shots. The easiest way to fix this glitch was to exit Commando Chick's Hideout and re-enter it.

  • Chicks, [[Ants]], [[Aphid]]s, [[Stick Nymph]]s, [[Mechsquito]]s, [[Cogmower]]s and [[Cogturret|Cogturrets]] are the only mobs that come in different varieties.

  • Commando Chick is the only chick with red eyes; all other chicks have black eyes. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Egg Hunt 2020]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Mini Bosses]] [[Category:Multiplayer Bosses]] [[Category:Removed Content]] [[Category:Passive Mobs]]

docs.title: Cloud Vial
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = CloudVial.png |description = Summons a Cloud in the field you're standing in. Lasts for 3 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second |cap = 10 }}The {{Color|Cloud Vial}} is a [[:Category:Consumables|consumable]] [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates|9/28/2019 update]]. Once used, it will spawn a [[Clouds|cloud]] in the field you are standing in.

The player can have a maximum of 10 in their inventory at a time. Obtaining more than 10 will not be added into the inventory unless obtained from a [[Quests|quest]], [[Sticker Stack]] reward, or [[Ornament Presents]].

The summoned [[Clouds|cloud]] will move around the [[Fields|field]]. It grants a 25% (50% with [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Windy Bee]]) [[pollen]] boost if the player is under it, while causing [[flowers]] under the cloud and [[sprout]]s in the field to grow faster. If there is a sprout in the field, the clouds will help the sprout grow by connecting to the sprout with a straight blue line. The growing speed applied to the sprout increases with the pollen amount required for the sprout. Using it on a field with a [[Planter|planter]] causes the planter to grow 8% faster per cloud, capping at 20%. Each field has a limit of clouds, with bigger and higher-tier fields having a higher limit. If the limit for clouds has reached, using anymore clouds will result in the following message: "There are too many clouds in this field." Windy Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Rain Cloud|Rain Cloud]] ability will ignore this field and will not further summon anymore clouds into the field.

It can't be used in the [[Ant Field]], attempting to do so will result in the following message: "You can't make clouds in a challenge field.".

It also can't be used in the [[Hub Field]], attempting to do so will result in the message: "You can't make clouds in the Hub Field.".

Donating a {{Cost|Cloud Vial||4=1}} to the [[Wind Shrine]] after having donated a {{Cost|Spirit Petal||4=1}} will give the player a chance to obtain a [[Egg#Event Bee Eggs|Windy Bee Egg]] if they do not already own a [[Windy Bee]].

The following audio plays when a {{Cost|Cloud Vial||4=1}} is used:[[File:Vialuse.ogg]]

==Ways to Obtain==

A reward from some of [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] and [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] quests. As a very common drop from [[Wild Windy Bee]]. A rare reward from [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]]. Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]: "BeesBuzz123" (Gives {{Cost|Cloud Vial|1}} + other items). *As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: Yellow Umbrella rewards {{Cost|Cloud Vial|1}}. Simple Cloud rewards {{Cost|Cloud Vial|1}}. Grey Raining Cloud rewards {{Cost|Cloud Vial|3}}. Tornado rewards {{Cost|Cloud Vial|3}}. Blowing Leaf rewards {{Cost|Cloud Vial|3}}.

===The methods below are no longer possible.=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table |+ |- | Completing Spirit Bear's Ornament Quest rewarded {{Cost|Cloud Vial|10}} and other [[items]]. Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Pearly Present]] gave {{Cost|Cloud Vial|30}} and other items. Purchasing packs in the [[Robux Shop]]: The Beginner's Bean Bundle gave {{Cost|Cloud Vial|5}} and other items. The Star Treat Special gave {{Cost|Cloud Vial|10}} and other items. Redeeming certain codes: Gumaden10T (Gave {{Cost|Cloud Vial|1}} + other stuff). "1MLikes" (Gives {{Cost|Cloud Vial|1}} + other stuff). ”ThnxCyasToyBox" (Gives {{Cost|Cloud Vial|1}}+ other stuff) As a reward from some of [[Sun Bear]]'s quests. Purchasing the Refreshing Bundle in the [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gives you {{Cost|Cloud Vial|20}} and other items *Completing some of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] quests. |}

==Token Locations==

*In the [[Windy Bee Gate]], to the right of the [[Wind Shrine]].

==Gallery== File:Capture402.PNG|A {{Cost|Cloud Vial||4=1}} token.

==Trivia==

  • {{Cost|Cloud Vial||4=}} do not spawn a [[Wild Windy Bee]]. Instead, if a {{Cost|Spirit Petal||4=1}} isn't donated yet, it will summon clouds. To summon a Wild Windy Bee, the player would need to donate items to the Wind Shrine. *{{Cost|Cloud Vial||4=}} are the only items that can directly help grow [[Sprout|sprouts]].
  • Clouds, [[sprinklers]] and [[bubbles]] are the only ways to regenerate [[Flowers]] without them naturally regenerating. *With high enough jump power, collecting the {{Cost|Cloud Vial||4=1}} token past the [[Windy Bee Gate]] is possible without 35 bees. Jumping from the roof of the [[Red HQ]] to the area where the token is makes it possible.

docs.title: Clouds
docs.text:
{{A|title1 = Cloud|image1 = Screenshot 2019-09-28 at 12.06.56 PM.png|caption1 = An entity that regrows flowers and grants short pollen buffs.}}'''Clouds''' are small, white rain clouds that can be summoned through various methods (listed below). They move around the [[field]] aimlessly over a 1-5 minute time span, depending on the source of the cloud, raining over 49 surrounding flowers and functioning as secondary [[sprinklers]]. Clouds can also help grow a [[sprout]] if there is a player in the same field although the [[pollen]] given to the sprout depends on the type of sprout and the field. If a player is under a cloud, they will receive the Cloud Boost buff which gives +25% pollen and +10% Unique Instant Conversion (+50% Pollen and +20% Unique IC if the player has a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Windy Bee]]) and lasts for up to 8 seconds. Clouds can also accelerate a [[planter]] by up to 20% with 6 clouds (around 8% with 1 cloud), however keeping a cloud in a field for hours is expensive making this method not viable for buffing planters.

There can only be a maximum of 6 clouds on a field at a time. If the player attempts to use a [[Cloud Vial|cloud vial]] to summon another cloud, a message will pop up saying, "There are too many clouds in this field."

Clouds cannot be summoned in the [[Ant Field]]. Attempting to do so will result in the following message: "You can't make clouds in a challenge field."

==Methods To Summon==

Using a cloud vial (3 minute duration). Receiving field winds from the [[Wind Shrine]] (5 minute duration). Activating/Defeating [[Wild Windy Bee]] (3 minute duration). Summoned by a player's [[Windy Bee]] (1 min duration + 10 sec per level of Windy Bee)

==Types== There are two different types of clouds: The Rain Cloud and the Windy Cloud.

Rain Cloud: The rain clouds are the ones that are summoned through donations to the Wind Shrine, by using a cloud vial and while fighting Wild Windy Bee. They are beneficial to players and give the cloud buff, grow sprouts, and regenerate flowers. These clouds are also spawned by tamed Windy Bees.

Windy Cloud: The Windy Cloud is a cloud that is only seen when a Wild Windy Bee has appeared. The cloud floats over a field and contains Wild Windy Bee inside it. Once a player approaches it and jumps up into the cloud, it will become a rain cloud and Wild Windy Bee starts to attack. Like rain clouds, it is still able to give the cloud buff, grow sprouts, and regenerate flowers.

Collecting a [[Ability Token#Cloud|Cloud]] token will give the player the message "🌧️ Windy Bee summoned a Cloud in {Field Name}. 🌧️" If another player's Windy Bee spawns a cloud in your field, a message will appear announcing "🌧️ {Username}'s Windy Bee summoned a Cloud in this field. 🌧️"

==Gallery == CloudLinkSprout.png|A cloud growing a sprout. Windy Bee in a cloud.png|A Wild Windy Bee hiding in a cloud. File:Cloud Boost.png|Buff icon for Cloud Boost File:Cloudplus.png|Buff icon for Cloud Boost+

==Trivia==

Rain from the [[Clover Field]] is visible in [[King Beetle's Lair]], rain from the [[Mountain Top Field]] is visible in the [[Werewolf's Cave]] and rain from the [[Pepper Patch]] is visible in the [[Petal Shop]]. Clouds have a faint sound of raindrops.

docs.title: Clover Field
docs.text:
{{Field |image = RevisedCloverField.png |fieldcolor = Assorted |bees = None |width = 29 |height = 26 }}The '''Clover Field''' is one of the five [[Starter Zone|starting]] [[fields]] any player is able to visit upon starting the game. It is protected by a [[ladybug]] and a [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetle]].

This field is a 26x29 field, containing 754 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single and double. {| class="article-table" !Flowers !White !Red !Blue !Total |- !Single |16% |18% |17% |'''51%''' |- !Double |16% |16% |17% |'''49%''' |- !Triple |0% |0% |0% |'''0%''' |- !Total |'''32%''' |'''34%''' |'''34%''' |'''100%''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should, however, be roughly correct.'''

This field can spawn [[treat]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|red boost]], blue boost, [[ticket]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], gold or diamond [[eggs|egg]] and [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|star jelly]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Clover Field are [[Basic Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Brave Bee]], [[Looker Bee]], [[Stubborn Bee]], [[Music Bee]], [[Puppy Bee]], and [[Tabby Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Clover Field are [[Lion Bee]] and [[Photon Bee]].

[[Planter|Planters]] planted here produce Invigorating [[Nectar]].

A level 1-3 [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has a chance to spawn here.

==Obtaining Boosts== Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a Clover [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +200% Clover Field pollen for 15 minutes. Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Clover Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes, if it isn't already maxed out. Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% [[Field Dice|(field dice)]] - 300% [[Loaded Dice|(loaded dice)]] Clover Field pollen for 15 minutes if the boost isn't maxed out yet. Clover [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Clover Field conversion and give +5% instant Clover Field conversion and +20% Clover Field pollen for each stack. All Field Winds (Including Clover Field Winds) can stack up to a total of 13 times. Redeeming certain valid codes: Troggles (Gives Clover Field Code Buff + other stuff). It can be boosted by the [[King Beetle Amulet]]. If it has a Clover Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +100%. *It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Clover Field Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.

=== The methods below are no longer possible.=== Giving a [[present]] to certain [[Quest Givers|NPCs]] in [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]]: In 2020 [[Brown Bear]] gave Clover Field Boost x3 and a star jelly. [[Onett]] gave Clover Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. In 2021 Brown Bear gave Clover Field Boost x3 and other [[items]]. Purchasing a Clover Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] gave 1.25x Clover Field Pollen along with x1.5 Clover [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]], and +15% [[System Page#Loot Luck|Loot Luck]]. Redeeming certain expired codes: 4MilMembers (Gives Clover Field Boost x1 and Clover Field Winds x4 + other stuff). 1MLikes (Gives Clover Field Boost x1 + other stuff). JellyHill (Gave Clover Field Boost x6 + other stuff). DarzethDoodads (Gives Clover Field Code Buff + other stuff). ThnxCyaBoost (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). Whoops (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). 1MoreTime (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). Reboots (Gave Clover Field Boost x8 + other stuff). MegaMittens (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). PuppyPerk (Gave Clover Field Boost x2 + other stuff). Elladiely (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). 1mFavorites (Gave Clover Field Boost x1 + other stuff). HappyNewYear (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). MoreTime (Gave Clover Field Boost x3 + other stuff). WindyReboot (Gave Clover Field Boost x3 and Clover Field Winds x3 + other stuff). BloxyCelebration (Gave Clover Field Boost x5 + other stuff). EggReboot (Gave Clover Field Boost x3, Clover Field Winds x3, and Clover Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). BlackBearMythic (Gave Clover Field Boost x3 and Clover Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). RebootPC (Gave Clover Field Boost x2 + other stuff). RebootXmas (Gave Clover Field Boost x1 + other stuff). *FrozenBugReboot (Gave Clover Field Code Buff + other stuff).

==Gallery== Screenshot 25.png|A plain view of the Clover Field. Spikeoncloverfield.png|A Rogue Vicious Bee's spike in the Clover Field. Clover Field Icon.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. Hivesticker clover field stamp.png|The Clover Field's associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

==Trivia== The field booster for the Clover Field has been decreased three times. In the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]], it was decreased from x5 to x4, in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]] it was decreased to x3, and in the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], it was decreased to x2. Before the 7/11/2018 update, the Clover Field had 39 rows instead of the current 26 so it had 1131 flowers, and it was the largest field in the game. It is no longer the largest field in the game, with only 5 less flowers than the new largest, the [[Pineapple Patch]]. The Bubble Wand on top of the [[Blue HQ]] will sometimes blow [[sparkles]] on to this field, along with the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Dandelion Field]]. The [[Honeystorm]] Summoner used to be where the [[Wealth Clock]] is currently, but when the Wealth Clock was added, the Honeystorm Pad was moved to right beside the bush in the Clover Field where the Rhino Beetle spawns. The [[King Beetle Lair]] is right under this field. This is the first field with 2 [[mobs]] that can be accessed in the game. When a [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] spawns in the Clover Field, a spike can be seen in King Beetle's Lair, which can still be activated. If a [[sprout]] is in the Clover Field, the stem and the light can be seen in King Beetle's Lair. Clover Field has a higher chance than any other field of dropping royal jelly when a sprout pops. This field also has a low chance of spawning a star jelly. If the player has the [[Spark Staff]], is in the King Beetle's Lair, and jumps, they are able to collect pollen from the Clover Field. This is the only field that gives eggs. *This is the only starting field with roughly the same amount of Single and Double flowers, while the other 4 fields in the Starter Zone all have around 90% Single flowers, and the rest being Double.
