docs.title: Cobalt Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Cobalt Bee.png |image-gifted = CobaltBee Gifted.png |description = A superhero and defender of all things Blue! Together with [[Crimson Bee]] it works to unite bees of all colors. |rarity = Event |color = Blue |energy = 35 |energylabel = more |speed = 18.2 |attack = 7 |skincolor1 = #0000ff |skincolor2 = #ffffff |skincolor3 = #0000ff }}'''Cobalt Bee''' is a [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]]. It can be obtained by purchasing a [[Egg#Event Bee Eggs|Cobalt Bee egg]] in the [[Ticket Tent]] for 250 [[ticket]]s.

Its abilities are enhanced when [[Crimson Bee]] is also in the hive.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Cobalt Bee likes the [[Clover Field]] and the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. It dislikes the [[Pineapple Patch]].

== Stats == Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. Makes 140 [[Honey]] in 3 seconds. +75% [[Energy]], +30% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +25% Convert Speed, +60 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], 10% [[Instant Conversion]], +6 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], 5% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]]. 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +15% [[System Page#Instant Blue Conversion|Instant Blue Conversion]].

=== Abilities === '''[[Ability Tokens#Pulse|[Blue Pulse]]]''' Fires a pulse that hops between your blue bees, collecting pollen around them (+10% per Level). Power increases with each hop. If you own a Crimson Bee, fires a [[Ability Tokens#Pulse|Red Pulse]] as well. If Gifted, the pulse also causes bees to instantly convert pollen equal to 25% of the bee's Convert Amount (+25% per Field Boost stack). '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb Sync|[Blue Bomb Sync]]]''' Grants 10% Blue Pollen and Instant Blue Conversion allows [[Ability Tokens#Bomb|Blue Bombs]] to collect from white [[Flowers]] for 30 sec. If red bomb sync is active, this applies to red flowers as well.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 4|honey = 140|honeytime = 3|rarity = event|color = blue}}

== Gallery == Old CobaltBee Slot.png|Cobalt Bee's old hive slot design. GiftedCobaltBee Slot.png|A Gifted Cobalt Bee hive slot. CrimsonCobaltIcon.png|Cobalt and Crimson Bee in a thumbnail of [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. ColoredPulses Field.jpeg|An activated blue and red pulse. CobaltFace.png|Cobalt Bee's face. Blue Pulse.png|The Blue Pulse Icon. Blue Bomb Sync.png|The Blue Bomb Sync Icon. Cobaltbeeoriginalface.png|Cobalt Bee's original face.

==Trivia== The only difference between Cobalt Bee and Crimson Bee's [[Fields|Field]] preferences is that the Cobalt Bee likes the Pine Tree Forest, whereas Crimson Bee prefers the [[Rose Field]]. Cobalt Bee and Crimson Bee have the same [[Stats]]. Cobalt Bee and Crimson Bee are the first colored Event bees, followed by [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Festive Bee]]. Cobalt Bee and Crimson Bee are the only [[Bees]] that can activate another [[Ability Tokens|Ability]] apart from their own. When Crimson and Cobalt Bee are both in the same hive, the player will get the following bonuses from these ability tokens: Blue pulse additionally fires a red pulse to collect from red bees. If both red bomb sync and blue bomb sync are activated simultaneously, blue bombs can collect from red and white flowers. This is one of the Event bees who have different color faces on the hive rather than the bee itself, the others being Crimson Bee, Festive Bee, and Vicious Bee. This was the first Blue Event bee, with Vicious Bee being the second. Cobalt Bee and Crimson Bee are currently the only event bees to cost 250 tickets. The [[First Edition Bee|first edition]] [[Tabby Bee]] and [[Puppy Bee]] could once be purchased with 250 tickets as well. This bee, Crimson Bee, [[Precise Bee]], [[Photon Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Shy Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], and [[Ninja Bee]] are the only bees that leave a trail. The [[Cobalt Guard]], which can be [[Crafting|crafted]] in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]], has a special design, name, and stats dedicated to Cobalt Bee. The Cobalt Guard has a [[Passive Abilities#Haste Pulser|Passive Ability]] that looks similar to Cobalt Bee's blue pulse ability. This bee, Crimson Bee, Puppy Bee, and Windy Bee are the only Event bees that don't have an 'enhanced' ability if gifted. Cobalt Bee's original face decal had a mouth that strongly resembled that of the [[Cool Bee]]. The decal was scrapped before the release of the Bee. {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Bees]] [[Category:Event]] [[Category:Blue]] [[zh-tw:鈷藍蜂]]

docs.title: Cobalt Guard
docs.text:
{{Accessory |image1 = Cobaltguard.PNG |description = A guard bestowed with the heroic power of Cobalt Bee - Defender of the Blue Bees. |cost = 200,000,000 [[Honey]], 100 [[Blue Extract]]s, 100 [[Stinger]]s, 50 [[Enzymes]], and 25 [[Glitter]]. |stats = +250,000 Capacity+50% Blue Pollen+20% Blue Bomb Pollen+3 Blue Bee Attack+10% Defense+100% Critical Power+Passive: Haste Pulser }}The '''Cobalt Guard''' is a [[:Category:Guards|guard]] that can be crafted in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]]. It is currently the highest tier [[:Category:Blue|blue]] guard. Its description reads, "A guard bestowed with the heroic power of [[Cobalt Bee]] - Defender of the Blue Bees." {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|200,000,000}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|100}}{{Cost|Stinger|100}}{{Cost|Enzymes|50}}{{Cost|Glitter|25}} |} It is equipped on the right shoulder. When equipped, it leaves a trail behind it, similar to Cobalt Bee's trail.

== Stats == * +250,000 [[Capacity]]. * +50% [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]]. * +20% [[System Page#Blue Bomb Pollen|Blue Bomb Pollen]]. * +3 [[System Page#Blue Attack|Blue Bee Attack]]. * +10% [[System Page#Defense|Defense]]. * +100% [[Critical Hits|Critical Power]]. * [[Passive Abilities#Haste Pulser|+Passive Ability: Haste Pulser]]. ** Effects: Each 30th [[Ability Tokens#Haste|haste]] token releases a [[Ability Tokens#Pulse|blue pulse]] that hops to each blue [[Bees|bee]], collecting [[pollen]] around them. Power increases with each hop. *** Unlike the ability token, this effect cannot trigger a [[Ability Tokens#Pulse|red pulse]], even if the player owns a [[Crimson Bee]] or the [[Crimson Guard]].

== Trivia == * If the ingredients to craft this item were to be crafted, a total of 200,000,000 (200 million) honey, 5000 [[Blueberry|blueberries]], 2500 [[pineapple]]s, 25 [[Magic Bean|magic beans]], 1500 [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]] and 100 stingers are needed. It has the most base [[capacity]] and the highest price of all containers. {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|25B|25,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Coconut|250}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|150}}{{Cost|Red Extract|150}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|150}}{{Cost|Refreshing Vial|2}} |}

The following audio plays whenever the Emergency Coconut Shield passive ability activates: (Note: The audio in game is sped up.)

[[File:Cocosiren.ogg]]

==Stats==

+1,000,000 Capacity. x1.25 [[Capacity]]. +400% [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]]. x1.5 [[System Page|Convert Rate at Hive]] +10% [[Instant Conversion]]. +10% [[System Page#Instant White Conversion|Instant White Conversion]]. +100% [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]]. [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|+Passive: Emergency Coconut Shield]]. Will activate upon taking damage. When it does, the Coconut Canister summons 5 falling [[coconut]]s and grants the "Coconut Shield" effect, which creates a translucent coconut around the player and gives +100% [[System Page#Defense|Defense]] and x1.25 [[System Page#Bee Attack|Bee Attack]] for 10 seconds. It has a 5 minute-cooldown between activations. *[[Passive Abilities#Inspire Coconuts|+Passive: Inspire Coconuts]]. Will activate after obtaining 5 stacks of [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire]]. When it does, it'll summon 5 falling coconuts in the [[Fields|Field]].

==Gallery== PassiveEmergencyCoconut.png|The Emergency Coconut Shield icon Inspirecoconuts.png|The Inspire Coconuts Icon. Coconut shield.png|The active Emergency Coconut Shield.

==Trivia==

This, the [[Porcelain Port-O-Hive]], the [[Red Port-O-Hive]] and the [[Blue Port-O-Hive]] are the only containers in the game that require [[Crafting|materials]] other than honey to craft it. If its items were to be crafted using the [[Blender]], it would cost 25 billion {{Cost|Honey}}, 1750 {{Cost|Coconut}}, 15000 {{Cost|Pineapple}}, 15000 {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}, 7500 {{Cost|Strawberry}}, 7500 {{Cost|Blueberry}}, and 9000 {{Cost|Royal Jelly}} to craft. It would also take 87.5 hours of Playtime to craft the Materials, or 1050 {{Cost|Ticket}} to speed up crafting. When the Coconut Canister was first added, it was crafted with {{Cost|Coconut|150}} instead of {{Cost|Coconut|250}}, as this was the maximum amount you could hold at the time. This is the only container that gives [[Passive Abilities]]. This is one of the only two items in the game that gives 2 passives without having to buy another [[Items|item]]. The other one is [[Gummy Boots]], not including certain [[Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulets]]. The red and blue "buttons" on each side of the canister repeatedly glow, alternating to represent the lights on ambulances. This was likely added to fit with the passive Emergency Coconut Shield, which also gives off a siren sound upon activation. The buttons' flashing alternation is synced with every player who has the item equipped. *Note that the player must take damage directly from a mob to activate the Emergency Coconut Shield. For example, taking damage from the fire trail of [[Ants#Fire Ant|Fire Ants]], from the lawn mower or dying from an [[Obstacle Courses|Obby]] does not activate this ability. When the Emergency Coconut Shield is activated, it does not protect you from the 'Twigs' ability from [[Stick Bug]]. *There is a rare bug that makes it when the Emergency Coconut Shield is activated when you should've died, you will have a very small amount of health instead. The x1.25 capacity stat currently does not function.

docs.text:
[[File:CocoCaveIntererior.png|alt=|right|thumb|210x210px|The inside of the Coconut Cave.]] The '''Coconut Cave''' is a cave located next to the [[Coconut Field]]. To access the cave, the player is required to defeat the [[Coconut Crab]] when it respawns out of the cave, If the player has not defeated the Coconut Crab yet and attempts to enter the cave (without actually standing in the field), they will be teleported back to the spawn place. There is also an invisible barrier on top of the Cave to prevent players from entering the cave when the Coconut Crab is not defeated yet, this is used to avoid lagging players from entering the cave without Coconut Crab being defeated.

The interior contains the [[Fastest Crab Slayers Leaderboard]], the [[Coconut Dispenser]], and a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] where the player can buy the [[Coconut Clogs]], the [[Coconut Canister]] and the [[Coconut Belt]].

docs.title: Coconut Crab
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Coconut Crab |image =Coconut_Crab_GeplagtesSkelett.png |location = [[Coconut Field]] |timer = 36 hours (1.5 days)30.6 hours (1.275 days) (with Gifted Vicious Bee) |hp = 250,000 (250 thousand) |damage = 40 (Claw), 150 (Coconut), 180 (Contact) |points = 400 |bond = 2,500 |honey = 0 |level = 12 }} The '''Coconut Crab''' is a level 12 [[:Category:Bosses|boss]] [[mob]] that defends the [[Coconut Field]]. It has 250,000 health and moves along the back wall of the Coconut Field. Like [[Tunnel Bear]], [[chicks]] (besides the [[Commando Chick]]), [[Aphid]]s, [[Wild Windy Bee]] and [[Puffshroom]]s, the player has a limited amount of time (two hours) to defeat it. After 2 hours, its health resets. The amount of time left can be found above its health.

Unlike the [[Stump Snail]], its health will not save, meaning it must be defeated without leaving the [[field]]. If the player leaves, its health will reset, and it will go back inside the [[Coconut Cave]]. Once defeated, it will take 36 hours (1.5 days) or 30 hours and 36 minutes (1.275 days) if the player has a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]] to respawn.

The loot it drops is scattered around the field, similar to a [[Sprout]]'s drops and the [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]]'s drops. However, only the player who has defeated their own Coconut Crab can see and pick up the tokens. A [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] can also be used to pick up the tokens, along with the [[Windy Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|Tornado]], [[Vector Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Triangulate|Triangulate]], or [[Precise Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Target Practice]]. The quality, quantity, and rarity of the items dropped vary depending on the time taken to defeat the Coconut Crab, similar to the Mondo Chick. But even if you kill it in a slow time the drops you get can still be rare.

== Attacks == The Coconut Crab alternates between two attack types: * Claw attack: The Coconut Crab will try and line itself up with the player, then proceed to jab quickly with its claws. Each hit deals 40 damage before [[System Page#Defense|Defense]] is applied. It will attack 7 times, then pause to move to where the player is standing and repeat it twice more, attempting to claw the player 21 times in total. * Coconut attack: The Coconut Crab will move to the middle of the back wall. It will then jump up a total of 8 times, each jump causing 1 large coconut to fall into the field. Each coconut deals 150 damage before defense is applied. The first coconut to fall will always target the player, but the others will randomly fall around the field.

== Drops == Note: Some of the quantity and the quality of rewards dropped depends on how fast it took to kill the crab.

{| class="article-table" !Guaranteed Drops List |- |{{Cost|Coconut}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink}}{{Cost|Bitterberry}}{{Cost|Star Jelly}}{{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} (Exclusive to Beesmas only) |} {| class="article-table" !Possible Drops List |- |{{Cost|Glitter}}{{Cost|Oil}}{{Cost|Magic Bean}}{{Cost|Glue}}{{Cost|Robo Pass|4=0}} (Uncommon){{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} (Somewhat Rare){{Cost|Cyan Hilted Sword Sticker|4=0}} (Unbelievably Rare){{Cost|Silver Egg|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Diamond Egg|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Night Bell|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Atomic Treat|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Gifted Diamond Egg|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Mythic Egg|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Basic White Hive Skin|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare) |}

==Tips== Avoid making contact with the Coconut Crab's hitbox, as doing so will deal a large amount of damage. If your defense is too low, it may be lethal. The claw attack can be avoided by passing the Coconut Crab by walking or gliding as it moves closer. It will lock onto the player's position once the player is in front, wait for a moment, and jab its claws. If they continue moving, they will pass by the attack. Sometimes, the Crab may not stop in place and will continue to follow in the opposite direction. If this happens, it is often easiest to change direction and cross it once more. ** Using the [[Glider]] and gliding around the claws can allow players to dodge all hits from the claws and may get 1 or 2 hits from them. Do not stay in the middle of the field when the Coconut Crab’s coconut attack is finished (unless the player has high movement speed), as the Crab will almost immediately begin its claw attack, resulting in massive damage. Avoid touching the walls of the Coconut Field, as the Coconut Crab's health will reset occasionally if this is done. It is possible to stand on the edge of the Coconut Field's walls and defeat the Coconut Crab from there due to a bug that allows players to. When the player jumps at the right time, they can avoid the falling coconut attack (right after its second jump hold space until the coconut falls on top). Having too much jump power i.e. [[Ability Tokens|Bear Morph]] + [[Beekeeper's Boots]] or higher will cause the player to exit the field's range vertically, thereby causing Coconut Crab to reset and its hp to replenish. Have bees that have a high attack and/or are specialized in attacking, such as [[Rage Bee]], [[Spicy Bee]], [[Lion Bee]], [[Precise Bee]] and [[Vicious Bee]] will be necessary to quickly defeat the Coconut Crab. Be sure to also have [[Music Bee]]s and other bees who produce [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] tokens for Critical Chance/Power, as they will also play a major role. Bees with the [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] ability are recommended to collect tokens that are in high-risk areas. Activating all 3 Targets or getting shot by Precise Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Target Practice]] will collect all tokens. *Own certain gifted bees: The Gifted [[Looker Bee]] grants +25% [[System Page#Critical Power|critical power]] and Gifted [[Tabby Bee]] grants +50% critical power. The Gifted [[Brave Bee]] grants +1 [[bee Attack]] while the Gifted [[Rage Bee]] grants 10% [[Bee Attack|bee attack]]. The Gifted [[Commander Bee]] grants +3% [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]]. The Gifted [[Precise Bee]] grants +3% [[System Page#Critical Chance|Super-Crit Chance]]. ALL gifted [[bees]] deal ×1.5 more damage. Before fighting the Crab, collect Focus tokens first on the [[Pepper Patch]]. Once the player has a ×10 stack of focus, jump immediately to the Coconut Field. Players can also collect a [[Ability Tokens#Melody|Melody]] token (if possible, without losing the focus stack) for more critical power, making the focus tokens much more effective. If the player owns a [[Precise Bee]], try and stack [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Precision]] to increase Super-Crit chance. Stand behind the Coconut Tree farthest from the Coconut Cave and closest to Spirit Bear. The Crab gets stuck and cannot move. This gives the bees a better opportunity to defeat the Crab. [[Bond|Level]] bees up to Level 12 or higher. Bees with a lower level than the mob will most likely miss when they attack. Bees with levels much lower than the level of the mob will have a higher chance of missing their attacks on the mob. Bees with an equal level or higher than the mob will never miss. Using a {{Cost|Stinger|||0}} gives a ×1.5 Bee Attack buff for 30 seconds. If owned, using 3 stingers will activate Star Saw which will deal damage to the Coconut Crab and collect tokens that would be dangerous to collect otherwise. Since the Coconut Crab has a large hitbox, using [[Coconut|coconuts]] has a good chance of hitting it and dealing large amounts of damage. The Coconut Crab drops many coconuts, so the player will most likely get all of their used coconuts back. Using [[Oil]] gives ×1.2 to both [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]] and [[Stats#Speed|Bee Movespeed]] for 10 minutes, which helps bees attack faster and helps the player in avoiding the claw and coconut attacks. Using a [[Tropical Drink]] gives +5% [[Critical Hits|critical chance]] for 10 minutes, which increases critical chance. *The [[Demon Mask]] or [[Fire Mask]] are recommended to defeat bosses like Coconut Crab as their passives and bonuses allow the player to get higher attack damage. If owned, try equipping [[Coconut Clogs]] or [[Gummy Boots]] for an extra +2 and 10% Bee Attack each respectively. If the player only has the [[Gummy Mask]] equipped, they can still trigger [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] to temporarily increase their [[Gummy Bee]]'s [[Bee Attack|attack]] by using [[Gumdrops]]. The Gummy Mask also increases [[System Page#Bee Ability Rate|bee ability rate]], which can be useful for defeating the Coconut Crab. [[Jelly Beans|Green jelly beans]] give +3% [[Critical Hits|critical chance]] for 1 minute. If the player can collect 3 green jelly beans, it will give a +5% critical chance total. A player with the [[Coconut Canister]] equipped can intentionally activate the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]] which for 10 seconds, grants ×1.25 Bee Attack and 100% Defense and drops 5 falling coconuts onto the field. * Owning a [[Cub Buddy]] while fighting the Coconut Crab can be beneficial as they can collect tokens even in the Coconut Crab or in front of a Coconut Crab attack. (Only during Beesmas Events) Using Onett's Lid Art, Gummy Beacon, Honeyday Candles, and {{Cost|Honey|}} Wreath (after completing [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]'s Beesmas quest) grants extra bees to help the player defeat the Crab. The timer is very lenient, even for a player who just got to the 35 Bee Zone. However, it would most likely be a tight timer if the player doesn't own the [[Vicious Bee]]. Having [[Nectar]]s like Invigorating Nectar grants x1.01 - 1.1 Bee Attack and Motivating Nectar for 1% - 5% Bee Ability Rate. If the crab is lagging, try moving opposite the crab to the other side of the field. If it is doing its Coconut Attack, then move to the corner of the field to avoid getting hit by one. However, sometimes the coconut may hit the corner of the field, so the player must keep moving around until they find an empty space in the field. * Standing half-side in the field and half-side out can cause the crab to go left and right constantly and can't attack. Be aware that any more into the field can cause it to start attacking and any less will cause it to run back to the cave (i.e. despawning).

==Gallery== CoconutCrabCave.png|The cave the Coconut Crab enters the field from. Inside is the Coconut Cave. CoconutCrabAttackA.png|The Coconut Crab's "Claw Attack". CoconutCrabAttackBWarning.png|Falling Coconut Circle Attack Warnings. CoconutCrabAttackB.png|The coconuts summoned by the Coconut Crab's "Coconut Attack". Unlocked Coconut Cave..png|The Coconut Cave after defeating the Coconut Crab. Star Treat from coconut crab.png|A {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} from the Coconut Crab. Coconut Crab 7 19 22 Bug.png|The Coconut Crab's loot when it has been defeated outside of the Coconut Field. GiftedDiamondEggveryrarezoomed.png|A {{Cost|Gifted Diamond Egg|4=0}} from Coconut Crab. File:Invisible coconut crab.png|A bug where the Coconut Crab is invisible and cannot deal damage to the player with its claws or falling coconuts. This occurs when the player has set their graphic levels too low.

==Trivia == The Coconut Crab has the highest base level of any mob in the game, even surpassing [[Cave Monster]]s, which are level 11. The Coconut Crab has the third-highest base health out of all mobs, right behind the [[Mondo Chick]] at 300,000 health, and the [[Stump Snail]] at 30 million health. The Coconut Crab is the only boss mob that spawns in a cave (not including the Stump Snail as it is considered a mini-boss). The Coconut Crab is the only mob to deal enough damage instantly kill the player upon getting hit by its falling coconut or touching it. [[Stick Bug]] is the only one to rival this with its flailing sticks attack at higher levels. The Coconut Crab is based on the real-life equivalent ''[[Wikipedia:Coconut Crab|"Birgus latro"]]'', more commonly known as the "Coconut Crab". The Coconut Crab is one of the fastest mobs in the game, second to Stick Bug in the later levels of its [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. The Coconut Crab is the largest mob in the game. The only thing to rival this mob would be a high-level [[Snowbear]]. The Coconut Crab is similar to the Stump Snail in the sense that it stops the player from easily grinding in their guarded fields without defeating the "guardian" of the said fields. The Coconut Crab is also the only mob that is protecting a [[:Category:Shops|shop]]. Defeating the Coconut Crab will allow the player to gain access to the [[Coconut Cave]] and will allow the player to farm in the Coconut Field with ease. * According to [[Spirit Bear]], the Coconut Crab isn't native to the game. It's an invasive species, accidentally brought in when she imported coconuts from far away. It used to be very small, but with Spirit Bear's neglect to remove it, the Coconut Crab grew big and now defends the Coconut Field. The sound that plays when a coconut from the Coconut Crab's coconut attack can be found [https://www.roblox.com/library/3576239937/coconutthud here]. Once the Coconut Crab has been defeated, standing on top of the Coconut Cave will not cause the player to teleport back to spawn. The teleportation is to prevent players from cheating by defeating the Crab on that platform, so it does not teleport the player if it has been defeated as that removes the purpose. *If looked closely, two tiny green spheres can be spotted right in front of the Coconut Crab. The purpose of those spheres is to collide with Coconut Crab's claws to stop them from extending. * This, cave monsters, [[Robo Bear Challenge]] mobs and [[ants]] are the only mobs that don't drop {{Cost|Honey}} upon defeat. The Coconut Crab is the only one of these to drop item loot. Around the Beesmas 2022 update, if the player had beaten their record of how fast they had defeated the crab, their record would not have been recorded and would revert to their former best time before the update. This was the same case as Mondo Chick's. This, Mondo Chick and Puffshrooms are the only mobs that scatter their loot on the field when defeated instead of a ring, being in the form of rings if it is outside the field. Onett once accidentally put Coconut Crab's HP to 20. If you jump out of the coconut field but quickly get back in it, the coconut crab’s HP bar will be reset, but not its timer.

docs.title: Coconut Dispenser
docs.text:
[[File:CoconutDispenser.png|thumb|The Coconut Dispenser.]] The '''Coconut Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] located on the right side of the [[Coconut Cave]]. The player will need to defeat the [[Coconut Crab]] to gain access to it, similar to the rest of the content in the Coconut Cave.

The dispenser has a cooldown of 4 hours. When used, the player will receive a certain number of [[coconut]]s, based on the quality of their [[Badges#Coconut Badges|Coconut Badge]]. They will also be granted a x1 [[Coconut Field]] [[Field Boost|Boost]]. This remains static, meaning the Coconut Badge will not affect the field boost multiplier.

{| class="article-table" !Badge Tier !Coconuts |- |Junior |3 |- |[[File:BCC.png|40px]] Cadet |5 |- |[[File:BCH.png|40px]] Hotshot |7 |- |[[File:BCA.png|40px]] Ace |10 |- |[[File:BCM.png|40px]] Master |12 |- |[[File:BCG.png|40px]] Grandmaster |15 |}

There is a secret entrance that leads to a tunnel that can be entered by jumping on top of the dispenser and into a small portion of the wall. Inside the tunnel, there are 3 tokens that grant 5 [[ticket]]s, 5 [[Jelly Beans|jelly beans]], and 1 [[enzymes|enzyme]] each.

== Trivia == * This, the [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]], the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]], the [[Glue Dispenser]], the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]], and the [[Robo Pass Dispenser]] are the only dispensers that don't grant [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]]. * This, the Free Ant Pass Dispenser, the Ant Pass Dispenser, the Free Robo Pass Dispenser and the Robo Pass Dispenser are the only dispensers that grant [[items]] with a capacity limit. * This is the only dispenser that grants a Field Boost. * This is the second mechanic that guarantees a certain field boost, the first one being [[glitter]]. * This is the only dispenser that gives a different message after using: "Earn coconut badges to receive more coconuts!" * This and the Glue Dispenser are the only dispensers to give more items based on the rank of a badge. * The amount of field boost applied to the coconut field is shown in this chart: {| class="article-table" !Badge Tier !Coconuts !Coconut Field Boost |- |Junior |3 |None |- |[[File:BCC.png|40px]] Cadet |5 | rowspan="5" |x1 |- |[[File:BCH.png|40px]] Hotshot |7 |- |[[File:BCA.png|40px]] Ace |10 |- |[[File:BCM.png|40px]] Master |12 |- |[[File:BCG.png|40px]] Grandmaster |15 |}

docs.title: Coconut Field
docs.text:
{{Field |image = CoconutField2.png |fieldcolor = White |bees = 35 |width = 30 |height = 21 }}The '''Coconut Field''' is a [[Fields|field]] added in the [[Updates#2019.9.28|9/28/2019 update]], located past the [[Windy Bee Gate]] and next to [[Spirit Bear]]. It is home to and protected by the [[Coconut Crab]].

This is a 30x21 field, containing 630 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, and the only natural size is triple.

{ class="article-table" !'''Flowers''' !White !Red !Blue !Total - !Single 0% 0% 0% '''0%''' - !Double 0% 0% 0% '''0%''' - !Triple 89.4% 6% 4.6% '''100%''' - !'''Total''' '''89.4%''' '''6%''' '''4.6%''' '''100%''' } '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

The field can spawn [[honey]], [[treat]]s, [[coconut]]s, [[Tropical Drink|tropical drinks]], [[ticket]] and [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Coconut Field are [[Vector Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]], [[Digital Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]]. There are no bees that dislike the Coconut Field.

This field grants Refreshing [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

A level 1-20 [[Wild Windy Bee]] has a chance to spawn in this field.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Coconut Field [[pollen]] onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - 300% Coconut Field pollen for 15 minutes based on the type used if it isn't already maxed out.[[File:Coconut Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Coconut Field boost icon.]] * Coconut [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% Instant Coconut Field Conversion and give +5% Instant Coconut Field Conversion and +10% Coconut Field pollen for each stack. Coconut Field Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times. * Using the [[Coconut Dispenser]] will always give Coconut [[Field Boost]] x1 (if the player has [[Badges#Coconut Badges|Coconut Badge]] cadet or higher), along with coconuts depending on the player's badge. * Equipping the [[Coconut Clogs]] grants x1.15 Coconut Field pollen. * Equipping the [[Coconut Belt]] grants x1.1 Coconut Field pollen.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Giving [[Gummy Bear]] a [[present]] gave Coconut Field Boost x3 + other stuff. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Gumaden10T (Gave Coconut Field Boost x1 and Coconut Field Winds x3 + other stuff) ** DarzethDoodads (Coconut Field Code Buff + other stuff). **FrozenBugReboot (Coconut Field Code Buff and Coconut Field Boost x4 + other stuff ** Purchasing a Coconut Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Coconut [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Coconut Field Pollen, x2.5 Pollen from Coconuts, and x1.1 [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]]. ** Mocito100T (Gives Coconut Field Boost x2 and Coconut Field Capacity x2 + other stuff).

== Gallery == hivesticker coconut field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * This is the only field where [[sprout]]s and [[leaves]] can yield coconuts and tropical drinks. * It is also the only field to have a regular [[:Category:Bosses|boss]] defending it. * This is one of four fields to solely have contain triple flowers without pollination, the others being the [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Stump Field]], and the [[Pepper Patch]]. ** Furthermore, this field is the only triple-flower field dominated by white flowers. * Under the coconut tree opposite of the cave and closest to [[Spirit Bear]], there is a coconut token that can be collected to give 10 coconuts. * This and the Pepper Patch are the only fields where sprouts cannot naturally appear or be planted with the [[Special Sprout Summoner]]. * Like the [[Badges#Pepper Badge|Pepper Badge]], the [[Badges#Coconut Badge|Coconut Badge]] requires more pollen collected than the other field badges. For example, the cadet badge for the Coconut Field requires 50,000,000 (50 million) pollen, compared to the normal requirement of 250,000 (250 thousand) pollen. * It is possible to gather pollen from this field without 35 [[bees]] from the ledge facing the [[Ticket Tent]]. ** Players can also collect from the field by going outside the map and finding the back of the Ticket Tent. Jumping on the Ticket Tent with enough jump height will reach the field, allowing bees to farm. * The Coconut Dispenser used to boost this field differently based on the player's Coconut Badge, with the Junior badge giving no boost, Cadet giving a +100% pollen boost, Hotshot giving a +200% pollen boost, and anything Ace and above giving a +300% pollen boost. After the [[Updates#2019.12.23|Beesmas 2019 update]], the Coconut Dispenser will always provide a +100% pollen boost, regardless of the player's Coconut Badge. * This field, the [[Ant Field]] and the [[Hub Field]] are the only fields without any bees to dislike them.

docs.title: Coconut
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = coconut.png |description = Drops a huge Coconut into the field. Catch it to convert Pollen to Honey Tokens. |cooldown = 10 seconds |cap = 500 }} A {{Color|Coconut}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]]. It will spawn a large, green circle on the [[Fields|field]] you used it on. If caught, it will convert [[pollen]] into a ring of 10 [[honey]] tokens. It can also collect pollen for the player that summoned it, damage [[mobs]], and can be used in certain [[crafting]] recipes.

Pollen from coconuts can be increased with the [[Coconut Clogs]], [[pollination]], and the [[Boost Market|Coconut Field Market Boost]] (now impossible to obtain as the Boost Market has been removed).

A maximum of 500 coconuts can be held at a time, as the item’s highest capacity limit, excluding items that don’t have a capacity limit.

There’s also an On/Off switch on the player’s hotbar (if the coconut Item is in the player’s hotbar). The coconut will be used automatically when this switch is turned on.

The following audio plays when a coconut hits a field:

[[File:Cocothud.ogg]]

== Ways to Obtain == * Defeating the [[Coconut Crab]] grants coconuts (depending on the time taken to defeat it). * Growing [[sprout]]s in the Coconut Field. * Finding them in token form in the Coconut Field. * There is a token worth 10 coconuts under the leaves of the palm tree closest to [[Spirit Bear]]. * Using the [[Coconut Dispenser]] grants 5 coconuts (increases 5+ depending on Coconut Field [[Badges|Badge]] tier). * A chance to spawn a Coconut token from [[leaves]] in the Coconut Field. * Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]: ** 1MLikes (Gives 1 coconut + other stuff). * Winning them from [[Memory Match#Mega Memory Match|Mega Memory Match]] and [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]] (available in increments of 3 and 5 respectively). * Purchasing certain packs from the [[Robux Shop]]. * As a rare gift from [[Cub Buddy]] in increments of 1. * As a drop from an [[Aphid#Armored|Armored Aphid]]. * Harvesting [[planter]]s in the [[Coconut Field]], [[Pine Tree Forest]] or [[Pepper Patch]]. * As a drop from [[puffshroom]]s within the 35 bee zone. * The Palm Tree [[sticker]] rewards {{Cost|Coconut|10}} when added to the [[Sticker Stack]].

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Purchasing certain packs from the [[Robux Shop]]: ** The Gooey Goodies Pack gave 100 coconuts and other items. ** The Stocking Stuffer Pack gave 25 coconuts and other items. * Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Funky Present]] gave 20 coconuts and other items. * Completing [[Panda Bear]]'s Beesmas 2020 Quest gave 5 coconuts and other items. * Redeeming certain expired [[codes]]: ** Mocito100T (Gave 10 coconuts + other stuff). |}

== Conversion == When the coconut lands on a player, the player's total [[System Page#Convert Amount|hive convert amount]] is converted into a ring of honey tokens. For example, if a player has 500,000 total hive convert amount and a coconut lands on them, 500,000 pollen would be converted into honey tokens. The amount of pollen stored beforehand is not taken into account of how much pollen is converted.

The amount of honey received from the coconut is multiplied by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]].

== Crafting Uses == Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Coconut|900}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Coconut}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |10 |{{Cost|Enzymes|2}}{{Cost|Oil|2}} |[[File:TropicalDrinkInventory.png|center|80px]][[Tropical Drink]] |- |150 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|10B|10,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|50}}{{Cost|Glue|100}}{{Cost|Oil|100}} |[[File:CoconutClogsShop.png|center|80px]][[Coconut Clogs]] |- |250 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|25B|25,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|150}}{{Cost|Red Extract|150}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|150}} |[[File:CoconutCanister.png|center|80px]][[Coconut Canister]] |- |500 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|7.5T|7,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|200}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|1,500}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|200}}{{Cost|Turpentine|3}}{{Cost|Refreshing Vial|3}} |[[File:Coconut Belt.png|center|80px]][[Coconut Belt]] |}

== Gallery == CoconutCrabAttackB.png|thumb|A summoned coconut. Coconut indicator.png|A green circle indicating a falling coconut. CoconutHitRing.png|The ring of honey tokens when hit by a coconut. Coco token.png|A coconut token.

== Trivia == Before the 12/26/2021 update, you only could have a max of {{Cost|Coconut|150}} in your inventory. It has been increased to 500 after said update. Getting hit by a coconut originally converted 75% of the player's hive convert amount into honey. This is the only inventory item that can directly damage mobs. If you have no [[pollen]] in your [[Bags|bag]], catching a coconut will still spawn honey tokens that give {{Cost|Honey|1}} each, (before Honey From Tokens is applied). This happens because a honey token needs to give you at least 1 honey. *When used in the [[Hive Hub]], a total of {{Cost|Honey|1,500}} is given, meaning each honey token grants 150 honey.

If you believe you are not seeing the most recent version of this page, [https://bee-swarm-simulator.wikia.com/wiki/Codes?action=purge try clicking here].If that doesn't help, [https://bee-swarm-simulator.wikia.com/wiki/Codes?v=153 try this link].

[[File:PromoCodesMenu.png|thumb|288px|The codes menu.]] Promo '''Codes''' are a feature added in the May 18, 2018 update. It is located at the top of the [[System Page]]. Redeeming them gives prizes such as [[honey]], [[Ticket|tickets]], [[gumdrops]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], [[crafting]] materials, [[Wealth Clock|wealth clock]], [[Magic Bean|magic beans]], boosts from [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], or [[Field Boost|field boosts]].

[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] posts codes (or hints for codes) in the game itself, on the game's [https://www.roblox.com/games/1537690962 Roblox page], on the [https://www.roblox.com/communities/3982592 Bee Swarm Simulator Club] page, on [https://twitter.com/OnettDev his Twitter account], and on the game's [https://discord.gg/bee official Discord server]. He also sometimes gives out codes to YouTubers, and there have been reports of codes posted on his [https://www.roblox.com/users/1912490 Roblox profile page] and on Roblox advertisements.

==Notes== Do '''''NOT''''' join the Discord server just to ask for codes! Instead, use the search function to look for posts by Onett (onett1, Onett#0001, 428649652871495691). Codes can only be used '''once'''. Some older codes may tell you once you redeem them that you have obtained a >x3 boost, though they will still only give you x3. * They are ''not'' case-sensitive: "Bopmaster", "BopMaster", "BOPMASTER", and "bopmaster" will all work equally. Codes allow spaces in between: "Bees Buzz 123" and "BeesBuzz123" will work equally. Expired codes do not always say "expired"; sometimes, they say "invalid." *When you try to redeem a valid code that you have already used, you will be told: "You have already redeemed [code]."

docs.text:
The '''Cog Amulet''' is an amulet that can be obtained from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]].

In order to obtain these amulets, the player will need to beat certain rounds during the Robo Bear Challenge. The more rounds the player beats, the higher the tier of the Cog Amulet. The average stats of the amulet also scale higher the more cogs you collect in a round.

docs.title: Cog
docs.text:
''This article is about the items used in the Robo Bear Challenge. Not to be confused with [[7-Pronged Cog]].''{{Consumables|description=Used for purchases during Robo Bear's Challenge. Removed when the challenge ends.|cooldown=N/A|image= Cog.png}} {{Color|Cog|Cogs}} are inventory items added in the [[Updates|12/26/2022 update]]. They are used to purchase upgrades, purchase [[drives]], and reroll bees and upgrades in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. They are removed from the inventory when the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] ends. Additionally, you can reach {{Cost|Cog|250,000}} collected in total to unlock the {{Cost|Robo Cub|4=0}}.

== Ways to Obtain == Completing quests in the Robo Bear Challenge. Starting a challenge gives 10 Cogs. The harder the quest, the more Cogs it gives. You may get bonus cogs for completing a quest within the first two minutes. You may also get bonus cogs from certain upgrades you can purchase in the challenge. Defeating a [[Golden Cogmower]] guarantees at least 14 Cogs and scales up to 18. *As a reward for completing [[Bubble_Bee_Man|BBM's Naughty List]] in Beesmas 2024.

==Trivia== * This is the first [[Items|item]] to be added that is not only exclusively rewarded in a challenge, but also used as a temporary form of currency. *This is no longer the case, as you can now get a cog outside of the Robo Bear Challenge from [[Bubble Bee Man]]. The item slightly resembles the cog on top of the [[Noob Shop]]. {{CurrencyNav}} {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Robo Bear Challenge]] [[Category:Currency]]

docs.text:
''Not to be confused with [[Golden Cogmower]]s, the rarer, golden counterparts of Cogmowers or [[Party Cogmower]]s, the Beesmas Edition of these.''

{{Mob |title = Cogmower |image =Cogmower.png |location = Any field while the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] is active. |hp = Increases with level and round. |damage = 50 (increases with level) |level = 5-22 }} A '''Cogmower''' is a [[mob]] that exclusively appears during [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]].

This is the second mob in the Robo Bear Challenge that the player encounters, appearing as early as round 5.

Cogmowers rise from the field before slowly moving around the field aimlessly in a straight line and destroying layers of flowers upon going near them. when the player switches fields, the Cogmower sinks in the former field and ascends to the field the player is currently/recently standing in to follow the player. Cogmowers bounce in different directions when hitting the field's borders or another cogmower. The higher the level of the Cogmower, the more pollen is drained. They only take half the damage from [[Critical Hits]].

In rounds 10 and 20. Cogmowers are the main target mobs, requiring to defeat 10 in Round 10 and 20 in Round 20. In these rounds, cogmowers do not randomly spawn but will always stay in the same field and not follow the player whenever they stand in another field.

In round 10, cogmowers spawn in 3 sets of fields. The first set always contains 4 cogmowers, spawning in either [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Bamboo Field]], or [[Clover Field]]. The second set contains 3 cogmowers and will spawn in either [[Dandelion Field]], [[Sunflower Field]], or [[Strawberry Field]]. The third set contains 3 cogmowers and will spawn in either [[Cactus Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]], or [[Pine Tree Forest]].

In round 20, 4 sets of cogmowers spawn and there are 5 cogmowers each set. They spawn in nearly the same fields as round 10, with the addition of the [[Rose Field]].

A Cogmower's level can range from 5-22, depending on what round of Robo Bear's Challenge the player is on.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |6 |5,400 |- |7 |6,400 |- |8 |7,400 |- |9 |8,400 |- |10 |9,400 |- |11 | 11,000 |- |12 |12,000 |- |13 |13,400 |- |14 |15,000 |- |15 |17,000 |- |16 |19,000 |- |17 |20,000 |- |18 |23,000 |- |19 |25,000 |- |20 |30,000 |- |21 |32,000 |- |22 |34,000 |}

==Strategies== Cogmowers do not aim for the player, allowing players to sidestep them easily. A Cogmower's hitbox is directly in front of it instead of over it, so you can stand inside of one to ensure your bees target them. Stand near the Cogmower, this allows your bees to lock on to the Cogmower and quickly deal damage. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control, especially since Cogmowers often come in pairs or packs. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Cogmowers at once, and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]]. *The '' Star Saw''' Passive from the [[Star Amulet#Supreme Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulet]] can be useful as it circles you for 30 seconds when activated and can damage multiple Cogmowers simultaneously. * Frogs, Pollen Haze, and multiple amounts of [[The Supreme Saturator|Supreme Saturators]] can provide great amounts of field regeneration, which can combat the flowers drained by the cogmowers.

==Gallery== File:Newrobothumbnail.jpg|A cogmower in the game icon, with Robo Bear, Digital Bee, Basic Bee and a Mechsquito File:Screenshot 2023-02-03 161429.png|A cogmower roaming through a field. File:CogmowerCogturret1.png|A Cogmower next to a Cogturret.

==Trivia == Cogmower is a portmanteau of "Cog" and "Lawnmower'. * Cogmowers have a unique golden counterpart known as a [[Golden Cogmower]]. They also have a Beesmas variant called the [[Party Cogmower]]. Cogmowers, [[Golden Cogmower]]s, [[Party Cogmower|Party Cogmowers]], [[Cogturret]]s, [[Party Cogturret|Party Cogturrets]], and [[Wild Windy Bee]] are the only mobs that are able to collect layers of flowers. * If a Cogmower is stunned due to Digital Bee's Mind Hack, and is hit by an unaffected one, it would still bounce.

docs.title: Cogturret
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Cogturret |image =Cogturret.png |location = Any field while the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] is active. |hp = Increases with level and round. |damage = 25 (Red cog) 34 (Contact) |level = 11-22 }} ''Not to be confused with [[Party Cogturret]]s, the Beesmas Edition of these.''

A '''Cogturret''' is a [[mob]] that appears during [[Robo Bear Challenge]].

This is the third type of mob the Player will encounter while doing the challenge, first appearing at round 11.

Cogturrets always position themselves on the field's edge and follow the player similar to cogmowers where they descend to the former field and ascend to the current/recent field the player has visited. Cogturrets behavior is a fixed cycle. First, Cogturrets hide under the field and move along the field's edges, either randomly or at the player, during this state, cogturrets cannot be targeted. Then, they ascend and become targettable again. After a few seconds, they blast a giant red cog projectile in a straight line that destroys flowers, removing all layers of the flower and any goo covering it. After this, the Cogturret hides again and repeats the cycle.

Cogturrets' level can range from 11-22 depending on the current round of the Robo Bear Challenge.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |11 |6,800 |- |12 |7,800 |- |13 |8,800 |- |14 |9,800 |- |15 |11,000 |- |16 |12,200 |- |17 |13,200 |- |18 |14,200 |- |19 |15,500 |- |20 |17,000 |- |21 |19,000 |- |22 |20,000 |}

==Strategies == Cogturrets aim either at the player or randomly and have a delay on attacking whenever they ascend. Because of this, moving to the side after they fire a cog will often result in Cogturrets missing their attack. Cogturrets will always shoot straight at where they are facing so you can avoid their attacks simply by not being in front of them. Stand near the Cogturrets, this allows your bees to lock on to the Cogturrets and quickly deal damage. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control, especially since Cogturrets often come in pairs or packs. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Cogturrets at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

==Gallery== CogturretBullet.png|The cog that the cogturret shoots. File:Screenshot 2023-04-05 160846.png|A Cogturret in a field during nighttime. File:Cogturret1.png|A Cogturret in a field. File:CogmowerCogturret1.png|A Cogturret next to a Cogmower.

== '''Trivia''' == * Cogturrets have a [[Robo Party]] variant named [[Party Cogturret]]s. * Cogturrets, [[Cogmower|Cogmowers]], [[Golden Cogmower|Golden Cogmowers]], [[Party Cogmower]], [[Party Cogturret|Party Cogturrets]], and [[Wild Windy Bee]] are the only entities who can collect from flowers. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Robo Bear Challenge]] [[Category:Robo Bear]]

The {{Color|Comforting Vial}} is a consumable [[Nectar Vial|nectar vial]] [[Items|item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2022.12.26|12/26/2022 update]]. Once used, it grants the player 4 hours of the [[Nectar|Comforting Nectar]] [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] instantly. It can also be used to craft other [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] and [[tools]].

== Ways to Obtain == * Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 6th, 10th, and 13th quests each grant 1 Comforting Vial and other items. * Completing [[Dapper Bear#Blue Drive Quest|Dapper Bear's Blue Drive quest]] grants 1 Comforting Vial and other items. * Using the [[Nectar Condenser]] to condense 12 hours of Comforting Nectar. * Adding the Comforting Nectar Icon to the [[Sticker Stack]] rewards 1 Comforting Vial.

Completing Peppermint Preparation 2 ([[Bee Bear]]) gave 1 Comforting Vial and other items. Completing [[Bubble Bee Man#2022 Beesmas Quest - Naughty List|Bubble Bee Man's Naughty List]] in Beesmas 2022 gave 8 Comforting Vials and other items. |}

Commander Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.

Commander Bee likes the [[Spider Field]] and the [[Cactus Field]]. It dislikes the [[Dandelion Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 15 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * +50% [[Energy]], +5 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +5% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]], +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +3% Critical Chance.

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Focus|[Focus]]]''' Grants +3% Critical Chance for 20 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times. [[Critical Hits|Critical hits]] increase pollen and damage by 100%. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb|[Buzz Bomb]]]''' Collects 7 pollen from 13 surrounding [[Flowers]] (+10% pollen per [[Bond|Level]]). Combo with other bombs to increase power.

== Trivia == * Commander Bee's skin is the same as [[Looker Bee|Looker Bee's]]. * This bee, [[Buoyant Bee]] and [[Frosty Bee]] are the only 3 [[bees]] in the game that wear hats. ** This is the only Colorless bee that wears a hat. * This bee is one of the 4 bees that have the focus ability, the other 3 are Looker Bee, [[Music Bee]], and [[Puppy Bee]] with [[Reindeer Antlers]]. * Commander Bee is the only epic bee added in an [[Updates|update]]. * A [[Egg#Specific Bee Egg|Commander Bee Egg]] can be obtained by capturing [[Commando Chick]] 200 times. * As the name and model suggest, this bee is likely inspired by the eponymous video game protagonist known as Commander Keen. ** This point is further supported by the expired [[codes|code]] "Keen4", which yielded a [[Royal Jelly#Royal Jelly Variants|Commander Bee Jelly]].

docs.title: Commando Chick's Hideout
docs.text:
[[File:CommandoChickHideout.jpeg|thumb|The location of the Commando Chick’s hideout.]] The '''Commando Chick’s Hideout''' is a location in the [[Starter Zone|starter zone]] that can be entered by completing the [[Obstacle Courses#Commando Chick's Hideout Obby|obby]] between the [[Blue HQ]] and the [[Wealth Clock]]. To enter the parkour, the player first needs to cut the vines with either the [[Clippers]], [[Scissors]], or the [[Scythe]]. It is home to the [[Commando Chick]].

== Strategy == Standing on the last stair, nearest to Commando Chick's hideout normally makes the chick flee. However, if the player stands on the edge of that stair (as close as possible to the hideout where one of your body parts is inside of the hideout), the Commando Chick does not flee; therefore, the player's bees can defeat the Commando Chick whilst they take no damage. This strategy does not 100% work as there could be a slight chance of the Commando Chick fleeing. The player could just move into the hideout and then back onto the stair again to fix this.

== Music == When in the hideout, the following audio plays:

[[File:Crawlers.ogg]]

This audio also plays in [[King Beetle's Lair]] and the [[White Tunnel]].

== Gallery == Commando 100.png|The inside of the hideout. Commando Chick.png|The Commando Chick inside its Hideout. Commandochickleaderboard.png|The Most Commando Captures leaderboard. File:CommandoChickHideoutPurpleFog.webp|The Commando Chick Hideout during a Mythic Meteor Shower.

== Trivia == * This location used to house the [[Most Commando Captures|Most Commando Captures leaderboard]] before it was removed from the game. * In Beesmas 2019, this location contained the [[Ornament Presents|Golden Present]]. ** The obstacle course remained after the presents were removed. When the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/6/2020 update]] came out, it was repurposed into the hideout.

docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Commando Chick |image =Commandochick.png |location = [[Commando Chick's Hideout]] |timer = 30:00 (25:30 with Gifted Vicious Bee) |hp = Varies on number of captures |damage = 20 (Colliding with the player), 50 (From grenade) |points = 0 |bond = 5 |honey = Varies on Number of Captures |level = 3-25 (Varies on Number of Captures) }}The '''Commando Chick''' is a [[:Category:Mini Bosses|mini-boss]] [[Chicks|chick]] that spawns in [[Commando Chick's Hideout|its hideout]]. Its hideout is located to the left of [[Brown Bear]] and the [[Wealth Clock]]. To cut the vines, the [[Clippers]], [[Scissors]], or [[Scythe]] needs to be equipped. Once the vines are cut, they will never regrow back.

The Commando Chick has a respawn time of 30:00 (25:30 with [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]). When Commando Chick hides in its egg, it throws grenades (1 if it has more than 2/3 of its health, 2 if it has less than 2/3 of its health, 3 if it has less than 1/3 of its health, 4 if less than 1/100).

The Commando Chick deals 20 damage when colliding with the player and 50 damage if the player is near a grenade when it explodes. Starting at 150 health and level 3, the chick increases in health and level with each successive capture, reaching level 6 by the fifth capture. The chick will grow another level after a progressively higher amount of captures per level up.

Commando Chick has a similar appearance to other Chicks but is twice as large as a normal one. It also has a green shell and red eyes.

The Commando Chick stays still and blocks attacks when it is in its shell. After some time, it jumps out of its shell and resumes running around within the hideout.

{{Clear}}

== Strategy == Standing on the last stair, nearest to Commando Chick's hideout normally makes the chick flee. However, if the player stands on the edge of that stair (as close as possible to the hideout), Commando Chick does not flee and the player's bees can defeat Commando Chick whilst they take no damage. This strategy does not 100% work as there could be a slight chance of the Chick fleeing or accidentally jumping onto the stair because of the hop it does when entering the egg. The player could just move into the hideout and then back onto the stair again to fix this. If the player doesn't want the Commando Chick to stay in its egg, moving out and re-entering the hideout will cause it to change back to its roaming state, do note that it will spawn grenades again though. Also however, there is a glitch in the strategy that the chick that is in its egg will flip upside-down and another chick will come from its same spawner. Another strategy is to get another player to help the player defeat the chick.

==Gallery== Cammando.png|A level 21 {{PAGENAME}}'s HP bar, at 9,984,846. Commando fled.png|The notification about {{PAGENAME}} fleeing after the player leaves its hideout. Comando chick.png|{{PAGENAME}} hiding in its egg with 4 grenades. Captured Commando Chick 50th time..png|A player capturing {{PAGENAME}} for the 50th time. Commando chick with no egg.png|{{PAGENAME}} with an invisible shell. 272424293 1323635558062985 1126643322167630472 n.png|A flipped over {{PAGENAME}}. File:Mindhack.jpg|{{PAGENAME}} being Mind Hacked. File:CommandoLevel20.jpg|A level 20 {{PAGENAME}} outside of its shell. File:CommandoChickinfloor.png|A picture of the Commando Chick duplicating a fake copy of itself inside the floor after the player left the hideout but came back quickly.

==Trivia == This is one of the few mobs to have its own hideout with the others being [[King Beetle]] and [[Tunnel Bear]]. Commando Chick’s hideout is the only one of the three where you have to complete an obby to enter it. Commando Chick is the only chick to have a green color egg. Commando Chick can spawn multiple grenades if you keep leaving and entering back in multiple times. However, you may die to this risky trick. Commando Chick is the only chick with red eyes; all other chicks have black eyes. Commando Chick is one of the two chicks to drop a [[Egg#Mythic Egg|Mythic Egg]], the other being the [[Mondo Chick]]. Commando Chick is one of two [[mobs]] whose health is saved if the player leaves mid-session, the other being the [[Stump Snail]]. * Other player's bees can attack your Commando Chick. Only your Commando Chick can damage you by contact, but all grenades can damage all players. There used to be a [[Leaderboards|leaderboard]] behind where it spawns called the [[Most Commando Captures Leaderboard]]. Since 4/7/2020, the leaderboard has been removed. There is a glitch where Commando Chick will disappear while being actively fought. When this occurs, a different fleeing message will appear: [🐣 Commando Chick got away! 🐣] The normal message is [🐣 Commando Chick fled! (HP Saved) 🐣] There is a glitch where Commando Chick's feet clip into the ground. This will cause it to slide and move extremely fast, even if it is in its egg. If it hits a corner, it will not change direction and stay there until it goes into its roaming stage again. There was a glitch where Commando Chick would stay in its egg and would not go out of its egg, even when it was moving. This can also make some player's bees keep on missing their shots. The easiest way to fix this glitch was to exit Commando Chick's Hideout and re-enter it. Towards the higher levels, Commando Chick can give millions of honey. This means that using a stronger alt account or friend to kill your commando chick can be a quick way to get honey on a newly made account. *Sometimes, when a players game is extremely laggy or they have high ping, the vines may reappear and can’t be cut. This can be fixed by rejoining the server. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Mini Bosses]] [[Category:Multiplayer Bosses]]

docs.title: Crimson Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |color = Red |rarity = Event |image-orig = Crimson Bee.png |image-gifted = CrimsonBee Gifted.png |description = "A Superhero and Defender of all things Red! Together with [[Cobalt Bee]] it works to unite bees of all colors." |energylabel = more |energy = 35 |speed = 18.2 |attack = 7 |skincolor1 = #ff0000 |skincolor2 = #ffffff |skincolor3 = #ff0000 }}'''Crimson Bee''' is a [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[Bees/Event|Event Bee]]. It can be obtained by purchasing a [[Egg#Event Bee Eggs|Crimson Bee Egg]] in the [[Ticket Tent]] for 250 [[Ticket]]s.

Its abilities are enhanced when [[Cobalt Bee]] is also in the hive.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only ways to make it gifted are by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Crimson Bee likes the [[Clover Field]] and the [[Rose Field]]. It dislikes the [[Pineapple Patch]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 140 [[Honey]] in 3 seconds. * +75% [[Energy]], +30% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +25% Convert Speed, +60 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], 10% [[Instant Conversion]], +6 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], 5% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +15% [[System Page#Instant Red Conversion|Instant Red Conversion]].

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Pulse|[Red Pulse]]]''' Fires a pulse that hops between your red bees, collecting pollen around them (+10% per level). Power increases with each hop. If you own Cobalt Bee, fires a [[Ability Tokens#Pulse|Blue Pulse]] as well. ** If Gifted, the pulse also causes bees to instantly convert pollen equal to 25% of the bee's Convert Amount (+25% per Field Boost stack). * '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb Sync|[Red Bomb Sync]]]''' Grants 10% Red Pollen and Instant Red Conversion and allows [[Ability Tokens#Bomb|Red Bombs]] to collect from white [[Flowers]] for 30 sec. If [[Ability Tokens#Bomb Sync|Blue Bomb Sync]] is active, applies to blue flowers as well.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 4|honey = 140|honeytime = 3|rarity = event|color = red}}

== Gallery == GiftedCrimsonBee Slot.png|A Gifted Crimson Bee hive slot. CrimsonFace.png|Crimson Bee's face. Red Pulse.png|The Red Pulse icon. Red Bomb Sync.png|The Red Bomb Sync icon.

== Trivia == * The only difference between Crimson Bee and Cobalt Bee's [[Fields|field]] preferences is that the Crimson Bee likes the Rose Field, whereas Cobalt Bee prefers the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. * This is one of the two [[bees]] which have [[Ability Tokens|Abilities]] that can trigger another bee's ability, the other being its counterpart, Cobalt Bee. * This is one of the four Event bees who have different color faces on the hive rather than the bee itself, the others being Cobalt Bee, [[Festive Bee]], and [[Vicious Bee]]. ** This is the first bee that is both a red bee and an Event bee, with Festive Bee being the second. * When Crimson and Cobalt Bee are both in the same hive, the player gets the following bonuses from these ability tokens: ** Red pulse additionally fires a Blue Pulse to collect from blue bees. ** If both red bomb sync and blue bomb sync are activated, red bombs can collect from blue and white flowers. * This bee, along with Cobalt Bee, are currently the only Event bees to cost 250 tickets. ** The [[First Edition Bee|first edition]] [[Tabby Bee]] and [[Puppy Bee]] could once be purchased with 250 tickets as well. [[File:Apples.png|thumb]] * The description of the Red Bomb Sync ability used to be spelled incorrectly as "apples" instead of "applies". [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] was aware of this and instead changed the "apples" to "🍎 s". This mistake has recently been corrected. * This bee, Cobalt Bee, [[Photon Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], [[Ninja Bee]] and [[Shy Bee]] are the only bees that create a trail. * The [[Crimson Guard]], which can be purchased in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]], has a special design, name, and stats dedicated to Crimson Bee. ** The Crimson Guard has a [[Passive Abilities|passive ability]] similar to Crimson Bee's red pulse ability. * This bee, [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Puppy Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]] are the only event bees that don't have an 'enhanced' ability if gifted. * According to the similar descriptions of both Crimson Bee and [[Cobalt Bee]], these two [[Bees/Event|Event Bees]] are working together to unite all Red and Blue Bees together. This shows that unlike the other bees, these opposing-colored bees have a genuine friendship.

Its description reads, "A guard bestowed with the heroic power of [[Crimson Bee]] - Defender of the Red Bees." {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|200,000,000}}{{Cost|Red Extract|100}}{{Cost|Stinger|100}}{{Cost|Oil|50}}{{Cost|Glitter|25}} |} It is equipped on the left shoulder. When equipped, it leaves a trail behind it similar to Crimson Bee's trail.

== Stats == * +250,000 [[Capacity]]. * +50% [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]]. * +20% [[System Page#Red Bomb Pollen|Red Bomb Pollen]]. * +3 [[System Page#Red Attack|Red Bee Attack]]. * +10% [[System Page#Defense|Defense]]. * +10% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]]. * [[Passive Abilities#Focus Pulser|+Passive Ability: Focus Pulser]]. ** Effects: Every 30th [[Ability Tokens#Focus|focus token]] releases a [[Ability Tokens#Pulse|red pulse]], which hops to each [[:Category:Red|red]] [[Bees|bee]], collecting pollen around them. Power increases with each hop. *** Unlike the ability token, this effect does not trigger a [[Ability Tokens#Pulse|blue pulse]], even if the player owns a [[Cobalt Bee]] or the [[Cobalt Guard]].

== Gallery == FocusPulser.png|The Focus Pulser Passive icon. Crimsonguardicon.png|The Crimson Guard icon. Stripescrimson.png|The trail the Crimson Guard leaves behind. File:The Crismon Guard worn on a player..jpg|The Crimson Guard worn on a player.

== Trivia == * If the ingredients to craft this item were to be crafted, a total of 200,000,000 [[honey]], 14,375 [[Strawberry|strawberries]], 9,375 [[Blueberry|blueberries]], 12,500 [[Pineapple| pineapples]], 2,500 [[Sunflower Seeds|sunflower seeds]], 25 [[Magic Bean|magic beans]], 2,125 [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies,]] 625 [[Treats|moon charms]], and 100 [[stinger]]s are needed. The total crafting time is 13375 minutes (or ~223 hours) of playtime. * This is the only red guard that cannot be purchased in the [[Red HQ]]. * This is one of the two guards that have a passive ability, the other being the [[Cobalt Guard]]. * Its [[:Category:Blue|blue]] counterpart is the [[Cobalt Guard]]. *This is the only red guard that leaves a trail.
