docs.title: Critical Hits
docs.text:
{{Update|We are in the process of catching up to the game. Please feel free to help us by updating the following information:The [[#Trivia]] stats need updating.}} '''Critical Hits''' are moments of increased [[pollen]] collection and attack damage, doubled at its base power. Their frequency is increased with higher [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]], and their strength is increased by greater [[System Page#Critical Power|Critical Power]]. A critical hit will have the pollen amount/attack damage shake and change color, similar to the animation below.

+5,627!

''The animation of a critical hit.'' [[File:CriticalStats1.png|thumb|The Critical Chance, Critical Power, Super-Crit Chance, and Super-Crit Power stats in the System Page.]] You can see the stats for all critical hit statistics in the [[System Page]].

== Critical Chance == '''Critical Chance''' is the chance of a hit being critical hit. The player can see how much their Critical Chance is by looking for the Critical Chance stat in the System Page. Critical Chance can be improved by a variety of ways such as [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], [[:Category:Guards|guards]], and [[:Category:Inventory|inventory items]].

=== [[Bees]] === ==== Tokens ==== * [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] gives +3% Critical Chance per token and caps at +30% Critical Chance from 10 tokens. * [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Precise Mark]] from the [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Target Practice]] ability gives +7% Critical Chance per token and caps at +21% Critical Chance from three Marks. * The [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Tabby Blessing]] buff, granted from collecting [[Ability Tokens#Tabby Love|Tabby Love]] while having maximum Tabby Love stacks, grants +1% Critical Chance.

==== [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|Gifted Hive Bonuses]] ==== * Gifted [[Commander Bee]] gives +3% Critical Chance.

==== [[Beequip]]s ==== * Individual Bee: ** A {{Cost|Bottle Cap|||0}} gives from +1% Critical Chance to +2% Critical Chance. Using [[waxes]] can increase the amount up to +12% Critical Chance. ** A {{Cost|Charm Bracelet|||0}} gives from +1% Critical Chance to +14% Critical Chance. ** A {{Cost|Bang Snap|||0}} gives from +1% Critical Chance to +3% Critical Chance. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +23% Critical Chance. ** {{Cost|Pink Shades}} can give from +22% Critical Chance to +26% Critical Chance. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +50% Critical Chance. ** A {{Cost|Beesmas Top|||0}} gives from +5% Critical Chance to +10% Critical Chance. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +20% Critical Chance. ** A {{Cost|Beesmas Tree Hat|||0}} gives from +2% Critical Chance to +5% Critical Chance. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +10% Critical Chance. ** A {{Cost|Snow Tiara|||0}} gives +1% Critical Chance. ** A {{Cost|Toy Drum|||0}} gives +1% Critical Chance.

=== [[:Category:Guards|Guards]] === * The [[Looker Guard]] gives +1% Critical Chance. * The [[Elite Red Guard]] gives +5% Critical Chance. * The [[Riley Guard]] gives +8% Critical Chance. * The [[Crimson Guard]] gives +10% Critical Chance.

=== [[Amulet]]s === * [[Star Amulet]]s: ** The Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond Star Amulet can give from +1% Critical Chance up to +5% Critical Chance. ** The Supreme Star Amulet can give from +1% Critical Chance up to +7% Critical Chance. * [[Ant Amulet]]s: ** The Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Supreme Ant Amulet can give up to +3% Critical Chance.

=== [[Buffs & Debuffs|Buffs]] === * Using a {{Cost|Tropical Drink|||0}} gives +5% Critical Chance. * Using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} gives +6% Critical Chance. The buff can also be given from certain codes. * Collecting [[Jelly Beans|green jelly beans]] gives +3% Critical Chance per jelly bean and caps and +5% Critical Chance from 3 jelly beans.

=== [[Robo Bear Challenge]] === There are several upgrades that can be bought with {{Cost|Cog}} during the Robo Bear Challenge which can upgrade Critical Chance.

  • Rare Upgrades: ** Commit: This upgrade starts at +5% Critical Chance and maxes at 2 upgrades with +10% Critical Chance. ** Virus: This upgrade starts at +1% Critical Chance and maxes at 3 upgrades with +3% Critical Chance.
  • Epic Upgrades: ** RGB: This upgrade gives 1% Critical Chance.
  • Legendary Upgrades: ** Pseudo-RNG: This upgrade gives 3% Critical Chance.

==== Debuffs ==== There are certain upgrades that can be bought with cogs during the Robo Bear Challenge which can downgrade Critical Chance.

  • Rare Upgrades: ** SSD: Blue: This upgrade starts at -3% Critical Chance and maxes at 3 upgrades with -6% Critical Chance.
  • Epic Upgrades: ** FOV: This upgrade gives -2% Critical Chance. ** Normalize: This upgrade gives x0 Critical Chance.

== Critical Power == '''Critical Power''' is how strong a critical hit can be. The player can see how much their Critical Power is by looking for the Critical Power stat in the System Page. Critical Power can be improved by a variety of ways such as ability tokens, guards, and beequips.

=== Bees === ==== Tokens ==== * [[Ability Tokens#Melody|Melody]] gives +100% Critical Power. * The [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Tabby Blessing]] buff, granted from collecting [[Ability Tokens#Tabby Love|Tabby Love]] while having maximum Tabby Love stacks, grants +25% Critical Power.

==== Gifted Hive Bonuses ==== * Gifted [[Looker Bee]] gives +25% Critical Power. * Gifted [[Tabby Bee]] gives +50% Critical Power.

==== Beequips ==== * Individual Bee: ** A {{Cost|Thumbtack|||0}} gives from +5% Critical Power to +10% Critical Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +40% Critical Power. ** A {{Cost|Camo Bandana|||0}} gives from +1% Critical Power to +6% Critical Power. ** A {{Cost|Bottle Cap|||0}} can give from +5% Critical Power to +10% Critical Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +60% Critical Power. ** A {{Cost|Kazoo|||0}} gives from +2% Critical Power to +5% Critical Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +65% Critical Power. ** A {{Cost|Whistle|||0}} gives from +15% Critical Power to +25% Critical Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +85% Critical Power. ** {{Cost|Pink Shades}} gives from +29% Critical Power to +49% Critical Power. * Hive Bonus: ** A {{Cost|Bottle Cap|||0}} can give from +2% Critical Power to +15% Critical Power from waxing. ** A {{Cost|Kazoo|||0}} can give from +2% Critical Power to +5% Critical Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +10% Critical Power. ** A {{Cost|Beesmas Top|||0}} can give from +2% Critical Power to +5% Critical Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +15% Critical Power.

=== Guards === * The [[Looker Guard]] gives +25% Critical Power. * The [[Looker Guard|Elite Blue Guard]] gives +50% Critical Power. * The [[Bucko Guard]] gives +75% Critical Power. * The [[Cobalt Guard]] gives +100% Critical Power.

=== Amulets === * Ant Amulets: ** The Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Supreme Ant Amulet can give up to +50% Critical Power.

=== Badges === * The [[Badges#Battle Badge|Battle Badge]] can give up to +100% Critical Power depending on the badge rank. ** The Cadet Battle Badge gives +10% Critical Power. ** The Hotshot Battle Badge gives +20% Critical Power. ** The Ace Battle Badge gives +40% Critical Power. ** The Master Battle Badge gives +70% Critical Power. ** The Grandmaster Battle Badge gives +100% Critical Power.

=== Buffs === ==== [[Sticker]]s ==== * The Wobbly Looker Bee Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Tabby From Behind Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Uplooking Bear Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Wishbone Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Triple Exclamation Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Eighth Note Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Green Circle Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Interrobang Block Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Taunting Doodle Person Sticker gives +1% Critical Power. * The Blue Square Sticker gives +2% Critical Power. * The Black Diamond Sticker gives +2% Critical Power.

=== Robo Bear Challenge === There are several upgrades that can be bought with {{Cost|Cog}} during the Robo Bear Challenge which can upgrade Critical Power. * Rare Upgrades: ** Nullify: This upgrade starts at x1.5 Critical Power and maxes at 2 upgrades with x2 Critical Power. * Epic Upgrades: ** Demarcate: This upgrade makes Mark Tokens give x1.03 Critical Power for 15 seconds which can stack up to 10 times at x1.3 Critical Power.

==== Debuffs ==== There are certain upgrades that can be bought with cogs during the Robo Bear Challenge which can downgrade Critical Power. * Common Upgrades: ** Defragment: This upgrade starts at x0.9 Critical Power and maxes at 10 upgrades with x0.5 Critical Power. * Epic Upgrades: ** Client-Side: This upgrade gives x0.75 Critical Power.

== Super-Crit == When performing a critical hit, there is a chance to perform a '''Super-Crit''' (purple version of a critical hit) which doubles the pollen collection while also instantly converting the pollen collected, while for the attack damage is increased by 33% of the Super-Crit's pollen. The frequency for a Super-Crit is increased with higher Super-Crit Chance, and their strength is increased by greater Super-Crit Power.

=== Super-Crit Chance === '''Super-Crit Chance''' is how often a critical hit will be a Super-Crit. The player can see how much their Super-Crit Chance is by looking for the Super-Crit Chance stat in the System Page. Super-Crit Chance can be improved by several ways.

==== Bees ==== ===== Tokens ===== * The [[Buffs & Debuffs#Precision|Precision]] buff granted from the [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Target Practice]] ability gives +2% per token and caps at +20% from ten tokens. * The [[Buffs & Debuffs#Precise Mark|Precise Mark]] buff from the Target Practice ability gives +7% Super-Crit Chance per token and caps at +21% Super-Crit Chance from three tokens. * The [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Tabby Blessing+]] buff, granted from collecting [[Ability Tokens#Tabby Love|Tabby Love]] from a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Tabby Bee]] while having maximum Tabby Love stacks, grants +1% Super-Crit Chance.

===== Gifted Hive Bonuses ===== * Gifted [[Precise Bee]] gives +3% Super-Crit Chance.

===== Beequips ===== * Individual Bee: ** {{Cost|Pink Shades|||0}} give from +1% Super-Crit Chance to +15% Super-Crit Chance. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +24% Super-Crit Chance. * Hive Bonus: ** {{Cost|Pink Shades|||0}} can give +1% Super-Crit Chance as a hive bonus.

=== Buffs === * Using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} gives +1% Super-Crit Chance. The buff can also be given from certain codes.

*

=== Robo Bear Challenge === * Legendary Upgrades: ** Bruteforce: This upgrade gives +6% Super-Crit Chance.

=== Super-Crit Power === '''Super-Crit Power''' is how strong a Super-Crit will be. The player can see how much their Super-Crit Power is by looking for the Super-Crit Power stat in the System Page. Super-Crit Power can be improved by several ways.

==== Bees ==== ===== Beequips ===== * Individual Bee: ** A {{Cost|Camo Bandana|||0}} can give up to +14% Super-Crit Power. * Hive Bonus: ** A {{Cost|Whistle|||0}} can give from +1% Super-Crit Power to +20% Super-Crit Power from waxing. ** {{Cost|Pink Shades|||0}} from +1% Super-Crit Power to +5% Super-Crit Power. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +9% Super-Crit Power. ** A {{Cost|Demon Talisman|||0}} can give up to 10% Super-Crit Power as a hive bonus from waxing.

=== Amulets === * [[Cog Amulet]]s: ** The Diamond Cog Amulet can give from +10% Super-Crit Power up to +12% Super-Crit Power. ** The Supreme Cog Amulet can give from +15% Super-Crit Power up to +25% Super-Crit Power.

=== Buffs === * Dark Heat made from dark flames using the [[Dark Scythe]] gives x1.05 Super-Crit Power with each additional dark flame granting x0.05 Super-Crit Power.

==== Stickers ==== * The Precise Eye Sticker gives +1% Super-Crit Power. * The Squashed Head Bear Sticker gives +1% Super-Crit Power. * * Purple Fleuron Sticker gives +1% Super-Crit Power. * The Royal Symbol Sticker gives +1% Super-Crit Power. * The Royal Bear Sticker gives +1% Super-Crit Power. * The Purple 4-Point Flower Sticker gives +1% Super-Crit Power.

=== Robo Bear Challenge === * Legendary Upgrades: ** Pseudo-RNG: This upgrade gives x1.25 Super-Crit Power.

== Trivia ==

  • The highest Critical Chance the player can have at a time is 88%. This is achieved by having Focus x10 (30%), Crimson Guard (10%), Supreme Star Amulet (+7%), Supreme Ant Amulet (+3%), Gifted Commander Bee (3%), x3 green jelly beans (5%), 3 stacks of Precise Mark (21%), {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} (6%), {{Cost|Snow Tiara|||0}} (1%), and two {{Cost|Toy Drum}} (2%). Additional percentages were possible during certain events, with +3% from [[Panda Bear|Panda Bear's]] [[Ornaments#Beesmas 2019|2019 ornament]], and +1% with [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] [[Ornaments#Beesmas 2020|ornament in 2020]] and [[Ornaments#Beesmas 2021|2021]]. ** However, this percentage can be brought up to 100% in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]], by purchasing two Virus upgrades (+2% Critical Chance) and two Commit upgrades (+10% Critical Chance).
  • The highest Critical Power the player can have at a time is 1,586%. This is achieved by having Melody (+100%), Cobalt Guard (+100%), Supreme Ant Amulet (+50%), Gifted Looker Bee (+25%), Gifted Tabby Bee (+50%), two {{Cost|Bottle Cap|||0}} (+30%), a {{Cost|Kazoo|||0}} (+10%), three {{Cost|Beesmas Top}} (+45%), Nullify upgrade maxed (x2), 10 stacks of Demaracte upgrade (x1.3), and Grandmaster Battle Badge (+100%). ** The lowest Critical Power the player can have at a time is 38%. This can be achieved by having Defragment upgrade maxed (x0.5) and Client-Side upgrade (x0.75).
  • The highest Super-Crit Chance the player can have at a time is 54%. This is achieved by having x10 [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Precision]] (+20%), x3 [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Precise Mark]] (+21%), [[Precise_Bee#Gifted|Gifted Precise Bee]] (+3%), [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Tabby Blessing+]] (+1%),{{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} (+1%), {{Cost|Pink Shades|||0}} (+1%), [[Sticker|Stretched Head Bear Sticker]] (+1%) and Bruteforce upgrade (+6%). ** Additional percentages were possible during certain events, with +1% from [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Galentine’s Blessing]] and +1% with [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] [[Ornaments#Beesmas 2022|ornament in 2022]] & [[Ornaments#Beesmas 2024|2024]], adding with the total, to create a result of 56% super-crit chance during beesmas.
  • Bees emit green sparkles when doing a critical hit. [[Category:Mechanics]] [[zh-tw:爆擊]]

docs.title: Cub Buddy
docs.text:
[[File:CubBuddy.png|thumb|226x226px|The default skin.]] A '''Cub Buddy''' is a small, baby version of a [[Bears|bear]] that follows the player around, collects tokens, and creates gifts. Whenever the player's cub buddy gets too far away, it will teleport back to them.

Cub buddies have settings that can be accessed and viewed through the [[Cub Console]], which is located on the [[System Page]].

When the player's cub buddy produces [[items]], it dances, emits heart particles, and an in-game message will pop up, saying:

{{Notification||🐻(Cub Buddy Name) made some gifts!}}

== Ways to Obtain == Note: This list also includes the cub buddy skins. * Redeeming a {{Cost|Cub Buddy Voucher|||0}}. * Purchasable in the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|600}} (gives a Cub Buddy Voucher). * Obtainable by completing [[Bee Bear]]'s 15th quest. * Obtainable by completing 300 [[Brown Bear]] quests (gives the Brown Bear Cub skin). * Obtainable by collecting {{Cost|Cog|250,000}}, beating Round 25 in [[Robo Bear Challenge]], or placing Top 10 on the [[Daily Top Robo Bear Challenge Scores]] (gives the Robo Cub skin). * Obtainable by placing Top 50 on the Daily Stick Bug score leaderboard or as a drop from [[Stick Bug]] (Unbelievably Rare) (gives the Stick Cub skin). For the end of challenge reward, the odds vary from around 1 in 25,000 (10 million score) to around 1 in 670 (over 1,000,000,000 score) https://discord.com/channels/427553293862961153/676148494276362260/1194516653724139581 Obtainable by sticking all 12 Star Signs to the [[Sticker Stack]], rolling it from the [[Sticker Printer]], or from purchasing a [[Star Amulet|Diamond Star Amulet]] (1 in 1,000,000 chance) (gives the Star Cub skin). By trading with other players. === Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | *Beesmas 2019: Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 10th quest, "A Beesmas Miracle" (gave a cub buddy and the Black Cub skin). Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 15th quest, "Bee Cub Workshop 5" (gave the Bee Cub skin). Purchasing the Cub Buddy Launch Pack for 800R$ (gave a cub buddy, the Black Cub skin, and the Noob Cub skin). Beesmas 2020: Purchasing in [[Bee Bear’s Catalog|Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|250}} (gives a cub buddy (only if not already owned), the Black Cub Skin, Gingerbread Cub skin and a star treat (2 if the player already owns a cub buddy when buying it). Beesmas 2021: Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 15th quest, "Cub Buddy Beckoning" (gave the Black Cub skin or a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} if the player already has a cub buddy) Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 20th quest, "Snow Cub Reformation 5/5" (gave the Snow Cub skin).

Beesmas 2022: Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 15th quest, "Cogs For The Cub Buddy" (gave a cub buddy and the Black Cub skin, or a [[Treats|star treat]] if the player already has a cub buddy). You could also complete [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 20th quest, "Peppermint Preparation (5/5)" (gave the Peppermint Robo Cub). Beesmas 2024 (Summer): Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 15th quest, "Here comes Cub Buddy" (gave a cub buddy voucher, redeemable for a Black Cub skin along with the actual Cub Buddy itself). Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 20th quest, "Doodle Cub Creation (5/5)" (gave the Doodle Cub skin).

*Purchasing in the [[Ticket Tent]] for 2000 [[Ticket]]s (gives a cub buddy and the Black Cub skin). |}

==Skins== ''Note: Skins are purely cosmetic.'' === Regular Skins=== {| class="article-table" |+ !Appearance !Name !Description |- |[[File:Black Cub.png|100px]] |Black Cub Skin | A precious baby Black Bear! This is the default skin given to all Cub Buddy owners. |- |[[File:Brown Cub.png|100px]] |Brown Cub Skin | A slightly chubby cub that got into the Royal Jelly. Rewarded after completing 300 [[Brown Bear]] Quests! |- |[[File:Robo Cub.png|100px]] |Robo Cub Skin | They forgot a few drives when constructing this Robo Bear. Rewarded after beating round 25 of [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]], collecting 250,000 [[Cog]]s, or being top 5 on the Daily Robo Bear scores. |- |[[File:Stick Cub.png|100px]] | Stick Cub Skin | This stick nymph evolved to camouflage itself as a bear. Awarded to the top 5 Daily Stick Bug scores. Dropped by [[Stick Bug]] (Unbelievably Rare) |- |[[File:Star Cub.png|100px]] |Star Cub Skin | A cosmic cub visiting from another galaxy. Awarded after sticking all 12 Star Signs to the [[Sticker Stack]] or obtained from the [[Sticker Printer]]. |}

===Limited Skins=== {| class="article-table" |+ !Appearance !Name !Description |- |[[File:Noob Cub.png|100px]] |Noob Cub Skin | This little noob doesn't know the first thing about running a shop. This was included in the Cub Buddy Launch Pack. (During Beesmas 2019) Obtained in the Cub Buddy Launch Pack. |- |[[File:Bee Cub.png|100px]] |Bee Cub Skin | A young polar bear going through an identity crisis. This was the final reward of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 2019 quests. (During Beesmas 2019) Obtained through Bee Bear's 2nd Cub Buddy questline. |- |[[File:Gingerbread Cub.png|100px]] |Gingerbread Cub Skin | A cub made of cookies, brought to life by Honeyday Magic! Purchased in [[Bee Bear's Catalog|Bee Bear's 2020 Catalog]] for 250 [[Gingerbread Bear]]s. |- |[[File:Snow Cub.png|100px]] |Snow Cub Skin | This cruel cub was carved from a Level 20 [[Snowbear|Snowbear's]] snowball. This was the final reward of Bee Bear's March 2022 quests. |- |[[File:Peppermint Robo Cub.png|100px]] |Peppermint Robo Cub Skin | A clockwork cub composed of cogs and candycanes. This was the final reward of Bee Bear's April 2023 quests. |- |[[File:Doodle Cub.png|100px]] |Doodle Cub Skin |Cut from cardboard and scribbled up with magic crayons. This was the final reward of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] Summer 2024 quests. |- |[[File:Gloomy Cub.png|100px]] |Gloomy Cub Skin |This crybaby's pessimism is reified as a permanent cloud. This is the final reward of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] March 2025 quests. |}

==Possible Gift Rewards== Cub buddies will produce gifts in a ring of 5 tokens, which usually contain common items like {{Cost|Treat}}, but can also produce rarer items like tickets or {{Cost|Royal Jelly}}. When a cub buddy starts to dance and heart particles appear above its head, that means it's about to produce some gifts. These items can be collected not only by the player, but also by [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|token links]], [[Vector Bee|Vector Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Triangulate|triangulate ability]], [[Windy Bee|Windy Bee’s]] [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|tornado ability]] and be collected by a [[Frog]]'s Tongue. Cub buddies produce gifts every 1–5 minutes. Similar to [[sprout]]s and [[leaves]], the rewards granted by cub buddies typically depend on the [[Fields|field]] the player stands in (e.g. getting 3 [[Sunflower Seed|sunflower seeds]] while standing in the [[Sunflower Field]]).

==Trivia== While Bee Bear said that the cub buddies are dolls animated by "Beesmas magic," [[Polar Bear]] said, "He says the [Cub Buddies] are animated by the magic of Beesmas... But in reality, Bee Bear had to build and program them himself.” Also, [[Science Bear]] said, "They're just robots, you know. But they're so lifelike, it's uncanny!" If the player bought the Cub Buddy Launch Pack, and then completed Bee Bear's 10th quest, the player was rewarded with 250 tickets since the player can only have one of each cub buddy skin. If the process is reversed, the player will instead be rewarded with 250 tickets in addition to the 250 tickets that they would normally get for a total of 500 tickets and the Noob Cub skin for purchasing the pack. When the player gets their first cub buddy, it will automatically be named "Buddy". A cub buddy uses the wave emote when idle, the point emote when collecting a token, the dance emote before it produces gifts, and the cheer emote when it makes the gifts. *Most cub buddies use the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/56/Cartoony-Animation-Package Cartoony Animation Package]. The Brown Cub, Snow Cub, Robo Cub, Peppermint Robo Cub, and Gloomy Cub are the only cubs to use a different one, being the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/68/Knight-Animation-Package Knight Animation Package], the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/75/Ninja-Animation-Package Ninja Animation Package] and [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/82/Robot-Animation-Pack Robot Animation Package], and [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/48/Elder-Animation-Package Elder Animation Package] respectively. Coincidentally, the Cartoony Animation Package is the one used by [[Black Bear]], [[Noob Bear]], and [[Bee Bear]]. There used to be a [[Glitches|glitch]] that would make cub buddies "wear" an item if they teleported on top of it, such as the [[Demon Mask]], [[Elite Blue Guard]], and [[Riley Guard]]. This could also happen if the owner died/reset on top of the cub buddy. This was because the cub buddy is a Humanoid Model. This [[Glitches|Glitch]] was patched in an unknown update. There is a glitch that causes cub buddies to stay in the game after their owners leave. The cub buddy can still collect any public tokens when it is left in the game, but it doesn't give the rewards to their owner. Cub buddies used to be the most expensive item in the [[Ticket Tent]], costing 2,000 tickets. * The maximum number of characters in a cub buddy name is 16. The name can also be filtered by Roblox. Although a cub buddy can collect any token, either the player's or public, it cannot collect its own gifts it made unless it picks up a Token Link. All of the cub skins except for the Gingerbread Bear, Doodle, Peppermint Robo, and the Gloomy Cub skin are based on their original NPC/mob counterpart. However, the Gingerbread cub skin looks like a bigger and more elaborate version of a {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear||4=0}}, and the Peppermint Robo cub is a reskin of the normal Robo cub. The Doodle cub fits the sticker update, and goes with the Doodle Hive skin too. Bee Bear has stated that a Snow Cub’s favorite treat is [[Egg|Basic Eggs]]. Cub buddies are affected by the player's [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] stacks. * The Robo Cub skin is the first of 3 skins to have 2 ways to be obtained, the other two being the Stick Cub and Star Cub, added in the same update. ** It is also the first skin to have 3 ways of obtainment. The Peppermint Robo Cub next to Bee Bear is the only NPC that does an emote originating from the Roblox catalog. The emote it does is the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/3576721660/Robot Robot]. *Rarely, a special gift will be made, always consisting of {{Cost|Tropical Drink|1}}, {{Cost|Enzymes|1}}, {{Cost|Red Extract|1}}, {{Cost|Blue Extract|1}}, and {{Cost|Oil|1}}.

docs.title: Cub Console
docs.text:
The '''Cub Console''' is a menu that can be found in the [[System Page]] and accessed by clicking on the green Cub Console button, under the options menu. It is where the player is able to customize and check their [[Cub Buddy]]. In the Cub Console, the player can equip or unequip their Cub Buddy, change its changeable stats, and view its unchangeable stats.[[File:Cub_Console_New_(Sticker_Update).png|thumb|293x293px|The Cub Console.]]

If the player has a Cub Buddy, they may rename it by clicking on the "Name" window, typing in the desired name, and pressing enter. Cub Buddies age depending on how long it has been equipped while the player is in-game. If it is at the age of newborn, that means that it has been equipped for less than an hour. Once it has been equipped for more than one hour, the Cub Console will measure its age in hours. Once it has been equipped for more than 24 hours, the Cub Console will measure its age in days and hours. Once it has been equipped for more than 3 days, the Cub Console will no longer measure its age in hours. Instead, the Cub Console will solely measure its age in weeks and days. Once it has been equipped for more than 4 weeks, the Cub Console will measure its age in months and weeks.

In the Cub Console, it shows the available [[Cub Buddy]] Skins they own. To equip it, you'll have to open your Inventory, click on [[Sticker Book]] at the top, and if you have a Cub Buddy skin isn't in your Inbox, you'll be able to drag the cub buddy skin from a slot to your hive. Doing this puts a sticker on your hive but also equips the Cub Buddy skin. Skins only change the appearance of the Cub Buddy and will not alter its stats nor provide any benefits. Some skins can be obtained year-round, and some are limited and cannot be obtained after a specific deadline. Each skin looks unique, and some even represent a different [[Bears|bear]] in-game. [[Cub Buddy|There are currently 12 skins in the game]]. [[Category:System]]

docs.title: Daily Fastest Crab Slayers
docs.text:
The '''Daily Fastest Crab Slayers''' is one of the {{WikiVariables|LeaderboardCount}} [[leaderboards]] in the game, and is only viewable via the Global Leaderboards menu in the [[System Page]]. This leaderboard shows players' fastest time to defeat the [[Coconut Crab]] on that day. It shows 10 leaderboard positions at a time. The player can scroll down the leaderboard to see more players, all the way to the 100th place. It resets every day at 12:00 AM CST.

==Prizes== If the player has reached the top 5 by the end of the day, they will be awarded the {{Cost|Cyan Hilted Sword Sticker|4=0}}.

If the player has reached the top 100 by the end of the day, they will be awarded with {{Cost|Ticket|25}}.

==Trivia== *The leaderboard has a glitch where the leaderboard inputs the players' best recorded time of slaying the crab even if your kill on the Coconut Crab is lower than your best. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Leaderboards]]

docs.title: Dandelion Field
docs.text:
{{Field |image = DandelionField2.png |fieldcolor = White |bees = None |width = 36 |height = 18 }}The '''Dandelion Field''' is one of the five [[Starter Zone|starting]] [[fields]] any player is able to visit upon starting the game. There are no [[mobs]] that protect this field.

This is an 18x36 field, containing 648 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single and double. {| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Red ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |480 |''{{Hover|74.1%|74.07%}}'' |31 |''{{Hover|4.8%|4.78%}}'' |53 |''{{Hover|8.2%|8.17%}}'' |'''564''' |'''''{{Hover|87%|87.04%}}''''' |- !Double |69 |''{{Hover|10.6%|10.64%}}'' |5 |''{{Hover|0.8%|0.77%}}'' |10 |''{{Hover|1.5%|1.54%}}'' |'''84''' |'''''{{Hover|12.9%|12.96%}}''''' |- !Triple |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |'''0''' |'''''0%''''' |- !Total |'''549''' |'''''{{Hover|84.7%|84.72%}}''''' |'''36''' |'''''{{Hover|5.6%|5.56%}}''''' |'''63''' |'''''{{Hover|9.7%|9.72%}}''''' |'''648''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can produce [[honey]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|red boost]], blue boost, [[ticket]], [[glue]], [[glitter]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], and [[treat]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

Bees that like the Dandelion Field are [[Baby Bee]], [[Bomber Bee]], [[Demo Bee]], [[Exhausted Bee]], [[Music Bee]], [[Stubborn Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Fuzzy Bee]], and [[Digital Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Dandelion Field are [[Commander Bee]], [[Brave Bee]], and [[Vicious Bee]].

This field gives Comforting [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is placed here.

A level 1-5 [[Wild Windy Bee]] can spawn here.

== Obtaining Boosts == Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a Dandelion [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +300% Dandelion Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] in the field will add 100% Dandelion Field pollen onto the current boost if it isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100%-300% Dandelion Field pollen for 15 minutes based on the dice used if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Dandelion [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of 20% instant Dandelion Field conversion and give +5% instant Dandelion Field conversion and +25% Dandelion Field pollen for each stack. Dandelion Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. Redeeming certain valid codes: Jumpstart (Activates Dandelion Field Code Buff + other stuff). PlushFriday (Gives Dandelion Field Code Buff + other stuff). *It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Dandelion Field Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

Giving [[present]]s to certain [[Quest Givers|NPCs]]: [[Mother Bear]] gave Dandelion Field Boost x5 and other [[items]]. [[Onett]] gave Dandelion Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. Mother Bear gave x3 Dandelion Field Boost and other items. Redeeming certain expired codes: AccentMaster (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x1 + other stuff). Sure (Gives Dandelion Field Boost x3 + other stuff). Wink (Gives Dandelion Field Boost x7 + other stuff). Afternoon (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x5 + other stuff). NikTacAttack (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x5 + other stuff). Noobasha+ (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x6 + other stuff). SunBearSendoff (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x6 + other stuff). Waiting (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x6 + other stuff). SDMittens1T (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x3 + other stuff). Crafty (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x4 + other stuff). RebootCode (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** Breeze (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x3 + other stuff). TornadoGlitch (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x3 and Dandelion Field Winds x3 + other stuff). WindyWeekend (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x1 and Dandelion Field Winds x3 + other stuff). ** BeesmasBegins (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x3 and Dandelion Field Winds x6 + other stuff). FestiveFinale (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x3 and Dandelion Field Winds x4 + other stuff). SpaceReboot (Gave Dandelion Field Boost x3 and Dandelion Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). RebootFriday (Gave Dandelion Field Code Buff + other stuff). *Purchasing a Dandelion Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] gave 1.25x Dandelion Field Pollen along with x1.5 Dandelion [[Field Capacity]], +10% [[System Page#Bee Ability Rate|Bee Ability Rate]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]].

==Gallery== RoyalJellyLocation TopofDandelion.png|The royal jelly on top of the tallest dandelion. DandelionFieldA FarAbove.png|The {{PAGENAME}} from above. DandelionFieldTheGames.png|The {{PAGENAME}} during [[The Games]]. Dandelion Field Icon.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. Hivesticker dandelion field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]]. Hivesticker small dandelion.png|The Small Dandelion sticker.

==Trivia== Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the Dandelion Field was the only field that was mob-proof, meaning no mobs could spawn/attack there. There is a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] token on top of the tallest dandelion which can be obtained by using the [[Parachute]]/[[Glider]] with cannons or from a high place. This is also the only dandelion in the field that has collision at its top. The [[Bubble Wand]] model on the [[Blue HQ]] can grow a face and blow [[sparkles]] onto this field, along with the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Clover Field]], and [[Blue Flower Field]]. The [[All-Time Top Honeymakers|All-Time Top Honeymakers Leaderboard]] is adjacent to the Dandelion Field. There used to be a [[Glitches|glitch]] where [[Stick Bug]] could fall from the tallest mushroom and land in the Dandelion Field. This has now been patched. During the Ready Player Two event, the field can be seen glitching after using [[the Computer|the computer]]. *[[Onett]] threatens to remove every field but the Dandelion Field if the [[bees]] and [[bears]] don't stop complaining in his Star Journey 2 quest dialogue. He then follows this up stating he wouldn't really do this though.

docs.title: Dapper Bear's Shop
docs.text:
{{Stores |title1 = Dapper Bear's Shop |image1 = DapperBearsShop.png |row1 = Past the Brave Bee Gate, near the Stump Field. |caption1 = The exterior of Dapper Bear's shop. }} '''Dapper Bear's Shop''' is a shop located behind the Brave Bee Gate. There are lower platforms the player is able to jump to in order to access the shop. The shop sells reusable [[Planter]]s and 6 beequips, with the 3rd, 4th, 5th, and 6th beequips requiring you to complete a certain number of [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] Quests in order to unlock them. You also have to pay honey and tickets for each beequip with the amounts scaling from the quality of the beequip. This is also where [[Dapper Bear]] is located.

The Beequips that can be purchased in the shop include: {| class="article-table" |- |{{Cost|Bandage|||0}}{{Cost|Thumbtack|||0}}{{Cost|Smiley Sticker|||0}}{{Cost|Bottle Cap|||0}}{{Cost|Beret|||0}}{{Cost|Thimble|||0}}{{Cost|Camo Bandana|||0}}{{Cost|Charm Bracelet|||0}}{{Cost|Paperclip|||0}}{{Cost|Bang Snap|||0}}{{Cost|Pink Eraser|||0}}{{Cost|Whistle|||0}}{{Cost|Bead Lizard|||0}}{{Cost|Kazoo|||0}}{{Cost|Camphor Lip Balm|||0}}{{Cost|Candy Ring|||0}}{{Cost|Rose Headband|||0}}{{Cost|Demon Talisman|||0}}{{Cost|Autumn Sunhat|||0}} |} When buying a beequip with a potential of half, it will either round up or round down after purchase.

To enter Dapper Bear's Shop, the player must wear the [[Propeller Hat]] and the [[Hiking Boots]] or better. If the player wears something "lower" than the propeller hat (the Helmet, Strange Goggles, BBM Mask, Mondo BBM Mask) and hiking boots (Basic Boots) and tries to enter the shop, a prompt will say: "You Must Wear a Nice Hat and Cool Boots to enter Dapper Bear's Shop."

The shop has a tan interior with a blue floor and ceiling, as well as two windows in the front. Above the entrance is an image of a Beequip Case. On the left side of the interior, there is the Beequip shop and the [[Highest Damage to a Single Puffshroom]] leaderboard. On the right side of the shop is the Planter shop.

The roof of the shop has a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} token, 25 {{Cost|Honeysuckle}}, and 3 {{Cost|Smooth Dice}}. During [[Beesmas]] 2021 and 2022, Dapper Bear's [[Samovar]] is located next to the shop entrance. In Beesmas 2021, the [[Gift Boxes#2021|Mythic Gift Box]] (12th present) was located on the roof. During Beesmas 2022, the [[Gift Boxes#2022|Shimmering Gift Box]] (5th present) was located to the right of the shop entrance. The shop has an [[Obstacle Courses#Dapper Bear's Shop Obby|obstacle course]] on the right side of the shop that leads up to the roof. It splits up into two paths: a rocky wall and a moon obby. The rocky wall allows access the roof, where a royal jelly and a honeysuckle token are hidden. The moon obby leads to a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} on a platform behind the shop (in order for the platforms to appear, it is necessary to have a [[Moon Amulet]] while at [[Day/Night Cycle|night time]] that isn't the night the player obtained the Moon Amulet). It is also possible to bypass the obby by using a [[Glider]].

==Trivia == This shop and [[Robo Bear's Shop]] are the only shops where the Bear NPC owner can talk to you. This is the only shop where you need to equip a certain hat and boots to access (Propeller Hat and Hiking Boots or something "higher" than them). This shop, [[Robo Bear's Shop|Robo Bear’s Shop]], [[Ticket Tent]] and the [[Coconut Cave]] are the only shops where the music that is playing isn't "[[Music|vendor]]". Unlike the other two, Dapper Bear’s Shop has its own music. * Using the [[Hiking Boots]] can help with completing the obby. The jump power is low enough to not bump into the roof, but high enough to be able to grab the [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|Star Jelly]] at the end. A [[Glider]] is also recommended. There used be a [[Beequip Storage]] case to Dapper Bear's left, but it was moved to the spawn. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Shops]] [[Category:Locations]]

{{Bear|image =DapperBearHD.png |type = Quest Bear |location = [[Dapper Bear’s Shop]] |bees = 10 |basecoloramount=#92735e |basecolor1 =#92735e |shadecoloramount =#947a5f |shadecolor1 =#947a5f |snoutcoloramount =#282623 |snoutcolor1 =#3e3835 |snoutcolor2 =#282623 |torsocolor1 =#8f4e3e |torsocoloramount =#8f4e3e |armscolor =#2b344c |legscolor =#555653 |enableother = no |basecolor2 = #5d5e5b}} '''Dapper Bear''' is a [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]], and one of the eight permanent quest [[Bears]] that can be accessed in the game, the others being [[Black Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], [[Science Bear]], [[Polar Bear]] and [[Spirit Bear]]. Dapper Bear is located inside his [[Dapper Bear’s Shop|shop]] next to [[Stump Field]].

Inside Dapper Bear's shop, he sells many different [[planter]]s ranging from{{Cost|Honey|750K-100T}} (alongside [[crafting]] materials). He also sells many different types of [[Beequip]]s for {{Cost|Honey}} and {{Cost|Ticket}}, with some being locked behind a certain amount of Dapper Bear Quests completed.

After speaking with him, Dapper Bear rewards the player {{Cost|Ticket Planter|3}} and a {{Cost|Beequip Case|||0}} (if the player does not already have one).

==Requirements== You need the following Accessories to enter Dapper Bear's shop, those being the [[Hiking Boots]] and the [[Propeller Hat]]. Players can also use gear that is better than the ones previously listed.

==Quests== Dapper Bear currently has 16 Quests. His 15 main quests focus on collecting nectar, collecting tokens from planters, and popping [[Puffshroom|Puffshrooms]], and the one quest is for obtaining the {{Cost|Blue Drive|4=1}} in order to repair [[Robo Bear]].

His 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, 12th and 14th Quest rewards an additional {{Cost|Beequip Case|||0}} slot. If you received {{Cost|Beequip Case|||0}} slots from Bee Bear previously, you will instead be rewarded one {{Cost|Ticket Planter}} until you catch up to the amount of additional slots a new player would have.

==Dialogue== Currently, Dapper Bear has 15 quests that were added in [[Beesmas|Beesmas 2022]]. However, more quests for him will be added upon further updates. Upon interacting with him, he will first give dialogue explaining [[Planter|Planters]] and a reward of {{Cost|Ticket Planter|||}}. Since the Beesmas 2022 update, a questline has been given to him. Dapper Bear gives plenty of information in his dialogues. Some of the information he gives is not found anywhere else in the game.

===Main Quests=== {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Source !Dialogue |- |First interaction |Hi, I like your hat, and your boots too. I guess you could call me snooty, but that's the only reason you got in. Appearances are everything, and our attire is more than skin deep. I take pride in how I present myself and my shop, in my own way. So much pride that you could call me Dapper Bear. I've set up shop here in hopes of meeting creative bears, beekeepers, and bees. Who aren't afraid to be a little bold, in a subtle sort of way... Tending towards an aesthetic sense to unlock our, hm, unique potentials. The mission is a little vague, but it should come together in time. For now, take this: A [Beequip Case]. With this, you can equip Beequips to your bees. Beequips are accessories your bees can wear to improve their stats, and even teach them new abilities. Every bee no matter how small or unassuming has the potential to stand out with the right Beequip. But I'll teach you all about that later. For now, I need to finish setting things up. But if you return throughout the Winter event, I'll have some quests for you. Feel free to take a look at my Planters, I'll teach you more about those later as well. Just know that the gist is, they're as helpful as they are neat looking. Sort of like me, and I'm guessing sort of like you. I'll have another [Beequip Case Slot] for you after this one's done.

''-During-''

There isn't anything very tricky about this quest. It just takes time. A practice in that steadfastness we were talking about, huh. The Epic Puffshrooms are probably the hardest part. There are strategies, though, that make getting them easier. Consider farming Puffshrooms in the 15 bee zone, with a few friends. One of you standing on each field. Those fields are close to each other. That reduces the time it takes for the spores to hop fields, increasing the number of Puffshrooms. But ultimately, it all comes down to chance.

''-Completion-''

Nice job out there. Stick Bug is pretty cool too, huh? Say, have you noticed with Puffshrooms that the loot seems to decrease the more your ''[sic]'' do them? That's because there are daily cooldowns to their rewards. Basically, the more loot you get in a day, the less likely that same loot becomes. But it all resets around midnight CST. Just something to keep in mind. Thanks for the help. With all that complete, I've got another [Beequip Case Slot] for you. And after the next quest that [Mythic Egg] should be ready too. |- |More Than Myth |Just about ready to expand my shop again. We're making incredible progress. So after this next quest, I'll reward you a [Mythic Egg]. I don't know too much about bees, but I do know Mythic Bees are in a league of their own. I mean, they're so special we call them the "myths". As if the legends of their powers are so unbelievable, we can't even be sure if they're real or not. When of course, they are. I see them all the time. So that's just some next level hyperbole. In any case, it wasn't easy getting my hands on this thing. So this next quest is going to require a bit of work. Like I said before, every 5th quest of mine is harder. That's because the bigger my shop gets, the harder it gets to stay inspired. Or maybe I just want to keep you around as long as possible. Wouldn't that be nice?

''-During-''

Here's some tips, in case the dice are giving you problems: The [Tacky Planter] is a reliable source for [Field Dice]. The first time you fully grow it, about once every day, it should give at least 3. And any Planter in the Dandelion Field has a higher chance for [Field Dice] as well. Oh, and if you're wondering what Meteors are... Those are spawned by Mythic Meteor Showers, which require 3 Mythic Bees discovered to activate. Catching a Meteor has a chance to grant a [Moon Charm]. You might need someone else's help for that. Good luck out there. The [Mythic Egg] is almost yours.

''-Completion-''

Oh, hey. Didn't expect you back so fast. Guess I should know by now nothing slows your bees down for long. With all that work done, I can expand my shop to offer 5 Beequips at once. And as a reward, I've got a plenty to give you. Including this [Mythic Egg]. You know, while you were out there, I was thinking I may want to pivot, take the boutique in a different direction. Source some new products. Watching you complete quests is inspiring for sure, but I need to get out there myself a bit. And more practically: I need to collect more things to reward you with. In any case, you deserve a rest. Can't thank you enough. Check in with you soon. |- |Conclusion | I'm still setting up shop, but I'll have a lot more I want to talk with you about soon. For now, getting yourself aquainted with Beequips and Planters ought to be helpful. Here are a few pointers that ought to get you started: *Each Planter type is likely to give you a special reward the first time you harvest it, every once in a while * If you use [Glitter] on a field with a Planter, the Planter will grow 25% faster until you harvest it[.] This lasts even after the field boost wears off. * Different types of Planters may give different rewards based on the Field you place them on.

Feel free to browse my selection of Planters. I'll check in with you soon. |- |Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2021 |(TBA) |- |Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2022 |Somehow I knew you'd get something for me this year. We're on the same page. I've been thinking about you too. I'll go ahead and open my gift now. ...(krumple krumple)... Ah hah, a funky little Bumble Bee pin for my lapel! I don't usually like accessories as gifts - I prefer to pick my own But this one hit's ''[sic]'' the right spot. Thank you! Now why don't you open mine? There's a few things in there: A [Ticket Planter], a vial of [Motivating Nectar]...And the [Potpourri Ornament]. It's filled with flowers and leaves I grew in my Planters. The fragrance is pretty strong... but hey, smells like Beesmas. With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Dandelion Field And +5% Nectar. Hope you like it. I know I'll be flaunting this pin around for weeks. Thanks again, and Happy Honeydays. |} [[File:HI.png|thumb|Dapper Bear along with Basic Bee, Precise Bee, and Buoyant Bee in a previous game thumbnail.]]

==={{Cost|Blue Drive|||0}} Quest=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" !Source !Dialogue

|- |Barter For The Blue Drive |Hey there. What's that? Oh, a [White Drive]? What a coincidence. I've got a [Blue Drive] just like it. Picked it up at an electronics shop in Akihabara a few years back. I suppose I could give it to you... If you're willing to give a little back. I'm a business man after all, and that [Blue Drive] wasn't cheap. So why not partake in some of my Beequips? And while you're at it, help me harvest some Puffshrooms. That is, only if you reallly want this [Blue Drive]. Cause I'll be honest, from the rumors I've heard... I'm not so sure you're ready for it any how. ''-During-''

N/A

''-Completion-''

Well if it wasn't my most loyal customer. Heh. As a token of appreciation for your recent purchases... The [Blue Drive] is all yours! When i bought this thing, the shopkeep tried to tell me something. My Japanese isn't great, but I think it was, hm, a warning or something. Basically, the Robot Bear is only for the most advanced beekeepers. So even if you manage to repair it, you might not get much out of it. At least not for a while. But it can't hurt to try, right? |}

==Beesmas Quest: Dapper Bear's Samovar== Completing the quest would grant the player access to Dapper Bear's [[Samovar]]. {{Tabber |2024 (Winter)|{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Requirements ! Rewards {{!}}- {{!}} * Collect 50,000,000 Blue [[Pollen]]. * Collect 12 Hours of [[Nectar]] * Collect 4 Hours of Refreshing Nectar. * Collect 25 Tokens from [[Planter]]s in the [[Pineapple Patch]]. * Collect 25 Tokens from Planters in the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. * Collect 25 Tokens from [[Plastic Planter]]s * Obtain 5 Random Leaf [[Sticker]]s (except Blowing, Oblique and Reniform) to give to Dapper Bear. {{!}} * 200,000,000 [[Honey]] * 1 [[Ticket Planter]] * 3 [[Smooth Dice]] * 1 [[Swirled Wax]] * 25 [[Snowflake]]s {{!}}} {{{!}}class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} ''- Accepting -'' Unknown

''- During -'' N/A

''- Completion -'' Unknown {{!}}} |2024 (Summer)|{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Requirements ! Rewards {{!}}- {{!}} * Collect 2,500,000 [[Pollen{{!}}Blue Pollen]]. * Collect 2,000,000 Pollen from the [[Cactus Field]]. * Collect 4 Hours of [[Nectar{{!}}Satisfying Nectar]]. * Collect 100 Tokens from [[Planter{{!}}Planters]]. * Obtain 4 Yellow Coffee Mug [[Sticker{{!}}Stickers]] to give to Dapper Bear. * Obtain 3 Cordate Leaf Stickers, 3 Hastate Leaf Stickers, OR 3 Lanceolate Leaf Stickers to give to Dapper Bear. * Obtain 1 Spore Covered Puffshroom Sticker to give to Dapper Bear. {{!}}10,000,000 Honey1x [[Ticket Planter]]1x [[Satisfying Vial]]1x [[Elf Cap]]10x [[Soft Wax]]5x [[Whirligig{{!}}Whirligigs]]25x [[Snowflake{{!}}Snowflakes]] {{!}}} {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}}It's unnaturally cold for this time of year. Thankfully I've got this snazzy coat. As well insulated as it is stylish. And I keep the temperature nice and cozy in my shop no matter what. But you and your bees must be freezing out there in the fields. Bet you'd like some nice warm Nectar, huh? Well, if you help me polish up my Samovar, there'll be plenty to go around. A Samovar is a traditional device originating from Russia usually used for tea. But I like to use it for warming Nectar, and to reconstitute dried [Honeysuckles]. Help me complete this quest, and I'll let you use it free of charge. Well, apart from the Stickers I'll need you to get. Those will be your fee, heh.

''-During-''

N/A

''-Completion-''

That was quicker than I expected! You must be thirsty. Well, let's go ahead and polish the Samovar right up. ...(scrub scrub)... Mmhmm, shiny! A Diamond Bee in the rough. As pretty as the day I thrifted it. Now that it's ready, you can use the Samovar once every 6 hours for some Nectar, [Honeysuckles], and other rewards ''[sic]'' The nectar you get will always be a random type, and starts at 1 hour. Each time you use it, the amount of Nectar goes up by 5 minutes (up to 4 hours). As the Samovar's brew gets stronger, you'll also get more [Honeysuckles]. Use it enough and you might be surprised how much joy it can bring you. I hope it keeps you warm out there while you're grinding away in the snow. Happy Honeydays! Check in with you soon. {{!}}} | 2022|{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Requirements ! Rewards {{!}}- {{!}} * Collect 1,000,000 [[Pollen{{!}}Blue Pollen]]. * Collect 2 Hours of [[Nectar]]. * Collect 25 Tokens from [[Planter]]s. * Pop 1 [[Puffshroom{{!}}Rare Puffshroom]]. {{!}}{{Cost|Honey|2,000,000}}{{Cost|Blue Drive|1}}{{Cost|Ticket Planter|1}}{{Cost|Motivating Vial|1}}{{Cost|Smooth Dice|3}}{{Cost|Snowflake|25}} {{!}}} {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}}Beesmas again, already? Boy, does time fly. Guess it's time to bring out my favorite winter treat... That dull looking thing out there is actually a Samovar. With a bit of polishing up, it'll dish out potent spiced Nectar. Perfect for winter. And I know you beekeepers love Nectar. Nectar provides hefty boosts to the pollen collection of your swarm. I'm a little busy at the moment though, gotta man the shop. Think you and your bees could clean it up for me? If so, I'll make it worth your while. You see, I've heard through the grapevine that a strange robot has appeared near the Rose Field. Don't get over there much myself. Well, I have something I think you could use to get that robot working. It's a [Blue Drive] I picked up at an electronics shop in Akihabara years back. If you get the Samovar working, the [Drive] is all yours. Collect 1,000,000 Blue Pollen... Collect 2 hours of Nectar... Collect 25 Tokens from Planters... And pop 1 Rare Puffshroom.

''-During-''

N/A

''-Completion-''

That was fast! Guess you really want that [Drive]. Let me tell you though, that [Drives] got nothing on this Samovar. ...(scrub scrub)... Mmhmm. See, a Diamond Bee in the rough. As pretty as the day I thrifted it. Now that it's ready, you can use the Samovar once every 6 hours for some Nectar, Honeysuckles, and other rewards ''[sic]'' The nectar you get will always be a random type, and starts at 1 hour. Each time you use it over the Winter event, the amount of Nectar goes up by 5 minutes (up to 4 hours). As the Samovar's brew gets stronger, you'll also get more Honeysuckles. Use it enough and you might be surprised how much joy it can bring you. And as I promised, here's your [Blue Drive]. As for the other 3 drives, well, your guess is as good as mine. But if I had to guess, I'd say Science Bear might know more. Maybe that's just me profiling. Well, whatever. I hope you enjoy the Samovar, and savor this time of year. Happy honeydays! Stay warm out there. {{!}}} |2021|{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Requirements ! Rewards {{!}}- {{!}} * Collect 500,000 [[Pollen{{!}}Blue Pollen]]. * Collect 300,000 [[Pollen]] from the [[Rose Field]]. * Collect 300,000 [[Pollen]] from the [[Cactus Field]]. * Collect 300,000 [[Pollen]] from the [[Clover Field]]. * Collect 15 Tokens from [[Paper Planter]]. * Collect 20 Tokens from [[Plastic Planter]]. * Collect 2 Hours of [[Nectar{{!}}Comforting Nectar]] from [[Planter]]s. * Collect 2 Hours of [[Nectar{{!}}Satisfying Nectar]] from [[Planter]]s. * Collect 2 Hours of [[Nectar{{!}}Refreshing Nectar]] from [[Planter]]s. * Collect 2 Hours of [[Nectar{{!}}Invigorating Nectar]] from [[Planter]]s. * Collect 2 Hours of [[Nectar{{!}}Motivating Nectar]] from [[Planter]]s. {{!}}{{Cost|Honey|2,000,000}}{{Cost|Ticket|3}}{{Cost|Ticket Planter|1}}{{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1}}{{Cost|Swirled Wax|1}}{{Cost|Smooth Dice|1}}{{Cost|Honeysuckle|3}}{{Cost|Single Mitten|1}} {{!}}} {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} So as you can probably tell, I'm still setting this place up. But I'd like to participate too. In the Beesmas festivities. You'd welcome me in, right? Couldn't turn a stranger away on a honeyday. Heh. Well, what if I had something to share? Something that'll warm you up right up straight down to your bones. This is a Samovar. A bit derelict, not unlike some of you beekeepers I see trotting around. But with a little TLC, we can use it to brew up some potent spiced Nectar. Perfect for winter. Nectar is absolutely essential for collecting pollen fast, and of course for making honey. And this Samovar is a perfect supplmental source for Nectar of all types. I can tell you're intrigued. I was too on my first trip to Tula. If you and your bees help me gather some pollen and Nectar, I'll play host and heat it up for us.

''-During-''

N/A

''-Completion-''

Nice to see you didn't come back empty handed. That's all I'll need to polish this thing up. ...(scrub scrub).. Mmhmm. See, a Diamond Bee in the rough. I lugged this antique Samovar in my carry-on on my way back from Moscow. Had to leave a few Beequips behind to make room. Worth it though. You can use the Samovar once every 6 hours for some Nectar, Honeysuckles, and other rewards. The Nectar you get will always be a random type, and starts at 1 hour. Each time you use it over the Winter event, the amount of Nectar goes up by 5 minutes (up to a 4 hours). As the Samovar's brew gets stronger, you'll also get more Honeysuckles. Use it enough and you might be surprised how much joy it can bring you. Just don't drink it too fast - pace yourself. Samovar is something you're supposed to savor, I've heard. Oh, and if you aren't familiar with Honeysuckles... Honeysuckles cause half of your bees to instantly convert pollen from your bag when your bag becomes full. This can help you stay on the field longer before having to return to the hive. To use them, you can toggle them on in your Egg Menu. I'll give you a few to try out. Well, thank you for including me in this year's Beesmas fun. I'll have more quests for you over the coming weeks. Happy Honeydays! Stay warm out there. {{!}}} }}

== Trivia== Despite Dapper Bear's appearance, he is male. Dapper Bear is shorter than every other bear in the game. This is referenced in his dialogue and is a key detail in the {{Cost|Tacky Planter|||}} chain that rewards the {{Cost|Dapper From Above Sticker|4=0}}. Dapper Bear, [[Gummy Bear]], [[Tunnel Bear]], [[Noob Bear]], [[Pro Bear]], [[Top Bear]], and [[Shadow Bear]] are the only bears to reside indoors. ** Dapper Bear and Gummy Bear are the only quest bears to reside indoors. Dapper Bear is the only permanent quest bear to reside indoors. This bear, [[Gummy Bear]], [[Robo Bear]] and [[Bee Bear]] are the only bears to own a [[:Category:Shops|shop]]. This bear and [[Bee Bear]] are the only quest bears to own a [[:Category:Shops|shop]]. This bear and [[Robo Bear]] are the only permanent bears to own a [[:Category:Shops|shop]]. Dapper Bear is also the only permanent quest bear to own a shop. Like [[Mother Bear]], Dapper Bear uses the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/83/Stylish-Animation-Pack Stylish Animation Pack]. Like Mother Bear and [[Gummy Bee]], Dapper Bear's face emits light. This is most noticeable if the player looks at Dapper Bear at [[Day/Night Cycle|night]]. He is the only permanent quest giver whose first quest was a seasonal one. * Dapper Bear may have a possible Russian background. When the player completes his [[Samovar]] quest (the Samovar is also of Russian origins), Dapper Bear mentions that he made room for some beequips and the Samovar on his travel back to Moscow. * In Beesmas Winter 2024, one of the requirements for his samovar quest was “Collect 25 tokens from planters in the Pineapple Patch” However, it was broken and no tokens collected in Pineapple Patch would count towards the quest. This was later fixed by setting the requirement to finished for all players. * Dapper Bear, [[Sun Bear]], and [[Spirit Bear]] are the only bears to wear 3D accessories. *Of the three, Dapper Bear is the only one to wear accessories that the player can't use. {{QuestNav}} [[Category:Bears]] [[Category:Quest Giver]] [[Category:NPC]]

docs.title: Dark Scythe
docs.text:
{{Tool |image= dark_scythe.png |price= (Needs to have 250 Gifted Riley Bee quests complete) 1,500 Red Extracts, 150 Stingers, 100 Hard Waxes, 50 Caustic Waxes, 50 Super Smoothies, 3 Invigorating Vials, {{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}} |shop= Red HQ |pattern= Crescent |range= 31-36 (Varies depending on the orientation of character) |time= 0.5 |collectbase= 13 |specialmultiplier= ? }}''Not to be confused with the [[Scythe]].''

{{Quote|quote=Harvest flames to unlock their Dark potential. Tend a violent field of violet fire to enhance your Super-Crit power and Red Ability Conversion.}}

The '''Dark Scythe''' is a [[Tools|tool]] that can be crafted in the [[Red HQ]]. The player needs to have completed at least 250 [[Gifted Riley Bee]] quests to unlock it. {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Red Extract|1,500}}{{Cost|Stinger|150}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|100}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|50}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Invigorating Vial|3}} |}

It collects 13 pollen from 35 patches in 0.5 seconds. It has an average base pollen collection rate of 910 pollen per second.

If a [[flame]] gets hit by the Dark Scythe's collection, it will turn it into a [[Flame#Dark Flames|Dark Flame]] and [[Ability Tokens#Flame Fuel|flame fuel]] (if active) is reapplied, as well as its lifespan being reset.

A Dark Flame grants a stack of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Others|Dark Heat]], which grants +10% Instant Red Ability Conversion and x1.05 Super-Crit Power (or +5% Super-Crit Power), with each additional Dark Flame granting +5% Super-Crit Power and +1% Instant Red Ability Conversion. An active Dark Flame always gives the player a stack of dark heat whether they are touching the flame or not.

Touching a Dark Flame grants 33% more growth to [[Passive Abilities#Scorching Star|Scorching Stars]] than normal flames. Dark Flames also deal 50% more damage than regular flames.

==Gallery== Hivesticker dark scythe.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. Dark Scythe In Shop.png|The Dark Scythe in the Red HQ shop. DarkHeat.png|Dark Heat Buff. File:Dark scythe animation.gif|Dark Scythe's trail when scooping. DarkFlame.jpg|A Dark Flame. File:DarkFlameHeat foto took Mati.png|Dark Flame Heat icon in the game. ==Trivia== The Dark Scythe's blue counterpart is the [[Tide Popper]], and its white counterpart is the [[Gummyballer]]. The Dark Scythe's scooping trail can pop [[bubble]]s. If the player's backpack is full and scooped their Dark Scythe while in a field, it will prompt the full backpack message three times. This is the only red collector that doesn't multiply the amount of red pollen collected. This is the same case as [[Tide Popper]]. This is tied with the Tide Popper for being the fifth most expensive item in the game, both having a cost of {{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}} Honey. In front of the Dark Scythe and Tide Popper is the [[Petal Planter]], costing {{Hover|5T|5,000,000,000,000}} Honey, Coconut Belt costing 7.5T Honey, the Gummyballer, costing {{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}} Honey, and [[The Planter Of Plenty]], costing {{Hover|100T|100,000,000,000,000}} Honey. If the ingredients for the item were to be crafted using the [[blender]], a total of {{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}}}}, {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|3}}, {{Cost|Strawberry|322,500}}, 247,500 [[Blueberry|Blueberries]], 82,500 [[Sunflower Seed]]s, 421,750 [[Pineapple]]s, 5,250 [[Honeysuckle]]s, 11,550 [[Bitterberry|Bitterberries]], 1700 [[Neonberry|Neonberries]], 150 [[Stinger]]s, 3,000 [[Coconut]]s, and 374,850 [[Royal Jelly|Royal Jellies]] are needed to craft the Dark Scythe. On December 28, 2021, there was an exploit that could have been used to obtain the Dark Scythe, as well as Tide Popper and Gummyballer for free. This was later patched by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]], and everybody who used the exploit got a full reset on their account. * There was a glitch allowing players to buy the Dark Scythe without completing 250 [[Gifted Riley Bee]] quests. If the Dark Scythe was bought without doing 250 [[Gifted Riley Bee]] quests, the player could only equip the item after doing 250 [[Gifted Riley Bee]] quests. This was also the case with the Tide Popper. This seems to be a better version of the [[Scythe]]. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Crafted]] [[Category:Red]]

docs.title: Day/Night Cycle
docs.text:
The '''Day/Night Cycle''' is a feature added in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]]. Before the update, it was always daytime.

==Day== [[File:RobloxPlayerBeta 2018-09-15 16-34-53.png|thumb|250px|The game during daytime.]] Daytime lasts from around 10 to 30 minutes (for an average of 20 minutes). All [[music]] plays as normal. This is the default setting for the game.

==Night== [[File:RobloxPlayerBeta 2018-09-24 18-02-11.png|thumb|250px|The game during nighttime.]] When the day ends, the sun goes down quickly, and the sky shifts to black, indicating that it is nighttime. During this cycle, all outdoor music is replaced by [[Music#mountaincall|mountaincall]]. Entering any area that plays the [[Music#vendor|vendor]], [[Music#crawlers|crawlers]], [[Music#gbtune1|gbtune1]], [[Music#hibernation1|hibernation1]], [[Music#starhall|starhall]] music or music playing during an [[Ant Challenge|Ant]], [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo]] or [[Stick Bug Challenge]] will override the night music. [[Fireflies]] will also appear, stopping in different [[fields]]. The background of the server and walls will turn pitch black. A [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has a higher chance of spawning every night. A moon sprout also has a 60% chance of spawning every night.

Walking near a firefly will make it fly into the air and leave a 1x1 patch of [[sparkles]]. Once a player has removed all the fireflies, one of the tokens below will appear in the middle of their formation: {{Cost|Moon Charm}} (increments of 1, 5, or 10). {{Cost|Glitter|4=0}} (Very rare). {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} (Extremely rare). {{Cost|Night Bell|4=0}} (Extremely rare). {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} (Exceptionally rare). {{Cost|Waxing Crescent Moon Sticker|||0}} (Rare) {{Cost|Glowing Smile Sticker|||0}} (Extremely Rare) {{I|hivesticker aries star sign}}[[Sticker#Sticker Index|Star Signs]] (Extremely Rare) {{Cost|Cyan Star Sticker|||0}} (Exceptionally Rare) {{Cost|Shining Star Sticker|||0}} (Exceptionally Rare)

Fireflies can only stop in the same field three times. After removing all the fireflies in a field three times, they will fly to a different field. Fireflies will only stop in the [[Rose Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Spider Field]], [[Strawberry Field]] and [[Bamboo Field]].

Night lasts 2 minutes 35 seconds, which is the duration of the night theme (mountaincall). Ever since the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018]] and [[Updates#2018.12.19|12/19/2018]] updates, moon-shaped platforms leading to the [[Diamond Mask]] and the platforms leading to [[Bubble Bee Man]] and the [[Memory Match|Night Memory Match]] are solid yellow only during nighttime if the player has a [[Moon Amulet]] (if the player owns the Diamond Mask, the platforms will be blue and stay permanently solid). When [[sprout|sprouts]] are planted at night, there is a 60% chance for it to be a moon sprout, with the odds of all other sprout types being altered (Supreme Sprouts become more common while the rest are rarer).

==Trivia== If the Stick Bug Challenge ends at night, the normal music will play instead of the night music. If the time cycles from night to day or day to night while a [[Honeystorm]] or [[Mythic Meteor Shower|mythic meteor shower]] is active, the fog will disappear, but the honeystorm or mythic meteor shower will still be active. In some occasions, the nighttime OST doesn't have to end for it to be daytime, it just simply fades. A {{Cost|Night Bell|4=0}} and [[Spirit Bear]] can manually summon nighttime. [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] can also summon nighttime, but does it globally and with a message (ex: "🌙 One of [[Mother Bear]]'s cubs has summoned nighttime... 🌙"). **A full gallery of these messages can be found in the {{Cost|Night Bell|4=0}} page.

docs.title: Debug Wax
docs.text:
{{Unobtainable}} {{Consumables |image=Debug Wax.png |description=100% chance to greatly improve a Beequip.}}{{Color|Debug Wax}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] and a type of [[Waxes|wax]] added in the [[Updates#2024.07.17|7/17/2024]] update that can be used on a [[Beequip]] to boost its stats. Upon usage, it has a 100% chance of greatly improving the Beequip's stats. Debug Wax has an [[Beequip#Stats, Waxes, Chances|Upgrade Value]] of 4.

When applying Debug Wax to a bee's Beequip, a message pops up saying: {{Notification||The Wax improved the Beequip!}} ==Ways to Obtain== There are currently no ways to obtain a {{Cost|Debug Wax|||0}}.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === As a reward for completing [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s quest "B.B.M's Naughty List" during the Winter Beesmas 2024 event. As a reward for completing Bubble Bee Man's quest "B.B.M's Naughty List" during the Summer Beesmas 2024 event.

==Trivia== This is the only wax which is unable to be crafted. This item functions almost the same as a {{Cost|Caustic Wax|||0}}, the only difference being that it always succeeds. This item originally shared its icon with Caustic Wax before the [[Updates|12/25/24]] update. This item originated from the [[Onett's Testing Group|Test Realm]], being a risk-free way to upgrade Beequips, before officially being added to the game. This wax, {{Cost|Soft Wax|||0}}, and {{Cost|Swirled Wax|||0}} are the only waxes guaranteed to change a beequip's stats. {{Items}} [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Waxes]] [[Category:Consumables]] [[Category:Unobtainable]]

docs.title: Demo Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig=Demo_Bee.png |image-gifted=DemoBee Gifted.png |description=An elite Bomber Bee who has worked its way up the ranks. It is an expert in explosives. |rarity=Epic |color=Colorless |energy=20 |speed=16.8 |attack=3 |skincolor1=#1b2a35 |skincolor2=#e5cf38 |skincolor3=#1b2a35 }}'''Demo Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Epic|Epic Bee]].

Demo Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.

{{Quote|quote=Proudly show your extreme wealth to the world. Shine so brightly that others will complain.}}

The '''Diamond Mask''' is a [[:Category:Hats|mask]] and the [[:Category:Blue|blue]] counterpart of the [[Demon Mask]]. It can be reached by finding the doorway near the end of the [[Obstacle Courses#Cloud Obby|Cloud Obby]], then completing yet another obstacle course. The player is able to skip the Cloud Obby by using a [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]] with enough height to steer themselves to the entrance to the [[Obstacle Courses#Diamond Room|Diamond Room]]. Prior to the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]], the player is unable to jump on the moons during the day, similar to the moon platforms in the [[Bear Gate]] and behind [[Dapper Bear's Shop]]. Now, if the player owns the Diamond Mask, the moons in the Diamond Room are permanently solid and shaded a deep blue color.

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|5B|5,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|250}}{{Cost|Oil|150}}{{Cost|Glitter|100}}{{Cost|Diamond Egg|5}}{{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}} |}

Once the 30th blue ability token is collected, the Diamond Mask's passive ability activates with the following sound file: [[File:Ddtune1.ogg]]

==Stats== x1.5 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]] +15% [[System Page#Instant Blue Conversion|Instant Blue Conversion]] * +25% [[Pollen]] x3 [[Capacity]] x1.5 [[Bubble#Bubble Pollen|Bubble Pollen]] +35% [[System Page#Defense|Defense]] +20% [[System Page#Bee Ability Rate|Bee Ability Rate]] [[Passive Abilities#Bubble Bombs|+Passive: Bubble Bombs]] (Requires [[Bubble Mask]] in order to use): Every 25th [[Ability Tokens#Bomb|Bomb Ability Token]] spawns 25 [[Bubble]]s that last for 8 seconds. if a player touches them, they pop, collecting 4R/6W/8B pollen, increased by 15% per [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] blue [[Bees|Bee]] type, from 29 nearby [[Flowers]] and causes them to grow. (Cooldown: 2 minutes) [[Passive Abilities#Diamond Drain|+Passive: Diamond Drain]]: **Every 30th blue [[Ability Tokens|Ability Token]] converts 5 million Pollen plus a percentage of the [[System Page#Convert Total|Convert Amount]] of all of your bees combined, increased by 10% per blue bee and +50% per gifted blue bee type in your [[Hive]]. It also [[Pollination|Pollinates]] 10 (+3 per blue bee) blue flowers within the field. (Cooldown: 45 seconds)

==Gallery== DiamondDrain.png|The Diamond Drain icon. Bubblebomb.png|The Bubble Bombs icon. Diamondmaskicon.png|The Diamond Mask icon. Drain.PNG|An active Diamond Drain. Ddrain2.png|A primed Diamond Drain. DiamondMaskShop.png|Diamond Mask in its shop. Diamond mask.png|Diamond Mask’s old stats. Screen Shot 2019-04-06 at 8.15.45 PM.png|Diamond Mask's stats before 9/28/2019. Diamond Mask stats.png|Diamond Mask's stats after the 9/28/2019 update. Diamondstats.png|Diamond Mask's current stats. File:Diamond mask gassss.png|A player wearing the Diamond Mask. File:Obraz 2023-02-10 014859908.png|The blue moons that appear when the player gets the Diamond Mask (Players need to rejoin the game after buying the mask).

==Trivia== If the ingredients to craft this item were to be crafted, a total of 5,000,000,000 honey, 4,000 [[Royal Jelly|Royal Jellies]], 12,500 [[Blueberry|Blueberries]], 7,500 [[Sunflower Seed]]s, 100 [[Magic Bean]]s, 2,500 Moon Charms, and {{Cost|Diamond Egg|5}} are needed, or 2000 [[Ticket|tickets]] if one decides to purchase all the diamond eggs from the [[Ticket Tent|ticket tent]]. This and the [[Honey Mask]] are the only [[items]] that require [[egg]]s to craft. This mask and the Demon Mask both are the only masks in the game that resemble [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bees]]. The Diamond Mask is based on [[Diamond Bee]] and uses the same face decal as it. When receiving the quest 'Breath of Blue', [[Spirit Bear]] says that Diamond Drain is activated on every 25th [[Ability Tokens|Blue Boost]] token collected, despite it being every 30th blue ability token collected. It is also stated by Spirit Bear that the amount of pollen converted by the ability decreases with each use, though this has not been confirmed. The Diamond Mask shop, the [[Hub Field Shop]] and the [[Demon Mask]] Shop are the only shops in the game that have a total of 1 item. This, the Demon Mask and the Gummy Mask are the only masks with decorative accessories (the Diamond Mask has a tiara). Unlike the Demon Mask and Gummy Mask, the sound effect of its passive is not based on music in the game. This hat gives the most capacity. *This mask, the [[Demon Mask]] and the [[Mondo B.B.M. Mask]] are the only masks that require an obby to equip or reach the shop.

'' Not to be confused with [[Digital Bee]] (the worker bee counterpart).''

'''Digital Bee''' (also known as '''?NULL''', '''0x4C4F4C''', and '''>> ☺''') is an NPC located inside [[The Computer]]. Digital Bee is involved in the [[Ready Player Two]] event, acting as a quest NPC, giving out three puzzles for the player to complete.

The player cannot interact with Digital Bee until they buy, and equip, the [[Strange Goggles]] that can be found in the [[Noob Shop]].

Upon completing puzzle 3, the player can walk into the screen where Digital Bee originally was and claim a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}}. The “[[How to Program BASIC]]” book also takes Digital Bee's place until the player leaves the game.

Its appearance is a computer with a pixelated smiley face (or the symbols it gives). It has an antenna and a body and wings similar to a regular bee.

If done right, a sound will play, and the symbols are replaced with happy faces. |Digital Bee flashes '''?~&'''. Therefore, the right combination to enter in the Dandelion Field is '''''', '''?''', '''~''', and '''&'''. |{{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}}{{Cost|Honey}} |- |Puzzle 2 |After the first puzzle is done, upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will disappear, and begin teleporting around the Sunflower, [[Clover Field|Clover]], and [[Mushroom Field]]. At a field, Digital Bee will continuously flash 3 symbols, '''& ~ '''. Then, you will have to uncover the hidden symbols with your collector and change them into the right sequence. The combination is always:Sunflower = '''&'''Clover = ''''''Mushroom = '''~'''When entered, the symbols will change into happy faces and a sound will play. |The code is the same for everyone, see the guide. |{{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|8}} |- |Puzzle 3 |After the second puzzle is done, upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will flash 4 letters.
