{{Bee |image-orig = Digital Bee.png |image-gifted = DigitalBee Gifted.png |rarity = Event |color = Colorless |energy = 20 |energylabel = less |speed = 11.9 |attack = 1 |skincolor1 = #717779 |skincolor2 = #bab088 |skincolor3 = #e7daaa |description=A virtual bee with malfunctioning AI. It corrupts the game itself.}}

''Not to be confused with Digital Bee's [[Digital Bee (NPC)|NPC]] counterpart from the [[Ready Player Two]] event.''

'''Digital Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] that hatches out of a [[Egg#Event Bee Eggs|Digital Bee egg]], which is available in the [[Robo Bear's Shop]] for {{Cost|Honey|7,777,777}}, {{Cost|Red Drive|5}}, {{Cost|Blue Drive|5}}, {{Cost|White Drive|5}}, and {{Cost|Glitched Drive|5}}. It also requires the player to have the [[Cog Amulet|Diamond Cog Amulet]] to unlock crafting it. If Digital Bee is already owned, {{Cost|Ticket|1000}} will be granted instead.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Digital Bee likes the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Mountain Top Field]], and [[Coconut Field]]. It dislikes the [[Pine Tree Forest]].

==Stats== * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. -15% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +10% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]], up to +1000 Convert Amount, up to +125 Gather Amount, up to +15 Attack, up to +25% Ability Rate 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +1% Ability Duplication Chance ===Abilities=== '''[[Ability Tokens#Glitch|[Glitch]]]''' Corrupts the Field you're in for 20s (+1s per Level), granting collected [[Ability Tokens]] a chance to be duplicated (or "Duped"). Duped Tokens hover over the field for a duration equal to the lifespan of the original Ability Token x2 (+5% per Digital Bee Level). Standing beneath a Duped Token for 1s causes it to activate. Increasing a field's Corruption increases the chance for abilities to be duplicated (8%-20%) and boosts the pollen collection and Instant Conversion of Duped Abilities (x1.1 - x3 Pollen from Duped Abilities, 20%-90% IC from Duped Abilities). Enhancing Digital Bee with Drives causes this ability to grant more Corruption: Colored Drives increase the Corruption of fields with matching flowers while {{Cost|Glitched Drive}} increase the Corruption of all fields. While this is active, Digital Bee will occasionally spawn [[Ability Tokens|☺︎ Tokens]]. Activating a ☺︎ token temporarily increases the field's Corruption, causes all Duped Tokens to be activated, and collects pollen equal to +50% of Digital Bee's gather amount from a random arrangement of flowers, then multiplies the Pollen collected by +50% per Duped Token collected with 50% being instantly converted. The flowers are stamped for 10s, granting them a x2 pollen multiplier. The stamped flowers also come in a "☺", "&", "?", "", or "~" shape. The frequency of ☺︎ tokens increases with the number of {{Cost|Glitched Drive}} Digital Bee has been enhanced with. '''[[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|[Mind Hack]]]''' Hacks the minds of up to 3 nearby enemies (+1 per every 3 lvls), stunning them for 3s (+0.1s per lvl). While hacked, the enemies take 25% more damage (+0.1% per {{Cost|Glitched Drive|||0}} Digital Bee has been enhanced with). Hacking is only half as effective against bosses. If in a field, this also spawns a [[Ability Tokens#☺|☺︎ token]]. '''[[Ability Tokens#Map Corruption|[🌟Gifted Ability: Map Corruption]]]''' Digital Bee corrupts a random field by a small amount for all players for 3 minutes (+15s per lvl). The amount of Corruption is increased by the number of Drives Digital Bee has been enhanced with up to 300 corruption (other players receive 1/3 of the corruption). ** Fields with more flowers matching the color of the most recent colored Drive you've used are more likely to be selected. If your most recent Drive is a Glitched Drive, the field is completely random but gains 25% more Corruption. '''[[Passive Abilities#Drive Expansion|[Passive: Drive Expansion]]]''' Using a Drive while this bee is active in [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]] corrupts the field you're standing in by an amount proportional to the number of flowers that match the Drive's color (Glitched Drives corrupt all fields equally). Additionally, it permanently enhances this bee, increasing the Corruption of its abilities and granting it the following stats: - Red Drive: +0.03 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]] - Blue Drive: +2 [[Stats#Production Amount|Convert Amount]] - White Drive: +0.25 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]] - Glitched Drive: +0.05% [[System Page#Bee Ability Rate|Ability Rate]] Every {{Cost|Glitched Drive|10}} Enhancements also grants a Hive Bonus of +0.03% Ability Duplication Chance. Digital Bee can be enhanced with up to 500 of each type of Drive. You can view the number of enhancements by clicking on Digital Bee's [[Hive Slot|hive slot]]. *Upon maxing out with all 2000 Drives, Digital Bee gains +10 [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]] and grants a Hive Bonus of +0.5% Ability Duplication Chance. {{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 4|honey = 80|honeytime = 4|rarity = event}}

==Trivia== Digital Bee first made its appearance in the [[Ready Player Two]] event. This also makes Digital Bee the first and only bee to make an appearance in the game before being implemented as an actual bee. Digital Bee was available in an old package at the time of its release. It was the only way to obtain the bee other than purchasing it in the Robo Bear Shop. Digital Bee is the only bee that requires an amulet to be unlocked as of right now. It is also the only event bee to require multiple materials to be purchased. Digital Bee's favorite operating system is TempleOS, according to Onett. Digital Bee is currently the most expensive bee that was sold in the Robux Shop, with a price of 2500 Robux. Digital Bee is the only bee that can be upgraded with the use of items, which are Drives. The shapes that Digital Bee makes when collecting a ☺︎ token are the same shapes made by the bee's [[Digital Bee (NPC)|NPC counterpart]] during its field puzzles. Digital Bee is the only event bee that has a passive and gifted ability. It is also the only non-mythic bee to have a gifted ability. Digital Bee is the first and only event bee to have a negative stat, which its Movespeed has a value of 11.9 which is below the normal speed value (14). Digital Bee's ☺ is a reference to an old computer malware called "You are an idiot" aka "youdontknowwhoiam" which overloads your computer's RAM and CPU usage every time you try to close the program; Digital Bee references this behavior with its ability. Digital Bee's gifted form's face resembles the blue screen of death, which is a common problem for Windows computers. Digital Bee is the only event bee other than [[Windy Bee]], [[Gummy Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], and [[Bear Bee]] to have an obtainment method not involving tickets. {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Bees]] [[Category:Event]] [[Category:Colorless]] [[Category:Robo Bear Challenge]] [[zh-tw:數據蜂]]

docs.title: Dispensers
docs.text:
A '''Dispenser''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] whose main purpose is to dispense various [[items]] or boosts to the player typically under a cooldown.

To use a dispenser, simply stand on the pad in front of the dispenser to use it. Some of the dispensers have certain requirements in order to be used such as having enough [[ticket]]s or being a part of the [[Bee Swarm Simulator Club]]. While there are some dispensers that don't directly have any requirements to be used, there are some that have indirect requirements such as the [[Glue Dispenser]] requiring the player have a certain [[Badges|badge]] to access, as the Gummy Bear's Lair requires the player to have [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Hotshot]] or above to enter, or the [[Coconut Dispenser]] needing the player to defeat the [[Coconut Crab]] to gain access to it, similar to the rest of the content in the [[Coconut Cave]] or the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser|Robo Pass Dispenser]] which requires the player to have 30 bees.

== Dispenser Types == There are currently 12 types of dispensers listed below: {{Tabber |Club Dispensers|Club Dispensers are dispensers that require the player to be part of the Bee Swarm Simulator Club in order to use them. They are the:

Blueberry Dispenser Honey Dispenser Strawberry Dispenser Treat Dispenser |Free Dispensers|Free Dispensers are dispensers that the player can use without having to join the Bee Swarm Simulator Club or spend tickets. They are the:

Coconut Dispenser Free Ant Pass Dispenser Free Robo Pass Dispenser Free Royal Jelly Dispenser Glue Dispenser |Ticket Dispenser|Ticket Dispensers are dispensers that require the player to spend tickets to use them. They are the:

Ant Pass Dispenser Robo Pass Dispenser Royal Jelly Dispenser }}

== Gallery == File:Treatdispenser.png|The Treat Dispenser in front of the Pro Shop. File:Honey Dispenser.png|The Honey Dispenser. File:BlueberryDispenser2022.png|The Blueberry Dispenser in the Blue HQ. File:StrawberryDispenserNewLid.png|The Strawberry Dispenser outside of the Red HQ. File:Glue Dispenser.png|The Glue Dispenser in Gummy Bear's Lair. File:Royal Jelly Dispenser-0.png|The Royal Jelly Dispenser next to the Clover Field. File:FreeRoyalJellyDispenser1.png|The option to use the Free Royal Jelly Dispenser. File:TreatDispenser1.png|The rewards from using the Treat Dispenser with 50 bees. File:AntPassDispensers1.png|The Free Ant Pass Dispenser and the Ant Pass Dispenser in the 20 Bee Zone. File:RoboPassDispensers1.png|The Free Robo Pass Dispenser and the Robo Pass Dispenser in the 30 Bee Zone. File:HoneyDispenser2.png|The cooldown timer for attempting to use the Honey Dispenser within an hour of its last usage.

== Trivia ==

  • Of all the machines in the game, dispensers have the most variants, with a total of 12 different types. The [[Honey Dispenser]], the [[Strawberry Dispenser]], the [[Blueberry Dispenser]], the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]], and the Glue Dispenser are the only dispensers that are required to be used for a [[Quests|quest]] ("Honey Bee's Honey Wreath?" from [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] requires the player to use the Honey Dispenser, "BBM's Naughty List" from [[Bubble Bee Man]] requires the player to use the Royal Jelly Ticket Dispenser, and "The Power of Information" from [[Science Bear]] requires the player to use the Strawberry Dispenser, the Blueberry Dispenser, and the Glue Dispenser). There are three dispensers that give [[treats]] in the game being the [[Treat Dispenser]], the Blueberry Dispenser, and the Strawberry Dispenser. The Glue Dispenser, the [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]], [[Ant Pass Dispenser]], [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]], [[Robo Pass Dispenser]], and the Coconut Dispenser are the only dispensers to not grant [[Ability Tokens#Haste|haste]]. The Glue Dispenser, the Free Robo Pass Dispenser, and the [[Free Royal Jelly Dispenser]] are the only dispensers with a 22-hour cooldown, the longest in the game. The Free Ant Pass Dispenser, the Ant Pass Dispenser, the Robo Pass Dispenser, and the Free Robo Pass Dispenser are the only dispensers that don't have any visible faucets, and instead have a small compartment, like a vending machine that gives out tickets. The Glue Dispenser and the Coconut Dispenser are the only dispensers that give more items when the player upgrades the badge that corresponds to it. *The Coconut Dispenser is the only dispenser to give a field boost. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Dispenser]] [[Category:Machines]]

docs.title: Drives
docs.text:
'''Drives''' are inventory items that were introduced in the [[Updates#2022.12.26|12/26/22 update]]. They can be used to repair [[Robo Bear]], purchase [[Digital Bee]], upgrade Digital Bee, and grant boosts during a round of the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. All Drives (except Broken Drives) can be purchased from Robo Bear's Shop for {{Cost|Cog|50}} ({{Cost|Cog|100}} for Glitched, and 5 of each other drive), and an increasing amount of {{Cost|Honey}} with each purchase.

== White Drive == [[File:White Drive.png|thumb|150x150px]] The {{Color|White Drive}}, when used, grants the following boosts during a single round of Robo Bear's Challenge:

  • x1.25 [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]]
  • x1.25 [[System Page#White Field Capacity|White Field Capacity]]
  • +1 [[Bee Attack#Colorless Bee Attack|Colorless Bee Attack]]

=== Ways to Obtain: === * Purchasing it for {{Cost|Cog|50}} and {{Cost|Honey|250,000}} (Honey price increases each time you buy one with an unknown cap) in [[Robo Bear's Shop]]. * Chance to receive from Robo Bear's Challenge. * Completing [[Science Bear]]'s "Repairing The White Drive" quest gives {{Cost|White Drive|1}}, replacing the Broken Drive.

==== Outdated Ways ==== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Purchasing it in Bee Bear's Catalog for {{Cost|Snowflake|222}}. * Purchasing the [[Robux Shop|Digital Bee pack]] for {{Cost|Robux|2500}} granted {{Cost|White Drive|10}} + other stuff. * As a reward for finishing your own [[Robo Party]]. |}

== Red Drive == [[File:Red Drive.png|thumb|150px]] The {{Color|Red Drive}}, when used, grants the following boosts during a single round of Robo Bear's Challenge:

  • x1.25 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]]
  • x1.25 [[System Page#Red Field Capacity|Red Field Capacity]]
  • +1 [[Bee Attack#Red Bee Attack|Red Bee Attack]]

=== Ways to Obtain: === * Purchasing it for {{Cost|Cog|50}} and {{Cost|Honey|1,000,000}} (Honey price increases each time you buy one with an unknown cap) in Robo Bear's Shop. * Chance to receive from Robo Bear's Challenge. * Completing [[Panda Bear]]'s "Ready For The Red Drive?" Quest gives {{Cost|Red Drive|1}} (Requires you to finish [[Science Bear]]'s {{Cost|White Drive|}} quest first)

==== Outdated Ways ==== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Completing [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] 2022 [[Beesmas]] quest. * Purchasing the Digital Bee pack for {{Cost|Robux|2500}} granted {{Cost|Red Drive|10}} + other stuff. * As a reward for finishing your own Robo Party. * Opening the Festive Gift Box rewards {{Cost|Red Drive|5}}. |}

== Blue Drive == [[File:Blue Drive.png|thumb|150px]] The {{Color|Blue Drive}}, when used, grants the following boosts during a single round of Robo Bear's Challenge:

  • x1.25 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]]
  • x1.25 [[System Page#Blue Field Capacity|Blue Field Capacity]]
  • +1 [[Bee Attack#Blue Bee Attack|Blue Bee Attack]]

=== Ways to Obtain: === * Purchasing it for {{Cost|Cog|50}} and {{Cost|Honey|250,000}} (Honey price increases each time you buy one with an unknown cap) in Robo Bear's Shop. * Chance to receive from Robo Bear's Challenge. * Completing [[Dapper Bear]]'s "Barter For The Blue Drive" Quest gives {{Cost|Blue Drive|1}} (Requires you to finish [[Science Bear]]'s White Drive quest first)

==== Outdated Ways ==== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- |* Completing Dapper Bear's 2022 [[Beesmas]] quest. * Purchasing the Digital Bee pack for {{Cost|Robux|2500}} granted {{Cost|Blue Drive|10}} + other stuff. * As a reward for finishing your own Robo Party. |}

== Glitched Drive == [[File:Glitched Drive.png|thumb|150px]] The {{Color|Glitched Drive}}, when used, grants the following boosts during a single round of Robo Bear's Challenge:

  • x1.25 [[Pollen]]
  • x1.25 [[Field Capacity]]
  • +1 [[Bee Attack#Regular Bee Attack|Bee Attack]] === Ways to Obtain: ===
  • Purchasing it for {{Cost|Cog|100}}, {{Cost|Red Drive|5}}, {{Cost|Blue Drive|5}}, {{Cost|White Drive|5}}, and {{Cost|Honey|1,000,000}} (Honey price increases each time you buy one with an unknown cap) in Robo Bear's Shop. It requires a Gold Cog Amulet to unlock the ability of purchasing it.
  • Completing 10 or more rounds of Robo Bear's Challenge has a chance to reward a {{Cost|Glitched Drive|||0}} (Chance increases as the player finished the challenge on a higher round).
  • Completing [[Science Bear]]'s "Corrupting The Glitched Drive" quest gives {{Cost|Glitched Drive|1}} (Requires you to complete [[Science Bear]]'s White Drive quest, [[Dapper Bear]]'s Blue Drive quest, and [[Panda Bear]]'s Red Drive quest).

==== Outdated Ways ==== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 5th 2022 [[Beesmas]] quest. * Purchasing the Digital Bee pack for {{Cost|Robux|2500}} granted {{Cost|Glitched Drive|10}} + other stuff. * Purchasing the Mondo Robo-Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|4500}} grants {{Cost|Glitched Drive|10}} + other stuff. * Purchasing the Glitching Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|111}}. * As a reward for finishing your own Robo Party. * Opening the Mondo Gift Box rewards with {{Cost|Glitched Drive|10}}. |}

== Broken Drive == {{Main|Broken Drive}} [[File:Broken Drive.png|thumb|113px]] The {{Color|Broken Drive}} is a unique drive added in the [[Updates#2023.05.07|2023.05.07 update]] that can be collected only once, from an area behind the [[Robo Pass Dispenser]] and [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]]. Once collected, it initiates Science Bear's drive questline. After completing Science Bear's quest, the Broken Drive will be replaced with a {{Cost|White Drive|||0}}.

==== Ways to Obtain: ==== * Found behind the Robo Pass Dispensers in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]].

== Gallery == Drivers coolio.jpg|Five White Drives, Red Drives, Blue Drives, and Glitched Drives in the inventory. Brokendrivetoken.jpg|A Broken Drive Token. Drives1.png|The Red Drive, White Drive, Blue Drive, and Glitched Drive in Robo Bear's Shop. WhiteDrive1.png|A White Drive along with other items as a reward for completing a quest. GlitchedDrive1.png|A Glitched Drive along with other rewards for getting to at least Round 20 in Robo Bear's Challenge. DigitalBeeDrives1.png|Fifty Red Drives, fifty White Drives, fifty Blue Drives, and twenty-five Glitched Drives enhancing a Digital Bee.

== Trivia == * Excluding the Broken Drive, these are the only items that can permanently enhance a [[Bees|bee]]. * Excluding the Broken Drive, these are the only items that can only be used during a challenge. * The existence of a Yellow Drive is hinted through Robo Bear’s 2022 present dialogue. ** This may be a reference to the unused yellow flowers found in [[Onett (Developer)|Onett's]] decal inventory. {{Items}} [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Robo Bear Challenge]] [[zh-tw:引擎]]

docs.title: Easter Eggs
docs.text:
Throughout the map, plenty of '''Easter Eggs''' can be found. Some of them have been removed, while some still exist.

== [[Codes]] == Codes or hints for codes have been scattered across the map. They are written in white and are usually in peculiar places. The codes and their hiding places are:

CogAndStarHallEntrance.png|''Cog,'' found at the top of [[Noob Shop]] (It was moved when the [[Star Hall]] was added in the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]]). OnettStatue2021.png|''38217,'' found on the [[Onett]] statue's backpack. The statue is the one on top of the 6th hive. (The interactive NPC Onett has a different number on his backpack, which isn't a code.) BlackBearsTitle2021.png|''Connoisseur,'' hint hidden behind the Brave Bee Gate [[Instant Converter]]. CrawlersHint2021.png|''Crawlers,'' hint found in the [[King Beetle Lair|King Beetle's Lair]]. RoofCodeHint.png|''Roof,'' found on top of the [[Red HQ]]. Wink.png|''Wink,'' hint found in the White Tunnel. File:EEEEEEEEEEE.png|Panda Bear last dialogue after completing his quest saying "BOPMASTER" based off of the code.

{{Clear}}

== Tutorial Decals (Removed) == [[File:Helpme.png|thumb|220px|The Help Textures outside the map.]] When starting the game or throughout, there is a help section which can be accessed by pressing the little red ? on the far right side. The textures used for the screenshots were able to be found underneath the map, by the side.

{{Clear}}

== Puppy Bee with Reindeer Antlers and Festive Bee with Festive Wreath (Level 2) == [[File:Sdfs.png|thumb|Puppy Bee with Reindeer Antlers]] The Puppy Bee with the {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers}} statue doesn't actually have the Antlers, but it's still called 'Puppy Bee with Reindeer Antlers' because of its nose. The Festive Bee with the {{Cost|Festive Wreath|||0}} was added when Part 2 of Beesmas 2020 came, and was right next to Puppy Bee with Reindeer Antlers.

The Puppy Bee with Reindeer Antlers and Festive Bee with Festive Wreath can be found behind the wall of the [[Blue HQ]] outside the map.

You can get to this by:

docs.title: Using a Red Cannon in combination with the parachute/glider to glide towards here.
Jump from a far distance towards here.
docs.text:
[[File:RobloxScreenShot20210201 153634661 (2).png|alt=Festive bee right next to Puppy Bee|thumb|325x325px|Festive Bee right next to Puppy Bee]]

{{Clear}}

== Onett Statue == The statue is one of the easiest easter eggs to find and can be found on the top of the rightmost [[hive]] (6th hive). Behind him, there is a [[Royal Jelly]]. On his backpack you can see the number 38217, which is actually a code that will give you 5 tickets. You can get to him using a few methods.

docs.title: Using the [[Yellow Cannon]], [[Red Cannon]], or [[Blue Cannon]] (only glider) in combination with the [[parachute]]/[[glider]] to glide to the top of the hive.
On very rare occasions the statue will fall to the ground, and actually could be found inside the honeycombs within the rightmost hive. Rarely, he can be found behind the 5-Bee Gate.
You can jump on the Puppy Bee's tail on the [[Ticket Tent]] or the Gifted Photon Bee on the ticket tent and jump on top of the hive if you have enough jump power or speed.
You can jump in the Gummy Bee in [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]], and use the Glider to get on the hives.
Jump and use glider from the coconut field to get on top of the hives.
docs.text:
Unlike the Onett NPC found in the [[Bear Gate]], he cannot be interacted with.

{{Clear}}

== Dancing Bear / Shadow Bear == [[File:9332E65C-472E-4B9E-B574-54DF2276285D.jpeg|thumb|158px|Shadow Bear]] There is a dancing bear (also known as [[Shadow Bear]]) found under the platform [[Onett]] (NPC) is located on. He looks the same as [[Tunnel Bear]], but he will not kill upon contact and is much bigger. In front of him is a {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} token you can collect, however, if the player touches the ground for long enough, the player will die. If you have enough speed, you can run across the floor without dying. This makes getting the Diamond Egg a challenge.

If you have enough ping, you can hold jump as the floor only kills you after a set amount of time, which is increased by ping.

{{Clear}}

== Hallway behind Badge Bearer's Guild == [[File:Hallway.png|thumb|The hallway.]] [[File:The Outside Of The Hallway.png|thumb|The hallway seen from the outside.]] There is a hallway behind the [[Badge Bearer's Guild#Ace Shop|Ace Shop]] that is inaccessible without glitching/cheating, but can be seen inside using ROBLOX's Shift Lock feature. It leads to an entrance to the area (see [[#Honey Void|Honey Void]]) under the game. It can also be seen by looking at the ceiling of the area. In the test realm, this path was open. This area was blocked off by a transparent wall in the main game, but the hole can still be seen using shift lock.

{{Clear}}

== Honey Void == Out of bounds past the Red HQ, towards a large green wedge outside the map, there is a hole. Upon entering the hole, there is a large expanse of flat land. This area, unofficially called the Honey Void, has its own [[music]], known as Hibernation1.{{Clear}} ===Bee Hibernation === [[File:Hibernated Bees.png|thumb|Bees frozen when entering the entrance of the honey void]] Something interesting is that bees also appear to freeze or go under hibernation when they first enter the area, as the name of the music suggests. It should be noted that this did not exist for a majority of this area's appearance in the game. However, the bees can occasionally unfreeze if the player goes near a corner, and freeze again as the reach the player.

{{Clear}}

===Strange Drawing=== [[File:Goofybssdrawing.png|right|250px]] Inside the Honey Void, there is a drawing of the game. It sits roughly in the middle of this area. It is completely two dimensional; therefore, it can only be viewed from the front. It depicts a [[:Category:Bears|Bear]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], [[Coconut Crab]], [[Onett]] with a [[Petal Wand]] and [[Petal Belt]] and [[Beekeeper's Mask]], [[Basic Bee]], [[King Beetle]] and [[Stick Bug]].

{{Clear}}

===Vector Bee and Tadpole Bee Statues (Level 2)=== In the same area as the strange drawing in the honey void, there are two bee models of a Tadpole Bee and a Vector Bee. They cannot be interacted with. [[File:Roblox 11 2 2019 11 53 44 AM.png|thumb|220x220px|The Tadpole and Vector Bee statues.]]

{{Clear}}

==Windy Bee and Vicious Bee Statues (Level 2)== If you go out of bounds to the right of the map, you will see a Vicious Bee and Windy Bee statue that are level 2. They cannot be interacted with. [[File:RobloxScreenShot20191025 211653099.png|thumb|220x220px|The Vicious and Windy Bee statues.]]

{{Clear}}

==Tabby Bee Block (Removed) == During the Tabby Bee Update (5/12/2018), there had been sightings of a block with a [[Tabby Bee]] image on it outside of the map. It was there along with the Tabby Bee itself to hint players of the [[Codes|code]] "Meow" (expired) which gave {{Cost|Ticket|5}}. [[File:Tabby Bee Easter egg 2.PNG|thumb|The Tabby Bee block.]]

{{Clear}}

==Invisible Platform (Removed)== There was an invisible platform in the air, above and just in front of the middle hive. To find it, you could use a cannon and the glider to approach the middle hive, and close the glider when you were right over the hive's white platform. This is no longer possible because there are now 6 hives. [[File:Invisible platform 2.png|thumb|155px|A player standing on the invisible platform.]]

{{Clear}}

==Mysterious Figure (Removed)== [[File:A04BE769-ADEA-47BA-8A23-FB0100E3DB3B.png|thumb|185x185px|The Mysterious Figure]] The Mysterious Figure, also known as Eggwick from the Egg Hunt 2019 event, was in the [[Mazes#Blue Maze|Blue Maze]] to the right of the [[Festive Bee]] on the [[Ticket Tent]]. After the Egg Hunt 2019 event ended, the statue was removed. Along with the maze, there was {{Cost|Plastic Egg|1}} (now a ticket token) and {{Cost|Jelly Beans|1|4=0}}.

He is the second statue in the game, the first being the Onett statue. The figure has been replaced by a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} token.{{Clear}}

==+5 pollen text== [[File:3BA71544-29F3-42DA-9B39-ADAA9A4AF820.png|thumb|The +5 pollen text.]] This Easter Egg is located outside the map next to the [[Stump Field]]. Behind it, there is a text decal written "+5".

{{Clear}}

==Red HQ Room== This room is hidden behind a wall in the [[Red HQ]]. When it was first added, the room had an unusable {{Cost|Red Extract|||0}} dispenser. The room had a slight change in the 12/26/2021 update, and another change in the 12/26/2022 update. [[File:Outside of the Red Room.png|thumb|The Red Room from the outside.]][[File:'250' Red Room Section Inside The Red HQ.png|thumb|Inside the Red Room & entrance to the Red Room.]]

== Red HQ Attic == [[File:Red hq roof room entrance .png|thumb|The entrance to the roof room, near the [[Wind Shrine|wind shrine]]]] If you go out of bounds you find a hole on the back of the wall where [[Red HQ]] would be. If you fly into it then you will be on the inside of the [[Red HQ]] roof. [[File:Red hq roof inside.png|thumb|The inside of red HQ roof]] [[Category:Gameplay]] [[Category:Locations]]

docs.title: Editing Guidelines
docs.text:
To reduce edit wars and other frustrations, please read the following guidelines before making any edits.

'''Note: This is a wiki that uses American English. Do not add a different language onto pages. If you would like to read a page in a different language, use a translator.''' * '''Please write correctly-spelled grammatical full sentences'''. Watch out for those homonyms and subject-verb agreement issues! ** If (or rather, ''when'') Onett misspells something in-game, silently correct it in the main section of the page, and list the actual spelling used in Notes/Trivia. Alternatively, if you're quoting in-game text verbatim (for example, in a quest dialogue), you can mark errors in the quoted text with "''[sic]''."

[[File:Contradictment.PNG|thumb|All bees in the game make honey...]] * '''Bears are "he"''' (unless specified otherwise*), '''and mobs are mostly "it,"''' except the Werewolf and King Beetle can both be "he." Bees are "they" or "it." ** Mother Bear and Spirit Bear are female. All of the other bears are male. ** Bees are technically female, but Onett goes out of his way to not use pronouns for them. Since that's not workable on a wiki, use "they" if possible, "it" otherwise. *** Specific bees may be named in dialogue. These are the exceptions and their pronouns can only be used in reference to the unique character. ** Regardless of their gender, bears and bees have names, and mobs have labels. '''Use "the" with labels, but not with names.''' He's "Black Bear," not "The Black Bear." This also means that '''bears and bees are "who," not "that."'''

  • '''Use actual headings''', not paragraphs formatted in bold. ** See that box that says "Paragraph" with a down arrow? Click it and select the appropriate heading level. ** Similarly, use actual lists, not workarounds with asterisks or dashes.

  • Please '''stick to a consistent, third person voice'''. Don't use "you" if possible. Phrases such as "the player" are preferred. ** This isn't a hard and fast rule. In certain cases, such as under Tip sections in pages, second person view ("you"). Yes, Wikipedia's guidelines say to not use "you" at all, but this isn't Wikipedia. Readability is more important than formality.

  • '''The wiki should reflect the current state of the game.''' This means '''don't post rumors/future content''', even if they come from Onett himself. (What he ''wants'' to deliver and what he ''actually'' delivers are often quite different.) ** This includes content from the Test Realm. ** This also means not writing things like "since the [insert date here] update..." Just '''write what's in the game currently, as if it had always been that way'''. If the old value/setting/behavior may be of interest to players, you can add it in a Notes/Trivia section. ** Debug and/or Developer gear not accessible to players normally will not be considered as part of the current state of the game.

  • At this point, unless there's been an update, '''you shouldn't be adding new pages'''. If you can't find a page, assume the fault lies with you unless and until proven otherwise. **If you find a page that shouldn't exist – for example, it has fake information, doesn't have to do with the game, or it's a duplicate – inform a [[Template:CurrentStaff|staff]] member, or edit the page and put the special code

    {{Delete}}
    at the top.

  • '''Do not add the Removed Content template to content that is still in the game'''. Just because you can no longer obtain something does not mean it is removed content. For example, a first-edition Tabby Bee is not removed content. Only add the Removed Content template to the items that were actually removed (e.g. the Bear Bee Pack). ** Traveling Bears who have left do get the Removed Content template, even if they promised to be back.

  • '''Don't add pointless trivia'''. Include trivia that is actually noteworthy and not clearly obvious to anyone with a brain in their head. ** Hint: if an item is the most expensive thing in the game, then it follows that it is the most expensive item in its shop. If you add the latter as a separate trivia point, be prepared to be ridiculed.

  • '''Opinion statements have no business in articles'''. If you want to write about your opinion, make a blog post instead. ** Hint: value statements, such as "This is a good thing," are opinions. Suggestions count as opinions as well.

  • When writing dates, '''write out the month name '''and''' include the year.''' For example, both ''November 24, 2018'' and ''18 May 2018'' are acceptable, though the former is preferred. If space is tight, use ISO date format: 2018-08-11.

  • '''Do not use external link syntax for internal links.''' In other words, if linking to another page on the wiki, do not put [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com] into links. In Visual Editor, there are provided options in order to do so. In Source Editor, you can follow the conventions from [[w:Help:Links/Wikitext|this help page]].

*'''The first occurrence of the page's subject should be bold'''. All subsequent occurrences should be normal text.

Similarly, '''any given page should only be linked to once'''. Don't make every occurrence of the word "Honey" a link to that page! *There can be some exceptions to this: if people are likely to read only a small subsection of the page, then repeating useful links in each subsection might be a good idea. (This still means "Honey" should not be linked more than once; it's rarely useful.)

'''Use normal capitalization'''. They may be important terms in the game, but "honey," "pollen," "spider," "mob," "ticket," etc. are not proper nouns. They should only be capitalized if they're the first word of a sentence. *"Brown Bear," "Lion Bee," etc. are names. Names ''are'' capitalized.

*'''Tables, infoboxes, etc. should be used ''in addition'' to normal text, not instead of normal text'''. This is partly for accessibility reasons, but it's mostly for clarity; things like infoboxes are designed specifically to be concise, so they do not have room for explanations.

*If you find yourself making the same edit a second time, '''check the page history'''. There's probably a good reason why your original edit was reverted.

'''Do not edit the same page multiple times in a row.''' There are previews to allow you to see the results of your edits. If you can't get it right in two edits, STOP EDITING and ask for help. *Editing the same page multiple times in succession can result in an assumption that you are edit-farming, so don't do this.

  • '''Be efficient with file usage.''' Items that share the same image (for example, the Nectar Tester using the Basic Egg icon) should all point to the same file. Don't create multiple duplicates. ** This includes when using images in other pages. Please make sure the image does not already exist yet before uploading a new one. [[Category:Guides]] [[Category:Bee Swarm Simulator Wiki]]

docs.title: Egg Hunt 2019
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} {{EventInfobox |image= Egg Hunt 2019 Banner.jpeg |duration= 4/18/2019 to 5/13/2019 |NPC=[[Egg Hunt Info|Egg Hunt Info]] |additions= [[Jelly Beans|Jelly Beans]], [[Marshmallow Bee|Marshmallow Bee]]s }}The '''Egg Hunt 2019''' was a Roblox event that spanned across 42 games, including [[Bee Swarm Simulator]], all connected to one central hub. In each game, players had to complete a certain task/quest in order to obtain an egg, which they could then wear on their avatar. In doing so, they could unlock more areas in the Hub World to gain powers, which they could use to defeat the final boss. More information can be found [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2019: Scrambled in Time|here]].

To get the egg from Bee Swarm Simulator, players needed to interact with the [[Egg Hunt Info]] near the [[Ant Gate]] to receive the quest. Then, three [[Marshmallow Bee|marshmallow bees]] are needed to be obtained. When the player had obtained three Marshmallow Bees, they would have to return to Egg Hunt Info for a few special rewards along with the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]], which players can wear on their Roblox avatar as a hat. BSSEggHunt2019Update.png|Bee Swarm Simulator's icon during the Egg Hunt 2019 Event. Egghunt2019.png|The notification that appeared when the player had obtained enough marshmallow bees for the Flight of the Bumble Egg. Egghuntend.png|The notification that appeared in-game when the Egg Hunt was about to end. [[Category:Egg Hunt 2019]] [[Category:Events]] [[Category:Removed Content]] [[Category:Egg Hunt Event]]

docs.title: Egg Hunt 2020
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} {{EventInfobox |image = Weirdagents.png |duration = 4/7/2020 to 4/28/2020 |NPC = [[Sun Bear]] |additions = [[Chicks]] }}

The '''Egg Hunt 2020''' was a Roblox event that spanned across multiple games. In each game, players had to complete a certain task/quest in order to obtain one of the eggs, which they could then wear on their avatar.

== The Story == [[Sun Bear]] stated that he wanted to work with the bears for the Egg Hunt. He said that he would hide exotic eggs on the map (presumably in the form of a scavenger/egg hunt). The eggs hatched, however, and Sun Bear needed the players to capture the [[chicks]] and bring them to [[Black Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], and [[Mother Bear]].

== How to Obtain the Egg == To get the egg from [[Bee Swarm Simulator]], the player needed to talk to [[Sun Bear]] near the [[Ant Gate]] to receive the [[Quests|quest]]. Then, the player needed to help three bears (Black, Brown, and Mother Bears) with their Egg Hunt 2020 quests. Their quests revolved around capturing chicks, along with a few other side objectives.

Once the player had helped the bears, they had to return to Sun Bear for a few special rewards along with the [[Swarming Egg of the Hive]], which players can wear on their Roblox avatar as a hat.

== Gallery == Beeswarmegghuntlogo.png|Bee Swarm Simulator's icon during the Egg Hunt 2020 Event. Swarmingegg.png|Bee Swarm Simulator's 2020 Egg Hunt egg - the Swarming Egg of the Hive. [[Category:Egg Hunt 2020]] [[Category:Events]] [[Category:Removed Content]]

docs.title: Egg Hunt Info
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}}[[File:FlightofBumbleNPC.png|thumb|287x287px]]

The '''Egg Hunt Info''' was a [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]] that was located in front of the [[Ant Gate]]. This was the quest location of the [[Egg Hunt 2019]] event that occurred in Roblox for [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. The player could collect three [[Marshmallow Bee]]s and turn in it here for various in-game rewards, the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]], and a [[Badges|Badge]]. If obtained before the event ended, the player could equip the Flight of the Bumble Egg in the avatar tab on the Roblox website.

Each of the [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] in game at the time, except for the [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee NPC]], [[Onett]], gave a quest for a marshmallow bee.

Note: If you completed the Egg Hunt quests before they were modified, you will be rewarded two [[Field Dice]], two marshmallow bees, and five [[Jelly Beans]].

== Dialogue and Quest == {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed autocollapse" ! Quest Name ! Requirements ! Rewards |- | Egg Hunt 2019 | * Obtain 3 [[Marshmallow Bee]]s. | {{Cost|Honey|2,500}}{{Cost|Ticket|10}}{{Cost|Jelly Beans|5}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|15}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}}[[Flight of the Bumble Egg]] |}

{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed autocollapse" ! Quest Name ! Dialogue |- | Egg Hunt 2019 | Welcome Egg Hunters! Look at this one - egg-ceptionally bee-utiful. Meticulously molded out of the finest beeswax. And one just like it can be yours! Here's how: Each bear around the map has an Egg Hunt Quest for you. Every time you complete one, you'll be rewarded with a [Marshmallow Bee]. (It's just a cute springtime treat - not a real bee) Return here with 3 [Marshmallow Bees] to trade them for the Egg Hunt Egg! If you're new here, you should talk to Black Bear and Mother Bear first. They'll keep things simple. You can find them near the Sunflower Field. Let's get to it! Happy Hunting! ''-During-'' Black Bear, Mother Bear, and Brown Bear have the simplest quests for you. If you're new to the game, be sure to talk to these 3 first. Black Bear can be found to the right of the hives near the Red Cannon. Mother Bear can be found near the Sunflower Field. Brown Bear can be found near the Clover Field. If you a ''[sic]'' [Marshmallow Bee], there are other bears on the mountain with more for you. ''-Completion-'' 1... 2... 3 [Marshmallow Bees]! You've earned our Egg Hunt Egg, good work! It's ''[sic]'' proper name is "Flight Of The Bumble Egg". Wear this bad boy on your head to truly embody the concept of bee swarm simulation. Hopefully that didn't take too long - we do things a little slow around here. You're free to buzz off now! But there are many more [Marshmallow Bees] to earn during this Egg Hunt event! Work your way up the mountain and introduce yourself to all the bears. When you're out of bears, well, try talking to whoever else you run into. We've got a lot to see here if you've got the time and a taste for the grind. For now, you ought to collect the other Egg Hunt eggs. You're welcome back anytime! |- | Conclusion | You earned the Egg Hunt Egg, isn't it nice? Now you can bring a swarm of bees into whichever ROBLOX game you choose. Go, spread those bees, collect the rest of the eggs. But remember, there's more to do here during the Egg Hunt. Make sure you talk to all the bears! |}

docs.title: Egg
docs.text:
[[File:New egg page.png|thumb|Eggs available inside the [[Robux Shop]].]]'''Eggs''' are a type of [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] where the player drags into their [[hive]] to hatch a [[Bees|bee]], can be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]] or get used to roll the [[Sticker Printer]]. They are also the items that help players start playing in the [[Bee Swarm Simulator|game]]. Eggs come in many different types, some offering chances at different rarities of bees, and some hatching a specific bee. Currently, a total of 6 (or 12 if counting the [[Gifted Bee|gifted]] variants of the Basic, Silver, Gold, Diamond and Mythic eggs and the Choose-A-Mythic Egg) different types of eggs exist in the game, not including [[Plastic Egg]]s, specific bee eggs, the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]], the [[Swarming Egg of the Hive]].

Ever since the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], players do not need a vacant [[Hive Slot|hive slot]] to hatch an egg. Now, players can hatch an egg on top of an existing bee to replace it. The level of the bee remains the same, acting like a [[Royal Jelly]].

Please also note that due to regulations in Netherlands and Belgium, any eggs in the Robux shop won't be available to purchase for Dutch and Belgian consumers. This restriction counts for every egg in the shop. == General Egg Types == {{Tabber |Basic Egg|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Basic Egg {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:Basic Egg.png{{!}}left{{!}}100px]] The {{Color|Basic Egg}} is the most common type of egg found in the game. It will almost always hatch into a [[Basic Bee]] (87% chance), but in rare cases, it can hatch into a [[Bees/Rare{{!}}Rare Bee]] (10% chance), an [[Bees/Epic{{!}}Epic Bee]] (2.5% chance), a [[Bees/Legendary{{!}}Legendary Bee]] (0.5% chance), or into a [[Gifted Bee]] (0.4% chance), with a 0.348% (1 out of 287.35632184) chance of getting a Gifted Basic Bee from the egg. [[Bees/Event{{!}}Event bees]] cannot be hatched from this egg. This egg cannot be used on a Basic Bee. {{clear}}

Ways to obtain a Basic Egg:

  • First-time players receive a free {{Color|Basic Egg}} in their inventory.
  • Purchasing from the [[Basic Egg Shop]] located near the [[Sunflower Field]] for a base price of {{Cost|Honey|1,000}} and capping at {{Cost|Honey|10,000,000}}. Every time the player purchases a {{Color|Basic Egg}}, the price of the next {{Color|Basic Egg}} scales up.
  • Adding the Round Basic Bee [[Sticker]] to the [[Sticker Stack]] rewards 1 {{Color|Basic Egg}}. |Silver Egg|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Silver Egg {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:Silver Egg.png{{!}}left{{!}}100px]] The {{Color|Silver Egg}} is a type of egg that will most likely hatch into a Rare bee (64.9% chance), but it has a small chance to hatch into an Epic bee (30% chance), a Legendary bee (5% chance), or a Mythic bee (0.1% chance). A Basic Bee or an Event bee cannot be hatched from this egg. {{clear}}

Ways to obtain a Silver Egg:

  • Purchasing from [[Ticket Tent]] for {{Cost|Ticket|50}} each.
  • Purchasing from the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|100}}.
  • By purchasing the {{Color|Silver Egg}} in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Snowflake|25}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|5}} during Winter Beesmas 2024.
  • Finishing [[Black Bear{{!}}Black Bear's]] and [[Panda Bear{{!}}Panda Bear's]] {{Color|Silver Egg}} [[quests{{!}}questline]].
  • As a reward from [[Brown Bear{{!}}Brown Bear's]] 25th quest.
  • Completing the 25th [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine{{!}}Sticker-Seeker quest]] rewards you 1 {{Color|Silver Egg}}.
  • An extremely low chance of dropping from a [[Mantis]] (in increments of 1 or 5).
  • A low chance of dropping from the [[King Beetle]] and [[Tunnel Bear]].
  • A low chance to drop from [[Sprout{{!}}Rare sprouts]].
  • An extremely rare chance from [[leaves]] when collecting [[pollen]] in the [[Clover Field]].
  • As a drop from a {{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}}.
  • A rare chance to drop from [[stockings]].
  • A rare reward from the [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match{{!}}Winter Memory Match]].

{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Outdated Ways {{=}}{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} {{{!}} class{{=}}"mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" {{!}}+ {{!}}- {{!}} * Using the expired [[Codes{{!}}code]] "PreUpdate" gave {{Cost|Silver Egg|1}} and other items. * As a reward for completing [[Bubble Bee Man{{!}}Bubble Bee Man's]] quest "B.B.M's Naughty List" during the Beesmas 2020 event. * By purchasing the Silver Egg in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Snowflake|30}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|3}} during Beesmas 2020 and 2021. * By purchasing the Silver Egg in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|5}} during Beesmas 2022. * By purchasing the {{Color|Silver Egg}} in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Snowflake|25}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|5}} during Summer Beesmas 2024. {{!}}}

{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}Gifted Silver Egg {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:Gifted Silver Egg.png{{!}}left{{!}}100px]] A {{Color|Gifted Silver Egg}} shares the same probabilities as a {{Color|Silver Egg}}, but the egg will always hatch the bee into its gifted variant. {{clear}}

Ways to obtain a Gifted Silver Egg:

  • Defeating [[Tunnel Bear]] for the first time guarantees any type of gifted egg including a {{Color|Gifted Silver Egg}}, but with lower chances of obtaining upon subsequent defeats.
  • As a reward for getting Top 25 in the [[Daily Top Legendary Bee Pollen Collectors]] by the end of a day.
  • Completing [[Black Bear{{!}}Black Bear's]] "Getting Stumped" quest.
  • Completing the 100th quest of the [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]] rewards you 1 {{Color|Gifted Silver Egg}}.
  • An exceptionally rare chance of dropping from [[Werewolf{{!}}werewolves]].
  • A rare chance to obtain when defeating the [[Stump Snail]].
  • An exceptionally rare chance of dropping from a [[Scorpion]]. |Gold Egg|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Gold Egg {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:Gold Egg.png{{!}}left{{!}}100px]] The {{Color|Gold Egg}} is a type of egg most likely to hatch into an Epic bee (79% chance), but it has a chance to hatch into a Legendary bee (20% chance) or a Mythic bee (1% chance). A Basic Bee, Rare bee, or an Event bee cannot hatch from this egg.

5 {{Color|Gold Egg}} are required in order to craft the [[Honey Mask]]. {{clear}}

Ways to obtain a Gold Egg:

  • Purchasing from the [[Ticket Tent]] for 100 {{Cost|Ticket}} each.
  • Purchasing from the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|200}} each.
  • By purchasing the {{Color|Gold Egg}} in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|10}} during Beesmas 2024.
  • A rare reward from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]].
  • A rare reward from the [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match{{!}}Extreme Memory Match]].
  • In token form in the [[Werewolf's Cave]], which is guarded by two [[Cave Monster{{!}}cave monsters]].
  • Completing [[Black Bear{{!}}Black Bear's]] and [[Panda Bear{{!}}Panda Bear's]] {{Color|Gold Egg}} [[Quests{{!}}questline]].
  • As a reward from [[Brown Bear{{!}}Brown Bear's]] 50th, 340th and 390th quest.
  • Completing the [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]]'s 50th quest rewards 1 Gold Egg.
  • Capturing [[Commando Chick]] 10 times.
  • A low chance of dropping upon defeating the [[King Beetle]].
  • An extremely low chance of dropping upon defeating a [[scorpion]].
  • A rare chance to drop from [[Sprout{{!}}Epic sprouts]].
  • An extremely rare chance of dropping from [[leaves]] when collecting pollen in the [[Clover Field]].
  • A rare drop from a {{Cost|Ticket Planter|||0}}, {{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}}, {{Cost|Red Clay Planter|||0}}, {{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}}, {{Cost|Pesticide Planter|||0}} and {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}}.
  • A rare drop from the [[Stockings]].
  • A low chance to drop from a [[Festive Nymph]].
  • As a rare reward from the [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match{{!}}Winter Memory Match]].

{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Outdated Ways {{=}}{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} {{{!}} class{{=}}"mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" {{!}}+ {{!}}- {{!}} * Opening the [[Ornament Presents{{!}}Golden Present]] gave 1 gold egg and other [[items]]. * Purchasing the Black Friday Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|800}} gave 1 gold egg and other items. * A chance of getting from the [[Wind Shrine]] after donating {{Cost|Strawberry}}. This was only possible if the player had completed Spirit Bear's Beesmas 2020 or 2021 quest for the [[Galentine Wind Shrine]]. * During Beesmas 2020 and 2021, it could have been purchased in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Snowflake|40}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4}}. * Opening the [[Gift Boxes{{!}}Gilded Gift Box]] gave {{Cost|Gold Egg|1}} and other items. {{!}}}

{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Gifted Gold Egg {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:Gifted Gold Egg.png{{!}}left{{!}}100px]] A {{Color|Gifted Gold Egg}} shares the same probabilities as a {{Color|Gold Egg}}, but the egg will always hatch the bee into its gifted variant. This type of egg cannot be applied to craft the [[Honey Mask]]. {{clear}}

Ways to obtain a Gifted Gold Egg:

  • Defeating [[Tunnel Bear]] for the first time guarantees any type of gifted egg, including a {{Color|Gifted Gold Egg}}, but with lower chances of obtaining upon subsequent defeats.
  • As a reward for getting Top 25 in the [[Daily Top Epic Bee Pollen Collectors]] by the end of a day.
  • As a Playtime Grandmaster [[Badges{{!}}badge]] reward from donating tickets to the [[Wind Shrine]].
  • Completing 50 [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] quests or 50 [[Gifted Riley Bee]] quests awards {{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|1}}.
  • Completing 275 [[Brown Bear]] quests awards {{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|1}}.
  • Completing the 150th quest of the [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]] rewards {{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|1}}.
  • A very rare chance of dropping upon defeating the [[Stump Snail]] and the [[Coconut Crab]].
  • An exceptionally rare chance to drop from [[mantis]].

{{=}}{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Outdated Ways {{=}}{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} {{{!}} class{{=}}"mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" {{!}}+ {{!}}- {{!}} * Opening the [[Ornament Presents{{!}}Mondo Present]] during Beesmas 2019 gave 2 gifted gold eggs and other items. {{!}}} |Diamond Egg|{{=}}{{=}}{{=}} Diamond Egg {{=}}{{=}}{{=}} [[File:Diamond Egg.png{{!}}left{{!}}100px]] The {{Color|Diamond Egg}} is a type of egg that will most likely hatch into a Legendary bee (95% chance), but it has a rare chance to hatch into a Mythic bee (5% chance). A Basic Bee, Rare bee, Epic bee, or an Event bee cannot hatch from this egg.

{{Cost|Diamond Egg|5}} are required in order to craft the [[Diamond Mask]]. {{clear}}

Ways to obtain a Diamond Egg:

  • A Diamond Egg token is located past the [[Bear Gate]], under the platform where [[Onett]] stands on. The player can use a [[glider]] or a [[parachute]] and glide towards the token in front of [[Shadow Bear]].
  • Purchasing from the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|400}} each.
  • Purchasing from the [[Ticket Tent]] for {{Cost|Ticket|400}} each.
  • A rare reward from [[Robo Bear Challenge]].
  • A rare reward from the [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match{{!}}Extreme Memory Match]].
  • Completing [[Black Bear{{!}}Black Bear's]] Diamond Egg questline.
  • Completing [[Panda Bear{{!}}Panda Bear's]] fifth [[Star Treat{{!}}star treat]]/[[Ants{{!}}ant]] quest, "Colossal Combat".
  • Completing [[Dapper Bear{{!}}Dapper Bear's]] tenth quest, "The Long Haul".
  • Completing [[Brown Bear{{!}}Brown Bear's]] 75th and 525th quest.
  • Completing [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]] 75th quest.
  • A rare chance of dropping upon defeating the [[Stump Snail]], [[Aphid#Diamond Aphid{{!}}Diamond Aphids]], [[King Beetle]], [[Tunnel Bear]], and [[Coconut Crab]].
  • A very rare chance of dropping upon defeating [[Spider]]s, [[Mantis]]es, and [[Werewolf{{!}}Werewolves]].
  • A rare chance to drop from [[Sprout{{!}}Legendary sprouts]].
  • A guaranteed drop from [[Sprout{{!}}Supreme sprouts]].
  • An extremely rare chance of dropping from [[leaves]] while collecting pollen from the [[Clover Field]].
  • A very rare reward from catching a [[Mythic Meteor Shower{{!}}meteor]].
  • A rare drop from a {{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}}.
  • A very rare chance to drop from a [[Festive Nymph]].
  • A very rare chance to drop from [[stockings]].
  • A rare reward from [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match{{!}}Winter Memory Match]].

  • Completing [[Dapper Bear{{!}}Dapper Bear's]] 15th quest, "More Than Myth".
  • As a reward from [[Brown Bear{{!}}Brown Bear's]] 100th, 200th, and 400th quests.

The Event bee royal jelly will turn any bee into that kind of Event bee. It cannot be applied if the player currently has that Event bee in their hive though. And instead of hatching into a random bee of a particular rarity, '''specific event bee eggs''' will always hatch into the egg's respective event bee. == Trivia ==

  • The [[Digital Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], and [[Gummy Bee]] Eggs are the only types of [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] eggs that could or can be obtained without spending robux or [[ticket]]s. (The Festive Bee Egg can now be purchased in the [[Ticket Tent]] for {{Cost|Ticket|500}}.)
  • Star Eggs and Basic Eggs are the only two eggs that can hatch into a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Basic Bee]].
  • [[Plastic Egg]]s, the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]] (Egg Hunt 2019), and the [[Swarming Egg of the Hive]] (Egg Hunt 2020) are the only types of eggs that do not hatch into a [[Bees|bee]].
  • Any kind of specific bee egg and event bee egg will have the same icon as a Basic Egg in the inventory.
  • The [[Bear Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], [[Puppy Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]] Eggs are the only type of Event bee eggs that can/could be obtained directly by spending robux.
  • Basic Eggs are the only type of eggs that can be obtained with honey.
  • The star that appears on the Star Egg is slightly larger than the stars on the other types of gifted eggs.
  • The Mythic Egg is the only type of egg with the name of the bee rarity that it hatches into. ** The Mythic Egg is also the only egg that has a 100% of hatching into a certain bee rarity (except for Event bee eggs and specific bee eggs). However, before mythic bees were added, diamond eggs used to have a 100% chance of hatching into a legendary bee. ** The Mythic Egg is also the only egg with a letter on it. ** The Choose-a-Mythic Egg is the only Egg that allows the player to choose what bee hatches.
  • The [[Fuzzy Bee]] egg, [[Buoyant Bee]] egg and the [[Precise Bee]] egg are the only non-event and the only specific bee eggs that could be bought from the Robux Shop.
  • The Gifted Silver Egg and the Star Egg are the only Gifted eggs that can be obtained by completing the main questlines from [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] (Black Bear's "Getting Stumped", Mother Bear's "Seven To Seven", and Panda Bear's "Royal Rumble").
  • The player cannot hatch a specific bee egg on that specific bee. For example, a Bumble Bee egg cannot be hatched on a Bumble Bee.
  • The Basic Egg is the only egg without a gifted variant of itself, excluding specific bee eggs. ** Similarly, the Star Egg is the only Gifted egg without a regular variant.
  • The Diamond and Basic Eggs are the only non-specific or event eggs that can hatch into a bee of their name (the [[Diamond Bee|Diamond]] and Basic Bees, respectively), though you can get other bees from these eggs.
  • The Bubble Bee Egg is the only non-Event specific bee egg that can be obtained from a quest (B.B.M's Naughty List).
  • The Tadpole Bee Egg is the only egg that can be obtained by giving a present (to Bubble Bee Man).

docs.title: Electro-Magnet
docs.text:
{{Tool |image =Electro-Magnet.png |price = 300,000 |shop = Pro Shop |range = 9 |pattern = Surround |time = 0.5 |collectbase = 4 |pollen = 4 }}The '''Electro-Magnet''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] added in the [[Updates|6/2/2018 update]]. It can be purchased in the [[Pro Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|300,000}} |}

It collects 4 [[pollen]] from 9 surrounding [[flowers]] in 0.5 seconds, which comes to a base pollen collection rate of 72 pollen per second, assuming all flowers are singles.

==Gallery== Hivesticker electro-magnet.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. ==Trivia== This tool is the upgraded version of the [[Magnet]]. Their appearances are similar and they are the only tools to collect pollen in a square pattern. However, the two have their differences. The Electro-Magnet is yellow and white in color, and it has electricity running on its tips, while the Magnet is red and gray, without electricity. It collects faster and also has four tips, whereas the Magnet only has two. The Electro-Magnet, [[Clippers]], [[Golden Rake]], [[Spark Staff]], [[Petal Wand]], [[Dark Scythe]], [[Tide Popper]] and the [[Gummyballer]] are the only tools added in an update. *The Electro-Magnet's associated sticker is strangely missing its handle. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

docs.title: Emoticons
docs.text:
'''Emoticons''' are a mechanic for showing a bee's mood. The mood can be affect how much [[bond]] a [[Bees|bee]] gets when it collects [[pollen]], how fast the bee flies, and can even enable some bees to find certain [[sticker]]s when collecting. It does not affect other [[stats]], such as [[Stats#Gather Amount|pollen collection rate]] or [[Stats#Production Amount|honey conversion speed]].

== Bee Moods == [[File:Happy.png|left|thumb|85x85px]] A bee will express happiness if it is fed a [[Treats|treat]] or if it is working (or most recently was working) in a [[fields|field]] that it likes. Bees gain extra bond from gathering when working in a field they like and also move slightly faster than usual. [[Precise Bee]] will also express happiness when it shoots all the targets during it's Target Practice ability.

{{clear}} [[File:Sad.png|left|thumb|85x85px]] A bee will express unhappiness if it is working in a field it dislikes or if the last field it worked in was one it dislikes. Bees gain less bond from gathering in fields they dislike, and move slower than usual.

docs.title: Energy
docs.text:
'''Energy''' represents the number of times a [[Bees|bee]] will gather [[pollen]] from a [[Flowers|flower]], sip [[nectar]], and [[Bee Attack|attack]] [[mobs]] before returning to the [[hive]] to rest. Each action costs one energy. Spawning [[Ability Tokens]] does not use up energy. The energy of all bees in a hive can be increased with stacks of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Polar Power]] from [[Polar Bear]]'s quests, certain [[mutation]]s, certain [[Beequip]]s or by [[Bond|leveling up]] bees.

It takes 30 seconds for a bee to rest and recover all its energy in the hive. However, there are some exceptions. [[Shocked Bee]] takes a lesser time to sleep, as well as [[Exhausted Bee]] and [[Photon Bee]] never sleeping at all. However, if the player dies or resets all bees will return to the hive to sleep regardless of any buffs, and they sleep for 30 seconds except Shocked Bee who sleeps for only 15 seconds.

When a bee runs out of energy, a message will appear, stating, {{Notification||😴 [Type] Bee is out of energy! It's going to sleep.}} ==Gallery ==

File:Energy.png|250px|Several bees on their way to recover in the player's hive. File:Absurd energy bug.png|Energy bug.

== Trivia== The bees with the highest finite energy are the [[Lion Bee]] and [[Buoyant Bee]]. There was a [[Glitches|glitch]] where the energy of a bee would go to an absurd amount if the player used a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} on an Exhausted Bee or Photon Bee. * There was glitch where dying twice in quick succession caused the player's bees to go to sleep and recover energy, instead of just the 30 second cooldown after death. This included Photon Bee and Exhausted bee, likely due to them not actually having "infinite" energy. This has been patched. The energy for Exhausted Bee and Photon Bee is actually set to 280,000,000. As a bee loses energy, it also loses convert amount. **When a bee wakes up, The Energy and Convert Amount will max.

[[Category:Mechanics]]

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Enzymes.png |description = Grants +10% Instant Conversion and x1.25 Convert Rate for 10 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second }} {{Color|Enzymes}} are an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. When used, it grants +10% [[System Page#Instant Conversion|Instant Conversion]] and x1.25 [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]] for 10 minutes when activated. Using another {{Cost|Enzymes|}} will not stack them, but will reset the timer. {{Cost|Enzymes|}} can also be used for crafting other [[:Category:Accessories|Accessories]] or items. Using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=1}} will override the buff.

== Ways to Obtain == * [[Crafting]] it via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Pineapple|50}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|10}} * As a potential match from all [[Memory Match|Memory Matches]]. * The [[Stick Bug Challenge]] includes other sources of {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} on top of rewarding {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} upon completion: ** Stick Bug can drop {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}}. ** [[Stick Bug Challenge#Defense Totem|Defense Totems]] can drop {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}}. * Redeeming certain valid [[Codes]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[Sticker|Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** Honey Bee Bear rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Panicked Science Bear rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Forward Facing Spider rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Standing Caterpillar rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Yellow Hi rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Taunting Doodle Person rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Orange Step Array rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}. ** Orange Green Tri Deco rewards {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}.

=== Drops === * As a drop from the [[Aphid#Armored Aphid|Armored Aphid]], [[King Beetle]], [[Tunnel Bear]], and the [[Coconut Crab]]. * As a rare drop from a [[scorpion]] and the [[spider]]. * Farming in the [[Pineapple Patch]] may rarely yield {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}}. ** Harvesting [[leaves]] in this field may also yield {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}}. * As a rare drop from [[sprout]]s (the odds increase depending on the rarity of the sprout and if the sprout is in the Pineapple Patch). * As a drop from [[Stick Bug]], [[Stick Nymph|stick nymphs]], or [[Stick Bug Challenge#Defense Totem|defense totems]]. * As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] (if [[Festive Bee]] is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]) or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a rare gift from a [[Cub bonus drop. *** Planting it in [[Pineapple Patch]] and [[Pepper Patch]] may make it drop {{Cost|Enzymes|100|4=}} (unknown cooldown). **** Planting it in [[Pineapple Patch]] three times in a row guarantees {{Cost|Enzymes|100|4=}} (unknown cooldown). === Quests === * [[Black Bear]] gives {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} on the following quests: ** The 15 Bee Zone gives {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}} and other items. ** Black Bear will occasionally give {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} following the completion of his repeatable quests. * [[Brown Bear]]'s 45th, 115th, 130th, 165th, and 260th quests give {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}}, while his 230th quest gives {{Cost|Enzymes|3|4=}}. * [[Science Bear]] gives {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} on the following quests: ** Breaking Down Badges gives {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}} and other items. ** Meditating On Phenomenon gives {{Cost|Enzymes|1|4=}} and other items. ** The Power Of Information gives {{Cost|Enzymes|3|4=}} and other items. ** Epistemological Endeavor gives {{Cost|Enzymes|4|4=}} and other items. * [[Polar Bear]] has a chance to give {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} after completing a quest. * [[Spirit Bear]] gives enzymes on the following quests: ** Rhubarb That Could Have Been gives {{Cost|Enzymes|5|4=}} and other items. ** Dancing With Stick Bug gives {{Cost|Enzymes|25|4=}} and other items.

=== Token Locations === * There is an {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} token in the bottom left corner of [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. * Right beside [[Memory Match#Night Memory Match|Night Memory Match]] inside the [[Bear Gate]]. * There is an {{Cost|Enzymes||4=}} token in the tunnel that can be accessed through the hole above the [[Coconut Dispenser]].

docs.title: Eviction
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}}{{Accessory |title1 = Eviction |image1 = Eviction.png |cost = 50,000 Honey |description = Removes a bee from the hive. }}The {{Color|Eviction}} was an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that used to be purchasable in the [[Mountain Top Shop]] for {{Cost|Honey|50,000}}. When used, it removed a [[Bees|bee]] from the [[hive]]. It was the cheapest item available at the Mountain Top Shop before being removed.

{{Color|Eviction|Evictions}} were mainly used to remove bees and replace them with [[egg]]s if the player couldn't afford a [[Hive Slot]], taking note that eggs could not be placed on hive slots with a bee in the game version that had evictions. [[File:Screenshot 31.png|thumb|210x210px|The Eviction Shop in the Mountain Top Shop.]] Evicting a bee would completely reset the hive slot, meaning that the bee's [[bond]], level, and [[Gifted Bee|gifted]] status, would be reset, so if a new egg were hatched, the new bee would have started at level 1. The previous bee will not affect the bee type or gifted status of the new bee.

'''All evictions that anyone might have had will no longer be in their inventory.'''

== Way(s) To Obtain == There are currently no methods to obtain the {{Cost|Eviction|4=0}}, as it has been removed from the game.

'''The methods below are no longer possible.''' * Purchasing an {{Cost|Eviction|4=0}} in the Mountain Top Shop for {{Cost|Honey|50,000}}. * Finishing [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee Man's]] Beesmas 2018 [[Quests|quest]] 'B.B.M. Mission' rewarded {{Cost|Eviction|800}} and other items.

== Removal Reason == As of the [[Updates#2018.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the player can now use eggs on existing bees, removing the need to evict bees, while also allowing a bee to keep its level. Thus, [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] removed the {{Cost|Eviction|4=0}} from both the shop and every player's inventory.

Exhausted Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Pineapple}}.

Exhausted Bee likes the [[Stump Field]], the [[Sunflower Field]], and the [[Dandelion Field]]. It dislikes the [[Cactus Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4.6 seconds. * Makes 240 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * -15% [[Stats#Speed|Move Speed]] and gather speed. +160 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]]. Doesn't require [[Energy|Sleep]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +20% White Field Capacity.

Combo with other bombs to increase power. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Token Link|[Token Link]]]''' Collects all other ability tokens, granting {{Cost|Honey|25}} (+10 per Level) per token collected.
