docs.title: FAQ
docs.text:
As with practically anything, some questions come up over and over as more people discover the game.

==Game FAQs==

How do I cut the vines by the [[Wealth Clock]]?

You need to have either the [[Clippers]], [[Scissors]], or [[Scythe]] equipped and then walk up to the pad in front of the vine and press "E" to cut the vines. You can then enter the area behind the vines with whatever tool you want.

How do I get a [[Spirit Petal|spirit petal]]?

For every 10 [[Spirit Bear]] quests, Spirit Bear will give you a spirit petal. There are 30 quests in all, meaning you can get 3 spirit petals.

How do I get a [[Windy Bee]]?

There are two ways. One way was to purchase it from the Robux Shop for 800 Robux before Beesmas 2019 began. The other way is to get a spirit petal from Spirit Bear's quests, donating it to the [[Wind Shrine]], and then donating [[Cloud Vial|cloud vials]] to (hopefully) obtain a Windy Bee (Note: Some items can increase the chance of you getting Windy Bee, and it will most likely take you a long time to get it).

You do not need to donate a spirit petal to start increasing your chance of getting Windy Bee, you increase the chance anytime you donate an item to the Wind Shrine. You just have to donate a spirit petal to ''be able''' '''''to have the chance to get Windy Bee.

Who should I give my [[translator]] to?

It is commonly recommended to give your translator to either [[Gifted Riley Bee]] or [[Gifted Bucko Bee]]. [[Stick Bug]] should be last, because the [[:Category:Quest Bees|quest bees]] have good rewards and other players/[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] can summon Stick Bug. Depending on whether you're a better red [[pollen]] [[:Category:Tools|collector]] or blue pollen collector, your first translator should go to the color you specialize in. Give it to Gifted Riley Bee if you are better in red, and Gifted Bucko Bee in blue. This is so you can start doing the easier quests for you and get rewards. If you're balanced in both red and blue pollen, give the translator to Gifted Riley Bee, as its quests may reward [[Stinger|stingers]], an [[Items|item]] that is very useful for acquiring [[Vicious Bee]] and the [[Demon Mask]].

Your second translator should go to the other bee that you ''didn't'' choose. For example, if you gave your first translator to Gifted Riley Bee, you would be recommended to give it to Gifted Bucko Bee. This is so you can get started on the other quests for more rewards.

As mentioned above, your last translator should go to Stick Bug. Stick Bug should be last, because it isn't as rewarding as the two bees. The [[Stick Bug Challenge]] periodically starts because of Onett, and other players can summon it as well if they gave a translator to Stick Bug, so giving the translator to Stick Bug will not make a big difference in terms of gameplay.

How do I get a translator?

Finish [[Science Bear]]'s new quests.

How do I start the Stick Bug Challenge?

First, get a translator, then go talk to the Stick Bug on top of the mushroom. (You'll need a [[parachute|Parachute]] or [[glider|Glider]], but if you don't have either of those, you're probably not at a high enough level to challenge Stick Bug.)

Which [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] should I get first?

The general consensus is to get [[Tabby Bee]] first, because the sooner you start collecting [[Tabby Love]], the sooner your Tabby Bee will reach the maximum level. [[Photon Bee]] is usually agreed to be the next priority. After that, it becomes a matter of how many bees you have, what colors they are, and which quests are you on, so there is no one-size-fits-all guideline.

Should I get the [[Scythe]] or the [[Bubble Wand]]?

This is a matter of opinion. In terms of absolute numbers based on the pollen collector alone, the Bubble Wand has a ''slight'' edge, but that's not the whole story. The right answer for you will depend on multiple factors, such as: Do you have more red bees or more blue bees? Do you prefer collecting pollen in a line or in a circle? Are you on a quest for a large quantity of red pollen? Some people get both tools, using one for red [[fields]] and the other for blue fields (and whichever one they happen to have equipped for white/neutral fields).

Note that as you get more bees, your pollen collector starts making less and less difference, because you'll be getting most of your pollen from stacked bombs or critical hits.

Special note about [[goo]]: most people find the Scythe works better for collecting goo, because the Bubble Wand's collecting circle is bigger than many goo puddles, so it misses most of the goo.

How do I get that royal jelly/[[ticket]] that's [insert location here]?

Check out the pages on [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] and tickets.

What is today's [[Codes|code]]?

There's no such thing as "today's code". Codes are issued when Onett deems fit, which is generally not a daily occurrence. ("Monthly" is closer to the truth.)

OK, OK, but I heard that there's a new code. How do I find out what it is?

Check the [[Codes]] page. If you're not a registered user, make sure to click both of the refresh links in the white box at the top of the page — otherwise, you'll get yesterday's page. Heck, even if you ''are'' a registered user, the refresh links can't hurt.

I know a new code! How do I add it to the Codes page?

First, make sure the code is not already listed. '''Use the refresh links''' at the top of the Codes page. Once you're absolutely positive that you're looking at the latest version of the Codes page, '''search the page''' (using your browser's Find function) for the code you want to add. Make sure your search is '''not''' case-sensitive.

If (and only if) you've done both of those steps and did not find the code, post a comment at the bottom of the page listing the code, where you found it, and what rewards it gives.

How long do I have until Photon/[[Cobalt Bee|Cobalt]]/[[Crimson Bee|Crimson]]/etc. Bee disappears?

There are currently no plans to remove any of the event bees. "Event Bee" does not mean "temporary"; it just means you can't get this bee through ordinary eggs or royal jellies.

Should I buy the Parachute? What purpose does it serve?

The Parachute is very useful for obtaining some of the royal jellies and tickets hidden around the map. (In fact, the parachute is outright necessary for some of the locations.)

I used a royal jelly on an [[:Category:Epic|Epic]] bee, and it turned into a [[:Category:Rare|Rare]] bee. Shouldn't it have turned into a [[:Category:Legendary|Legendary]] bee?

No; the probabilities for royal jelly don't depend at all on what bee you're applying it to. Even if you use royal jelly on an Event bee, it will more than likely turn into a Rare bee.

If I use a royal jelly on a [[Bond|level]] 7 bee, will it reset to level 0?

Royal jelly only transforms the ''type'' of the bee, not its level, so the new bee will still be level 7. It's also very important to remember that Gifted status is part of the type, so it '''''does''''' reset if you use a royal jelly.

If I use a royal jelly on Tabby Bee, will my Tabby Love stack reset?

No, your Tabby Love will be saved, so it's safe to use royal jelly on Tabby Bee. (But see caveat about Gifted status above.)

Whoops, I accidentally deleted my event bee. How do I undo it?

Event Bees come with a special royal jelly that will turn any bee into the event bee in question. Note that you can only have one of each type of event bee in your swarm at the same time, so the only use for the special royal jelly is to recover from precisely this situation, i.e. getting your event bee back after converting it.

Whoops, I accidentally deleted my gifted bee. Help?

Sorry, there's no way to undo this.

''Why is there a "''1st"'' flag on my event bee?''

It means that your bee is a 1st edition. [[Bear Bee]]s bought during the first month of the game's release, [[Gummy Bee]]s obtained from [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] quests, and Tabby Bees bought when it was first put on sale in the [[Ticket Tent]] are all first editions.

There's a player stuck in my hive! He never moves, and I can't read his name.

You're in hive #6, aren't you? That's the Onett statue from on top of the hives. (Onett is the game's creator.) Sometimes, he falls down and lands in odd places, like in the honeycomb of hive #6. You should be able to just play as if he weren't there - your bees will ignore him, and the hive will still be functional.

Do the royal jellies or tickets hidden around the map ever respawn?

Nope, sorry, they're a one-time-only thing.

There's no way I'm finishing this Traveling Bear's quests before he leaves. Will I be able to get the quest rewards afterwards?

Ah, yes, those last few quests can seem interminable; I feel your pain. Good news: you ''will'' be able to buy the quest rewards somewhere. (Bad news: it'll probably cost you.) For example, after [[Sun Bear]] left, the [[Belt Bag]] became available from the [[Pro Shop]] for 440,000 Honey, and the [[Mondo Belt Bag]] was put on sale in the [[Mountain Top Shop]] for 12 million Honey.

Help, I'm missing a leg/arm/head! -or- Help, I turned into a strange half-human/half-bear monster!

You died or reset while you were in [[Ability Tokens#Bear_Morph|Bear Morph]] mode, didn't you? It can also happen if you leave the game while in bear shape. The fix is to wait until you're not a bear anymore (or until you're only half bear), and then leave the game and come back.

Where do I report bugs?

First, check that your bug doesn't appear on this page or the [[Glitches|Known Glitches]] page. Next, do the Roblox equivalent of turning it off and back on again: leave the game and come back. (Important: '''don't''' reset your character! Actually close the game window and then open the game again.) Is the bug still there?

If it's a new bug which isn't fixed by leaving and coming back, but it's not preventing you from playing and doesn't involve actual money, then it's probably sufficient to report it on the [https://goo.gl/forms/eLoUcvc0BIqE71qC2 BSS Discord server's Bug Report form]. If the bug is preventing you from playing, and/or if you don't have Discord, send a message within Roblox to '''''[https://www.roblox.com/users/556387844/profile BeeSwarmBugReport]'''''. If the problem involves purchases/Robux, send a message within Roblox to '''''[https://www.roblox.com/users/556383852/profile BeeSwarmSupport]'''''. (If you're not sure, send messages to both accounts.) Depending on your Roblox privacy settings, you may have to follow the accounts before being able to send messages to them. ==Wiki FAQs==

What conventions should I follow when editing?

See the [[Editing Guidelines]] page.

I'm just getting started. What should I do?

Wikia has already a complete and user-friendly answers for editors who are just started to join Wikia. Click [[Help:Getting_Started|here]] to have a basic knowledge about Wikia.

I know about the basics. But how do I add some links and photos?

If you already know about the basic knowledge of Wikia, this [[Help:Contributing|page]] will help you about accessing Source Editor efficiently and adding media like photos and videos.

How do I get an Admin/Moderator position on this wiki?

If you would like to become an admin/mod, you must first display qualities that befit those positions, be helpful and considerate to other users, and have little to no actions taken against your account. Then, staff may notice you and consider giving you those roles.

The page is too long. Is there any faster way to do this?

Yes, there is. In fact, our staff already had a page that compiles all the wiki coding in one page. It's called [[FAQ/Wiki Code]]. This page also has information about our templates. With this, you have the knowledge not only for basic wikitext formatting, but also the templates.

I saw a vandal. What should I do?

There are two ways to remove the vandal: manually remove the edit by yourself, or report to the staff. To remove an edit yourself, go to the history section of the page (add '?action=history'), then go to the previous edit, and undo the edit. To report it to the staff, post a message on the wall of any of the admins or moderators (see the list in the sidebar of the main page) with a link to the vandalized page and/or the profile page of the offending user. [[Category:Gameplay]]

This document is intended to be a Quick Tutorial. Please amend this description to reflect purpose of this document.

==Sample Code==

See the following example, taken from [[Basic Bee]]; trivia section. (31 May 2018)

==Trivia==
* This is one of the only bees without an ability (the other one being Brave Bee).
* This is the only bee that can't be obtained from [[Royal Jelly]].
** However, there used to be Basic Bee Jelly obtained by from a code called DontUseThisJelly.
** This code has expired, so you can't obtain Basic Bee Jelly anymore.
** This is most likely the first bee the player will get and discover.
*Basic Bee and [[Demo Bee]] have the same skin colors.
*Basic Bee is the only bee that can be obtained from only a [[Basic Egg]].
*Basic Bee is the only common bee.
*Basic Bee is the most common colorless bee in the game.
{{BeeNav}}

We will be referring to this code segment in this document.

===Note on Code Segment===

This guide was originally written for mid-level players or that has a basic knowledge of wikitext.

==Preface==

Most of the codes are of a basic format. Either double "{" and closed with double "}" (curly brackets) or double "[" closed with double "]" (square brackets) or single straight quotes " ' ". Some codes from HTML 5 do support Wikia. such as ''''''.

==Basic Formatting Codes==

Basic formatting codes are simple instructions that tell the wiki you want more than plain text in a single paragraph. =D

===Paragraphs===

The extra line between paragraphs creates a new paragraph. If the line is removed, the two paragraphs will join. ''Two empty lines'' between paragraphs increases the space between paragraphs.

A colon ":" means indent, like so:

:Indent / block paragraph.

===Lists===

The asterisk "*" at the beginning of a line (no space in front) means the wiki should insert a bullet like this:

  • bullet

A "#" (hash/pound) sign means a numbered list, like so:

# Item 1
# Item 2

docs.title: Item 2
docs.text:
You can combine paragraph code and list code thus:

::* Sub level
:::# Item 1, Sub 1

::* Sub level :::# Item 1, Sub 1

or you can add indent by adding more list code:

* Title
**Sub-title

Title *Sub-title

#Media
##Photo
##Video

docs.title: Video
docs.text:
Inserting a space (by pressing enter) before the start of your text is recommended and improves readability in the source code.

===Italics & Boldface===

''italics''

gives ''italics''.

'''bold'''

gives '''bold'''.

'''''bold and italicized'''''

gives '''''bold and italicized'''''.

===Heading=== This code shows a main part of the topic such as a bee's history and trivia. Using this code creates a table of contents, which helps users to navigate throughout the page.

Normal text

==Heading 2==

===Heading 3===

====Heading 4====

=====Heading 5=====

 preformatted

The code 

 can also preformat the text.

===Links===


[[Basic Bee]]


gives [[Basic Bee]]. The square brackets mean you are trying to link to a page on the wiki (known as internal links). "Basic Bee" is the name of the page.


Note: If it didn't work as you expected, check your spelling and the capitalization. 


You can also change the name of the link. But it will lead you to the same page:


[[Basic Bee|Common Bee]]


gives [[Basic Bee|Common Bee]].


In order to add URLs (external links), single square brackets are required instead of two.


[https://www.roblox.com]


gives [https://www.roblox.com].


As you can see that it gives out number instead of the actual link. In order to solve this, you need add a name of the link. But instead of using a pipe "|" to separate it, adding a space is at least required.


[https://www.roblox.com ROBLOX]


gives [https://www.roblox.com ROBLOX].


And one step closer if you want to add a Wikipedia Link:


[[Wikipedia:Bee]]


gives [[Wikipedia:Bee]]


These are the basics. As you edit other work, you will learn more from other people's "codes".


===Reference Code===


This code's purpose is to show what data is gathered from another external page.


[[Basic Bee]] Basic Bee 



gives


[[Basic Bee]] Basic Bee 


and to show all summary of reference quotes:







gives




NOTE: These two codes must be performed or else an error will occur.


==Tables==


Sometimes we use Tables to organize and summarize data, particularly when there is large amounts of it -- e.g., for Stick Bug hp.


Code segment for Tables follow:



 {| class="wikitable"
 |-
 ! Header 1
 ! Header 2
 ! Header 3
 |-
 | row 1, cell 1
 | row 1, cell 2
 | row 1, cell 3
 |-
 | row 2, cell 1
 | row 2, cell 2
 | row 2, cell 3
 |}





The preceding code produces:




{
class="wikitable"




! Header 1



! Header 2



! Header 3




-



row 1, cell 1



row 1, cell 2



row 1, cell 3



-



row 2, cell 1



row 2, cell 2



row 2, cell 3



}




===Code Definitions===


'''{|''' and '''|}''' start and end tables respectively.


'''|-''' marks the beginning of a new row (a set of cells arranged in a horizontal manner.)


'''!''' marks the beginning of a new header cell (for titles - please do not use this as a lazy way to bold the contents of a cell)... Header cells may be assigned special functions, e.g., for sorting.


'''|''' ''at the beginning of a line'' is used to mark the beginning of a new cell. When this symbol is used ''elsewhere'', it may be used to separate the cell formatting from its contents. E.g., 
| align="center" | centered contents


[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Table Wikipedia's Help:Table] is a more complete in detail and includes advanced code &/ options if you need it.


==Templates==


Templates are documents written by (advanced) coders to allow Bee Swarm Simulator Wiki to have a consistent look throughout. The curly brackets really mean "insert this document here, with the following conditions." 


===Tabbers===


Wikia has an extension called ''"Tabber"''. They give content and title on every tab; the purpose is to make the wiki more organized and more designed.
====Content Tabbers====
Content Tabbers are type of tabbers that require to write information inside the same page. The Content Tabber uses section headers as pseudo-links to open and navigate through the tabs.



Colors=
Red, Blue, Colorless
|-|
Hats=
Helmet, Propeller Hat, Beekeeper's Mask

Red, Blue, Colorless
|-|

Helmet, Propeller Hat, Beekeeper's Mask



====Tab Viewers====
Unlike Content Tabbers, Tab Viewers just view the page contents. They require less space to configure the tabber. In order to edit the content, you need to edit it to the page where it projects it.



Scooper|Page 1||
Pouch|Page 2||
Backpack|Page 3||




gives



Scooper|Page 1||
Pouch|Page 2||
Backpack|Page 3||




There are three parts of the tab viewer:
* The actual link of the page,
* Name projected and,
* The pipe.


The pipe separates the text. Add a pipe "|" to separate the link and the name, while two pipes "||" to separate the tabs.


Like for example, if something is wrong about Page 2, you need to go to [[Tab View 2]] page.
===Template ''"Bee"''===


''Main Page:''[[Template:Bee]]


===Template ''"Bear"''===


''Main Page:''[[Template:Bear]]
{{Bear/doc}}


===Notice Templates ===
Templates are used for giving notices above the page content. These templates do not require to fill-up information.
* Template Stub
: Stubs are used when a section of the page is partially finished or not yet added.

docs.title: Festive Bean
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Festive Bean.png |description = Plants a Festive Sprout in the field you're standing in. |cooldown = 2 hours }}

'''Festive Bean''' is a special variant of the {{Cost|Magic Bean|4=1}} that always plants a [[Sprout|Festive Sprout]] in a [[Fields|field]]. When harvested, it grants {{Cost|Ticket|4=}}, [[Crafting|crafting materials]], and unique tokens that are commonly found in [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|festive gifts]] in abundant quantities. There is a 120 minute (2 hour) cooldown between planting Festive Sprouts. Since the end of Beesmas 2019, only the player who planted can receive the {{Cost|Festive Blessing}} and {{Cost|Beesmas Cheer}} buffs to avoid overuse. When a player plants a Festive Sprout, the following message appears, reading: {{Notification|Red|"🌱 {Username} has planted a Festive Sprout 🌱}}

When planted, the following audio also plays:

[[File:Dth1.ogg]]

== Festive Sprout Rewards == {| class="article-table" !Possible Rewards List |- |{{Cost|Treat}}{{Cost|Ticket}}{{Cost|Gumdrops}}{{Cost|Festive Blessing}} (30 seconds of buff per token, appears only to the sprout's planter){{Cost|Beesmas Cheer}} (30 seconds of buff per token, appears only to the sprout's planter){{Cost|Snowflake}}{{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} (Only during Beesmas){{Cost|Glitter}}{{Cost|Enzymes}}{{Cost|Red Extract}}{{Cost|Blue Extract}}{{Cost|Magic Bean}}{{Cost|Glue}}{{Cost|Oil}}{{Cost|Flying Bee Bear Sticker|||0}} (Rare) |}

==Ways to Obtain== There is an exceptionally rare chance to obtain a {{Cost|Festive Bean||4=1}} from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]]. The [[Festive Bee]] that made the gift does not need to be [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]. An extremely low chance to drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. A very rare drop from a {{Cost|Festive Planter|4=1}}. * An extremely low chance to drop from a [[Mythic Meteor Shower]]. * A very rare reward from the [[Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]]. * A very rare drop from the [[Stockings]]. * As an extremely rare drop from [[Onett's Lid Art]]. * The Festive [[Gift Boxes|Gift Box]] awards {{Cost|Festive Bean|2|2=2}}. * [[Stick Bug|Stick bug]]'s Beesmas quest rewards {{Cost|Festive Bean|1|4=1}}. * Buying certain items in [[Bee Bear’s Catalog|Bee Bear's Catalog]]: The Critter Comforts Pack gives {{Cost|Festive Bean|1|4=1}}. The Reindeer Games Pack gives {{Cost|Festive Bean|3}}. The Beans-mas Boosting Bundle gives {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}}. Purchasing the Starry Night Special in the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|1700}} gives {{Cost|Festive Bean|10}} + other stuff.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

{{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} were included in the Happy Honeyday Pack, and could be bought for {{Cost|Robux|900}} in the Robux Shop (limit 1 per player). {{Cost|Festive Bean}} were purchasable for {{Cost|Robux|250}} each in the Robux Shop (Limit five per player). The sale ended on January 2, 2019. Purchasing the Magic Mythical Pack for {{Cost|Robux|800}} gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Doodle Pack for {{Cost|Robux|1700}} gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Festive Frenzy Haul in the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux|4500}} gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. {{Cost|Festive Bean|1}} was able to be earned by completing the [[Bubble Bee Man#Quest .28Inside 30 Bee Gate.29|B.B.M. Mission]] quest in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]]. The [[Ornament Presents|Pearly Present]] next to the [[Wind Shrine]] gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff when opened. The [[Ornament Presents|Mondo Present]] on top of the [[Mountain Top Shop]] gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|6}} + other stuff when opened. Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Merry Gift Box]] gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|2}} + other stuff. Purchasing certain items in [[Bee Bear’s Catalog|Bee Bear's Catalog]]: Purchasing the Beesmas Tree Bundle gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}}. Purchasing the Blessed Bean Bundle gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|10}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Festive Bundle gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|2}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Bean Bundle in Bee Bear's Catalog for {{Cost|Snowflake|2500}} gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|1|4=1}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Festive Bundle in Bee Bear's catalog for {{Cost|Snowflake|5000}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|100}} gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Jolly Jumbo Pack in the Robux Shop gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. Purchasing the Angelic Bundle in Bee Bear's Catalog gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Earthen Gift Box]] gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|1}} + other stuff. Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Festive Gift Box]] gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|2}} + other stuff. Opening the Beesmas 2020 Mondo Gift Box gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|3}} + other stuff. Opening the Beesmas 2021 Mondo Gift Box gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|5}} + other stuff. Opening the Beesmas Summer 2024 Mondo Gift Box gave {{Cost|Festive Bean|3}} + other stuff.

==Trivia==

At the end of Beesmas 2019, tokens from Festive Sprouts became unshareable. However, they are now shareable again, with the "Festive Blessing" and "Beesmas Cheer" buffs being the only private rewards. If summoned by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] (or one of his many aliases), a Festive Sprout's {{Cost|Festive Blessing}}, and {{Cost|Beesmas Cheer}} can be shared between all the players. They cannot be grabbed by abilities that collect personal tokens (e.g. [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] or [[Ability Tokens#Triangulate|Triangulate]]) as the tokens do not belong to any player. This bean is the only variant of {{Cost|Magic Bean|4=}}. This and the {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|4=1}} are the only event items that can be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]]. The {{Cost|Festive Bean|4=1}} is the only way for a Festive Sprout to be planted, with the exception of Onett planting them. The {{Cost|Festive Bean|4=1}} is the item with the longest cooldown in the game, being 2 hours. This and the {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=1}} are the only event items that are infinitely renewable outside of an event. This item cannot be used during the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * Festive Beans are the only way to get {{Cost|Snowflake}} outside of Beesmas, though they won't appear in the player's inventory even if they pick up the tokens. *They will be visible if {{Cost|Snowflake}} are already in the player's hotbar.

docs.title: Festive Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |color = Red |rarity = Event |image-orig = Festive Bee.png |image-gifted = FestiveBee Gifted.png |description = A jolly bee who loves giving gifts! It's purely motivated by the joy of others. |energy = 20 |speed = 16.1 |attack = 1 |skincolor1 = #ad2222 |skincolor2 = #227d3d |skincolor3 = #ad2222 }}'''Festive Bee''' is a [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]]. It can be purchased in the [[Ticket Tent]] for 500 [[ticket]]s, replacing [[Gummy Bee|Gummy Bee's]] former spot. It was also obtainable through different means during the first three [[Beesmas]] events.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

'''Festive''' bee likes the [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Mushroom Field]], and the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. It dislikes the [[Blue Flower Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 40 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 150 [[Honey]] in 1 second. * +20% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +30 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +70 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +75% [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Speed]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: x1.25 [[System Page#Convert Rate At Hive|Convert Rate at Hive]]

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|[Festive Gift]]]''': Grants random gifts including [[Treats]], honey, and "[[Ability Tokens#Festive Blessing|Festive Blessing]]" to all players on the server. Gifts are improved with [[Level]]. A message will appear saying "🎁 Festive Gifts from [Player's Display Name]! 🎁". If Gifted, can grant rarer gifts and "[[Ability Tokens#Beesmas Cheer|Beesmas Cheer]]". * '''[[Ability Tokens#Mark|[Honey Mark]]]''' : Marks a random area on the [[Fields|field]] for 7 seconds (+0.2s per level) that grants 2 Conversion Links and x1.25 Convert Rate while you stand in it. Stacks up to 3 times. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb|[Red Bomb+]]]''': Collects 10 pollen from 29 surrounding red [[Flowers]] (+10% pollen per level). You can combo with other bombs to increase power. * '''[[Ability Tokens|[Festive Mark]]]''': Marks a very large random area on the field for 12 seconds (+0.5s per level) that grants +10% [[Honey Per Pollen|Honey per Pollen]], x1.4 bomb pollen, x1.4 red bomb pollen, 100% instant bomb conversion, and 5 conversion links to all players who stand in it. While active, it summons Red Boosts and random gifts within its radius. Rarer gifts grow more likely with bee level, and certain gifts are only possible if the bee is Gifted. This mark can link with marks from all players. '''This ability token can only be obtained with the [[Festive Wreath]] [[Beequip]] when it’s equipped to Festive Bee.''' The beequip could’ve been obtained by completing all of [[Bee Bear]]'s quests during the 2020 [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] event or by opening the [[Gift Boxes|Festive Gift Box]] during the Beesmas 2021 and Beesmas 2022 events. ** The {{Cost|Festive Wreath|4=0}} [[Beequip]] can currently be obtained by opening the [[Gift Boxes|Festive Gift Box]] as of Beesmas 2024 (Winter).

{{Stat|pollen = 40|pollentime = 4|color = Red|honey = 150|honeytime = 1|rarity = event}}

File:Hivesticker flying festive bee.png|The Flying Festive Bee [[Sticker]].

== Trivia == * This was the third Event bee to have ability tokens that can be summoned by non-Event bees (Honey Mark and Red Bomb+), the first being [[Photon Bee]] ([[Ability Token#Haste|Haste]]) and the second being [[Vicious Bee]] (Blue Bomb+). * This bee likes the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. This is a reference due to most Christmas trees being pine trees. ** This also makes it the only red bee to like this field. * This bee, [[Buoyant Bee]], and [[Digital Bee]] are the only bees that can apply buffs to the entire server. (More specifically, Balloons, Festive Gifts, and Field Corruption.) * This bee, [[Rage Bee]] and [[Spicy Bee]] are the only red bees to produce tokens that don't give primary benefit to only red (Festive Bee yields Honey Mark tokens and both Rage Bee and Spicy Bee yield [[Ability Tokens#Rage|Rage]] tokens). * This was the second bee available to be bought for Robux, the first being [[Bear Bee]]. ** However, this was the first bee to be obtainable through both [[quests]] and Robux; and the second bee to be obtained through quests overall, the first being Gummy Bee. * When Festive Gift activates, it plays the first few notes from the classic Christmas song "[[Wikipedia:Deck the Halls|Deck the Halls]]". When collecting the Festive Blessing and Beesmas Cheer tokens, the players can hear the next few notes. * A [[First Edition Bee|First Edition]] Festive Bee's flag is offset and is placed behind where it normally is to make room for the bee's bow. * Due to a bug, Festive Bees obtained from the Ticket Tent before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]] might have received a First Edition Flag in that update despite not being a true First Edition Bee. * It was the only Event bee that could have been obtained in two different ways (excluding Robux packs) at the same time: The Festive Present next to Bee Bear and in the Ticket Tent for 500 tickets during Beesmas 2019. * This bee, along with [[Windy Bee]], are the only bees with tinted wings when not gifted. * According to Bee Bear, his Festive Bee is female. * It could be obtained during [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas 2018]] by completing the Bee Bear questline or by purchasing the Festive Bee Pack for 1600 Robux in the [[Robux Shop]]. * It could have been obtained through the [[Ornament Presents|Festive Present]], in the Beesmas 2019 Event. If the player already had Festive Bee, they would instead get 500 tickets. * In Beesmas 2020, this bee can be obtained after finishing Bee Bear’s questline. If the player already has a Festive Bee, they are awarded 500 tickets instead. * This and [[Puppy Bee]] are the only [[bees]] that have an exclusive [[Beequip]] for themselves. * Festive Bee is the only non-colorless bee capable of making Mark tokens. * After Beesmas 2020, the models of Festive and Puppy Bee, wearing their respective exclusive beequips, were moved outside of the main map, just behind [[Commando Chick's Hideout]]. * Festive Bee and [[Riley Bee]] are the only red bees to like three fields. * Festive bee is the only bee to have a [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]]-exclusive [[Sticker|sticker.]]

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Festive_Nymph_Decoration.png|thumb|Festive Nymphs.|alt=]] The '''Festive Nymph''' is a variant of [[Stick Nymph]] that can be summoned by [[Stick Bug]] during the [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. Festive Nymphs are only available after finishing Stick Bug's Beesmas 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024 (Summer) and 2024 (Winter) [[Quests|quest]] - Stick Bug's Nymph Hats. Other players could attack and collect rewards from Festive Nymphs. (The player who started the challenge must complete Stick Bug's quest first, otherwise no Festive Nymphs will appear.)

Festive Nymphs followed the player closest to them and deal damage if they have touched a player, like their regular counterparts. Despite their low stats, Festive Nymphs, along with the Stick Nymphs, would usually be summoned in large groups, often outnumbering players.

== Gallery == Festive Nymph.png|A picture of a Festive Nymph. Festive nymph blessing token (2).png|A Festive Nymph blessing token. Festive Nymph Blessing x5.png|Festive Nymph Blessing Icon. 0D601F09-F6A0-4BC2-A462-8A01D2714C01.jpg|The Festive Nymph maxed blessing stats. Festive Nymph Bell.png|A {{Cost|Night Bell|||0}} from a Festive Nymph. Screen Shot 2021-03-01 at 5.04.55 PM.png|The caption when the player walked on the Festive Nymphs' pad after Beesmas. Festive Nymph Snow Storm moment.png.png|A Gifted Festive Nymph summoning a Snow Storm.

== Trivia == * Like Stick Nymphs, Festive Nymphs can follow players out of the [[Fields|field]] they were in and can either be gone through or be obstructed by some objects. They can also go into certain locations such as the [[King Beetle's Lair]] and get into spots where they couldn't reach the player. This allowed the player to exploit them and deal damage from afar. * Just like [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]] and the stick nymphs, they lose health every second; Mondo Chick always loses 333 health per second, but Festive Nymph and Stick Nymph's health depletes faster when their level is higher. It is possible for them to be defeated naturally unlike Mondo Chick who would have 300 health left after 15 minutes. They would drop rewards regardless if they have been attacked or not. * Onett has also summoned the Stick Bug Challenge with Festive Nymphs. * Festive Nymphs are unable to jump, so if the player got higher than the Festive Nymph's hitbox, they would not be able to damage them. * Festive Nymphs and Stick Nymphs are the only [[mobs]] that can be summoned by another mob. ** These are two of 18 mobs that cannot spawn naturally, as in the player cannot simply walk in a field and fight it, the other mobs being the five types of [[Ants]], [[Snowbear]], Stick Bug, the five [[Robo Bear Challenge]] Mobs, and the four [[Robo Party]] mobs. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Stick Bug Challenge]] [[Category:Removed Content]]

It grows in 4 hours of playtime, and grants 3x more nectar. The chances of a Festive Planter spawning a [[Puffshroom]] is 1/10 (10%)

Only {{Cost|Festive Planter|1}} can be active at a time. ==Drops== ''Note that some drops and buffs it gives are based on the field the planter is in.''

== Ways to Obtain== '''There are currently no ways to obtain a {{Cost|Festive Planter|4=0}} ===The methods below are no longer possible.===

By purchasing certain items/bundles from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]: ** Buying the Festive Planter for 100 [[Snowflake]]s and 10 [[Gingerbread Bear]]s during the 2021, 2022 and 2024 [[Beesmas]] events. Buying the Hefty Honeyday Bundle in Bee Bear's Catalog for {{Cost|Snowflake|25,000}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|250}} gave {{Cost|Festive Planter|10}} and other items. Purchasing the Purple Planter Pack for 800 Robux gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|2}} and other items. ** Buying the Merry Mondo Bundle for {{Cost|Snowflake|25,000}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|250}} which gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|10}} and other items. ** Buying the Festive Bundle For 750 [[Snowflake|Snowflakes]] and 75 [[Gingerbread Bear]] which gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|2}} and other items. Purchasing in Bee Bear's Catalog for 100 [[Snowflake|Snowflakes]] and 10 [[Gingerbread Bear|Gingerbread Bears]]. Buying Planter Sampler Pack gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|1}} and other items. Buying Triumphant Turp Pack gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|10}} and other items. Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 5th and 10th quest of Snow Cub Reformation. * By opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]: Opening the Festive Gift Box from 2021 gave 1 Festive Planter, 2 if the player already had the [[Festive Wreath]], it also gave other items. Opening the Festive Gift Box from 2022 or 2024 gave {{Cost|Festive Planter|2}} and other items. Opening the Mondo Gift Box from 2021 and 2022 gave {{Cost|Festive Planter|5}} and other items. *By purchasing certain offers in the [[Robux Shop]]: Purchasing the Festive Frenzy Haul for 4,500 robux gave {{Cost|Festive Planter|10}} and other items. Purchasing the Mondo Robo Bundle gave {{Cost|Festive Planter|10}} and other items. {{Cost|Festive Planter|10}} were included in the Royal Winter Wonder Haul in the Robux Shop. As a reward for completing Onett's Beesmas 2022 or 2024 Quest. As a reward for completing Spirit Bear's Beesmas 2022 or 2024 Quest. Completing Bee Bear's 10th and 20th quest rewards the player with a Festive Planter. * Completing the Bee Bear's ¨Festive Planter Prep¨ gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|1}} and other items. * Completing Onett´s Winter Beesmas 2024 Quest gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|1}} and other items. * Completing Spirit Bear's Winter Beesmas 2024 Quest gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|1}} and other items. * Completing Rank 40 Robo Party Cake gives {{Cost|Festive Planter|1}} and other items. As a reward for completing your own Robo Party (Rank 40).

==Gallery == Full Grown Festive Planter.jpg|A fully grown Festive Planter. Festive Planter with a puffshroom..png|A Festive Planter hosting a [[Puffshroom]]. Festive Planter Inventory.png|A Festive Planter in the inventory. Floating festive planter.jpg|A newly placed Festive Planter in the Stump Field.

==Trivia== At this time, the max possible amount of Festive Planters a player can own is 100. This is the only planter that can drop Magic Beans. This planter gives the best Nectar multiplier in the game (3x), overtaking the [[Ticket Planter]] and [[Sticker Planter]] that give a x2 nectar multiplier. This is one of the four planters that aren't reusable. Others being the [[Ticket Planter]], [[Sticker Planter]] and the [[Paper Planter]]. **Out of these four, the Festive Planter is the only one that is non-renewable.

docs.text: {{Beequip}} {{Unobtainable}} The {{Color|Festive Wreath}} is a [[Bond|level]] 10 [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] [[Beequip]]. It has an equip limit of one. It has a red color requirement. It can only be equipped to [[Festive Bee]]. ==Possible Stats== {{BeequipStatsTable}} ==Ways To Obtain== ===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Festive Gift Box]] during [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] 2021 and 2022 and 2024, located behind [[Onett's Lid Art]]. Before Beesmas Summer 2024, if you already have the Festive Wreath, you would get {{Cost|Ticket|250}} and a {{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}} instead. Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 25th Beesmas 2020 [[Quests|quest]]. |} ==Gallery== Screen Shot 2021-02-01 at 3.02.39 PM.png|left|thumb|Bee Bear's Festive Bee wearing a Festive Wreath. Festive Mark Image.jpg|thumb|Festive mark on a field. File:1st Edition Gifted Festive Bee with Festive Wreath.png|A First Edition Mutated Gifted Festive Bee wearing a Festive Wreath. File:FestiveWreathInCase.jpg|Festive Wreath in a player's Beequip Case. ==Trivia== The {{Cost|Festive Wreath|4=1}} and the {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers|4=1}} share many similarities: The two are the only beequips to have models visible on the bee that they are equipped to. Before the [[Updates#2024.01.12|2024/01/12 update]]'s removal of permanent beequips, the two were the only permanent beequips in the game. This was the second permanent beequip added to the game, preceded by the Reindeer Antlers. They were the only beequips that cannot be discarded. {{Cost|Caustic Wax}} were unable to be used on these two beequips. However, this is no longer the case. A model of a Festive Bee with the Festive Wreath can be found outside the map, next to a model of a [[Puppy Bee]] with Reindeer Antlers. This is the one of three beequips to give a unique ability. The other two are {{Cost|Snowglobe|4=1}} and {{Cost|Reindeer Antlers|4=1}}. *The model of the Festive Wreath on Festive Bee is the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/191097654/Deluxe-Christmas-Wreath Deluxe Christmas Wreath] Roblox accessory. {{Items}} [[Category:Beequips]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Permanent Beequip]] [[Category:Red]] [[zh-tw:歡樂花圈]]

docs.title: Field Booster
docs.text:
[[File:FieldBooster.png|thumb|220x220px|The Field Booster.]] The '''Field Booster''' is a booster that provides a [[Field Boost|field boost]] to a random [[field]] that is either [[:Category:Colorless|colorless]] or has no primary color (mixed fields) for 15 minutes. The machine is located beyond the [[Lion Bee Gate]], between the [[Mountain Top Shop]] and the [[Ticket Shop]]. In order to use it, the player needs to have discovered 20 bee types. The cooldown is 45 minutes.

The following audio plays when the Field Booster has been activated:[[File:Fieldbooster.ogg]]

== Boosts == * [[Sunflower Field]]: +300% [[pollen]] * [[Dandelion Field]]: +300% pollen * [[Spider Field]]: +200% pollen * [[Clover Field]]: +200% pollen * [[Pineapple Patch]]: +200% pollen * [[Pumpkin Patch]]: +200% pollen * [[Cactus Field]]: +100% pollen

== Gallery == SunflowerFieldBoostSparkles.png|A boosted Sunflower Field. Sunflower Field Icon.png|The Sunflower Field boost icon. Dandelion Field Icon.png|The Dandelion Field boost icon. Pineapple Patch Icon.png|The Pineapple Patch boost icon. Spider Field Icon.png|The Spider Field boost icon. Clover Field Icon.png|The Clover Field boost icon. Pumpkin Patch Icon.png|The Pumpkin Patch boost icon. Cactus Field Icon.png|The Cactus Field boost icon.

== Trivia == * This is one of the three field boosters in the game, along with the [[Blue Field Booster]] and the [[Red Field Booster]]. ** The Field Booster has the same design as the Red and Blue Field Boosters, the only difference being the colors and that it has a sign. * The [[Coconut Field]] and the [[Mountain Top Field]] cannot be boosted using the Field Booster, despite not being a specifically-colored field. * Prior to the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the player could access the booster without having 25 bees. They only needed to '''discover''' 25 bees to unlock the [[Red Cannon]], which fires them to the Mountain Top Field. Since then, the player will now be teleported back to spawn due to it being an attempt to bypass a [[:Category:Gates|gate]]. * Prior to the 9/28/2019 update, the cooldown of the booster used to be 2 hours. * The Field Booster gives more pollen for fields that appear at the beginning of the game to compensate for their smaller [[Flowers|flower]] sizes. The Field Booster's model is a modified version of EndorsedModel's [https://www.roblox.com/library/530963839/Teleport Teleport]. This is the only Field Booster to give a field boost of 200% today, as in the past, the Red Field Booster granted 200% Strawberry Field boost and the Blue Field Booster granted 200% Bamboo Field boost.

docs.title: Field Capacity
docs.text:
[[File:Field_Capacity_Buff_Icon.png|thumb|The Pepper Patch Capacity Buff Icon.]] '''Field Capacity''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that increases the player's [[Capacity|Capacity Multiplier]] depending on what kind of [[Fields|field]] they are in. There are 2 types of field capacity: colored field capacity (shown as a stat) and field capacity for a specific field (shown as a buff).

== Ways to Obtain ==

  • Donating certain stickers to the sticker stack can grant field capacity.

  • Colored field capacity multiplies the player's capacity depending on the percentage of the specific [[pollen]] type in the field. ** Red field capacity can be obtained from [[Riley Bee|Riley Bee's]] gifted hive bonus, the [[Demon Mask]] and [[Passive Abilities#Scorching Star|Scorching Star]]. ** Blue field capacity can be obtained from [[Bucko Bee|Bucko Bee's]] gifted hive bonus and [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|Bubble Bloat]] (Bubble Bloat can only be obtained if the player has [[Passive Abilities|Pop Star]] passive on [[Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulet]]). ** White field capacity can be obtained from [[Exhausted Bee|Exhausted Bee's]] gifted hive bonus, the [[Gummy Mask]] and [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Star|Gummy Star]].

  • Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]:
  • Using certain [[Beequip]]s that include a Field Capacity boost stat. The {{Cost|Warm Scarf|||0}} grants +1% to +3% Red and White Field Capacity. The {{Cost|Pinecone|||0}} grants +8% to +15% Pine Tree Forest Capacity. The {{Cost|Snow Tiara|||0}} grants +2% to +5% Blue Field Capacity and +3% to +5% White Field Capacity. The {{Cost|Rose Headband|||0}} grants 14% to +40% Rose Field Capacity.

===The methods below are no longer possible.=== * Every [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] grants x1.5 field capacity for 30 minutes to the boosted field (only obtainable from codes). All [[Ornaments|Beesmas 2020]] and [[Ornaments|2021 Ornaments]] (excluding [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]'s ornament) gave field capacity as a stat. Redeeming certain expired codes: ** RebootXmas (gave +100% [[Clover Field]] Capacity + other stuff). ** Buoyant (gave [[Blue Flower Field]] Capacity x3 + other stuff). ** WintersEnd (gave +100% Spider Field Capacity, +100% Pine Tree Forest Capacity + and other stuff). 3YearParty (gave [[Mountain Top Field]] Capacity x3 + other stuff). 5mMembers (gave [[Pine Tree Forest]] Capacity x3 and [[Rose Field]] Capacity x3 + other stuff). **RedMarket (gave [[Pepper Patch]] Capacity x1 + other stuff). ** Mocito100T (gave [[Coconut Field]] Capacity x2 + other stuff). ** BANNED (gave [[Spider Field]] Code Buff [+100% Spider Field pollen, +100% Spider Field Capacity] + other stuff). ** All [[Ready Player Two]] codes give Code Buffs on different fields. ** ThreeBeeVee (gave [[Mountain Top Field]] Code Buff, granting +100% Mountain Top Field Capacity).

== Colored Field Capacity Formula == The following formula shows how much capacity multiplier a player gets in a field:

Let x equal the colored capacity multiplier.Let y equal the percentage of that [[pollen]] type in the field.

Capacity multiplier in the field =

{{{{x ~ - ~ 1} ~ \times ~ {{\frac{y}{100}}} ~ + ~ 1}}}

==Trivia== The [[Spider Field]] is the only field where the player is guaranteed to get 100% of a colored capacity bonus, specifically white field capacity. This is achievable with Exhausted Bee's gifted hive bonus, by using the [[Gummy Mask]], activating Gummy Star, the Warm Scarf's hive bonus, or the Snow Tiara's hive bonus. The only opposite version of this is in the [[Mountain Top Field]], it generates no white flowers and therefore doesn't give white field capacity. It is also possible to get 100% of a colored capacity bonus on any other field if they generate entirely with one color of flowers, but the odds of a field generating like that is exceptionally rare. The Field Capacity Buff, Field Code Buff, Capacity Buff, and the x2 Pollen Boost are the only code-exclusive buffs.

docs.title: Field Dice
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Fdice.png |description = Boosts a random field, granting +100% pollen for 15 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second }} {{Color|Field Dice}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]]. When used, It boosts a random [[Fields|field]] the player has access to, granting a +100% [[pollen]] [[Field Boost]] for that field for 15 minutes. If the player uses another field dice, or any other type of dice while a Field Boost from a dice is still active, the new field boost will override the old one, preventing the Field Boost from stacking up.

As of the 12/26/2021 Update, there are currently 3 types of dice in the game, those being Field Dice, [[Smooth Dice]] and [[Loaded Dice]].

The following audio plays when a field dice is used:[[File:Fdice.ogg]]

== Ways of Obtaining == * [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Soft Wax|1}} ** {{Cost|Whirligig|1}} ** {{Cost|Red Extract|1}} ** {{Cost|Blue Extract|1}}

=== Drops === * As a drop from [[mobs]], such as [[aphid]]s, [[ladybug]]s, [[scorpion]]s, [[spider]]s, [[Werewolf|werewolves]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], and [[Mondo Chick]]. * A rare drop from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] (if [[Festive Bee]] is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]). * A rare drop from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a reward by donating to the [[Wind Shrine]]. * As a reward from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * As a rare drop from a [[Cub Buddy]] gift. * As a drop from specific [[planter]]s. ** The {{Cost|Tacky Planter}} and {{Cost|Petal Planter}} drop field dice as a bonus drop. * As a drop from [[Mythic Meteor Shower]].

  • Matching a pair of field dice in [[Memory Match]].
  • Adding the Wishbone [[sticker]] to the [[Sticker Stack]] rewards 5 field dice === Quests ===
  • [[Black Bear]] rewards field dice on the following quest: ** High Altitude gives 1 field dice. ** Colorful Craving gives 3 field dice. ** Smorgasbord gives 3 field dice. ** One Stop On The Tip Top gives 5 field dice. ** Bamboo Boogie 2: Bamboo Boogaloo gives 3 field dice. ** Low Tier Treck gives 5 field dice. ** Variety Fetcher 2 gives 5 field dice.
  • [[Brown Bear]] rewards field dice on the completion of these quests: ** Brown Bear's 5th quest rewards 3 field dice. ** Brown Bear's 15th quest rewards 5 field dice. ** Brown Bear's 65th quest rewards 5 field dice. ** Brown Bear's 145th quest rewards 5 field dice. ** Brown Bear's 205th quest rewards 5 field dice.
  • [[Spirit Bear]] rewards field dice on the following quests: ** The First Offering gives 3 field dice. ** Nature's Lessons gives 3 field dice. ** Beauty Duty gives 5 field dice. ** Beeternity gives 5 field dice. ** Space Oblivion gives 5 field dice. ** Pollenpalooza gives 5 field dice. ** Bear Without Despair gives 10 field dice. ** Echoing Call gives 10 field dice. [[Sun Bear]] rewards field dice on the following quest: *⛳Golfing With Sun Bear (2/3): Right On Target gives 3 field dice.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | *[[Bee Bear]] rewards field dice on the following quests: ** Robotic Beesmas gives 1 field dice. ** Commence The Wrapping gives 5 field dice. ** Merry Mechsquitos gives 10 field dice. * Purchasing the Whirling Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. * As a reward from the Robo Party. * As a drop from [[stockings]]. * Opening up the [[Ornament Presents|Funky Present]] gave 4 field dice along with other items. * Collecting the field dice token found inside of the [[Beesmas Tree]] during Beesmas 2019. * Purchasing the Booster Bundle during Beesmas 2020 from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gave 5 field dice along with other items. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** FeelingLucky (Gave 3 field dice and 1h [[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Conversion Boost]]). ** BeeDay2019 (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** ClubCloud (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** Reboot2020 (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** BeesmasBegins (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** 2Years (Gave 3 field dice + other stuff). ** 4MilMembers (Gave 4 field dice + other stuff). ** NewMic (Gave 10 field dice + other stuff). ** BlackFriday (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** 3YearParty (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** 500mil (Gave 5 field dice + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gave 1 field dice + other stuff). ** WalmartToys (Gives 1 field dice + other stuff). . |}

== Crafting Uses == Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Field Dice|0}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Field Dice}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |3 |{{Cost|Soft Wax|3}}{{Cost|Whirligig|3}}{{Cost|Oil|3}} |[[File:Smooth Dice.png|center|80px]]{{Color|Smooth Dice}} |}

== Trivia == * Field Dice's raw ingredients cost: ** {{Cost|Whirligig|1}} ** {{Cost|Honeysuckle|5}} ** {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|50}} ** {{Cost|Pineapple|50}} ** {{Cost|Blueberry|50}} ** {{Cost|Strawberry|50}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|50}} or {{Cost|Honey|50,000,000}} * The field icons shown on the dice are the [[Pine Tree Forest]], the [[Strawberry Field]], and the [[Blue Flower Field]]. * This item is similar to {{Cost|Glitter}}, because they both give a 100% pollen boost on a field. However, it can only be used every 15 minutes, and the player can choose which field to boost. * Field Dice is actually a plural name. The singular version of this item would be Field Die. * It is possible to get a [[Mountain Top Field]] Boost and [[Coconut Field]] Boost from field dice. ** Unlike this, [[Field Booster]]s can’t give a boost to said fields. * Donating 3 field dice to the [[Wind Shrine]] is almost guaranteed to summon [[Wild Windy Bee]]. * There used to be a limit of 25 field dice, but it was removed in the 12/26/21 update. * The Field Dice used to be able to stack field boost allowing player to get up to 300% field boosts from it, it was later reworked in 12/26/21 update, where dice system was reworked and with the introduction of new dice types. * Rolling the same field three times in a row grants the [[Sticker|Triple Exclamation Sticker]], spawning it in the field rolled. ** The chance of this happening is 1/289 (≈0.34%). This is because the first field can be any field and the others must be the same. ** In addition, rolling the same four or more times in a row will continue to grant the sticker. ** The message for this is "Oh! That Field Dice had something on it." * Normally, rolling the same field twice with field dice would just refresh the boost, but if you roll a field, leave, and then roll until you get the field again, it would stack (doesn’t go beyond the limit though).

docs.title: Field Wind
docs.text:
[[File:Screenshot 2022-03-26 120621.png|thumb|A field wind showing it's length, field boost and conversion.]] A '''Field Wind''' is a stacking buff that grants a bonus to [[pollen]] and [[Instant Conversion|instant conversion]] to a specific [[Fields|field]]. Each stack of a field wind increases pollen gained from its field by a set amount depending on the field, and also gives 3% instant conversion to the field starting with a base of 25%. Field winds last for 30 minutes. Field winds are obtained by donating certain [[items]] to the [[Wind Shrine]] or using various [[codes]]. Field wind tokens from the Wind Shrine have a lifespan of 30 seconds.

With each application, the field winds stacks add up, and the duration resets to 30 minutes. If there's another code that gives a boost for that same field, this can be used to extend or reset the timer for another 30 minutes. The max stack for field winds is x15. Field winds can stack up to x15 if the item donated is rare enough and the player has enough [[Wind Shrine#Favor|favor]].

Field winds can also be replenished with codes, for example, if the Wind Shrine and a code both grant field winds, it restarts the 30 minutes field winds timer.

Unlike its [[Field Boost|field boost]] counterpart, fields boosted with winds do not give off [[sparkles]]. However, the icons used to identify field winds are the same as field boosts, except they have a white background.

Lower level fields tend to have more field pollen than other fields.

Specific items donated to the Wind Shrine can give specific winds. For example, donating Pineapples makes it more likely to give Pineapple Field Winds. Below is a table containing which items correlate with which fields. Many of these are unknown, and fields with no text in the donation column means it is unknown. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table" !Field !Donation |- | Dandelion Field |Bitterberries, Moon Charms, Tropical Drinks |- | Clover Field | |- | Sunflower field |Sunflower Seeds, Moon Charms, Oil, Tropical Drinks |- |Blue Flower Field |Blueberries, Blue Extract, Purple Potion, |- |Mushroom Field |Strawberries, Red Extract, Purple Potion |- |Strawberry Field |Strawberries, Red Extract, Purple Potion |- |Spider Field |Bitterberries, Moon Charms, Neonberries, Tropical Drinks |- | Bamboo Field |Blueberries, Blue Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Pineapple Patch |Pineapples, Moon Charms, Enzymes, Tropical Drinks |- | Stump Field |Gumdrops, Glue, Blue Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Cactus Field | |- |Pumpkin Patch | |- |Pine Tree Forest |Blueberries, Blue Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Rose Field |Strawberries, Red Extracts, Purple Potion |- | Mountain Top Field |Tickets, Basic Eggs |- |Pepper Patch |Strawberries, Red Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Coconut Field |Coconuts, Moon Charms, Tropical Drinks, Sunflower Seeds |- |Hub Field |N/A |}

docs.title: Fields
docs.text:
'''Fields''', also referred to as "patches" or "[[Pine Tree Forest|forests]]" are square/rectangle areas of [[flowers]] scattered around the map, where players are able to collect [[pollen]], which can be converted into [[honey]] at their [[hive]], or by other methods. There are a total of 19 different fields in the game. Each field consists of flowers, which come in three different colors: blue, red, and white. The flowers also vary slightly each time a player joins a server. The more flowers in each square, the more pollen it gives and the faster it regrows; however, [[Fuzzy Bee]] or any bee equipped with a {{Cost|Poinsettia|4=0}}, {{Cost|Rose Headband|4=0}} or {{Cost|Lei|4=0}} can pollinate it and increase the number of flowers on a square. [[Passive Abilities|Guiding Star]] pollinates flowers when it hovers over a field. [[Passives#Diamond Drain|Diamond Drain]] also pollinates blue flowers. Fields can also spawn {{Cost|Honey|}} and {{Cost|Treat|}} in form of tokens.

docs.title: Fire Ant
docs.text:
{{Mob |title=Fire Ant |image=FireAnt.png |location=[[Ant Field]] while the [[Ant Challenge]] is active. |hp=25 base; Increases by level |damage=30 (from flame trail) 40 (when touched) |points=None |bond=None |honey=None |level=1-16 (Varies with Wave) }} A '''Fire Ant''' is one of five [[ants]] that are exclusively found in the [[Ant Challenge]], past the [[Ant Gate]].

This is the last Ant Challenge [[Mobs|mob]] that the player will encounter. Fire Ants typically spawn in the later waves, such as after the first [[Giant Ant]].

Fire Ants are colored red and act the same as [[Regular Ant]]s, but they leave a damaging flame trail behind them as they move. The flames will linger even after the Fire Ant that left it is defeated. However, the fire disappears after a short amount of time.

A Fire Ant's level can increase depending on what wave of the Ant Challenge the player is on. They can range from level 1 up to level 16.

Fire Ants are one of the most threatening of the five ant types, as their flame trails can stack up on the [[Fields|field]].

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |25 |- |2 |35 |- |3 |45 |- |4 |75 |- |5 |105 |- |6 |135 |- |7 |165 |- |8 |205 |- |9 |245 |- |10 |295 |- |11 |335 |- |12 |385 |- |13 |435 |- |14 |485 |- |15 |545 |- |16 |605 |}

== Strategies == * Fire Ants move in predetermined straight lines and are quite slow. This enables to player to easily dodge any coming their way. * Standing near the Fire Ant will allow your [[bees]] to quickly target the Fire Ant to quickly deal damage and defeat it. * Focus on taking out Fire Ants first as they can make the field very hard to navigate without taking damage from their flame trails. This is especially true if there is a large amount of them on the field. * Fire Ants will come out in groups and they could overwhelm the player if they are collecting pollen quickly to advance to the next waves. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control with their [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]] and [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|Tornado]] abilities which could greatly help counter the large amounts of Fire Ants landing on the field. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Fire Ants at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]]. * The player can walk through the gap between the Ant Challenge's window and the field to avoid stepping over fire trails.

== Gallery == File:GiantAnt3.png|Two Fire Ants next to two Giant Ants. File:ArmyAnt2.png|A Fire Ants next to two Army Ants. File:FireAnt1.png|Two Fire Ants. File:FireAntTrail1.png|The flame trail left behind by a Fire Ant.

== Trivia == * This is the only ant to have a second method of attack. * They have the same health per level as Regular Ants. * Noted by [[Panda Bear]], the fire from a Fire Ant is not affected by [[System Page#Defense|defense]], but this seems to be untrue. Addition, having 100% defense (through [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]]) will nullify any damage altogether. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

docs.text:
{{Bee|image-orig = Fire_Bee.png |image-gifted= FireBee Gifted.png |description = As an egg, this bee was accidentally left in the trunk of a car in the middle of the summer for over 3 days! |rarity = Epic |color = Red |energy = 25 |speed = 11.2 |attack = 4 |skincolor1 = #9d2916 |skincolor2 = #f3492d |skincolor3 = #9d2916}} '''Fire Bee''' is a [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[Bees/Epic|Epic bee]].

Fire Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Pineapple}}.

Fire Bee likes the [[Mushroom Field]], and [[Strawberry Field]]. It dislikes the [[Pine Tree Forest]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * -20% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +25% [[Energy]], +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: x1.25 [[Flame#Flame Pollen|Flame Pollen]].

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb|[Red Bomb+]]]''' Collects 10 pollen from 29 surrounding red [[Flowers]] (+10% pollen per Level). Combo with other bombs to increase power. * '''[[Passive Abilities#Gathering Flames|[Passive:]] [[Flame#Gathering Flames|Gathering Flames]]]''' 35% chance (50% if Gifted) to spawn a [[Flame]] when gathering. Flames last 4 seconds. Each second they deal 10 damage (+25% of the bee's [[Bee Attack|base attack]]) to nearby enemies and collect [5 Red / 3 White / 2 Blue] pollen (+10% per bee level) from 9 flowers. Standing near a flame grants Flame Heat, which increases [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]] (between x1.2 and x2) and [[Bee Attack]] (between +5% to +25%).

{{Stat|pollen = 12|pollentime = 4|honey = 80|honeytime = 4|rarity = epic|color = red}}

== Gallery == Firebee.PNG|A Fire Bee hive slot. File:FireBeeHiveSlotOld.jpg|An old Fire Bee hive slot. Png (12).png|Fire Bee's face. Firefaceoriginal.png|Fire Bee's original face. FireBeeNotification.png|Looker Bee transforming into a Fire Bee. File:FireBeeJelly.png|A Fire Bee Jelly in a player's inventory.

==Trivia== The [[Fire Mask]], which can be purchased in the [[Red HQ]], has a special design, name, and stats dedicated to Fire Bee. Fire Bee can be summoned by [[Spicy Bee]] with its [[Ability Tokens|Inferno]] ability, making it the only bee summon-able by [[Ability Tokens]]. This bee could also be summoned by using the [[Honeyday Candles]]. Fire Bee is the red counterpart of [[Bubble Bee]]. This bee was one of the bees to have a specific jelly in the [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. The jelly was given as part of the Cozy Bundle.

If the player owns the Fire Mask, its passive is inherited by the [[Demon Mask]]. Before the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020]] Update, the passive ability had a 5 second cooldown. docs.title: Fireflies
docs.text:
[[File:Fireflies_StrawberryField.png|thumb|251px|Fireflies in a crescent in the [[Strawberry Field]].]] [[File:FirefliesFlying.png|thumb|A depiction of what the firefly would look like as a bee.]] '''Fireflies''' are passive [[mobs]] that only appear during [[Day/Night Cycle|Nighttime]]. Individually, they produce [[sparkles]] on the [[flowers]] that they land on. Fireflies band together to generate various [[items]] for the player.

As soon as Nighttime begins, a group of eight fireflies will spawn above the [[Star Hall]]. These fireflies will then fly to a random [[field]]s. Fireflies can fly to the [[Spider Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Strawberry Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Cactus Field]], or the [[Rose Field]]. Once they reach the designated field, they will land randomly in a circle, facing towards the center. Fireflies also spawn [[Sparkles]] on the current flower they are on.

The player can chase a firefly from its position by walking close to it, forcing it to fly up. They will fly up if a player is within a 3-flower radius. If a firefly is nudged away, the flower the firefly sat on will generate sparkles. When all eight fireflies are nudged away and fly up, the following might appear in the middle of the firefly formation: {| class="article-table" !Possible Drops !Rarity |- |{{Cost|Moon Charm}} |Common, increments of 1, 5, 10 |- |{{Cost|Glitter|||0}} |Rare |- |{{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} |Very Rare |- |{{Cost|Night Bell|||0}} |Extremely Rare |- |{{Cost|Star Treat|||0}} |1/1,000,000 |- |{{Cost|Waxing Crescent Moon Sticker|||0}} |Rare |- |{{Cost|Glowing Smile Sticker|||0}} |Extremely Rare |- |{{I|Aries Star Sign Sticker|Sticker}}[[Sticker#Sticker Index|Star Signs]] |Extremely Rare |- |{{Cost|Cyan Star Sticker|||0}} |Exceptionally Rare |- |{{Cost|Shining Star Sticker|||0}} |Exceptionally Rare |- |}

The fireflies will continue this cycle in one field three times, and afterward, will target a new field. This cycle repeats until daytime arrives. When daytime arrives, they will fly back above the [[Star Hall]] and eventually despawn.

File:Fireflies in a moon shape.webp|Fireflies in a moon shape pattern. File:Fireflies RogueViciousInside.png|A [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] spawning in a firefly. File:Captura de pantalla (304).png|A firefly's face. File:Firefly.png|A firefly in the spiders cave. File:Fireflies-glitter-token.png|A {{Cost|Glitter|||0}} token from fireflies. File:Firefly Star Jelly.png|The message in the chat when a player gets a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} from fireflies. File:1 Night Bell Fireflies.png|The message in the chat when a player gets a {{Cost|Night Bell|||0}} from fireflies. File:Star treat from fireflies.jpg|The message in the chat when a player gets a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}} from fireflies. File:Onett fireflies.png|Onett stating the chances of a star treat in the official Bee Swarm Simulator discord.https://discord.com/channels/427553293862961153/427553293862961155/711716939726323794 in the [https://discord.gg/bee Bee Swarm Simulator official Discord server] File:Star jelly as fireflies drop.PNG|A {{Cost|Star Jelly||4=1}} token from fireflies. File:Fireflies leaving.jpg|Fireflies leaving once Nighttime ends.

== Trivia == The face of a firefly has the same face as the [[Gummy Bee]], but the color of the face is black and not cyan. [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] has confirmed that the chance of obtaining a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}} from fireflies is 1 in a million. Fireflies, [[Frog]]s, [[Chicks#Chick|Chicks]], [[Chicks#Hostage Chick|Hostage Chicks]], [[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted Chicks]], and [[Bean Bugs]] are the only Passive Mobs in the game. Fireflies were the first passive mob introduced to the game. Fireflies are also the only passive mobs to spawn exclusively at night. If a player uses a {{Cost|Night Bell|||0}} when a group of fireflies are leaving, another group will replace them. In an unknown update, the old group will come back instead of a new one. *Despite the fact there are eight fireflies, the [[Sticker|Glowing Smile Sticker]] only shows seven "fireflies".

docs.text:
[[File:1stflag.png|thumb|189x189px|''The decal & design of the First Edition Flag.'']] A '''First Edition Bee''' is a designation given to certain [[Bees/Event|Event Bees]] bought or earned during their first release. This designation is represented by a white and yellow "1st" flag appearing on top of the bee, and the flag emits a sparkling effect. The flag is purely cosmetic and does not change or affect gameplay at all.

This designation is currently only available for [[Bear Bee]], [[Tabby Bee]], [[Gummy Bee]], [[Puppy Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], [[Digital Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]].

If the player removes a first edition bee, the flag will NOT disappear once it is added back to the [[hive]].

== First Edition Bees == * Bear Bee: Bought at the first month of BSS launching (all first edition Bear Bees got an additional bonus of being automatically [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]). * Tabby Bee and Puppy Bee: Purchased during the their respective release sales (half price). * Gummy Bee: Obtained after completing all of [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] [[quests]] during the [[:Category:Gummy Invasion|Gummy Invasion Event]]. *Festive Bee: Obtained after completing all of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] quests during the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas 2018 Event]] or obtaining it from the Festive Bee Pack for {{Cost|Robux|1,600}} in the [[Robux Shop]]. * Windy Bee: Obtained as a special prize from the [[Wind Shrine]] or purchased in the Robux Shop before October 27, 2019. * Digital Bee: Obtained from [[Robo Bear's Shop|Robo Bear's shop]] behind [[Robo Bear]], or by purchasing the Digital Bee Pack for {{Cost|Robux|2,500}} in the [[Robux Shop]] during [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas 2022.]]

docs.title: Flame
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the flame trail produced by [[Fire Ant]]s.''

'''Flames''' are objects that can be produced by certain [[tools]], [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], or [[Passive Abilities|passive abilities]]. Flames have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering, lasting for 4 seconds. Each second, the flames collect 4 red, 2 white, or 1 blue [[pollen]] from 9 surrounding flowers (+2% per red bee and +4% per gifted red bee if spawned by the player, +10% per bee level if spawned by a bee), deals 10 + (25% of [[Bee Attack|base Bee Attack]]) damage per second to any mob (15 if spawned by the player), and grants the player [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|flame heat]].

Flames can be generated by the [[Scythe]], [[Fire Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], [[Spicy Bee|Spicy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Inferno|Inferno]], bees with the {{Cost|Bead Lizard|||0}} or {{Cost|Electric Candle|||0}} beequips, [[Fire Mask]]'s Ignite passive, and [[Demon Mask]]'s X-Flame passive.

Flames are used to help grow Scorching Stars.

== Flame Heat == '''Flame Heat''' grants extra Red Pollen and Bee Attack starting at x1.2 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]] and +5% [[Bee Attack]] Multiplier. The more flames around the player, the faster the Flame Heat grows up to a maximum of 20 seconds at x2 Red Pollen and +25% Bee Attack Multiplier. Flame Heat boosts [[Spicy Bee|Spicy Bee's]] Movespeed and gather speed and can also be consumed by [[Precise Bee]] to convert Pollen into Honey.

== Gathering Flames == The '''Gathering Flames''' passive gives a chance for a bee to spawn a flame while gathering pollen from a field. Gathering Flames+ gives a higher chance for a bee to spawn a flame.

There is a 35% chance (50% if gifted) for Fire Bees' Gathering Flames passive to spawn a flame while gathering, and a 65% (85% if gifted) chance for Demon Bees' Gathering Flames+ to spawn a flame while gathering.

The Gathering Flames passive chance can be increased with the {{Cost|Bead Lizard|||0}} or {{Cost|Electric Candle|||0}} beequip for individual bees.

  • A {{Cost|Bead Lizard|||0}} gives from +9% Gathering Flames chance to +14% Gathering Flames chance.
  • An {{Cost|Electric Candle|||0}} gives from +1% Gathering Flames chance to +5% Gathering Flames chance. Using waxes can increase the amount up to +25% Gathering Flames chance.

== Dark Flames == Flames that are hit with [[Dark Scythe]] will be converted into '''dark flames''', a dark violet version of normal flames which collects pollen from 13 surrounding flowers (instead of 9), deals 50% more damage, and grants dark heat and also normal flame heat. Dark flames also grant 33% more growth to Scorching Stars.

== Flame Stats == There are multiple aspects of flames that can be improved by stats and modifiers.

=== Flame Pollen === '''Flame Pollen''' is the amount of pollen that flames can collect. The player can check how much flame pollen they have in the system page. [[File:FlamePollenStat1.png|thumb|The Flame Pollen stat in the System Page.]] Flame Pollen can be increased in a few ways:

  • The Demon Mask gives a x1.25 Flame Pollen multiplier.
  • Gifted Fire Bee gives a x1.25 Flame Pollen multiplier.
  • [[Beequip]]s: ** An {{Cost|Electric Candle|||0}} gives from +5% Flame Pollen to +10% Flame Pollen for an individual bee. Using [[waxes]] can increase the amount up to 50% Flame Pollen. ** An {{Cost|Electric Candle|||0}} can give +1% Flame Pollen as a hive bonus. Using waxes can increase the amount up to 11% Flame Pollen.
  • [[Cog Amulet]]s: ** The Silver Cog Amulet can give up to +5% Flame Pollen. ** The Gold Cog Amulet can give up to +8% Flame Pollen. ** The Diamond Cog Amulet can give from +12% Flame Pollen up to +14% Flame Pollen. ** The Supreme Cog Amulet can give from +15% Flame Pollen up to +20% Flame Pollen.
  • [[Sticker]]s: ** The Small Flame Bee Sticker gives +3% Flame Pollen. ** The Dark Flame Sticker gives +3% Flame Pollen. ** The Orange Swirled Marble Sticker gives +3% Flame Pollen.
  • [[Robo Bear Challenge]]: ** Epic Upgrades: *** Furnace: This upgrade gives x1.5 Flame Pollen. === Flame Duration === '''Flame Duration''' is how long flames will last. Flame Duration can be increased by Spicy Bee's gifted bonus (25% more time) and [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] Spicy Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Flame Fuel|Flame Fuel]] ability (50% more time). In addition, Flame Fuel causes the flames to instantly convert 50,000 pollen plus 10% (+5% per Field Boost) of the hive's total convert amount.

=== Instant Flame Conversion === [[File:InstantFlameConversionStat1.png|thumb|The Instant Flame Conversion stat in the System Page.]] '''Instant Flame Conversion''' is how much pollen collected by flames are instantly converted. It can be increased by a few ways.

  • The Fire Mask gives +50% Instant Flame Conversion.
  • The Demon Mask gives +50% Instant Flame Conversion.
  • A Scorching Star gives +50% Instant Flame Conversion.

=== Other Improvements === Certain upgrades from the Robo Bear Challenge can be used to improve flames.

  • Epic Upgrades: ** Furnace: This upgrade gives x1.5 Flame Duration and x1.5 Flame Damage. ** Invert: This upgrade makes flames collect x4 pollen from blue flowers.

== Gallery == NewFlame.png|A flame in a field. XFlameNewTexture.png|An X-Flame in the Strawberry Field. DarkFlame.jpg|A Dark Flame. NewInferno.png|Spicy Bee's Inferno ability. IgniteNewFlames1.png|An Ignite Flame. File:GrayFlame.png|A flame spawned by another player's bees. Passive-gathering-flames.png|The old texture used for a flame. 2019-12-23 (6).png|The icon for the Flame Heat buff. DarkHeat.png|The icon for the Dark Heat buff.

== Trivia == * The maximum Flame Pollen a player can have is 380%. This can be achieved by having the Demon Mask (x1.25), Gifted Fire Bee (x1.25), a Supreme Cog Amulet (+20%), three {{Cost|Electric Candle}} (+33%), activating the [[Sticker Stack]] with certain stickers (+9%), and the Furnace upgrade (x1.5). ** The exact amount is 379.6875% but it rounds up to 380%. * The maximum Instant Flame Conversion a player can have is 100%. This can be achieved by having the Fire Mask (+50%) or the Demon Mask (+50%) while having a Scorching Star (+50%). * The texture for flames were changed in the 12/26/2021 update. This was probably to help with the texture for dark flames. * Flames generated by another player's bees will appear dark red instead of yellow-orange. * Flames are the counterpart of [[bubble]]s. [[Category:Mechanics]]
