docs.title: Flowers
docs.text:
''Are you looking for [[Pollen]] or [[Leaves]]?''

'''Flowers''' can be found in all [[fields]]. They can be interacted with using different sources to obtain [[pollen]] from and later be converted into [[honey]]. There are 5 flower sizes: single, double, triple, large, and star. Single, double, triple, large, and star flowers multiply pollen by 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 per harvest, respectively. This number can be increased with better [[tools]], [[badges]], [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], [[Field Booster|field boosters]], etc. They also have base total pollen amounts of 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 respectively. Total pollen is how much pollen the player can get before the flower's pollen is depleted and the flower has to regrow. In addition, larger flowers grow at a higher rate than smaller ones. [[Sprinklers]], [[Clouds]] and [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|Bubbles]] can regenerate flowers while the [[Ability Tokens#Pollen Haze|pollen haze]] [[Ability Tokens|ability]] improves flower growth rate.

There are 3 different flower colors: [[:Category:Colorless|white]], [[:Category:Red|red]], and [[:Category:Blue|blue]]. [[Bees]] also have these colors, and red/blue bees that harvest flowers of the same color get 50% bonus pollen from it. Also, the color of the pollen plays a large role in many [[quests]] and bee abilities.

Sometimes, a flower patch might emit green [[leaves]]. Collecting pollen from that patch will either grant an [[Items|item]] or spawn an [[aphid]].

{ class="article-table" !Flower Type !Locations - [[File:FlrsW1b.png [[Sunflower Field]], [[Dandelion Field]], [[Mushroom Field]], [[Clover Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Spider Field]], [[Strawberry Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Pine Tree Forest]], [[Rose Field]], [[Ant Field]]. - [[File:FlrsW2b.png Sunflower Field, Dandelion Field, Mushroom Field, Clover Field, Blue Flower Field, Spider Field, Strawberry Field, Bamboo Field, Pineapple Patch, [[Cactus Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]], Pine Tree Forest, Rose Field. - [[File:FlrsW3b.png Spider Field, Strawberry Field, Bamboo Field, Pineapple Patch, [[Stump Field]], Cactus Field, Pumpkin Patch, Pine Tree Forest, Rose Field, [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Coconut Field]], [[Pepper Patch]]. - [[File:FlrsW4b.png Can only be created by [[pollination]]. - [[File:FlrsW5b.png Can only be created by [[pollination]]. }

== Gallery == SmallFlower.png|The old single white flower design. MediumWhiteFlower.png|The old double white flower design. LargeWhiteFlower.png|The old triple white flower design, which was instead a large flower, more closely resembling the current large flower design. File:Fdf41ca6f09022fdc321eebfe2108d33.png|A yellow flower decal that was most likely scrapped during development.

== Trivia ==

  • There are decals of yellow flowers in [[Onett (Developer)|Onett's]] inventory, but they have never made an appearance in the game itself. They were most likely scrapped during the game's development.
  • White flowers are the most common in the game, as practically all fields have white flowers. The only field that doesn't have white flowers is the [[Mountain Top Field]]. ** The only field with exactly one color of flowers is the [[Spider Field]], the color being white.
  • The [[Ant Field]], [[Stump Field]], Mountain Top Field, [[Coconut Field]], and [[Pepper Patch]] are the only fields with exactly one type of flower size (single for Ant Field, triple for the rest).
  • Star flowers glow during [[Day/Night Cycle|nighttime]].
  • Ant Field flowers hold 50 pollen, plus 10 pollen per tier (up to 90 pollen).
  • Before the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/6/2020 update]], the flower designs were different, and the sizes were only small, double, and large. If the player looks at a field from a nearly flat angle, the flowers will appear to turn to their corresponding colors. [[Fuzzy Bee|Fuzzy Bee's]] abilities and [[Passive Abilities#Fuzzy Coat|passive ability]], the [[Passive Abilities#Diamond Drain|Diamond Drain]] passive, the [[Passive Abilities#Guiding Star|Guiding Star]] passive, and a bee with the {{Cost|Poinsettia|||0}} or {{Cost|Lei|||0}} Beequip are the only ways to pollinate flowers. *Blue flowers are stated by [[Black Bear]] to taste minty, with red flowers tasting spicy, and white flowers tasting neutral.

[[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Fields]]

docs.title: Flying Ant
docs.text:
'''Flying Ants''' are one of five mobs that is part of a family called [[ants]] that are exclusively found in the [[Ant Challenge]], past the [[Ant Gate]].

{{Mob|title=Flying Ant|image=FlyingAnt.png|location=[[Ant Field]] while the [[Ant Challenge]] is active.|hp=? base; Increases by level|damage=40|points=None|bond=1|honey=None|level=1-16 (Varies with Wave)}}

This is one of the first Ant Challenge [[mobs]] that the player will encounter, capable of appearing on the very first wave. Despite being able to appear on the first wave, Flying Ants usually start appearing at around the second or third waves.

Flying Ants are ants with wings and they will pursue the player. They have the ability to pounce on players from quite a distance are the fastest out of the five ant types. However, they also have low health, much lower than any other ant type.

A Flying Ant's level can increase depending on what wave of the Ant Challenge the player is on. They can range from level 1 up to level 16.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |? |- |2 |25 |- |3 |30 |- |4 |45 |- |5 |60 |- |6 |75 |- |7 |90 |- |8 |110 |- |9 |130 |- |10 |155 |- |11 |175 |- |12 |200 |- |13 |225 |- |14 |250 |- |15 |280 |- |16 |310 |}

== Strategies ==

  • Due to their quick speed, the player will need to react more quickly in order to dodge Flying Ants trying to pounce them.
  • Having [[bees]] that can produce [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste tokens]] can help the player gain more speed needed to maneuver around Flying Ants.
  • Flying Ants occasionally spawn in waves which could overwhelm the player. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control with their abilities which could greatly help counter the large amounts of Flying Ants landing on the field. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Flying Ants at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

== Gallery == File:FlyingAnt1.png|A Flying Ant. File:FlyingAnt2.png|A pair of Flying Ants. File:FlyingAnt3.png|A Flying Ant getting hit by Vicious Bee's Impale.

== Trivia ==

  • The [[Ant Amulet|Supreme Ant Amulet]] resembles a Flying Ant.
  • Despite having "flying" in its name, it doesn't actually fly, but it simply jumps. ** Flying could mean to move quickly in this context since the Flying Ant moves quite fast. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]], which requires [[ticket]]s.''

[[File:AntPassFree.png|thumb|The design of the Free Ant Pass Dispenser.]] The '''Free Ant Pass Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] located past the [[Ant Gate]] and to the left of the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]]. Players can use the dispenser to get a free {{Cost|Ant Pass|||0}} every 2 hours, which can be used to participate in the [[Ant Challenge]]. Players cannot use the dispenser if they already have 10 or more ant passes in their inventory.

== Trivia == * This and the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]] are the only free dispensers in the game that do not grant any [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] when used. ** This, the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]], the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]], the [[Robo Pass Dispenser]], the [[Coconut Dispenser]], and the [[Glue Dispenser]] are the only dispensers that do not grant [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] when used. * This, the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]], the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]], and the [[Robo Pass Dispenser]] are the only dispensers that don't have any visible faucets. Instead, they have a small compartment, similar to a vending machine or an ATM.

When used, gives the player a free {{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}} every 22 hours, which can be used to participate in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. Instead, they have a small compartment, similar to a vending machine or an ATM.

docs.title: Free Royal Jelly Dispenser
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] which requires tickets or the [[Royal Jelly Shop]].''

[[File:Royaljelly.png|thumb|The Free Royal Jelly Dispenser.]]

The '''Free Royal Jelly Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] that is located in the [[Star Hall]]. It requires at least 1 [[Gifted Bee|gifted bee type]] to redeem {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} and [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste+]]. The number of royal jellies the player receives is based on how many [[Gifted Bee|gifted bees]] they currently have in their [[hive]]. For example, if the player has 15 gifted bees, but two of them are the same gifted bee, they will still get {{Cost|Royal Jelly|15}}.

This dispenser has a cooldown of 22 hours. Currently, players can get a maximum of 50 royal jellies per use with 50 gifted bees.

== Gallery == File:Message when no gifted bees .png|The message when the player has no gifted bees.

== Trivia ==

  • Unlike the Royal Jelly Dispenser which gives a stack of 10x Haste, the Free Royal Jelly Dispenser gives Haste+.
  • Using this is one of the two only ways to get the Haste+ [[Buffs & Debuffs|Buff]], the other being certain [[codes]].
  • Unlike the Royal Jelly Dispenser, which is limited to one Royal Jelly per use, the Free Royal Jelly Dispenser can give up to 50 Royal Jellies.
  • Unlike how the [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]] or the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]] are directly next to their {{Cost|Ticket|||0}} counterparts, the Free Royal Jelly Dispenser is not directly next to its ticket counterpart, the Royal Jelly Dispenser.
  • This, the Free Robo Pass Dispenser, and the [[Glue Dispenser]] are the only dispensers with a 22-hour cooldown, the longest in the game. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]] [[Category:Dispenser]]

docs.title: Frog
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Frog |image = File:RobloxScreenShot20191227 121628788 (2).png |location = All Fields |hp = N/A|damage = Varies (only attacks mobs)|points = N/A|bond = N/A|honey = N/A|level = N/A}}'''Frogs''' are passive [[mob]]s added in the [[Updates#2019.12.23|12/23/2019 Update]]. They despawn after a set period of time (3 minutes if summoned by a {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs}} or 20 seconds (+2s per level) if summoned by a [[Tadpole Bee]]).

There are two types of frogs, normal frogs and gifted frogs. Normal frogs can be summoned by collecting a [[Ability Tokens#Summon Frog|Summon Frog]] ability token generated by Tadpole Bee or by using a {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs}}, and the gifted variant can only be summoned by a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] Tadpole Bee with a chance 10% (+2% each level) chance of summoning it when collecting its Summon Frog ability token. Gifted frogs have a longer tongue range, faster token collection and attack, 50% more attack, a chance to summon Gold Bubbles while hopping, and can hit balloons with their tongue to convert pollen into honey tokens.

Players cannot damage frogs, neither can the frogs damage players, meaning that frogs are not hostile mobs. == Abilities == * Upon summoning, frogs will hop around the field until they despawn, creating [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|Bubbles]] on their 2nd, 3rd and 4th hop. * Frogs can collect [[Ability Tokens]], {{Cost|Honey|}} Tokens and other Tokens (such as rewards from Mobs) for the Player by using their Tongues, which can also create Bubbles. * Frogs can attack Hostile Mobs (dealing x5 the damage of the attack power of the Tadpole Bee that summoned them or dealing 7 damage when summoned from a {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs}}.

== Audio == The following audio plays when a frog has been summoned by the summon frog ability:[[File:Summonfrog.ogg]]

The following audio plays when a frog collects a token:[[File:Froggulp.ogg]]

== Gallery == RobloxScreenShot20200106 183857683.png|A frog hopping. Froggo.png|A frog using its tongue. Roblox31 (2).png|A frog attacking [[Stump Snail]] with its tongue. Gifted Frog.png|A Gifted Frog. Summon frog ability token..png|A “Summon frog” Token generated by a Tadpole Bee. Screen Shot 2021-03-01 at 3.22.58 PM.png|The Honeyday-Cleanup Frog Crew arriving at the end of Beesmas. Screen Shot 2021-03-01 at 3.24.51 PM.png|The Honeyday-Cleanup Frog Crew planting a Debug Sprout. Image 2023-09-29 172235742.png|A frog glitched into the ground.

== Trivia == * Frogs are the only mob in the game that can be summoned by an ability token. It is also the only passive mob that is passive to players, but hostile to harmful mobs. * Frogs, [[fireflies]], [[Bean Bugs]], [[Chicks#Chick|Chicks]], [[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted Chicks]], [[Puffshroom]], and [[Chicks#Hostage Chick|Hostage Chicks]] are the only Passive Mobs, meaning that they can't damage the Player. * Frogs, [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddies]], and [[Windy Bee]] (with its [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|Tornado Ability]]) are the only entities that can collect tokens from [[flowers]], [[leaves]], and [[sprout]]s for the player. * Frogs, [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], and [[Wild Windy Bee]] are the only mobs that can deal damage to other hostile mobs with attacks. ** However, Frogs are the only Mob that will deliberately attack other Mobs, as Rogue Vicious Bee and Wild Windy Bee will only "attack" other Mobs if they happen to be where they are going to Attack. * Collecting Bubbles from Frogs summoned by other Players will currently grant pollen to both players and would also add to both Players' [[Bubble Bee Man#Ornament Quest|Bubble Bee Man's Ornament Quests]] during Beesmas 2019. * The frog and the Rogue Vicious Bee are the only mobs that can be spawned by using an [[Items|item]], with the items being the {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs}} and the {{Cost|Night Bell}} respectively. * Frogs can sometimes fall outside of the field they are in if it is at a high enough elevation. If this happens, they will hop around uselessly until they despawn. * At the end of Beesmas 2020, Onett spawned frogs under the name of the "Honeyday Clean-Up Crew". * At the end of Beesmas 2021, Onett spawned frogs under the name of the "Frog Foundation". * Frogs are the only mobs capable of spawning bubbles. * The frog and Rogue Vicious Bee are the only mobs to have a gifted variant. * Frogs will only spawn facing towards the 30-Bee Zone, or away from the Hive. * Frogs are the only passive mobs that can be summoned by a Bee. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Passive Mobs]] [[zh-tw:青蛙]]

If there has been a Pollen Haze over the field within the last 3 minutes, this summons fuzz bombs instead. * '''[[Passive Abilities#Fuzzy Coat|[Passive: Fuzzy Coat]]]''' This bee may pollinate up to 5 nearby flowers (9 if gifted) every time it gathers. == Trivia == * This bee, [[Buoyant Bee]], and [[Precise Bee]] are first Mythic bees to be added since the release of the original Mythic bees. ** It's also the only Mythic bee to be introduced on its own. *** Additionally, Fuzzy Bee is the only Mythic bee to be added outside of [[Beesmas]]. * This bee is currently the only bee that can pollinate flowers without the help of the [[Poinsettia]]. * This bee may like the Dandelion Field because [[Wikipedia:Taraxacum|dandelions]] in real life are also soft and fuzzy. * This bee, [[Shy Bee]], [[Ninja Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]] are the only bees with one skin color. * This bee, [[Spicy Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]] and [[Digital Bee]] all have four different [[Ability Tokens|abilities]], the most for any [[Bees|bee]] in the game. * The [[Egg#Specific Bee Eggs|Fuzzy Bee Egg]] was the fifth specific bee egg that can/could have been bought for [[Robux Shop|Robux]], after [[Bear Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], Windy Bee, and [[Puppy Bee]] and before Precise Bee and Buoyant Bee. ** Fuzzy Bee was the first non-Event bee that can be purchased with Robux. * Fuzz bombs can be popped by using petal Shurikens from the [[Petal Wand]] and [[Passive Abilities#Petal Storm|Petal Storm]], Windy Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Tornado|tornado]], and [[Puppy Bee|Puppy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Fetch|fetch ball]]. ** Any player can pop fuzz bombs, even if they were summoned by another player's Fuzzy Bee. * Fuzzy Bee is the only [[hive]] bee that was introduced in 2020 (not counting [[Digital Bee]], as it wasn't usable until 2022). *Fuzzy Bee's Fuzz Bombs can pop bubbles when the fuzz bombs touch them.

docs.title: Giant Ant
docs.text:
A '''Giant Ant''' is one of five mobs that is part of a family called [[Ants]] that are exclusively found in the [[Ant Challenge]], past the [[Ant Gate]].

{{Mob|title=Giant Ant|image=Giant_Ant.png|location=[[Ant Field]] while the [[Ant Challenge]] is active.|hp=? base; Increase by level|damage=60|points=None|bond=3|honey=None|level=1-16 (Varies with Wave)}}

This is one of the last Ant Challenge [[mobs]] that the player will encounter, appearing every fifth wave.

Giant Ants are enormous versions of the normal ant that relentlessly pursue the player. They have a relatively slow movespeed. However, they have large amounts of health, more than any other type of ant, and high attack power, also more than any other type of ant, to compensate for their slow speed.

A Giant Ant's level can increase depending on what wave of the Ant Challenge the player is on. They can range from level 1 up to level 16.

Giant Ants are one of the most threatening of the five ant types, as they are have high amounts of health and chase the player nonstop.

== Health by Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |? |- |2 |500 |- |3 |700 |- |4 |1,000 |- |5 |1,300 |- |6 |1,800 |- |7 |2,300 |- |8 |2,800 |- |9 |3,400 |- |10 |4,100 |- |11 |4,800 |- |12 |5,600 |- |13 |6,400 |- |14 |7,200 |- |15 |8,100 |- |16 |9,100 |}

== Strategies ==

  • Due to the Giant Ant's high health, they can 'tank' hits from [[bees]] and allow the smaller, faster ants to attack the player with a much lower chance of being defeated. Their size makes them much harder to avoid. The player should bring bees with high attack such as [[Lion Bee]] to deal enough damage to defeat Giant Ants. ** The player can also use a [[Stinger]] to help deal extra damage against the Giant Ant.
  • They always appear every fifth wave on a side of the map so the player can prepare for their arrival.
  • [[Vicious Bee|Vicious Bee's]] [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Ability_Tokens?so=search#Impale Impale] can deal high amounts of damage to single targets which can help take away tons of health from Giant Ants. [[Windy Bee|Windy Bee's]] [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Ability_Tokens?so=search#Tornado Tornado] can help chip away a Giant Ant's health and also take out other ants that are hiding behind the Giant Ant. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun Giant Ants and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

== Gallery == File:GiantAnt1.png|A Giant Ant. File:GiantAnt2.png|A Giant Ant directly above a player. File:GiantAnt3.png|Two Giant Ants on wave 40 next to two Fire Ants. File:GiantAnt4.png|A Giant Ant being hit by Vicious Bee's Impale. File:GiantAnt5.png|A Giant Ant stunned by Digital Bee's Mind Hack and taking damage from Windy Bee's Tornado.

== Trivia ==

  • Giant Ants are the only ant to follow a spawn pattern where they appear every five waves (5th, 10th, 15th, etc.). ** Every 40th wave has two Giant Ants spawn instead of one.
  • They are the only ant to have health in the thousands. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Ant Challenge]]

docs.title: Gift Boxes
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} ''Not to be confused with [[Present]]s and [[Ornament Presents]].''

'''Gift Boxes''' are presents that appear during each Beesmas update, which are located around the map. To open them, the player needs to help a certain number of [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] complete their [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] decorations by completing their [[quests]]. There are 13 gift boxes this year.

[[Category:Pages that uses original tabber]] |-|2024 (Winter)= {{:Gift Boxes/2024 (Winter)}} |-|2024 (Summer)= {{:Gift Boxes/2024 (Summer)}} |-|2022= {{:Gift Boxes/2022}} |-|2021= {{:Gift Boxes/2021}} |-|2020= {{:Gift Boxes/2020}}

==Trivia== Originally, the Mondo Gift Box required 12 NPCs. When the second update had arrived, it changed to 14 NPCs. In Beesmas 2021, the Mondo Gift Box required 14 NPCs, then due to the occurrence of [[Dapper Bear]] being added, it changed to 15 NPCs. Everything that required 6-11 NPCs were made to require 1 more than before, and the Festive Gift Box was added, requiring 13 NPCs. This happened after the Midnight Gift Box was added. In Beesmas 2022, the requirements of every gift box that required above 7 NPCs had their requirement increase by 1. This happened after Chestnut Gift Box was added in part 2 of Beesmas, where Spirit Bear, Gummy Bear, Bubble Bee Man, Robo Bear, and [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] got new Beesmas quests. * The Midnight Gift Box and the Chestnut Gift Box were the only gift boxes to be added in the middle of Beesmas. The Midnight Gift Box was the first to accomplish this. The Mondo Gift Box was the last gift box to get removed from the game in Beesmas 2020, because [[Bubble Bee Man|B.B.M's]] quest was extended by 1 week. It was '''not''' necessary to have 35 bees to access the Pristine Gift Box. Instead, the player could go to the roof of the [[Red HQ]], where they could jump onto the ledge with the box. However, taking just a few steps beyond that would bring them back to the spawn point. There were 10 gift boxes in total during Beesmas 2020, 12 gift boxes in 2021 and 2022, and there are 13 gift boxes this year. There has never been a gift box for helping one NPC. :Up to the 12/25/2024 update, there was never a gift box for helping two NPCs, until the Elite Gift Box was changed from 3 NPCs to 2 NPCs. There was never a gift box for helping three NPCs since. Originally, the Elite Gift Box was next to [[Panda Bear]].

docs.text:
''This page is for the quest-giving NPC. For the worker bee version, see the [[Bucko Bee]] page.''

{{NonBearNPC|image=Gifted Bucko Bee NPC.png|type=Bee NPC|location=Blue HQ|bees=Discovered 4 blue types of}}

'''Gifted Bucko Bee''' is a [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]] and one of three permanent [[:Category:Quest Bees|Quest Bees]], the others being {{I|Gifted Riley Bee NPC}} [[Gifted Riley Bee]] and {{I|Honey Bee NPC}} [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]. Gifted Bucko Bee is located on the second floor of the [[Blue HQ]], in between the [[Top Bucko Bee Helpers]] and the [[Daily Top Blue Collectors]] [[Leaderboards]]. The player cannot start receiving and completing its [[Quests]] without a {{Cost|Translator|4=0}}, which is given by [[Science Bear]] three times. Completing 150 quests from Gifted Bucko Bee is required to craft the {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|4=0}} and completing 250 quests from Gifted Bucko Bee is required to craft the [[Tide Popper]].

== Quests == Gifted Bucko Bee is an infinite quest giver whose quests scale up in difficulty. However, some specific quest requirements may stay the same. Due to this, the reward will vary depending on the quest. Rewards will always contain one {{Cost|Blue Extract|||0}} and [[Honey]].

For the requirements below, ''X'' represents the number of quests the player has completed for Gifted Bucko Bee, and ''Y'' represents how many times 10 quests have been completed. Requirements are not represented this way are static or may progress in a way not yet determined. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! In addition to {{Cost|Blue Extract|4=0}} and {{Cost|Honey|4=0}} for completing each quest, certain thresholds may reward other items as well. These can include {{Cost|Royal Jelly}}, {{Cost|Moon Charm}}, [[Treats]], {{Cost|Gumdrops}}, {{Cost|Magic Bean}}, [[Egg|gifted eggs]] (excluding Gifted Mythic Eggs) or {{Cost|Star Jelly}}.

For every 25th Quest completed, a {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} is rewarded (excluding special milestones).

(Gifted Bucko Bee is speaking buzzes) '''You are given a choice to use a translator or to leave. You use a translator. '''What's this? Hmm, amazing... A device that lets me talk to beekeepers... Well then, let me introduce myself! I'm Bucko Bee - Leader of the Blue Bees! And this is the Blue Headquarters. Here, the Blue Bees and I are constantly working... Thinking, planning, honing our skills... Doing everything we can to advance the Blue cause. We've discovered a method to boost the blue fields. We've developed highly advanced Blue Guards. That's what sets us apart - why we're always one step ahead of the Red Bees! I see you've discovered quite a few Blue Bees. Seem to have some great Blue potential. But you'll need some training if you're hoping to rank up to a Blue Master. Complete my quests, and I'll reward you with some [Blue Extracts]. Those can be used to boost your blue pollen collection... Or to craft some of the equipment we've developed in house. Each time you complete one of my quests, they'll become more challenging. To make it worth your effort, you'll be rewarded a bonus after every 5. What do you say? Ready to start? Talk to me again, and we'll dive right in. |- |Repeatable Quests |Brave, Bold, Blue. It's time for another blue-themed quest. Complete it, and you'll be another step closer to realizing your True Blue potential! I'll also reward you with a [Blue Extract]. [Blue Extracts] boost blue pollen by x1.25 for 10 minutes. They're also used as materials for making advanced blue equipment. After every 5th quest, I'll reward you a bonus. And after certain milestones, the bonus may be truly brilliant. I've loaded the next quest into your Quest Menu. Report back when it's complete.

''-During-''

My quests becoming progressively more challenging. There's no end to this fight - we just keep moving. It's this ongoing work that gives us an edge over other bees. Do you have what it takes to become True Blue? Complete my quests to prove it.

''-Completion-''

Beautiful work! You've earned yourself a [Blue Extract]. But there's no time to rest. Blue Bees are constantly working, striving... That's what gives us an edge over the Red Bees. Keep moving forward, into the blue. |- | Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2018 | The cool, calm spirit of winter reflects the nature of us Blue Bees. Still yet thoughtful. Calm and steady. That's what gives us our edge. '''You are given a choice to give a present to Gifted Bucko Bee or continue talking like normal. You choose to give him a present.'''Hah hah, of course you'd do this. Suprise ''[sic]'' me with a [Present] out of the blue! You're a stand up beekeeper, you know that? Let me just open this thing up... ...(krumple krumple)... Nice! Some ticket to see the Blue Bee Group in Vegas. Not sure how I'll get there or when I'll find the time to go, But it doesn't look like they expire. Now's your turn! A little something from all us Blue Bees at the HQ. |- | Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2019 | |- | Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2020 |I'm just happy it's Winter. '''You are given a choice to give a present to Gifted Bucko Bee or continue talking like normal. You choose to give him a present.''' Wait, don't tell me you've brought a [Present]? Of all the beekeepers I've met, you really are the coolest! One second, let me just try to unwrap this with my wings somehow... ...(krumple krumple)... Oh, it's a [Snow Tiara] Beequip! Well, this is a little awkward... Bucko Bees can't equip [Snow Tiaras],. But don't worry. I've got plenty of blue bee friends here at the HQ who will make great use out of this! Thanks! And now some gifts for you, including the [Snowman Ornament]! With this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Blue Flower Field and Pine Tree Forest and +10% Blue Field Capacity! Hope that helps! Merry blue Beesmas! |- |Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2021 | |- |Exclusive Beesmas Dialogue 2022 |I'm just happy it's Winter. '''You are given a choice to give a present to Gifted Bucko Bee or continue talking like normal. You choose to give him a present.''' Well, if it isn't the coolest Beekeeper around! You bringing me a [Present] makes you even cooler. Let's see what it is... ...(krumple krumple)... Well I'll be! An entire gallon of Comforting Nectar! No wonder that thing was so heavy. Soo... I happened to get you some Comforting Nectar as well.. That's just part of my gift though, so this isn't too awkward. The most important part is the [Snowman Ornament]! ==Trivia== Since the quests are all chosen at random, including the first, the formula for the first requirements of any quest is "x divided by (number of Gifted Bucko Bee quests completed +1)". * Gifted Bucko Bee is one of the three [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] to be based on [[bees]], the other two being [[Gifted Riley Bee]] and [[Honey Bee (NPC)]]. This Bee is the only quest bee to reside indoors, though [[Gifted Riley Bee]] resided indoors too before an update. In the Bucko Bee's [[Snow Machine]] for Beesmas 2020 dialogue, Gifted Bucko Bee says to defeat ten Spiders. However, the [[Quests|quest]] requires the Player to defeat five Spiders.

{{NonBearNPC|type=Bee NPC|location=Red HQ|bees=15 and discovered 4 types of red|image=Gifted Riley Bee NPC.png}}

'''Gifted Riley Bee''' is a [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]] and one of three permanent [[:Category:Quest Bees|Quest Bees]], the others being [[File:Gifted Bucko Bee NPC.png|25px]] [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] and [[File:Honey Bee NPC.png|25px]] [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]. It resides on the roof of the [[Red HQ]], next to the [[Top Riley Bee Helpers]] [[leaderboards|leaderboard]]. The player cannot speak or receive/complete its [[Quests]] without a {{Cost|Translator|4=0}}, which is given by [[Science Bear]] three times. The player must complete 150 quests from Gifted Riley Bee to unlock crafting the {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|4=0}}, and 250 to unlock crafting the [[File:Dark Scythe.png|25px]] [[Dark Scythe]].

== Quests == Gifted Riley Bee is an infinite quest giver. Its quests scale up in difficulty the more the player completes them, with the rewards also getting better the more difficult the quests get. Each quest always rewards one [[Red Extract]] and [[Honey]], depending on the current difficulty of the current quest. Every fifth completed Quest has a bonus reward.

For the requirements below, ''X'' represents the number of quests received from Gifted Riley Bee, or the number of quests completed plus one, ''Y'' represents how many times 10 quests have been completed, ''Z'' represents how many times 25 quests have been completed, and ''A'' represents how many times 50 quests have been completed. However, in the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]], the glass roof was removed. * While Gifted Riley Bee says to defeat 50 scorpions in the Honeyday Candles 2020 dialogue, the requirement was replaced with collecting 500 red bomb tokens. * Gifted Riley Bee says that the 2021 Honeyday Candles give a {{Cost|Swirled Wax|}} for each use, but the candles can actually give all types of waxes and at a varying amount, with Swirled Waxes being a rare drop. This is because before the [[Updates#2021.12.26|26/12/2021 Update]], Swirled Wax was the only wax in the game and was given after every use. * The second half of the dialogue of Gifted Riley Bee's Beesmas 2021 present dialogue is repeated from Beesmas 2020's as Gifted Riley Bee mentions setting up the bPad. * The "bPad" is obviously a reference to the iPad, with the "i" being replaced with a "b" since the users are likely all bees and beekeepers.

This article is about the item. For the similarly named Gingerbread Cub skin, see ''[[Cub Buddy]]''. Not to be confused with an "{{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear|4=1}}".

A {{Color|Gingerbread Bear}} is a unique type of [[Treats|treat]] that was added in the [[Updates#2020.12.25|12/25/2020 update]]. It is obtainable by checking [[Mother Bear|Mother Bear's]] [[Gingerbread House]], defeating certain [[mobs]] and bosses, opening [[Gift Boxes]], completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] quests, giving {{Cost|Present}} to certain [[Quest Givers|NPCs]] around the map, completing NPCs Beesmas quests, using [[Onett's Lid Art]], and buying certain [[Robux Shop|Robux Packs]].

==Overview== Gingerbread bears have 2 functions. The player could save them up and spend it on [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] during the Beesmas 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2024 events, or feed them to [[bees]]. In addition to granting [[bond]], it has a 1% chance to make them [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]. They can also be saved up until the next Beesmas event, where they turn into {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

The formula of turning a bee gifted:

(1 - 0.99^x) \times 100\%

(𝑥 is the number of the {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} fed to a bee)

Chance from getting high combos in [[Puppy Bee|Puppy Bee's]] [[Beequip]] ability, [[Ability Tokens#Reindeer Fetch|Reindeer Fetch]] (limit 1 per day). ==Trivia== {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear||4=1}}, along with {{Cost|Snowflake}}, are the only currencies that can be used in Bee Bear's Catalog. However, unlike {{Cost|Snowflake}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear||4=1}} are not removed from the player's inventory when Beesmas ends and are still obtainable and usable. This, along with the {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}} and {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}, are the only items in the game that can turn [[Bees/Event|Event bees]] gifted. This and the {{Cost|Festive Bean|||0}} are the only event items that are infinitely renewable outside of an event. Feeding {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|100}} to a bee does not guarantee to turn it gifted. The chance of it becoming gifted is around 63%.

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Gingerbread House.png|thumb|180px|The Gingerbread House after being assembled by completing [[Mother Bear]]'s Beesmas quest.]]The '''Gingerbread House''' is a [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] exclusive machine which can be assembled after completing [[Mother Bear]]'s Beesmas quest.

It sits between [[Mother Bear]] and the [[Treat Shop]]. When activated, the house gives {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|1}} for every 2 playtime hours, which can be built up over time.

If the player attempts to use the Gingerbread House before it is completed, it will display text that reads: This Gingerbread House is far from complete...

==Overview== The Gingerbread House has gumdrops for decorations at the corners, a {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|||0}} in the middle, and a candy cane acting as a possible chimney.

Its only use is to produce a Gingerbread Bear every 2 '''in-game''' hours. If the player is offline, it does not generate any.

Upon completing the quest, the Gingerbread House can be used immediately for one Gingerbread Bear. '''The Gingerbread House will not accumulate Gingerbread Bears until after it is used for the first time.'''

==Gallery== Unfinishedgbhouse.png|The incomplete setup on Gingerbread House before completing Mother Bear's beesmas quest. ExampleGingerbreadHouseClaim.png|Example of a player claiming their gingerbread after 44 in-game hours. ==Trivia==

The Gingerbread House stores multiple gingerbread bears at the same time, meaning that multiple gingerbread bears can be collected in one go after 4 or more hours. Even though the cooldown to collect reset once it was collected, the timer for generating gingerbread bears does not. For example, if a player with 3 hours in-game checks the house, they will only get 1 gingerbread bear and the cooldown will reset to 2 hours. The timer saves that extra hour, so the player will get 2 gingerbread bears if they collect after 3 more hours (6 hours total). * A player can get {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|12}} a day if they are online for 24 hours. This means they can make the 500 gingerbreads required for the super smoothie pack in 32 days (31 days and 16 hours to be exact) just from the Gingerbread House, so long as they are online 24/7. * The Gingerbread House was introduced in [[Updates#2020.12.25|Beesmas 2020]], and has returned on each Beesmas since. * Quest givers such as [[Bee Bear]] require the player to interact with the Gingerbread House a varying amount of times.
