docs.title: Glider
docs.text:
[[File:Glider.png|thumb|220x220px|The Glider. ]] {{Quote|Floats much faster than the [[Parachute]], allowing you to fly through the sky! Press jump while in the air to open.}} The '''Glider''' is a [[:Category:Gliding Tools|gliding tool]] that can be purchased at the [[Mountain Top Shop]], it is the upgraded version of the [[Parachute]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients ! colspan="2" |Statistics |- |{{Cost|Honey|5,000,000}} |Speed |70 |- | |Float | -24 |}

It allows the player to glide much quicker and change direction faster than the [[Parachute]]. To activate it, jump, then jump again while in mid-air. If the player goes airborne through some other method (a cannon, for example), double jump; to disengage it, jump once more or make contact with ground. The gliding feature is hardcoded to the player, and they will glide even during a lag spike; although, the Glider doesn't immediately appear.

The primary use of the Glider is to glide to places on the map that would otherwise be inaccessible. It can be used to collect some of the {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} and {{Cost|Ticket|4=0}} tokens around the map and can be used to perform several shortcuts. The Glider, along with the [[Parachute]], are the only ways to obtain the {{Cost|Diamond Egg|4=0}} token below the platform in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]]. It is also used to reach the [[Star Hall]] located on top of the [[Noob Shop]]. The Glider can also be used to dodge [[mobs]], since most of them don't have a high detection range in the air. Combined with the cannons (especially with the [[Red Cannon]]), it is one of the most efficient ways to travel around the map.

The Glider's gliding speed is not affected by boosts that enhance the player’s movement speed, such as [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]], Haste+, [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]] or [[Oil]].

==Gallery== Gliiiide.png|The Glider being used. Gliderondisplay.PNG|The Glider on display in the Mountain Top Shop. gliderdesc.PNG|The Glider's description.

==Trivia== The Glider and the [[Parachute]] are the only gliding tools in the game, excluding the unobtainable Debug Glider. With the Glider, it is possible to glide outside of the map. You can also exit out of the map via a [[Wild Windy Bee]] blowing at you with a gust of wind. If the player enables shift-lock, they can slightly strafe to one side while using the [[:Category:Gliding Tools|gliding tools]]. The Glider is located on top of the [[Mountain Top Shop]] as a decoration, similar to how a Parachute model is located on top of the [[Pro Shop]]. *The Glider is the second cheapest item in the Mountain Top Shop, after the first [[Hive Slot|hive slot]]. It was the third cheapest item in the shop before the {{Cost|Eviction|4=0}} was removed. *The Glider along with the [[Parachute]] can be used to move during a game of [[Memory Match]]. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Gliding Tools]] [[Category:Accessories]] [[Category:Transport]]

docs.title: Glitches
docs.text:
{{Inaccurate}} '''Glitches''', or '''bugs''', are situations that can occur in-game that are unintended, and thus likely to be patched in future [[updates]]. Some of these glitches can be detrimental to gameplay while others are mostly visual and won't affect players.

''Note: Glitches (mostly visual) with an asterisk (*) next to its name means this glitch can happen in other games, as well as Roblox Studio.''

== Mob Glitches ==

=== Mobs Unable to Move === [[File:Cococrab.png|thumb|356x356px|Coconut Crab stuck in the [[Coconut Cave]] during 7/20/2022. Image taken from a video on [https://www.reddit.com/r/BeeSwarmSimulator/comments/w3fqwx/what_the_heck_is_up_with_my_coconut_crab_ive/ Reddit].]] Occasionally, a [[mob]] will get trapped in the collision box of certain objects around it. This usually renders them unable to move or escape, which makes killing them easier. The mob can still be attacked and will still drop rewards normally. This glitch seems to happen primarily to [[Mantis]]es when they leap into objects, such as a wall. Sometimes, the [[King Beetle]] gets stuck in the corner which says "Song Name" near it, making it easy to kill him. This can also happen to [[Stick Bug]] in certain places.

In mid-2022, during the days of 7/19-20, 7/22-31, 8/2, and 8/3, all mobs (Excluding the [[Werewolf]], Stick Bug, [[Tunnel Bear]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], and [[Aphid]]s) would be frozen in place upon entering the area they spawn in. Affected bosses include the [[Coconut Crab]], [[King Beetle]], and [[Stump Snail]]. This makes killing them easier, as the mobs will not be able to voluntarily attack the player. On 7/21/2022, Onett would fix this glitch (temporarily) and added the code "FrozenBugReboot" to suffice for the glitch. The glitch would become fixed and unfixed for multiple weeks until 8/3/2022, when Onett would finally fix the glitch permanently in servers of version 448+.

=== Frozen Field Defenders === When the player jumps while a mob is going towards them to attack, the mob freezes and does not move towards the player again until the player lands on the ground. This generally makes killing mobs easier. This does not apply to [[Stump Snail]], [[Ants]], [[:Category:Bosses|Bosses]], Aphids, and [[Cave Monster]]s.

=== Out of Bounds Mobs === Mobs will occasionally go out of bounds (outside of the map). It is unknown why or how this happens, but when it does, mobs will attempt to walk to their desired spawn field. However, bees can still attack it, with it acting the same as if players were to kill it in the field it defends.

=== Collapsing Mobs === [[File:Collapsed ladybug.png|alt=An example of a Collapsed Ladybug|thumb|A collapsed [[Ladybug]].]] This glitch is purely visual, but it can be triggered when a mob, such as a [[Ladybug]] or [[Rhino Beetle]] is defeated while it is trying to move. The mob's head or any other part can move inward. This glitch seems more common with the [[Ladybug]] and [[Spider]].

=== Invisible Meshes* === If the meshes (notably the Chick eggshell and both of the Stump Snail's body and shell) doesn't load yet, they will appear invisible. This is purely a visual glitch. This glitch can be fixed by waiting until the meshes load or by rejoining the game.[[File:Mondo chick with no egg.png|thumb|193x193px|A Mondo Chick with an invisible egg.]] [[File:Commando chick with no egg.png|thumb|A Commando Chick with an invisible egg.]]

=== [[King Beetle]] in the Fields === Sometimes, when a player dies or glitches their way out of [[King Beetle Lair|King Beetle's Lair]], King Beetle's head and health can be seen outside from the Blue Flower Field. This is not rare, as it happens very often when players die. This seems to be because the script that lets you see its health is still running. [[File:Invisible Stump Snail body.png|alt=An example of an invisible Stump Snail.|thumb|An example of an invisible Stump Snail.]]

=== [[King Beetle]] Stuck in Flower === This glitch is quite rare. To activate it, the player should stand near the entrance to the King Beetle's Lair then let it attack them. When they die, there is a very small chance that it'll go out of its lair and get stuck at the flowers near the entrance. To fix this, either go inside the lair again or rejoin.

=== Spinning [[King Beetle]] === This glitch can occur when fighting [[King Beetle]], causing it to spin around. This glitch is relatively rare. The cause is currently unknown.[[File:King beetle stuck.png|alt=King beetle stuck in flower|thumb|The King Beetle stuck in the flower below the lair entrance.]]

=== [[Stick Nymph]] Spawns === Sometimes, when Stick Bug summons Stick Nymphs in a field with a wall beside it (the Strawberry, Bamboo, Spider, Clover, Mountain top, Blue Flower, and Pineapple fields) some of the Stick Nymphs get stuck inside the wall making them unable to move.

=== [[Stick Nymph]] Rain === If the player stands on the instant converter by the [[Mountain Top Field]], they can trick all the Stick Nymphs into falling through the gap between the field and the platform, making them fall straight through to the inside of the [[Pro Shop]] (the Stick Nymphs no-clip right through the ceiling), and will stay by the containers in the Pro Shop, constantly trying to get back to the Mountain Top Field. They will remain there after Stick Bug switches fields and can kill anyone who is in the Pro Shop. To fix this, simply kill the Stick Nymphs or just wait until the Stick Bug Challenge ends.

=== Floating [[Stick Nymph]] === This bug is where a stick nymph is left floating above a field, even after the challenge has ended.

=== [[Cave Monster]] Death === When Cave Monsters die, their body will remain in the location of defeat. The walking sound will repeatedly play as if they were still walking. Rejoining could be a method to stop the walking sound.

=== [[Cub Buddy]] Stuck in Bag === When a cub buddy goes inside a bag in the Pro Shop or [[Mountain Top Shop]], it can’t get out. When in the bag, they can't be interacted with. [[File:40323E7A-67D3-4832-8811-70DA3B4FE0D2.jpeg|thumb|170px|An example of a Cub Buddy being stuck in a bag.]]

=== Enormous [[Mobs|Mob]] HP Bars === This glitch causes a mob to have enormous health bar. This is because that HP is the HP that the mob loads with, and after the mob loads, the game changes the HP. However, if the player's internet is slow or lagging, the game doesn't change the HP and so the mob appears to gain a large amount of HP (usually 1,300,400,000). Its HP should return to normal after a short period of time.

=== Enormous Mob Time Bars === The same as the Enormous Mob HP bars glitch, but this happens with the time bar instead.

=== [[Snowbear]] Leaving the Spider Field === Sometimes, if the snowbear gets [[Ability Tokens|Mind Hacked]], it will wander out of the field, sometimes getting stuck. It can even potentially wander out of the 5 Bee Zone.

=== No Numbers on [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]'s Health Bar* === This glitch causes the numbers on the Rogue Vicious Bee's health bar to go invisible. This is purely visual, and the moment Rogue Vicious Bee takes damage, the health bar will return to normal.[[File:GlitchAmountHP.png|thumb|150px|An example of a mob's enormous glitched HP bar.]]

=== Confused [[Coconut Crab]] ===

If the player stands on the wall of the [[Coconut Field]], the Coconut Crab will think the player is standing on the field and try to attack the player with its claw attack but cannot hit the player. It should be noted that the falling coconut attack still can hit the player, even though this can be dodged by jumping.

=== Confused [[Commando Chick]] === If the player stands on the entrance to Commando Chick's lair, putting them on the elevated floor and inside the spawn area of Commando Chick at the same time, Commando Chick will not be able to damage the player by touching them. Commando Chick can still damage the player with grenades and the glitch making it go on the ledge while in egg form.

=== Slow [[Coconut Crab]] Claws === This glitch causes the Coconut Crab's claws to jab slowly but the crab is moving at normal speed, making it much harder to avoid the attack. If the Coconut Crab starts to jab with its claws again, this may result in it attacking with all of its claws. This usually happens when the player or server is lagging, and can be avoided by either changing your internet, rejoining, or joining a different server.

=== Commando Egg Transportation ===

If a [[Commando Chick]] transforms into an egg in the corner north-west of the arena's entrance, it can briskly move to the corner south-west of the entrance.

=== Commando Wall Jump === If a player is standing near the entrance to [[Commando Chick's Hideout]], when it goes into its shell, it will sometimes jump onto the ledge. [[Commando Chick]] can still be harmed and will return to the hideout when it comes out of its shell.

=== Slow Mobs Glitch === This glitch causes field defenders to move at a slower speed. This includes the speed at which the mobs fall from a spawning location. The cause of this glitch is unknown though it happens at the same time as the Slow Bees Glitch, meaning it may be caused by bad internet connection or extreme lag.

=== Frozen [[Stump Snail]] === [[File:Screen Shot 2021-01-01 at 10.07.30 PM.png|thumb|An example of a glitched Stump Snail.]] If a player with a cub buddy goes into the blue HQ and keeps on activating and deactivating the cub buddy, it can get glitched inside of the elite blue guard and can then teleport away with the guard. If the player goes to the Stump Snail and positions the glitched Cub Buddy in one of the corners, when the snail reaches that corner, it will no longer be able to move.

=== Moving [[Commando Chick]] in Egg === It is unknown how this glitch occurs, but it is probably because the game thinks that it is out of its egg without showing it out of it. It will cause Commando Chick to move around while still inside its egg. Here's a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EB5rYJOJfSI video] as reference for this glitch.

=== Speedy Commando Chick Glitch* === This glitch occurs randomly when Commando Chick spawns. Commando Chick's feet become stuck in the ground, and it will move around extremely quickly only stopping when hiding in its egg. This bug can occur in conjunction with the Moving Commando in Egg glitch.

=== Dancing [[Stump Snail]] Glitch === [[File:7719D772-2083-4C0D-A457-823B38F07D8C.jpg|thumb|A Stump Snail dancing in the field.]] This glitch occurs sometimes when fighting the Stump Snail. It causes the Stump Snail to start moving from side to side. Part of its body can go off the field itself. This happens occasionally when the Stump Snail changes its direction when it is moving.

=== Grenade Rain === This glitch can be performed by constantly exiting and entering the [[Commando Chick's Hideout|Commando Chick's hideout]] repeatedly, causing the Commando Chick to spawn and despawn while summoning two grenades at a time. The grenades can kill players inside the hideout. This glitch can be annoying for people that are in the hideout that just want to defeat their Commando Chicks. Very rarely, if the player does this enough, it will knock the fleeing Commando Chick into the ground. It will stay there as the new Commando Chick does its normal behavior. After around 5 seconds, it will despawn.

=== Inanimate [[Coconut Crab]] === Similar to the Mobs Unable to Move glitch, the Coconut Crab can sometimes go inanimate and would therefore be unable to move.

=== [[Fireflies]] Stuck Inside Walls === Sometimes a firefly will get stuck inside a wall and the player will not be able to nudge the firefly. The rest of the fireflies will remain in air. Fireflies can get stuck in multiple different places such as the [[Honey Bee Gate]]. [[File:RobloxScreenShot20210206 190536528.png|alt=Fireflies not moving glitch|thumb|Glitched Fireflies.]]

=== Fast Coconuts === Sometimes, a coconut from the Coconut Crab will drop too early. This will cause many problems for the players because it drops too fast, and the player can't see it. Lag is the main cause of this occurring. [[File:RobloxScreenShot20210215 081453025 (2).png|thumb|A glitched Coconut Crab.]]

=== Moving Claws === Sometimes the claws of a Coconut Crab will move with the Coconut Crab; it can make things harder for players as the glitch happens from time to time if a player's connection isn't working properly.

=== Fallen [[Mondo Chick]] === Occasionally, [[Mondo Chick]] may fall off of the [[Mountain Top Field]] into the [[Bamboo Field]] or the [[Pineapple Patch]]. Loot dropped from Mondo Chick's defeat will spawn inside the field it was defeated in, and if it fails to reach a field before this happens it spawns no loot at all. This glitch is a result of Mondo entering its egg just close enough to the edge of the Mountain Top that the moment it leaves, if it moves in the correct direction, it falls out of the field.

=== Cub Buddy Loop Glitch === When there's an [[Ability Tokens|ability token]] made by a [[Bees|bee]] in the air, the player's [[Cub Buddy]] might go for it and keep teleporting next to the player. This can also happen when standing on a ledge. The cub may walk off and constantly teleport to the same spot, then fall again. [[File:RobloxScreenShot20220224 161414390.png|thumb|193.981x193.981px|Another glitched coconut crab.]]

=== Invisible and Non-Attacking Coconut Crab === This is a partly visual glitch occurs while you are in the middle of fighting the Coconut Crab. The only way that the Coconut Crab can damage you during this glitch is when you touch its hitbox or touch any of its visible claws. A purely visual glitch occurs when you either leave the Coconut Field, or defeat the Coconut Crab, where the remaining Coconut Crab arms float mid-air. The floating Coconut Crab arm is purely a visual glitch, and may only stop once the server is empty, and closes. It is currently unknown how either of these glitches occur. === Frozen Cub Buddy === [[File:Weird cub buddy glitch.webp|thumb|The frozen cub buddy glitch|153x153px]] This glitch causes parts of the player's cub buddy to freeze wherever it goes. The cause of this glitch is unknown, although it is most likely cause by a bad connection.

=== Submerged Cogmowers === [[File:CogmowerGlitch.png|thumb|A Cogmower mostly submerged in the Pineapple Patch.|140x140px]] Rarely, when the player goes to another field during the [[Robo Bear Challenge]], some [[Cogmower]]s when rising up to follow the player will not fully rise up into the field rendering them mostly submerged, or fully submerged in the field on where the player is in. It is unknown what causes this glitch.

=== Infinite Lawn Mowers === The [[Ant Challenge]] timer freezes and [[ants]] will stop spawning, it starts to spam lawn mowers which will not deal any damage to you. This rarely occurs if you play the Ant Challenge when [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] is trying to reset servers for a new update/bug fix.

=== Crashing Mondo === This sometimes happens when you let Mondo Chick despawn, when it does its leaving jump animation, it can sometimes crash into the Instant Converter or the Mountain Top Shop, spins back, lays for a few seconds before despawning,

=== Frozen Mechsquitos === [[File:LandMowersGoesCrazy.jpg|thumb|The Infinite Lawn Mowers Glitch|206x206px]] When the player dies during [[Robo Bear Challenge]], all [[Mechsquito]]s stop targeting the player until a bee attack one again. This may not be a glitch, as it could also be to not instantly kill the player on arrival, but Cogmowers remain active (although they do not target the player) and Cogturrets also keep going, thus possibly making this a glitch.

=== Gifted [[Rogue Vicious Bee|Vicious Bee's]] Health Bar === When a gifted Rogue Vicious Bee spawns, it's not always at maximum health. It is usually missing around 5% of its maximum health. This could possibly be due to the [[Glitches#Vicious Bee Spike Glitch|Vicious Bee Spike Glitch]] and it somehow damages itself.

=== [[Ant Challenge|Ants]] Stuck in Wall === Rarely during an Ant Challenge, an [[Regular Ant|Ant]] or a [[Fire Ant]] can get stuck on the wall where the lawn mowers come from. They will stay stuck in the wall until the challenge ends, or they are defeated.

=== Glitched Fastest Time === Since the [[Updates|12/26/2022 update]], the fastest time a player can defeat the Mondo Chick, or the Coconut Crab is glitched and won't update if the player defeats them with a faster time than their previous record.

=== Flopping Cub Buddies === [[File:Frozen Mobs and Flopping Cub Buddies Glitches Message.png|thumb|A message acknowledging the Flopping Cub Buddies.]] Sometimes, a Cub Buddy will get glitched and fall over nonstop. It can't summon any tokens or collect any tokens while this effect is active.

=== Other Players' Mobs Attacking You === If a mob has no target (either because the target died or left the attack zone), the mob becomes capable of hitting anyone within its hitbox. This is noticeable when collecting pollen in the [[Coconut Field]] when your Coconut Crab has already been defeated. This glitch can be replicated when a player is fighting a Coconut Crab, and you are inside the player’s Coconut Crab’s hitbox. If the player dies or leaves, the Coconut Crab can damage you while traveling back to its spawn location. This can occur with any mob that has a set spawn location. Occasionally, this can also occur with Tunnel Bear. The cause of this glitch is unknown.

== Player Glitches ==

=== [[Quests|Quest]] Skipping === [[Quest Givers|Quest givers]] can act like the player have done more [[quests]] than they have actually done, giving them quests from farther ahead without giving them the rewards for the quests that should be completed. This means that the player could miss out on [[Spirit Bear]] quests and not be able to get all of the {{Cost|Spirit Petal}} or miss out on [[Science Bear]] quests and not get all of the {{Cost|Translator}}. This can happen for unknown reasons.

=== Receiving/Completing Removed Quests === Occasionally, if a player has completed the requirements for a quest that has been removed from the game, they can still get the rewards or possibly receive the next quest, this appears to be most common with [[Black Bear#Repeatable Quests .28Old.29|Black Bear's old repeatable quests]]. [[File:Black Bear Old Quests Glitch.png|thumb|An image showing a player receiving one of black bear's old quests.]]

=== Talking to [[Spirit Bear]] with less than 35 bees === If the player has laggy internet or high ping, they can talk to Spirit Bear by gliding from the top of the Windy Bee Gate with less than 35 bees.

=== [[Glider]]/[[Parachute]] on while running glitch === If the player lands on the ground with a glider/parachute on, still have it on until they jump, equip it, and unequip it before they touch the ground. This glitch happened on 9/17/2020 but was patched the very same day. However, on 9/19/2020 it started to glitch again.

=== Shop Trap === This glitch can occur in any shop. When players reset with the shop open, they are unable to close the interface, as there is no button to do so. Players are able to exit the shop by resetting their character and spamming the E key, but this won't work all the time so players may have to reset a few times or rejoin. This mostly happens in [[Gummy Bear's Lair]].

=== Bear Morph Body Split Glitch === [[File:ZGLitch 2.png|thumb|120px|An example of the Bear Morph Body Split Glitch.]] One glitch can rarely occur when players die or enter a game with [[Bear Morph]] active. It causes the player to appear with no head and sometimes a few limbs. Players will not be able to equip items, and they'll often move erratically. To fix it, wait until the bear morph buff expires, then leave and rejoin the game. Resetting also works, but players will still lose their pollen unless they use a micro-converter beforehand.

=== Sticker Quests Buggy Progress Bar === Sometimes, a sticker requirement for a quest will suddenly reset to zero before moving back to the player's current progress.

=== Wall Stuck Glitch === [[File:Bear morph glitch-0.png|thumb|180px|alt=|An example of the Wall Stuck Glitch with Bear Morph on.]] If Bear Morph is active and players get too close to an outside wall, they can get stuck in the wall. They will remain stuck until the bear transformation ends, and the player will be able to move again. If players try to do this on purpose, they will likely achieve the desired glitch. If players don't get out of the wall, they should leave and rejoin the game rather than resetting, so they don't lose the [[pollen]] in their backpack unless they use an [[Instant Converter]] or a [[Micro-Converter|micro-converter]]. Rarely, players can get stuck in a wall even without Bear Morph. Using certain Rthro packages, like the Gothic Gargoyle, can lead to body parts becoming distorted.

=== Frozen Glitch === This glitch makes the player frozen in place until the player resets their character or rejoins the game, however the player will still be able to move their tool to collect [[pollen]] if standing in a field. To cause this glitch is unknown but using a weak internet, high ping, being on low battery mode on mobile and using a complex [[Mechanics|mechanic]], (Memory match, Pollen Pot, purchasing high-cost items, and [[Beesmas]] [[mechanics]]) will usually cause this glitch.

=== Invisible Splinter Trap === If a player respawns right as Stick Bug uses his [[Stick Bug Challenge#Splinter Trap|Splinter Trap]], they will still get the debuff. However, players will not see the pollen requirement to remove it and will continuously deal damage until death unless they fulfill the unknown pollen requirement.

=== Ant Challenge Haste+ Glitch === If players start the Ant Challenge with Haste+ and run towards the ant hill, they will "leave" the [[Ant Field]] and will be taken out of the field given the amulet with the score they had at the time of leaving.

=== Empty Ant Challenge Glitch === This glitch causes the Ant Challenge to be empty. It is unknown what causes this glitch, but it is theorized that this glitch happens when a player leaves the game while doing the Ant Challenge. [[File:BD8F04F9-9A82-4F43-85B5-AEA386C0A454.jpeg|thumb|The Empty Ant Challenge Glitch]]

=== Walking on Lava Glitch === [[File:On lav.png|thumb|A player on top of lava.]] There is multiple [[Obstacle Courses]] that have instant-death floors. However, using a max scale Roblox character and one of the 2019 Rthro Football packages, it is possible to walk on top of these floors. However, certain emotes can cause the character to collide with the floor, such as /e dance3. This also works with the Levitation Animation Pack. Sometimes hitting the lava floor at a high enough speed (Such as jumping and landing) can cause the player to collide with it and die.

=== Stuck in Objects Glitch === If players have enough speed and run into a solid object, such as a strawberry, they can get stuck inside of the object. Players can get out by resetting, rejoining, or they can run glitch back out by mass jumping and running. [[File:Stuck in objects glitch.png|thumb|A player stuck in a strawberry in the [[Strawberry Field]].]]

=== Sideways Ability === [[File:Películas y TV 31 08 2020 09 21 23 a. m. (2).png|thumb|160px|The Sideways Ability in action.|alt=]] This glitch is a minor glitch and doesn't affect gameplay. Abilities such as the [[Porcelain Dipper]] ability, supercharged [[Golden Rake]], and petal shuriken are based on the player's orientation. Because of this, activating an ability can be summoned sideways instead of upright. Possible ways to achieve this include being flung by [[Wild Windy Bee]], or when the player is in a vertical facing position, or when the player is spamming wasd in a certain order when it is activated (people do this to also benefit from the boots collecting passive).

=== Glider Clip Glitch === Sometimes, if a wall is thin enough, a player will be able to glide against it and clip through it.

=== Shop Trap 2 === If the player activates the red field booster and quickly open the shop, the button for activating the red field booster will be on the screen instead of the "Close Shop" button. This will result in the player getting stuck inside the shop with no way to close it. The same glitch will occur if the player has a high-speed boost and runs towards the blender at the correct angle then quickly opens the sprinkler shop.

=== Death Teleport === Sometimes when the player dies, their head or other body parts will teleport to the [[King Beetle's Lair|King Beetle’s Lair]], no matter their location of death. This does not activate [[King Beetle]]. When the player is dead and teleports to King Beetle’s Lair after dying, they can’t leave the lair until they respawn.

This is often caused by the player collecting the Bear Morph token from [[Bear Bee]] in any way (usually from their Cub Buddy) after the player dies or resets. If the token collected is a Black Bear, Brown Bear, or Polar Bear Morph, it will teleport the player into the King Beetle's Lair. In the case of a Science Bear Morph, it will teleport the player next to Science Bear.

=== Stuck in [[Ant Field]] Glitch === If the player has slow internet connection and starts the ant challenge, there is a chance that the game will detect the player as being "disconnected" from the game when the internet connection acts up. This causes the player to get stuck in the Ant Field, due to the game thinking the player had disconnected from the server. This can be fixed when someone else starts the Ant Challenge, kicking the player out of the field. This glitch is beneficial to some quests requiring pollen from the field.

=== Invisible Pollen Collector === [[File:My friend lost his collector LOL.png|thumb|alt=A player having no collector.]] There is a glitch where the player can lose their pollen collector, it is encountered when the player dies, or it can happen if they click backspace. The player can fix this by rejoining or by equipping another collector and equipping their original one. If the player loses their pollen collector by pressing backspace, they can press backspace again within the next 5 seconds to get it back. This glitch can also happen when the inventory slot of the collector appears and is clicked.

It can also happen if a player has slow internet, and the inventory shows up on the "Loading" screen and the player unequips the pollen collector. When the player spawns, they will have no pollen collector. To fix this they have to rejoin the game or reset their character. It can also be fixed by equipping a different pollen collector and equipping back to your original pollen collector.

=== Invisible Twigs === When [[Stick Bug]] moves to a different field and the player is not in flowers, the game will say they've been trapped in twigs, but the pollen to remove it and the twigs itself will not appear. This can be fixed by leaving the game. This can also be caused if the player has twigs on them when they die. You can also stop this glitch by leaving and rejoining.

=== Floor Gliding === [[File:Stuck in floor glitch.png|thumb|147x147px|A player stuck in the floor.]] This can happen when landing on the ground with high ping, the player will get stuck in the floor and start moving around at high speeds without being able to control where they are going. They can get out of the floor by moving off the edge of whatever surface they got stuck in or resetting. The player can partially control which direction they move in by equipping their glider. Note: If the player plays on computer, they can use shift lock and move with their glider equipped.

=== [[Tide Popper]] freeze glitch === On 1/01/2022, going to the Tide Popper in the [[Blue HQ]] shop would cause a game freeze not letting you leave the shop anymore. Onett and the Bee Swarm Simulator crew left a warning sign for all users to not visualize the item.

=== Player becoming noob skin glitch === If you do the [[Glitches#Shop Trap|Shop Trap]] glitch in the pro bear shop, you have a chance (using the porcelain dipper, Mondo belt, Beekeeper Boots, Propeller hat, Port-O-Hive, Elite Bucko Guard) to become a noob skin.[[File:Tide popper glitch.png|alt=The warning sign about the Tide Popper glitch|thumb|Onett alerting the players about the Tide Popper freeze glitch.]]

=== Extra Long Respawn Time Glitch === This glitch happens when you activate Emergency Coconut Shield and die, the player will not respawn until the Emergency Coconut Shield ends + original respawn time, resetting the character does not work.

=== Healing Lawnmowers Glitch === This glitch occurs in the Ant Challenge. If the player is wearing Coconut Canister and triggers the Emergency Coconut Shield passive, during this period, all lawn mowers will heal the player instead of damaging them. Ironically, this was the only way for the player to heal themselves without dying outside of the small autoheal that is always in effect.

=== Extremely Fast Speed === When you are fighting snowbear, your haste stack ends when you get hit by a snowball. When the ice-cube debuff ends, you should have very fast speed. Note that when you're frozen, you cannot get hit by anything. The glitch ends if you reset, take damage, or leave the game.

=== Invisible player === [[File:Invisible player.webp|thumb|An invisible player]] Sometimes, the player may turn invisible. The glitch can be fixed by resetting. The cause of this glitch is unknown.

=== Audio glitch === If players go in different areas the audio will overlap for everyone.

===Glider Clip Speed Glitch===

Sometimes, when using the Glider and hitting a ledge, you get stuck on it and move really fast left and right until you glide off the ledge or stop gliding.

==Buff Stacking Glitch*==

On mobile, when exiting the app, usually you are kicked out of the game after a bit of time. However, sometimes you stay in-game. This potentially stacks up all the tokens and events, making it all happen at once, allowing you to have more than 2 Bear Morphs at once. As stated before, this may just be a visual glitch, but it could also potentially stack up to something like Inspire x50.

[[File:HexaBearMorph.jpg|thumb|6 Bear Morphs active at once.]]

== Bee Glitches ==

=== Confused Bee === This glitch causes a bee to spin around the flower it wants to collect, instead of collecting it. To fix it, clear out the flower the bee is stuck in, and the bee will go somewhere else, or just leave the field and the bee will follow the owner.

=== Extreme Bee Energy === This glitch can occur after using Royal Jelly on a [[Photon Bee]] or an [[Exhausted Bee]] and leads to a bee having a ridiculous amount of energy. This can be fixed by leaving and rejoining the server. This glitch can also occur when a bee has full energy when the player dies. The energy is raised to incredible amounts.

=== Sideways Spinning Glitch === This glitch is when a bee rotates to summon a token, but is also rotated in the direction it is while gathering.[[File:Glitched Diamond Bee.png|extreme bee glitch|thumb|An example of extreme bee energy.]]

=== Long Trail/Effect Glitch === [[File:An example of a Tadpole bee stretching .jpg|thumb|A [[Tadpole Bee|Tadpole]] [[Tadpole Bee|Bee's.]] trail stretching]] [[File:RobloxScreenShot20210201 194527523.png|thumb|Temporary bees stuck near wealth clock.]] This bug takes place when the player has a bad internet connection, causing their bees to teleport around the screen. Any bees with 2D trails ([[Tadpole Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Photon Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], [[Ninja Bee]], [[Windy Bee|Windy bee]]) will cause the said trail to stretch to any length the bee has traveled through the lag.

This bug can also happen if the player uses a [[Whirligig]] while inside of the [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. ===Stuck Bees Glitch=== During [[Beesmas]] 2020 and 2021, if a player used [[Onett's Lid Art]], [[Honeyday Candles]], Gummy Beacon, or Honey Wreath (after the player finished Honey Bee's Beesmas quest) the player's temporary bees may get stuck anywhere around the map after they're supposed to despawn. This glitch will always happen if the owner of the bees leaves. Even if the same player joins the same server again, the bees remain devoid of movement.

===[[Rogue Vicious Bee|Vicious Bee]] Spike Glitch=== If a new [[Mobs|Mob]] spawns while a [[Vicious Bee]] uses its impale ability (while in range of the impale), each spike will deal the same amount of damage as it would if only a single spike targets a Mob (5% of health + attack damage), dealing massive amounts of damage. The easiest setup for it is with a [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] and [[Mondo Chick]] in the [[Mountain Top Field]].

=== Frozen Bee Glitch ===

Sometimes bees will freeze in their position and not move. The cause of this glitch is unknown, but it happens fairly commonly while fighting mobs, especially Stump Snail.

=== Confused Fighting Glitch ===

This glitch can occur when the Spider is still on cool-down. While it is recovering, the player can walk against the Spider Cave (where the Spider spawns), and the bees will think a hostile mob is around them. They will spawn [[Ability Tokens|tokens]] that will only be spawned when encountering an enemy (e.g: A Vicious Bee spawning an Impale token). This is for unknown reasons, though it may be because the Cave Monster spawn is above or too close to the Spider Cave, so the bees will spawn tokens that will only be spawned when attacking an enemy.

=== Bees Sleeping Sideways Glitch ===

Sometimes, the player's bees will sleep sideways, instead of upside down. The cause of this is extremely high lag and bad internet connection. The player's bees will also move extremely slowly.

=== Slow Bees Glitch === During the glitch, all bees will move at a significantly slower speed. The cause of this glitch is unknown however it happens at the same time as the Slow Mobs Glitch, meaning it may be caused by lag, high ping, or bad internet.

=== Stuck [[Vector Bee]] Glitch === During the Robo Bear Challenge, if a player collected the duplicate token of a triangulate ability token from a Vector Bee which is currently in the hive and not one of the bees that were chosen by the player during the Robo Bear Challenge, it will get stuck in the air for a while and not move even after the round ends. [[File:Glitched shop.jpg|thumb|Demon Mask shop displaying Royal Jelly shop]] [[File:What??.png|thumb|Bees sleeping sideways.]]

== Visual/Audio Glitches ==

=== Wrong [[:Category:Shops|Shop]] Display === When you enter a shop, it will display the the image of the shop that you enter previously before coming to this shop for a split second. Thereafter, it will display the correct image of the current shop that you are in. The cause of the glitch is unknown but may be due to lag or high ping.

=== Negative [[Sprout]] Numbers Glitch === [[File:RobloxScreenShot20210107 143451471 (3).png|thumb|An example of the sprout glitch.]] When the player pops a sprout too quickly or if a player has high ping, the numbers that show the amount of pollen needed will show the excess pollen that was collected with a negative sign in front of it. If a sprout is popped normally, it will show small negative numbers for a split second before disappearing. The numbers will go below the field, as well as turning red, and if the number of pollen collected is high enough it will turn purple.

=== Phantom Token=== [[File:Phantom Pineapple.jpeg|thumb|A phantom pineapple token.]] [[File:Strawbeary by 3than5wee.png|thumb|A phantom strawberry token.]] This glitch can happen when a player joins the game right when a [[Honeystorm]] or [[Snowstorm]] ends, after a [[sprout]] has been popped, or can happen very rarely by other means because the token appeared almost exactly when the player joined. Images of tokens are visible, but not the token itself. Players cannot collect phantom tokens. The phantom tokens remain until the player leaves. This can also happen on PC if you leave the game minimized for too long, causing the lag to prevent visual token despawning.

=== Incorrect Dialogue Box === Occasionally when the player interacts with the wind shrine the previous text box that they encountered will be displayed, but it still says it's from the [[Wind Shrine]]. This glitch can also be done with other NPCs if the player is in the dialogue box to start the Stick Bug Challenge, and another player starts the challenge. The player can then talk to another NPC, which will show the normal dialogue for starting the challenge, but with the name of the NPC the player is talking to.

=== Onett/[[Stick Bug]]/[[Mondo Chick]] Falling === [[File:Screenshot 2021-01-09 093608.png|thumb|The incorrect dialogue box glitch.]]Occasionally the statue of Onett on top of a hive, [[Stick Bug]], or the [[Mondo Chick]] will fall off their designated location. Onett usually falls to the ground around the sixth hive. Stick Bug usually lands around the [[Mushroom Field]], or sometimes the [[Dandelion Field]]. With the Mondo Chick, it usually lands on the [[Bamboo Field]] or in front of the [[Pro Shop]]. This glitch will not affect gameplay, except in the case of Mondo Chick, as players will have to move to a different location to continue fighting it.[[File:Lolwtf.PNG|alt=geared bear morph glitch|thumb|The geared bear morph glitch.]] === Geared Bear Morph === This glitch happens when players equip any item while the bear morph buff is active. It simply makes gear appear when the player is a bear. The glitch gets fixed when the bear morph buff ends.

=== No Fog === This glitch happens when a [[Honeystorm]], [[Snowstorm]] (from Beesmas 2020, 2021, and 2022), or [[Mythic Meteor Shower]] is active and a switch between [[Day/Night Cycle|day and night]] occurs: the fog disappears. This does not end these events; the fog is just invisible. Similar to the fog disappearing, if a Honeystorm is summoned during a Mythic Meteor Shower (or vice versa), the fog will override to the newer spawn. Afterward, the fog will disappear. [[File:No fog.jpg|thumb|The no fog glitch (Honeystorm).]]

=== [[Ant Challenge]] Boost Glitch === This glitch sometimes occurs after an [[Ant Challenge]] ends. The icon for the Ant Challenge buff will still be visible. The reason of this glitch is because the instant conversion is designed to last until the end of one whole run. Nothing will happen because it only grants 100% '''Ant Field''' Instant Conversion. [[File:Phantom Honey Token.jpg|thumb|A phantom honey token.]]

=== Red Hive Slot Glitch === [[File:RobloxScreenShot20191113 201729946.png|thumb|209x209px|Red Hive Slots.]]This glitch makes a [[Hive Slot|hive slot]] look red. To activate it, click and hold a random consumable from the inventory that doesn't give bond ([[gumdrops]], [[Magic Bean|magic beans]], etc.) and use it as if it were to be fed to a bee. To fix it, players can either rejoin the game or click another random item ([[ticket]]s and [[Spirit Petal]]s won't work). This also works on empty hive slots but instead of turning the empty hive slot red, it will turn white. Using consumables that can be used outside of fields, like Red and Blue Extracts, can cause multiple bees to have red Hive Slots. [[File:RobloxScreenShot20200627 104915217.png|thumb|206x206px|A white colored empty hive slot (as seen on the top middle).]]

=== Extra-Bright Hive Slots === This glitch makes all the player's bees with a beequip brighter. To activate it, the player should click and hold [[Swirled Wax]] and drag it to their hotbar. To fix it, rejoin the game or click on a treat.

=== Colored Hive Slots === Although it might be intentional, when using using hive skins, the hive slot will turn a different color depending on the hive skin. To make it normal, drag a treat or any item that makes a bee slot go red or green out of the inventory. You do not need to use it though. Alternatively, you could reset or rejoin the game.

=== Invisible Mask Icon === If players equip the Diamond Mask, its icon on the boost bar will be invisible. However, players can still hover their cursor over it and view its stats.

=== Phantom Glider === If players press the jump button right before the frame they hit the ground, they will jump back up, and the glider will be seen above the player. The player will not automatically glide but can input the glide command to trigger it as usual.

=== Invisible Glider === Sometimes if players die while gliding, they will see only 1 glider rope. When players use the gliding tool again, the rope will disappear.

===Negative Pollen Quest Glitch=== This glitch makes the amount of pollen that the player has collected in a quest be in negative numbers. This glitch happens randomly when redeeming a quest, or when the player pops a bubble and exits the field quickly.

=== No Cub Buddy Glitch === This glitch causes the Cub Buddy to not be in sight, even if the Cub Buddy is equipped.

=== Phantom Flame === This glitch is similar to a Phantom Token, but it happens to a Flame instead. A high-rise (or just maxed out) flame will appear indefinitely on a field, but the flame won't do anything. The cause of this glitch is currently unknown.

=== Bee Stats Glitch === This glitch causes the stats of a bee to be messed up, such as different attack, speed, energy, bond, level, and picture. Mostly, a frosty bee appears as placeholder.

=== Flower Texture Glitch=== Occasionally, the texture on flowers will disappear and appear completely green. However, this is completely visual, and the flower can still be collected. This glitch is often caused by lag, although this can also happen if the player just joined Bee Swarm Simulator on a slow/low-end device. where the assets are still loading. === Amulet Glitches === [[File:Roblox 5 16 2020 10 54 20 AM (3).png|thumb|220px|A player's amulets stuck above the bamboo field.]] Sometimes, for unknown reasons some of the player's amulets will disappear. However, the amulet's buffs are still active. This can be fixed by rejoining the game. There is also a glitch where if the player is in the [[Spider Field]], players might see Amulets clumped together or a [[Cub Buddy]] without an owner. This is caused by someone leaving the server in the Spider Field a while ago. The glitch can’t be fixed.

=== Frozen Treats Glitch === [[File:Frozentreat.jpg|thumb|A Sunflower Seed stuck on the screen with the Frozen Treats Glitch.]] This glitch is known to freeze the image for a consumable item to get stuck on screen. This will more occur more often on mobile rather than a computer. To get this glitch to occur, the player should give all of one desired item to a bee all at once, then extremely quickly select and drag the same item that they just got rid of onto a place on the screen before the item in their inventory is no longer shown. If done correctly, the item will now appear to be stuck on the screen. To fix this glitch, leave then rejoin the server.

=== Green Hotbar Glitch === This glitch causes the player's hotbar to become green. To do this glitch, all players need to do is move an item from their items tab that can go to their hotbar and then close their item tab still holding the item. Then, let go of the item, and the hotbar should stay green. It will stay green until the player drags something to their hotbar, and let go of it without closing the items tab.[[File:Green Screen Hotbar Glitch.jpeg|alt=green screen hotbar glitch|thumb|The green hotbar glitch]]

=== Mask Decal Glitch === For some reason, whenever a player looks at their character through some surfaces, they can still see the front part of the mask they are wearing.[[File:RobloxScreenShot20200823 135006014.png|thumb|270px|A player experiencing the Empty Make Honey glitch.]]

=== Empty Make Honey Glitch === Sometimes, if players have an empty bag and there aren't any balloons surrounding their hive, it says, "Make Honey" instead of "Collect Pollen To Make Honey.", although clicking E doesn't do anything. The cause of this is unknown, but players can fix the glitch by leaving or collecting pollen, returning to the hive and converting it to honey.

=== Empty Instant Converter Glitch === Like the Empty Make Honey Glitch, the Empty Instant Converter Glitch is almost the same. Normally, if the player doesn't have pollen in their bag and they attempt to use the Instant-Converter, it will say, "You need pollen to use the Instant Converter." But in some cases, it will say "Use the Instant Converter" although the player does not have any pollen in their bag.

=== Out-of-Bounds Night Music Glitch === When out of bounds when it's nighttime in-game, when daytime arrives, the night music will still be playing. This will be fixed upon doing anything that would put the player back in bounds, such as resetting, or touching certain areas, which will teleport the player back to the Starter Zone. Leaving and rejoining the game also fixes this. When the player goes onto the summoner, and it becomes nighttime and daytime again, the night music still plays until they leave the area. Like the Special Sprout Summoner, this can also happen when you’re in diamond room and sometimes when you are on top of the [[Basic Bee]] located on top of the [[Basic Bee Gate]].

=== Incorrect Music Glitch === This glitch can occur if the [[Stick Bug Challenge]] is started and it ends at night. Instead of playing the normal nighttime music, it will instead play the music that plays in the respective area the player is in.

It also occurred from 3/18/2023 to 3/??/2023, on Version 477; Where people would hear the wrong music (e.g.: Hearing Vendor instead of Drone, Overflowin instead of Bpatrol, etc..), even if they had Music turned off in the [[System Page]].

=== Forever Green Glitch === [[File:Green hive slot.png|thumb|Forever green glitch.]] To do this glitch, put a treat of any kind in the item toolbar, and all of the player's hive slots will turn green. Players can also make this happen by dragging any kind of treat from the item toolbar, and then close the item toolbar. To fix this glitch, drag a [[Treats|treat]] to anywhere except the toolbar. ===Quest Counter Glitch=== [[File:Glitched quest counter.png|alt=Translation says: Collect 30.000.000 pollen from Sunflower Field|thumb|A glitched quest task counter in Spanish (Translation: Collect 30.000.000 pollen from the Sunflower Field)]] This glitch makes the quest counter numbers say that the player has completed the quest task without completing it, that is, for example: "Defeat 10 Ladybugs", and the player has defeated six ladybugs in total, but the counter of Ladybugs defeated says the player defeated 10. The player can see that the task is not completed due to the green bar behind the text. ===Phantom Sprout=== [[File:Screenshot 2021-06-01 7.39.14 PM.png|thumb|A Phantom Sprout.|alt=|170x170px]] This happens when the player lags. Once a sprout pops, there will be no more numbers on the sprout, but the beam will still be there. This generally fixes itself after a few seconds.

===Translation Glitch=== [[File:Static-assets-upload15197407166964625267.png|thumb|A glitched [[Wealth Clock]] cooldown timer.|185x185px]] [[File:A glitched pollen number on a Black Bear quest.png|alt=A glitched pollen number on a Black Bear quest (notice that it's showing 75 million pollen in the requisite and in how many the player already collected)|thumb|A glitched pollen number on a Black Bear quest.]] This glitch occurs when the player is playing Bee Swarm Simulator in a language other than English. The cooldown timer on objects that the player can interact with will show the same numbers for every second / minute / hour that passes, preventing the player from knowing the remaining cooldown time. The pollen numbers on quests also will glitch, and the name of some mobs will translate to their literal translation. Symbols like a plus (+) may also be swapped for other symbols like a slash (/) and other things may occur. It shares similarities with the [[#Wrong Radiation Emoji|wrong radiation emoji glitch]]. [[File:Glitched mob name.png|alt=in this quest the player need to defeat 8 Mantises, but the Mantises instead of being traduced to it's correct translation, it was traduced to "8"|thumb|In this quest the player needs to defeat 8 Mantises, but the word "Mantises" instead of being translated to it's correct translation, was translated to "8"|161x161px]]

===Phantom Field Boost effect=== [[File:Glitched mission numbers.gif|thumb|Note that the bar is filling, but the numbers are the same.]] When any field boost ends, the snow particle effect from that field will continue for some time.

===Big Beequip Glitch=== This glitch makes every beequip appear unusually large. The player can manually do this glitch by having a beequip equipped to a bee, open up the Beequip Case, go away from the hive from an enough distance, after going far enough, close the beequip case and go back to the hive then open up the beequip case, the icon of the beequips will be larger than normal.

===Wingless Bees/Invisible Transparent Parts=== If the player looks at any transparent parts (mostly bee wings) with a Glass material part standing between the transparent part and the camera, then the transparent part goes invisible.

===Phantom Clouds=== This glitch makes clouds on a field disappear making only the water droplets appear. There is no reason discovered for this glitch yet, although you can still obtain the +25% pollen buff from clouds.

===Server Audio Glitch/Overlapping Audio Glitch=== In a public server, if you had this glitch, you could hear everyone's audios/sound effects. (e.g. Someone was in King Beetle's Lair and Crawlers is playing, meaning that if you had this glitch, you would hear Crawlers without even being in King Beetle's Lair or another place where Crawlers plays.)

===Invisible Party Robots=== [[File:Invisiblel cogturrets.PNG|thumb|Invisible [[Party Cogturret|Party Cogturrets.]]]] If the player joins while a [[Robo Party]] is in progress, all of the Party Robots will appear invisible. The player will still be able to attack them and collect their loot, and the Party Robots will be able to harm the player.

===Quest Givers Stuck in Ground=== Various quest givers will appear slightly stuck in the ground. It is most noticeable with Onett and Stick Bug.[[File:Wingless Bees.png|thumb|An example of wingless bees.]]

===Quest Dialogue Glitch=== When the player immediately talks to an NPC just after claiming the rewards from their quest. They will speak the same dialogue that was during the quest completion.

===Wrong Radiation Emoji=== [[File:Wrong radioactivity emoji.png|thumb|A checkmark emoji instead of the radiation emoji.|150x150px]] The emoji in the hive slot for radioactive is not the radiation emoji. This happens when the in-game language is set to Portuguese (‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍‍), Spanish (☑️), German (⭐), Japanese (📈), Italian (”), Indonesian ( ), or Vietnamese (☢️☢️).

==Item Glitches==

=== Invisible Purple Potion/Super Smoothie Glitch === Prior to the items being officially added to the game, it was possible to obtain [[Purple Potion]]s and [[Super Smoothie]]s from [[Tunnel Bear]] and [[King Beetle]]. The items could not be seen in the inventory but could be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]], where they had the texture of a basic egg and no donation value.

===Broken Auto on Items === Sometimes, if players are using auto on items like [[gumdrops]] or [[coconut]]s lag may temporarily stop using the item for a few seconds. To fix this, ether use the item manually or wait a few seconds for it to work again.

=== False Cooldown === When a cooldown occurs for an item in the hotbar, the time between each second is a bit more than what the game considers to be the cooldown of said item. This results in an item available to be used before the cooldown seen on the hotbar is completed. Usually, this is unnoticeable, but with long-cooldown items such as [[Glitter]] and [[Festive Bean]]s, the cooldown difference is visible.

=== Sprinkler Glitch=== When the player jumps and use a sprinkler multiple times then they can stack sprinklers on top of each other or put them close together, which can be useful. Be aware that if the player has too much jump boost (sources of jump boost include bear morph, boots, etc) then it will show a message saying, "You must be standing in a field to use this." This glitch is very powerful when the player has Golden Gushers or Diamond Drenchers sprinklers because they have a larger quantity of sprinklers.

===Invisible Golden Balloon=== Sometimes, when you collected a Gifted Buoyant Bee's Surprise Party, it will summon Golden Balloons normally, but the balloons are invisible and only its area of effect can be seen, the area is also not moving. It is unknown how this glitch happens.

==Other Glitches==

===Big / Small Text Glitch=== [[File:Big text glitch.png|thumb|An example of the big text glitch.]] [[File:Small text glitch.png|thumb|An example of the small text glitch (in the third bar, click for a better view).]] This glitch is minor and does not affect gameplay. This mainly happens with quests, mostly Brown Bear's. The cause for this glitch is unknown, but could possibly be because of automated text format, or by the fact that the text cannot fit, forcing into a more fitting size.

===Double Memory Match Glitch=== [[File:Double memory match glich.jpg|thumb|A player doing double memory match.]] This glitch occurs when a player interacts with a Memory Match while already in another game of Memory Match. The player will still spend honey and start the machine's cooldown, but they won't get to play it.

===Broken Red Cannon Glitch === If the player is playing with laggy internet, the red cannon may transport the player to the mushroom field or makes them crash into the nearest sunflower to the 5th and 6th hives. If the player's glider is activated when using any cannon, it will fail to fire and teleport the player under the cannon instead.

===Honey/Field Grandmaster Badge Glitch=== [[File:Broken honey badge.jpg|thumb]] If the requirement for a badge is equal to or more than 10,000,000,000 of ''n'', and you finish the requirement, the badge will only show "''n'' / ''n''" rather than "''n'' / ''n'' Complete! Press to collect.".

===Double Passive SSA for 490 Billion Honey === If the player has between 490 billion and 500 billion honey, they will still receive the prompt to generate a double passive [[Star Amulet#Supreme Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulet]] for 500 billion honey upon using the Supreme Star Amulet Generator. If they select yes, they will receive a double passive SSA for 490 billion honey. [[File:Ssaorsomething.png|thumb]] ===Wealth Clock Time Saving When Leaving The Game=== When a player leaves the game while in the hive hub, there is a few minutes of grace period when the wealth clock still has its timing saved when the player rejoins the game.

===Ghost Sticker Glitch=== If a player places a sticker down on the [[Public Sticker Board]] and claims it very quickly, it might leave a ghost sticker on the board. This sticker cannot be seen by other players and is not claimable, yet it still can be interacted with.

docs.title: Glitter
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Glitter.png |description = Boosts the field you're standing in, granting +100% pollen for 15 minutes. |cooldown = 15 minutes 5 seconds }}

{{Color|Glitter}} is a craftable [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. It grants a +100% [[pollen]] boost in the [[field]] the player is standing in for 15 minutes upon activation. If used in a field with a [[planter]], the planter gains a 25% growth rate boost until it is harvested. Glitter has a 15 minute and 5 second cooldown between uses. This is to prevent the user from stacking the item's buff for one field.

It can be used in all fields except the [[Ant Field]]. Attempting to do so will result in the following message: {{Notification|Red|You can't boost a challenge field}}

The following audio plays when glitter is used to boost a field:

[[File:Glitteruse.ogg]]

== Ways to Obtain == * [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Moon Charm|25}} ** {{Cost|Magic Bean|1}} * Playing any type of [[Memory Match]] (Increments of 1 or 5). * As a reward from donating to the [[Wind Shrine]]. * From a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] or [[Ability Tokens#Festive%20Mark|Festive Mark]]. * Purchasing the [[Bee Bear's Catalog|Brilliant Beesmas Bundle]] from Bee Bear's Catalog. * As a stack reward for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** Sideways Spirit Bear rewards 1 glitter. ** Shining Halo rewards 1 glitter. ** Glowing Smile rewards 1 glitter. ** Every Star Sign sticker rewards 1 glitter.

=== Drops === * As a drop from certain mobs: ** [[Tunnel Bear]] ** [[Coconut Crab]] ** [[Stump Snail]] ** [[Scorpion]] (Rare) ** [[Mantis]] (Rare) ** [[Aphid#Diamond Aphid|Diamond Aphid]] (Rare) ** [[King Beetle]] (Rare) ** [[Wild Windy Bee]] (Rare) * Farming in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]] and [[Spider Field]] can rarely drop glitter. ** Harvesting leaves in these fields may also yield glitter. * Can be generated in place of a [[Moon Charm|moon charm]] by [[Fireflies]] during [[Day/Night Cycle|Nighttime]]. * As a rare gift from a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]]. * As a rare drop from [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteors]]. * All [[sprout]]s (excluding the Debug Sprout) can generate a glitter token (possibilities differ depending on the type of sprout) ** Rare drops from Moon [[Sprout]]s will usually yield glitter. * As a rare drop from harvesting [[Sparkles]]. * As a rare drop from [[Puffshroom]]s. * As a drop from certain [[Planter]]s: ** {{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|Tacky Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|Pesticide Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} (Drops bonus glitter) *** Planting the {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} in any white field may yield a bonus {{Cost|Glitter|10}} (Unknown cooldown).

=== Quests === * [[Black Bear]] gives glitter on the following quests: ** Pretty Pumpkins gives 1 glitter and other items. ** All-Whitey Then gives 1 glitter and other items. ** Black Bear can occasionally give glitter after completing a repeatable quest. * [[Science Bear]] gives glitter on the following quests: ** Smart, Not Hard gives 1 glitter and other items. ** Meditating On Phenomenon gives 1 glitter and other items. ** Hive Minded Bias gives 3 glitter and other items. ** Epistemological Endeavor gives 4 glitter and other items. Before its nerf, the quest gave 5 glitter. * [[Dapper Bear]] gives glitter on the following quests: ** Unintended Intimidation gives 2 glitter and other items. ** The Trick To Tickets gives 1 glitter and other items. ** Ongoing Maintenance gives 5 glitter and other items. * All of [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] quests except for her 10th and 17th reward glitter. * [[Polar Bear]] has a small chance of rewarding glitter after one of his quests.

=== Token Locations === * In the [[Obstacle Courses#Diamond Room|Diamond Room]], in front of the [[Diamond Mask]]. * Behind the [[Gummy Boots]]' honeycomb in [[Gummy Bear's Lair]].

=== Beesmas === As a drop from [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] [[Samovar]]. (Appeared at the 4th use and every 5 uses.) From [[Onett's Lid Art]]. *Completing [[Bee Bear]]'s Winter Spotlight (3/3): The Gift of Giving rewards 1 glitter.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | [[Bee Bear]] gave glitter on the following quests: The Gift of Gifts gave 1 glitter and other items. Commence The Wrapping gave 1 glitter and other items. Courtesies For A Cousin gave 3 glitter and other items. Peppermint Preparation (1/5) gave 3 glitter and other items. Peppermint Preparation (5/5) gave 10 glitter and other items. Purchasing certain packs in the [[Robux Shop]]: Purchasing the Shining Star Pack for 2,000 robux gave 50 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Winter Wonder Pack for 3,400 robux gave 60 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Happy Honeyday Pack for 900 robux gave 10 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Star Treat Special for 1,700 robux gave 100 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Silent Night Special for 800 robux gave 25 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Jumbo June Pack for 1,700 robux gave 25 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Honeyday Mega-Haul for 4,500 robux gave 100 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Snowy Starter Pack for 400 robux gave 10 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Magical Mythic Pack for 800 robux gave 25 glitter and other items. Purchasing the Cyber Monday Special for 800 robux gave 10 glitter and other items. docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Glue.png |description = Grants x1.25 Bee Gather Pollen and Tools for 10 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second }}'''Glue''' is a craftable [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. Its purpose is as a creating material for [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]], or as a 10 minute boost that grants x1.25 [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]] and [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|tools]] when used directly. The [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] cannot stack and will only reset its timer when another glue is used when one is currently active. Using a {{Cost|Purple Potion|4=0}} or {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=0}} will override the buff.

== Ways to Obtain == * Crafting it in the [[Blender]] for {{Cost|Gumdrops|50}} and {{Cost|Royal Jelly|10}}. [[Black Bear]] gives glue on the following quests: ** All-Whitey Then gives 1 glue and other items. ** Black Bear's repeatable quests occasionally reward glue. [[Brown Bear]] will give glue on the completion of these quests: ** Brown Bear's 140th quest rewards 1 glue. ** Brown Bear's 235th quest rewards 1 glue. Brown Bear's 310th quest rewards 3 glues. Brown Bear's 395th quest rewards 5 glues. [[Science Bear]] gives glue on the following quests: Chemical Analysis rewards 1 glue and other items. Epistemological Endeavor gives 4 glues and other items. [[Mother Bear]] rewards 3 glues when you give her a [[present]] [[Polar Bear]] occasionally gives glue after the completion of his quests. * As a rare drop from [[mobs]] such as the [[Spider]], [[Werewolf]], [[Puffshroom]], [[King Beetle]], and [[Coconut Crab]], or guaranteed from the [[Stump Snail]]. * As a drop from [[Robo Bear Challenge]] (The chances are affected by the round the challenge end at) A drop from [[Aphid#Armored Aphids|Armored aphids]]. Small chance of dropping from the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]], and the [[Stump Field]] in place of a honey token. A rare drop from [[leaves]] that appear in the [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Dandelion Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]], [[Stump Field]], or [[Spider Field]]. A rare drop when collecting [[pollen]] in the [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Spider Field]], or the [[Pumpkin Patch]]. Rarely, a glue token can appear from collecting [[goo]] from [[flowers]]. You can claim 2-5 Glues from the [[Glue Dispenser]] depending on your Goo [[Badges|Badge]]. Hotshot rewards 2, Ace rewards 3, Master rewards 4, and Grandmaster rewards 5 Glues. The Glue Dispenser is located inside [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. * As a drop from [[Sprout|Gummy Sprouts]]. As a rare drop from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gifts]] (if [[Festive Bee]] is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]). As a rare drop from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. In a crevice between the [[Pineapple Patch]] and the [[Stump Field]]. As a badge reward by donating to the [[Wind Shrine]]. Matching a pair of glue in [[Memory Match]]. Capturing [[Commando Chick]] the 5th time drops 1 Glue. As a rare drop from the [[Candy Planter]], [[Blue Clay Planter]], [[Pesticide Planter]] and [[Festive Planter]]. ** Planting the Candy Planter in the [[Stump Field]] 3 times in a row will guarantee at least {{Cost|Glue|10}} (Has a cooldown, can give 20 glues) As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: Right Facing Stump Snail rewards 1 glue. Yellow Sticker Hand rewards 1 glue. *Glowering Gummy Bear Rewards 1 glue. **

== The methods below are no longer possible. == * Buying the Buoyant Pack for {{Cost|Robux|800}} gave 25 glue. Purchasing the Loaded Bundle gave 15 glues in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] during Beesmas 2021. Purchasing the Booster Bundle gave 1 glue in Bee Bear's Catalog during Beesmas 2020. * Giving a [[present]] to certain NPCs. Science Bear gave 3 glue, activated the buff, and gave other stuff. [[Onett]] activated the buff and gave other stuff. Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Gooey Present]] gave 10 glues. Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Glowing Gift Box]] gave 10 glues and other items. Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Gummy Gift Box]] gave 10 glues and other items Before its nerf, Science Bear's Epistemological Endeavor quest gave 5 glue instead of 4. * [[Bee Bear]] gave glue on the following quests: By Golly, Get Jolly gave 1 glue. Blue Beesmas gave 1 glue. Beequips and Berries Make Me So Merry gave 1 glue. All I want For Beesmas Is Goo gave 3 glues. Snow Cub Reformation (4/5) gave 3 glues. Science Bear's 2020 Beesmas Lights quest awards 1 glue and other items. Redeeming certain expired codes: Using the code "2YearsAfterParty" (Activated the buff and other stuff). Using the code "Discord50k" (Activated the buff and other stuff). Using the code "Willgoold" (Gave 1 glue and activated the buff and other stuff). Using the code "GummySausage" (Activated the buff and other stuff). Using the code "HappyNewYear" (Activated the buff and other stuff). ** Using the code "SecretProfileCode" (Activates the buff and other stuff). Purchasing the Nighttime Nectar Pack for {{Cost|Robux|400}} gives {{Cost|Glue|20}} + other items. Purchasing the Kazoo Bundle for 25 [[Gingerbread Bear]]s gives {{Cost|Glue|20}} + other items. As a common drop from [[Robo Bear Challenge]] As a reward from the [[Robo Bear's Party Cake]] Giving a present to Brown Bear gives 2 glue and other items [[Onett's Lid Art]] has a chance of dropping glue and other stuff. *Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Gooey Gift Box]] gives 10 glues and other items.

docs.title: Golden Cogmower
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with [[Cogmower]]s, the more common counterparts of Golden Cogmowers or [[Party Cogmower]]s, the Beesmas edition of Cogmowers.''

{{Mob |title = Golden Cogmower |image =GoldenCogmower.png |location = [[Clover Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Pumpkin Patch]] or [[Mountain Top Field]] while the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] is active. |hp = Increases with level and round. |damage = 50-75 |level = 6-22 }} A '''Golden Cogmower''' is a [[mob]] that appears during [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]], known for its distinct golden and bronze accents, which separates itself from its much more common counterpart, [[Cogmower|Cogmowers.]] They are the rarest mob type that appears in Robo Bear Challenge, only spawning a total of 3 times:

  • once on either rounds 3, 4, or 6;
  • once again on either rounds 12, 13, 14, or 16;
  • and once more on either rounds 21, 22, 23, or 24.

They can appear only on 4 following fields:

  • [[Clover Field]]
  • [[Pineapple Patch]]
  • [[Pumpkin Patch]]
  • [[Mountain Top Field]]

They do not despawn until the round is over. Unlike regular Cogmowers, Golden Cogmowers will not follow the player if they go to another field, they stay in the random field they spawned in.

Golden Cogmowers rise up from the field before slowly moving around the field, draining flowers they pass over. The higher the level of the Golden Cogmower, the more pollen is drained. Golden Cogmowers bounce off of the edges of the field. They also only take half as much damage from [[Critical Hits]].

A Golden Cogmower's level can range from 6-22, depending on what round of Robo Bear Challenge the player is on.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |6 |5,400 |- |7 |6,400 |- |8 |7,400 |- |9 |8,400 |- |10 |9,400 |- |11 |11,000 |- |12 |12,000 |- |13 |13,400 |- |14 |15,000 |- |15 |17,000 |- |16 |19,000 |- |17 |20,000 |- |18 |23,000 |- |19 |25,000 |- |20 |30,000 |- |21 |32,000 |- |22 |34,000 |}

== Drops == {{Cost|Cog|14-20|(Guaranteed)}} {{Cost|Wavy Yellow Hive Skin||(Unbelievably Rare)|1}} == Strategies == Golden Cogmowers don't aim for the player, allowing players to easily sidestep them. Stand near the Golden Cogmower, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Golden Cogmower and quickly deal damage. *[[Vicious Bee]] provides very strong single-target damage. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun the Golden Cogmower in place and allow it to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]]. * After starting a round, quickly use the [[Red Cannon]] to check all fields for a Golden Cogmower. The cogs it drops can help you afford 1 or 2 extra upgrades during the challenge.

==Gallery == Golden Cogmower Reward.png|The ring of cogs dropped by a Golden Cogmower. File:GoldenCogmower2.png|A Golden Cogmower in the Mountain Top Field. File:GoldenCogmower1.png|A Golden Cogmower stunned by Digital Bee's Mind Hack.

== Trivia== Golden Cogmowers have a more common counterpart known as a Cogmower. While they don’t have a [[Robo Party]] variant, the [[Party Cogmower]] behaves similarly to the Golden Cogmower as they will not leave the Field they spawned in. Golden Cogmowers are the only mobs in the Robo Bear Challenge to drop loot.

docs.title: Golf
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} '''Golf''' is a system that was introduced with the [[Updates#2024.08.01|2024.08.01 update]] as part of Bee Swarm Simulator's experience in "[[The Games]]" event and removed in the [[Updates#2025.04.30|2025.04.30 update]].

Golf was used throughout [[Sun_Bear|Sun Bear's]] 2024 questline, his quests required the player to hit golf balls into holes, and to activate Targets. Golf currently has no use in any [[quests]].

Golf only appears in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. TOC == Golf Balls == {{Mob |title=Golf Ball |location=The Dandelion Field, Blue Flower Field, and Sunflower Field. |hp=100 - 100,000 (Pollen) |honey=Depends on the level when putt into a Hole. |level=1 - 8 |image=GolfBallMidair.png}} '''Golf balls''' have a pollen meter, which can be filled, similar to [[Puffshroom|Puffshrooms]]. When filled, the player can putt the ball, by collecting [[pollen]] near the ball when it's pollen meter is full. The further away the player stands, the farther and higher the ball will go. A hit golf ball collects [[pollen]] from [[flowers]] underneath it, however, they do not interact with [[mobs]] or [[bees]] but they do have collision with the environment and Pink Fences. Golf balls can also hit targets, giving the player some rewards. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" |+Health !Level !Pollen Required |- |1 |100 |- |2 |200 |- |3 |400 |- |4 |800 |- |5 |1,000 |- |6 |8,000 |- |7 |20,000 |- |8 |100,000 |} === Spawning === Golf Balls can only spawn in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. There can only be two Golf Balls in a field at any time. A new Golf Ball spawns after they are putted into a hole or sink into mud.

== Holes == {{Infobox item |title=Hole |effects=Putting a golf ball into a hole spawns 7 Honey tokens. |source=Appears in the Dandelion, Blue Flower and Sunflower Fields. |image=GolfFlagDandelionField.png|imagecaption=}} '''Holes''' are located in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. Putting the golf ball into a hole rewards a ring of {{Cost|Honey|7}} tokens around the hole, which scales by the amount of points and the level of the golf ball. After putting a golf ball into a Hole, a new golf ball with a different level spawns. === Gallery === File:GolfBallScore1.png|The text displayed when the player hits the ball into the hole in one try. File:GolfPar2.png|The text displayed when the player hits the ball into the hole in 2 tries. File:Honey around a golf hole.png|Honey tokens around the hole after hitting the ball into it.

== Targets == {{Infobox item |title=Target |effects=Hitting it with a Golf Ball gives rewards. |source=Appears in and around the Dandelion, Blue Flower and Sunflower Fields. |image=TargetWhite.png|imagecaption=}} '''Targets''' can be found in and around the 3 fields, hitting them with a golf ball gives a few rewards. Targets can only be activated once, afterwards they turn green and can't be hit for rewards again. === Rewards === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" |+Rewards !Location !Rewards |- |Behind [[Bee Bear]]. |{{Cost|Treat|2}}, {{Cost|Honeysuckle|3}}, {{Cost|Ticket|2}}, {{Cost|Honey|200}}. |- |Left wall In The [[Blue Flower Field]]. |{{Cost|Blueberry|3}}, {{Cost|Blue Extract|1|4=0}}, {{Cost|Ticket|3}}, {{Cost|Honey|750}}. |- |[[Blue Flower Field]] next to the entrance

to [[King Beetle's Lair]]. |{{Cost|Treat|1}}, {{Cost|Blueberry|2}}, {{Cost|Whirligig|3}}, {{Cost|Ticket|1}}, {{Cost|Honey|600}}. |- |In the [[Sunflower Field]], infront of the [[Red HQ]]. |{{Cost|Treat|2}}, {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|3}}, {{Cost|Oil|1}}, {{Cost|Ticket|2}}, {{Cost|Honey|750}}. |- |In the [[Sunflower Field]], on the nearby [[Instant Converter]]. |{{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}}, {{Cost|Smooth Dice|1|}}, {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|3|}}, {{Cost|Ticket|2}}, {{Cost|Honey|750}}. |} === Gallery === File:TargetGreen.png|The target after being hit. GolfTargetUnactivated.png|An unactivated target. File:TargetHitMessage.png|The message seen after hitting a target.

== Mud == {{Infobox item |title=Mud |effects=Makes Golf Balls that stop on it respawn.|source=Appears in the Dandelion, Blue Flower and Sunflower Fields. |image=Mud.png|imagecaption=}} '''Mud''' is found on [[flowers]] in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. Mud tints all flowers underneath it brown. If a golf ball comes to a complete stop over mud, it sinks and a new golf ball spawns.

This is the same mud as the pattern [[Stick Bug]] turns into during the [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. === Gallery === File:GolfBallMud.png|The text seen when the golf ball sinks into Mud. File:GolfMudInBlueflower.png|Mud in the Blue Flower Field.

== Pink Fences == ''Note: This mechanic has not been given an official name, but will be referred to as Pink Fences on this wiki.'' {{Infobox item |title=Pink Fence |effects=Blocks Golf Balls shot at it. |source=Appears in the Blue Flower Field and Sunflower Field. |image=PinkFenceBlueFlowerField.png|imagecaption=}} '''Pink Fences''' are a set of transparent pink fences that can be found in the [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. The fences block Golf Balls shot at it.

They can only hit moving Golf Balls, and do not affect players, [[mobs]], or any other mechanics. === Gallery === File:PinkFencesSunflowerField.png|The Pink Fences in the Sunflower Field. File:Pink fence king beetle lair.png|A Pink Fence inside the [[King Beetle's Lair]].

== Trivia == The Golf Ball's model seems to be the "[https://www.roblox.com/catalog/17164477752/Golf-Ball Golf Ball]" made by [https://www.roblox.com/groups/33233742/Wink1gs-Group#!/about Wink1g's Group]. The Pink Fence in the [[Blue Flower Field]] can go inside of [[King Beetle's Lair]]. *Golf balls are easier to aim with Shift Lock enabled.
