docs.title: Goo
docs.text:
[[File:GooPatches.jpg|thumb|Patches of Goo covering the Pineapple Patch.]] [[File:Gumdrops-0.png|thumb|186x186px|However, then there are 2 types of colors from gumdrops.]] '''Goo''' is a purple-to-teal substance that gives the player bonus [[honey]] when spread across [[flowers]]. It is required for all of [[Onett|Onett’s]] and [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] [[quests]] and was required for all of [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] quests, as well as for some [[Gifted Riley Bee]] and [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] quests and some of [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] quests. Using [[gumdrops]] is the easiest and most common way to manually spread goo until one gets the [[Gummy Boots]]. To collect goo, collect pollen as usual (with [[tools]], [[bees]], and/or their [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]]) from flowers that are covered in goo.

The following formula shows how much bonus honey a player gets from goo. Let ''p'' equal the amount of pollen collected from a puddle of goo, and ''f'' the amount of flowers inside the puddle.

p\sqrt{\frac{f}{200}}

This means that the larger the goo puddle, the more bonus honey the player gets. For example, collecting 500,000 pollen from a goo puddle of 80 flowers would grant roughly 316,228 bonus honey.

Unlike ability tokens, goo can be freely shared with other players. Collecting goo depletes the underlying flowers, but does not actually "use up" the goo itself, unless you collect goo with the [[Gummyballer]]. Goo puddles disappear on their own over a short period of time.

==Trivia==

Gummy Bear's [[Gummy Cannon]] is capable of shooting [[gumdrop]]s at all [[fields]] except the [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Ant Field]], [[Hub Field]], and [[Retro Swarm Challenge|Brick Fields]]. When the gumdrops land, they turn into goo. Gummy Bear continually cycles through all 13 fields excluding the [[Mountain Top Field]] in a random order. When he targeted a field, the server announces it in the bottom right corner as well as in the chat window. ** The Gummy Cannon doens't always shoot in the center of fields. Sometimes, the gumdrops landed outside of the field, making them vanish and sometimes going to the surrounding fields. If a gumdrop falls outside of a field and does not land on a flower, it disappears. [[Gummy Bee|Gummy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Glob|Glob]] and [[Ability Tokens#Gumdrop Barrage|Gumdrop Barrage]] abilities both spread goo in fields. Activating [[Gummy Mask|Gummy Mask’s]] [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph passive ability]] covers the entire field the wearer is in with goo.

The '''Gumdrop Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] introduced in the [[Updates#2018.05.26|5/26/2018 update]], located between the [[Spider Field]] and the [[Bamboo Field]]. It can be used to purchase [[gumdrops]] with [[ticket]]s, in increments of 3, 30, and 300.

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Gumdrops icon.png |description = Use while standing in a field to cover flowers in goo. Goo grants bonus honey. |cooldown = 2 seconds }} {{Color|Gumdrops}} are an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was introduced in the [[Updates#2018.05.26|Gummy Invasion Event]]. When used, gumdrop blobs fall from the air and splatter [[goo]] if they hit a [[Flowers|flower]]. Goo grants an additional 40% bonus [[honey]], with bigger goo puddles granting even more bonus honey. {{Color|Gumdrops}} can also be used to craft other gear, such as the [[Gummyballer]]. [[File:GumdropsLandField.png|thumb|Gumdrops falling in a field.]] When gumdrops are placed in the hotbar, there will be an ON/OFF switch. Turning it ON uses gumdrops automatically with a cooldown of two seconds. Setting it to OFF lets the player manually use the gumdrops.

It can also set them OFF when they are ON if the player activates them with the hotbar or clicks on them.

==Ways to Obtain== [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Blueberry|3}} ** {{Cost|Strawberry|3}} ** {{Cost|Pineapple|3}}. Spending {{Cost|Ticket}} at the [[Gumdrop Shop]] grants 3 gumdrops for each ticket. As a drop from certain [[mobs]]. (Anywhere from 0 to 2,500 gumdrops per mob, depending on [[System Page#Loot Luck|Loot Luck]] and the type of mob.) As a drop from [[leaves]] in the [[Stump Field]]. Popping a [[Sprout|Gummy Sprout]] or a [[Festive Bean|Festive Sprout]]. * As a reward for completing certain [[Black Bear]] and [[Brown Bear]] [[quests]]. Receiving [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] "Chemical Analysis" quest also gives the player 10 gumdrops. As a gift from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]]. As a [[Cub Buddy]] gift. As a possible reward for participating in the [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. Collecting tokens from the [[Star Amulet|Supreme Star]] [[Amulet]] passive, "Gummy Star". As a common drop from catching [[Mythic Meteor Shower|mythic meteors]]. As a drop from any [[planter]]. As a drop from [[Puffshroom]]s. There is a token worth 5 gumdrops in a block near the Ant Gate, it is most likely the gumdrop token left behind from the Gummy Invasion event in 2018. Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]: BeesBuzz123 (Gives 10 gumdrops + other stuff). 15MMembers (Gives 15 gumdrops + other stuff). As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: The Silly Tongue rewards 25 gumdrops. The Yellow Walking Wiggly Person rewards 25 gumdrops. The Gummyballer rewards 25 gumdrops. As a drop from [[Stockings]]. *As 25 drops from [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] [[Samovar]]. (Appears after every 5th use.) * During a [[Gummy Siege]], the fields in which Gummy Bear is targeting has a chance to spawn Gumdrops.

After the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the hotkey for gumdrops (G), along with the hotkey of {{Cost|Stinger}} and {{Cost|Micro-Converter}}, were removed. *Before the 4/5/2019 update, if the player attempted to use gumdrops before the cooldown was over, a message in the bottom right corner would say: [Must wait X seconds to use gumdrops again]. docs.title: Gummy Beacon
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Gummy Beacon.png|alt=The Gummy Beacon|thumb|The Gummy Beacon after the player has turned in Gummy Bear's Beesmas quest.]] The '''Gummy Beacon''' is a [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] 2020+ machine that can be unlocked after completing [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] Beesmas [[Quests|quest]]. It is located on top of the [[Noob Shop]], on the corner closest to the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] next to the [[Clover Field]], in front of the [[Star Hall]]. If the player attempts to activate it without completing Gummy Bear's Beesmas quest, it reads: ''"The satellite dish isn't working, but it still emits bad vibes..."'' Completing his quest allows the player to activate a Gummy Siege.

== Gummy Siege == Upon activating, a platform will appear with [[Gummy Bear]] and [[Gummy Bee]] in front of the Gummy Beacon, and the [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] tune will play. Then, it will summon three level 8-20 Gummy Bees for five minutes. Gummy Bear will begin to shoot [[goo]] puddles at random fields similar to the [[:Category:Gummy Invasion|Gummy Invasion]] event. The targeted field will also spawn {{Cost|Gumdrops}} tokens. Gummy Bear will pick five random fields (excluding the [[Ant Field]] and [[Hub Field]]), and shoots goo for one minute per field, making the Gummy Siege 5 minutes long.

If a player stands on the Gummy Beacon who hasn't completed the Gummy Bear's Goo Year Beacon quest, the message will say: "This Satellite dish isn't working, but it still emits bad vibes...". [[File:Static-assets-upload566652386421731089.png|thumb|Three random leveled Gummy Bees being summoned.]]

When it starts, two server-wide messages will appear saying the following lines: {{Notification|Goo|Gummy Bear: "Artillery has arrived, Gummy Soldier {Username}."|15}} {{Notification|Goo|Gummy Bear: "Beesmas ends now. Commence GOO YEAR celebrations!"|13.5}}

As Gummy Bear targets fields, more server-wide messages will appear showing which field is being targeted:

{{Notification|Goo|Gummy Bear: "Sight set on {Field Name}!"}}

== Gallery == Beacon.png|The Gummy Beacon before the player has turned in Gummy Bear's Beesmas quest. Gooyearsmessage.png|A message from Gummy Bear when a player activates the Gummy Beacon. GummySiegeInProcess.png|The message that appears when you step onto the Gummy Beacon while a Gummy Siege is in progress.

== Trivia == * This is the second and currently the only way of making Gummy Bear appear in the mountain, the first being using the [[Gummy Cannon]]. ** Although Gummy Bear is shown during the siege, he can still be seen in his lair. ** This is also the only way that the Gummy Cannon can appear. * This is one of the 4 machines that summons temporary bees, the others being the [[Honeyday Candles]], [[Onett's Lid Art]], and Honey Bee's [[Honey Wreath]]. * This is the only way to have more than 1 Gummy Bee, though it is only for a limited amount of time. * The Gummy Bees given by the Gummy Beacon can help player activate the [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] very quickly by spawning tokens that contribute towards the passive. * This and Onett's Lid Art are the only ways to have multiple [[Bees/Event|Event Bees]]. However, they only last for a limited amount of time. * This, Onett's Lid Art and the [[Naughty List]] are Beesmas machines that have the longest cooldowns in the game, at 8 hours. * The Gummy Bees from the Gummy Siege are not affected by the [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] Passive from the [[Gummy Mask]], however their [[Ability Tokens|abilities]] will still contribute to activating the passive.

docs.text:
[[File:GummyLairBeesmas2021.png|thumb|220px|Gummy Bear's Lair.]] [[File:QuestPlatform.png|thumb|The Talk To platform in which the player can talk to Gummy Bear. This was used for Gummy Bear's Beesmas 2020 quest, or now to teleport out of the lair. Only players with the Gummy Mask can use this.|alt=]] [[Gummy Bear's Lair]] is a location that can only be accessed by having a [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Hotshot Badge]] or above.

[[File:Eee4a72469aa45acd97d01685d93a3e1.png|thumb|250px|The prompt to enter the Gummy Lair.]]

To get into the lair, touch the [[Gummy Bee]] model on the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] and use a [[Gumdrops|gumdrop]]. The player can reach the egg claim by going behind the [[Top Ant Exterminators|Ant Leaderboard]] and following the path (where there's also an [[Ant Pass|ant pass]] token). They can also use a cannon, such as the [[Red Cannon]], in combination with the [[Parachute]]/[[Glider]].

If the player doesn't have the Goo Hotshot Badge, then the following message will prompt: {{Notification|Goo|Only Goo Hotshots can hear Gummy Bee...}}

[[File:Capture73762.jpg|thumb|250px|The notification that appears when the player is on top of the Gummy Bee model and does not have the Goo Hotshot Badge.]]Otherwise, the player will be aprompted to use gumdrops to enter the Lair with this message:{{Notification|Goo|The Gummy Bee wants Gumdrops}}

== Shop == When entered, you are greeted with [[Gummy Bear]] and [[Gummy Bee]]. The lair contains the [[Glue Dispenser]], which activates the "[[Passive Abilities|Unlimited Gumdrops]]" passive, with 3 minutes of unlimited [[gumdrops]] when using them, as well as a shop that sells the [[Gummy Mask]], [[Gummy Boots]] and the [[Gummyballer]].

[[Passive Abilities#Coconut Haste|+Passive: Coconut Haste]] (see [[Coconut Clogs]], needs [[Coconut Clogs]] in order to use). *[[Passive Abilities#Goo Trail|+Passive: Goo Trail]]. |- |[[File:Gummyballer.png|center|50px]][[Gummyballer]] |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Glue|1,500}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|2,000}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|50}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Turpentine|5}}{{Cost|Satisfying Vial|3}} |

*Conjures up a delectible arsenal of gummy wrecking balls. Bombard Marks and Honey Tokens for massive gooey gains. |}

==Gummy Bear's Dialogue== When the player walks up to Gummy Bear without having the Gummy Mask or Gummy Boots bought, he will say the following in chat and through '''notifications''': [[File:Gummy Bear Dialogue.png|thumb|220x220px|The in-game dialogue of Gummy Bear]] [[File:Gooyearsmessage.png|thumb|The dialogue from Gummy Bear that appears when the [[Gummy Beacon]] is activated]] {{Notification|Goo|Gummy Bear: "What's sweeter than honey?"}} {{Notification|Goo|"Glorious gumdrops... they're just the start!"}} {{Notification|Goo|"A sweet and sour, ooey-gooey universe..."}} {{Notification|Goo|"Can't you see it too?" (slight pause)}} {{Notification|Goo|"What's that Gummy Bee?"}} {{Notification|Goo|"They're not seeing clearly?"}} {{Notification|Goo|"YOU'RE ALWAYS RIGHT!"}} {{Notification|Goo|"GOO-dbye, beekeeper... HAH!"}}

After he finishes his speech, Gummy Bear will instantly kill the player, sending the player back to their [[hive]].

If the player owns the Gummy Mask or the Gummy Boots, they can talk to Gummy Bear, but he does not give a quest. It is not required to have either of the two equipped to talk to him.

{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Dialogue |- |A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee!

''The player is given two options: "Talk to Gummy Bear" or "Return to hive".''

''-Talk to Gummy Bear-''

Our Gummy Army marches forward at a steady, viscous pace. An inevitable ooze that envelopes all things, uniting us all! This glorious gummy world awaits you and your Gummy Bee as well. A place where nothing is bitter, and EVERYTHING is sweet!

''-Return to hive-''

Back to work, soldier!

''The player is teleported to their hive.''

If the player has bought the Gummy Mask after Beesmas 2021, only the dialogue of talking to Gummy Bear will activate. |}

==Notes == Players should avoid going to Gummy Bear's Lair if they have a lot of [[pollen]] in their [[Bags|container]], as they will eventually die due to Gummy Bear killing them or by the player needing to reset their character. However, the player can avoid losing pollen by rejoining the game, using a [[Micro-Converter]] to convert all of the pollen beforehand, or using a [[Whirligig]]. *During Beesmas 2020 and 2021, the player would be able to exit the lair if they have given Gummy Bear a present. * The player’s bees do not go to the lair with the player. This is because the lair is high up in the sky, so the bees will take a while to get there.

==Glitches== When the player walks up to Gummy Bear, he sometimes fails to kill the player after he finishes his speech. * After Gummy Bear kills the player, their body parts will slip down until they reach the end of the shop. If the player presses E at the right time, they will be stuck in the shop, resulting in the [[Glitches#Shop Trap|Shop Trap glitch]]. Only leaving the game could fix this glitch. On rare occasions, [[Wild Windy Bee]] can push the player to Gummy Bear's Lair, making them glitch into it.

== Token locations== * A glitter token behind the Gummy Boots case. (Contains 1 Glitter) A [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|star jelly]] token in front of Gummy Bear. (Contains 1 Star Jelly) An enzymes token in the corner of the lair. (Contains 1 Enzymes)

==Trivia== Before Beesmas 2020, the only way to leave the lair without exiting or losing connection to the game is to die. The player can die by either courtesy of [[Gummy Bear]] or by resetting their character. This is currently the only location not connected to the mountain; instead, it is high up in the sky. The player is able to see the silhouette of the lair if they look closely at the sky. [[Bee Bear]] refers to [[Gummy Bear]] as '''naughty''' in 2018, most likely because he kills the player upon finishing his dialogue, and the fact that he tried to "invade" the mountain. Originally, the lair required the Goo Ace Badge or above, which was a mistake on [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]]'s end. It was quickly fixed to allow people with Goo Hotshot as well, so there could be more players that could actually access the lair. This, the Ace Shop, and the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]] are the only places that require [[badges]] to enter them. Gummy Bear's Lair is the only location that requires a specific badge to enter. * Before the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], the [[Gummy Bee]] that was used to teleport was on top of the [[Ticket Tent]]. Now [[Gummy Bee]] is replaced with a model of [[Festive Bee]] and was instead put at the [[Fields|Ant Field]]. When Gummy Bear's Lair first came out, it said, “Gummy Bee wants 1 [[Gumdrops|Gumdrop]].” Now, it says “The Gummy Bee wants Gumdrops.” However, if the player is visiting Gummy Bear's Lair for the first time, standing on the [[Gummy Bee]] model will say "The Gummy Bee wants 1 Gumdrops." [[Spirit Bear]] mentions how to get to the lair in her quest dialogue. Some players may experience lag when they are getting close to [[Gummy Bear]]. *This and the [[Petal Shop]] are the only shops with items in a triangular formation.

'''Gummy Bear''' is an [[:Category:NPC|NPC]] that resides in [[Gummy Bear's Lair|his lair]], killing those with no Gummy Gear who go near him. Either the [[Gummy Mask]], [[Gummy Boots]] or [[Gummyballer]] need to have been purchased to talk to him, though they aren't required to be worn. The player must have the [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Hotshot Badge]] or above to enter [[Gummy Bear's Lair]], plus have 20 [[Bees]] to access the [[Ant Gate|20 Bee Zone]] as the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] is at the entrance of it.

The player can either talk to him, which gives a short paragraph of dialogue about the Gummy Army, claim his Beesmas quest or give him a present (during Beesmas), or teleport the player back to their [[Hive]]. If a player who does not have any of the Gummy gear would like to see Gummy Bear without losing their pollen, they should empty out their bag before going into the lair. If the player is already inside the lair, the player can use a {{Cost|Micro-Converter}} to empty their bag, or a {{Cost|Whirligig}} to teleport them back to their hive. The Whirligig '''must''' be used '''before''' the dialogue begins, otherwise the player will still die as it ends, regardless of the fact they are no longer in the lair.

His first appearance on the mountain was during the ''''Gummy Invasion'''' on [[Updates#2018.11.25|May 26, 2018]]. He gave 15 [[quests]] that rewarded the player a [[Eggs#Gummy Bee Egg|Gummy Bee Egg]] at the end of the questline. During this event, he used the [[Gummy Cannon]] to shoot {{Cost|Gumdrops}} at [[fields]] and cover flowers with [[goo]]. He targeted every field except the [[Mountain Top Field]] (and the [[Stump Field]], [[Coconut Field]], and [[Pepper Patch]], as they weren't in the game at that time). Gummy Bear left on June 24, 2018, and returned as an NPC in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|Nov. 25, 2018 update]] in his current location, accessible through the Gummy Bee model that used to be on the [[Ticket Tent]].

Starting from Beesmas 2020 and through following Beesmases, he gives out a Beesmas quest: "Gummy Bear's Goo Years Beacon". {{clear}}

==Lair Dialogue== If the player walks close enough to Gummy Bear in his lair, and that player does not own the [[Gummy Mask]], [[Gummy Boots]] or [[Gummyballer]], the following dialogue will appear in chat, and in the player's notifications:

{{Notification|Goo|"Gummy Bear: "What's sweeter than honey?"}} {{Notification|Goo|"Glorious gumdrops... they're just the start!"}} {{Notification|Goo|"A sweet and sour, ooey-gooey universe..."}} {{Notification|Goo|"Can't you see it too?" (slight pause)}} {{Notification|Goo|"What's that Gummy Bee?"}} {{Notification|Goo|"They're not seeing clearly?"}} {{Notification|Goo|"YOU'RE ALWAYS RIGHT!"}} {{Notification|Goo|"GOO-dbye, beekeeper... HAH!"}}

After the last line, Gummy Bear will use the point emote and kill the player, taking them back to spawn.

Even if the player uses a [[Whirligig]] during the dialogue to exit the lair, the dialogue will continue regardless, and they will still be killed when Gummy Bear's dialogue ends.

If the player owns the [[Gummy Mask]], [[Gummy Boots]] or [[Gummyballer]], they can talk to Gummy Bear, but he does not give a quest.

== Dialogue == {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Quest Name !Dialogue |- |Begin The Goo Invasion |BOOM! SPLAT! HAH... I am Gummy Bear! This is my bee, Gummy Bee. And that's my Gummy Cannon! I'm on a mission to spread my sweet Gummy Bees all around the universe! I'll cover this whole mountain in GOO to claim it for my GUMMY EMPIRE! YOU will join my cause! Complete all 15 of my initiation quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg]! First, Collect 500 goo. When I shoot gumdrops from my Gummy Cannon, they cover flowers in goo. Collect pollen from those flower to receive bonus honey, and GOO! The bigger the goo puddle, the more honey and goo you get! You can also create goo with [Gumdrops], I've got some for you behind my cannon. Activate your [Gumdrops] while standing in a field to cover the flowers in goo! If you need more [Gumdrops], you can get them from defeating enemies. Try teaming up with your friends to share [Gumdrops] and create large puddles! I'll tell you when I'm about to fire my cannon at a field. Let's get GOO-ing!''-During-''Flowers covered in goo give you bonus honey (and goo) when you collect from them. The bigger the goo puddle, the more you get! When I shoot gumdrops at a field, always look for the biggest puddle. You can even combine your own [Gumdrops] with existing puddles to create even larger ones! Go try it! Collect 500 goo.''-Completion-''GOO-d job! HAH. Gummy Bee says it thinks you look promising. I'm not convinced yet! Come back when you're ready for the next test. |- |Patient Plundering |Each place I invade offers something new to my Gummy Empire. I've heard the flowers on this mountain produce rare Honey Tokens! I need you to collect some of those to help fund my mission. Collect 5 Honey Tokens while you gather 2,000 more GOO! Remember: Always collect from the largest goo puddle! It gives you the most goo. And if you need more [Gumdrops], you can get them from defeating bugs!''-During-''It takes dedication and patience to find Honey Tokens. Those are only some of the virtues I require out of a Gummy Soldier. Go out there and prove you've got what it take. Collect 5 Honey Tokens and gather 2,000 more goo!''-Completion-''With each quest you prove yourself more loyal to my GUMMY EMPIRE! I'll give you some [Gumdrops] each time so you can keep spreading the goo too. We won't stop until this entire mountain is PINK and TEAL. |- |Piecewise Invasion |I've planned this invasion for months! I've figured out the optimal method of gooing up this place field by field. Gummy Bee is my advisor. And it's telling me we need to tackle the Clover Field! Take my advice: work together with other Gummy Soldiers to share [Gumdrops]. You'll both benefit from the goo. You will not complete my tests without teamwork. Collect 3,500 goo from the Clover Field! GO GO GO GO GO GO!''-During-''Why would anyone oppose the GUMMY CAUSE? My only objective is to make the universe sweeter. You are here to help me accomplish that! Collect 3,500 goo from the Clover Field.''-Completion-''Gummy Bee says you did a fine job out in those clovers. I say you've got a long way to go! |- |Colorful Conquest |Goo does not discriminate - white, red or blue, it doesn't matter. ALL flowers are GOO FLOWERS to me! Get out there and gunk them all until their colors are just a distant memory! Collect 2,000 goo from White, Red, and Blue flowers and collect 10 Honey Tokens.''-During-''People think I'm soft cause I'm physically soft and squishy. I use this to my advantage to catch my adversaries off guard. Nobody expects my GUMMY INVASION! Collect 2,000 goo from White, Red, and Blue flowers and collect 10 Honey Tokens.''-Completion-''I'm starting to open your eyes to my gummy ways. You see it now: GOO is GREAT! Gummy Bee says we're making great progress. Let's not lose our momentum! |- |Stickier Than Spider Webs |Spiders and their webs are nothing compared to Gummy Bees and their goo. Those puny arachnids guard those White flowers like their lives depend on it! Guess what SPIDERS, those belong to ME now. Collect 20,000 goo from the Spider Field.''-During-''Nothing is good unless it's squishy and sweet. You look sort of squishy, probably not sweet though. You'll have to compensate for your lack of sweetness through hard work. Collect 20,000 goo from the Spider Field.''-Completion-''Spiders are nothing before our gummy might! Gummy Bee says those fools should have stayed in their cave. Good work soldier, but we've still got more to do. |- |Four Front Assault | Gummy Bee says let's stop playing games. I'm inclined to agree!!!!! Each and every one of these fields will fall to my confectionary cannon. BOOM BOOOOM! No more chit chat, this is an invasion! Collect 30,000 goo.. Collect 5,000 goo from the Mushroom, Blue Flower, Strawberry, and Bamboo Fields... And collect 20 Honey Tokens!''-During-''Get going soldier: Collect 30,000 goo.. Collect 5,000 goo from the Mushroom, Blue Flower, Strawberry, and Bamboo Fields... And collect 20 Honey Tokens.''-Completion-''What a mess - just how I like it! And it'll only get messier from here! |- |Total Gummification | All around the universe, we're in the midst of war... A war between GOO and everything that's not GOO. All other conflicts are TRIVIAL DISTRACTIONS. Now collect 60,000 more GOO!''-During-''I ain't picky if the goo is sticky. Collect 60,000 goo.''-Completion-''Gummy Bee says "No flower will remain un-gummied!" Just 8 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg] of your own. |- | Artillery Lessons: Slingshot |A good Gummy Soldier must know how to use artillery. My Gummy Cannon takes years of experience to man, you're not ready for it. I'll start you off on something smaller - the SLINGSHOT. BOING BOING! Collect 80,000 goo from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 30 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot 10 times.''-During-''You'll need to discover a certain number of bee types to use the Slingshot and Cannons. To discover more types, try transforming your bees with Royal Jelly. You can buy Royal Jelly for Honey at the shop near the Rose Field. You can also buy it for tickets from the dispenser near the Noob Bear's Shop. Now back to work: collect 80,000 goo from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 30 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot 10 times.''-Completion-''My Gummy Cannon is used to shoot gumdrops, but the other cannons on the map are used to shoot YOU into the sky. They're the fastest way to move around the map. Just 7 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg] of your own. |- |GOO Away, Bugs |Look at all those bugs sipping up slime faster than I can spread it... These beetles have got to go! Gummy Bee says your swarm looks like it could make quick work of them. Collect 100,000 goo and defeat 10 Ladybugs, 10 Rhino Beetles, and 3 Spiders.''-During-''Gummy Bee is a military mastermind, but it only has 1 attack. With GOOd strategy, even a lone Basic Bee can take down a Werewolf. Come back when you've collected 100,000 goo and defeated 10 Ladybugs, 10 Rhino Beetles, and 3 Spiders.''-Completion-''SPLISH SPLAT SPLAT! BUGS BE GONE JUST LIKE THAT! Just 6 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg] of your own. |- |Colorful Conquest 2 |As you trudge your way through the goo, you get sweeter and sweeter... That's how it is with all things! I can tell you don't quite understand it yet. It'll seep in in due time. Collect 80,000 goo from Red and Blue flowers... Collect 80,000 goo from the Clover Field... And use the Slingshot 20 times...''-During-''I cycle through each of the 13 themed fields. Sure enough, I reach them all. Collect 80,000 goo from Red and Blue flowers... Collect 80,000 goo from the Clover Field. And use the Slingshot 20 times...''-Completion-''YES! HAHA! It's happening... the gooification is almost complete. Just 5 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg]. |- |Artillery Lessons: Yellow Cannon |I love nothing more than firing endless barrages of Gumdrops at pristine fields of flowers. There's something so satisfying about the KABOOM of a cannon! You will come to know it too! Collect 200,000 white goo... Collect 40 Honey Tokens... And use the Yellow Cannon 30 times...''-During-''You may not be able to experience that joy of launch gumdrops with explosives, but at least you can still fire cannons. Collect 200,000 white goo... Collect 40 Honey Tokens... And use the Yellow Cannon 30 times.''-Completion-''AHAH! Isn't it a rush? Just 4 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg]. |- |Peace Through Goo-nity | Gummy Bee and I are made of the very same goo! We are practically one creature. I want to feel that same closeness with all other things. By GOO-IFYING the universe, I will unite us all! Help me in my mission of GOO-nity. Collect 200,000 from Red flowers... 200,000 goo from the Pumpkin Patch... And 200,000 goo from the Cactus Field.''-During-''If you need some more Gumdrops try using the code "Tapioca" Those'll help you finish this up: Collect 200,000 from Red flowers... 200,000 goo from the Pumpkin Patch... And 200,000 goo from the Cactus Field.''-Completion-''Gummy Bee says it's starting to feel close to you too! That means it's almost time... Just 3 more quests and I'll give you a [Gummy Bee Egg]. |- |Artillery Lessons: Blue Cannon |My primary objective is to make everything SWEETER. It may not seem that way when I'm being so strict, hahaha! I'm someone who understands that to get anything done you've got to be POWERFUL. I use the power of my Gummy Cannon to enforce my will on the universe! You are on your way to doing the same! Next up: Collect 100 Honey Tokens... Collect 300,000 goo from Blue flowers... Collect 300,000 goo from the Rose Field and Pine Tree Forest... And use the Blue Cannon 40 times!''-During-''There is no greater force in the universe than my Gummy Army. All things fall to the slow, viscous march of my gooey might. Keep working, you're part of my cause! Collect 100 Honey Tokens... Collect 300,000 goo from Blue flowers... Collect 300,000 goo from the Rose Field and Pine Tree Forest... And use the Blue Cannon 40 times!''-Completion-''Gelatinous judgement is upon us!!! All unsweet things must let my goo seep in or be banished from existence! What's that Gummy Bee? You see our glorious gooey victory approaching fast? I see it too!!!! Just 2 more quests... |- |Goo-ing Goo-mmando |I like it sweet, the mobs like it SOUR! That will not do... oh no no. "Put an end to the beasts once and for all!" Gummy Bee whispers in my ear. My sweet little bee always knows best, HAH! You - my loyal recruit - are you ready for a sweet little bee of your own?? PROVE YOURSELF TO ME, UNSWEET MEATY CREATURE! Collect 500,000 goo from White flowers... Use the Blue and Yellow Cannons 20 times each... And defeat 10 Mantises, 10 Scorpions, and 3 Werewolves.''-During-''There's nothing squishy or sweet about those vile creatures! They work for the forces of SALT, SOUR, AND MEAT. Not in my GUMMY epoch... no sir... Collect 500,000 goo from White flowers... Use the Blue and Yellow Cannons 20 times each... And defeat 10 Mantises, 10 Scorpions, and 3 Werewolves.''-Completion-''Gummy Bee! Look! Our soldier is beginning the final transformation!!! As you collect the GOO, the GOO also collects YOU! Just 1 more quests and I'll know your transformation is complete... |- | Candy Conquest |AHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! Look Gummy Bee - it's almost ours! Not just the mountain, but the beekeepers too. Well trained soldiers of the Gummy Empire! There's only one thing left for YOU to do... Hatch a Gummy Bee of your own! Then, just like me, you'll never be alone. You'll never be lost. Gummy Bee will always guide you with it's gooey gifts! All you need to do is finally finish globulating this unGOO-dly mountain. Collect 750,000 goo... Collect 75,000 goo from the Strawberry Field, Dandelion Field, Spider Field... ...Pineapple Patch, and Pumpkin Patch... Collect 250 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot, Yellow Cannon, and Blue Cannon 30 times each.''-During-''BOOM! GLUGSPLUGGLUGLGLGOOL. SPLAT SPLAT SPLAAAAT. By now you ought to speak MY language! Collect 750,000 goo... Collect 75,000 goo from the Strawberry Field, Dandelion Field, Spider Field... ...Pineapple Patch, and Pumpkin Patch... Collect 250 Honey Tokens... And use the Slingshot, Yellow Cannon, and Blue Cannon 30 times each.''-Completion-''Gummy Bee says "We are done here." Not so fast sweet little bee! YOU, beekeeper, answer me honestly... How sweet is your soul? How squishy is your mind??? When you close your eyes, do you see the undulating waves of PINK and TEAL? Of course you do!!!!!!!!! So take it now, hatch it quick and let it lead you - this [Gummy Bee Egg]! The universe is big, and so much of it is still ungummied... So much left to absorb into my empire! HAH! I trust you will maintain the rule of goo here. GOO-DSPEED GUMMY SOLDIER! |- |Conclusion | Huh? Gummy Bee... what's gotten into you??? ...Yes I know this place is the perfect place for a Gummy Bee now... But we're not looking for a place to rest! You've always told me the GOO MUST SPREAD!! It's time to go. OH. You, soldier, listen here: Why don't you and your Gummy Bee go help out the other recruits? The more Gummy Bees on the mountain, the more you help our cause. |}

==Trivia== Gummy Bear was originally the [[:Category:Traveling Bears|traveling bear]] for the Gummy Invasion event, spanning from May 26 to June 24, 2018 (30 days, or 4 weeks and 2 days). He gave 15 [[quests]] with a final reward of a [[Eggs#Event Bee Eggs|Gummy Bee Egg]]. He came back in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 Update]]. [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] added 1 more week to the Gummy Bear's timer when he first arrived because many players requested an extension. Gummy Bear uses the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/619547874/Levitation-Animation-Pack Levitation Animation Pack]. Gummy Bear is one of two bears (the other being [[Shadow Bear]]) to float, rather than stand on the ground. Like all of the permanent bears (except [[Spirit Bear]] and [[Dapper Bear]]), he also has his own Bear Morph. Unlike them, the player doesn't need a [[Bear Bee]] to get it, but rather it can be activated by Gummy Mask's [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph Passive Ability]]. *Gummy Bear is the only traveling bear to have a morph of his own. Gummy Bear brought the following during his visit to the mountain: ** A [[Gummy Bee]], which could have been seen flying around him. Gummy Bear was the first bear to introduce his own bee, with [[Bee Bear]] being the second, introducing [[Festive Bee]], and [[Robo Bear]] being the third, introducing [[Digital Bee]]. A [[Gummy Cannon]], which he used to fire [[Gumdrops]] at [[fields]] and the only cannon the player is unable to use for [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Transport transportation]. The [[Gumdrop Shop]] where the player could buy gumdrops with [[Ticket]]s (which was moved to its current position near [[Panda Bear]]). In total, the players could have received up to 31 tickets from his quests. Gummy Bear is translucent, like the candy he is named after. (His colors of pink and teal, on the other hand, don't resemble any of the colors of [[Wikipedia:Gummy Bear|classic gummy bear candy]].) ** Gummy Bear is the first and currently only [[:Category:Bears|bear]] to have colors unnatural to their real-life counterpart. * Gummy Bear gave a [[Codes|Code]] in the dialogue of one of his last quests "Peace Through Goo-nity", which was the "Tapioca" code. Spirit Bear has stated that Gummy Bear was made out of gumdrops. In addition, according to his dialogue, he and his Gummy Bee are made of the same [[goo]]. According to [[Science Bear]], Gummy Bear is in fact an alien. Gummy Bear, [[Tunnel Bear]] and [[Onett]] were "Naughty" during the Beesmas Event, as stated by Bee Bear. Gummy Bear was featured in the "Dance Party" advert. Gummy Bear appears in the [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Badge]] for its icon. He was voted as the strongest [[:Category:Bears|Bear]] in Onett’s StrawPoll voting.[https://twitter.com/OnettDev/status/1611171069540409345] Tweet posted by Onett linking the poll He is also the first and only quest-giver that can kill the player. He is the second bear out of three bears that can kill the player, the first being [[Tunnel Bear]] and the third being [[Snowbear]]. Gummy Bear, [[Sun Bear]] and Bee Bear have all had a second visit to the mountain, but Gummy Bear is the only one to stay permanently (for now). Gummy Bear was the first bear to require the usage of [[:Category:Transport|transportation]] devices (cannons and the [[Slingshot]]) to complete his quests. Gummy Bear is one of four NPCs to have moved locations, with the other three being [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]], [[Bubble Bee Man]], and [[Sun Bear|Sun Bear]].

docs.title: Gummy Bee Egg Claim
docs.text:
[[File:GummyBeeEggClaim.png|thumb|220px|The Gummy Bee Egg Claim.]] The '''Gummy Bee Egg Claim''' is a platform that can be found beyond the [[Ant Gate]]. It's located on a ledge near the [[Ant Challenge]] and the Player [[hive]]s. It can be reached by going through the gap behind the [[Top Ant Exterminators|Top Ant Exterminators Leaderboard]], going on top of the Ant Gate, or by walking on top of the hives to the egg claim.

== Claiming the Egg== Standing on the white platform prompts players with a message saying, "Combine 2500 [[Gumdrops]] into a [[Gummy Bee]]" if they haven't claimed a {{Cost|Gummy Bee Egg|4=0}}. If the player already owns one, the text saying, "You Already Own a Gummy Bee" is displayed. Whenever a player forms a Gummy Bee Egg, a slight remix of "[[Music|gbtune1]]" (the music played around the Gummy Bee Egg Claim and in [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]) is played throughout the map and a server-wide announcement is made reading:{{Notification|Honey|🎉 {Username} has formed a Gummy Bee 🎉}}

== Teleporting to the Lair == Standing on the Gummy Bee model without the Goo Hotshot [[Badges|badge]] prompts the player with "{{Notification|Goo|Only Goo Hotshots can hear Gummy Bee...}}

Using gumdrops when this message is shown will not teleport the player to Gummy Bear's Lair. If the player has the Goo Hotshot badge, standing on the model prompts the player with: {{Notification|Goo|The Gummy Bee wants Gumdrops}}

Using Gumdrops while standing on the model with Goo Hotshot teleports the player to Gummy Bear's Lair. A Gummy Bee is not required to enter the lair.

==Music== Gummy Bee Egg Claim's theme:

[[File:Gbtune1.ogg]]

The sound that plays when the player combines 2500 gumdrops into a {{Cost|Gummy Bee Egg|4=0}}:

[[File:Gbm.ogg]]

==Gallery== RobloxScreenShot20190405 172120345.png|A player forming a Gummy Bee. 84c7b0a3692df1ea5192934d8523a823.png|The prompt of forming a Gummy Bee. 9ADD253A-70B8-45F8-B591-F87235F2838F.jpeg|The message given on top of the egg claim without Goo Hotshot or greater. Screenshot 2020-06-22 at 12.39.38 PM.png|The pop-up that shows up when the player steps on the pad and has the Goo Hotshot Badge. Screenshot 2020-06-22 at 12.38.18 PM.png|The pop-up that shows up when the player steps on the pad and already owns a Gummy Bee. Static-assets-upload17608076326006468459.png|The Gummy Bee Egg Claim glowing at night.

==Trivia== Over the course of the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] events succeeding the first one in 2018, there were several presents placed beyond an [[Obstacle Courses|obstacle course]] next to the claim with a theme similar to gumdrops. This is one of two egg claims in the map, the other being the [[Vicious Bee Egg Claim]] for [[Vicious Bee]]. At night time, the Gummy Bee model's face glows as well as the teal outline of the pad. An alternative way to reach this is by jumping on top of one of the Ant Pass Dispensers, jumping on to the rock by the Ant Gate, walking across the Ant Gate, and jumping onto the pad. This is the only bee claim to have a different soundtrack than the area around it playing gbtune1. While Gummy Bee was available in the [[Ticket Tent]], the giant Gummy Bee used in the egg claim was located on the top of the Ticket Tent to the right of [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Photon Bee]] where the [[Festive Bee]] is now. It would still teleport players to Gummy Bear's Lair if a gumdrop was used on top of it.

docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Gummy_Bee.png |image-gifted=GummyBee Gifted.png |description = A squishy bee who's sweet as sugar. Covers flowers in goo to grant you bonus honey! |rarity = Event |color = Colorless |energy = 50 |energylabel = more |speed = 14 |attack = 3 |skincolor1 = #ff77f4 |skincolor2 = #1aff6b |skincolor3 = #ff77f4 }}'''Gummy Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]]. It can be purchased for {{Cost|Gumdrops|2,500}} from the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]]. Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Gummy Bee likes the [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Mountain Top Field]], and the [[Stump Field]]. It dislikes the [[Pumpkin Patch]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 700 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * +150% [[Energy]], +620 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +2 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +5% [[System Page#Honey Per Pollen|Honey Per Pollen]].

[[Flowers]] covered in goo grant bonus Honey that increases with the size of the Goo puddle. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Glob|[Glob]]]''' Covers 49 surrounding flowers in goo. If gifted, covers 81 Flowers instead.

== Trivia ==

  • There is a model of the Gummy Bee on the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]]. Using [[gumdrops]] right after touching it and receiving the message; "The Gummy Bee wants gumdrops" will teleport the player to [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. The player must have the [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Hotshot Badge]] to enter the lair, or else there is a message that says "Only Goo Hotshots can hear Gummy Bee...".
  • Gummy Bee is the only [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] that doesn't have extra body parts.
  • Gummy Bee and [[Fireflies]] share the same face, which resembles [[Basic Bee|Basic Bee's]] face.
  • The Gummy Bee is the fourth [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] to be released in an [[Updates|Update]]. ** This bee was also the first bee to ever be a prize for completing the [[Quests]] of a [[:Category:Traveling Bears|Traveling Bear]]. ** It was also the third bee to have been unobtainable for a while.
  • The Gummy Bee, [[Bear Bee]], [[Tabby Bee]], [[Puppy Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], [[Digital Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]] are the only Event bees which can be a [[First Edition Bee]].
  • This is the only bee that is translucent.
  • The Gummy Bee was once obtainable through completing all 15 quests of [[Gummy Bear]]. ** Before the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 Update]], the player could buy Gummy Bee in the [[Ticket Tent]] for 500 [[Ticket]]s. ** [[Festive Bee]] took the place of Gummy Bee in the Ticket Tent after the 4/5/2019 Update.
  • The Gummy Bee and [[Diamond Bee]] are the only bees that have a sparkle effect that surrounds their bodies.
  • Gummy Bee emits a faint light from its eyes that can be easily seen in dark places.
  • This is the only Event bee to have a [[:Category:Hats|Mask]] based off of it, the [[Gummy Mask]]. ** The other bees that have a mask based off them are [[Honey Bee]], [[Diamond Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], [[Bubble Bee]], and [[Fire Bee]].
  • Gummy Bee is the third bee in the game to at some point cost a currency besides tickets, the first being Bear Bee (Robux), the second being [[Vicious Bee]] ([[Stinger]]s), and the fourth being [[Windy Bee]] ([[Cloud Vial]]s).
  • This bee, [[Bear Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], [[Photon Bee]], and [[Tabby Bee]] are the only bees whose signature abilities are directly buffed by being gifted.
  • If it were to be bought by buying gumdrops from the [[Gumdrop Shop]], it would cost 834 [[Ticket]]s, with 2 [[gumdrops]] left over.
  • When [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] is active, this bee has the highest base attack, an attack of 303 being about 30 times the base attack of [[Lion Bee]].
  • Gummy Bee can find two stickers when in a specific field: ** Gummy Bee has a chance to find a Launching Rocket [[Sticker]] in the [[Clover Field]]. ** Gummy Bee has a very rare chance to find a Yellow Sticky Hand [[Sticker]] in the [[Sunflower Field]]. {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Bees]] [[Category:Event]] [[Category:Colorless]] [[Category:Gummy Invasion]] [[Category:Goo]] [[zh-tw:軟糖蜂]]

== Trivia== In order to craft this item, a total of 100,000,000,000 honey, 168,750 [[Blueberry|blueberries]], 200,000 [[pineapple]]s, 168,750 [[Strawberry|strawberries]], 250 [[Magic Bean|magic beans]], and 16,250 [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]] are needed. Also, keep in mind that crafting all the glue, glitter, red extracts, and blue extracts require a total of 6,250 minutes, which is equivalent to 104.16 hours or 4.3 days (minus drops from mobs and quest rewards and using tickets to speed crafting.) If crafting gumdrops and moon charms are included, in total the crafting would take 156,250 minutes, or 2,604.16 hours, or 108.5 days. Added together, it would take 162,500 minutes, or 2,708.8 hours, or 112.8 days. The gumdrops, strawberries, magic beans, and royal jelly amount is for [[crafting]] the items required to craft the Gummy Boots. These are the first boots to have a [[Passive Abilities|passive ability]], as the [[Coconut Clogs]] were not in the game when the Gummy Boots were added. These are the first boots that could not be obtained by [[Sun Bear]], followed by the Coconut Clogs. This, the [[Gummy Mask]], and [[Shell Amulet]]s are the only accessories that give a goo buff. * Behind the Gummy Boots figure in the shop in [[Gummy Bear's Lair]], there is a glitter token. The player needed this or the Gummy Mask in order to talk to Gummy Bear for his [[Beesmas]] quest. The Gummy Boots were necessary if the player wanted to give [[Gummy Bear]] a present. Before the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]], these boots were the most expensive item in terms of honey, excluding hive slots. Initially, the Goo Trail passive ability covered only one flower, directly underneath the player, in goo. This has been buffed to the nearest 5 flowers. During the release of the Gummy Boots, it costed 999 [[glue]], 300 [[glitter]], 300 [[Red Extract|red extracts]], and 300 [[Blue Extract|blue extracts]] in order to be crafted. However, the price was later nerfed to 500 [[glue]], 250 [[glitter]], 250 [[Red Extract|red extracts]], and 250 [[Blue Extract|blue extracts]] on the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]]. Everyone who bought the Gummy Boots before the update were refunded the extra items when Beesmas 2021 was released. *Unlike other items like the [[Diamond Mask]], the [[Gummy Mask]], and the [[Demon Mask]], the Gummy Boots do not require another item to 'inherit' the passive, rather having two passives regardless of whether the player has bought the [[Coconut Clogs]]. This makes it one of the only two items to have this characteristic, the other being the [[Coconut Canister]], as it's the first and only bag to have passives. {{Items}} [[Category:Boots]] [[Category:Accessories]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Crafted]] [[Category:Goo]] [[zh-tw:軟糖靴]]

docs.title: Gummy Cannon
docs.text:
The '''Gummy Cannon''' is [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] personal cannon that he used to fire [[gumdrops]] onto [[fields]]. It was brought to the mountain in the [[Updates#2018.05.26|5/26/2018]] update and was removed alongside Gummy Bear at a later date. The Gummy Cannon's color scheme is identical to the color of [[goo]], gumdrops, [[Gummy Bee]], and Gummy Bear, with a teal base and a pink barrel. It was found next to Gummy Bear and Gummy Bee.

When Gummy Bear launched the cannon, all players in the server would get a notification that said: {{Notification|Goo|Sights Set on the [Field Name]!}}

Gumdrops would be scattered all over the selected field until the field changed.

Starting in Beesmas 2020 and returning each Beesmas after, it could be summoned by using the [[Gummy Beacon]] to summon a [[Gummy Siege]] after completing Gummy Bear's [[Gummy Bear#2021 Beesmas Quest - Gummy Beacon|Beesmas Quest]]. Each time gumdrops are scattered on a field, a gumdrops token appeared in its place. [[File:Gummy bear's plataform.png|thumb|200px|Gummy Bear next to the Gummy Cannon during a Gummy Siege.]]

== Trivia == * The Gummy Cannon was the only cannon that wasn't used for player [[:Category:Transport|transportation]]. It was only used for decoration. ** It was also the first and only cannon to launch [[items]]. * When the Gummy Cannon launched gumdrops, the animation of the gumdrops falling onto the selected field was the same one as the player using gumdrops in the field. * The Gummy Cannon was not completely accurate; the gumdrops it launched could miss the fields it was aimed at, and possibly even splatter goo into nearby fields. * This is the only cannon that was removed in-game and returned. * The cannon shot 5-7 gumdrops before aiming at other fields. * There used to be a gumdrop token behind the cannon. ** After the [[:Category:Gummy Invasion|event]] ended, the gumdrop token was covered with a green path, which made it more difficult to get, although it is possible to get it if the player moves along the edge.

docs.title: Gummy Mask
docs.text:
{{Accessory |image1 =Gummy Mask.png |description =The official mask of a Gummy Soldier. |cost =5,000,000,000 [[Honey]], 250 [[Glue]], 100 [[Enzymes]], 100 [[Oil]], 100 [[Glitter]] and 1 [[Nectar Vial#Satisfying Vial|Satisfying Vial]]. |stats =+75% Goo+10% Goo Conversionx1.25 White Pollen+25% Pollenx1.5 Capacityx1.5 White Field Capacity+30% Defense+20% Bee Ability Rate+Passive: Coin Scatter (Needs Honey Mask)+Passive: Gummy Morph }} {{Quote|The official mask of a Gummy Soldier.}} The '''Gummy Mask''' is a [[:Category:Hats|mask]] available for purchase in [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. It can be reached by touching the [[Gummy Bee]] model on the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] and using [[gumdrops]] if the player has obtained the [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Hotshot]] badge. {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|5B|5,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Glue|250}}{{Cost|Enzymes|100}}{{Cost|Oil|100}}{{Cost|Glitter|100}}{{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}} |}

Once 30 regular gumdrops are used or 10 [[Ability Tokens]] from Gummy Bee are collected, Gummy Mask's passive ability (Gummy Morph) activates with the following sound file:

[[File:gbm.ogg]]

The appearance of the Gummy Mask has a teal gumdrop on top emitting tiny bubbles. Below that is a pink dome with a neon teal disc and a pink disc underneath. The Gummy Bee face is placed on a pink barrier surrounding the player's face.

==Stats== +75% [[Goo]] * +10% [[System Page#Goo Conversion|Goo Conversion]] x1.25 [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]] +25% [[Pollen]] x1.5 [[Capacity]] x1.5 [[Field Capacity|White Field Capacity]] +30% [[System Page#Defense|Defense]] * +20% [[System Page#Bee Ability Rate|Bee Ability Rate]] [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|+Passive: Coin Scatter]] (Requires [[Honey Mask]] in order to use): The passive is activated every 20 [[Ability Tokens#Mark|Mark Tokens]]. When it does, 300% of the player's total [[System Page#Convert Total|Hive Convert Amount]] will be converted and scattered into honey tokens, which cannot be collected through a [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] (visible only to the player, Honey Tokens last one minute). The passive has a cooldown of two minutes before being able to be used again. [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|+Passive: Gummy Morph]]: **The Gummy Morph will trigger every 30 gumdrops used OR 10 Gummy Bee ability tokens collected (+1 stack per gumdrops used, +3 stacks every Gummy Bee ability). When it triggers, it will turn you into [[Gummy Bear]], your Gummy Bee will glow and leave a trail. In addition, the field will be fully covered in goo. As Gummy Bear, you will gain +75% goo, instantly converting all of it, and have increased jump power and player speed. As Gummy Bee glows, it will gather 1000% more pollen, gain +300 attack, and move 200% faster for 10 seconds. This passive does not have any cooldown time.

==Gallery== Gummymaskicon.png|The Gummy Mask icon GummyMorph.png|The Gummy Morph icon Coinscatter.png|The Coin Scatter icon GummyBearMorph.png|A player with the Gummy Bear Morph. GummyBee.png|When Gummy Morph is activated, Gummy Bee will change colors, glow brighter, and leave a trail. RobloxScreenShot20220207 190300610.png|The rose field covered in goo by the Gummy Bear Morph passive. GummyHatShop.png|The Gummy Mask in its shop. Gummy mask.png|Gummy Mask's stats when it first released. Gummystats.png|Gummy Mask's stats before the [[Updates#2019.12.23|12/23/2019 update]]. Gummymasknoow.png|Current Gummy Mask's stats Gummy mask stats.png|Gummy Mask's stats before the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/6/2020 update]]. Boostgummy.png|Gummy Bear Morph's first stats when it came out. RobloxScreenShot20191217 180715356.png|Gummy Bear Morph's old stats. GBMS.png|Gummy Bear Morph's current stats.

==Trivia== * If the ingredients to craft this item were to be crafted, a total of 5,000,000,000 Honey, 75,000 [[Blueberry|Blueberries]], 75,000 [[Strawberry|Strawberries]], 92,500 [[Pineapple]]s, 5,000 [[Sunflower Seed]]s, 7,000 [[Royal Jelly|Royal Jellies]], 2,500 [[Moon Charm|Moon Charms]], 100 [[Magic Bean]]s and 1 [[Satisfying Vial]] of nectar are needed. Upon activating the Gummy Morph, [[Gummy Bee]] will have the highest Base Attack Power of 303 damage in total. * This is the only mask that represents an [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] (Gummy Bee), as the other masks are based on [[Bees/Epic|Epic]] and [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary Bees]]. The Gummy Mask was nerfed in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 Update]] because it was too powerful. It was later buffed a little in the [[Updates#2019.04.17|4/17/2019 Update]], as people were complaining that it was extremely bad with the nerf. *Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]], if the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Unlimited Gumdrops]] buff is active, the passive ability would not be activated from gumdrops. This is because gumdrops in the inventory weren't technically consumed upon use with the Unlimited Gumdrops buff. After the update, it can now be activated with Unlimited Gumdrops. * The [[music]] that plays when the Gummy Bear Morph is active is a slight rendition of [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] theme that plays in the Gummy Bear's Lair. This and the [[Honey Mask]] are the only masks in the game that requires a badge to access and purchase. ** Coincidentally, the Honey Mask is also required to unlock the coin scatter ability on this mask. The Gummy Mask is the only mask in the game that requires a specific badge to access it. ** This is the only way to get a Bear Morph ability without Robux and codes before the [[Updates#2024.05.23|5/23/2024 Update]]. Either this mask or the [[Gummy Boots]] were needed in order to receive Gummy Bear's [[Beesmas]] quest. The Gummy Morph icon is the same icon as the one for the Goo badge. This and the [[Strange Goggles]] are the only items that are required to interact with NPCs. However, during Beesmas, the Honey Mask was also needed to give [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] a present and to receive its Beesmas quest. This, the [[Demon Mask]] and the [[Diamond Mask]] are the only masks with decorative accessories (Gummy Mask has a teal gumdrop). This is the 3rd most expensive item requiring {{Cost|Glue|4=0}}. In front of the Gummy Mask is [[Gummy Boots]] (2nd) and [[Gummyballer]] (1st). The morph lasts a bit longer than the field being covered in goo during Gummy Morph. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Accessories]] [[Category:Hats]] [[Category:Crafted]] [[Category:Goo]] [[Category:Colorless]]

docs.title: Gummyballer
docs.text:
{{Tool |image =Gummyballer.png |price=1,500 Glue, 2,000 Gumdrops, 50 Caustic Waxes, 50 Super Smoothies, 5 Turpentines, 3 Satisfying Vials, {{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}} |shop=Gummy Bear's Lair |pattern=Ball |range=29 |time=1 |collectbase=4 |specialmultiplier=Takes goo, if there is goo when collecting pollen it increases the stack of your gummyball.|whitemultiplier=3|redmultiplier=2|bluemultiplier=2}} {{Quote|quote=Conjures up a delectable arsenal of gummy wrecking balls. Bombard Marks and Honey Tokens for massive gooey gains.}}

The '''Gummyballer''' is a [[Tools|tool]] that can be crafted in [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Glue|1,500}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|2,000}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|50}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Turpentine|5}}{{Cost|Satisfying Vial|3}} |}

It collects 8 [[pollen]] from 29 patches in 1 second and boosts it by x2 on red and blue flowers, or x3 on white flowers. It has an average base pollen collection rate of 541.33 pollen per second: 696 from white flowers and 464 from red and blue flowers.

Every swing absorbs any collected [[goo]] and removes it from the flower. In return, it gives 12 seconds of "Gummyball" buff with a max of 1000 stacks. The amount of Gummyball stacks per collected goo patch is proportional to how fresh the goo is (the more faded the goo is, the less it gives stack to the Gummyball). The more Gummyball stacks collected, the bigger the ball on the collector becomes, along with a stronger aura around it and up to a 1.1x white pollen boost.

Upon reaching the max stack of Gummyball (1000) or swinging with the collector above the ground (by jumping) while being inside a field, a Gummyball will launch forward from the player's faced direction and bounce around the border of the field. It leaves a trail of goo behind and collects pollen from the flowers it hits (collection and goo spread depends on the size of the Gummyball). It will also grab any ability or honey token and pop bubbles along the way. The larger the initial Gummyball stacks when it's launched, the larger the Gummyball will start as and the longer the Gummyball will last.

The Gummyball rewards the player with "Gummyball Combo", giving 2 stacks for hitting a wall, 1 per [[Ability Tokens|ability token]], 3 per honey token, 8 per [[Ability Tokens#mark|mark]] and 30 per precise mark for 8 seconds. Gummyball combo has a max stack of 1000 and always provides a 1.1x white pollen boost and up to a 11x goo boost depending on the stack of Gummyball combo.

==Gummyball Combo Strategies== Choose a narrow field and align your character perpendicular to the field border that you're facing by using the "<" and ">" keys with shift lock (rotates the camera by 45 degrees) If on mobile, go in straight vertical lines across the field. When aligned, launch the Gummyball at a place with lots of active marks, including the Honey Mark (+), Pollen Mark (+), Festive Mark, and Precise Mark. This will cause the ball to go back and forth and hit the mark(s) and other things that give stacks along the way without the Gummyball going to the left/right. Time the Gummyball before [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] activates (at around 21/30 if gumdrops are being dropped), so it has the time to stack up before the Gummy Morph activates.

==Gallery== Hivesticker_gummyballer.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. Gummyballershop.png|The Gummyballer in Gummy Bear's shop. FullyChargedGummyballer.png|A fully stacked Gummyballer's Gummyball. GummyballerGummyball.png|The Gummyball buff. GummyballerGummyballCombo.png|The Gummyball Combo buff. GummyballerGummyballBall.gif|Gummyball in action.

==Trivia== The Gummyballer is the second most expensive item in the game in terms of honey, only behind {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty||4=1}} which costs {{Hover|100T|100,000,000,000,000}} {{Cost|Honey}}. Its red counterpart is the [[Dark Scythe]], and its blue counterpart is the [[Tide Popper]]. However, this tool is more expensive than its counterparts. This is likely because the Dark Scythe and Tide Popper require 250 quests to be finished from its corresponding shop owner, while the Gummyballer does not. The Gummyballer is tied with the [[Pulsar]] and the [[Sticker-Seeker]] for the slowest tool in the game (in terms of how long the cooldown of each collection lasts). On December 28, 2021, the Gummyballer was obtainable through an exploit that gave the Gummyballer for free, along with the [[Tide Popper]] and [[Dark Scythe]]. Onett later patched this, and everybody who used this exploit had their data reset on their account. * If the ingredients for the item were to be crafted, the total cost would be {{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}} {{Cost|Honey}}, {{Cost|Blueberry|412,500|4=}}, {{Cost|Strawberry|412,500|4=}}, {{Cost|Pineapple|902,500|4=}}, {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|135,000|4=}}, {{Cost|Royal Jelly|812,700|4=}}, {{Cost|Bitterberry|16,500|4=}}, {{Cost|Neonberry|3,700|4=}}, {{Cost|Coconut|6,000|4=}}, {{Cost|Magic Bean|2,400|4=}}, {{Cost|Honeysuckle|12,500|4=}}. Behind {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty||4=1}}, this requires the most base resources to craft. * The Gummyballer is the only item to be added to Gummy Bear's Lair in an update after the lair came out. This is the only tool that undergoes visual changes with its ability. * This is the only tool that has the ability to take goo patches from flowers. The Gummyball on the tool moves similarly to amulets, meaning it drags behind the collector's actual movement. *On occasion, the Gummyball will appear to be dislocated from the collector, this occurs if either the server or client ping (response delay) is at high levels. The Gummyballer, along with {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty||4=1}}, {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter||4=1}}, {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter||4=1}}, and the [[Coconut Belt]] are currently the only five items that require {{Cost|Turpentine||4=}} to craft, needing 5, 25, 1, 1, and 3 respectively. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Crafted]] [[Category:Goo]] [[zh-tw:軟糖球法杖]]

docs.title: Hard Wax
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Hardwax.png |description=A firm hunk of beeswax. Has a 60% chance to improve a bee's Beequip.}} {{Color|Hard Wax}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] and a type of [[Waxes|wax]] added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]] that can be used on a [[Beequip]] to improve its stats. Upon usage, it has a 60% chance of improving the Beequip's stats. The other 40% and the Hard Wax gives no improvement, simply taking up a space in a wax slot. Hard Wax has [[Beequip#Stats, Waxes, Chances|Upgrade Value]] of 2.

Hard Waxes can also be used to craft [[tools]] and [[items]], such as [[planter]]s.

If giving a Hard Wax to a [[Bees|bee's]] Beequip is successful, the message pops up saying:

{{Notification|2=The Wax has Improved the Beequip!}}

However, if it fails, the message pops up saying:

{{Notification|Red|The Wax didn't seem to help...}}

== Ways to Obtain == * [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Soft Wax|3}} ** {{Cost|Enzymes|3}} ** {{Cost|Bitterberry|33}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|33}} * As a common reward from [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * As a common reward from [[Retro Swarm Challenge]]. * As a stack reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** The {{Cost|Precise Eye Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 hard wax. ** The Red Palm Hand rewards 1 hard wax. ** The {{Cost|Eviction|||0}} rewards 1 hard wax. ** The {{Cost|Small Shield Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 hard wax. ** The Prehistoric Hand rewards 1 hard wax. ** The Prehistoric Boar rewards 1 hard wax. ** Ionic Column Top rewards 1 hard wax. ** Ionic Column Middle rewards 1 hard wax. ** Ionic Column Base rewards 1 hard wax. ** The Shiitake Mushroom rewards 1 hard wax. ** The Black Truffle Mushroom rewards 1 hard wax. *5 Hard Waxes are included in the [[Bee Bear's Catalog|Candlewax Bundle]].

=== Drops === * As a drop from Rare+ [[Puffshroom]]s. * Three hard waxes are dropped by a lvl 5 snowbear. * As a reward from Gifted Riley Bee's [[Honeyday Candles]]. (16.3%) * As a rare drop from [[Planter]]s. ** Planters in the [[Pumpkin Patch]] drop waxes more frequently, including Hard Wax. ** The {{Cost|Red Clay Planter}} and {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty}} drop bonus waxes, including Hard Wax.

=== Quests === * [[Dapper Bear]] gives Hard Wax on the following quests: ** All About Appearances (#4) gives 3 Hard Waxes and other items. ** Creative Comforts (#6) gives 3 Hard Waxes and other items. ** Wandering Ambition (#8) gives 1 Hard Wax and other items. ** Unintended Intimidation (#9) gives 3 Hard Waxes and other items. ** Solitarily Steadfast (#14) gives 10 Hard Waxes and other items.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Purchasing certain [[Robux Shop|Robux Packs]]: ** Purchasing the Precise Pack gave 50 Hard Waxes + other items. * A Hard Wax token used to be located behind the [[Honeyday Candles]]. * As a drop from a level 5 [[Snowbear]] during Beesmas 2022, it gave 3 Hard Waxes. * Opening the Earthen Gift Box gave 10 Hard Waxes and other items. * As a reward for giving a present to certain [[Quest Givers|NPCs]]. * As a reward from [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]]. * During [[Beesmas]], using Riley Bee's [[Honeyday Candles]] has a 16.3% chance to give 3 Hard Wax. |}

== Crafting Uses == Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Hard Wax|465}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Hard Wax}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |3 |{{Cost|Soft Wax|9}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|6}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|3333}} |[[File:Swirled Wax.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Swirled Wax}} |- |3 |{{Cost|Smooth Dice|3}}{{Cost|Oil|3}}{{Cost|Glue|1}} |[[File:Loaded Dice.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Loaded Dice}} |- |5 |{{Cost|Enzymes|5}}{{Cost|Neonberry|25}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|5252}} |[[File:Caustic Wax.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Caustic Wax}} |- |5 |{{Cost|Honey|50,000,000}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|10}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|1}}{{Cost|Soft Wax|20}} |[[File:Tacky Planter.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Tacky Planter}} |- |10 |{{Cost|Honey|750,000,000}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|25}}{{Cost|Neonberry|25}}{{Cost|Glue|15}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|3}} |[[File:Pesticide Planter.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Pesticide Planter}} |- |100 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Red Extract|1500}}{{Cost|Stinger|200}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|50}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}} |[[File:Dark Scythe.png|80px|center]][[Dark Scythe]] |- |150 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|750B|750,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|75}}{{Cost|Red Extract|750}}{{Cost|Swirled Wax|25}}{{Cost|Turpentine|1}} |[[File:Heat-Treated Planter.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Heat-Treated Planter}} |- |200 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|7.5T|7,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Coconut|500}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|1,500}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|200}}{{Cost|Turpentine|3}}{{Cost|Refreshing Vial|3}} |[[File:Coconut Belt.png|80px|center]][[Coconut Belt]] |}

== Trivia == * Hard Wax's raw ingredients cost: ** {{Cost|Honeysuckle|15}} ** {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|150}} ** {{Cost|Pineapple|300}} ** {{Cost|Bitterberry|33}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|153}} or {{Cost|Honey|153,000,000}} * The probability of Hard Wax improving a Beequip all 5 times is 7.776%, or about 1 in every 13 (12.86) Beequips. * This is the only wax that can make no changes to a Beequip.

Sometimes it even makes YOU move faster. |energy = 20 |speed = 19.6 |attack = 1 |skincolor1 = #f1f1f1 |skincolor2 = #e5cf38 |skincolor3 = #f1f1f1 }}'''Hasty Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Rare|Rare bee]].

Hasty Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Pineapple}}

Hasty Bee likes the [[Sunflower Field]] and [[Cactus Field]]. It dislikes the [[Pumpkin Patch]] and [[Stump Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[pollen]] in 3 seconds. * Makes 80 [[honey]] in 3 seconds. * +40% [[Stats#Speed|movespeed]], +25% gather and convert speed. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +15% [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]].

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 3|honey = 80|honeytime = 3|rarity = rare}}

== Trivia == * The [[Hasty Guard]], which can be bought in the [[Pro Shop]], has a special design, name, and stats dedicated to Hasty Bee. * This is the only [[Bees|bee]] to have a [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|gifted bonus]] that affects Player Movespeed. This bee, Shocked Bee, Ninja Bee, and [[Photon Bee]], are the only bees that grant the Haste token without any certain [[Beequip]]s. Hasty Bee most likely dislikes the [[Stump Field]] because it is home to the [[Stump Snail]], who moves very slowly. *Hasty Bee is the fastest Rare bee.

docs.title: Heat-Treated Planter
docs.text:
{{Planter |image1=Heat-Treated Planter.png |description=Alone, grows in about 12 hours. Stores around 10 billion Pollen. Grants Red Extracts and Enzymes. |reusable=Yes|cost=750,000,000,000 Honey, 75 Magic Beans, 750 Red Extracts, 150 Hard Waxes, 25 Swirled Waxes, 1 Turpentine |grow=12 hours |growbonus=+50% in fields with red flowers. |pollen=10,000,000,000 Pollen |pollenbonus=+50% Red Pollen |nectar=+40% Invigorating+40% Motivating |item=Red Extracts Enzymes}}The {{Color|Heat-Treated Planter}} is a reusable [[Planter]]. It grows in 12 in-game hours and stores around 10 billion pollen. It grants bonus {{Cost|Red Extract}} and {{Cost|Enzymes}}. It is purchasable in the [[Red HQ]]. The player also needs to complete 150 [[Gifted Riley Bee]] quests for it to be unlocked.

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|750B|750,000,000,00}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|75}}{{Cost|Red Extract|750}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|150}}{{Cost|Swirled Wax|25}}{{Cost|Turpentine|1}} |}

It grows 50% faster in fields with red flowers. Red bees are 50% more likely to sip [[Nectar]] from it, but blue bees are 50% less likely to sip from it. This planter grants 40% more Invigorating and Motivating Nectar. Harvesting a fully-grown Heat-Treated Planter has a 1/6 (16.66%) chance to spawn a [[Puffshroom]].

docs.title: Hive Hub
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Hub Field]].''

The '''Hive Hub''' is a unique location added in the [[Updates#2024.01.12|1/12/2024]] update. It is inside the Hive Hub Portal, which is beyond the [[Ant Gate]]. It has several features, including a total of 36 hives for players to claim, the [[Public Sticker Board]], the [[Sticker-Seeker]], the [[Hub Field]], a [[Beequip]] Storage chest, and [[Sprout|Sticker Sprouts]] that spawns every 3 hours. The Hive Hub's purpose is to seek out opportunities to trade with other players and to craft the [[Sticker-Seeker]], a tool that specializes in collecting stickers and unlocks the [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine|Sticker-Seeker's quests]]. The Hive Hub also has a field, aptly named the Hub Field, which instantly converts all pollen collected into honey, as well as [[flowers]] regrowing very often, so there is no need for Sprinklers. [[Bees]] do not spawn in the Hive Hub to reduce lag. In the Summer Beesmas 2024 event, an obby made out of circular platforms was added. At the end of the obby, you jump up onto a hexagonal platform which has three tokens: a {{Cost|Smooth Dice|4=0}}, a {{Cost|Red Balloon|4=0}}, and a {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=0}}, as well as the Celestial Gift Box which is able to be opened after helping 12 NPC's complete their [[:Category:Beesmas Decorations|Beesmas decorations]].

== Gallery == HivesInHiveHub.jpg|Several hives in the Hive Hub. EmptyStickerBoard.jpg|The Sticker Board in the Hive Hub, without any stickers on it. HubField.png|The Hub Field. File:Sticker board with stickers.png|The Sticker Board with stickers on it.

== Tips == * Sharing {{Cost|Jelly Beans}} is possible here. This makes it easy to share Jelly Beans for quests, the sharing buff, or other purposes. * Be aware that the Hive Hub isn't very well optimized (Bee Swarm Simulator wasn't made to handle this much data at once), so it's best to have a decent device and set your graphics to 1 in order to avoid crashing and major framedrops.

== Restricted Items == The following items are not usable in the Hive Hub: * [[File:Sprinkler builder.png|25x25px]] [[Sprinklers]] * {{Cost|Snowflake}} * {{Cost|Stinger}} (This means that [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]] cannot be activated here). * {{Cost|Cloud Vial}} * {{Cost|Field Dice}}, {{Cost|Smooth Dice}}, and {{Cost|Loaded Dice}}. * {{Cost|Whirligig}} * {{Cost|Night Bell}} * Every type of [[Balloon]]. * Every type of [[Planter]].

== Trivia == The Hive Hub is the only field in which your Bees don't spawn. Placing a [[planter]] will prompt, “Cannot use (type) Planter in Challenge” despite the hub not being a challenge area or field. * The [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]], [[Public Sticker Board|Sticker Board]], [[Gift Boxes]], & other Hive Hub structures can be seen behind the Bee Swarm Mountain, beyond the TP barrier at the edge of the base plate on the main map. * It's possible to enter the Hive Hub without having 20 bees, since the 20 Bee Zone teleport barrier doesn't cover the left side of the area due to the teleport barrier never being increased after the area was expanded. Players can climb the wall to the left of the [[Ant Gate]], then following the wall to the left, they need to jump down. They should find themself behind the [[Stinger Shop]]. After that, the player just needs to jump while hugging the wall in front of them, allowing them to gain enough height to be able to climb over the fence, and once they are climbing it, they can either climb over it or fit in the middle hole of the fence. Alternatively, you can just join anybody who is in the Hive Hub directly from their profile without meeting the requirements. *Before a natural Sticker Sprout spawns, the following message will be displayed: [🌱 A Sticker Sprout is about to spawn in (Public Server) Hive Hubs… 🌱 ] The Retro Swarm Challenge has the [Public Server] Part, although it technically isn’t a Private Server. *All of the main machines/features of the Hive Hub seem to be behind the entrance portal. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Hive Hub]]

docs.title: Hive
docs.text:
The '''Hive''', also known as the '''Honeycomb''', is where the player's [[bees]] go to rest when they run out of [[energy]], to convert [[pollen]] to {{Cost|Honey}}, or when the player dies. Upon joining a server, the player must first claim a hive by following a red arrow and pressing "E" (on laptop, PC, etc.), "X" (On Xbox), "Square" (on Playstation) or tapping the "claim hive" button (Tablet, iOS, Android, etc.) to claim it. The player may hatch [[egg]]s and use {{Cost|Royal Jelly}} on hive slots to use them.

There are 6 hives in a server. A basic hive contains 25 slots for bees. The player can expand their hive by buying additional [[Hive Slot|hive slots]] at the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. The maximum number of bees a hive can contain is 50, but the price of that many hive slots is quite high.

On top of the 6th hive, there is a [[Easter Eggs#Statue of Onett|statue of Onett]], the [[Onett (Developer)|game's creator]]. This statue can very rarely [[Glitches|fall off and land in the rightmost hive]].

Each bee's hive slot has the face of the bee icon in the bee's color. The background color of the hive slot is based on the bee's rarity; bronze for [[Bees/Common|Common]], white for [[Bees/Rare|Rare]], bright yellow for [[Bees/Epic|Epic]], aqua blue for [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary]], light purple for [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic]], and green for [[Bees/Event|Event]]. If a bee is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]], then a thin yellow glowing line will trace the hive slot border. If a bee is [[Mutation|mutated]], then the bee's [[Bond|level]] will turn a different color depending on the mutation.

The player can also customize their hive putting [[sticker]]s on it, aswell as changing the color of the hive using hive Skin Stickers, they may also change the appearence of their {{Cost|Cub Buddy|4=1}} by placing Cub Buddy Skin Stickers in their hive.

== Gallery == GtmNDoA.png|The old hive design before the 7/10/2018 update. Hive.JPG|The old hive design before the 1/12/2024 update. HiveStickerUpdate.png|The new hive design after the 1/12/2024 update. NewUnclaimedHive.png|An unclaimed hive. EmptyServerUpdated.png|A server with no hive claimed. CustomizedHive.png|A hive customized with stickers and a Basic Green Hive Skin. HivesInHiveHub.jpg|Several hives in the [[Hive Hub]]. File:Screenshot 2024-12-25 231036.png|A hive customized with stickers and an Icy Crowned Hive Skin.

== Trivia == * Once a player dies, all of their bees return to the hive to rest, but do not recover energy. This is to prevent abusing resetting to get all bees to max energy. ** There was once a bug that could bypass this by resetting twice in a row, of which all the player's bees returned to the hive and recovered energy, and the energy would go back up to maximum. This could be abused if the player's best bee was out of energy. This bug has been patched; however, and attempting to do this won't recover their energy anymore. * The statue of Onett on the top of the 6th hive has 38217 pollen in his [[Port-O-Hive]], which is a reference to a [[Codes|code]] with the reward of {{Cost|Ticket|5}}. * The [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]] introduced a glitch that when looking on another hive, it shows the wrong rarity. This is mostly patched, but still occasionally happens. * Prior to the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], there were only 5 hives in the game. * In the earlier days of Bee Swarm Simulator, bee faces on hive slots were bigger and they also used to sparkle depending on what rarity the bee was. The rarer the bee, the more sparkles they would've emitted (excluding the [[Basic Bee]] hive slot). * The blue wall next to the leftmost hive wasn't solid after the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]]. Because of this, it was possible to bypass most of the gates without having the required number of bees. This was fixed in the following update. ** According to [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]], this was for a test when he was developing the game. However, he forgot to make the wall solid after testing. * You can click on your bee's hive slot from any distance, as long as you click the face of the bee. * A username will appear in a different font on a hive if that user has the Wavy Festive Hive Skin, Wavy Doodle Hive Skin, or Icy Crowned Hive Skin equipped.
