'''Honey Bee''' is a [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]] and one of the three permanent [[:Category:Quest Bees|Quest Bees]], the others being [[Gifted Riley Bee]] and [[Gifted Bucko Bee]]. Honey Bee is located on the rock near the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. Added in the [[Updates#2019.02.01|2/1/2019 Update]], its original purpose was to give players something to do while the next update was being worked on, but it has now become a Permanent Quest Giver.

It doesn't require a {{Cost|Translator|4=0}} to give quests, making it different from the other quest-giving bees.

== General Quest - Honey Bee's Honey Hunt == Honey Bee only gives quests that solely revolve around collecting [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|Honey Tokens]]. The first Quest starts from collecting 500 honey tokens, then the amount of Honey Tokens needed to complete a Quest is increased by 500 per subsequent Quest. Completing of each quest will award the player with a [[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Conversion Boost]] (×2 [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]]) that lasts for 30 minutes. Other rewards, such as {{Cost|Honey}}, {{Cost|Treat}}, {{Cost|Magic Bean}}, {{Cost|Royal Jelly}}, or {{Cost|Ticket}}, can be rewarded. For every 10th Quest that is completed, a {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} is rewarded. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible" !Requirements !Rewards |- |Collect 500*n Honey Tokens (n being the quest's number) |[[File:Conversion Boost.png|25px]] ×2 Conversion rate for 30 minutes. * Every 5th quest you complete, you will be rewarded with Royal Jellies, Honey, Treats, Magic Beans, Tickets, or star jellies in addition to the 2x conversion boost. * Every 10th quest completed rewards a Star Jelly. |}

==Tips== Fighting [[Stick Bug]] and [[Stick Nymph]]s and/or the [[Mondo Chick]] are very effective for completing its quests, as they spawn many honey tokens. Defeating normal [[mobs]] for their token rewards can also help with Honey Bee's quests. Defeating many [[Wild Windy Bee]]s is another way of completing this quest faster. Farming [[sprout]]s is a viable way, as they spawn many honey tokens. [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|Coin Scatter]] is also an effective way of collecting honey tokens quickly. Coin Scatter can be easily triggered by having multiple [[Stubborn Bee]]s, [[Honey Bee]]s, [[Carpenter Bee]]s and [[Vector Bee]]s. Use Coin Scatter on fields where there aren't many decorations blocking them, such as the [[Mountain Top Field]]. Catching [[coconut]]s and [[Mythic Meteor Shower|meteors]] produces many honey tokens. Summoning a [[honeystorm]] is also an option. Lower level [[fields]] such as the [[Sunflower Field]] spawn more honey tokens than higher-level fields such as the Mountain Top Field. Have bees that can spawn [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|honey gift]] tokens in your hive in order to complete the quests faster. Using the [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Star|Gummy Star]] passive would be effective as it spawns many honey tokens. *When the quest is finished, claim it '''ONLY''' when you're about to boost due to its 2x conversion.

==Trivia== This is the third bee-based [[:Category:NPC|NPC]] in the game. It is also first bee-based NPC that isn't in its gifted form, the second being the [[Digital Bee (NPC)|Digital Bee NPC]]. Honey Bee is the only Bee Quest giver that you don't need a translator to talk to. Honey Bee, [[Science Bear]], and [[Polar Bear]] are the only quest givers to give a buff as a reward for finishing a quest. Honey Bee, along with [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Onett]], [[Stick Bug]], and [[Bubble Bee Man]] are the only non-bear quest givers. In the [[Updates#2019.04.17|Egg Hunt 2019 update]], there was a [[Plastic Egg|plastic egg]] token hidden behind it. It has been replaced by a ticket token granting 3 [[Ticket]]s. Honey Bee was one of the three quest givers that did not give an Egg Hunt quest, the others being Onett and [[Spirit Bear]]. Honey Bee is the only NPC whose [[Beesmas]] quest affected another NPC's machine (Black Bear's Honey Wreath). Honey Bee along with Spirit Bear are the only quest givers that can summon a [[Honeystorm]]. ** According to [[Bee Bear]], [[Bubble Bee Man]] can also summon honeystorms.[[Honeystorm]] Honey Bee is one of 3 NPCs who have moved place, the others being [[Bubble Bee Man]] and [[Gummy Bear]]. Honey Bee's quests are the only repeatable quests which don't contain the NPCs name followed by a colon (:). During Beemas 2021, there was an error with Honey Bee’s ornament that made the Bag of Honey ornament and buffs are not visible to the player. This bug has been fixed and all players who gave Honey Bee a present before 01/06/2022 were refunded. Honey Bee is one of the 2 NPCs (the other being Science Bear) that require you to join the [https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592/Bee-Swarm-Simulator-Club#!/about Bee Swarm Simulator Club] in order to access the Club Dispensers and complete their quests. Its Beesmas quests require you to use the Honey Dispenser. It used to be located next to the ramp leading to the [[Basic Bee Gate]], but it was moved behind the biggest tree in the Pine Tree Forest in the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 Update]]. {{QuestNav}} [[Category:Quest Bees]] [[Category:NPC]] [[Category:Quest Giver]] [[Category:Bees]]

[[File:Dispenser.png|thumb|The Honey Dispenser.]] The '''Honey Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] that grants {{Cost|Honey|4=0|}} and x5 [[Ability Tokens#Haste|haste]] every time it's used. It has a 1 hour cooldown and requires the player to be in the [https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592/Bee-Swarm-Simulator-Club#!/about Bee Swarm Simulator Club] in order to be used by the player. It initially gave 5x haste and {{Cost|Honey|4=0|500}}, but after the [[Updates#2018.04.27|4/27/2018 update]], the amount was changed to {{Cost|Honey|4=0|100}} per [[bee]] in the player's [[hive]] and x5 haste. Since then, the amount of {{Cost|Honey|4=0|}} was changed again.

It is one of the four club dispensers in the game. However, it is the first one to be accessed.

The [[Obstacle Courses#Lava Obby|Lava Obby]] can be found behind it and leads to a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} token at the back of the [[Noob Shop]] and also to the [[Demon Mask]] shop.

If the player tries to use the Honey Dispenser without being in the group, they will get a prompt saying that they must join the Bee Swarm Group (or club).

docs.title: Honey Per Pollen
docs.text:
'''Honey Per Pollen''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that increases the amount of [[honey]] earned when converting [[pollen]]. For example, if a player has 10 pollen in their [[Bags|container]], with a 110% Honey Per Pollen multiplier, they would receive 11 honey if converted. 20 to 22, etc. To determine how much honey will be earned when converting pollen, multiply bag space ''B'', by Honey Per Pollen percentage.

Similar to many other boosts, (for example, [[Instant Conversion]]) the player can always check their current percentage of Honey Per Pollen on the [[System Page]]. It starts off at 100% and increases later on when the player gets more and more Honey Per Pollen boosts.

Honey Per Pollen, along with other boosts like Instant Conversion, [[goo]], and extra capacity, is one of the best ways to get maximum efficiency when producing honey. These boosts, when combined with each other, are extremely helpful overall. It can affect the player's condition when, for example, grinding or converting your [[Balloon|hive balloon]].

Keep in mind that there is a difference between Instant Conversion and Honey Per Pollen. While both help with honey production, Instant Conversion converts pollen collected in [[fields]] into honey instantly. However, Honey Per Pollen affects the amount of honey the player makes for every pollen.

== Increasing Honey per Pollen == The player can increase their Honey Per Pollen from the following sources.

== Other Honey per Pollen == As there are multiple method to converting pollen into honey, there are other variant of Honey per Pollen that applies from converting in one of those method, such as converting honey at hive and [[Instant Conversion]]. Similar to Honey per Pollen they start off at 100%.

Each Honey per Pollen variant stacks multiplicatively with Honey per Pollen, and other Honey per Pollen variant if possible. For example, with 110% Honey per Pollen and 150% Honey at Hive, the player is effectively having 165% Honey per Pollen only when converting pollen to honey at hive.

=== Honey at Hive === '''Honey at Hive''' is a Honey per Pollen that applies when the player converts their pollen into honey at their hive.

=== Honey from Instant Conversion === '''Honey from Instant Conversion''' is a Honey per Pollen that applies when pollen is converted by any [[Instant Conversion]], that is instant conversion itself, [[Instant Converter]], and anything that converts pollen from capacity except converting pollen at hive. Honey from Instant Conversion stat can't be found in [[System Page]] and the source is very limited.

docs.title: Honey Wreath
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Honey Wreath.png|thumb|195x195px|The Honey Wreath's appearance after the player completes Black Bear's Beesmas quest.]] The '''Honey Wreath''' is one of the Beesmas machines which can be unlocked after completing [[Black Bear]]'s Honey Wreath [[Quests|quest]].

When used, it converts all of the [[pollen]] in the player's bag into [[honey]], multiplied by the player's [[Honey Per Pollen]], scattering eight honey tokens around them to collect. The amount of honey obtained is also be multiplied by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]. It has a cooldown of 30 minutes, and is located between [[Windy Bee Gate|35 Bee Zone]] and the [[Ticket Tent]].

The Honey Wreath can be upgraded by completing Honey Bee's Beesmas quest, "Honey Bee’s Honey Wreath?". This causes the wreath to grant 50% more honey and additionally summon a level 20 [[Honey Bee]] that lasts for 30 minutes.

If the player attempts to use the Honey Wreath before it is decorated, it will display text reading: This Wreath looks frankly uninspired...

== Appearance == Before completing Black Bear's quest, it looks like an ordinary wreath. After completing the "Black Bear's Honey Wreath" quest, the wreath is decorated with honey icons and the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]]. After the player completes Honey Bee's "Honey Bee's Honey Wreath?" quest, it changes to have a Gifted [[Honey Bee]] face in the center of the wreath.

== Gallery == Blackbearwreathincomplete.png|The Honey Wreath's appearance before the player completed the "Black Bear's Honey Wreath" quest. Wreath use.png|A player claiming honey tokens after admiring the Honey Wreath. Honey Bee's Honey Wreath.png|The Honey Wreath after completing both Black Bear's and Honey Bee's Beesmas quests.

== Trivia == * The wreath model comes from the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/42844877/Christmas-Wreath Christmas Wreath hat] on Roblox's catalog. * The egg that is hung on the wreath is the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]]. It is a limited item that could be worn on your avatar. It was only obtainable during the [[Egg Hunt 2019]] event. * Similar to [[coconut]]s, the amount of honey received from the wreath is increased by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]. * This is one of the 4 Beesmas machines that grants the player temporary bees (only if the "Honey Bee’s Honey Wreath?" quest is completed), the others being the [[Honeyday Candles]], the [[Gummy Beacon]] and [[Onett's Lid Art]]. If the player uses the Honey Wreath with less than 801 [[Pollen]] in their bag, the tokens will each reward {{Cost|Honey|100}} ({{Cost|Honey|800}} in total), which is modified by [[Honey Per Pollen]] and [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]. Using the Honey Wreath is required for a few of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] quests during his visits, and it is also required for [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee's]] Beesmas Quest. * The Honey Bee given by Honey Wreath can collect pollen for the player is also able to attack the mobs the player's bees are attacking. e.g. if the player's bees attack the [[King Beetle]], the bee summoned from the Honey Wreath will also attack the King Beetle. ** If the player goes to their hive to convert their pollen, the Honey Bee given by the Honey Wreath does not convert any pollen and stays idle near the player. However, the bees are able to convert when a [[Ability Tokens#Mark|Honey Mark]] is active.

docs.title: Honey
docs.text:
[[File:HoneyDrop.png|thumb|The honey icon.]] {{Color|Honey}} is the main [[:Category:Currency|currency]] in [[Bee Swarm Simulator]].

== Overview == === Usage === {{Color|Honey}} can be used to purchase many [[items]] such as [[tools]], [[bags]], and in-game [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] such as [[:Category:Guards|guards]] and [[:Category:Gliding Tools|gliding tools]], and to play [[Memory Match]]. Honey can also be used to purchase products such as {{Cost|Ticket||4=}}, {{Cost|Basic Egg||4=}}, {{Cost|Royal Jelly||4=}}, {{Cost|Treat||4=}}, and [[Hive Slot|hive slots]]. In addition, Honey used along with {{Cost|Ticket||4=}}, could have been used to purchase [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boosts]] from the [[Boost Market]], which is now removed. The price of many [[:Category:Consumables|consumables]] increases with each purchase, for example, {{Cost|Basic Egg||4=}}.

=== Obtaining Honey === Honey is usually obtained by converting [[Pollen]] into it. It can be converted at the [[Hive]] or (partly) instantly converted using an [[Instant Converter]] or with a {{Cost|Micro-Converter||4=1}}, catching a falling {{Cost|Coconut||4=1}} or Science Bear's falling [[Beesmas Lights|Beesmas Light]] (only during Beesmas), activating [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|Coin Scatter]] and/or [[Passive Abilities#Diamond Drain|Diamond Drain]]. Honey can also be obtained by completing [[quests]], redeeming [[codes]], defeating [[mobs]], and collecting [[Sparkles]] and [[Goo]] from [[fields]]. [[Vicious Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]] ability spawns a honey token if it hits a [[mob]]. [[Festive Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|festive gift]] ability always spawns Honey tokens. Some other [[bees]] have the ability to give a [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|Honey Gift]] or a [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]]. Certain [[:Category:Hats|hats]], guards, and [[amulet]]s have the ability to [[Instant Conversion|instantly convert]] a percentage of pollen into honey. Popping [[bubble]]s, spawning a [[flame]], having field conversion such as [[Field Wind]]s, collecting a [[Ability Tokens#Bomb|Bomb token]] produced by a bee can result in instant conversion as well. The player can also get honey for participating in the [[Ant Challenge]]. Honey tokens can appear when the player collects pollen in a [[Fields|field]] and can be obtained from [[Honeystorms]]. The [[Mythic Meteor Shower]] awards Honey tokens after catching a meteor. The [[Honey Dispenser]] is also an option, however, it is only available to those who are in the [https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592/Bee-Swarm-Simulator-Club#!/about Bee Swarm Simulator Club].

== [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]] == Bees convert pollen into Honey at a set rate. For example, [[Basic Bee]] makes 80 honey in 4 seconds, translating into a conversion rate of 20 honey per second. [[Badges]], accessories, [[Robux Shop#Gamepasses|gamepasses]], {{Cost|Enzymes||4=1}}, and [[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Science Enhancement]] can increase the convert rate. The production rate stacks and adds up. There is currently no convert rate cap in the game.

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Honeyday Candles.png|thumb|The Honeyday Candles after completing [[Gifted Riley Bee|Gifted Riley Bee's]] Beesmas Quest.]] The '''Honeyday Candles''' are a Beesmas-exclusive machine which is unlocked after completing [[Gifted Riley Bee]]'s Honeyday Candles [[Quests|quest]].

When activated, 3 random level 10 red [[bees]] are summoned for 30 minutes, and a random [[Waxes|wax]] is spawned. They have a cooldown of 4 hours, and are located next to the [[Red HQ]]'s interior ladder.

The chances for each wax are as follows: {| class="article-table" !Wax !Chance |- |{{Cost|Soft Wax|3}} |81.3% (1/1.23) |- |{{Cost|Hard Wax|3}} |16.3% (1/~6) |- |{{Cost|Swirled Wax|3}} |1.63% (1/~61) |- |{{Cost|Caustic Wax|3}} |0.81% (1/~123) |} When a player stands on top of the pad before completing the quest, a red text box appears on the top of the screen reading: The red bees are having trouble lighting the candles...

Bees summoned by the Honeyday Candles can collect [[pollen]], attack [[mobs]], and convert honey for the player. They can also convert pollen at the hive now, using a random bee's hive slot.

The Honeyday Candles summon 3 bees from the following pool, each with increasing rarity:

[[File:Fire Bee.png|40px]] [[Fire Bee]]. [[File:Demon Bee.png|40px]] [[Demon Bee]]. *[[File:Spicy Bee.png|40px]] [[Spicy Bee]].

==Trivia== A {{Cost|Hard Wax|||0}} token used to be found hidden behind the candles. * These are one of the four machines that grants the player temporary bees, the others being [[Onett's Lid Art]], [[Gummy Beacon]], and the [[Honey Wreath]] (after completing [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee's]] Beesmas quest). * There is a glitch when the player leaves, the bees generated would stay in place until they despawned. Even when the player joins the same server, the bees will not despawn. They were introduced in the [[Updates#2020.12.25|Beesmas 2020 event]] and returned in all Beesmas updates since. During Beesmas 2020, using these candles were one of the two only ways of getting {{Cost|Swirled Wax}}, the other way is by giving Gifted Riley Bee a {{Cost|Present|||0}} during that same event. ** For every Beesmas event succeeding Beesmas 2020, the Honeyday Candles would no longer guarantee a Swirled Wax. This is the only machine that can summon bees who produce [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Flames|flames]]. Loot Luck does not affect Honeyday Candles drops. Summoned bees don't have to rest, even if you die. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]] [[Category:Summoner]] [[Category:Beesmas Decorations]] [[Category:Removed Content]]

docs.title: Honeystorm
docs.text:
[[File:Honeypad.png|thumb|The Honeystorm summoner.]] A '''Honeystorm''' is a server-wide event that can be summoned by using the pad near [[Brown Bear]] by anyone who has discovered at least four [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary Bee]] types. When summoned, a server-wide announcement will state: {{Notification|Honey|[Username] has summoned a Honeystorm!}} Upon being summoned, a golden-yellow fog will appear along with a multitude of [[Honey|honey tokens]] and some [[ticket]] tokens that will begin to randomly appear across all [[fields]], even the [[Ant Challenge|Ant Field]]. The storm lasts for 20 seconds and has a cooldown of 4 hours. It can also be randomly triggered, in which the announcement says: {{Notification|Honey|A Honeystorm has been summoned!}} When a honeystorm is summoned, the honey tokens make raindrop-like popping noises when they appear. Like with the [[Mythic Meteor Shower]], the distorted voice clip of [[BSS Staff#IcedTeaLatte|IcedTeaLatte]] saying "Honeystorm" indicates that a honeystorm has been summoned.

Fields with bigger [[flowers]] give higher amounts of honey per token, with their totals being increased by the [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey from Tokens]] stat. These honey tokens also despawn faster than normal honey tokens.

== Gallery== Honeystorm-0.png|The message shown when the player had not discovered enough Legendary bee types to summon a honeystorm. HoneystormFog.png|The golden fog of a honeystorm. Honeystorm.png|The location of the Honeystorm summoner before the 9/10/2018 update.

==Trivia== The honeystorm fog is normally tinted yellow, but during Beesmas in 2018 and 2019, the fog is white. As of Beesmas 2020, this is no longer the case, since [[Snowstorm]]s use the white fog instead. This and the [[Special Sprout Summoner]] are the only [[:Category:Machines|machines]] that require the player to discover Legendary bee types to be activated, with this requiring 4 and the Special Sprout Summoner requiring 8. A honeystorm's yellow tint could generate enough light to make the [[Cave Monster|cave monsters]] in the Werewolf's cave visible. There is a [[Glitches|glitch]] where if a switch between day and [[Day/Night Cycle|night]] occurs while a honeystorm is active, the fog will disappear. This is purely visual and the honeystorm will still function as normal. This glitch is shared with Mythic Meteor Showers and Snowstorms. There was a short-lived issue around 5/26/2018 that caused the Honeystorm Summoner to be removed. If a player encountered a server without a Honeystorm Summoner, they could simply leave the game and come back. This was, of course, fixed later. After the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], the Honeystorm Summoner was moved and the [[Wealth Clock]] now sits in its former spot. Now it is located between the [[Clover Field]] and [[Blue HQ]]. Upon receiving the quest "Witness Grandeur", [[Spirit Bear]] summons a honeystorm. According to [[Bee Bear]], [[Bubble Bee Man]] summons the honeystorms. If you summon honeystorms at night, the fog will stay even after the storm until daytime. Honeystorms can stack with other honeystorms. This does not affect the intensity of the honeystorms, but instead increases the duration.

docs.title: Honeysuckle
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Honeysuckle.png |description=Automatically makes bees instantly convert some Pollen into Honey when your bag becomes full. (Cooldown 30s) |cooldown=30 seconds }} The {{Color|Honeysuckle}} is a consumable inventory item that was introduced in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]]. Unlike other consumable items with an auto setting, {{Color|Honeysuckle|Honeysuckles}} are automatically used once a player's pollen container is full, and it is also the only item with an auto setting that cannot be put in the hotbar. When a player's pollen container is full, the Honeysuckle causes the player's [[bees]] to instantly convert some [[pollen]] in their [[Bags|bag]] into [[honey]]. It has a cooldown of 30 seconds before it can activate again, and can be toggled on or off by clicking the item in the inventory.

Unlike most consumables, this cannot be dragged to the hotbar. There is, however, an On/Off switch in the honeysuckle's inventory section. Turning it ON causes it to work automatically when the bag becomes full, and turning it OFF disables using honeysuckles.

== Ways to Obtain == * As a rare drop from [[Ladybug]]s. * As a drop from [[planter]]s. ** Planters in [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Rose Field]] and especially [[Sunflower Field]] give honeysuckles more often than other fields. ** The {{Cost|Blue Clay Planter|}} drops honeysuckles as a bonus drop. * As a reward from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * As a common reward from [[Retro Swarm Challenge|Retro Swarm Challenge.]] * As a reward from the [[Memory Match]], [[Memory Match#Mega Memory Match|Mega Memory Match]], [[Memory Match#Night Memory Match|Night Memory Match]] or [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** The Small Tickseed rewards 10 honeysuckles. ** The Small White Daisy rewards 10 honeysuckles. ** The Small Pink Tulip rewards 10 honeysuckles. ** The Small Dandelion rewards 10 honeysuckles. *Purchasing the Poinsettia Pack in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gives {{Cost|Honeysuckle|50}} and other items. * As a drop from [[Robo Party]] mobs. * As a reward from the Robo Party. === Token Locations === * A Honeysuckle token is located on the roof of [[Dapper Bear's Shop]] which grants 25 Honeysuckles.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | *Completing 6th and 18th [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] [[Beesmas|Beesmas 2022]] quests granted 25 and 50 Honeysuckle respectively. * Honeysuckle token under the [[Beesmas Tree]] which granted 5 Honeysuckles. * Giving [[Onett]] a present granted the player 25 honeysuckles and other items. * As a potential match from the 2021 and 2022 [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]]. * Purchasing the Honeysuckle Bundle from Bee Bear's Catalog rewarded 150 Honeysuckles and other items. * From certain [[Beesmas]] related [[quests]]. * Opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]: ** The Gilded Gift Box gave 20 Honeysuckles. * Using the [[Samovar]] grants 3-30 Honeysuckles (Starts from 3, increases by 1 each use and caps at 30). |}

== How to Use == Three things are needed for a honeysuckle to activate:

More pollen is collected.

[[File:How to Program BASIC.png|thumb]]{{Unobtainable}} The '''How to Program BASIC''' is a Roblox cosmetic hat that was able to be obtained by solving all the puzzles from [[The Computer]]. It was available starting from November 23, 2020 through the [[Ready Player Two]] event. As it is a Roblox hat, players can wear it on their avatar. When the player solves the puzzles, the hat will appear in the center inside the computer. However, if they leave the game, it won't appear when they rejoin.

Like the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]] and [[Swarming Egg of the Hive]] accessories, the How to Program BASIC does not give any special boosts.

The '''Hub Field Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] inside the [[Hive Hub]], right next to the [[Hub Field]].

This shop is a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]] and it sells 1 item, being the [[Sticker-Seeker|Sticker Seeker]].

Has a chance to find stickers in field, and unlocks the sticker seeker quests! |}

== Quests ==

{{Main|Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine}}

Quests from this shop require the Sticker Seeker. The quests consists of multiple parts: collect pollen with the Sticker Seeker, donating stickers to the [[Public Sticker Board]], collecting Rainbow Sticker Tokens, collecting stickers from [[sprout]]s or [[Puffshrooms]], and finding hidden Seeker-Stickers at random bee zones, shops, or HQ's.

docs.title: Hub Field
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Hive Hub|Hive Hub.]]'' {{NonRectangularField |image = HubField.png |fieldcolor = Assorted |bees = 20 |flowercount = 697 Flowers }} The '''Hub Field''' is a [[field]] that was added in the [[Updates#2024.01.12|1/12/2024 update]] and is located in the trading portal beyond the [[Ant Gate]] inside the [[Hive Hub]].

This field contains 697 [[flowers]]. They are white, blue, and red, in single, double, and triple sizes.

When planting a sprout using a {{Cost|Magic Bean|4=1}} on the Hub Field, there is a rare chance of it spawning a [[Sprout|Sticker Sprout]]. A Sticker Sprout is also guaranteed to spawn every 3 hours, granted there is no sprout occupying the field.

All pollen collected in this field will [[Instant Conversion|instantly convert]] to [[honey]].

{| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Red ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |78 |11.1% |77 |11.1% |77 |11.1% |'''232''' |33.3% |- !Double |79 |11.2% |77 |11.1% |77 |11.1% |'''233''' |33.4% |- !Triple |78 |11.1% |77 |11.1% |77 |11.1% |'''232''' |33.3% |- !Total |'''''235''''' |'''''{{Hover|33.4%|33.34%}}''''' |'''''231''''' |'''''{{Hover|33.3%|33.33%}}''''' |'''''231''''' |'''''{{Hover|33.3%|33.33%}}''''' |'''''697''''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[Blueberry]], [[Honey]], [[Pineapple]], [[Strawberry]], [[Sunflower Seed]], [[Treats|Treat]], and [[Magic Bean]] tokens.

== Obtaining Boosts == *Using [[Glitter]] will add 100% Hub Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the boost isn't already maxed out.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === Redeeming expired [[codes]]: BeequipTradeReboot (gave x4 Hub Field Boost and x15 Hub Field Winds + other stuff). ==Gallery== Hivesticker hub field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|field stamp]] and [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. ==Trivia== This, the [[Ant Field]], and the [[Stump Field]] are the only fields that the player can collect pollen from while not directly standing on the flowers. This and the [[Stump Field]] are the only non-quadrilateral fields in the game and the only fields that the player can collect pollen from while not directly standing on the flowers. This, the [[Ant Field]], and the [[Stump Field]] are the only fields where [[Wild Windy Bee]] cannot spawn in nor fly to. This, the [[Coconut Field]], the [[Pepper Patch|Pepper Patch,]] the [[Ant Field]] and the [[Stump Field]] are the only fields that were added after the game's first release. This, the [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Ant Field]], and the [[Coconut Field]] are the only fields that can't be given a field boost by [[Field Booster|field boosters]]. This field is one of three fields with no decorations in it, indicating what field it is. The other two fields to do this are the [[Ant Field]] and the [[Mountain Top Field]]. This field gets its name from the place it is located in, the [[Hive Hub]]. The Hub Field is the only field in the entire game without a truly unique field boost icon. Instead, its icon is reused from its associated [[Sticker#Stickers|field stamp]]. You cannot use many types of consumable items while on this field. *You cannot use [[Sprinklers]], [[Stinger]]s, [[Cloud Vial]]s, [[Balloon]]s, [[Snowflake]]s, [[Planter]]s, [[Whirligig]]s, [[Night Bell|Night bells]] or any kind of [[Field Dice]] while on this field. As such, this is the only field in the game where [[Sprinklers]] are completely disabled. However, you can use [[Glitter]], [[Jelly Beans]], and [[Box-O-Frogs]]. Planters can be placed only by using a glitch, although abusing this may result in potentially having your account flagged. ***As such, harvesting a planter in the field grants Comforting Nectar This is the only field that instantly converts your collected pollen into honey (the Ant Field does not instantly convert your honey by itself, and it happens instead because of the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Ant Challenge Buff]]). * The Hub Field was used to test the max amount of Combo Coconuts that could be caught from a single Combo Coconuts Ability, the idea behind it was that 34 players can cover all spots on the field where Combo Coconut could land, thus, if it could land infinitely, it would last forever, since in normal conditions Combo Coconut accelerates too fast for players to even reach 40th coconut. So, the final result showed that Combo Coconut can land a total of 50 Times, after which it will just finish as if players didn't catch it, but there won't be a message about the player missing it. * 5 minutes before a natural '''Sticker Sprout''' spawns, the following message will be displayed: [🌱 A Sticker Sprout is about to spawn in Public Server Hive Hubs… 🌱 ] [[Category:Fields]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Hive Hub]]

The {{Color|Hydroponic Planter}} is a reusable [[planter]]. Alone it grows in 12 in-game hours and stores around 10 billion pollen, as well as granting bonus {{Cost|Blue Extract}} and {{Cost|Oil}}. It is purchasable in the [[Blue HQ]]. It requires the player to complete 150 [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] quests for it to be unlocked.

docs.title: Instant Conversion
docs.text:
'''Instant Conversion''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that instantly converts some of the player's collected [[pollen]] into [[honey]]. The amount of the converted pollen depends on how much % of instant conversion you have with the support of the respective type of instant conversion (white, red, and blue instant conversion etc.). This effectively makes the player's [[Bags|bag]] bigger, in the sense that the player can collect more pollen than the bag will hold. The player's [[Honey Per Pollen]] stat will boost the amount of honey received from instant conversion. There are also color variants for each [[Flowers|flower]] color ([[:Category:Blue|blue]], [[:Category:Red|red]], [[:Category:Colorless|white]]) that only instantly convert from their respective pollen colors.

== Instant Conversion Variants == Instant Conversion has 8 variants, consisting of Flame Conversion, Field Conversion (e.g. [[Field Wind|field winds]]), Colored Conversion, Goo Conversion, Bomb Conversion, Unique Instant Conversion, Instant Tool Conversion and Bee Gather Conversion. Instant Conversion functions in the order of Goo Conversion, Field Conversion, Colored Conversion, then finally regular Instant Conversion, For example, if a player were to have 50% of the 4 variants of conversion, and they collected 10,000 red pollen, it would convert 50% of that, then another 50% of that outcome, and so on. Goo conversion converts a flat amount of pollen equal to a percentage of the [[goo]] collected from a flower. Unique Instant Conversion is applied independently of all other instant conversion, for example if you have 2 different sources of 50% Unique Instant Conversion it would apply the 50% conversion twice giving you effectively 75% Instant Conversion instead of 100%.

== Increasing Instant Conversion ==

  • Instant Conversion is increased by: ** {{Cost|Enzymes}} (+10%) ** {{Cost|Tropical Drink}} (+10%) ** {{Cost|Super Smoothie}} (+20%, overwrites {{Cost|Enzymes}}) ** [[Badge#Cactus Badges|Cactus Badge]] (+5%) ** [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Photon Bee]] (+5%) ** Certain [[Items]] ** Certain [[Amulet|Amulets]]
  • Instant White Conversion is increased by amulets, the [[Badges#Pineapple Badge|Pineapple Badge]], Gifted [[Windy Bee]] or with the [[Coconut Canister]].
  • Instant Red Conversion is increased by the [[Badges#Mushroom Badge|Mushroom Badge]], Gifted [[Crimson Bee]] or with certain items.
  • Instant Blue Conversion is increased by the [[Badges#Blue Flower Badge|Blue Flower Badge]], Gifted [[Cobalt Bee]] or with certain items.
  • Instant Field Conversion (field winds) are granted by donating to the [[Wind Shrine]] or from certain [[codes]].
  • Goo Conversion is increased by the [[Shell Amulet]], [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]], or [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Star|Gummy Star]].
  • Instant Flame Conversion is granted by the [[Fire Mask]], [[Demon Mask]] and [[Passive Abilities#Scorching Star|Scorching Star]].
  • Instant Bomb Conversion is granted by [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]] and Gifted [[Demon Bee]].
  • Unique Instant Conversion is granted by Coconut Combo, [[Clouds]], Puffshroom Blessing, [[Beequip|Beequips]] and Refreshing [[Nectar]].
  • Instant Bee Gather Conversion is granted by the [[Jelly Beans#Types and Effects|Pink Jelly Bean]] buff.
  • Instant Tool Conversion is granted by the [[Jelly Beans#Types and Effects|Teal Jelly Bean]] buff.

== Effects ==

  • When instant conversion is in effect, and pollen text is turned on, the player will see yellow numbers in addition to the blue/red/white pollen numbers while they're working in the [[fields]]. Those yellow numbers are the amount of pollen that instantly became honey; Collected honey amounts also show up in yellow, but those are also listed in the bottom right corner of the player's screen.

  • The formula for the effective increase in capacity given by instant conversion is: (x/(100-x)), where x is the player's total instant conversion.

{ class="article-table" !Instant Conversion !{{texttip Increase in effective capacity - 5% {{texttip - 10% {{texttip - 15% {{texttip - 20% {{texttip - 25% {{texttip - 30% {{texttip - 35% {{texttip - 40% {{texttip - 45% {{texttip - 50% {{texttip - 55% {{texttip - 60% {{Hover - 65% {{texttip - 70% {{texttip - 75% {{texttip - 80% {{texttip - 85% {{texttip - 90% {{texttip - 95% {{texttip - 100% {{texttip }

== Trivia ==

  • The [[Ability Tokens#Festive Blessing|Festive Blessing]] [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] from [[Festive Bee|Festive Bee's]] Festive Gift token or [[Sprout|Festive Sprouts]] grants 100% Instant Conversion temporarily. If the player has a full container with 100% Instant Conversion, collecting pollen will not transfer into honey. ** The [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] also grants 200% Goo Conversion while covering the whole field in goo. ** The [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Ant Challenge Buff]] grants 100% instant [[Ant Field]] Conversion. ** Pollen collected from the [[Hub Field]] is instantly converted.
  • [[Critical Hits#Super-Crit|Super-Crits]] and [[Bubble#Golden Bubbles|Golden Bubbles]] instantly convert all pollen they collect.
  • Tadpole Bee used to give 25% Instant Bubble Conversion before the 5/23/2024 update. [[Category:Mechanics]]

docs.title: Instant Converter
docs.text:
[[File:Converter.png|300px|right|An Instant Converter.]]The '''Instant Converter''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] used to immediately convert [[pollen]] into [[honey]], similar to a [[hive]], but instantly and without the use of [[bees]].

There are three Instant Converters that can be found in the game:

docs.title: Behind the [[Basic Egg Shop]], next to the [[Sunflower Field]] and in front of the [[Mushroom Field]]; this one is available to all players.
Just around the corner from the [[Brave Bee Gate]]; the player will need 10 bees to access it.
Next to the [[Mountain Top Field]]; the player will need 25 bees to access it.
docs.text:
Each machine costs {{Cost|Ticket|1}} to use and has a cooldown of 15 minutes.

The player's [[Honey Per Pollen]] rate also applies to the Instant Converter, just like it would at the hive.

==Tips== The player can use an Instant Converter to squeeze in one more trip to a [[Field Boost|boosted field]]. This can be useful when they know that going back to their hive and waiting for their bees to convert their pollen would take longer than the time left on a boost. It is more cost-effective to use an Instant Converter when the player's [[Bags|bag]] is full since it's a free cost. *Keep in mind that the cooldown of an Instant Converter is the same as the duration of a field boost, which means the same converter cannot be used twice during a field boost unless the player increases the duration of it.

==Trivia== The player can jump inside the chute of the converter in the Brave Bee Gate, which leads to the [[White Tunnel]] where [[Tunnel Bear]] spawns. There's a pad in the middle of the tunnel that will teleport the player on top of the converter behind the [[Basic Egg Shop]]. Before the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]], the Instant Converter in the 10 Bee Zone was the only one available in the entire game, and had a cooldown of only 10 minutes. Before the 7/11/2018 update, the conveyor belt in the Instant Converter would push the player out of it. [[File:BlackBearTitle.jpeg|thumb]]Behind the converter in the Brave Bee Area, there is a question that asks '[[Black Bear|Black Bear's]] Title?'. This question is a hint to the [[Codes|code]], 'Connoisseur', as Black Bear claims to be a Honey Connoisseur in the dialogue of his first [[Quests|quest]]. *According to [[Spirit Bear]], it was planned for an Instant Converter to be built on the spot where the [[Wind Shrine]] sits now. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Machines]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Starter Zone]]

{{Consumables|image=Invigorating vial.png|description=Grants 4 hours of Invigorating Nectar. (Boosts: Red Pollen, Convert Rate, Bee Attack.)|cooldown=1 Second|cap=10}}

The {{Color|Invigorating Vial}} is a consumable [[Nectar Vial|nectar vial]] [[Items|item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2022.12.26|12/26/2022 update]]. Once used, it grants the player 4 hours of the [[Nectar|Invigorating Nectar]] [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] instantly. It can also be used to craft other [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] and [[tools]].

== Ways to Obtain == * Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 9th and 12th quests. * Using the [[Nectar Condenser]] to condense 12 hours of Invigorating Nectar. * Adding the Invigorating Nectar Icon to the [[Sticker Stack]] grants 1 Invigorating Vial. * Dropped by a Level 10 [[Snowbear]].

=== '''Outdated Ways''' === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Purchasing the Charming Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gave an Invigorating Vial and other items. * Purchasing the Hefty Honeyday Bundle in Bee Bear’s Catalog gave 5 Invigorating Vial and other items. * Opening the [[Gift Boxes#2022|Obnoxious Gift Box]] gave an Invigorating Vial and other items. * Giving a [[present]] to [[Gifted Riley Bee]]. * Completing [[Stick Bug#2022 Beesmas Quest - Nymph Hats|Stick Bug's Beesmas 2022 quest]]. * Dropped by a Level 10 [[Snowbear]]. * Purchasing the Nighttime Nectar Pack in the [[Robux Shop]] granted 1 of each Nectar Vial. * Opening the Cherry Gift Box during Beesmas Winter 2024 gives an Invigorating Vial and other items. |}

docs.title: Jelly Beans
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Jelly Beans.png |description = Scatters various buff-granting beans on nearby flowers. Works best when shared. |cooldown = 30 seconds |cap = 100 }} {{Color|Jelly Beans}} are an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2019.04.17|Egg Hunt 2019 update]]. When used, it spreads jelly beans of varying colors in the direction the player is facing, with each color representing a different [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]]. They will turn into jelly bean tokens when they land on [[flowers]], making them collectable. Each buff lasts for a minute. Each jelly bean item spawns 11-13 jelly bean tokens.

If multiple players are around, a different player picking up the tokens will give both the owner and the collector the token's buffs, as well as the Jelly Bean Sharing Bonus to the owner. Therefore, it is best to share jelly beans.

The player can only hold a maximum of 100 at a time in their inventory. The player will need to use at least one in order to get any more unless they are obtained from [[quests]], purchased from any [[Robux Shop|Robux pack]], or from the [[Ornament Presents|Colorful Present]] (now unobtainable).

'''''Note:''' Jelly Beans can be activated anywhere, though it is recommended to be in a field because if the beans do not land on a field, no tokens will be spawned.''

==Types and Effects== All jelly bean types stack up to 3 times. There are 15 different types of jelly beans and 1 unique [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] related to sharing jelly beans with other players: {| class="sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" !Name == Ways To Obtain == * As a reward from the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]] * As a reward from the [[Ant Challenge]]. * A common reward from [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * As a drop from [[Party Cogmower]]s and [[Party Cogturret]]s. * As a reward from [[Memory Match]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding the following [[Sticker]]s to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** {{Cost|Standing Bean Bug Sticker|||0}} grants 5 Jelly Beans. ** {{Cost|Baseball Swing Sticker|||0}} grants 5 Jelly Beans. ** {{Cost|Colorful Buttons Sticker|||0}} grants 5 Jelly Beans. === Drops === * As a bonus drop from certain [[Planter]]s: ** {{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}} * Donating certain items to the [[Wind Shrine]]. * Rarely through a [[Cub Buddy]] gift in increments of 1 or 5. === Quests === * [[Black Bear]] gives jelly beans on the following quests: ** Can't Without Ants rewards 3 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** Low Tier Treck rewards 3 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** Mountain Mix rewards 3 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** You Blue It rewards 5 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** Getting Stumped rewards 10 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** Red Delicacy rewards 3 jelly beans and other items after completion. * [[Brown Bear]] rewards jelly beans after every third quest completed. * [[Spirit Bear]] rewards jelly beans on the following quests: ** QR Quest rewards 5 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** Pleasant Pastimes gives the player 3 jelly beans once the quest is started. ** Out-Questing Questions rewards 10 jelly beans and other items after completion. ** Do You Bee-lieve In Magic? ==Audio== Whenever a jelly bean token is collected, one of the five following audios will play:[[File:Jb1.ogg]][[File:Jb2.ogg]][[File:Jb3.ogg]][[File:Jb4.ogg]][[File:Jb5.ogg]]

==Gallery== SpreadJellyBeans.gif|A player using jelly beans. File:Jelly Beans from Onett.png|Onett granting jelly bean buffs at the end of Beesmas. File:Jelly bean token from g-shrine.png|A jelly bean token.

==Trivia == [[Bean Bug]]s are passive mobs that spawn in random fields. They scatter jelly bean tokens around their current field. They are the second and only other way of getting jelly bean tokens. When picking up a jelly bean item token (the consumable), it said "You found a Jelly Beans!" instead of "You found Jelly Beans!" or "You found a Jelly Bean!". This was an error, fixed at an unknown date. The Merigold Jelly Bean is misspelled throughout the game. The correct spelling should be 'Marigold'. The hearts in the Jelly Bean Sharing Bonus buff are similar to the heart of the [[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|Baby Love ability token]], but they are not blushing. Rarer jelly beans emit sparkles when being thrown into a field, and the token will also emit a sparkle effect. Prior to the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], Jelly Beans did not have a maximum capacity and players could obtain them in an unlimited amount. If the player donates any number of Jelly Beans for the first time to the [[Wind Shrine]], it gives back 7 Jelly Beans. After donating, it says "- ( Number ) Jellybeanss". It should be "Jelly Beans" with one S. When claiming the tokens, it says "+ ( Number ) Jelly Beans ( from >>☻︎ ). This is a clue from the [[Ready Player Two|Ready Player Two Event]]. If the player attempts to throw Jelly Beans in the [[Ant Field]] from outside, the beans will be thrown, but no tokens will spawn even if they hit flowers in the Ant Field. Like [[Field Wind]]s, further Jelly Bean stacks do not add up on each other. Instead, they gain their own stacks of percentage. The Spoiled Jelly Bean is the only jelly bean to grant a debuff.

docs.title: King Beetle Amulet
docs.text:
[[File:King Beetle Amulet.png|thumb|220x220px]] The '''King Beetle Amulet''' is an [[amulet]] with a one in seven (or 14.287%) chance of dropping upon defeating the [[King Beetle]] ([[Loot Luck]] does ''not'' affect the probability or stats).

If the player has three or more types of amulets, the King Beetle Amulet will be above the player's right shoulder. If the player has two types, it will be above their left shoulder, and if it's the only type, it will be above their head.

The amulet grants a random number of [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]]. The buffs can be field-specific [[Field Boost|pollen boosts]], [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]] bonuses, and/or [[System Page#Bee Attack|Bee Attack]] bonuses. The quality of the amulet (the number of buffs it gives as well as the amount of those buffs) has the tendency to improve with the number of times the King Beetle is defeated, up to a maximum of 100 defeats, though a guaranteed improvement on every occasion should not be expected.

== Possible Buffs == * +1% to +100% Convert Rate (Guaranteed). * One of the following (Possible): ** +1 [[Bee Attack#Regular Bee Attack|Bee Attack]] ** +1 [[Bee Attack#Red Bee Attack|Red Bee Attack]] ** +1 [[Bee Attack#Blue Bee Attack|Blue Bee Attack]] * Two of the following: ** +1% to +100% [[Bamboo Field]] Pollen ** +1% to +100% [[Mushroom Field]] Pollen ** +1% to +100% [[Blue Flower Field]] Pollen ** +1% to +100% [[Clover Field]] Pollen ** +1% to +100% [[Strawberry Field]] Pollen

== Trivia == * The King Beetle Amulet used to be a guaranteed drop by King Beetle but was removed some time after. * The amulet looks like King Beetle's head, but with a 45 degree tilt. * The King Beetle Amulet is the first amulet that is a dropped from a [[Mobs|mob]], the second being the [[Shell Amulet]] that is dropped by [[Stump Snail]]. * This is the only amulet in the game to not be guaranteed to drop from its source. * All rewards from King Beetle will automatically be added into the player's inventory if they receive a King Beetle Amulet.

docs.title: King Beetle's Lair
docs.text:
'''King Beetle's Lair''' is the location where [[King Beetle]] spawns. It can be accessed from the light green door between [[Blue HQ]] and under the [[Clover Field]] and next to the far end of the [[Blue Flower Field]]. Inside the lair, the exit can be accessed by climbing a ladder leaning adjacent to the entrance. The interior of the lair is completely empty, except for the ladder for leaving. Both doors are one-way. The player will be pushed through either door if they stand too close, even if they aren’t moving. The entrance to the lair cycles in color, so it stands out from the rest of the environment.

The King Beetle spawns on the back wall adjacent to the Noob Shop and [[Obstacle Courses#Lava Obby|Lava Obby]].

Near the back right corner of the lair, there is some text on the floor, "Song Name". It refers to the song that plays inside the lair and is a hint to the [[Codes|code]], "Crawlers".

== Music == When in the lair, the following audio plays:[[File:Crawlers.ogg]]

This [[Music|audio]] is known as "Crawlers" and also plays inside the [[Commando Chick's Hideout]] and the [[White Tunnel]].

== Gallery == D2F788D1-B6B0-4AF3-9498-E0673E9D7C6B.jpg|King Beetle in his lair. Kingbeetlelairentranceandexit.png|The interior of the King Beetle's Lair. CrawlersHint2021.png|The ‘Song Name’ Hint in the corner of the lair. KingBeetleSprout.png|A sprout in the Clover Field as seen in the lair. LairSpike.png|A spike as seen from the lair (with the honeystorm pole visible at the top right). IMG 1013.jpg|The entrance to King Beetle's Lair. Ezgif-7-12ec8f7233b2.gif|The entrance cycling color. A64877C9-E489-458C-89B6-8F268EDF4BAF.jpeg|Rain from a cloud in the Clover Field, seen in the lair. KING BEETLE GETS STUCK EPICALLY.png|King Beetle getting stuck because of the "Song Name" text.

== Trivia == * In early game versions, if players went too close to the side of the lair that is closest to the Noob Shop, they could die due to a lava block clipping into the wall from the lava obby. This was later patched. * The bottom of the pole of the [[Honeystorm|Honeystorm Summoner]] sign pokes into the top of the lair. * If there is a [[sprout]] in the Clover Field, the bottom of its light column and the remaining pollen number can be seen in the lair. **This is similar to when [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]’s spikes and [[clouds]] spawn in the Clover Field. * There is a [[Glitches|glitch]] where the King Beetle can fail to lunge and get stuck when in the 'Song Name' corner. * During the [[Updates#2018.12.25|Beesmas 2018 Event]], the red roof of the lair could be seen on the sides of the flower blocks in the Clover Field. ** However, the red roof's glow near the Noob Shop wall is still visible even when it was not snowy. * Any [[Tools|tool]] can collect [[pollen]] from the Clover Field inside the lair if the player continuously jumps and has enough [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]]. However, the [[Spark Staff]] doesn't require too much Jump Power. * If the player has enough Jump Power and jumps high enough, the [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetle]] and [[ladybug]] in the Clover Field can be triggered. The player's bees may also think that they are in the Clover Field and start collecting pollen. * The entrance to the lair is lighter than the color of the surrounding ground and slightly changes in. During Beesmas, it is much more noticeable as the walls surrounding the entrance are white. * The cycling colors of the entrance matches the cycling colors and pattern of any supreme-tier amulet.

docs.text:
{{Mob |title = King Beetle |image =King_Beetle.png |location = [[King Beetle's Lair]] |timer = 24 hours (20 hours 24 minutes with a Gifted Vicious Bee) |hp = 2,500 |damage = 40 |points = 150 |bond = 500 |honey = 5,000 Honey |level = 7}} The '''King Beetle''' is a level 7 [[:Category:Bosses|boss mob]] that resides in his [[King Beetle's Lair|lair]]. The entrance to his lair is on the wall between the [[Blue Flower Field]] and the [[Clover Field]], above the blue flower closest to the [[Blue HQ]]. He has 2,500 health and deals 40 damage to the player per hit if the player has no [[System Page#Defense|Defense]].

He takes 1 day (24 hours) to respawn after being defeated (20 hours and 24 minutes with a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]). The rewards for defeating him vary, but always include 150 [[Battle Points]], as well as [[Honey]], [[Royal Jelly|Royal jelly]], [[Ticket]]s, and [[Bond]].

There is a one-in-seven (approximately 14%) chance that he will drop a [[King Beetle Amulet]] when defeated. Having more [[Loot Luck]] increases the probabilities of other drops but doesn’t improve the probability of a King Beetle Amulet dropping. After the [[Updates#2019.02.01|2/1/2019 Update]], King Beetle drops honey tokens and rewards in a token circle around the center of the lair unlike all other mobs who drop the circle around the place of their death (except for [[Stump Snail]], [[Tunnel Bear]], and [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]) unless the player receives a King Beetle Amulet, in which it goes directly into the player's inventory.

Antennas|||0}} (Beesmas only){{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|||0}} (Beesmas only) {{!}}} }} == Strategies== Defeating a King Beetle is challenging and he might kill players several times before they succeed (It's recommended that players don't fight King Beetle with a full bag). Here are some recommended strategies for defeating him: *'''The Stop and Run Method.''' This method counts on the fact that King Beetle has a predictable pattern of behavior. He moves toward the player, stops to "aim," and then lunges. If the player stays still long enough for him to aim (about 3 seconds), but then quickly moves away, King Beetle will lunge at where the player used to be, not where the player has moved to. Thus, this method entails running along the edge of the lair, stopping, looking at King Beetle and waiting for him to lock onto the player, and then quickly jumping and running to a different point along the edge of the lair. Rinse and repeat until he is defeated.

*'''Circling King Beetle.''' This method allows the player to defeat King Beetle faster. If the player keeps circling around their King Beetle while keeping a good distance from him, their bees can get very close to King Beetle. Though the player might get hit the first few times, the beetle will most likely be defeated.

*'''Running along the perimeter of the lair.''' This method takes a long time, but it works. Run around the lair and occasionally look at his health. It's very helpful if players have Rage Bees, so they can run around and grab the tokens. However, if the player is too far away from him, their bees will come back to them rather than attacking the beetle. Building up maximum [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] can help, although it may run out before King Beetle gets defeated. Using the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]] can also help since gliding through the air can be faster than running.

*'''Have strong bees.''' If the player is certain that their bees will kill him before they die, they can just wait for their bees to defeat him while the player stands in front of King Beetle, doing nothing during the process.

*'''The spike attacks from Rogue Vicious Bee.''' If a Rogue Vicious Bee is active in the Clover Field, players can trick it into damaging King Beetle.

  • '''Abusing a glitch method.''' Due to a bug, if the player gets the King Beetle stuck on the clue 'Song Name' by standing in the top right corner, King Beetle cannot attack them. This may take several attempts to work.

== Look Out For... == With all methods, there are some things to watch out for.

*If the player gets too far from King Beetle, their bees will follow them instead of attacking it. But if the player gets too close, it's very easy to accidentally touch its aura which will damage the player.

*If more than one player is trying to fight King Beetle at the same time, his pattern of behavior can become less predictable. It can also be difficult to tell which King Beetle is targeting them. For best results, wait for the other player's King Beetle to be defeated before entering its lair.

*If the player's bees' levels are lower than 7, their attempts to attack will most likely miss. This will make defeating it take much longer than if they were level 7 or above.

  • When dodging King Beetle, keep in mind he does not follow directly behind the player but can sidestep to get in their way.

  • If you die, the King Beetle's health will reset, unlike [[Commando Chick]] and [[Stump Snail]].

==Tips== Some things can help the player defeat King Beetle, regardless of which strategy the player chooses.

Having more bees and having bees with high attack power such as [[Lion Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Riley Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], [[Rage Bee]], [[Brave Bee]], and [[Precise Bee]]. Having high-level bees so attacks don't miss (Recommended level 5-7 with at least one Rage Bee and 20 [[bees]]). Wearing an [[:Category:Accessories|Accessory]] that can boost [[System Page#Bee Attack|Bee Attack]], [[System Page#Movespeed|Movespeed]], [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]], or Defense, such as [[:Category:Guards|guards]]. Collecting [[Ability Tokens#Rage|Rage]], [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] and [[Ability Tokens#Melody|Melody]] tokens can be helpful, especially if the player has fewer bees. Collecting [[Ability Tokens#Haste|haste]] and [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|bear morph]] tokens can also help dodge King Beetle's attack. While it is possible to defeat King Beetle using the arrow keys to move, WASD is the suggested method, because it allows the player to keep looking at King Beetle while they are moving. The Parachute or Glider can be used to quickly get out of King Beetle's attack path. Having at least 20-25 bees with all of them at least level 7 is usually enough to defeat King Beetle using the above strategies. Using a [[Stinger]] can be useful with low level bees.

==Trivia== King Beetle used to guarantee an amulet upon death In the back right corner of the lair, there is something written on the floor. This is a hint for a [[Codes|code]]. The clue is "Song Name", which refers to the music that plays in the lair. If the player checks [https://www.roblox.com/library/1598349092/crawlers Onett's inventory], the user will see that it's called Crawlers. King Beetle was the first boss to be added to the game. King Beetle has the fifth-largest amount of health in the game for any mob, with [[Tunnel Bear]] being the fourth, [[Coconut Crab]] the third, [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]] the second, and [[Stump Snail]] the first. On certain occasions, Rogue Vicious Bee, [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[Aphid|Aphids]], and [[Stick Bug]] will have more health depending on their level. In this case, King Beetle can be considered the weakest boss in terms of health. King Beetle and Stump Snail are the only mobs that can drop an amulet, the [[King Beetle Amulet]] and the [[Shell Amulet]] respectively. There was a myth that clicking on King Beetle has an effect. However, this was disproven as [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] has confirmed that King Beetle does not even have a [http://robloxdev.com/api-reference/class/ClickDetector click detector]. Before the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 Update]], King Beetle took two days to respawn after being defeated, granted more battle points and despawned after about 5 minutes. King Beetle is a hybrid of a [[Rhino Beetle]] and a [[Ladybug]], as stated by Onett on Discord. [[File:BSS lore.PNG|thumb|220px|Onett stating that King Beetle is a hybrid on the Bee Swarm Simulator Discord Server.]][[File:ItOmitsToxins.png|thumb|337x337px]] Onett stated that the King Beetle emits toxins that makes the player hallucinate, which is why both he and his lair are strangely colored. An active King Beetle's health bar can be seen through the Clover Field and the Blue Flower Field. *King Beetle is the only boss that doesn’t have a time limit to kill it.

==Gallery== RobloxPlayerBeta 2018-07-25 15-40-57.png|thumb|The King Beetle Amulet GUI. KingBeetleDefeat.png|thumb|Defeating a King Beetle for the first time. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Bosses]]

docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Ladybug |image =Ladybug.png |location = [[Mushroom Field]], [[Clover Field]], [[Strawberry Field]] |timer = 5 minutes (4 minutes 15 seconds with [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]) |hp = 12 (Lvl 1) 20 (Lvl 2) 28 (Lvl 3) |damage = 15 |points = 1 |bond = 5 |honey = ~75 |level = 1-3 }} The '''Ladybug''' is a [[mob]] that defends three different [[fields]].

This is one of the first mobs a player will encounter, as they are in 2 out of 5 of the [[Starter Zone|starting fields]] (the others being [[Rhino Beetle]]s and the possibility of [[aphid]]s, [[Wild Windy Bee]], and [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]).

It takes 5 minutes for a ladybug to respawn after being defeated (4 minutes 15 seconds with a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]). Defeating one gives 1 [[Battle Points|Battle Point]] and about 75 [[Honey]] (increased by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]) spread across 4 honey tokens. Various other rewards are also possible with their probability increasing with [[Loot Luck]].

A ladybug's level can range from 1-3, depending on the field it is located in.

{| class="article-table" !Guaranteed Drops list |- |{{Cost|Honey|75}} (increased by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]) |} {| class="article-table" !Possible Drops list |- |{{Cost|Ticket}} (2% Chance, Increments of 1, 5 or 10){{Cost|Strawberry}} (Increments of 1, 5 or 10){{Cost|Gumdrops}} (Increments of 1, 5 or 10){{Cost|Treat}} (Increments of 1 or 50){{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} (Uncommon){{Cost|Robo Pass|4=0}} (Rare){{Cost|Magic Bean|4=0}} (Rare){{Cost|Red Extract|4=0}} (Rare){{Cost|Field Dice}} (Rare){{Cost|Honeysuckle|4=0}} (Rare){{Cost|Bitterberry}} (Rare, increments of 1 or 5){{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Ant Pass|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Elf Cap|4=0}} (Rare, Exclusive to [[Beesmas]] only){{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|4=0}} (Rare, Exclusive to [[Beesmas]] only){{Cost|Rascal Bee Egg|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare){{Cost|Pink Balloon|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare) |}

==Strategies== *Ladybugs behave similarly to most mobs: it pauses to aim, then lunges. If the player stops to let them aim, then move, it will attack the spot where the player used to be, not the player's current location.

==Trivia== The respawn timer for a ladybug currently counts down from 5 minutes (previously 5 minutes and 15 seconds). However, as with most Mobs, ladybugs do not always respawn immediately after their timer runs out. (Usually a 10-20 second delay) The ladybug's detection range in the Mushroom Field is larger than that of the Field, making it react even when the player is not in the field. * Before, ladybugs would completely ignore players, but this was patched on the [[Updates#2018.05.11|5/11/2018 Update]]. The maximum level of this mob is level 3, which is the lowest maximum level of all mobs. The [[King Beetle]] is a [[:Category:Bosses|boss mob]] that shares a similar design to the ladybug, being a hybrid of a ladybug and a Rhino Beetle, as stated by Onett in his Discord server.

''This page is for the in-game leaderboards. For this wiki's Achievement Leaderboard, see the [[Special:Leaderboard|Achievement]] page.''

'''Leaderboards''' are a feature within the game. Each leaderboard displays the ranks of the top 100 players, showing ten ranks at a time. Leaderboards are usually not in real-time, but update very often. Upon standing on the white pad in front of a leaderboard, it will show a message stating the player's score for the corresponding leaderboard.

Out of the 64 total leaderboards, 18 are able to be viewed at various locations around the map, and the rest are available to view in the [[System Page]]. ==Trivia== * All leaderboards that reset on a daily basis reset at 12:00am GMT-5. [[Highest Snowbear Level|The Highest Snowbear Level leaderboard]] was added on Christmas Day 2020 with the Beesmas update. This was removed 1 week after Beesmas 2020 ended. The [[Top Brown Bear Helpers]] leaderboard is the only leaderboard that does not show the player's current amount of the stated objective. The player can still view their score either in the leaderboard menu in the System Page or by speaking to [[Brown Bear]] when claiming or turning in a quest. The [[Most Commando Captures Leaderboard]] also shared this property, but has since been removed from the game entirely. On 3/17/2022, [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] abbreviated the amount of honey for the Daily Top Honeymakers and the All-Time Top Honeymakers leaderboard due to players having massive amounts of honey. ''Not to be confused with [[Flowers]] or [[Pollen]].'' [[File:Leaf.png|thumb|A leaf.]] '''Leaves''' are entities that appear in most [[fields]]. It works similarly to [[sparkles]] and emits leaf particles. To get a reward from leaves, the player needs to collect [[pollen]] on the tile it is on, similar to sparkles. If the leaves are collected upon, a rustling sound plays, and multiple leaf particles fly out before the token appears. Rewards vary depending on which field the leaves are in but will always be in the quantity of 1. For example, leaves will spawn blueberries in blue fields. Leaves also have a chance of spawning an [[aphid]] based on field activity, with a higher chance to spawn if in a field with lower activity, they can also summon leaf [[Sticker#Sticker Index|stickers]] in most fields.

Because the [[Mountain Top Field]] cannot naturally spawn treats, leaves in the Mountain Top Field are very rare and will always spawn an [[aphid]], [[Bitterberry]], [[Neonberry]], or [[Magic Bean]] token. The [[Stump Field]] and the [[Ant Field]] cannot spawn Aphids.

docs.text:
{{Bee Gate |title1 = Lion Bee Gate |image1 = LionBeeGate.png |caption1 = The Lion Bee Gate.|shops = * [[Mountain Top Shop]]. * [[Ticket Shop]].|fields = * [[Mountain Top Field]].|extras = * [[Bear Gate]]. * [[Instant Converter]]. * [[Field Booster]].|mobs = *[[Mondo Chick]]}}The '''Lion Bee Gate''', also known as the '''Mountain Top Gate''' or the '''25 Bee Gate''', is a [[:Category:Gates|gate]] that requires 25 [[bees]] to pass through. It is located at the end of the slope beside the [[Pumpkin Patch]].

It gets its name from the large statue of a [[Lion Bee]] located on top of it.

This area contains the [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Mondo Chick]], [[Sticker Printer]], [[Field Booster]], [[Instant Converter]], [[Ticket Shop]] and the [[Mountain Top Shop]].

== Trivia == * As of the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the player will be teleported back to spawn if they manage to bypass the gate, whether if it was by jumping around it or using the [[Red Cannon]] without the Parachute. * This and the [[Ant Gate]] share a few similarities. ** They are the only gates that don't have a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]] behind them. *** If one were to count the [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]] inside the [[Hive Hub|Hive Hub Portal]] past the Ant Gate, then this would be the only gate that doesn't have a quest giver behind it. **They are the only gates that only contain 1 [[Fields|field]]. *** If one were to count the [[Hub Field]] inside the [[Hive Hub|Hive Hub Portal]] past the Ant Gate, then this would be the only gate that contains 1 field.

docs.title: Loot Luck
docs.text:
'''Loot Luck''' is a passive attribute that increases the chances of receiving certain rewards from defeated [[mobs]]. The formula to calculate the chance of receiving an [[Items|item]] from a mob when the player defeats it is: 1-((1-base chance) ^luck). A general rule of thumb is that for every 100% Loot Luck the player has, the player gets an extra roll to get each drop.

It also affects what type of token spawns in [[fields]]. Every time a [[honey]] token spawns in the field, it rolls a "drop table". Every [[Items|item]] has a chance to "pass," with Loot Luck boosting the chance for it to pass. If it does, that item spawns. Otherwise, if it fails, it goes on to the next item. If every item fails, the honey token spawns as it is.

Loot Luck does not affect [[amulet]] tiers, stats granted from amulets, drops from [[chicks]], or hatching and transforming [[bees]].

== Ways to Increase == Loot Luck can be increased through [[:Category:Belts|belts]], [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]], and other ways.

=== [[:Category:Belts|Belts]] === Each belt gives an amount of Loot Luck.

  • The [[Belt Pocket]] gives +25% Loot Luck.
  • The [[Belt Bag]] gives +50% Loot Luck.
  • The [[Mondo Belt Bag]] gives +75% Loot Luck.
  • The [[Honeycomb Belt]] gives +100% Loot Luck.
  • The [[Petal Belt]] gives +101% Loot Luck.
  • The [[Coconut Belt]] gives +102% Loot Luck.

=== [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonuses]] ===

  • Gifted [[Baby Bee]] gives +25% Loot Luck.

=== Buffs ===

  • [[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|Baby Love]] gives +50% Loot Luck.
  • [[Ability Tokens#Snowglobe Shake|Cool Breeze]] gives from 1% Loot Luck up to 10% Loot Luck at 100% Cool Breeze.

=== [[Badges]] === *The [[Badges#Clover Badges|Clover Badge]] can give up to +50% Loot Luck depending on the badge rank. ** The Cadet Clover Badge gives +10% Loot Luck. ** The Hotshot Clover Badge gives +20% Loot Luck. ** The Ace Clover Badge gives +30% Loot Luck. ** The Master Clover Badge gives +40% Loot Luck. ** The Grandmaster Clover Badge gives +50% Loot Luck. == Trivia ==

  • Before the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], Loot Luck was simply named Luck.
  • Loot Luck once affected [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|honey tokens]]. However, this feature was removed due to there already being a [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]] stat.
  • Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the Clover Badge did not give any Loot Luck. This was a mistake, which was fixed after said update.
  • The [[B.B.M. Mask]] used to grant +50% Loot Luck.

docs.text:
[[File:Magic_Bean_Shop.png|thumb|The Magic Bean Shop.]] The '''Magic Bean Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], located next to the [[Stump Field]]. It can be used to purchase [[Magic Bean|magic beans]] with [[ticket]]s, in increments of 1 and 10, with each bean being 20 tickets.

It is decorated with a small normal sprout on top, along with the magic bean icon on all of its sides.

== Prices == {|class="article-table" !{{Cost|Magic Bean}} !{{Cost|Ticket}} |- |1 |20 |- |10 |200 |}

== Trivia == * In terms of Robux, the Magic Bean Shop is overpriced. In the [[Robux Shop]], a ticket costs 10 robux, while a magic bean costs 30 robux. The player needs 20 tickets for 1 magic bean. That means the player is getting something for 200 robux when they could get for only 30 robux (This is similar to the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser|Royal Jelly Ticket Dispenser]]). **For comparison, 200 robux can also be used to purchase a bundle of 10 magic beans in the robux shop, effectively meaning the player misses out on 9 magic beans if they buy 20 tickets from the robux shop to spend them on the magic bean shop.

A {{Color|Magic Bean}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. As a reward from the [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. As a reward from donating to the [[Wind Shrine]]. As a reward from [[Memory Match]] games. docs.title: Magnet
docs.text:
{{Tool |image =Magnet.png |price = 5,500 |shop = Noob Shop |range = 9 |pattern = Surround |time = 0.8 |collectbase = 2 }} The '''Magnet''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that can be purchased at the [[Noob Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|5,500}} |}

It collects 2 [[pollen]] from 9 surrounding patches every 0.8 seconds. It has a base pollen collection rate of 22.5 pollen per second on average, making it the second best tool in the Noob Shop.

==Appearance== The magnet is consisted of a magnet colored red with white tips. The pole is a shade of grey.

==Gallery== Hivesticker magnet.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]].

==Trivia== According to LunaTalks, an [[BSS Staff|administrator]] on the official Bee Swarm Simulator Discord, the Magnet was the first tool [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] ever made when developing the game. The Magnet is a weaker version of the [[Electro-Magnet]], a tool that can be purchased in the [[Pro Shop]] for 300,000 honey. In addition, the Electro-Magnet bears a different appearance to the Magnet; instead of the body color being red, it is yellow. In addition, it has four poles instead of two, and there is electricity in between the poles, unlike the Magnet. The two are the only tools to collect pollen in a square pattern. They also have the same exact collecting pattern. Interestingly, the Magnet's associated sticker portrays a different gray magnet with colored ends. This is the only tool sticker in the entire game that is completely different from the original tool's appearance. The Magnet’s design is most likely based upon a real-life horseshoe magnet. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

{{Mob |title = Mantis |image =Transparent_mantis.png |location = [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Pine Tree Forest]] |timer = 20 minutes (17 minutes with a Gifted Vicious Bee in hive) |hp =115 (Lvl 4)

140 (Lvl 5)

165 (Lvl 6) |damage =20 |points = 5 |bond = 25 |honey = 250 |level = 4-6 }}The '''Mantis''' is a [[Mobs|mob]] that defends the [[Pineapple Patch]] and the [[Pine Tree Forest]].

It takes 20 minutes for a Mantis to respawn after being defeated (17 minutes if the player has a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]).

This Mob's level can range from 4-6 depending on the [[field]] it is located at.

The Mantis is green with red eyes. Its arms stick out, similar to a praying mantis.

== Locations == {| class="article-table" !Field !Quantity !Level |- |Pineapple Patch |1 (with 1 [[Rhino Beetle]]) |4 |- |Pine Tree Forest |2 (with 1 [[Werewolf]]) |5 (on left) 6 (on right) |}

== Drops == Guaranteed: * 5 [[Battle Points]]. * 250 [[Honey]]. ([[Loot Luck]]: + Honey From Tokens).

Possible: * {{Cost|Ticket}} (20% chance) (Loot Luck: + Drop rate). * {{Cost|Snowflake}} (increments of 1, 5, 50 or 100) (Beesmas only). * {{Cost|Blueberry|}} (increments of 1, 3, 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100). * {{Cost|Pineapple}} (increments of 1, 3, 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100). * {{Cost|Treat}} (increments of 3, 5, 10, and 25). * {{Cost|Gumdrops}} (increments of 1, 5, 10 or 25). * {{Cost|Moon Charm|}} (Rare). * {{Cost|Robo Pass|4=0}} (Rare). * {{Cost|Royal Jelly}} (increments of 1, 5, or 10). * {{Cost|Micro-Converter}} (increments of 1 or 5). * {{Cost|Smooth Dice}} (Rare). * {{Cost|Neonberry}} (Rare). * {{Cost|Whirligig}} (Rare). * {{Cost|Oil}} (increments of 1, 5 or 10) (Rare). * {{Cost|Glitter}} (increments of 1 or 5) (Rare). * {{Cost|Beesmas Top|4=0}} (Beesmas only, Rare). * {{Cost|Menacing Mantis Sticker|4=0}} (Extremely Rare). * {{Cost|Silver Egg}} (increments of 1 or 5) (Extremely Rare). * {{Cost|Diamond Egg|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare). * {{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare). * {{Cost|Pink Balloon|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare).

==Strategy== Due to the Mantis' long attack range, the player’s [[Bees]] normally won’t target it until they get closer/when the mantis itself attacks. Try to get at the very edge of its enormous jump range. Then, when it stops to get ready to attack, walk in a very wide circle around it. If done correctly, the mantis will undershoot and land where you were a few seconds before. This is often close enough for your Bees to start attacking, even once it retreats back. Also, keep in mind the [[Glitches#Frozen Field Defenders|Frozen Field Defenders Glitch]] can be used to defeat it, just like with most other mobs. When a Mantis is stuck in an object, the player can also defeat it more easily.

== Gallery == RobloxScreenShot20180721_072204888.png|Obtaining 5 Silver Eggs from a mantis. ==Trivia == * When a [[:Category:Bears|Bear]] gives a quest that involves more than one mantis, its plural form was spelled incorrectly, such as "4 Mantiss" rather than "4 Mantises" or "4 Mantis"; This was fixed at an unknown time. In [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] dialogue for his quests, he asks you to defeat x "Mantises", but in the quest list, it still says "Mantiss". In Bee Bear's quest, ‘''BEE-liz Honey-dad''’, he told the player to defeat 10 Mantises, but if the player talked to him again, he didn't mention this. The mantis in the Pineapple Patch can get stuck in the wall surrounding the field or in the smaller pineapple behind the [[Treat Dispenser]], though this is rare. Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]], the pine trees in the [[Pine Tree Forest]] could be collided with and the mantises could get stuck in them. * Mantises have the longest attack jump length of any mob, only rivaled by the [[Werewolf]]. Because of this, the mantises can jump outside of the field that they're defending into others. * The mantis has the same respawn time as the [[Scorpion]]. During Beesmas 2020, you could get the [[Beesmas Top]] from the Mantis. As stated by Number1Riker, a [[BSS Staff#Former BSS Staff|Former Moderator]] of the Bee Swarm Simulator Discord server, the Mantis was originally supposed to be a cricket before being changed into the former. The reason for the change is unknown.

docs.title: Mazes
docs.text:
'''Mazes''' are secret areas in the game that contain [[items]] inside of them. To obtain these items, the player needs to navigate through the mazes and find them. There are currently two mazes that exist in the game, each located in their own respective location.

== Blue Maze== The '''Blue Maze''' is located next to the [[Ticket Tent]] (or behind the Beige Gift Box in Beesmas 2021) . It was added in the [[Updates#2019.04.17|Egg Hunt 2019 Update]]. This requires no [[Bees|bee]] requisites to enter since it's located in the [[Starter Zone]].

Inside the maze, the player can obtain 5 [[ticket]]s by taking a left turn first and then a right turn, and a [[Jelly Beans|jelly bean]] token by taking the path on the right. There used to be a [[Plastic Egg|plastic egg]] where the tickets were in the 2019 Egg Hunt. The player can also find a [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|star jelly]] token on the right, but it is blocked by a glass wall. It can be obtained by going through a passage behind the [[Petal Shop]].

[[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted Chicks]] could spawn in this maze before they were removed.

== Pro Shop Maze == The '''Pro Shop Maze''' is located behind [[Pro Bear]] in the [[Pro Shop]]. It requires at least 10 bees to pass through the [[Brave Bee Gate]], where the Pro Shop is located.

The player can obtain a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] by going forward to the end and turning right two times, then going to the first opening available. Follow through it to find the royal jelly token.

There is also a [[Sunflower Seed|sunflower seed]] token inside the maze that awards 10 sunflower seeds. The player can obtain it by taking same path as the royal jelly, but instead of turning on the last right, go to the end of the hall and follow through the last corridor.

If the player gets close enough, they can grab both tokens through the walls, making collecting them easier.
