== Trivia == * Before the [[Egg Hunt 2019]] Event ended on [[Updates#2019.05.13|5/13/2019]], there was a plastic egg token in place of the ticket token and the [[Mysterious Figure]] was in the Blue Maze in place of the star jelly token. These have been removed in the following minor update, as well as other Egg Hunt content with it. The room it was located in is still present, however.

docs.text:
''Not to be confused with [[Mega Mechsquito]]s, the larger counterparts of Mechsquitos or [[Party Mechsquito]]s, the Beesmas Edition of these.''

{{Mob |title = Mechsquito |image =Nightmare.png |location = Anywhere (Including outside of fields) while the [[Robo Bear Challenge]] is active. |hp = Increases with level and round. |damage = 5 (laser) 25 (when touched) |level = Varies with Robo Bear's Challenge level }} A '''Mechsquito''' is one of the five [[Mobs]] that spawns during [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]].

This is the first Robo Bear Challenge mob that the player will encounter, appearing as early as round one. Mechsquitos often spawn a few seconds into the round.

Mechquitos spawn far away from the player and will fly towards the players' vicinity. Mechquitos hover away from the player when they are near them when not in an attacking state. When starting to attack, they will become immobile and only aim at the player for a few seconds before shooting a small exploding projectile aimed at the player. The projectile explodes upon contact or after a short while. When in the vicinity of its explosion radius, the player will get damaged and receive [[Buffs & Debuffs#Debuffs|Mechsquito Toxin]], lowering the Pollen and Movespeed of the player and can stack up to 10 times. Note: The toxin projectile cannot damage and affect other player, only the player playing the challenge.

A Mechsquito's level can increase depending on what round of Robo Bear's Challenge the player is on.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |60 |- |2 |120 |- |3 |200 |- |4 |250 |- |5 |400 |- |6 |600 |- |7 |900 |- |8 |1,100 |- |9 |1,300 |- |10 |1,500 |- |11 |1,800 |- |12 |2,000 |- |13 |2,200 |- |14 |2,500 |- |15 |2,800 |- |16 |3,000 |- |17 |3,200 |- |18 |3,400 |- |19 |3,700 |- |20 |4,000 |- |21 |4,200 |- |22 |4,400 |- |23 |4,600 |- |24 |4,800 |}

== Strategies == * Mechsquitos aim for where the player is, not where the player will be. Because of this, moving around in circles will often result in Mechsquitos missing their attack. * Stand near the Mechsquito, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Mechsquito and quickly deal damage. * [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control, especially since Mechsquitos often come in pairs or packs. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Mechsquitos at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

== Gallery == File:Mechsquito Image 1.png|A level 13 Mechsquito in a field. File:BSSRoboBearUpdateThumb.png|A Mechsquito in an older version of the game's icon with Robo Bear, Digital Bee, Basic Bee, and a Cogmower.

== Trivia == * Mechsquito is a portmanteau of "Mechanical" and "Mosquito". * Mechsquitos has a party variant called Party Mechsquito. * Mechsquitos has a stronger variant called [[Mega Mechsquito]]. Mechsquitos are the only mob that can appear in every round of Robo Bear's Challenge. *It's also the mob with the most levels in Robo Bear's Challenge.

(Contact) |level = 13-22 }} A '''Mega Mechsquito''' is a [[mob]] that appears during [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]].

This is the fourth and last unique mob type a player will encounter in Robo Bear's Challenge, first appearing at Round 15.

Mega Mechsquitos behave similarly to [[Mechsquito]]s. Flies away from the player when they are not attacking and staying in position while attacking the player from a distance. Unlike the Mechsquitos, they try to get away from the player farther than Mechsquitos and consecutively shoot at the player with 6 small exploding projectiles in a short amount of time, inflicting [[Buffs & Debuffs#Debuffs|Mechsquito Toxin]] debuff upon hitting the player.

A Mega Mechsquito's level can range from 13-22 depending on what round of Robo Bear's Challenge the player is on.

In Round 15 of the Robo Bear Challenge, the player has to defeat 10 Mega Mechsquitos and collect 2,000,000,000 pollen of a certain color to complete it.

==Strategies== * Mega Mechsquitos aim for where the player is, not where the player will be. Because of this, moving around in circles will often result in Mega Mechsquitos missing their attack. Stand near the Mega Mechsquito, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Mechsquito and quickly deal damage. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control, especially since Mega Mechsquitos often come in pairs or packs. [[Digital Bee]] can also stun many Mega Mechsquitos at once and allow them to take extra damage via [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]].

docs.title: Memory Match
docs.text:
'''Memory Match''' is a match-style minigame located in various places throughout the map. The goal is to match as many pairs as possible to win [[items]]. There are four (five during Beesmas) of these machines that can be used. Each machine costs a varying amount of [[honey]] (See "[[Memory Match#Machines|Machines]]"). NOTOC == Gameplay == [[File:MemoryMatchScreen.png|thumb|The Night Memory Match Screen. An example of a board of size 4x4 cards.]] [[File:Ossas.png|thumb|The Extreme Memory Match screen. An example of a board of size 4x5 cards.]] When activated, a screen will pop up with a board of size 4x4 or 4x5 cards. A player has a limited number of chances to match cards together. Matching a pair also costs a chance. They can gain more chances if they have the required [[Badges|badge]] and its rank to get it.

Machines with rarer rewards require more honey and a higher badge rank for extra chances. They also have a longer cooldown between each activation.

If at least one match is made, a message will appear in the chat: {{Notification|Honey|Winner!}}, with the items received listed below.

If no matches are made, a message will appear in the chat: {{Notification|2=Better luck next time!}}

== Machines == Currently, four machines can be accessed at any time. There's also a machine that can only be accessed during Beesmas, and one that can only be accessed as a reward for completing certain quests. {{Tabber |Permanent|{{Tabber |Memory Match|{{MemoryMatchInfobox |name=Memory Match |image=Memory Match.png |location=In front of the [[Pro Shop]] |cost={{Cost|Honey|25000}} |cooldown=2 hours |size=4x4 }}The '''Memory Match''' is located in front of the [[Pro Shop]]. It costs {{Cost|Honey|25000}} to use and has a 2-hour cooldown. The size of the board is 4x4 cards. docs.title: Micro-Converter
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Mconv.png |description = Instantly converts all Pollen in your bag to Honey. |cooldown = 5 seconds |cap = 15 }}The {{Color|Micro-Converter}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]]. When used, it instantly converts all [[pollen]] in the player's [[Bags|bag]] into [[honey]]. It acts as an [[Instant Converter]] without the need for [[ticket]]s and the journey to the hive, a significantly shorter cooldown, and is portable.

The amount of honey the player receives from a micro-converter is not affected by their [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]], although it is affected by [[System Page#Honey Per Pollen|Honey Per Pollen]].

The player can have a maximum of 15 micro-converters in their inventory at a time. Obtaining more than 15 will not add any micro-converters to their inventory unless purchased from the [[Robux Shop]], obtained from [[Quests]], or adding certain [[stickers]] to your [[Sticker Stack]].

The following audio plays when a micro-converter is used: [[File:Mconv.ogg]]

== Ways To Obtain == * Rarely dropped when defeating [[mobs]], such as a [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetle]], [[mantis]], [[werewolf]], [[Tunnel Bear]] and [[aphid]], or guaranteed drop from [[Coconut Crab]] and [[Mondo Chick]]. * Completing some of [[Black Bear#Quests to Star Jelly (15)|Black Bear's Star Jelly quests]] and [[Black Bear#Quests to Mythic Egg#Mythic Egg quests|Black Bear]]'s Mythic Egg quests (15 in total). * Completing some of [[Spirit Bear#Quests (30)|Spirit Bear's quests]]. Completing some of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] quests. Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 4th 9th, and 13th quest. * Completing 10, 30, 70, 155, 170, 215, and 270 [[Brown Bear]] quests will reward an additional 5 micro-converters, and completing 80 will reward an additional 10 micro-converters. * A rare gift from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gifts]]. * As a rare drop from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a reward for donating to the [[Wind Shrine]]. * Matching a pair of micro-converters in [[Memory Match]]es (available in increments of 1, 2, 6, or 5 depending on which Memory Match). * Rarely through a [[Cub Buddy]] gift in increments of 1 or 5. * A token behind [[Black Bear]] in between the [[Red HQ]] and the [[Windy Bee Gate]]. * As a drop from a [[Blue Clay Planter]]. ** Planting it in the [[Spider Field]] makes it drop at least 10 Micro-Converters. * As a reward from [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * As a reward from [[Retro Swarm Challenge]] * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** The Alert Icon rewards 3 micro-converters. ** The Simple Skyscraper rewards 3 micro-converters. ** The Lightning rewards 3 micro-converters. ** The Grey Diamond Logo rewards 3 micro-converters. ** The Magnet rewards 3 micro-converters. ** The Spark Staff rewards 3 micro-converters.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Completing certain Egg Hunt quests rewarded micro-converters and other items. * Opening the Shady Present gave 24 micro-converters and other items. * Purchasing the Booster Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for 33 [[Snowflake]]s and 3 [[Gingerbread Bear]]s gave 5 micro-converters and other items. Purchasing the Robotic Bundle in Bee Bear's Catalog for {{Cost|Snowflake|2500}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|50}} gave 25 micro-converters and other items. The Vibrant Gift Box and the Charcoal Gift Box both granted micro-converters. Giving a present to Gifted Bucko Bee rewarded 5 micro-converters and other items. Completing [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee's (NPC)]] [[Beesmas|Beesmas 2022]] quest gave 9 Micro-Converters. * Redeeming certain expired [[codes]]: ** WalmartToys (Gave 3 micro-converters + other stuff). ** ClubConverters (Gave 10 micro-converters). ** 1MLikes (Gave 1 micro-converter + other stuff). ** PlushFriday (Gave 1 micro-converter + other stuff). ** ThnxCyasToyBox (Gave 1 micro-converter + other stuff). ** 5Years (Gave 5 micro-converters + other stuff). ** 4MilMembers (Gave 4 micro-converters + other stuff). ** FuzzyFarewell (Gave 3 micro-converters + other stuff). ** SpaceReboot (Gave 5 micro-converters + other stuff). ** BillionVisits (Gave 10 micro-converters + other stuff). ** NewMic (Gave 10 micro-converters + other stuff). ** WintersEnd (Gave 1 micro-converter + other stuff). ** 3YearParty (Gave 5 micro-converters + other stuff). ** MondoOutage (Gave 3 micro-converters + other stuff). ** FourYearFiesta (Gave 4 micro-converters + other stuff). * Purchasing certain finished packs from the Robux Shop: ** Purchasing the Spikey Spring Basket pack gave 15 micro-converters and other items. ** Puchasing the Cyber Monday Deal gave 10 micro-converters and other items. * A token to the right of the Mythic Present (gave 3 Micro-Converters). docs.title: Mobs
docs.text:
There are 34 different kinds of '''enemies/creatures/monsters''' (colloquially called “'''mobs'''”) in [[Bee Swarm Simulator]].

Other than [[ants]] and [[Robo Bear Challenge]] mobs, the most frequently occurring mob is the [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetle]] as there are five of them in the game with [[ladybug]]s being the second with four. The least frequently occurring mob is the [[Stump Snail]], respawning in 96 hours (4 days) or 81 hours and 36 minutes or 3.4 days (if the player owns a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]) upon defeat.

The 8 entities that can attack other mobs are [[bees]], [[flame]]s, [[frog]]s, [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[Ability Tokens|abilities]], [[Passive Abilities|passives]], [[coconut]]s, and the coal summoned from the [[Naughty List]] during [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]]. One method for defeating mobs that reliably works for any mob that defends a [[field]] (everything other than the [[King Beetle]], [[Tunnel Bear]], [[Cave Monster|cave monsters]], [[Stick Bug]], [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], [[Wild Windy Bee]], and the [[Chicks#Commando Chick|Commando Chick]]), with the exception of the [[Coconut Crab]] and [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]], is to jump continuously. It is one of the [[glitches]] where when jumping, mobs will freeze and not attack which leads to the player’s bees thinking the mob isn't a threat and not attack it. Players would have to make sure their bees "know" to attack a mob before starting to jump - if the mob has not started attacking them - by waiting for their bees to begin attacking the mob before jumping.

Before the [[Updates#2019.02.01|2/1/2019 update]], rewards from defeating any mob were sent to the player's inventory right after the mob was defeated. After the update, the mobs were altered to drop a ring of tokens around it instead ([[Battle Points|battle points]] do not spawn as tokens). Other players cannot collect tokens dropped by the mob if the mob was not spawned by them. The tokens can be collected by a [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|token link]], unless the rewards are from public mobs, meaning other players can collect the drops regardless of whether they attacked it or not.

Mobs have levels that are shown next to their name. If a player’s bees are at a lower level than the mob they are attacking, they have a higher chance of missing their attacks depending on how far the level of the bee is from the level of the mob being attacked. This means that the lower the level of the bee, the more likely a mob that has a higher level than the bee attacking will deflect or dodge the bee's attacks.

Some mobs are considered passive. This means that they will not attack the player, nor the player will attack them. These include [[Bean Bugs|bean bugs]], [[frog]]s, [[fireflies]], with the exception of [[Chicks#Chick|Chicks]], [[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted Chicks]], and [[Chicks#Hostage Chick|Hostage Chicks]].

While some mobs are considered [[:Category:Bosses|bosses]], others do not qualify for this designation. These mobs are called [[:Category:Mini Bosses|mini bosses]], distinct from regular mobs but not qualifying as a boss. [[Wild Windy Bee]], [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], [[Snowbear]], Commando Chick, and Stump Snail are all in this category.

Daylight Saving Time will affect the respawn time of the Stump Snail, King Beetle, and Tunnel Bear.

[[Loot Luck]] has the ability to directly affect the quantity and quality of the rewards that mobs drop upon defeat but will not affect honey dropped by mobs (that is instead affected by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey from Tokens]].)

When the Mondo Chick and Commando Chick use their egg block ability, it will block almost all bees' attacks, even if the bee is the same level or a higher level than it.

Stump Snail has the highest health out of all mobs and does not intentionally attack the player. Instead, it moves in a circle around the edge of the [[Stump Field]]. However, it will deal damage if the player stands in the front of the snail or in its head. Standing inside the shell will not deal any damage to the player.

From 7/20/22 to 7/29/22, there was a Roblox bug that caused mobs to not work properly.

== Regular Mobs== Regular mobs stay in certain fields and will attack the player if they enter that field. Once defeated, they will respawn after a period of time. docs.text:
{{Unobtainable}} {{Accessory |image1 = MONDOB.B.M.M.png |stats = +250,000 Capacity+50 Convert Amount+100% Honey From Tokens+1 Bee Attack }} The '''Mondo B.B.M. Mask''' is a [[:Category:Hats|mask]] that is the bigger version of the [[B.B.M. Mask]]. It was obtained by completing [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee Man's]] [[Quests|Quest]], "B.B.M. Mission", which was given out in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]] during the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas 2018 Event]].

To obtain the quest the player would have needed to complete [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear’s]] entire now unavailable Beesmas 2018 questline. Otherwise, Bubble Bee Man would say, 'uhh... ..ummm....'. After the completion of this quest, this hat would automatically replace the hat the player was wearing. Currently, players can reequip this mask by talking to BBM in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]].

==Stats== +500,000 [[Capacity]] +10% [[Pollen]] +10% [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]] +50% [[System Page#Convert Rate|Conversion Rate]] +50% [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]] +1 [[Bee Attack]]

==Gallery== MondoBBMMask.png|The Mondo B.B.M. Mask icon. MondoOutageOnBBM.webp|A player wearing the Mondo B.B.M. Mask.

==Trivia== This and the B.B.M. Mask are the only masks that cannot be purchased, and the only ones with no description. This, the B.B.M. Mask, the [[Fire Mask]], and the [[Demon Mask]] are the only masks to have [[System Page#Bee Attack|Bee Attack]] buffs. *This and the [[Mondo Belt Bag]] are the only items that are a mondo version of an [[:Category:Accessories|accessory]]. {{Items}} [[Category:Hats]] [[Category:Accessories]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Beesmas]]

==Trivia==

This is the second belt accessory awarded by [[Sun Bear]] on his first visit, the first being the Belt Bag. In the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], Sun Bear returned for a second visit wearing the Mondo Belt Bag and the [[Beekeeper's Boots]]. The Mondo Belt Bag worn by Sun Bear is much bigger than the player's. Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], the Mondo Belt Bag didn't require stingers, pineapples, or sunflower seeds to be purchased. This is the 4th strongest belt accessory in the game, behind the [[Honeycomb Belt]], [[Petal Belt]] and the [[Coconut Belt]]. This is one of the few items that went from being a quest reward to being purchasable in a [[:Category:Shops|shop]]. *Other items with this quality are the [[Belt Bag]] and the original three pairs of [[:Category:Boots|boots]].

docs.title: Mondo Chick
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Mondo Chick |image =MondoChicktransparent.png |location = [[Mountain Top Field]] |timer = 45 minutes - 1 hour |hp = 300,000 |damage = 75 |points = 0 |bond = 0 |honey = Varies |level = 8 }}The '''Mondo Chick''' is a level 8 [[:Category:Bosses|boss]] [[Chicks|chick]] located in the [[Mountain Top Field]]. It respawns every hour at the full hour (1:00, 2:00, 3:00, etc; not in time zones that are a fractional number of hours away from UTC), and it's respawn timer can be found on the side of the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. The respawn time is unaffected by the Monster Respawn Time stat. Its rewards can be shared between players.

The Mondo Chick will always spawn at level 8 with 300,000 health. It takes 333 damage automatically each second, causing its health to reach 300 after 15 minutes. If it isn't defeated within 15 minutes of spawning, it will despawn in a similar fashion of the [[Commando Chick]]. Similarly to the [[Coconut Crab]], player(s) will be rewarded depending on how fast the Mondo Chick is defeated. Due to its large range and damage, it’s recommended to use distance between the player and the Mondo Chick.

When nighttime appears, a [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] will be spawned by any chance in the Mountain Top Field and it can attack the Mondo Chick, causing its health to drop rapidly.

The Mondo Chick will hide in its egg after several seconds, causing it to stop moving and block some attacks. The egg can be cracked by dealing 7,500 damage to it or by waiting 23 seconds via automatic damage.

When Mondo Chick spawns, a server-wide message displays: {{Notification|Chick|🐣 Mondo Chick has spawned! 🐣}} Once it is captured, players that damaged it gets three messages displaying: {{Notification||Defeated Mondo Chick!}} {{Notification|Chick|🐣 Captured Mondo Chick in [Time] (Fastest Time: [Fastest Time])/[(New Record)] 🐣|11}} {{Notification|Chick|Reward: Mondo Chick Blessing x[Amount]}}

When its time runs out, it will jump out of the field towards the [[Lion Bee Gate]] entrance. A message notifies players that damaged it when Mondo Chick's time runs out displaying: {{Notification||🐣 The Mondo Chick got away!}}

Strangely, for some players, the message that appears when Mondo Chick is captured always says "New Record" next to the time. This includes cases when the time it took for that capture wasn't a fastest time for that player. This is possibly a bug. {| class="article-table" !Time to defeat !Amount of Mondo Chick Blessing |- |<5 seconds |x10 |- |6 – 10 seconds |x9 |- |11 – 15 seconds

x8 16 – 20 seconds x7 - 21 – 30 seconds x6 - 31 – 59 seconds x5 - 1:00 - 2:30 x4 - 2:31 - 4:59 x3 5:01 - 10:00 x2 - 10:01 - 15:00 x1 }

==Drops== {| class="article-table" |- |{{Cost|Honey}}{{Cost|Treat}}{{Cost|Bitterberry}} (Amount increases the faster it is captured){{Cost|Neonberry}} (Up to 2, very common){{Cost|Field Dice}} (Common){{Cost|Micro-Converter}} (Common){{Cost|Magic Bean|||0}} (Somewhat rare){{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Mythic Egg|||0}} (Extremely rare){{Cost|Star Treat|||0}} (Exceptionally rare){{Cost|Snowflake}} (Amount increases the faster it is captured, Beesmas only){{Cost|Snowglobe|||0}} (Rare, Beesmas only){{Cost|Small Blue Chick Sticker|||0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Basic Pink Hive Skin|||0}} (Extremely rare) |}

== Tips ==

  • Have bees specialised in attack such as [[Vicious Bee]], [[Lion Bee]], [[Rage Bee]], Spicy Bee and [[Precise Bee]].
  • Have bees that produce ability tokens such as Focus, Rage and Melody, that improve Critical Chance, Critical Power and Bee Attack.
  • Build a Focus stack before the Mondo Chick spawns. ** If the player owns a Precise Bee, they can try and stack Precision to increase Super-Crit Chance.
  • The [[Demon Mask]] or the [[Fire Mask]] is recommended as they have stats and passives that improve the player's attack damage.
  • If the player has the [[Coconut Canister]] equipped, they can intentionally activate the Emergency Coconut Shield, giving them 10 seconds of ×1.25 Bee Attack and drops 5 falling [[Coconut|coconuts]] onto the field.
  • Having [[Nectar|Nectars]] like Invigorating Nectar which grants ×1.01 - 1.1 Bee Attack.
  • [[Bond|Level]] up bees to level 8 or higher. Bees with a lower levels than the Mondo Chick are likely to miss their attacks, while bees with the same level or higher won't miss.
  • Keep a distance from the Mondo Chick, as it can randomly change direction and deal significant damage to the player. *Using various [[:Category:Consumables|consumables]] and [[Passive Abilities|passives]] such as {{Cost|Stinger}}, {{Cost|Coconut}}, {{Cost|Oil}}, or [[Passive Abilities|Star Saw]] can help defeat aphids faster.

==Gallery== Capture-1586731714.PNG|Mondo Chick walking around. FA55E91E-02EE-4357-98F8-88B3A927CDD3.jpeg|Mondo Chick hiding in its egg. Mondorespawn.png|The respawn timer for the Mondo Chick. MondoChick Hibernating.png|Mondo Chick hibernating. Mondochickgotawayono.png|The message sent when Mondo Chick runs out of time. (only appears when you are close to Mondo Chick when it runs out of time) 24579F7E-EDAB-4EE6-AB5B-0B78228181A4.jpg|The server-wide message that the Mondo Chick has spawned. MondoChickBlessing.png|Mondo Chick Blessing Icon. Mondo chick with no egg.png|Invisible Mondo Chick shell. Mondo's drop forming a huge halo.png|Mondo Chick's drops in a ring instead of scattered across the field. Mondoinpineapple.png|Mondo Chick in the Pineapple Patch. Mondo next to pineapple patch.png|Mondo Chick by the Instant Converter near the Pineapple Patch. Mondo Chick in spider.png|Mondo Chick in Spider Field. Mondo Chick at the 30 Bee zone.png|The Mondo Chick inside the 30 Bee Zone. Mondo Chick Using Memory Match.png|Mondo Chick facing the [[Memory Match]]. Mondo Chick Star Jelly.png|A player receiving a {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} from a Mondo Chick. Mythic Egg Mondo.png|A player receiving a {{Cost|Mythic Egg|4=0}} from a Mondo Chick. Star mondo mini.png|A player receiving a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} from a Mondo Chick. File:MountainTopChaos.jpg|Mondo Chick, along with Stick Bug, Rogue Vicious Bee and Wild Windy Bee in the Mountain Top Field.

==Audio== [[File:Mondochickchirp.ogg|thumb|342x342px]] The chirping sound made from the Mondo Chick:

[[File:Mondochickhatch.ogg|thumb|342x342px]] The following audio plays when the Mondo Chick breaks out of its egg:

[[File:Mondo Capture.ogg|thumb|342x342px]] The chirping sound made when the Mondo Chick is captured:

==Trivia== The Mondo Chick's noises can be heard throughout the entire map. This is also the case with the [[Cave Monster]]s. The Mondo Chick is the only mob that has a fixed spawn point in the Mountain Top Field. During the soft launch of the [[Egg Hunt 2020]] update, the Mondo Chick only had 250,000 health. It was later changed to 300,000 the following day. If the player already has the Mondo Chick Blessing buff and defeats another Mondo Chick, the new blessing will override the old buff, resetting its timer and possibly degrading or upgrading the buff depending on the time took to defeat the Mondo Chick. * Mondo Chick, [[Stick Nymph]]s and Festive Nymphs are the only mobs in the game that take damage without any things attacking it. * Mondo Chick, Festive Nymphs and [[Robo Party|Party Robots]] are the three mobs in the game that can drop a “blessing” buff. Out of these three, Mondo Chick is the only one to guarantee a blessing buff after defeating it. ** Mondo Chick does not drop the blessing buff in token form, instead it goes directly to the player’s active buffs. * Onett has said on discord that he dislikes Mondo Chick "on a personal level." If the Mondo Chick falls out of the Mountain Top field and into another field, when defeated, the rewards will spawn in that field it was defeated in. However if it dies outside of a field, their drops will form in a ring. As of the Beesmas 2020 update, the Mondo Chick no longer drops {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee}}. * There is a glitch where the Mondo Chick would fall into other areas outside of the [[Mountain Top Field]], such as into the [[Bamboo Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]] or in front of the [[Pro Shop]]. Rarely, the fallen Mondo Chick will not be able to move unless it falls into the [[Pineapple Patch]]. On an even rarer occurrence, the Mondo Chick will get stuck on the tall rocks adjacent to the Lion Bee Gate.

docs.title: Monthly Top Honeymakers
docs.text:
The '''Monthly Top Honeymakers''' is one of the {{WikiVariables|LeaderboardCount}} [[leaderboards]] in the game and is only viewable via the Global Leaderboards menu in the [[System Page]]. This leaderboard shows how much [[honey]] players have collected over the span of 1 month. It shows 10 leaderboard positions at a time. The player can scroll down the leaderboard to see more players, all the way to the 100th place. Only legitimate players appear on the leaderboards for lengths of time (hackers/exploiters will be removed). The leaderboard resets on the 1st day of every month at 12:00 AM, CST.

== Trivia ==

  • This is the only leaderboard in the game to reset every month, unlike the daily leaderboards which reset every day and the all-time leaderboards which doesn't reset. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Leaderboards]]

docs.title: Moon Amulet Generator
docs.text:
[[File:Moon_Amulet_Generator.jpg|thumb|214px|The Moon Amulet Generator.]] The '''Moon Amulet Generator''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] located between [[Spider Field]] and [[Bamboo Field]] that allows the player to generate and/or replace a [[Moon Amulet]]. To use this machine, {{Cost|Moon Charm|100}} are needed to generate a moon amulet.

It can be reached by traversing the [[Obstacle Courses#Bamboo Field Obby|obstacle course]] between the Spider Field and [[Bamboo Field]], by dropping in from above by cannon and using a [[:Category:Gliding Tools|gliding tool]], or by falling off the ramp leading to the [[Lion Bee Gate]] and onto the platform.

Every time the player uses the generator, the capacity buff increases, starting at 25k and increasing by 25k each. This buff stops at the maximum of 250k capacity. However, to obtain the Moon Amulet at its highest potential, the player would have to use the generator 25 times, being when the other (potential) stat boosts max out.

When using the generator, it will say, "🌙 The moon seems to grow brighter... 🌙". If the player has reached the maximum [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|capacity]] [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] (+250k), the chat instead states, "🌙 The moon seems happy! 🌙".

When the player generates a Moon Amulet, the following audio plays:

[[File:MoonAmuletGet.ogg]] [[File:Efde88f1a538b4dad97f6942f1a70f1f.png|thumb|The Moon Amulet Generator at night.]]

== Trivia == * The Moon Amulet Generator glows at [[Day/Night Cycle|night]], although nothing changes mechanically. * The Moon Amulet Generator is one of the 6 amulet generators, the other 5 being the [[Star Amulet|star amulet]] generators in the [[Star Hall]]. * This is the only amulet generator that requires something other than [[honey]] to activate. * This is the only Generator that increases the Capacity Buff and stops at maximum.

{{MapNav}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]]

docs.title: Moon Amulet
docs.text:
[[File:Moon Amulet.png|thumb|150px|The Moon Amulet icon.]] The '''Moon Amulet''' is an [[amulet]] created by spending 100 [[Moon Charm]]s at the [[Moon Amulet Generator]]. This amulet gives a few [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] and allows the player to walk on the moon-shaped platforms (located at the back of [[Dapper Bear’s Shop]], in the [[Obstacle Courses#Diamond Room|Diamond Room]], and at the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone Obby]]) at [[Day/Night Cycle|night]].

Each time the player purchases the amulet, the buffs given tend to improve. The player will always receive a [[capacity]] expansion, which starts at +25,000 capacity and progressively increases by 25,000. The buff is capped off at 250,000 extra capacity.

When using the generator, a message will appear in the chat, saying, "🌙 The moon seems to grow brighter... 🌙." If the player has maxed out their capacity buff, the message will instead say, "🌙 The moon seems happy! 🌙."

When the player generates a Moon Amulet, the following audio plays:

[[File:MoonAmuletGet.ogg]]

== Possible Buffs == [[File:Moon Amulet Generator.jpg|thumb|220px|The Moon Amulet Generator.]][[File:Anmerkung_2020-05-25_135807.png|thumb|A Moon Amulet's stats.]] * +25,000 to +250,000 Capacity (Guaranteed) * +1% to +5% [[Ticket]] Chance (Very Rare) * +1 to +3 [[Movement Collection]] (Very Rare) * One of the following: ** +20% to +50% [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]] ** +3% to +10% [[System Page#Bond From Treats|Bond from Treats]] * One of the following; ** +1% to +5% [[System Page#Pollen|Pollen]] ** +50% to +150% [[Pineapple Patch]] Pollen ** +10% to +25% [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]] ** +2% to +8% [[System Page#Honey Per Pollen|Honey Per Pollen]] ** +1% to +5% [[System Page#Instant Conversion|Instant Conversion]] ** +10% to +20% [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]] ** +5% to +12% [[System Page#Bond From Battle|Bond from Battle]]

== Trivia == [[File:Moon amulet glitch.png|thumb|230px|The Moon Amulet glitch.]] * There's a [[Glitches|glitch]] that when the player upgrades the Moon Amulet for the 7th time, instead of getting +175K capacity, they will get +150K capacity again. However, on the 8th upgrade, it'll go back up to +175K and it continues from there until reaching the max of +250K capacity. * This and the [[King Beetle Amulet]] are the only amulets that don't have different tiers. * Despite the capacity capping at +250K, the quality of the amulet continues to rise for another 10 Moon Amulets generated, meaning that the player will need to generate 25 or more Moon Amulets in order to get the possibility of generating the best amulet. * While the current maximum Honey Per Pollen stat is +8%, it was briefly possible to receive +9%, although this is not possible anymore.

docs.title: Moon Charm
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Moon Charm.png |description=Increases your bond with a bee by 250. }} [[File:RobloxScreenShot20190224_131610641_(2).png|thumb|right|220px|The two types of moon charm tokens: On the left, there is a token that is not glowing, dropped by mobs or mythic meteors. On the right, there is a glowing variant that is dropped during nighttime from fireflies, sparkles, and moon sprouts.|alt=]] A {{Color|Moon Charm}}, when fed to a [[Bees|bee]], raises its [[bond]] by 250. Moon Charms are also used in generating [[Moon Amulet]]s and they are used in crafting of [[glitter]] and the [[Helmet]]. If fed to a [[Radiation|radioactive]] bee, it has a 1/2,500 (0.04%) chance to give that bee a [[Mutation]].

Moon charm tokens last for 10 seconds before disappearing.

==Ways to Obtain== * [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Pineapple|5}} ** {{Cost|Gumdrops|5}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}} * As a reward from [[Memory Match]]es (Every type except Extreme Memory Match and the Winter Memory Match). ** A potential with an increment of 5 in the Memory Match. ** A potential pair with an increment of 10 in the Mega Memory Match. ** Two pairs with increments of 25 in the Night Memory Match. * As a reward from the [[Wind Shrine]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** {{Cost|Waxing Crescent Moon Sticker|||0}} rewards 10 moon charms. ** {{Cost|Petal Wand Sticker|||0}} rewards 10 moon charms.

===Drops=== * As a drop from certain [[Mobs]]: ** [[King Beetle]] and [[Tunnel Bear]] always drop moon charms upon defeat. ** A common outcome from chasing all 11 [[Fireflies]] (Increments of 1, 5, and 10.) ** As a rare drop from [[Mantis]] and [[Stump Snail]]. As a common drop from [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteors]]. A common drop from harvesting [[sparkles]]. A guaranteed drop from a [[Sprout|Moon Sprout]]. Harvesting [[planter]]s in the [[Pineapple Patch]].

===Quests=== * Black Bear rewards moon charms on the following quest: ** Rare Red Clover gives 25 moon charms. ** Red Delicacy gives 50 moon charms. * Spirit Bear rewards moon charms on the following quests: ** The First Offering gives 5 moon charms. ** Rules of The Road gives 10 moon charms. ** Nature's Lessons gives 20 moon charms. ** The Gifts Of Life gives 25 moon charms. ** Out-Questing Questions 25 moon charms. ** Forcefully Friendly gives 25 moon charms. ** Memories of Memories give 30 moon charms. ** Beans Becoming gives 30 moon charms. ** The Ways Of The Winds / The Wind And Its Ways gives 50 moon charms. ** Witness Grandeur gives 50 moon charms. ** Glory Of Goo gives 50 moon charms. ** Beeternity gives 100 moon charms. ** The Sky Over The Stump gives 100 moon charms. ** Spirit Spree gives 150 moon charms. ** Dreams Of Being A Bee gives 200 moon charms. ** Space Oblivion Gives 250 moon charms. ** Echoing Call gives 250 moon charms.

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Redeeming Certain Codes: ** FourYearFiesta (Gives 4 moon charms + other stuff). ** 10mMembers (Gave 10 moon charms + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gives 1 moon charm + other stuff). * A Moon Charm token located in the Beesmas Tree gave 5 Moon Charms. * Purchasing the Night Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] granted 25 moon charms. * By opening certain Gift Boxes: ** The Midnight Gift Box gave 20 moon charms during Beesmas 2021. |}

==Crafting Uses== Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Moon Charm|114}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Moon Charm}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |1 |{{Cost|Honey|30,000}}{{Cost|Pineapple|5}} |[[File:Helmet.png|center|80px|link=Helmet]][[Helmet]] |- |3 |{{Cost|Honey|1,000,000}}{{Cost|Blueberry|50}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}} |[[File:Blue Guard.png|center|80px|link=Blue Guard]][[Blue Guard]] |- |5 |{{Cost|Honey|300,000}} |[[File:Hasty Guard.png|center|80px|link=Hasty Guard]][[Hasty Guard]] |- |5 |{{Cost|Honey|2,500,000}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|25}}{{Cost|Pineapple|100}} |[[File:Propeller Hat.png|center|80px|link=Propeller Hat]][[Propeller Hat]] |- |10 |{{Cost|Honey|250,000,000}}{{Cost|Glitter|3}}{{Cost|Soft Wax|3}} |[[File:Porcelain Port-O-Hive.png|center|80px|link=Porcelain Port-O-Hive]][[Porcelain Port-O-Hive]] |- |15 |{{Cost|Honey|5,000,000}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|3}}{{Cost|Blueberry|50}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|5}} |[[File:Elite Blue Guard.png|center|80px|link=Elite Blue Guard]][[Elite Blue Guard]] |- |25 |{{Cost|Magic Bean|1}} |[[File:Glitter.png|center|80px|link=Glitter]]{{Color|Glitter}} |- |75 |{{Cost|Honey|30,000,000}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|10}}{{Cost|Blueberry|100}}{{Cost|Glue|5}} |[[File:Bucko Guard.png|center|80px|link=Bucko Guard]][[Bucko Guard]] |- |100 |N/A |[[File:Moon Amulet.png|center|80px|link=Bucko Guard]][[Moon Amulet]] |}

==Trivia== *This item is one of the 8 things that can have a glowing token, the others being [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]], {{i|Festive Blessing}}{{Color|Festive Blessing|Festive Blessing Tokens}}, {{i|Beesmas Cheer}}{{Color|Beesmas Cheer|Beesmas Cheer Tokens}}, [[Ability Tokens#Map Corruption|Map Corruption]], as well as {{Cost|Glitter}}, {{Cost|Night Bell}}, {{Cost|Star Jelly}}, and {{Cost|Star Treat}} tokens (as exceptionally rare drops from [[fireflies]]). {{Inventory}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Treats]]

''Due to the leaderboard's removal, this can't be updated anymore.)'' The '''Most Commando Captures Leaderboard''' was a [[Leaderboards|leaderboard]] located in [[Commando Chick's Hideout]]. This leaderboard showed how many [[Commando Chick]]s players have captured. It displayed 10 leaderboard positions at one time. The player could have scrolled down the leaderboard to see more players, all the way to the 100th place.

==Trivia== This and [[Top Brown Bear Helpers]] are the only leaderboards where the player cannot see how much of the objective they have obtained. This leaderboard, the [[Fastest Crab Slayers]] leaderboard, the Most Damage Done to a Single Puffshroom, and the Top Brown Bear Helpers are the only leaderboards that hang on a wall. * This leaderboard was removed a day after it was added due to a glitch, where Commando Chicks would instantly respawn. Instead of resetting everyone's progress, the leaderboard was hidden. This and the [[Highest Snowbear Level]] leaderboard are the only leaderboards that have been removed from the game. This also was the first leaderboard to be removed from the game. This is the shortest-lived feature in the game. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Leaderboards]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Removed Content]]

'''Mother Bear''' is a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]], and one of the eight permanent quest [[bear]]s that can be accessed, the others being [[Black Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], [[Science Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Polar Bear]], and [[Spirit Bear]]. Her quests are focused on [[Bond|leveling]] up the player's [[bees]] and feeding them [[treats]]. She is located below the red-and-white-striped awning at the far end of the [[Sunflower Field]], next to the [[Strawberry Field]] and [[Mushroom Field]].

Each time she introduces a new treat to feed to the player's bees, she tells them which bees love the treat. Mother Bear gives a {{Cost|Star Egg|4=0}} near the end of questline and a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}} at the end.

==Dialogue== Mother Bear gives a lot of information in her quest dialogues. Some of the information she gives is not found anywhere else in-game. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Quest Name !Dialogue |- |Treat Tutorial | Hello there new beekeeper! I'm Mother Bear, pleased to meet you. My cubs are away at camp, but I still can't help but feel a need to nurture! I've taken to caring for the bees of this mountain as if they were my own children. I'm going to teach you all about Bee Leveling, and the bond you share with your bees. Your bees are more than just honey-making tools you know. They have emotions too! As they grow closer to you, they become better workers. As their bond with you increases, they level up. Higher level bees gather more pollen and produce more honey. They also have more energy, move faster, and can defend you from higher level monsters! You can increase your bond with a bee by gathering pollen from fields they like... From defeating bugs and monsters... And from giving them [Treats]! Here's a [Treat] so you can test it out. Go to your hive and drag the [Treat] from the Egg menu to the slot of the bee you'd like to feed it to. Their bond with you will immediately increase by 10! Click on a bee's slot in the hive to see information about that bee. You can see how much bond you need to level it up to the next level! When you've done that, come back and I'll have a reward for you!

''-During-''

To feed a [Treat] to a bee, first go to your hive. Open your Egg menu, and drag the [Treat] to the slot of the bee you'd like to feed it to. When you've done that, come back to me for a reward!

''-Completion-''

Yes! Exactly like that! Just look how happy that made your little bee. It's begun to warm up to you. It even advanced to level 2! Each level increases the stats of your bees. If you want more treats, you can purchase them with honey from the machine to your left. Keep working to increase your bond with your bees and you could become a Top Honeymaker! Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on caring for bees. |- |Bonding With Bees |Different types of bees have different tastes. They have fields they like, and also fields they dislike. When gathering pollen from a field they like, they are more likely to increase their bond with you! You can see when a bee's bond increases - look for small pink numbers that pop up by your bees. Gathering from fields a bee likes and giving it treats will make it happier. Happier bees move and grow faster! Your next quest is to raise 1 bee to level 3... Raise 2 bees to level 2... And feed 5 [Treats] to your bees!

''-During-''

When bees become happier or sadder, they'll show it to you. They express their emotions with little smiley face bubbles! You can't please all your bees all the time, so don't worry too much if some are sad. They'll cheer up when you move around. Come back when you've raised 1 bee to level 3... Raised 2 bees to level 2... And fed 3 [Treats] to your bees.

''-Completion-''

Your bees are really becoming attached to you! They care about you so much they even fight to defend you. Raising the levels of your bees will become more important as you move up the mountain. If your bees are lower level than the bugs and monsters, their attacks may miss! Keeping your bees appropriately leveled will allow them to defend you. Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on caring for bees. |- |Search For A Sunflower Seed |Some treats are more special than others. If you're lucky, you may find rare treats hidden in the fields. You may even receive them from a bug you defeat! For your next lesson, I want you to find a [Sunflower Seed] and feed it to a bee! You can find [Sunflower Seeds] right here in the Sunflower Field. They'll occasionally pop out of the flowers as you collect pollen. They are quite rare, so it could take a while!

-During-

There's no telling exactly how long it can take you to find [Sunflower Seed]. ''[sic]'' But when you do, it'll look like a light blue token. Come back when you've raised 3 Bees to level 3 and fed 1 [Sunflower Seed] to a bee.

''-Completion-''

Oh, wonderful! How long did that take? Each type of bee prefers a different special treat. Basic, Bomber, Looker, Demo, Commander, and Ninja Bee all love [Sunflower Seeds] the most. Feed one to them, and they'll gain twice as much bond! Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on caring for bees. |- |The Gist of Jellies |There are many different types of bees you know! Each bee has it's ''[sic]'' own traits, abilities and personality. One way to obtain bees of different types is to transform them with [Royal Jelly]! When you transform a bee, they retain their level and bond, but their other stats change. Why don't you give it a try? You can find [Royal Jellies] around the map. You can also receive them as rewards for Brown Bear's quests. But I'll give you one to get you started! Come back when you've raised 3 bees to level 4, fed 15 [Treats] to yours bees, and used 1 [Royal Jelly]. ''-During-''

Brown Bear lives near the Clover Field. Once a day ''[sic]'', he can give you 1 quest that'll reward you with a [Royal Jelly]! Come back when you've raised 2 ''[sic]'' bees to level 4... Fed 10 [Treats] to your bees... And used 1 [Royal Jelly].

''-Completion-''

Exciting, isn't it! You never know what your bee will transform into when you give it a [Royal Jelly]. But keep in mind you might not always like the result! Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on raising bees. |- |Search for Strawberries |Let's talk about my personal favorite treat: [Strawberries]! They're not only delicious and sweet - they're also healthy and raise your bond with a bee by 25. [Strawberries] can be found in the Strawberry Field. Also, if you're lucky, Ladybugs sometimes drop a [Strawberry] when you defeat them. I know many types of bees love [Strawberries] as much as I do... Rascal, Rad, Rage, Riley, Baby, and Shy Bee all love [Strawberries] more than any other treat! When you feed one to them, they gain twice as much bond, and even have a tiny chance to become Gifted! For this lesson, I want you to feed 20 [Treats] and 5 [Strawberries] to your bees. In addition, raise 1 bee to level 5 and 5 bees to level 4. ''-During-''

You can find [Strawberries] in the Strawberry Field or from defeating Ladybugs. They're the favorite treat of Rascal, Rad, Rage, Riley, Baby, and Shy Bee! Come back when you've fed 20 [Treats] and 5 [Strawberries] to your bees... and raised 1 bee to level 5 and 5 bees to level 4.

''-Completion-''

The [Strawberries] around here are always ripe and delicious! In fact, this whole mountain is rich and full of life! I attribute that to all the wonderful bees and their caring beekeepers like you. Remember, try to feed your [Strawberries] to a bee who really appreciates them. Rascal, Rad, Rage, Riley, Baby, and Shy Bee all get twice as much bond out of [Strawberries]! Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on raising bees. |- |Binging on Blueberries |[Blueberries] are a little hard to find, but they grow in more places. If you're lucky, you can find them in any field that has mostly blue flowers. Rhino Beetles may also drop [Blueberries]. [Blueberries] are definitely worth the hassle, though. They're the favorite treat of Bumble, Cool, Bubble, Frosty, Bucko, Diamond, and Music Bee! For this lesson, raise 3 bees to level 5 and feed 10 [Blueberries] and 30 [Treats] to your bees. ''-During-''

[Blueberries] can be found in the Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, and Pine Tree Forest. You can also sometimes obtain them from defeating Rhino Beetles. They're the favorite treat of Bumble, Cool, Bubble, Frosty, Bucko, Diamond, and Music Bee! For this lesson, raise 3 bees to level 5 and feed 10 [Blueberries] and 30 [Treats] to your bees.

''-Completion-''

Very well done! You ''[sic] ''bees look so pleased, I bet they loved those juicy [Blueberries]! Remember, try to feed your [Blueberries] to the bees who really love them. Bumble, Cool, Bubble, Frosty, Bucko, Diamond, and Music Bee all get ×2 bond out of [Blueberries]! Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on raising bees. |- |Royal Jelly Jamboree |Have you heard of Gifted Bees? They're very rare and incredibly useful! They look similar to ordinary bees, but they've got beautiful star patterns on them! They also come in unique colors that make them stand out! They collect 50% more pollen and make honey 50% faster than non-Gifted bees. And most importantly, they offer Hive Bonuses that enhance the power of your entire swarm! For example, a Gifted Cool Bee increases all blue pollen you receive by 10%. That's a big deal! You can receive Gifted Bees when hatching or transforming bees. A bee also has a small chance to become gifted if you feed it its favorite treat! There are even special eggs and items that guarantee a Gifted Bee. But we'll talk more about those later... Here's your next lesson: Feed 50 [Treats] to your bees... Raise 1 bee to level 6 and 5 bees to level 5... And use 3 [Royal Jellies]! ''-During-''

Are you a member of the Bee Swarm Simulator Club? If you are, there's a special Treat Dispenser near the Pro Bear's shop that's very helpful! Once and ''[sic]'' hour, it can give you [Treats] free of charge. The more bees you have, the more [Treats] you get! They may be useful for this lesson: Feed 50 [Treats] to your bees... Raise 1 bee to level 6... ''[sic] '' And use 3 [Royal Jellies]!

''-Completion-''

Your bees are absolutely enamored with you! I'm convinced you're one of the most caring beekeepers I've ever met yet... And believe me I've met a lot! If you can complete my next 3 lessons, I'll give you something special! Here's a hint: it has to do with Gifted Bees. |- |Search for Sunflower Seeds | As you progress up the mountain, you'll need higher level bees to defend you! Higher level monsters are able to avoid the attacks of lower level bees. If you see the word "MISS" hover above a monsters ''[sic]'' head, that means your bees are underleveled. Keep this in mind before venturing beyond the 15 Bee gate! For this lesson, I want you to raise 3 ''[sic]'' bees to level 6. This will allow them to defend you from the level 6 Werewolf ''[sic]'' who defends that area. I'd also like you to feed 25 [Sunflower Seeds] to your bees. I've heard Werewolves tend to drop those! (-Missing dialogue) ''-During-''

You can see how much damage your bees are dealing with enemies as red numbers over the target's head. If you see the word "MISS", that means your bee is lower level than the enemy! The higher the monster's level, the more likely a lower level bee's attack will miss. This means it's very important to keep your bees leveled up as you venture to more dangerous areas! For this lesson, I want you to level 6 ''[sic] ''bees to level 6 and feed 25 [Sunflower Seeds] to your bees. ''[sic]''

''-Completion-''

Your bees radiate pure joy - you can tell they are truly loved! They love you so much that they fight extra hard to defend you! I feel like you've proven yourself to be a truly caring beekeeper. From now on, I'll give you [Royal Jellies] every time you complete one of my lessons! Come talk to me again when you're ready for the next. |- |Picking out Pineapples |[Pineapple] is one of the most popular treats around! Brave, Hasty, Shocked, Exhausted, Honey, Fire, Lion, and Demon Bee all love it the most! That makes sense when you consider it's as sweet has''[sic]'' honey! You can obtain it from the [[Pineapple Patch|Pineapple Field]], but also as a rare drop from a variety of monsters: [[Scorpion]]s, [[Mantis]]es, and [[Spider]]s have all been known to occasionally drop [Pineapple]. Which is odd because I don't think they eat it... Here's your next lesson: Raise 1 bee to level 7, 8 bees to level 6, and 12 bees to level 5... And feed 250 [Treats] and 25 [Pineapples] to your bees! ''-During-''

Oh, I forgot to mention! The [[Treat Dispenser]] by the [[Pro Shop|Pro Bear's]] shop also gives 1 Pineapple every time you use it. That may come in handy with completing this lesson: Raise 1 bee to level 7, 8 bees to level 6, and 12 bees to level 5... And feed 250 [Treats] and 25 [Pineapples] to your bees!

''-Completion-''

Oh good, you've finished! How did your bees like those [Pineapples]? They've got a strong flavor so they're not for everyone! Hopefully you've been feeding the special treats to the right bees. Brave, Hasty, Shocked, Exhausted, Honey, Fire, Lion, and Demon Bee all LOVE [Pineapple]! You get twice as much bond out of a treat if you feed it to a bee who loves it! You can tell they're appreciating the treat if it gives you an alert after feeding like this: "☺️ Brave Bee loves Pineapple ☺️" It really speeds up the leveling process. Come talk to me again when you're ready for another lesson on raising bees. |- |Seven to Seven |Your bees are growing up beautifully! Your love for them really shows! As a reward, I've got something special in store for you... A [Star Egg]! It's a special egg that always hatches into a Gifted Bee. Gifted Bees are special versions of other bees with increased stats. They also come in beautiful colors that really set them apart! The first Gifted Bee of each type increases the performance of your entire hive. If you can finish this quest, I'll gladly give you this [Star Egg]. Feed 25 [Blueberries], 25 [Strawberries], and 500 [Treats] to your bees... And raise 7 bees to level 7!

''-During-''

Gifted Bees are the hardest working bees out there! They've been touched with inspiration, and that inspires all other bees to work hard as well! We're truly lucky to have them on this mountain! Come back when you've fed 25 [Blueberries], 25 [Strawberries], and 500 [Treats] to your bees... And raised 7 bees to level 7. After that I'll give you a [Star Egg]!

''-Completion-''

Oooh! I knew you could do it! I'm so thrilled - now I can give you this [Star Egg]. A [Star Egg] always hatches into a Gifted Bee you don't already have. Don't underestimate the power of Gifted Bees! They off much more than just their unique looks. The first gifted bee you obtain of each type grants you a Hive Bonus. This is a special perk that applies to your ENTIRE swarm, and in some cases even to you! For example, a Gifted Basic Bee increases ALL pollen you gain by 20%! That makes it one of the most useful bees in the world! It's definitely worth the hassle to obtain Gifted Bees. I'm so excited to see which one this [Star Egg] hatches into! |- |Mother Bear's Midterm |You and your bees already share an unbreakable bond! But there is always room for more love. If you're willing to go the extra mile and complete these next 4 lessons... I'll reward you with a [Star Treat]! [Star Treats] are the most delicious treat known to beekind. Feed one to a bee, and it immediately becomes a Gifted Bee! This is incredibly useful because it lets you choose a Gifted bee you really want. Here's the first of 4 lessons: Raise 3 bees to level 8, 9 bees to level 7, and 15 bees to level 6... Feed 30 [Sunflower Seeds], [Pineapples], [Strawberries], and [Blueberries] to your bees... And feed 1000 [Treats] to your bees!

''-During-''

[Star Treats] are one of the most valuable things in the world! In the [[Ticket Tent]], they are a whopping 1000 Tickets!!! But there are 3 [Star Treats] that you can obtain for free, as far as I know: The 1st, of course, is my [Star Treat]! The 2nd belongs to the [[Panda Bear]]. He tries to hide it, but I know he's got one hidden away... The 3rd and final [Star Treat] can be received from Onett, the developer of this game! I've heard he's working on something beyond the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Gate]]... If you want my [Star Treat], first I'll need you to do the following: Raise 3 bees to level 8, 9 bees to level 7, and 15 bees to level 6... Feed 30 [Sunflower Seeds], [Pineapples], [Strawberries], and [Blueberries] to your bees... And feed 1000 [Treats] to your bees!

''-Completion-''

Fantastic job! Oh, by the way, I forgot to mention... Now that you have a Gifted Bee, you should check out the [[Star Hall]]! It's a special place dedicated to Gifted Bees located above the Noob Bear's shop. The easiest way to get there is to use a Glider from the top of the mountain. Inside, you'll find a free Royal Jelly dispenser! Once a day, you can claim a Royal Jelly for every Gifted Bee type you have! If you fill your hive with Gifted Bees of many types, you'll get tons of jellies that way! 3 more quests and I'll give you my [Star Treat]... |- |Eight to Eight |There are different ways to obtain special treats. The most obvious way is to search for them in the appropriate flower fields. In addition, bugs and monsters have a small chance of dropping special treats when they're defeated. But one of the most reliable ways to obtain special treats is to participate in challenges. The Ant Challenge grants many special treats - the higher you score, the more you get! ==Trivia== She, Brown Bear, and [[Onett]] are the only quest givers to give out [[Ticket|tickets]] in all non-event Quests. She is the first female bear added to the game. She and Spirit Bear are the only female bears in the game. She, Panda Bear, Brown Bear, and Onett are the only quest givers to give a star treat. She is the first permanent bear released in an [[Updates|Update]], before Spirit Bear. Mother Bear gives {{Cost|Ticket|65}} in total. She also gives a total of 19,438,250 [[honey]] throughout her quests. Like Dapper Bear, Mother Bear uses the [https://web.roblox.com/catalog/619520125/Stylish-Animation-Pack Stylish Animation Pack]. Mother Bear, when giving the player the "Search for Sunflower Seeds" quest, tells the player to get 3 bees to level 6 even though the quest requires 6 level 6 bees. Also, when receiving the "Search for Sunflower Seeds" quest, she mentions that the [[Werewolf]] is level 6 when it is actually level 7. This is because the werewolf was level 6 when Mother Bear was introduced to the game but was Leveled up to level 7 later on. Both of these have been fixed. Mother Bear mentions in the "Mother Bear's Midterm" quest that the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] gives one [[royal jelly|Royal Jelly]] per gifted bee type when it actually gives one {{Cost|Royal Jelly|}} per Gifted Bee in the Player's Hive. This is because it gave one royal jelly per gifted bee type when Mother Bear was added but was changed to one royal jelly per gifted bee later on. She is the first bear to give quests about leveling bees, using royal jelly, and feeding treats to bees. Excluding her and Panda Bear's Ornament Quest, she, [[Gummy Bear]], Panda Bear, and [[Honey Bee (NPC)]] are the only quest givers so far to not give quests that include collecting [[pollen]]. She is self-aware that she is in a [[Bee Swarm Simulator|Roblox game]], along with Panda Bear, [[Bee Bear]], Black Bear, Science Bear, and Spirit Bear, stating in “Mother Bear's Midterm", that the quest-giving Onett is the developer of the game. She, Black Bear, and Brown Bear were "nice" during the 2018 Beesmas Event, as stated by Bee Bear. During the [[Ready Player Two]] event, Mother Bear's conclusion dialogue is changed, as she got ''the strangest text''. The text is a riddle for one of the codes that give the 7-Pronged-Cog, used to craft the Strange Goggles and do the puzzles. She is the only quest bear who (outside of event quests) never asks the player to collect pollen OR defeat mobs. {{Cost|Honey|}} Bee and [[Egg Hunt Info]] are the only other quest-givers who do not require these. Like [[Dapper Bear]] and [[Gummy Bee]], Mother Bear's face decal emits light. This is most noticeable if the player looks at the glass behind Mother Bear at night or if they transform into Mother Bear using a [[Bear Bee|Gifted Bear Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]] or a code and walk into a dark place such as the [[Werewolf's Cave]]. *She is the only quest bear in the [[Starter Zone]] to not have any extensions/changes to their permanent quests.

docs.text:
{{Field |fieldcolor = Red/Blue |bees = 25 |width = 24 |height = 28 |image = MountainTopField2024.png }} The '''Mountain Top Field''' is a [[Fields|field]] located past the [[Lion Bee Gate]]. The [[Mondo Chick]] protects this field and respawns roughly every hour.

This is a 24×28 field, containing 672 [[flowers]]. The flowers are red and blue, and the natural size is triple.

{ class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" White ! colspan="2" Red ! colspan="2" Blue ! colspan="2" Total - !Single 0 ''0%'' 0 ''0%'' 0 ''0%'' 0 '''''0%''''' - !Double 0 ''0%'' 0 ''0%'' 0 ''0%'' 0 '''''0%''''' - !Triple 0 ''0%'' 336 ''50%'' 336 ''50%'' 672 '''''100%''''' - !Total '''0''' '''''0%''''' '''336''' '''''50%''''' '''336''' '''''50%''''' '''672''' '''''100%''''' } '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Red Boost]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Blue Boost]], [[Honey]], [[Magic Bean]], [[Ticket]], [[Bitterberry]], and [[Neonberry]] Tokens while collecting pollen.

[[Bees]] that like the Mountain Top Field are [[Basic Bee]], [[Looker Bee]], [[Frosty Bee]], [[Honey Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]], [[Digital Bee]], [[Festive Bee]] and [[Gummy Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Mountain Top Field are [[Carpenter Bee]] and [[Demon Bee]].

This field grants Invigorating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

A level 6-8 [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has a chance of spawning here.

A level 1-20 [[Wild Windy Bee]] has a chance of spawning here.

== Obtaining Boosts== Using [[Glitter]] will add 100% Mountain Top Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the boost isn't already maxed out. Using [[Field Dice]], [[Smooth Dice]], or [[Loaded Dice]] may add +100% Mountain Top Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't maxed out yet. Mountain Top [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Mountain Top Field conversion and give +5% instant Mountain Top Field conversion and +10% Mountain Top Field pollen for each stack. Mountain Top Field can stack up to a total of 13 times. Redeeming certain valid codes: ThreeBeeVee (Gives Mountain Top Field Boost x3, Mountain Top Field Capacity x3, and Mountain Top Field Code + other stuff). ===The methods below are no longer possible.=== Giving a [[Present]] to [[Onett]] in 2020 gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 and other boosts and [[items]]. In 2021 and 2024, he gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 and other boosts and items. Purchasing a Mountain Top Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] or certain codes will give x1.5 Mountain Top [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Mountain Top Field Pollen, +25% [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]]. *Redeeming certain expired codes: Keen4 (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). 3YearParty (Gives Mountain Top Field Boost x3, Mountain Top Field Capacity x3, and Mountain Top Field Market Boost + other stuff). 100mVisits (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). Xanthan (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). Whoops (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). SaleEnd (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). Reboots (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x4 + other stuff). MegaMittens (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). PuppyPerk (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 + other stuff). SunBearSendoff (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). 12HourGeneral (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 + other stuff). Waiting (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). 1mFavorites (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 + other stuff). MagicMittens (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 + other stuff). SDMittens1T (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 + other stuff). TallTallMountain (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x2 + other stuff). BloxyCelebration (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). WindyWeekend (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 and Mountain Top Field Winds x3 + other stuff). RebootCheer (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 and Mountain Top Field Winds x3 + other stuff). 2Years (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 + other stuff). 2YearsAfterParty (Gave Mountain Top Field Capacity x3 and Mountain Top Field Market Boost + other stuff). SpaceReboot (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x3 and Mountain Top Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). BillionVisits (Gave Mountain Top Field Winds x10 + other stuff). MondoOutage (Gave Mountain Top Field Code Buff + other stuff). FrozenBugReboot (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x4 and Mountain Top Field Code Buff + other stuff). 1MLikes (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x1 + other stuff) BlackReboot (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x4 and Mountain Top Field Winds x15 + other stuff) **BeequipTradeReboot (Gave Mountain Top Field Boost x4, and Mountain Top Field Winds x15 + other stuff). ==Gallery== Mountain Top Field Icon.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. Hivesticker mountain top field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|field stamp]].

==Trivia== This is the only field that doesn't produce [[treats]] from farming. However, harvesting [[sprout]]s in the Mountain Top Field will still drop normal rewards. Leaves in this field are more rare, and always either spawn bitterberries, [[aphid]]s, or a [[Sticker]]. This was the only field that wasn't targeted by the [[Gummy Cannon]] during the [[:Category:Gummy Invasion|Gummy Invasion]] event. (The [[Stump Field]], [[Coconut Field]], [[Pepper Patch]], and the [[Ant Field]] were not in the game at that time.) The Mountain Top Field and the Ant Field were the only two fields that did not have their own [[badges]]. This was changed in the 1/12/2024 Update, when the Mountain Top Field received a [[Badges|badge]], thus making the Ant Field the only field without a badge. *This is the first field that consists of only triple flowers, the second being the Stump Field, the third and fourth being the Pepper Patch and the Coconut Field. This is also the only field without any white flowers. Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], the [[Red Cannon]] required 22 discovered [[Bees|bee]] types, but now it requires 25 instead, so the player can't bypass the Lion Bee Gate without 25 bees or 25 bee types discovered. After the 9/28/2019 update, even by bypassing the Lion Bee Gate with 25 bee types discovered but not 25 bees, the player will be teleported back to spawn. Out of all the fields in the game, the Mountain Top Field requires the most amount of pollen to unlock its Grandmaster badge, at a grand total of {{texttip|10 quadrillion|10,000,000,000,000,000}} pollen. *The Mountain Top Field is the only field that cannot be boosted without the help of items or codes. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Fields]] [[Category:Locations]]

docs.title: Movement Collection
docs.text:
[[File:Moon amulet movement collection.png|thumb|A moon amulet with the movement collection buff.]] '''Movement Collection''' is a type of boost that allows the player to collect [[pollen]] when walking on [[flowers]]. The higher the movement collection, the greater amount of pollen the player collects from walking on flowers. This boost also collects [[goo]] if the player walks on any goo patches.

== Ways to Increase == The player can get this boost from wearing [[:Category:Boots|boots]] or from a [[Moon Amulet]].

  • The Moon Amulet can give from +1 Movement Collection to +3 Movement Collection.
  • Boots: ** The [[Basic Boots]] give +2 Movement Collection. ** The [[Hiking Boots]] give +6 Movement Collection. ** The [[Beekeeper's Boots]] give +10 Movement Collection. ** The [[Coconut Clogs]] give +14 Movement Collection. ** The [[Gummy Boots]] give +16 Movement Collection.

== Trivia == * Movement Collection isn't shown in the [[System Page]], unlike most other boosts, such as [[Loot Luck]] and [[Instant Conversion]]. If the player has movement collection on their Moon Amulet, they can still collect pollen even without boots equipped. The maximum Movement Collection a player can have is 19. This can be achieved by having a Gummy Boots (+16) and a Moon Amulet (+3).

docs.text:
{{Field |image = MushroomField2021Beesmas.png |fieldcolor = Red |bees = None |width = 32 |height = 23}} The '''Mushroom Field''' is one of the five [[Starter Zone|starting]] [[fields]] any player is able to visit upon starting the game. It is the first [[:Category:Red|red]] field accessible to players in the game. The field is protected by a level 1 [[ladybug]].

This is a 32x23 field made up of 736 [[flowers]]. The flowers are red and white, in sizes of single and double. {| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Red ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |211 |''{{Hover|28.7%|28.66%}}'' |453 |''{{Hover|61.5%|61.55%}}'' |0 |''0%'' |'''664''' |'''''{{Hover|90.2%|90.22%}}''''' |- !Double |21 |''{{Hover|2.9%|2.85%}}'' |51 |''{{Hover|6.9%|6.93%}}'' |0 |''0%'' |'''72''' |'''''{{Hover|9.8%|9.78%}}''''' |- !Triple |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |'''0''' |'''''0%''''' |- !Total |'''232''' |'''''{{Hover|31.5%|31.52%}}''''' |'''504''' |'''''{{Hover|68.5%|68.48%}}''''' |'''0''' |'''''0%''''' |'''736''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[treat]], [[strawberry]], [[bitterberry]], [[ticket]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|red boost]], [[honey]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], and [[Red Extract|red extract]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

Bees that like the Mushroom Field include [[Rad Bee]], [[Rascal Bee]], [[Fire Bee]], [[Riley Bee]], [[Baby Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], and [[Festive Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Mushroom Field include [[Bumble Bee]], [[Frosty Bee]], [[Shocked Bee]], and [[Ninja Bee]].

This field gives Motivating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

== Obtaining Boosts== Using the [[Red Field Booster]] may give a Mushroom [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +300% Mushroom Field pollen for 15 minutes. Using [[glitter]] in the field will add 100% Mushroom Field pollen onto the current boost if the boost isn't already maxed out. Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - +300% Mushroom Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out and based on the type used. * Mushroom [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Mushroom Field conversion and give +5% instant Mushroom Field conversion and +25% Mushroom Field pollen for each stack. Mushroom Field Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times. It can be boosted by the [[King Beetle Amulet]]. If it has a Mushroom Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +100%.

===The methods below are no longer possible.=== Giving a [[present]] to certain NPCs: [[Gifted Riley Bee]] gave Mushroom Field Boost x3 and other boosts and [[items]]. [[Onett]] gave Mushroom Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. [[Bubble Bee Man]] gave Mushroom Field Boost x4 and other boosts and items during Beesmas 2021. Completing [[Gifted Riley Bee#Egg Hunt 2019 Quest|Gifted Riley Bee's Egg Hunt 2019 Quest]] gave Mushroom Field Boost x7 (although the boost only went up to x5) and other items. Purchasing a Mushroom Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Mushroom [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Mushroom Field Pollen, x1.1 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]]. Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Nonchalant (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** AccentMaster (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x1 + other stuff). MischiefMaker (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x 6 +other stuff). ** RoyalRobzi (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x5 + other stuff). 12HourGeneral (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x3 + other stuff). 1mFavorites (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ClubParty (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x6 + other stuff). RedCatBee (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x3 + other stuff). PingBoost (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** BloxyBoost (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x5 + other stuff). Breeze (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x3 + other stuff). Buzzy (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x3 and Mushroom Field Winds x3 + other stuff). ** ClubBasket (Gave Mushroom Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** WonkyFlop (Gives Mushroom Field Boost x4, Mushroom Field Winds x10 + other stuff). ** Dysentery (Activates Mushroom Field Code Buff + other stuff) ==Gallery== Mushroom Field Icon.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. Hivesticker mushroom field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]]. ==Trivia== * There is a small [[Obstacle Courses#Mushroom Field Obby|parkour course]] in the Mushroom Field that can be done to obtain a royal jelly. The [[Bubble Wand]] model on top of the [[Blue HQ]] can occasionally grow a face and blow [[sparkles]] onto this field, along with the [[Blue Flower Field|Blue Flower]], [[Clover Field|Clover]], and [[Dandelion Field]]. [[Stick Bug]] is found on the tallest mushroom, along with the [[Top Stick Bug Fighters]] leaderboard. This is where the player can start the [[Stick Bug Challenge]] if they have given Stick Bug a [[translator]]. After the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]] was released, Stick Bug would sometimes fall off the tallest mushroom and land in or near the [[Dandelion Field]]. This was a visual [[Glitches#Onett/Stick Bug/Mondo Chick Falling|glitch]] and didn't affect gameplay. This glitch was patched a few days after the update. This is one of the two fields in the Starter Zone with a Ladybug in it, the other being the Clover Field. *The [[Sticker|Yellow Walking Wiggly Person sticker]] cannot spawn in this field.

docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Music_Bee.png |image-gifted = MusicBee Gifted.png |description = This bee's buzz is so beautiful it can bring anyone to tears. It uses this gift to motivate others. |rarity = Legendary |color = Colorless |energy = 20 |speed = 16.1 |attack = 1 |skincolor1 = #1b2a35 |skincolor2 = #f1f1f1 |skincolor3 = #1b2a35 }}'''Music Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bee]].

Music Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Blueberry}}.

Music Bee likes the [[Clover Field]] and the [[Dandelion Field]]. It dislikes the [[Cactus Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 16 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 240 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * +15% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +6 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +160 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]]. * 🌟[[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +25% [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Pollen From Bee Gathering]].

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Melody|[Melody]]]''' Grants +100% [[System Page#Critical Power|Critical Power]] for 30 seconds. Critical Power increases the pollen and damage of critical hits. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Focus|[Focus]]]''' Grants +3% [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]] for 20 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times. Critical hits increase pollen and damage by 100%. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Token Link|[Token Link]]]''' Collects all other [[Ability Tokens]], granting {{Cost|Honey|25}} (+10 per Level) per token collected.

{{Stat|pollen = 16|pollentime = 4|honey = 240|honeytime = 4|rarity = legendary}}

== Gallery == MusicBee Hive.png|Music Bee's old hive slot design. Gifted Music Bee hive.png|A Gifted Music Bee hive slot. A049E73A-E595-424B-BF29-12C641AAD6F1.jpeg|A Melody token. == Trivia == * This bee and [[Carpenter Bee]] are the only Legendary bees added in an [[Updates|update]]. * It has a tail that symbolizes a quaver, also known as an eighth note. ** In musical notation terms, its face is a slur between an eighth note and a dotted quarter note. ** These are also known as a quaver and a dotted crotchet. * Music bee is the only legendary bee with 3 abilities. * Despite it being colorless, it favors blueberries. ** This makes it the only non-[[:Category:Blue|Blue]] bee to like blueberries. * Music Bee and [[Shocked Bee]] have the same skin pattern. * This is the only bee that generates a melody token without beequips. However, some bees can generate a melody token if they have the [[Toy Horn|toy horn]] or [[Kazoo]] beequips equipped to them. * A [[Royal Jelly#Specific Bee Jelly|Special Jelly]] that changes a bee into a Music Bee could be obtained by opening the [[Ornament Presents|Funky Present]] during the [[Updates#2019.12.23|Beesmas 2019 event]]. However, as the event has ended, the jelly was unobtainable until the Beesmas 2020 event where it could be purchased in the Beesmas Tree Bundle along with 5 [[Festive Bean]]s, and a [[Beesmas Tree Hat]] [[Beequip]]. Previously, you could of gotten this jelly from the Percussive Bundle from the Summer 2024 Bee Bear's Catalog. * The Music Bee Egg can be obtained from the Musical Mega-Bundle.
