docs.title: Mutation
docs.text:
[[File:191B4FCF-52DD-47BF-8AF7-8C0E07E6EEBB.jpeg|frame|An example of a mutated bee's hive slot. Note that the number depicting the bee's level is colored.]] '''Mutations''' are a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that buffs the [[stats]] of certain [[bees]] in the player’s [[hive]]. Mutated bees have a different colored [[Bond|level]] number in their [[Hive Slot|hive slot]] and on their wings than the standard white, respective to what stat it's mutated with. A mutated bee can become temporarily [[Radiation|radioactive]], and the radiation can spread to neighboring bees in the hive.

Every time the player feeds a bee a [[bitterberry]], it has a 1 in 1,000 chance to get a random mutation. All [[treats|Fruits]] have a 1 in 25,000 chance, if the bee is radioactive. If the bee is radioactive, the chances when using a bitterberry are increased to a 1 in 100 chance, and [[Royal Jelly|royal jellies]], [[Moon Charm|moon charms]], [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|star jellies]], and special treats have a chance of making the bee mutated. [[Atomic Treat|Atomic treats]] guarantee a mutation when fed to a bee, regardless of whether it is radioactive or not.

A mutated bee's GUI on discovery shows a pop-up to the left of the bee, which shows the player the mutation the bee has gained, with a text box reading, {{Notification|Honey|☢️ {Bee type} gained a mutation! (+x% [Mutation Buff]) ☢️|17}}

==Possible Bee Bonuses == ''(The "x's" shown below are numbers that indicates the value on the Mutation Stats. Note that there are '''x%''''s, the '''percentage''' of the amount, and '''x''''s, the amount in just numbers.)''

''(Stat's colour will be shown on the number of the bee's level, which can be seen on the hive slot and on the bee's wings.)''

''(The table below only shows the range for bees level 20 or below. It is possible to get higher amounts on higher level bees.)'' {| class="article-table" !Stat !Chance !Range |- |%{{Color|Bee Attack|Attack}} |17.9% |5-20% |- | +{{Color|Bee Attack|Attack}} |3.87% |1-2 |- |%{{Color|Convert Amount}} |17.9% |10-30% |- | +{{Color|Convert Amount}} |8.55% |20-80 |- |%{{Color|Gather Amount}} |17.9% |10-30% |- | +{{Color|Gather Amount}} |8.55% |2-10 |- |%{{Color|Energy}} |17.9% |10-40% |- |%{{Color|Bee Ability Rate}} |1.87% |1-5% |- |%{{Color|Critical Chance}} |1.87% |1-3% |- | +{{Color|Movespeed}} |1.87% |2-6 |- | %{{Color|Instant Conversion}} |4.57% |8-20% |} The highest mutation value a bee can get depends on its level. For example, only level 21+ bees can get a +5% Bee Ability Rate mutation.

'''''Note that using a royal jelly or an egg on a mutated bee will almost certainly make the bee lose its mutation, just like gifted bees losing their gifted status.'''''

'''''If the player's bee already has a mutation, and they are trying to re-mutate it, there is a chance it will have the previous type of mutation, and possibly with worse stats. For example, a bee's +20% Gather Amount could change to +18% Gather Amount.'''''

==Gallery== File:0F9CB735-3DAA-4276-BF59-A2D19DA0B462.jpeg|A Bee Ability Rate mutation. File:5144FBB3-82C1-498E-A915-B13753EB3FDB.jpeg|An Attack mutation. File:MutatedRadiation GiftedViciousBee.png|A radioactive bee with an attack mutation. File:Mutate1.png|A radioactive bee with a Convert Amount mutation. File:EnergyMutation.png|A radioactive bee with an energy mutation. File:SpicyBeeTreatMutation.png|A [[Spicy Bee]] getting a mutation from treats. File:PreciseGather.png|A [[Precise Bee]] with a Gather Amount Mutation. Notice the green level numbers on its wings. File:MovespeedBumbleBee.png|A gifted Bumble Bee with a Movespeed Mutation. The mutation color is blue. File:Wrong radioactivity emoji.png|Bees with the [[Glitches#Wrong_Radiation_Emoji|wrong radiation emoji.]]

==Trivia== It is possible to obtain mutations that are almost entirely useless to certain bees. These include: An Attack Mutation on [[Baby Bee]] since it is unable to attack. While Attack mutations do not allow Baby Bee to attack, it will still add to the player's total attack, which can buff [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]]. A Bee Ability Rate mutation on an ungifted [[Basic Bee]] or [[Brave Bee]] without a [[Beequip]] adding an ability, both of which lack abilities. ** An Energy mutation on a [[Photon Bee]] or [[Exhausted Bee]] as both bees have infinite energy.

The {{Cost|Beesmas Tree Hat|4=0}} Beequip requires a bee to have a mutation to be equipped, making any mutation potentially useful for any bee. The {{Cost|Bubble Light|4=0}} Beequip requires a bee to have a Energy mutation to be equipped. When mutating a bee, any equipped Beequip is automatically unequipped and must be reequipped by the player if they wish to continue using it. Depending on the game's language, the [[Glitches#Wrong Radiation Emoji|radiation emoji might be changed]]. *If the player feeds the favorite treat to a mutated bee and it has radiation effect there is a chance to get a new mutation and lose the old mutation(This can affect the player if the bee had a rare or wanted mutation).

docs.title: Mysterious Figure
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}}[[File:Static-assets-upload2667563678635273646.png|thumb|246px|The Mysterious Figure.]] The '''Mysterious Figure''' (named '''Eggwick''' or '''Evilwick''') was a short figure with a light gray hood, gray skin, and no face. He could be found in the [[Mazes#Blue Maze|Blue Maze]] behind the glass wall on the path to the right. He could neither be interacted with nor be collided with. There are also two tiny hallways to the right and left of where the figure was. The player could enter the hallway using a glitch to bypass the wall.

Since the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], there is a [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|star jelly]] token in his place and can only be obtained by entering a passage in the [[Petal Shop]] located in the [[Windy Bee Gate]].

== Trivia == * He, along with [[Onett]], [[Stick Bug]], [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]], and [[Digital Bee (NPC)|Digital Bee]] are the only [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] that aren't [[:Category:Bears|bears]]. ** He and Onett are the only Robloxian-species NPCs. * This figure represents the Hooded Figure in the Roblox [[Egg Hunt 2019]] Event, who also appeared in other games that participated in the Egg Hunt, and in the hub world. * He would occasionally wave at the player. * This is the only NPC that the player normally couldn't get close to, as a glass wall prevented players from reaching him. * This is the third NPC to not originate in Bee Swarm Simulator, the first being Onett and the second being [[Bubble Bee Man]]. docs.title: Mythic Meteor Shower
docs.text:
[[File:MythicMeteorSummoner.png|thumb|The Mythic Meteor Shower summoner.]] A '''Mythic Meteor Shower''' is a server-wide event that was added in the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]]. Its original location was on top of the [[Pro Shop]] but has since been changed to be on [[Badge Bearer's Guild]] in the [[Updates#2024.01.12|1/12/2024 update]]. Any player who has discovered at least 3 [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic Bee]] types can summon it and it has a cooldown of 22 hours.

When summoned by a player, the distorted voice of [[BSS Staff#IcedTeaLatte|IcedTeaLatte]] says "Mythic Meteors", and a server-wide announcement will state:

{{Notification|Meteor|☄️️{Username} has summoned a Mythic Meteor Shower!☄️|17}} Rarely, Onett himself will summon a global meteor shower. In this case, a server-wide announcement will state:

{{Notification|Meteor|☄️️A Mythic Meteor Shower has been summoned!☄️️|19}} Sometimes, usually before [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] ends, [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] will summon Mythic Meteor Showers under an alias.

A light purple fog will appear, and meteors will start raining down on 3 random [[fields]], those of which will show white boxes falling from the sky onto them (similar to the [[Ability Tokens#Pollen Haze|pollen haze]] box). These boxes will appear vibrant from a distance but will dim when the player enters the field, and they indicate that meteors are falling onto those fields. The prizes scale with size, for the smaller the meteor, the higher the chance to get more valuable rewards. If the Meteor Shower was activated by a player, the meteors will collect and instantly convert pollen for them, and the amounts collected are based on the number of Mythic and [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] Mythic bees in their hive. The event lasts for 3 minutes, and the chosen fields will swap a total of 3 times during that time period with the swap occurring approximately once every minute.

If the player is on cooldown, the pad will prompt, "Summon a Mythic Meteor Shower ([time remaining])." If there is a Meteor Shower currently active and the player steps on the pad, whether or not the player is on or off cooldown, it will prompt, "A Meteor Shower is in progress".

== Drops == When a player stands on the drop zone of a meteor (which is indicated by a purple circle), the reward tokens will be distributed in a line across the field, usually leading to the drop zone of another meteor. The number of tokens per meteor is determined by the number of Mythic bees in the summoner's hive, while the rarity of reward tokens changes with the size of the meteor drop zone (with rarer items tending to be more common the smaller the meteor). Tokens produced by the Meteors can be collected with [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|token links]] and other means of token collection. The drops are not affected by a player's [[Loot Luck|loot luck]].

On the start of 1/1/2022, a global mythic meteor shower with the tag "☄️️2022 has summoned a Mythic Meteor Shower! ☄️️ " occurred. *This also occurred the following year in 2023 with the tag "☄️️2023 has summoned a Mythic Meteor Shower! ☄️️"

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Naughty List.png|thumb|203x203px|Bubble Bee Man's Naughty List after completing his Beesmas quest.|alt=]]The '''Naughty List''' is a recurring [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] machine that could be unlocked after completing [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s Beesmas quest.

It is located on top of the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Gate]], between [[Memory Match|Night Memory Match]] and Bubble Bee Man. When used, a voiceline of presumably Bubble Bee Man saying "''Naughty Naughty Naughty"'' will play server wide, and a lump of coal will fall onto each player in the server, which deals lethal damage if the player does not move out of the way. The falling coal is similar to [[Coconut Crab]]'s ''Coconut Attack''. If a player is killed by the falling coal, the player receives a [[Lump Of Coal|Lump of Coal Beequip]] and the [[Buffs & Debuffs#Buffs|Beesmas Repentance buff]] for 2 hours. Players can use the Naughty List every 8 hours.

If a player attempts to use it without completing Bubble Bee Man's quest, the pop up will read: There aren't any names on the Naughty List. That can't be right...

== Audio == [[File:BBMNaughty.ogg]]

== Gallery == Naughty List b.png|Bubble Bee Man’s naughty list before completing Bubble Bee Man's quest During Beesmas 2020. Screenshot 2021-02-10 085723.png|Bubble Bee Man's Naughty List text after completing his Beesmas quest. Flying coal.png|The coal that attempts to kill the player when someone uses Bubble Bee Man's naughty list. 91220A96-42FE-4594-AA79-B05439647154.jpg|The Beesmas Repentance Buff. Lump Of Coal.png|A Lump of Coal icon.

== Trivia ==

  • This, Black Bears Honey Wreath (Honey Bee as well), and Onett's Lid Art are the only Beesmas decorations to have voices play upon activation. ** It is also the only Beesmas decoration to say words instead of voices.
  • If a player stands on a mob while the coal was falling, it can kill the player and deal 100 damage to the [[Mobs|mob]].
  • The names that the player could see that are stated are: Aardvark Joe, Apple BEe ''[sic]'', and Applebee's Cofounder 1.
  • The Naughty List is tied for the Beesmas machine with the longest cooldown, being tied with [[Onett's Lid Art]] and the [[Gummy Siege]].
  • This is the only machine to kill both players and hostile mobs.
  • The Beesmas Repentance Buff does not stack. However, the duration of the buff does stack.
  • After finishing Bubble Bee Man's quest, the dialog states that the player can use it every 22 hours. However, the player can use it every 8 hours.
  • If two or more players use the Naughty List at the same time, you can receive two or more Lumps of Coal while only dying once.

docs.title: Nectar Condenser
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Nectar Pot]], located in 30 Bee Zone, used to store one type of nectar at a time.''

The '''Nectar Condenser''' is a machine added in the [[Updates#2024.01.12|1/12/2024 update]] and is located past the [[Windy Bee Gate]] near the [[Wind Shrine]]. It allows the player to condense 12 hours of any [[nectar]] to receive a [[Nectar Vial|vial]] that holds 4 hours of [[nectar]]. This vial can be used at any time and grants 4 hours of that nectar type. It requires at least 35 bees to use and access. [[File:The Nectar Condenser.jpg|thumb|The Nectar Condenser.]] [[File:Nectar condenser menu.jpg|thumb|The menu of the Nectar Condenser.]]

==Usage== The Nectar Condenser allows players to condense 12 hours of any nectar to receive a [[Nectar Vial|vial]] that holds 4 hours of nectar. This vial can be used at any time and grants 4 hours of that nectar type. Unlike the [[Nectar Pot]], there is no extra cost for this action.

When condensing nectar. It has a 1/25 chance to drop a [[Sticker]] corresponding to the nectar condensed, the place it will drop depends on the nectar that was condensed: Refreshing in [[Coconut Field]]. Satisfying in [[Sunflower Field]]. Motivating in [[Rose Field]]. Comforting in [[Dandelion Field]]. *Invigorating in [[Pepper Patch]].

==Gallery== File:Condenser sticker.png|The Nectar Condenser dispensing a [[sticker]]. File:Condenser refreshing.png|The Nectar Condenser when Refreshing Nectar is converted. File:NectarCondenserLocked.png|Being unable to use the Nectar Condenser. File:Condenser max.png|The message that appears when a player has 10 or more of a certain type of Nectar Vial.

==Trivia ==

By default, the model of the Nectar Condenser is set to be purple and has a [[Nectar|Motivating Nectar]] decal. Upon first use, the Nectar Condenser will always show the last nectar type condensed by the player. There is currently a bug with its hitbox. You can be a bit off to the side on the Nectar Condenser and won’t fall. This is most likely due to the fact its placeholder model shared one with the [[Nectar Pot]] during testing, and Onett never changed the hitbox for it. The player can reach the Nectar Condenser even if they don't have 35 bees, by jumping off the roof of the [[Red HQ]] and gliding down to it, although they won't be able to use it. The Nectar Condenser can make every type of [[Nectar Vial]] except [[Nectar Shower Vial|Nectar Shower Vials]]. *If you try to condense a nectar but already have 10 or more of that type of vial, a message will pop up saying: “You already have 10 or more [nectar type] Vials." [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]]

docs.title: Nectar Pot
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Nectar Condenser]], located in the 35 Bee Zone which converts 12 hours of [[Nectar]] into a [[Nectar Vial]].''[[File:Nectar jar.png|thumb|The Nectar Pot in the 30 Bee Zone.]] The '''Nectar Pot''' is a pot in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]] that can store any type of [[Nectar]] buff that the player can take out to use later, for the cost of 5 [[ticket]]s.

[[File:Nectar jar menu.png|thumb|The menu that appears when choosing which type of nectar to deposit.]] There are 5 types of nectar the player can store. These types are Satisfying Nectar, Motivating Nectar, Refreshing Nectar, Comforting Nectar, and Invigorating Nectar. The player can only store one type of nectar at once, but they can leave it in the pot for as long as they wish. To store another type of nectar, the player must claim the stored nectar, and then pay an additional 5 tickets to put in the new nectar. [[File:Nectar pot partly filled.png|thumb|The Nectar Pot partly filled with Comforting Nectar.]] When storing nectar, the nectar in the pot's color will change into the color of the nectar stored in, and the icon in front of it will change to the nectar's icon. Nectar will be visually filled in the pot, and the amount in it increases with the amount nectar stored in it. When the player claims the nectar, therefore emptying the pot, it will drain and only a little nectar will visually remain, and the icon and color will not change.

== Tips ==

  • The nectar pot is very useful for holding nectar to prepare for a boost. Store the selected nectar beforehand and take the nectar out before boosting.
  • It is best to use this when storing a large quantity of nectar, as storing less and taking it out to store more results in higher ticket loss.
  • Store Invigorating and Refreshing Nectar before boosting if you have mainly red bees, and Motivating and Comforting Nectar before boosting if you have mainly blue bees. If you have mostly colorless bees, you are best off storing Satisfying Nectar. If you have a variety of colors of bees, Satisfying Nectar is usually the best to store, however it can depend on the field you're in.
  • If you have high nectar and are about to log off, store the nectar in the pot for use next time.
  • You can make your bees harvest a planter for a few hours to have the maximum nectar, which you can then store in the pot for later usage. [[File:Full Nectar Pot.png|thumb|The Nectar Pot fully filled with Comforting Nectar.]]

== Trivia == The Nectar Pot is located where the [[Boost Market]] used to be. If the player leaves the game and rejoins while there is no nectar in the Nectar Pot, the color and icon changes to the last nectar the player stored. If the player has never stored nectar, it will become a random one instead.

docs.title: Nectar Vial
docs.text:
[[File:AllNectarVials.png|thumb|Nectar Vials inside a player's inventory.]] '''Nectar Vials''' are a type of inventory [[Items|item]] that can be used to increase a player's current [[Nectar]] by 4 hours when used. Using any Nectar Vial grants 4 hours of their respective nectar type. You can hold a maximum of 10 Nectar Vials of each type at a time. However, this limit can be bypassed by obtaining them through [[quests]] or [[Robux Shop|Robux Packs]].

== Ways to Obtain == * Using the [[Nectar Condenser]] to convert 12 hours of nectar into a Nectar Vial which stores 4 hours of nectar. * Adding the Satisfying, Refreshing, Motivating, Invigorating, and Comforting Nectar Icon [[sticker]]s to the [[Sticker Stack]] will reward the player with their respective nectar vial. * As a reward from certain quests. ** Completing several [[Dapper Bear]] quests reward the player with at least one of every nectar vial. *** {{Cost|Satisfying Vial}}: * Means of Mutation (5) rewards {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}} and other items. The Trick To Tickets (11) rewards {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}} and other items. More Than Myth (15) rewards {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}} and other items. *** {{Cost|Comforting Vial}}: Creative Comforts (6) rewards {{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}} and other items. The Long Haul (10) rewards {{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}} and other items. Ongoing Maintenance (13) rewards {{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}} and other items. Barter For The Blue Drive rewards {{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}} and other items. *** {{Cost|Refreshing Vial}}: Keeping It Chromatic (7) rewards {{Cost|Refreshing Vial|1}} and other items. Solitarily Steadfast (14) rewards {{Cost|Refreshing Vial|1}} and other items. *** {{Cost|Motivating Vial}}: Wandering Ambition (8) rewards {{Cost|Motivating Vial|1}} and other items. *** {{Cost|Invigorating Vial}}: Unintended Intimidation (9) rewards {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}} and other items. * Invigorating View (12) rewards {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}} and other items.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * As a reward from certain quests: ** Completing [[Onett|Onett's]] Beesmas 2022 Quest rewarded {{Cost|Refreshing Vial|1}}. ** Completing [[Gifted Riley Bee|Riley Bee's]] Beesmas 2022 Quest rewarded {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}}. ** Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] Beesmas 2022 Quest rewarded {{Cost|Motivating Vial|1}}. ** Completing [[Stick Bug|Stick Bug's]] Beesmas 2022 Quest rewarded {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|2}}. ** Completing [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Gifted Bucko Bee's]] Beesmas 2022 Quest rewarded {{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}}. * From giving [[Present]]s to certain NPCs. ** Giving [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] a Present rewarded {{Cost|Comforting Vial|1}}. ** Giving [[Polar Bear]] a Present rewarded {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}}. ** Giving [[Gifted Riley Bee]] a Present rewarded {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}}. * From opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]. ** Opening the Gooey Gift Box rewarded {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}}. ** Opening the Obnoxious Gift Box rewarded {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}}. ** Opening the Tropical Gift Box rewarded {{Cost|Refreshing Vial|1}}. ** Opening the Soothing Gift Box rewarded {{Cost|Comforting Vial|2}}. ** Opening the Mythic Gift Box rewarded {{Cost|Motivating Vial|2}}. * From purchasing certain bundles from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. ** Purchasing the Hefty Honeyday Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] granted 5 of each Nectar Vial and other items. ** Purchasing the Angelic Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] granted {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|1}} and other items. ** Purchasing the Charming Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] granted {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}} and other items. ** Purchasing the Refreshing Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] granted {{Cost|Refreshing Vial|1}} and other items. * From Purchasing certain packs from the [[Robux Shop]]. ** Purchasing the Nighttime Nectar Pack in the Robux Shop for {{Cost|Robux|400}} gave 1 of each Nectar Vial and other items. * Defeating a Level 10 [[Snowbear]] dropped {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}}. Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] Cheering Up Gloomy Cub (4/5): Material Things? rewards {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|3}}. Completing [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee Man’s]] 2025 Winter Beesmas Quest rewards {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|7}}. * Buying the Royal Winter Wonder Haul pack for {{Cost|Robux|4500}} grants {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|10}}. |}

== Variants == There is a total of six variants of Nectar Vials. Five of which; immediately grant 4 hours of a type of Nectar buff to the player. The other grants 4 hours of every Nectar buff to all players in the server. The type of Nectar that the player is granted depends on the type of Nectar Vial that they choose to use, with the exception of the {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial||4=1}}.

=== {{Color|Comforting Vial}} === [[File:Comforting Vial.png|75px|thumb|link=Comforting Vial]]{{Main|Comforting Vial}} {{Cost|Comforting Vial|}} instantly give the player 4 hours of the Comforting Nectar [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]].

=== {{Color|Invigorating Vial}} === [[File:Invigorating Vial.png|75px|thumb|link=Invigorating Vial]]{{Main|Invigorating Vial}} {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|}} instantly give the player 4 hours of the Invigorating Nectar buff.

=== {{Color|Motivating Vial}} === [[File:Motivating Vial.png|75px|thumb|link=Motivating Vial]]{{Main|Motivating Vial}} {{Cost|Motivating Vial|}} instantly give the player 4 hours of the Motivating Nectar buff.

=== {{Color|Refreshing Vial}} === [[File:Refreshing Vial.png|75px|thumb|link=Refreshing Vial]]{{Main|Refreshing Vial}} {{Cost|Refreshing Vial|}} instantly give the player 4 hours of the Refreshing Nectar buff.

=== {{Color|Satisfying Vial}} === [[File:Satisfying Vial.png|75px|thumb|link=Satisfying Vial]]{{Main|Satisfying Vial}} {{Cost|Satisfying Vial|}} instantly give the player 4 hours of the Satisfying Nectar buff.

=== {{Color|Nectar Shower Vial}} === [[File:Nectar Shower Vial.png|75px|thumb|link=Nectar Shower Vial]]{{Main|Nectar Shower Vial}} {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|}} instantly give all players in the server 4 hours of each Nectar buff.

== Gallery == File:NectarVial1.png|Each type of Nectar Vial (excluding {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial}}) along with other stuff in the Nighttime Nectar Pack. File:10 Shower Vials in the Royal Winter Wonder Haul robux pack.png|{{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|}} along with other items in the Royal Winter Wonder Haul Pack. File:MotivatingNectar1.png|{{Cost|Motivating Vial|2|4=1}} tokens from the Mythic Gift Box from Beesmas 2022. File:SatisfyingVial1.png|A {{Cost|Satisfying Vial||4=1}} token from the Gooey Gift Box from Beesmas 2022. File:InvigoratingVial1.png|An {{Cost|Invigorating Vial||4=1}} token from the Obnoxious Gift Box from Beesmas 2022. File:RefreshingVial1.png|A {{Cost|Refreshing Vial||4=1}} token from the Tropical Gift Box from Beesmas 2022.

== Trivia == * While most of the Nectar Vials have a letter on them which represents the first letter of their name (C for Comforting, I for Invigorating, M for Motivating, S for Satisfying), the {{Cost|Refreshing Vial||4=1}} doesn't have an R on it to represent the first letter of its name. The {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial||4=1}} has no icon at all, as it just seems to be a mix of all the previous Nectars. * There is only a limited amount of Nectar Vials that can be obtained by the player without the use of the [[Nectar Condenser]]. ** For {{Cost|Comforting Vial||4=}}, the total amount that can be obtained is 23. ** For {{Cost|Invigorating Vial||4=}} Vials, the total amount that can be obtained is 13. ** For {{Cost|Motivating Vial||4=}}, the total amount that can be obtained is 10. ** For {{Cost|Refreshing Vial||4=}}, the total amount that can be obtained is 11. ** For {{Cost|Satisfying Vial||4=}}, the total amount that can be obtained is 16. The {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial||4=1}} is the only vial that is not obtainable from the [[Nectar Condenser]] and is only obtained from the Royal Winter Wonder Haul robux pack. Using Nectar Vials does count toward collecting nectar in [[quests]]. **However, they do not contribute to the [[Daily Top Nectar Collectors|Top Nectar Collector Leaderboards]]. {{Items}} [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Nectar Vials]] [[Category:Consumables]] [[Category:Items]]

docs.title: Nectar
docs.text:
[[File:Nectar jar.png|thumb|128x128px|The [[Nectar Pot]] located in the 30 Bee Zone.]][[File:The Nectar Condenser2.png|thumb|162x162px|The [[Nectar Condenser]] located in the 35 Bee zone]]'''Nectar''' is a set of [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] that were added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/21 update]]. It is granted from [[planter]]s, either by harvesting them, by [[bees]] sipping them from planters, or by using [[Dapper Bear]]'s [[Samovar]] during Beesmas. [[Nectar Vial]]s give 4 hours of a specific Nectar when used. Some [[quests]] require a certain amount and type of nectar to be collected. All sources of getting Nectar can contribute to those quests (except collecting Nectar from the Nectar Pot).

There are five types of Nectar: Invigorating, Satisfying, Motivating, Comforting and Refreshing.

Nectar buffs can last for up to 24 hours and the boosts granted scale with the amount of time remaining. 12 hours of Nectar can be converted to a [[Nectar Vial|Vial]] using the [[Nectar Condenser]]. If the player has more than 12 hours of nectar, the remaining nectar will not be stored. Nectar can also be stored inside the [[Nectar Pot]] located in the 30 Bee Zone for 5 [[Ticket]]s. All of the Nectar types can be stored, but in order to deposit Nectar, any stored Nectar must be withdrawn first. If the Nectar is not stored, it will continue to deplete even if the player is not in the game.

The table below shows the different Nectar types, the fields where a player can obtain them, and which planters give more Nectar than usual. All nectar types have a x0.75 bonus from the [[Paper Planter]], x1.5 from [[The Planter Of Plenty]], x2 from [[Ticket Planter]]s and [[Sticker Planter]]s, and x3 from [[Festive Planter]]s.

The {{Cost|Nectar Tester|4=0}} is a special item that acts like nectar vials, but instead of providing a single nectar for 4 hours, it provides every type of nectar for 24 hours. It was meant to be only available on Test Realm, but was presented to Main Game during 2024 Summer Beesmas as a reward for completing [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s quest.

{{NectarTypes}} ==Gallery== Nectar types.png|The Nectar types, the effects and where to get them. Hivesticker satisfying nectar icon.png|The Satisfying Nectar Icon Sticker. Hivesticker refreshing nectar icon.png|The Refreshing Nectar Icon Sticker. Hivesticker motivating nectar icon.png|The Motivating Nectar Icon Sticker. Hivesticker invigorating nectar icon.png|The Invigorating Nectar Icon Sticker. Hivesticker comforting nectar icon.png|The Comforting Nectar Icon Sticker.

==Trivia== Every nectar icon (except Refreshing) has a letter on it that represents the first initial of the type of nectar. Refreshing has no letter, although it is presumed that the icon has the gaps of the letter 'R'. Comforting has the letter 'C' resembling a crescent moon shape. Satisfying has the letter 'S' resembling the lightning bolt in its decal. Motivating has the letter 'M' in the lightbulb resembling the filament. ** Invigorating has the lower part of 'I' or a small capital 'I' at the bottom of the fire. [[Shy Bee]] has the passive [[Passive Abilities#Nectar Lover|Nectar Lover]], where it is twice as likely to sip nectar and gather twice as much nectar. It also contributes twice as much to the planter's growth. Nectar cannot be collected from the [[Ant Field]] although Onett announced that Ant Field contains Invigorating Nectar. Likewise, nectar cannot be collected from the [[Hub Field]], though a glitch allowed planters to be placed there. **As such, harvesting a planter in this field grants Comforting Nectar, though abusing this glitch may result in having your account flagged.

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Neonberry.png |description=Increases bond with a bee by 500 and makes it Radioactive for a while. }}A {{Color|Neonberry}} is a type of [[Treats|Treat]] that, when fed to a [[Bees|bee]], raises its [[bond]] by 500 and makes it [[Radiation|radioactive]] for a period of time. This is the only treat to have guaranteed chance of making the bee radioactive. These are not the favorite treat of any bee.

== Ways to Obtain == * As a reward from the [[Ant Challenge]]. * As a common reward from [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * Under the [[Beesmas Tree]] * Redeeming certain valid codes: ** There are currently no valid codes that give neonberries. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain stickers to the Sticker Stack: ** {{Cost|Wobbly Looker Bee Sticker|||0}} rewards 3 neonberries. ** {{Cost|Traffic Light Sticker|||0}} rewards 3 neonberries. ** Red Beesmas Light Sticker rewards 3 neonberries. ** Green Beesmas Light Sticker rewards 3 neonberries. ** Yellow Beesmas Light Sticker rewards 3 neonberries. ** Blue Beesmas Light Sticker rewards 3 neonberries. ** {{Cost|Atom Symbol Sticker|||0}} rewards 5 neonberries. *From purchasing the Shiny Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. ** Every colored [[Beesmas Lights|Beesmas Light]] sticker rewards 3 neonberries each. === Drops === * Has a low chance of dropping from [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetles]], [[ladybug]]s, [[mantis]]es, [[King Beetle]], [[Stump Snail]], [[Mondo Chick]], and [[Coconut Crab]]. * Farming in the [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Mountain Top Field]], and the [[Pine Tree Forest]] has a rare chance to drop neonberries. ** Harvesting [[Leaves]] in these fields may also yield neonberries. * As a rare drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a gift from a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]]. * As an uncommon drop from all [[sprout]]s. ** Debug sprouts are guaranteed to drop neonberries. * As a rare drop from [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteors]]. * As an uncommon drop from [[Puffshroom]]s. * As a drop from [[planter]]s. ** The {{Color|Pesticide Planter}} drops extra neonberries in the [[Stump Field]], [[Mountain Top Field]], and the [[Coconut Field]]. ** Planting the {{Color|Pesticide Planter}} in the [[Stump Field]], then the [[Mountain Top Field]], then the [[Coconut Field]] results in an additional 25 neonberries (1 week cooldown). * As a reward from a Robo Party.

=== Quests === * Black Bear's Triple Treck gives 1 neonberry. === Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Gooey Present]] rewarded 10 neonberries and other items. * Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] "Unsilent Night" quest. * [[Festive Nymph]]s had a chance to drop 1 neonberry. * Matching a pair in Winter memory match (stack of 3). * 3 neonberries could be found on top of the 2020 Beesmas Tree. * Giving a present to Science Bear or Gummy Bear during Beesmas 2020 rewarded the player with 10 neonberries. * Completing [[Gummy Bear|Gummy Bear's]] 'Gummy Bear's Goo Year's Beacon' quest gave 100 neonberries + other items during Beesmas 2020 and 2021. * Opening certain Gift Boxes across the map during Beesmas 2020: ** Glowing Gift Box (Gave 20 neonberries + other stuff). * Opening certain Gift Boxes across the map during Beesmas 2021: ** Emerald Gift Box (Gave 10 neonberries + other stuff). ** Gummy Gift Box (Gave 25 neonberries + other stuff). * Digging in to the [[Beesmas Feast]]. * Under the 2021 Beesmas tree. * As a rare reward from Beesmas Feast. * Purchasing certain Robux Packs. ** Purchasing the Precise Pack gave 250 neonberries + other items. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** MondoOutage gave 1 neonberry + other stuff. ** FourYearFiesta gave 1 neonberry + other stuff. ** 5Years gave 5 neonberries + other stuff. ** 10mMembers gave 10 neonberries + other stuff. ** PlushFriday gave 1 neonberry + other stuff. |}

== Crafting Uses == Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Neonberry|30}}

With caustic waxes needed for the [[Dark Scythe]], the total increases to {{Cost|Neonberry|1335}}. The total for all the items which require {{Cost|Caustic Wax|228}} is {{Cost|Neonberry|5730}}. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Neonberry}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |3 |{{Cost|Red Extract|3}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|3}}{{Cost|Glue|3}} |[[File:Purple Potion.png|center|80px|link=Purple Potion]]{{Color|Purple Potion}} |- |3 |{{Cost|Star Jelly|3}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|3}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|6}} |[[File:Super Smoothie.png|center|80px|link=Super Smoothie]]{{Color|Super Smoothie}} |- |5 |{{Cost|Honey|7,000,000}}{{Cost|Glue|1}}{{Cost|Oil|1}}{{Cost|Soft Wax|5}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter|10}} |[[File:Sticker-Seeker.png|center|80px|link=Sticker-Seeker]][[Sticker-Seeker]] |- |25 |{{Cost|Hard Wax|5}}{{Cost|Enzymes|5}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|5,252}} |[[File:Caustic Wax.png|center|80px|link=Caustic Wax]]{{Color|Caustic Wax}} |- |25 |{{Cost|Honey|750,000,000}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|25}}{{Cost|Glue|15}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|3}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|10}} |[[File:Pesticide Planter.png|center|80px|link=Pesticide Planter]]{{Color|Pesticide Planter}} |}

{{Bee |image-orig = Ninja_Bee.png |image-gifted = NinjaBee Gifted.png |description = This bee trained vigorously for years to become the swiftest bee that has ever lived. |rarity = Legendary |color = Blue |energy = 20 |speed = 21 |attack = 4 |skincolor1 = #1b2a35 |skincolor2 = #1b2a35 |skincolor3 = #1b2a35 }} '''Ninja Bee''' is a [[:category:blue|Blue]] [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bee]].

Ninja Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.

Ninja Bee likes the [[Blue Flower Field]] and [[Bamboo Field]]. It dislikes the [[Mushroom Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 2 seconds. * Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 2 seconds. * +50% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], Gather Speed, and Convert Speed, +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], +10% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]] * 🌟[[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +5% [[Stats#Speed|Bee Movespeed]].

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Haste|[Haste]]]''' Grants +10% [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]] for 20 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb|[Blue Bomb+]]]''' Collects 10 pollen from 29 surrounding Blue [[Flowers]] (+10% pollen per Level). Combo with other bombs to increase power.

== Gallery == NinjaBee Hive.png|Ninja Bee's old hive slot design. Gifted Ninja Bee hive.png|A Gifted Ninja Bee hive slot. Png (23).png|Ninja Bee's face. Ninjafaceoriginal.png|Ninja Bee's original face. File:Hivesticker flying ninja bee.png|The Flying Ninja Bee [[sticker]].

== Trivia == * In the early versions of the game, Ninja Bee had an ability called "[[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Haste+]]," which doubled the player's Movespeed for 20 seconds. This ability has now been stripped from the bee and is currently only obtainable through the [[Star Hall|Star Hall's]] [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] and [[codes]]. ** Ninja Bee, [[Hasty Bee]], [[Shocked Bee]], and [[Photon Bee]] are the only bees that grant haste without any certain [[Beequip]]s. * Ninja Bee is the only colored bee to grant haste, with the exception of those with the [[Toy Drum]] Beequip. * This bee, [[Shy Bee]], [[Fuzzy Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]] are currently the only bees that have a solitary colored skin. * Ninja Bee is the fastest bee in the game, tied with Photon Bee. ** In Ninja Bee's description, it is supposedly the "swiftest bee". However, Photon Bee is just as fast. * Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 Update]], Ninja Bee's Gifted Hive Bonus was +20% Player Movespeed instead of +5% Bee Movespeed. * Ninja Bee, [[Cobalt Bee]], and [[Vicious Bee]] are the only blue bees that do not like {{Cost|Blueberry}}. ** It is the only non-[[Bees/Event|Event]] blue bee to not like blueberries. ** This and [[Precise Bee]] are also the only non-[[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] bee to like [[Sunflower Seed]]s. * This bee, Photon Bee, Cobalt Bee, [[Crimson Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], and Windy Bee are the only bees that leave a trail. * Ninja Bee is the blue counterpart of Shy Bee. * This bee is the placeholder image for any bee in a hive slot that hasn't loaded yet. * Ninja Bee's favorite treat was originally {{Cost|Pineapple}}. * Ninja Bee is stated by [[Black Bear]] to be his choice of leader for the [[Blue HQ]].

docs.text:
{{Bear |image = NoobBear.png |type = Shop Bear |location = Noob Shop |bees = 0 |basecolor1 = #b89924 |basecoloramount = 1 |shadecoloramount = 1 |shadecolor1 = #b89924 |snoutcoloramount = 1 |snoutcolor1 = #b89924 |torsocolor1 = #083d63 |torsocoloramount = 1 |armscolor = #9f851f |legscolor = #566325 |enableother = n }} '''Noob Bear''' is the [[bear]] who runs the [[Noob Shop]]. Like other Shop Bears, his presence is not required to purchase from the shop, and players cannot interact with him.

==Gallery== NoobCub.png|The Noob Cub Skin from the Cub Buddy Launch Pack. RobloxScreenShot20180430 183336660.png|Noob Bear when killed. Noobimage.webp|The stereotypical Roblox noob Noob Bear is based on. File:Defendfieldsagainstretroswarms.jpeg|Noob Bear in a banner of The Classic event.

==Trivia== He is the first shop bear to be accessed in the game. As with the other bears, Noob Bear can sometimes fall over or fall apart. This [[Glitches|glitch]] has been mostly patched, so it occurs very rarely as of now. This bear, [[Pro Bear]], [[Top Bear]], and [[Shadow Bear]] are the only bears without any significant purpose. Noob Bear uses the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/56/Cartoony-Animation-Package Cartoony Animation Package]. *Noob Bear is represented by one of the eleven [[Cub Buddy]] skins, specifically the {{Cost|Noob Cub|4=1}}. This skin was obtainable by buying the [[Robux Shop|Cub Buddy Launch Pack]].

docs.text:
{{Stores |title1 = Noob Shop |image1 = Shop1New.png |row1 = Spawn }}The '''Noob Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] run by [[Noob Bear]]. This shop sells four [[bags]], five [[tools]], one [[:Category:Hats|hat]], one pair of [[:Category:Boots|boots]], and one [[:Category:Belts|belt]]. It is located right next to the [[Dandelion Field]], and below the entrance of the [[Star Hall]]. It is the first shop, other than the [[Ticket Tent]], players have access to.

[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] has not yet revealed the official name of this shop; it has been named "Noob Shop" by the players because the bear inside is labeled "Noob Bear". However, when [[Mother Bear]] talks about [[amulet]]s with the player, she calls the shop, "Noob Bear's Shop."

Outside of the shop, there is a [[Honey Dispenser]], which can only be used by members of the [https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592/Bee-Swarm-Simulator-Club#!/about Bee Swarm Simulator Club].

Behind the Honey Dispenser is a hidden [[Obstacle Courses#Lava Obby|obstacle course]]. There is a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} token at the end of it, located inside the Noob Shop. This obstacle course also has the [[Demon Mask]] shop. During the [[Egg Hunt 2019]] event, a {{Cost|Plastic Egg|4=0}} token was added to this course as a part of [[Brown Bear#Egg Hunt Quest 2019|Brown Bear's Egg Hunt 2019 Quest]]; but this token was removed after the event and replaced with a token that gives {{Cost|Ticket|3}}.

[[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted Chicks]] could have spawned here during the [[Egg Hunt 2020|2020 Egg Hunt Event]], however this was removed.

docs.title: Obstacle Courses
docs.text:
'''Obstacle Courses''', sometimes referred to as "obbies" for short, are short platforming challenges. Several of these exist on the main map, each having a reward or a shop at the end. Some are easy, while others are challenging. It gives the player something to do and helps them by rewarding the player with several [[items]] such as [[ticket]]s, [[royal jelly]], or even a [[Star Jelly|star jelly]]. There are also obstacle courses that lead to certain [[:Category:Hats|masks]] that the player can purchase.

== Mushroom Field Obby == [[File:Obby1.PNG|thumb|291x291px|The design of the Mushroom Field obstacle course.]] This obstacle course is located in the [[Mushroom Field]]. It is the first obstacle course that players can complete. Players do not need anything that will make them jump higher, but the obstacle course would be easier if they do. From the first step of the mushroom to the second step, there is an invisible wall.

On the biggest mushroom, there are a total of three circular pads, two red and one white. After the pads, there are three circles in the air, which are red with white dots representing mushrooms. On the end of the course, there is another mushroom with a royal jelly token on it.

Players can skip this obstacle course with the [[Parachute]]/[[Glider]] and any method that'll get them high enough in the air, such as the [[Yellow Cannon]].

== Lava Obby == [[File:Noobshopobbynoplayer.png|alt=|thumb|The design of the Lava Obby.]] This obstacle course is hidden behind the [[Honey Dispenser]] or through a hole through a wall in the [[Noob Shop]]. After the player enters, there will be green blocks surrounded by lava. If the player touches the lava, they will die instantly. The [[Parachute]]/[[Glider]], [[Propeller Hat]] or Gummy Boots/Coconut Clogs is recommended for this obstacle course. Though, jumping rapidly upon hitting lava can keep the player alive. Upon hitting lava, the player must rapidly jump until they can jump on a platform. Then, they can continue with the obby as normal.

The first four blocks are in a straight line. Then, the player will arrive at a split path. If the player keeps going forward, they will find the shop for the [[Demon Mask]]. However, the player will need a decent jump power to be able to jump over one of the large ledges. If the player turns left, they come across 6 more blocks with a left turn. They get higher all the way to a small hole at the end, with a royal jelly just inside it. When the player goes through the hole, they end up on top of an awning inside the [[Noob Shop]]. The player thus is able to go out from the Noob Shop instead of redoing the obstacle course.

Players can bypass this obstacle course by jumping and gliding from the shelf above the hat and belt to the top of the awning. The player needs a highly enhanced jumping ability to do so ([[Beekeeper's Boots]] at minimum, plus [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]] if the player has it), and the player may need the Glider instead of the Parachute.

Alternatively, players can stand on top of [[Noob Bear]]'s cash register, then hop up onto the awning to collect the royal jelly. The Propeller Hat or the Beekeeper's Boots have enough jump power to allow them to reach the awning.

In the [[Egg Hunt 2019|Egg Hunt Event]], players could obtain a [[Plastic Egg]] token by immediately turning right after entering. This has been replaced by a ticket token yielding 3 tickets.

== Commando Chick's Hideout Obby == [[File:CommandoChickHideout.jpeg|thumb|The location of the Commando Chick's Hideout.]] This obstacle course is located between the [[Blue HQ]] and the [[Wealth Clock]], the same location where the [[Ornament Presents|Golden Present]] obstacle course was. There is a hole in the wall, with vines blocking the entrance. To pass through, players must use the [[Clippers]], [[Scissors]], or the [[Scythe]] to cut the vines down. The vines are then permanently cut down, meaning they do not need to cut the vines again. This obstacle course consists of evenly spaced blocks, gradually getting higher, that the player must jump across to reach the arena.

The [[Commando Chick's Hideout]] is located past this obstacle course.

[[File:Hole between Blue HQ and the Wealth Clock.png|thumb|The opening between the Blue HQ and the Wealth Clock that led to the Golden Present obby.]] When the vines blocking the entrance are being cut down, the following audio plays: [[File:Vinecut.ogg]]

The Commando Chick's Hideout Obby is, in fact, a newer version of the [[Ornament Presents|Golden Present]] obby, which had made its debut in Beesmas 2019 in order to serve as a challenge for people trying to get to the Golden Present. After the end of Beesmas 2020, the Golden Present obby was removed, only to return in the Egg Hunt 2020 event as the Commando Chick's Hideout obby. The only difference between the former and the latter is that the latter has vines to cut through.

== Bamboo Field Obby == [[File:156149170171928899.png|thumb|287x287px|The design of the Bamboo Field obstacle course.]] This obstacle course is located between the [[Spider Field]] and the [[Bamboo Field]]. Players need at least 5 bees to get here. Players do not need anything that will make them jump higher to finish the course.

First, there are 9 rocks, alternating between brown and gray. The first three go from the Spider Field to the Bamboo Field, then the next three go in the opposite direction, and then there are three more in the original direction. After those, there are three bamboo sticks, and the royal jelly is on the last stick. The [[Moon Amulet Generator]] is also accessible by this obstacle course.

Players can skip this obstacle course with the parachute, jumping down from the ramp to the 25 Bee Zone and any method that'll get the player high enough in the air, such as the [[Slingshot]].

== Dapper Bear's Shop Obby == [[File:Dapper Bear's Shop Obby Image.png|thumb|Full view of Dapper Bear's Shop Obby.]] The Dapper Shop Obby can be accessed by going to the right wall of [[Dapper Bear's Shop]] and jumping on the three protruding planter displays. There are two paths the player can take afterward. The first one is to jump onto a gray ledge on the right, and then jumping onto the roof of the shop, where the player can find a [[honeysuckle]], royal jelly, and [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]] token, and the [[Gift Boxes|Mythic Gift Box]] (now unavailable). The second is to jump on an orange ledge partially covered by a roof, and then jumping on two moon platforms (the player must wait until nighttime and have a Moon Amulet) to reach a star jelly token. However, if the moon platforms are disabled, they can be skipped by using the [[Hiking Boots]], [[Glider]], and a stack of Haste+. Using the Hiking Boots can help with completing the obby if the moon platforms are active. The jump power is low enough to not bump into the roof, but high enough to be able to grab the [[Royal Jelly|Star Jelly]] at the end. The [[Basic Boots]] lack the jumping power boost the [[Hiking Boots]] have to grab the [[Royal Jelly|Star Jelly]] at the end, so it's not recommended to use those, A [[Glider]] is also recommended in case you hit the ceiling on one of the moon platforms.

== Cloud Obby == [[File:Obby4v2.jpg|thumb|431x431px|The design of the Cloud obstacle course, behind Polar Bear.]] This obby is located past the [[Honey Bee Gate]], starting close to [[Polar Bear]], and ending on the tallest tree in [[Pine Tree Forest]]. Players will require the Parachute or Glider to pass it.

To the left of Polar Bear, players should climb the cliffs to the highest one. Using the [[parachute]] or [[glider]], they should then make the jump to the next two cliffs. Turn left and jump/glide along the tops of the four clouds. The player will be met with the entrance to the Diamond Room on the last cloud. Next to the last cloud is a pine tree with a royal jelly above it. Players can walk right off the cloud into the royal jelly token to collect it.

Players can bypass this obstacle course with the Parachute/Glider and the [[Red Cannon]]. Alternatively, players can skip a variable amount by parachuting/gliding down from the 25 bee zone.

== Diamond Room == The Diamond Room is a room located at the close of the Cloud Obby. The room leads to a [[glitter]] token, the [[Diamond Mask]] and a sky-blue room with 2 moons serving as parkour. The moons will only become collidable if the player has a [[Moon Amulet]] during nighttime. If the player owns the Diamond Mask, the moons will always be solid and will turn blue. With enough speed and the [[Glider]] you can skip the moons entirely.

C28EBFCC-66B3-42F6-AD54-F553F3E011C1.jpeg|The location of the doorway to the Diamond Room. DiamondMask glitter.png|The Diamond Room during day if you don't own the Diamond Mask. DiamondMask night.png|The Diamond Room at night if you don't own the Diamond Mask. Diamondmaskobbybutyouownthemask.png|The Diamond Room at day if you own the Diamond Mask. Diamondmaskobbynightownmask.png|The Diamond Room at night if you own the Diamond Mask.

== 30 Bee Zone Obby == The 30 Bee Zone obstacle course is located to the right of [[Onett]]. This is the last obstacle course that players can reach. During the day the moons leading to on top of the bear gate are slightly invisible and not solid, thus making it inaccessible during the day. If it is night and the player has a Moon Amulet, they can parkour up to the Bear Gate. The moon platforms will lead the player up to [[Bubble Bee Man]]. There is also a royal jelly token in front of Bubble Bee Man and an [[enzymes]] token with the [[Memory Match|Night Memory Match]] on the other side. There used to be a [[present]] where the enzymes are. As of the [[Updates#2019.12.23|2019-12-23 update]], [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] added more moons to make the obstacle course easier.

File:7166B2C2-68FF-4968-91CB-56C3213F11AF.jpeg|The 30 Bee Zone Obby during the day prior to the 12/23/2019 update. File:Postupdatemoonobby.png|The 30 Bee Zone Obby during the day after the 12/23/2019 update.

== Hive Hub Obby == Added in the [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Updates#2024.07.17 2024.07.17] Beesmas update, this obstacle course is located at the entrance of the [[Hive Hub]]. Each platform has a large gap, encouraging you to use the [[Glider]] for every jump you take. These platforms lead the player to a [[Loaded Dice]] token, a [[Red Balloon]] token, and a [[Gingerbread Bear]] token for both 2024 Beesmas events. == Mythic Present Obby == {{RemovedContent}} The Mythic Present obstacle course was located to the left of the [[Stump Field]] and could only be accessible during Beesmas 2019 and 2020. To get to this obstacle course, the player had to go through the [[Brave Bee Gate]] and head to the left of the Stump Field. There would have been a hole in the wall containing the obstacle course. This obstacle course consisted of many purple balls that the player had to jump across to reach the end. At the end of the obstacle course, the Mythic Present was found on a stair-like platform. To the left of the present was a royal jelly token that gave 1 royal jelly. To the right was a [[Micro-Converter|micro-converter]] token that gave 3 micro-converters. If a player were to go out of the map to the place where this obstacle course was during the Beesmas 2019 Event and slide against the wall, the player would die because the floor still kills players.

File:Mysitc Obby.JPG|The area outside of the Mythic Present Obby. File:Capture34.JPG|The view inside the Mythic Present Obby in Beesmas 2019. File:Purplegiftboxobby.png|The view inside the Mythic Present (Purple Gift Box) obby in Beesmas 2020.

{{Consumables |image = Oil.png |description = Grants x1.2 Bee and Player Movespeed for 10 minutes |cooldown = 1 second }} {{Color|Oil}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates|11/25/2018 update]]. When used, it grants x1.2 [[Stats#Speed|Bee]] and [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]] for 10 minutes when activated. Using another will reset the timer, but it does not stack. It can also be used to craft other [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] or [[items]]. Using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=0}} will override the buff.

== Ways to Obtain == * Crafting it via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|50}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|10}} * Matching a pair of oil in [[Memory Match]]. * As a reward for donating to the [[Wind Shrine]]. * As a common drop from [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * A common reward from [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. ** Stick Bug drops oils. ** Defense Totems also yield oils. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** Flying Photon Bee rewards 1 oil. ** Drooping Stubborn Bee rewards 1 oil. ** Fuzz Bomb rewards 1 oil. ** Yellow Coffee Mug rewards 1 oil. ** White Flag rewards 1 oil. ** Standing Beekeeper rewards 1 oil. ** Honey Dipper rewards 1 oil.

=== Drops === * As a drop from certain [[mobs]]: ** [[Tunnel Bear]] ** [[Coconut Crab]] ** [[Stump Snail]] ** Stick Bug ** [[Mantis]] (Rare) ** [[Werewolf]] (Rare) ** [[Aphid#Armored Aphid|Armored Aphid]] (Rare) ** [[King Beetle]] (Rare) ** [[Wild Windy Bee]] (Rare) * Farming in the [[Sunflower Field]] may rarely yield oil. ** Harvesting [[leaves]] in this field may also yield oil. * A rare drop from [[Sprout|sprouts]] (the odds increase depending on the rarity of the sprout and if the sprout is in the Sunflower Field). * As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] (if [[Festive Bee]] is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]) or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a rare gift from a [[Cub Buddy]]. * As a drop from [[Planter|planters]]. ** Fully grown [[Planter|planters]] in Sunflower Field are almost always guaranteed to drop an oil when harvested (Cooldown Unknown). ** The {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} often drops a lot of oil. *** Growing it 3 times in a row at the Sunflower Field guarantees 100 oil. * Activating the [[Target]] in the Sunflower Field in front of the [[Red HQ]].

=== Quests === * [[Black Bear|Black Bear's]] repeatable quests have a chance of yielding oil after completion. * [[Brown Bear]] rewards 1 oil at the 35th, 105th, 160th, 185th, 255th, and 285th quests. * [[Science Bear]] gives oil on the following quests: ** Subsidized Agriculture gives 1 oil and other items. ** Meditating On Phenomenon gives 1 oil and other items. * [[Polar Bear]] occasionally gives oil after the completion of one of his quests.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * As a reward from the [[Robo Bear's Party Cake|Robo Party.]] * Opening the Shimmering gift box gives 5 oils + other items. * By purchasing the Brass Bundle in the [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. * By purchasing the Whirling Bundle in the [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. * Purchasing certain bundles in the [[Robux Shop]]: ** Colossal Crafts Pack for {{Cost|Robux|3,400}} (Granted {{Cost|Oil|50}} + other stuff) ** Festive Bee Pack for {{Cost|Robux|1,600}} (Granted {{Cost|Oil|30}} + other stuff) ** Spikey Spring Basket for {{Cost|Robux|2,700}} (Granted {{Cost|Oil|75}} + other stuff) ** Gooey Goodies Pack for {{Cost|Robux|800}} (Granted {{Cost|Oil|50}} + other stuff) ** New Year Booster Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|400}} (Granted {{Cost|Oil|15}} + other stuff) * Giving [[present]]s to certain [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] during the Beesmas 2018 Event. ** Science Bear activated the oil buff and gave other things. ** [[Polar Bear]] gave 3 oil and other things. ** [[Onett]] activated the oil buff and gave other things. * Opening the [[Ornament Presents|Golden Present]] rewarded 2 oil and other things. * Completing [[Bubble Bee Man|Bubble Bee Man's]] B.B.M. Mission rewarded 1 oil (Was obtainable during Beesmas 2019). * As a drop from [[stockings]] (Was obtainable during Beesmas 2020, 2021, and 2022). * As a drop from [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] [[Samovar]] (Appears at the 1st use and every 5 uses). * Purchasing the Booster Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gave 3 oil + other stuff (Was obtainable during Beesmas 2020). * [[Bee Bear]] gave oil during Beesmas 2019 on the following quests: ** Beesmas Rush gave 1 oil and other items. ** Beesmas Blitz gave 1 oil and other items. ** Bee Cub Workshop 2 gave 1 oil and other items. * Opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]: ** Gilded Gift Box gave 3 oils. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** 2YearsAfterParty (Activated the buff + other stuff). ** 2MFavorites (Gave 1 oil + other stuff). ** Discord50k (Activated the buff + other stuff). ** ThatGuyGift (Gave 1 oil + other stuff). ** GravyGoodies (Gave 1 oil + other stuff). ** kotиkbean (Activated the buff + other stuff). ** 3YearParty (Gave 1 oil + other stuff). ** SecretProfileCode (Activates the buff and other stuff). |}

docs.title: Onett (Developer)
docs.text:
[[File:Onett2023.png|thumb|220px|Onett’s Roblox avatar.]] ''This page is for the developer of the game. For the quest-giving NPC, see [[Onett]].''

'''Piercen Harbut''', better known as '''[https://www.roblox.com/users/1912490/profile Onett]''' on Roblox, is the owner and programmer of [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. Bee Swarm Simulator is his first and main game on Roblox. He owns the [[Onett's Testing Group]].

Onett also runs alternate accounts to handle messages about errors experienced while playing Bee Swarm Simulator. [https://www.roblox.com/users/556387844/profile BeeSwarmBugReport] handles bug reports and [https://www.roblox.com/users/556383852/profile BeeSwarmSupport] handles the purchase and saves file reports. Onett also has a secret alternate account named [https://www.roblox.com/users/1953773238/profile/ ltpb2020], which he mainly used to upload decals for the [[Ready Player Two]] event. Another account was found by the name [https://www.roblox.com/users/5098329817/profile HiddenBeePotential] but seems to only be used for testing as of now.

[https://twitter.com/OnettDev/ Onett's Twitter account] can be found by searching @OnettDev.

Onett also has an [https://www.instagram.com/beeswarmsimulator/ Instagram account], a [https://www.youtube.com/@PiercenHarbut YouTube account] and a [https://www.reddit.com/u/BeeSwarmDev/s/iutuKGHL2H Reddit account].

Onett lives in the CST timezone, as confirmed on Discord.

== Gallery == Dsa.png|A player meeting BeeSwarmBugReport in a server. Asd.png|A player chatting with BeeSwarmBugReport. 20190805 180023.png|Onett revealing his cat's name on Discord. Onett's Face.webp| Onett at RDC 2022.

== Trivia == Onett has a cat in real life, as he states that [[Tabby Bee]] looks like his cat in [[Onett|his NPC's]] quest dialogue. The cat he owns is named Sam (revealed in Discord). Onett has a [https://www.youtube.com/@PiercenHarbut YouTube] account, a [https://twitter.com/OnettDev Twitter] account, an [https://www.instagram.com/beeswarmsimulator/ Instagram] account, a [https://www.twitch.tv/OnettBSS Twitch] account, and a Discord account (onett1). Onett's favorite bees are [[Basic Bee]], [[Rascal Bee]], [[Brave Bee]], and Tabby Bee. Onett claimed he likes Basic Bee because it knows it is not as talented as other bees, but it does not care and smiles non-stop and always exudes pride. He said he likes Rascal Bee because of its laughing face. Onett's favorite ability is Triangulate, due to the fact that he thinks it's satisfying. Onett has a sister (confirmed on Discord). His username could be a reference to a city in the Nintendo game EarthBound. Onett owns a special [[Tools|tool]] called Onett's Honey Hammer. Onett's favorite [[Mobs|mob]] is the [[Rhino Beetle]], as confirmed on Discord. Onett's favorite in-game music is [[Music|bpatrol]]. Onett has broken his hands once. Occasionally, Onetts summons mini events. They have various aliases which replace the username, such as "[Alias] has summoned (a) [mini event]". Onett's birthday is on 12/24/89, and he is currently 35 years old.

{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Onett's Lid Art.png|alt=|thumb|244x244px|Onett's Lid Art after completing Onett's Beesmas quest.]] '''Onett's Lid Art''', or '''Yard Art''' is a beesmas decoration which is unlocked after completing [[Onett|Onett's]] Yard Art [[Quests|quest]].

The art is located past the [[Bear Gate]] next to Onett. It can be used every 8 hours. When activated, the player receives 3 temporary bees, an assortment of loot, and a [[Guiding Star]] is activated.

If a player attempts to use the Lid Art before completing Onett's quest, it displays the message: This art is missing something... It's not very impactful. ==Appearance== The Lid Art consists of (left to right) [[Spirit Bear]] on [[King Beetle]], [[Black Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Bumble Bee]] and [[Stick Bug]], and a [[Basic Bee]] fence gate.

The names confirmed by Onett so far are: Queen Spirit Bear (Spirit Bear), King Stick Bug (Stick Bug), and King Bumble Bee (Bumble Bee).[[File:LidArtIncomplete.png.png|thumb|Onett's Lid Art before the completion of Onett's Beesmas 2020 quest and beyond.]] After completing Onett's Yard Art Quest, [[Baby Bee]], wearing a Santa hat, appears in between Black Bear and Mother Bear in the cradle.

==Gallery== Post1.png|The wooden frame with Basic Bee's face. BearsAndBaby.png|Black Bear and Mother Bear. SpiritQueen.png|Queen Spirit Bear riding King Beetle. BumbleKing.png|King Bumble Bee. StickBugKing.png|King Stick Bug. Babyface.png|Baby Bee wearing a Santa hat. LidArtRecreation.png|An accurate recreation of Onett's Lid Art using the original images.

==Trivia== Onett's Lid Art is the only Beesmas decoration to activate a passive ability, that being the Guiding Star. Originally, the message that would appear if the player tried to use Onett's Lid Art before they completed [[Onett]]'s quest was This art isn't as impactful without Baby Bee in the middle... This, the [[Gummy Beacon]], and the [[Naughty List]] are tied for the longest cooldown of Beesmas decorations of 8 hours. This and the Gummy Beacon were the only ways to have multiple [[Bees/Event|Event bees]] of the same kind, although they are temporary. This art is a reference to the birth of Jesus, which is celebrated by people of Christian faith during Christmas. There was a [[Glitches|glitch]] that caused the player's temporary bees to end up stuck midair once they despawned. The summoned bees can level up, even if they are not in the player's [[hive]]. Players cannot make the temporary bees level up by feeding them treats. However, the summoned bees can level up by other means such as [[Ability Tokens#Puppy Love|Puppy Love]] or the [[Beesmas Feast]]. This is one of the 4 machines that grant the player temporary bees, the others being the [[Honeyday Candles]], the [[Gummy Beacon]] and the [[Honey Wreath]] (after completing [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]'s quest). Sometimes when players look at it from a certain view, some parts of it don't show up. Having a Cobalt Bee from the lid art with Crimson Bee in your hive also activates both a red and blue pulse. [[Bees]] summoned by Onett's Lid Art are able to attack the mobs the player's actual bees are attacking. However, they cannot convert at the [[hive]]. Bees summoned by the lid art in 2020 may also have been gifted. It is unknown whether they granted a hive bonus or not. A [[Tabby Bee]] from summoning can spawn a Tabby Love token which will increase Tabby Love (if it isn't maxed). This is the only way to summon a Guiding Star without a [[Star Amulet#Supreme Star Amulet|Supreme]] or [[Star Amulet#Diamond Star Amulet|Diamond]] Star Amulet with the respective passive. *Summoned bees don't have to rest, even if you die.

docs.text:
{{Group |title1=[https://www.roblox.com/groups/5211428 Onett's Testing Group] |image1=OnettTestingGroupIcon.png |owner=Onett |roles=Member, Admin, Owner |members=66K+ |games=Bee Swarm Test Realm ⚠️ READ DESC ⚠️ }}'''[https://www.roblox.com/groups/5211428 Onett's Testing Group]''' is a Roblox group with 66K+ members. Joining it grants access to the '''[https://www.roblox.com/games/4079902982 Test Realm]''', a ROBLOX place where [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] tests updates before releasing them to the [[Bee Swarm Simulator|main game]].

You can not freely join the group, however. You must send a join request and wait for Onett or any other group admin (in this case, zlib) to accept your request for admission. This group is notorious for being very hard to get into, and people are randomly accepted at unannounced times (usually during periods when the Test Realm is open). ==Description== [ Note: This group very rarely accepts new members. The most recent applications will be accepted first because of how Roblox's site works (I cannot view the oldest applications). For best chance of acceptance please cancel and resend your request. ]

The purpose of this group is to limit access to temporary test places. I use these places to test bug fixes and new content. Access to this group may be limited at any time, and all games owned by this group may go private or have their data reset.

I am currently testing some bug fixes and measuring statistics in this place: https://www.roblox.com/games/4079902982/

==Trivia== *Every major update starting with the [[Updates#2019.09.28|09/28/2019 update]] has been publicly tested within the Test Realm. [[Category:Groups]] [[Category:Community]]
