docs.title: Passive Abilities
docs.text:
[[File:Displayed_Passives.png|thumb|250px|Passive Ability icons which can be seen above the hotbar, or bottom right next to the hotbar on mobile. These icons are for Haste Pulser, Coconut Haste Surge, Ignite, X-Flame, and Emergency Coconut Shield.]] '''Passive Abilities,''' or simply '''Passives''' are effects found on some [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]], [[amulet]]s, or [[bees]]. These abilities are active all the time or only activate when specific actions are done, as an additional effect of those actions.

Passive abilities granted by an accessory or an amulet are displayed near the hotbar. Some passive abilities require the player to do the same action multiple times, as shown by the number displayed on the passive's icon, indicating how close it is to activating the ability. When the ability is activated, the number will reset to 0.

Some passive abilities have a cooldown. When in cooldown, the number of seconds left will be displayed on the passive's icon in pale red. No trigger will activate the ability, nor will the trigger counter be increased. These passive abilities also have an initial cooldown when the player equips items that have those passives to prevent bypassing the cooldown. == Accessory Passives == === Haste Pulser === [[File:HastePulser.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Haste Pulser.]] '''Haste Pulser''' activates every 30th [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste token]] collected.

When activated, it fires a blue pulse that hops to each blue bee, identical to that of [[Cobalt Bee]].

Haste Pulser is granted by equipping the [[Cobalt Guard]].

If the player has no blue bees, then nothing happens. {{clear}}

=== Focus Pulser === [[File:FocusPulser.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Focus Pulser.]] '''Focus Pulser''' activates every 30th [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus token]] collected.

When activated, it fires a red pulse that hops to each red bee, identical to that of [[Crimson Bee]].

Focus Pulser is granted by equipping the [[Crimson Guard]].

If the player has no red bees, then nothing happens. {{clear}}

=== Bubble Bombs === [[file:bubblebomb.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Bubble Bombs.]] '''Bubble Bombs''' activates every 25th [[Ability Tokens#Bomb|Bomb token]] collected, with a 2-minute cooldown.

When activated, it spawns 25 [[bubbles]] randomly in the [[Fields|field]] the player is in.

Bubble Bomb is only granted by equipping the [[Bubble Mask]], or the [[Diamond Mask]] if the player owns the Bubble Mask. {{clear}}

=== Diamond Drain === [[File:DiamondDrain.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Diamond Drain.]] [[File:Ddrain1.png|thumb|The diamond rising into the air.]] [[File:Ddrain2.png|thumb|The Diamond shining.]] '''Diamond Drain''' activates every 30th [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[Ability Tokens|ability token]] collected, with a 45-second cooldown.

When activated, it summons a giant diamond that instantly converts 5 million pollen plus the [[System Page#Convert Total|total conversion amount]]. The conversion amount increases by 10% for every Blue bee the player has and increases by 50% for every Gifted Blue bee type they have. It also pollinates 10 (+3 per Blue bee) blue flowers within the field.

Diamond Drain is granted by equipping the [[Diamond Mask]].

When Diamond Drain is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:Ddtune1.ogg]] {{clear}}

=== Ignite === [[File:Ignite.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Ignite.]] [[File:Ignite!!!!!1!1!!1.png|thumb|220px|The old Ignite flames damaging [[Commando Chick]].]] '''Ignite''' activates every 15th [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[Ability Tokens|ability token]] collected.

When activated, it creates 5 [[flame]]s in a plus shape where the 15th red token is collected.

Ignite is granted by equipping the [[Fire Mask]], or the [[Demon Mask]] if the player owns the Fire Mask. {{clear}}

=== X-Flame === [[File:XFlame.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for X-Flame.]] [[File:XFlameNewTexture.png|alt=|thumb|An X-Flame in the Strawberry Field.]] '''X-Flame''' activates every 25th Battle [[Ability Tokens|ability token]] collected (ability tokens that can be generated in combat), with a 20-second cooldown.

When activated, it creates 29 [[flame]]s in an X shape around the player.

X-Flame is granted by equipping the [[Demon Mask]].

When X-Flame is activated, the following audio plays (Note that the audio in-game is slowed down slightly): [[File:Xflame.ogg]] {{clear}}

=== Coin Scatter === [[File:coinscatter.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Coin Scatter.]] [[File:RobloxScreenShot20210320 232506480.png|alt=|thumb|255px|Honey tokens scattered randomly from Coin Scatter.]] '''Coin Scatter''' activates every 20th [[Ability Tokens#Mark|Mark token]] collected, with a 2-minute cooldown.

When activated, it converts pollen equal to 300% of the player's [[System Page#Convert Total|total conversion amount]], scattered into 24 honey tokens around the field the player was last in. The honey tokens last for 1 minute.

Each token will give a minimum of 1000 honey, increasing with the amount of pollen converted and the player's [[System_Page#Honey_From_Tokens|Honey From Tokens]] stat.

The honey tokens cannot be collected by [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]], but can be collected by [[Ability Tokens#Triangulate|Triangulate]].

Coin Scatter is granted by equipping the [[Honey Mask]], or the [[Gummy Mask]] if the player owns the Honey Mask.

When Coin Scatter is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:Coinscatter.ogg]] {{clear}}

=== Gummy Morph === [[File:GummyMorph.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Gummy Morph.]] [[File:GummyBearMorph.png|thumb|163px|The Gummy Bear morph.]] [[File:Gummy field.png|thumb|Gummy Bee's trail during the passive.]] '''Gummy Morph''' activates every 30 {{Cost|Gumdrops|4=0}} used or 10 [[Gummy Bee]] ability tokens collected (Gummy Bee ability tokens count as 3 gumdrops).

When activated, the player will be transformed into [[Gummy Bear]], Gummy Bee will glow, and the field will be covered fully in [[goo]].

As Gummy Bear, the player will be granted +75% [[System Page#Goo|Goo]], +100% [[System Page#Goo Conversion|Instant Goo Conversion]], +24 [[System Page#Movespeed|Movespeed]], and +60 [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]].

As Gummy Bee glows, it is granted +1000% [[Stats#Gather_Amount|Gather Amount]], +300 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], and +200% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]] for 10 seconds. The Gummy Bee also leaves a trail while glowing.

Gummy Morph is granted by equipping the [[Gummy Mask]].

When Gummy Morph is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:gbm.ogg]] {{clear}}

=== Coconut Haste === [[File:coconuthaste.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Coconut Haste.]] '''Coconut Haste''' activates whenever the player is hit by a falling {{Cost|Coconut|||0}}.

When activated, the player gains a single stack of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Haste]] and 2 seconds of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Coconut Surge]], giving x1.5 [[Stats#Speed|Bee Movespeed]] and +10 [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]].

Coconut Haste is granted from equipping the [[Coconut Clogs]] or [[Gummy Boots]]. {{clear}}

=== Goo Trail === [[File:GummyBoots.PNG|thumb|139px|The trail of goo left behind.]] '''Goo Trail''' passively covers 5 surrounding flowers with [[goo]] wherever the player walks on a field. The passive is always active while the player has it.

Flowers directly behind the player will have more goo than those surrounding.

Goo Trail is granted by equipping the [[Gummy Boots]]. {{clear}}

=== Emergency Coconut Shield === [[File:PassiveEmergencyCoconut.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Emergency Coconut Shield.]] [[File:Coconut shield.png|thumb|A player is protected inside the Emergency Coconut Shield.]] '''Emergency Coconut Shield''' activates when the player takes damage directly from a [[Mobs|mob]], with a 5-minute cooldown.

When it activates, it summons 5 {{Cost|Coconut}} in the field the player is last in, gains 100% Defense, and increases Bee Attack by x1.25 for 10 seconds.

This does not protect the player from kill bricks.

Emergency Coconut Shield is granted by equipping the [[Coconut Canister]].

When the Emergency Coconut Shield is activated, the following audio plays (Note that the audio in-game is sped up): [[File:Cocosiren.ogg]] {{clear}}

=== Inspire Coconuts === [[File:inspirecoconuts.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Inspire Coconuts.]] [[File:Inspire coconuts in action (2).jpg|thumb|Inspire coconuts activated by a player.]] '''Inspire Coconuts''' activates every 5th [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire token]], [[#Star Shower|Star Shower's shooting stars]] or [[Beesmas Lights|Beesmas Light]] collected.

When activated, it summons 5 falling {{Cost|Coconut}} in the field the player is last in.

Inspire Coconuts is granted by equipping the [[Coconut Canister]]. {{clear}}

=== Petal Storm === [[File:pstorm.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Petal Storm.]] [[File:Petal storme.png|thumb|Petal Storm in action.|alt=]] '''Petal Storm''' activates every 30th [[Ability Tokens#Boost|boost token]] collected, with a 30-second cooldown.

When activated, it fires 30 Petal Shurikens around the player in a spiral pattern. When the shuriken passes through a bee, the bee instantly converts 10,000 pollen, increased by 7% of its conversion amount.

Petal Storm is granted by equipping the [[Petal Belt]], or the [[Coconut Belt]] if the player has the Petal Belt.

=== Combo Coconuts === [[File:Combococonuts.png|left|thumb|104x104px|The icon for Combo Coconuts.]] '''Combo Coconuts''' activates every 40th {{Cost|Coconut|||0}} the player drops onto a field (through items or abilities).

The 40th {{Color|Coconut}} dropped becomes a Combo Coconut. When caught by any player, the Combo Coconut is kicked and either falls onto the summoner's field (if on the first drop, the coconut was caught within the blue circle) or onto another player's field.

Every time it is kicked, it speeds up and gives the kicker stacks of [[Buffs_&_Debuffs#From_Passives|Coconut Combo]]. Many more stacks are granted if caught by other players in fields with different colors.

The buff grants between 10% to 75% Unique Instant Conversion, between x1.1 to x1.5 Pollen, and between +1% to +50% Pollen, Red Pollen, Blue Pollen, White Pollen, Bee Attack, and Honey From Tokens.

When the Coconut fails to be caught, it despawns and reapplies the buff to all players who caught it at least once.

Coconut Combo is granted by equipping the [[Coconut Belt]]. {{Clear}}

== [[Star Amulet]] Passives == === Guiding Star === [[File:GuidingStarIcon.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Guiding Star.]] [[File:Guiding star.png|thumb|A Guiding Star in the Sunflower Field.]] '''Guiding Star''' activates every 250th [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Boost token]] collected, with a 5-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants 1.25x capacity.

When activated, it summons a Guiding Star over 1 of the 5 fields the summoner has collected the least from for 10 minutes.

The Guiding Star grants x2.5 [[System Page#Pollen|Pollen]], Convert Rate, and [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|Capacity]] to the player who summoned it, and x1.25 Pollen, Convert Rate, and Capacity to other players in that field. While active, the star pollinates 15 (+1 per Gifted Bee Type) flowers every 15 seconds. It will disappear if the player who summoned it leaves the server.

Guiding Star is granted by having a Diamond or Supreme Star Amulet with the Guiding Star passive.

Guiding Star can also be summoned if a player used [[Onett's Lid Art]] during the [[Beesmas]] event. {{Clear}}

=== Star Shower === [[File:StarShowerIcon.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Star Shower.]] [[File:Starshowere.png|thumb|A Star Shower on a field.]] '''Star Shower''' activates every 40th [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Boost]] or [[Ability Tokens#Mark|Mark]] token collected, with a 30-second cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants 1.25x capacity.

When activated, 10 shooting stars will fall onto the field the player is standing on, which collect and instantly convert 30 pollen (+50% per Gifted Bee Type) from 5 flowers. Catching a shooting star grants a stack of [[Buffs_&_Debuffs#From_Ability_Tokens|Inspire]] and instantly converts 1,000,000 pollen, added by 200% of the player's [[System Page#Convert Total|total conversion amount]].

Star Shower is granted by having a Diamond or Supreme Star Amulet with the Star Shower passive.

The passive is similar to the falling Beesmas Lights, which could be activated by completing [[Science Bear]]'s [[Beesmas Lights]] quest during the Beesmas events.

For every individual star, the following audio plays: [[File:Starshowerstar.ogg]] {{Clear}}

=== Pop Star === [[File:PopStarIcon.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Pop Star.]] [[File:Popstare.png|thumb|A Pop Star.|43x43px]] '''Pop Star''' activates every 30th [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Boost token]] collected, with a 1-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants x1.25 Blue Field Capacity.

When activated, it summons a Pop Star, which grants 10% [[System_Page#Instant_Blue_Conversion|Instant Blue Conversion]] and x2 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]] for 45 seconds.

When the Pop Star is activated, it automatically applies 2 minutes of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|Bubble Bloat]]. While the Pop Star is active, every one of the player's bubbles popped increases the bonus Blue Pollen by 1% (up to x4.5 from x2) and grants 4 seconds of Bubble Bloat (6 seconds if the bubble is gold, 1 second if the bubble is not the player's).

Bubble Bloat increases [[System_Page#Blue_Field_Capacity|Blue Field Capacity]] and [[System Page#Convert_Rate_At_Hive|Convert Rate at Hive]] by up to x6 for up to 2.5 hours.

When it ends, the Pop Star spawns several bubbles over the field that increase with the number of Bubbles popped.

Pop Star is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Pop Star passive.

When Pop Star is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:Popstar.ogg]] {{Clear}}

=== Gummy Star === [[File:GummyStarIcon.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Gummy Star.]] [[File:Gummystare.png|thumb|A Gummy Star.]] '''Gummy Star''' is activated at a 2% chance when using Gumdrops, or at the 75th use after the cooldown ends, with a 1-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants x1.25 White Field Capacity.

When activated, it summons a Gummy Star, which grants 10% Instant [[System Page#White Pollen|White]] and Goo Conversion for 45 seconds. Collecting goo during this time will make the star grow, granting bonus White Pollen and Goo (up to x2).

After the 45 seconds are up, the Gummy Star will pop, scattering honey tokens and {{Cost|Gumdrops|}} tokens on the field the player was last in. The honey tokens are worth, in total, a percentage of the goo collected during the Gummy Star's duration, equal to 1.5% per gifted colorless bee type on the player's hive. The number of {{Cost|Gumdrops|}} tokens increases the amount of goo collected.

Gummy Star is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Gummy Star passive.

When Gummy Star is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:Gummystar.ogg]] {{Clear}}

=== Scorching Star === [[File:ScorchingStarIcon.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Scorching Star.]] [[File:Scorchingstare.png|thumb|A Scorching Star.]] '''Scorching Star''' activates every 30th [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Boost token]] collected, with a 1-minute cooldown. Additionally, it permanently grants x1.25 Red Field Capacity.

When activated, it summons a Scorching Star for 45s, which grants 50% [[System_Page#Instant_Flame_Conversion|Instant Flame Conversion]], +5 Conversion Links, and x2 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]] and [[System_Page#Convert_Rate|Convert Rate]].

Standing near flames causes the star to grow, increasing the bonus Red Pollen and Convert Rate (up to x5 from x2) and the number of Conversion Links (up to 30 from 5).

When Scorching Star ends, it converts all of the player's pollen in their bag into Honey.

Scorching Star is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Scorching Star passive.

When Scorching Star is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:Scorchingstar.ogg]] {{Clear}}

=== Star Saw === [[File:StarSawIcon.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for Star Saw.]] [[File:StarSawSpinning.gif|alt=|thumb|A star saw circling around a player.]] '''Star Saw''' activates after using {{Cost|Stinger|3}}.

The 3rd Stinger used will be refunded, while also summoning a Star Saw that lasts for 30 seconds.

The Star Saw circles around the player, damaging hostile mobs (equal to 15% of the player's [[System Page#Total Attack|Total Attack]], with accuracy equal to the average bee level of the player's hive, not including summons), collecting tokens, and collecting and instantly converting 3 pollen (+0.5 for every 100 Total Attack) from 5 flowers 10 times a second. The saw instantly converts additional pollen equal to the amount it gathers.

Star Saw is granted by having a Supreme Star Amulet with the Star Saw passive.

When Star Saw is activated, the following audio plays: [[File:Starsaw.ogg]] {{Clear}}

== Bee Passives == === Gathering Bubbles === {{Main|Bubble}} [[File:2019-12-23_(7).png|thumb|A bubble in a field.]] '''Bubbles''' have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering.

Bubbles spawned by this passive ability can be generated by [[Bubble Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], and [[frog]]s. There is a 35% chance (50% if gifted) for Bubble Bees to spawn a bubble while gathering, and a 55% (75% if gifted) chance for Tadpole Bees to spawn a bubble while gathering.

When a bubble is popped, the following audio plays: [[File:Bubblepop.ogg]] {{Clear}}

=== Gathering Flames === {{Main|Flame}} [[File:NewFlame.png|thumb|125px|A flame in a field.]] [[File:Passive-gathering-flames.png|thumb|The old texture of a flame.]] '''[[Flame]]s''' have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering.

Flames spawned by this passive ability can be generated by the [[Fire Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], [[Spicy Bee|Spicy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Inferno|Inferno]], and bees with the [[Electric Candle]] Beequip. There is a 35% chance (50% if gifted) for Fire Bees to spawn a flame while gathering, and a 55% (75% if gifted) chance for Demon Bees to spawn a flame while gathering. {{Clear}}

=== Steam Engine === '''Steam Engine''' is a passive ability exclusive to Spicy Bee. It boosts any Spicy Bee's [[Stats#Speed|speed]] by up to 100% with [[Buffs_&_Debuffs#From_Passives|Flame Heat]]. While Steam Engine is active, Spicy Bee will increase the number of steam particles from its exhaust pipes proportionately with the amount of flame heat. {{Clear}}

=== Fuzzy Coat === '''Fuzzy Coat''' is a passive ability exclusive to [[Fuzzy Bee]]. It has a chance to [[Pollination|pollinate]] up to 5 surrounding [[flowers]] (9 if gifted) when gathering. Lower-tier flowers have a higher chance of being pollinated than higher-tier flowers. {{Clear}}

=== Nectar Lover === '''Nectar Lover''' is a passive ability exclusive to [[Shy Bee]]. It makes Shy Bee twice as likely to sip from a [[planter]] than any other bee. When sipping, it also collects twice as much [[nectar]] and contributes twice as much to the growth of the planter. {{Clear}}

=== Shimmering Honey === [[File:90935ED9-7B1D-47E4-94EE-B714907A58E7.jpg|thumb|Diamond Bee's Conversion Link color when Shimmering Honey is activated.|alt=|120px]] '''Shimmering Honey''' is a passive ability exclusive to [[Diamond Bee]]. Whenever this bee converts at the hive, it grants a 25% bonus honey (+2.5% per level). This bonus is doubled if the bee is Gifted. {{Clear}}

=== Balloon Enthusiast === '''Balloon Enthusiast''' is a passive ability exclusive to [[Buoyant Bee]]. When converting from Balloons, this bee gains x3 its normal [[System_Page#Convert_Amount|convert amount]]. Additionally, this bee's base attack scales up to x3 with [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Balloon Blessing]]. {{Clear}}

=== Sniper === '''Sniper''' is a passive ability exclusive to [[Precise Bee]]. In battle, this bee uses slow, long-range, more accurate shots and deals x2 damage. The accuracy is calculated as if the bee were 1 level higher (2 if gifted), and it can never be below 5%. If the shot is a [[Critical Hits|Critical Hit]], the reload time after shots is cut in half. If it's a [[Critical Hits#Super-Crit|Super-Crit]], it's reduced by 75%. {{Clear}}

=== Drive Expansion === '''Drive Expansion''' is a passive ability exclusive to [[Digital Bee]]. Using a [[Drives|Drive]] while this bee is active in [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]] corrupts the field you're standing in by an amount proportional to the number of flowers that match the Drive's color (Glitched Drives corrupt all fields equally). Additionally, it permanently enhances this bee, increasing the Corruption of its abilities and granting it the following stats: - Red Drive: +0.03 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]] - Blue Drive: +2 [[Stats#Production Amount|Convert Amount]] - White Drive: +0.25 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]] - Glitched Drive: +0.05% [[System Page#Bee Ability Rate|Ability Rate]]

Every {{Cost|Glitched Drive|10}} Enhancements grants a Hive Bonus of 0.02% Ability Duplication Chance.

Digital Bee can be enhanced with up to 500 of each type of Drive. You can view the number of enhancements by clicking on Digital Bee's [[Hive Slot|hive slot]].

Upon maxing out with all 2000 Drives, Digital Bee gains +10 [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]]. {{Clear}}

== Other Passives == === Unlimited Gumdrops === [[File:Unlimited Gumdrops.png|thumb|left|100px|The icon for the Unlimited Gumdrops buff.]] '''Free Gumdrops''' is a passive ability that can only be obtained through the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Unlimited Gumdrops]] buff, which can be activated through certain [[codes]] and the [[Glue Dispenser]].

It allows the player to use their {{Cost|Gumdrops|4=0}} without losing any from their inventory. Having this buff active does not increase the amount of {{Cost|Gumdrops|4=0}} in the player's inventory. {{Clear}}

== Trivia == * There is a visual glitch where, if the player has the Fire, Honey, Bubble, Demon, Gummy, or Diamond Mask equipped, looking at it through the coconut shield will make the front of the mask disappear. This is caused by glass textures overriding particles and transparent parts. [[Category:Mechanics]] [[zh-tw:被動技能]]

docs.title: Pepper Patch
docs.text:
{{Field |image = PepperPatchBeesmas2021.png |fieldcolor = Red |bees = 35 |width = 27 |height = 21 }} The '''Pepper Patch''' is a [[field]] that was added in the [[Updates#2019.9.28|9/28/2019 update]], located past the [[Windy Bee Gate]], to the right of the [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]] and to the left of the [[Wind Shrine]]. There are no [[mobs]] that protect this field.

This is a 21x27 field, containing 567 [[flowers]]. The flowers are red and white, and the only natural size is triple.

{| class="article-table" !Flowers !White !Red !Blue !Total |- !Single |0% |0% |0% |'''0%''' |- !Double |0% |0% |0% |'''0%''' |- !Triple |8% |92% |0% |'''100%''' |- !Total |'''8%''' |'''92%''' |'''0%''' |'''100%''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. However, the percentages should be roughly correct.'''

This field can spawn [[strawberry]], [[bitterberry]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], [[Red Extract|red extract]], [[ticket]] and [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] tokens when gathering [[pollen]]. The only [[Bees|bee]] that likes the Pepper Patch is [[Spicy Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Pepper Patch are [[Looker Bee]], [[Frosty Bee]], [[Baby Bee]] and [[Fuzzy Bee]].

This field grants Invigorating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

A level 9-12 [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has a chance to spawn here.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Red Field Booster]] may give a Pepper [[Field Boost|Patch Boost]] (only if the player has 35+ bees). When it does, it will give +100% Pepper Patch pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Pepper Patch pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out. [[File:Pepper Patch Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Pepper Patch boost icon.]] * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - +300% Pepper Patch pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Pepper Patch [[Field Wind|Winds]] can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Pepper Patch conversion and give +5% instant Pepper Patch conversion and +10% Pepper Patch pollen for each stack. Pepper Patch Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Sriracha (Gave Pepper Patch Boost x2 and Pepper Patch Capacity x2 + other stuff). ** 10mMembers (Gives Pepper Patch Code Buff + other stuff). ** DemiDecade (Gives Pepper Patch Boost x4 + Pepper Patch Winds x15 + other stuff). ** Gumaden10T (Gave Pepper Patch Boost x1 and Pepper Patch Winds x3 + other stuff). ** RedMarket (Gave Pepper Patch Boost x1, Pepper Patch Market Boost, and Pepper Patch Capacity x1). **FrozenBugReboot (Gave Pepper Patch Boost x4 and Pepper Patch Code Buff + other stuff). * Purchasing a Pepper Patch Market Boost from the [[Boost Market]] or certain codes gave x1.25 Pepper Patch Pollen along with 1.5x [[Field Capacity|Pepper Patch Capacity]], x1.25 [[System Page#Pollen From Flames|Flame Pollen]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]].

== Gallery == hivesticker pepper patch stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == This, the Coconut Field, the [[Stump Field]], the [[Ant Field]] and the [[Hub Field]] are currently the only fields released in updates. This, the [[Mountain Top Field]], Stump Field, and Coconut Field are the only fields to solely have natural triple flowers. The Pepper Patch is the only field past a bee gate with nothing guarding it. * This and the Coconut Field are the only fields where [[sprout]]s cannot appear naturally or be planted with the [[Special Sprout Summoner]]. The [[Badges#Pepper Badge|Pepper Badge]], [[Badges#Coconut Badge|Coconut Badge]], [[Badges#Mountain Top Badges|Mountain Top Badge]] and the [[Badges#Hive Hub Badges|Hive Hub Badge]] require more pollen collected than the other field badges. The Pepper Patch used to cover the entire platform it is placed on. Now, the field has shrunk a little and the area was amplified. As a result, it does not cover the edges of the platform anymore. The peppers used as decoration were also reorganized. This is the only red field that gives [[Nectar|Invigorating Nectar]]. *There used to be a {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|4=1}} token next to this field.

docs.title: Peppermint Antennas
docs.text: {{Unobtainable}} {{Beequip}} The '''Peppermint Antennas''' are a [[Bond|level]] 7 [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] [[Beequip]]. They have an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement. == Possible Stats == {{BeequipStatsTable}} == Ways to Obtain == '''There are currently no ways to obtain {{Cost|Peppermint Antennas|||0}} without [[trading]]. ===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | From the [[Gift Boxes|Gummy Gift Box]]. Every 3rd swing fires a Petal Shuriken that causes bees to instantly convert pollen!}} The '''Petal Wand''' is a [[Tools|tool]] added in the [[Updates|9/28/2019 update]] that can be crafted in the [[Petal Shop]]. {| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|1.5B|1,500,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Star Jelly|10}}{{Cost|Glitter|25}}{{Cost|Enzymes|75}}{{Cost|Spirit Petal|1}} |}

It collects 6 [[pollen]] from 37 patches in 0.7 seconds, and boosts pollen collected by 100%. It has an average base pollen collection rate of 634.28 pollen per second. It emits a yellow particle effect at the top of the tool, similar to the [[Petal Belt]].

Every 3rd swing, it fires a Petal Shuriken, which causes [[bees]] to instantly convert pollen if it touches their hitbox. The shuriken instantly converts 10,000 + 6% of the bees' [[System Page#Convert Amount|convert amount]] in pollen to honey, + an additional 6% per [[Field Boost|field boost]] stack of the field you're standing in. Shurikens can also pop [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|bubbles]] and [[Ability Tokens#Fuzz Bombs|fuzz bombs]].

The version held by Spirit Bear is much bigger than a player's. *After the shuriken comes in contact with one of the player's bees, the sound effect changes. docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Photon_Bee.png |image-gifted = PhotonBee Gifted.png |description = An entity made of pure light temporarily taking on the form of a bee. |rarity = Event |color = Colorless |energy = Unlimited |speed = 21 |attack = 4 |skincolor1 = #e7ff2c |skincolor2 = #f1f1f1 |skincolor3 = #e7ff2c }}'''Photon Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] that hatches out of a [[Eggs#Event Bee Eggs|Photon Bee Egg]], which is available in the [[Ticket Tent]] for 500 [[Ticket]]s.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, the only way to make Photon Bee gifted is either with a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Photon Bee likes the [[Pineapple Patch]] and the [[Pumpkin Patch]]. It dislikes the [[Clover Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 20 [[Pollen]] in 2 seconds. * Makes 240 [[Honey]] in 2 seconds. * +50% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +50% gather and convert speed, +10 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +160 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +20% [[Instant Conversion]], +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. If Gifted, Beamstorm collects x1.5 more white pollen for a total of x3 white pollen and ALL pollen is instantly converted. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Haste|[Haste]]]''' Grants +10% [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]] for 20 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times.

{{Stat|pollen = 20|pollentime = 2|honey = 240|honeytime = 2|rarity = event}}

== Gallery == Photon.png|Photon Bee's old hive slot design. Gifted Photon Bee hive.PNG|A Gifted Photon Bee hive slot design. PhotonFace.png|Photon Bee's face. Beamstorm.png|The beamstorm ability token. Captura de pantalla (271).png|A beamstorm beam from a normal Photon Bee. GiftedBeamstorm.jpg|A beamstorm beam from a gifted Photon Bee. BeamStorm.png|Beamstorm in action File:Hivesticker flying photon bee.png|The Flying Photon Bee [[sticker]]. File:Photon hive slot.jpg|An ungifted photon bee’s hive slot == Trivia == Photon Bee's energy, along with [[Exhausted Bee|Exhausted Bee's]], is actually set to 280,000,000. It was the first Event bee to be added in the Ticket Tent and the second Event bee added to the game, with [[Bear Bee]] being the first. It was also the first Event bee that is purchased using tickets. This bee and the [[Ninja Bee]] are tied as the fastest [[Bees]] in the game, with a speed of 21. Photon and Exhausted Bee are the only bees that don't require sleep and have infinite energy. However, they still need to rest at the hive when you die. This bee, [[Festive Bee]] and [[Vicious Bee]] are the only Event bees that have [[Ability Tokens]] generated by non-Event bees. This bee, Ninja Bee, [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], and [[Precise Bee]] are the only bees that create a trail behind them (not counting particle trails). *This is the first event bee with a trail. [[Gummy Bee]] also creates a trail, but it can only be seen while the [[Gummy Mask]] ability is active. This bee, Bear Bee, Festive Bee, Gummy Bee, [[Tadpole Bee]] and [[Tabby Bee]] are the only bees to have a [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|Gifted Bonus]] that affects their signature ability. If Photon Bee is gifted, its Beamstorm is white instead of yellow and instantly converts its collected pollen. The sun model on Photon Bee's rear has 20 spikes. Because Photon Bee has infinite energy, there is a [[Glitches|glitch]] if a [[Royal Jelly|Royal jelly]] is used on a Photon Bee, the transformed bee will have a ridiculous amount of energy. This glitch is also shared when transforming an Exhausted Bee, since that has endless energy as well. All versions of the Ticket Tent have had this bee on top, except for the initial release. Although Photon Bee's energy is infinite, it is still possible to get an energy [[mutation]] on Photon Bee. However, the mutation will have no effect, similar to an attack mutation on a [[Baby Bee]]. Photon Bee's Beamstorm ability is able to collect pollen from other fields. If the token was close enough to the other field, the range of the Beamstorm can possibly be able to reach it. {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Colorless]] [[Category:Bees]] [[Category:Event]] [[zh-tw:光子蜂]]

docs.title: Pine Tree Forest
docs.text:
{{Field|image = PineTreeForest2024.png|fieldcolor = Blue|bees = 15|width = 31|height = 23}}[[File:67C17751-F8B4-4284-A635-CE88FE7FD727.jpeg|thumb|200px|The royal jelly token on top of the tallest pine tree.]] The '''Pine Tree Forest''' is a [[Fields|field]] located past the [[Honey Bee Gate]] and near the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]]. It is protected by two [[mantis]]es and the [[Werewolf]].

This is a 23x31 field, containing 713 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white and blue, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

{| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |8 |''1.1%'' |34 |''4.7%'' |'''42''' |'''''5.8%''''' |- !Double |61 |''8.5%'' |282 |''39.5%'' |'''343''' |'''''48%''''' |- !Triple |46 |''6.4%'' |282 |''39.5%'' |'''328''' |'''''46.2%''''' |- !Total |'''115''' |'''''16%''''' |'''598''' |'''''84%''''' |'''713''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[blueberry]], [[ticket]], [[Blue Extract|blue extract]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], and [[neonberry]] tokens while gathering [[pollen]]. [[Planter]]s in this field grant extra [[whirligig]]s and blue extracts.

[[Bees]] that like the Pine Tree Forest are [[Bear Bee]], [[Bumble Bee]], [[Cool Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], [[Bubble Bee]], [[Carpenter Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], [[Fuzzy Bee]], and [[Tadpole Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Pine Tree Forest are [[Rascal Bee]], [[Rad Bee]], [[Riley Bee]], [[Fire Bee]], [[Shy Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], [[Digital Bee]] and [[Baby Bee]].

This field grants Comforting [[Nectar]] when a planter is planted here.

== Obtaining Boosts== [[File:Pine Tree Forest Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Pine Tree Forest boost icon.]]

Using the [[Blue Field Booster]] may give a Pine Tree [[Field Boost|Forest Boost]]. When it does, it will give +100% Pine Tree Forest pollen for 15 minutes. Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Pine Tree Forest pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - +300% Pine Tree Forest pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. Pine Tree [[Field Wind|Forest Winds]] can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of 20% instant Pine Tree Forest conversion and give +5% instant Pine Tree Forest conversion and +15% Pine Tree Forest pollen for each stack. Pine Tree Forest Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. * The [[Pinecone]] [[Beequip]] can grant up to +15% Pine Tree [[Field Capacity|Forest Capacity]] and +10% Pine Tree Forest Pollen. * Giving [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] a [[present]] during the Beesmas 2024 event gives you a x3 Pine Tree Forest boost.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

Giving [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] a [[present]] during the Beesmas 2020 event gives you a x3 Pine Tree Forest boost. * Redeeming certain expired codes: 300mVisit (Gave Pine Tree Forest Boost x2 + other stuff). WordFactory (Activates Pine Tree Forest Code Buff + other stuff). PlushFriday (Gives Pine Tree Forest Code Buff + other stuff). DemiDecade (Gives Pine Tree Forest x4 + Pine Tree Winds x15 + other stuff). ByeBeeBear (Gave Pine Tree Forest Boost x1 + other stuff). MinhMaMaMoons (Gave Pine Tree Forest Boost x2 + other stuff). 12hourgeneral (Gave Pine Tree Forest Boost x1 + other stuff). YTFMMoons (Gave Pine Tree Forest Boost x3 + other stuff). ==Trivia == Festive Bee likes the Pine Tree Forest, which may be a reference to the fact that most Christmas trees are pine trees. It is also the only red bee to like a field of the opposite color. The only other bee that shares this trait is [[Vicious Bee]] liking the [[Rose Field]]. The Pine Tree Forest is the only field with "Forest" in its name instead of "Field" or "Patch". This field is guarded by the werewolf and 2 mantises. This makes the Pine Tree Forest the field with the most [[mobs]] guarding it, at 3. There is a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] token on top of the tallest pine tree in this field. To get it, the player can do the [[Obstacle Courses#Cloud Obby|Cloud Obby]] starting near [[Polar Bear]] using the [[Parachute]] to glide to the next step. However, it is much easier to use the [[Red Cannon]] and the [[Parachute]]/[[Glider]]. As of the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]], [[Honey Bee (NPC)]] can be found on the gray platform behind the Pine Tree Forest. The Pine Tree Forest has shrunk since it was released. Before the Badge Bearer's Guild was added, the field stretched all the way to where the Badge Bearer's Guild currently is. When the Badge Bearer's Guild was added, the field was shrunken to end at the door of the guild. It has been shrunken again, now being farther from the guild's door. *One of the pine trees still remains near the [[Honey Bee Gate]] from the field's original spot. This field currently has the most amount of bees liking it, at 10, and the most amount of bees to dislike it, at 8.

docs.title: Pineapple Patch
docs.text:
{{Field |image = PineapplePatch2.png |fieldcolor = White |bees = 10 |width = 33 |height = 23 }}The '''Pineapple Patch''' is a [[Fields|field]] located past the [[Brave Bee Gate]] and to the right of the [[Pro Shop]]. It is protected by a level 4 [[mantis]] and a level 5 [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetle]].

This is a 33x23 field, containing 759 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

{| class="article-table" ! Flowers !White !Red !Blue !Total |- !Single |17% |1% |1% |'''19%''' |- !Double |45% |3% |2% |'''50%''' |- !Triple |27% |2% |2% |'''31%''' |- !Total |'''89%''' |'''6%''' |'''5%''' |'''100%''' |}

'''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. However, the percentages should be roughly correct.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[pineapple]], [[bitterberry]], [[neonberry]], [[enzymes|enzyme]], [[ticket]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], [[glue]] and [[glitter]] tokens when gathering [[pollen]].

This field grants Satisfying [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

[[Bees]] that like the Pineapple Patch are [[Shocked Bee]], [[Diamond Bee]], [[Lion Bee]], [[Gummy Bee]], and [[Photon Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Pineapple Patch are [[Vector Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], and [[Crimson Bee]].

A level 1-20 [[Wild Windy Bee]] has the chance of spawning here.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a [[Field Boost|Pineapple Patch Boost]]. When it does, it will give +200% Pineapple Patch pollen for 15 minutes. [[File:Pineapple Patch Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Pineapple Patch Boost icon.]] * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Pineapple Patch pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - +300% Pineapple Patch pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Pineapple Patch [[Field Wind|winds]] can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Pineapple Patch conversion and give +5% instant Pineapple Patch conversion and +20% Pineapple Patch pollen for each stack. Pineapple Patch Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. * The [[Moon Amulet]] can give a pollen boost for the Pineapple Patch between +1% and +150%. * It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Pineapple Patch Boost, it can boost the field by +7% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity. *Donating either the Menacing Mantis or Pineapple Patch Stamp [[Sticker]] to the [[Sticker Stack]] boosts the Pineapple Patch by 5% and 10% respectively.

=== The methods below are no longer possible === * Giving a [[present]] to certain NPCs during Beesmas: [[Science Bear]] gave Pineapple Patch Boost x4 and other items (Beesmas 2018). ** [[Onett]] gave Pineapple Patch Boost x1 and other boosts and items (Beesmas 2018). Giving Science Bear a present gave Pineapple Patch Boost x3 and other [[items]] (Beesmas 2020). Giving Science Bear a present gave Pineapple Patch Boost x3 and other items (Beesmas 2021). * Purchasing a Pineapple Patch [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Pineapple [[Field Capacity|Patch Capacity]] x1.25 Pineapple Patch Pollen, x1.25 White Pollen, and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]]. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Tabby (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x1 + other stuff). ** ClubBean (Gives Pineapple Patch Boost x2 + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gives Pineapple Patch Boost x1 + other stuff). 10MilMembers (Gives Pineapple Patch code buff + other stuff). **WalmartToys (Gives Pineapple Patch code buff, boost x4, and winds x10 + other stuff). ** LateNightGumdrops (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x2 + other stuff). ** SugarRush (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x4 + other stuff). ** Shutdown (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x5 + other stuff). ** 1MoreTime (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x2 + other stuff). ** Reboots (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x5 + other stuff). ** DarzethDonation (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x5 + other stuff). ** 1mFavorites (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x1 + other stuff). ** Trying (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x3 + other stuff). ** OffToOrlando (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x3 and Pineapple Patch Winds x5 + other stuff). ** Market (Gave Pineapple Patch Market Boost + other stuff). ** PineappleParty (Gave Pineapple Patch Boost x3, Pineapple Patch Capacity x3, and Pineapple Market Boost x3 + other stuff.)

== Gallery == Pineapple face.png|The Pineapple's face when it is blowing [[sparkles]]. Currentpineappletoken.png|The pineapple token behind the pineapple closest to the Pro Shop. Ticketonpineapple.png|The ticket token on the giant pineapple. File:PineappleSpitFace.png|The Pineapple's face before blowing sparkles. hivesticker pineapple patch stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * Oddly, the mobs in this field ([[Rhino Beetle]] and [[Mantis]]) are affiliated with blue, despite the field being white. * There is a [[pineapple]] token behind the pineapple closest to the shop. Collecting it grants the player five pineapples. * There is a [[ticket]] token worth three tickets on top of the giant pineapple. It can be obtain by using the [[Red Cannon]] and the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]], or by jumping up from the side of the pineapple. * There is a [[glue]] token behind the biggest pineapple between the [[Stump Field]]. * This was the third biggest field in the game before the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]]. * This field is one of the three fields to have the word "Patch" in their name instead of "Field," along with the [[Pumpkin Patch]] and the [[Pepper Patch]]. ** The [[Pine Tree Forest]] is another field without the word "Field" in it, having "Forest" in its name instead. * This is one of six fields that [[fireflies]] can travel to, with the others being [[Bamboo Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Rose Field]], [[Spider Field]], and [[Strawberry Field]]. * This is one of the fields that the [[Stick Bug]] can move to during the [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. * This field along with the [[Sunflower Field]] and the [[Pumpkin Patch]] are the only fields where an object may come to life and shoot sparkles. * The biggest pineapple will occasionally grow a face, where it will blow bubbles at patches of flowers, producing [[sparkles]] (in diamond formation) upon contact. Collecting pollen on the affected flowers can produce tickets, pineapples, [[Moon Charm|moon charm]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], [[enzymes]], or honey tokens. * While doing one of [[Spirit Bear]]'s quests, Spirit Bear states that the Pineapple Patch was originally supposed to be a Rhubarb Field. Instead, she and Stick Bug planted pineapples. This is the only field to be guarded by two mobs of different tiers (Rhino Beetle and Mantis), if you don't include the [[Werewolf]] guarding the Pine Tree Forest as it merely happens to be located in the Werewolf's attack territory. This is the currently the biggest field in the game.

docs.title: Planter
docs.text:
[[File:AllPlanters.jpg|thumb|354x354px|All of the planter models (excluding the Ticket Planter and the Sticker Planter).|alt=]] '''Planters''' are inventory items that can be deployed in [[fields]]. Only one of each type of planter can be planted at any time, and only one planter can be planted in each field at any time. A player can only have up to 3 planters active at any given point of time. Harvesting planters grants [[nectar]], random loot depending on the planter and the field, and has a chance to summon a [[Puffshroom]] (excluding [[Ticket Planter]] and the [[Sticker Planter]], which are both guaranteed to summon a Puffshroom upon harvesting them after fully-grown). [[File:Nectar types.png|thumb|All types of nectar and their respective info.]]

== Mechanics == To use a planter, simply drag the planter in your inventory or use the planter on your hotbar while standing on an unused field. A deployed planter will naturally grow over time only when you are playing the game. Only 3 planters can be active at a time.

The growth of the planter can be boosted by using [[glitter]] on the field it is deployed (25% faster), active clouds in the field (8% faster each active cloud, 20% maximum bonus growth), a field they can naturally grow by faster (ex. [[Red Clay Planter]] grows 25% faster in red fields), or by bees sipping on the planter by standing in the field the planter is deployed. When bees are sipping on the planter, they will convert pollen in the player’s bag, grant nectar, and give growth to the planter. The amount of growth added to the planter depends on the bee's energy and the amount of nectar depends on the bee's collection amount and the planter deployed.

After reaching 95% growth, the planter will roll on whether it will "smoke" or not. If the planter smoked, the planter will spawn a puffshroom on harvest. The chance for the planter to smoke depends on the type of planter, with the ticket planter and sticker planter being guaranteed to smoke.

Upon harvesting the planter, the planter will drop three things: nectar, pollen and items; the nectars are guaranteed to be granted upon harvest, items are only dropped at a certain percentage of growth, and pollen is based on planter growth. Additionally, '''excess pollen gained exceeding the player's capacity is instantly converted'''. The amount of nectar and items it drops depends on the current growth of the planter. If the planter is smoking while at full growth, it will release a puffshroom upon harvest with its level being affected by the type of planter used. The type of nectar dropped is affected by the field the planter is deployed on, and the items are affected by the type of planter and the field it is deployed on. Some planters grant more nectars than other ones.

Planters have bonus drops. Either from the planter itself, when they are deployed in a particular field, or by chaining them by planting and fully growing them at particular fields (see chart below under "All Bonus Drops (from growing in a certain field)".

When harvesting a planter on a field, the field will "degrade". When a field degrades, the natural growth of the planter slows down when it is planted there. The amount of degradation on the field depends on the current percentage of growth on the planter corresponding to the natural time of the planter's growth, and harvesting a planter also always degrade the field by 1 hour. Every field can be degraded by a maximum of 48 hours. The more degradation is put on the field, the longer they'll naturally grow and the longer they'll stay degraded. When a planter is in a degraded field, the color of the planter will be brown instead of green, getting darker the higher the degradation. It seems that after being placed for a while, the color will return to being green. However, the field will still stay degraded. == Drops == Planters drop items and nectars upon harvesting, the quality and amount of items and nectars depend on the total growth. Chaining or having the planter deployed in certain fields will make them drop certain items. Some planters also exclusively drop certain items. As seen below:

{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" ! style="text-align: center" |Item !How and Where to Obtain |- |[[File:Ticket.png|50px|center]]{{Color|Ticket}} | * Planters can sometimes drop tickets, the quantity of the Tickets depend on the type of the Planter. {{Cost|Ticket Planter}} exclusively drops tickets as a bonus drop, and has dropped up to 150. |- |[[File:Gumdrops.png|50px|center]]{{Color|Gumdrops}} | {{Cost|Candy Planter}} drops Gumdrops as a bonus drop. Placing {{Cost|Candy Planter}} in Blue Flower Field, Strawberry Field, or Pineapple Patch makes it drop more gumdrops. Planters in Stump Field can make it drop Gumdrops. {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty}} drops Gumdrops as a bonus drop and has a rare chance to drop 100 gumdrops. |- |[[File:Coconut.png|50px|center]]{{Color|Coconut}} | Planters in the 35 Bee Zone can drop Coconuts. |- |[[File:Micro-Converter.png|50px|center]]{{Color|Micro-Converter}} | * Planting {{Cost|Blue Clay Planter}} in the [[Spider Field]] makes it drop at least 10 Micro-Converters. {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty}} drops Micro-Converters as a bonus drop. |- |[[File:Stinger.png|50px|center]]{{Color|Stinger}} | Fully growing {{Cost|Red Clay Planter}} in [[Clover Field]], [[Spider Field]] and [[Cactus Field]] (in that order) rewards Stinger (2 weeks cooldown). Planting a Planter in Cactus Field gives the planter a chance to drop stingers, the amount of stingers depends on the type of planter. ==Planter Types==

There are currently 14 planters in-game, listed below: [[Category:Pages that uses original tabber]] One-time Use=

One-time Use Planters are planters that can't be reused and requires the player to acquire more of them in order for them to be used again.

Paper Planter Ticket Planter Festive Planter Sticker Planter

|-|Permanent=

Permanent Planters are planters that can be indefinitely reused after acquiring them. Once you collected the planter, it goes back into the player's inventory.

Plastic Planter Candy Planter Red Clay Planter Blue Clay Planter Tacky Planter Pesticide Planter Heat-Treated Planter Hydroponic Planter Petal Planter The Planter Of Plenty

==Nectar Types== {{NectarTypes}}

==Trivia== All planters (except the {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|4=0}}, {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|4=0}} and {{Cost|Sticker Planter|4=0}}) were added in the [[Updates|12/26/2021 update]]. There are currently 10 reusable planters, thus adding 10 more inventory items that are reusable. Onett hired [https://www.roblox.com/users/87520897/profile Not_Nert] for modelling all of the planter models. Similarly to certain other items that can be placed down, any planters that have been placed down before the player has joined will not appear for that player. {{Cost|Festive Planter|4=0}} is the only planter that can drop {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} and {{Cost|Festive Bean}}. The pollen gained from planters counts toward [[quests]] that require [[Pollen]]. {{Cost|Sticker Planter|4=0}} is the newest planter, being added in the [[Updates|1/12/2024 Update]]. Bees do not sip from planters during battle. *In spite of the game labelling many planters with "1/1" in the player's inventory, many of them listed above are reusable meaning the player can use them an infinite number of times after purchase.

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} {{Consumables |image = Plastic Egg.png |description = Turn in 3 to Brown Bear for a prize! |cooldown = N/A |cap = 3 }}The {{Color|Plastic Egg}} was a blue-colored egg that was scattered around the map for [[Brown Bear#Egg Hunt Quest 2019|Brown Bear’s 2019 Egg Hunt Quest]]. The player had to find all three eggs to finish Brown Bear's Egg Hunt Quest, which awarded a {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|4=0}}. They had no special abilities and were removed from the player's inventory when turning in the [[Quests|quest]]. The egg locations were replaced by {{Cost|Ticket|4=0}} tokens after the [[Egg Hunt 2019]] ended and the [[Updates#2019.05.13|5/13/2019 update]].

== Locations ==

  • In the [[Mazes#Blue Maze|Blue Maze]], next to the [[Ticket Tent]]. ** Turn left first, and follow the right wall after that to find the token. ** In the ramp leading up to the [[Basic Bee Gate]], opposite the [[Blue Flower Field]] and behind the [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee's]] original location. ** Inside the [[Obstacle Courses#Lava Obby|Lava Parkour]]. There will be a little window outside of the lava parkour that shows the token. *** When entering, immediately turn right, and climb up the rocks.

== Gallery == 5D3B5CA2-52B0-4267-8CE9-CC841CB2C5FF.jpeg|The Plastic Egg token inside the Lava Parkour. EB8471CD-E2FD-4734-AC4B-B20A2EA1A6D6.jpeg|The Plastic Egg token behind the Honey Bee NPC. PlasticEggMaze.png|The Plastic Egg token inside of the Blue Maze. PlasticEggInventory.png|Plastic Eggs in a player's Inventory. File:60C05C6F-C42A-4EFB-8944-15A53C04CDF7.webp|A Plastic Egg token.

== Trivia == * This is the first and only [[egg]] that can be obtained as an inventory item and yet can't hatch into a [[Bees|bee]]. * In the Egg Hunt 2019 lobby, the portal to Bee Swarm Simulator said, "Find 5 Plastic Eggs", though the player only needed 3 to obtain a {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|4=0}}. ** Compounding the error, this was also not the only quest needed to complete the Egg Hunt. * This and the {{Cost|Broken Drive|4=0}} are the only [[items]] that only serve a purpose to complete a [[Quests|quest]].

docs.title: Pollen
docs.text:
''Are you looking for [[Flowers]] or [[Honey]]?''

'''Pollen''' is one of the main features in [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. Pollen is collected in order to make [[honey]]. It can be obtained by using [[tools]] (via tapping or clicking) on [[flowers]], from [[bees]] collecting pollen and/or activating their [[Ability Tokens|abilities]], from some [[Passive Abilities|passive abilities]], from [[Mythic Meteor Shower|meteors]], and from [[coconut]]s. Flowers can have different sizes and different colors. Some [[quests]] require pollen to be collected from a specific flower color or field. There are many sources of pollen multipliers, including [[amulet]]s, [[bags]], [[masks]], [[badges]], [[Gifted Bee|hive bonuses]], abilities, [[Field Boost|field boosts]], [[Field Wind|field winds]], and certain passive abilities.

Pollen is mainly used to convert it into [[honey]] at the player's [[hive]], through [[Instant Converter]]s, by using a [[Micro-Converter]], [[Honeysuckle]], etc. This is one of the most common ways to get honey. Pollen is also used as a counter to track how much a player has farmed from a [[field]] in [[badges]].

== Pollen Amount Per Flower == In order to get more pollen per collection, collect the biggest flowers on the field. The bigger the flower, the larger the pollen multiplier. There are 5 different flower sizes: single, double, triple, large, and star.

{| class="article-table" style="width:500px;" cellspacing="1" cellpadding="1" border="0" ! scope="row" |Flower size | style="text-align:center;" |Single | style="text-align:center;" |Double | style="text-align:center;" |Triple | style="text-align:center;" |Large | style="text-align:center;" |Star |- ! scope="row" |Image | style="text-align:center;" |[[File:FlrsW1b.png|thumb|90px]] | style="text-align:center;" |[[File:FlrsW2b.png|thumb|90px]] |[[File:FlrsW3b.png|thumb|90px]] |[[File:FlrsW4b.png|thumb|90px]] |[[File:FlrsW5b.png|thumb|90px]] |- !Multiplier | style="text-align:center;" |1 | style="text-align:center;" |2 | style="text-align:center;" |3 | style="text-align:center;" |4 | style="text-align:center;" |5 |- ! scope="row" |Total amount of pollen | style="text-align:center;" |30 | style="text-align:center;" |45 | style="text-align:center;" |60 | style="text-align:center;" |75 | style="text-align:center;" |90 |}

Collection amount and efficiency can be increased by using better tools (either collecting in a large area or multiplying pollen collection. For example, the [[Scythe]] and the [[Bubble Wand]] each collect double red and blue pollen, respectively). Collecting [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]], [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire]], [[Ability Tokens#Beesmas Cheer|Beesmas Cheer]], [[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|Baby Love]] ability tokens, [[Bear Bee]] and [[Basic Bee]] [[Gifted Bee|gifted]] bonuses, badges, using game [[mechanics]], expanding the hive, different [[amulet]]s, using [[items]], and different [[Passive Abilities|passive abilities]] can all lead to better pollen collection.

When a flower is [[Pollination|pollinated]], it upgrades any kind of flower, with star flowers being the exception. Flowers can be pollinated by [[Fuzzy Bee]], The [[Passive Abilities|Diamond Drain]] Passive, bees with the [[Poinsettia]] or [[Lei]] beequip, and [[Passive Abilities#Guiding Star|Guiding Star]].

== Gallery == SmallFlower.png|The original single white flower. MediumWhiteFlower.png|The original double white flower. LargeWhiteFlower.png|The original triple white flower, which was instead a big flower. File:Pollination.gif|A flower is being pollinated.

== Trivia == * Single, double, and triple flowers are the only types of flowers that can naturally spawn in fields. Large and star flowers can only be spawned through pollination. * Before the [[Updates#2020.04.06|Egg Hunt 2020 update]], only the single, double, and large flowers were in the game. When the Egg Hunt 2020 update was released, large flowers became triple flowers, and the flower images were polished to look more attractive and simplistic. * In real life, nectar is used by bees to be turned into honey and not pollen.

docs.title: Pollination
docs.text:
[[File:Ezgif.com-crop_(1).gif|thumb|150px|A flower being pollinated.]] [[File:IMG 20200414 175220.jpg|thumb|152px|A large and a star flower, both of which can only be seen via pollination.]] '''Pollination''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that causes [[flowers]] to grow to higher tiers, increasing their total [[pollen]] and multiplier. Flowers that are lower tier than other flowers in the [[Fields|field]] have a higher chance of being pollinated. When flowers are pollinated, they will burst flower particles.

Flowers only stay pollinated for 1 minute, but this can be stacked up to 5 times for 5 minutes. Every minute that an already pollinated flower is not pollinated, it will go down a tier, until it has reverted to its original state.

Pollination is the only method to achieve large and star flowers, as the highest natural tier is triple.

== Ways To Pollinate Flowers == * [[Fuzzy Bee|Fuzzy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Fuzz Bombs|fuzz bombs]] can pollinate flowers upon popping it. * Fuzzy Bee‘s [[Passive Abilities#Fuzzy Coat|Fuzzy Coat]] passive has a chance to pollinate up to 5 surrounding flowers while collecting pollen. This increases to 9 when gifted. Fuzzy Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Pollen Haze|Pollen Haze]] pollinates up to 30 flowers every second. [[Ability Tokens#Bomb|Bomb]] tokens produced in a field with pollen haze are automatically collected and pollinate flowers. * [[Diamond Mask|Diamond Mask's]] [[Passive Abilities#Diamond Drain|Diamond Drain]] pollinates 10 blue flowers when activated. The number of flowers pollinated increases by 3 for every blue bee the player has. * If [[Star Amulet#Supreme Star Amulet|Guiding Star]] is active, the star will pollinate 15 (+1 per [[Gifted Bee|gifted bee]] type) flowers every 15 seconds. * A bee with the {{Cost|Poinsettia|||0}} beequip equipped has an 11% to 20% chance to pollinate flowers while gathering. A bee with the {{Cost|Lei|||0}} Beequip equipped has a 20% to 50% chance to pollinate flowers while gathering. *A bee with the {{Cost|Rose Headband|||0}} has a 10% to 20% chance to pollinate flowers while gathering.

== Trivia == * This is the only way to directly change flowers in a field. * Fuzzy Bee is the only bee in the game to pollinate flowers without a Beequip. [[Category:Mechanics]] [[zh-tw:授粉]]

docs.title: Porcelain Dipper
docs.text:
{{Tool |image = Porcelain Dipper.png |price = 150,000,000 |shop = Mountain Top Shop |range = 49 |pattern = Surround |time = 0.7 |collectbase = 3 |whitemultiplier = 1.5 |specialmultiplier = 50% White Pollen Multiplier }} The '''Porcelain Dipper''' is a [[Tools|tool]] that was added in the [[Updates#2018.06.02|6/2/2018 update]]. It can be purchased in the [[Mountain Top Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|150,000,000}} |}

It collects 3 pollen from 49 surrounding patches in 0.7 seconds, increasing white pollen by 50%. Its average base pollen collection rate is 245 pollen per second: 315 from [[:Category:Colorless|white]] [[flowers]] and 210 from [[:Category:Red|red]] and [[:Category:Blue|blue]] flowers (the ability is not counted, assuming all flowers are single-size). It has a maximum base [[pollen]] collection rate of 315 pollen per second, which is achievable only in the [[Spider Field]]. It emits bubbles and sparkles.

Every 10th swing will summon a large copy of this tool rising up, it then summons a pillar of light collecting lots of pollen from 29 flowers (in a 5x5 area around the player and 4 other flowers 3 tiles ahead, to the side and behind the player) and plays the following audio:

[[File:PDAbility.ogg]]

== Gallery == Hivesticker porcelain dipper.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. Pillar.gif|The Porcelain Dipper's beam of light in action. Porcelain Dipper-0.jpg|A bee face through the glass of a Porcelain Dipper. DipperStraw.png|The effect on certain decals. DipperCoco.png|The effect allowing you to see the Coconut Canister through the cave.

== Trivia == The price was increased from 100,000,000 (100 million) honey to 150,000,000 (150 million) honey after the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], because an ability was added to it. It used to collect more patches prior to the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]]. The Porcelain Dipper is an upgraded version of the [[Honey Dipper]], which can be bought in the [[Pro Shop]]. This was the second tool to have an ability, first being the [[Golden Rake]]. Some decals aren't visible through the glass of a porcelain dipper (such as bee faces in a hive, or the flame effect on the scythe) similar to the water of the sprinklers. However, if positioned correctly, it can be used to view certain things in areas, like the [[Coconut Canister]], [[Coconut Clogs]], and the [[Coconut Belt]] in the [[Coconut Cave]]. The average collection rate of this tool is 41% better than the [[Scythe|Scythe's]] and the [[Bubble Wand|Bubble Wand's]] average rate. However, the Scythe is 48% better at red flowers, and the Bubble Wand is 48% better at blue flowers. This is tempered by the fact that there are no fields that are entirely blue or entirely red, meaning the Bubble Wand and Scythe never actually achieve their theoretical maximum collection rate. The Porcelain Dipper glows white during a [[honeystorm]]. The ability still activates outside of a [[Fields|field]]. The Porcelain Dipper’s light pillar will not collect pollen if the player is above the field in any way (e.g. jumping or gliding above the field or standing outside at the edge), although the pillar visually touches the flowers. **If a player goes in the [[King Beetle's Lair]] and jumps right before the beam effect, they can collect pollen from the Clover Field. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

docs.title: Precise Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |color = Red |rarity = Mythic |image-orig = Precise Bee.png |image-gifted = PreciseBee Gifted.png |description = This sharpshooting bee is always on point and expects the same of you. |energy = 40 |speed = 11.2 |attack = 8 |skincolor1 =#450302 |skincolor2 =#cb4144 |skincolor3 =#840909 }} '''Precise Bee''' is a [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]].

Precise Bee’s favorite type of [[Treats|treat]] is {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.

Precise Bee likes the [[Mountain Top Field]] and [[Rose Field]]. It dislikes the [[Bamboo Field]] and [[Pine Tree Forest]].

== Stats ==

  • Collects 20 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds.
  • Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds.
  • +7 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], -20% Movespeed, +10 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +100% [[Energy]], +5% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]], +3% Super-Crit Chance.
  • 🌟[[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +3% Super-Crit Chance.

===Abilities===

  • '''[[Ability Tokens#Target_Practice|[Target Practice]]]''' Causes the bee to fly into the air and project 3 targets on the field for a few seconds. Running on a target activates it. ** When all 3 targets are activated, this collects all ability tokens and grants a stack of [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Precision]], which grants +2% Super-Crit Chance for 60s and stacks up to 10 times. Super-Crits can only occur for Critical hits and gain x2 power and 100% [[Instant Conversion]]. ** After a few seconds, any target activated will generate a [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] token and be shot, collecting pollen equal to double this bee's attack (+10% per [[Bond|Level]]) from 29 [[Flowers]]. With Flame Heat, the shots gain up to x4 Pollen and up to 50% instant conversion. Any unactivated target spawns a [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Red Boost]] token instead. ** If the player is shot while standing on a target, this collects all ability tokens and consumes your [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Flame?so=search#Flame_Heat Flame Heat] to instantly convert Pollen in your bag, with half turning into Honey Tokens. The amount converted is equal to 50% of your Convert Total + 10x this bee's convert amount and scales up to x10 with the Flame Heat consumed and up to x3 with your current field's boost stacks. ** If Gifted: When only the farthest target is activated, it will summon a Precise Mark which grants +7% [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]] and Super-Crit Chance and stacks up to 3 times. ** If the player collects a Target Practice token that is outside the field, they will immediately be granted either the Precision or the Focus buff. The chances of getting Precision buff are 20%, and 80% for Focus buff. *'''[[Passive Abilities#Sniper|[Passive: Sniper]]]''' When fighting mobs, this bee uses slow, long ranged shots that are more accurate and deal x2 damage. The accuracy is calculated as if the bee was 1 level higher (2 if gifted), and it can never be below 5%. If the shot is a [[Critical Hits|Critical Hit]], the reload time after shots is reduced by 50%. If it's a Super-Crit, it's reduced by 75%.

{{Stat|pollen = 20|pollentime = 4|honey = 80|honeytime = 4|rarity = mythic}}

== Gallery == Precise Bee Face.png|Precise Bee's Face. PreciseBeeFace2.PNG|Precise Bee’s original face. Target Practice.png|Precise Bee's Target Practice ability. Precise Bee Target Practice in action.png|Precise Bee's Target Practice in action. NormalTarget.png|An unactivated Precise Target. PurplePreciseTarget.png|A purple Precise Target, hitting only this target in a Target Practice summons a Precise Mark. ActivatedPreciseTarget.png|An activated Precise Target. PreciseBullet.png|The Bullet Precise Bee fires when the player reached a target in its Target Practice. Precise Mark.png|A Precise Mark. Beesmas 2021 Thumbnail.png|Precise Bee in the background with [[Dapper Bear]], [[Basic Bee]], and [[Buoyant Bee]]. Precise Pack.png|Precise Bee's depiction in the Precise Pack. GiftedPreciseSlot.png|A gifted Precise Bee slot.

== Trivia == * Excluding Event bees, this bee, [[Demon Bee]] and [[Fire Bee]] are the only red bees currently in the game whose favorite treat is not strawberries. ** This is the only red Mythic Bee who doesn’t like strawberries. * The Precise Bee is the only Mythic Bee that does not have a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] ability. * Precise Bee's attack is based on a long-ranged weapon with a sharp scope, such as a sniper. * This is the only bee that can attack [[mobs]] from outside the standard bee range, and likewise the only bee that shoots projectiles towards hostile mobs to deal damage. * This bee's attack changes appearance when landing a Critical Hit or Super-Crit. It fires a bigger projectile when landing a Critical Hit, and fires a purple projectile when landing a Super-Crit. This makes Precise Bee the only bee to have a standard attack that changes depending on whether a Critical hit (Or Super-Crit) are rolled. * This bee, Buoyant Bee, and [[Fuzzy Bee]] are the only mythic bees to be added since the release of the original three Mythic bees, which are [[Vector Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]] and [[Spicy Bee]]. Precise Bee and Buoyant Bee were both added in the 12/26/2021 update. * This bee, Vector Bee, Spicy Bee and Buoyant Bee all have glowing parts when gifted. ** This bee is the only bee that has a part of their body that glows even if it is not gifted. * This, along with Tabby Bee, are the only bees that have an ability that grants Super-Critical chance. * This bee is the only bee to always hit a level 26 mob (27 if gifted) when it is level 25. Its passive guarantees that it never misses against mobs one level higher (two if gifted.) * Unlike Fuzz Bombs and Bubbles, players cannot activate each other's targets. ** The Precise Bee target practice of other players is seen as gray to prevent confusion on which one is the player's. ** If the "Hide Other Bees" option were activated, other player's targets will be invisible instead. * This bee, [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Photon Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], and [[Ninja Bee]] are the only bees that have a trail. * There used to be a [[Glitches|glitch]] with Gifted Precise Bee's Precise Mark, that even after the farthest target is activated, it is supposed to summon the mark, but it often doesn't spawn. Another glitch can occur where when a target is hit, it does not function which commonly occur due to server lag. **After giving [[Gifted Riley Bee]] a {{Cost|Present|||}} during the Beesmas 2022 Event, [[Gifted Riley Bee]] says about how people would die for a Precise Mark, possibly referencing this specific bug. * Precise Bee's attack can still be seen by other Players even if they have their Hide Other Bees option on. * Factoring in the Passive and the Attack, this Bee has the Highest Attack Damage, only surpassed by Gummy Bee when the Gummy Bear Morph ability is active.

{{RemovedContent}} ''This article is about the gifts given to NPCs. Not to be confused with [[Ornament Presents]] and [[Gift Boxes]].'' {{Consumables |image = Present.png |description = A festively wrapped gift. Exchange it with an NPC for prizes! |cooldown = (None) }} A {{Color|Present}} is a Beesmas-exclusive [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that appears in every [[Beesmas]] event since 2020 following its debut in 2018 and hiatus in 2019. Presents can be given to most NPCs in the game in exchange for various prizes from the NPC. Each NPC can only receive one gift.

To give a present, the player needs to talk to an NPC of their choice. When interacted with, special dialogue will appear, allowing the player to give the present to the chosen NPC. If the player does not have a present in their inventory or have already recently given said NPC a present, normal dialogue will display. Some NPCs, such as [[Gummy Bear]], [[Bubble Bee Man]] and [[Onett]], have other requirements for the player before it allows itself to receive a gift. Gummy bear requires the player to complete his Beesmas quest, while Onett requires the player to have completed Star Journey One to receive a present. Bubble Bee Man requires the player to have given a present to all other NPCs before allowing itself to receive a present.

[[Category:Pages that uses original tabber]] 2024 (Winter)= Presents returned once again in Beesmas 2024 (Winter). They still have their main function of adding [[Ornaments]] to the [[Beesmas Tree]] when given to NPCs, but can now be given to [[Sun Bear]].

A present for me? How thoughtful! I wonder what it could be... ...(krumple krumple)... Wow! It's a Vicious Bee themed back scratcher! The prongs look like [Stingers]. Yikes! I've never been a fan of Vicious Bee. It's straight up scary and rude. But my arms are pretty short, so this will really come in handy. Thanks! I've got gifts for you as well! Including the [Honey Jar Ornament]! With this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Sunflower Field and +5% Honey Per Pollen! It's a picture of my cubs having fun at camp! Boy do I miss them. This'll help though! Thank you so much! I've got some presents for you as well, including the [Stuffed Heart Ornament]! With that on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Strawberry Field and +10% Pollen from Bee Gathering! Make sure to cherish the time with your bees this Beesmas! That's what it's all about! |- |Brown Bear |Brrrr, it's cold!

But not too cold for us to exchange gifts! So what is it, huh? What'd you get ol' Brown Bear? ...(krumple krumple)... Whoa! A 12 month subscription to ChatGPBee! Not sure exactly how I'll use this, but I'll try it out! Maybe it can come up with quests to give you. Or maybe it can just keep me company. Thanks bud! Now look at what I got you, including the [Royal Jelly Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Clover Field And +20% Pollen from "Bomb" abilities! Happy Beesmas! |- |Panda Bear |Hmm...

A gift? Oh, that's kind of you. I'll open it now. ...(krumple krumple)... WHOA! It's 5 [Invigorating Vials]! With these, I can instantly gain Invigorating Nectar to temporarily boost my attack power. Thanks! Well I can't take something without giving you something back. I got you a few gifts, including the [Boxing Glove Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Bamboo Field And +5% Bee Attack Power! Stay safe out there, and Merry Beesmas. |- |Science Bear |Beesmas is amazing! But it sure keeps us busy.

Oh, of course! Time to exchange our gifts. Let’s see what you’ve brought me... Fascinating! It's a 3D Printer! Imagine all the useful tools I'll be able to make with this. Like, hmm... I'll come up with some. Anyways, now for your gift: the [Conical Flask] ornament! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you’ll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Pineapple Patch And +25% Convert Rate at the Hive! That ought to help make this Beesmas productive. Thanks again for all your help. Happy Honeydays! |- |Polar Bear |I'm just happy it's winter.

My cousin Bee Bear's entire identity is centered around Beesmas. At first our family thought it was weird, but we've become supportive over the years. Beesmas brings Bee Bear joy and gives him a sense of purpose. Who are we to judge? We all have our quirks. Me, I'm obsessed with cooking. So I hope you brought a cooking related gift! Come on, let me see what you brought. ...(krumple krumple)... Niiiice! An air fryer! I've been wanting one of these for ages. This can crisp up some stuff fast, and'll let me cut back on [Oil]. Now for your gift! The [Cast Iron Skillet] Ornament! With this on the tree, you'll receive these boosts: +25% Convert Rate And +3% Pollen from Colorless Bees! Works for their gathering and abilities! Well, good luck on the rest of your Bee Bear quests. Merry Beesmas! |- |Dapper Bear |You're free to warm yourself up in my shop.

Somehow I knew you'd get something for me this year. We're on the same page. I've been thinking about you too. I'll go ahead and open my gift now. ...(krumple krumple)... Ah, cool! An incense stand. Now, I just so happened to get you something fragrant as well: the [Potpourri Ornament]. It's filled with flowers and leaves I grew in my Planters. Smells like Beesmas! With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Dandelion Field And +5% Nectar. Hope you like it. Happy Honeydays! |- |Onett |Is it snowing? I can't tell from in this... cave..
