A [Present] for me? I'll try to act surprised! Oh boy, here I go opening it... ...(krumple krumple)... Nice! It's the bottle of sublingual melatonin tablets that I totally didn't order for myself! You know, in some parts of the world this stuff is difficult to get. RX, even. Crazy, right? Cause I can't sleep without it. Anyways, thanks! And here's my gift to you: Bringing Beesmas back this December when I said I wouldn't, and actually having the holiday-themed update overlap with Christmas. ... Just kidding! It's the [Candy Cane Reindeer Ornament]! With this on the Beesmas tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity on the Mountain Top Field and +20% Pollen from Tools! Hope your Honeydays are full of fun and quality time with those you love. Merry Beesmas! |- |Spirit Bear |Mmmm...mhmm...(she's murmuring to herself with her eyes close [sic])...

''-Present Given-''

I've been counting [Snowflakes] all day as they fall onto the fields. (Yawn). Oh, it's quite hypnotic! I keep losing count because, well, it's like counting sheep. At one point, though, I counted. What was it... Over 50 [Snowflakes]? I lost count that time because of a Snow Storm. I mean, I can't keep up with that. ... Snow everywhere, like frosting on our Beesmas cake! Decorated with all those delightful contraptions this year. Like that wreath. Hehehh, Black Bear, bless his heart. Look at that Honey Wreath. I won't say more... Oh but Mother Bear's Gingerbread House! Oh, I like that one. ...(she's staring into the distance)... Is that a [Snowflake]? Or... Hmm. I'm tired of counting. I'm bored now. Why bother with something so mundane, in the most exciting time of the year! Bee Bear, oh that precious fool. Don't tell him I called him a fool. Not that he would mind. To think that we mere mortal bears could offend a honeyday deity. Anyways, that sweet, jovial bear, he brightens up the entire mountain in the darkest days of the year. How did we even make it through the winters before him? Well, I mean, I do remember... It wasn't so bad. We just celebrated, we just didn't focus so much on the bees. Not that you bees don't deserve it! Bee Bear is completely right about that. We celebrated the passing of the year in a more general sense. We still ate a lot of the same food, did similar customs, it just felt a little more... off the cusp. We still put ornaments on a tree, you see, we just didn't have a special name for it. Or did we? Hmmm... Was it... Oh, like I'll ever remember. Mother always had a tree, and we dolled it up for winter. Left it up much longer than we probably should have, we were never... punctual. But it was always so, so full of ornaments! Everyone was jealous of our tree. Perhaps the only time our hoarding tendencies were a source of envy. Hah! And things really took off as Beesmas became more and more of a thing. Mother couldn't help herself, any time she saw an ornament on sale. Mmhmm. And some of those - completely unnecessary, Mother. The only thing more imposing than our tree was the size of our debt. How did we even get approved for so many credit cards? Yaach... But it was worth it. You can't put a price on Beesmas Magic. Well, you can, sort of. Just take a look on Bee Bear's Catalog. But you understand what I mean. Those debts are long gone, and here I am countless years later and still reminiscing about our trees. Mother's taste for ornaments - they were well considered. ...(she's staring off into the distance)... ...31... Or was it? Drats. I've lost count again. I can't help myself! I just see the [Snowflakes] and I just start... But it's too hard! And it's boring. Let's do something else. What have you come to see me about, anyhow, dear? What's that you're holding - it's for me? Oh! A gift! Will you open it for Spirit Bear? My hands are full, you know. And sore. ...(You open the present for Spirit Bear)... ...(krumple krumple)... Oh no! Oh no no no! This - this is just too much! It's a Windy Bee Bobble Head! So silly! Looks just like you, doesn't it? ... ...(shes [sic] staring off in the distance)... Yes it does. OK, goodbye now. ... Oh! YOUR gift! Yes yes I have one for you! A few things, actually. Including my [Memory Match Ornament]! With that on the tree, well, I don't quite recall what it does. You can check the tree yourself. (Yawn). First, why not check out that strange [Snowflake] in the Dandelion Field. Merry Beesmas, dear! |- |Robo Bear |(click click click click click)

''-Present Given-''

CHARITABLE GIFT DETECTED. I did not foresee this event occurring! >>Commencing Unwrapping Sequence ...(krumple krumple)... I have received: USB C to USB C Cable, Type C 60W (3.1A) Fast Charging Cable (20FT, 2Pack) Compatible with beePhone 16+16 Pro / beePad Mini 6 / beeBook Pro / Beesung S24+S24 Ultra / + More (USB 2.0, Green). I will be able to utilize these. I have many compatible USB C ports. Thank You! [sic] In return, I will grant you this: The [Digital Pet Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +10% Capacity +25% Capacity in the Spider Field +10% Pollen from Event Bees and +5% Pollen from Duped Abilities! >> GIFT EXCHANGE SEQUENCE COMPLETE: OUTCOME SUCCESS |- |Gifted Riley Bee |I should have built a roof like Bucko Bee...

''-Present Given-''

NUH-UH! You didn’t! You DID! Let me open it, let me open it! ...(krumple krumple)... Alright! Some rechargeable wing warmers!!! Between these and the candles, I MIGHT be able to make it through this stupid, cold, long winter. Just barely. Thank you!! Now here's your gift: the [Electric Candle Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you’ll receive these boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Rose and Mushroom Field and +15% Pollen from Flames! Merry Beesmas! Now if you’ll excuse me, I’m gonna go warm up my flappers. |- |Gifted Bucko Bee |Looks chilly out there!

''-Present Given-''

Wait, don't tell me you've brought a [Present]? Of all the beekeepers I've met, you really are the coolest! One second, let me just try to unwrap this with my wings somehow... ...(krumple krumple)... What's this? Oooh, it's a jigsaw puzzle! Looks like it's supposed to be a picture of the ocean against a blue sky. Man, that's a lot of blue... might be tricky. I'll try my best! Thanks! And now some gifts for you, including the [Snowman Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Blue Flower Field and Pine Tree Forest and +15% Pollen from Bubbles! Hope that helps! Merry blue Beesmas! |- |Stick Bug |You beekeepers are funny with your seasonal traditions.

''-Present Given-''

I won't judge though. We all move to our own beat. So, let's see what you've brought me. ...(krumple krumple)... It's a pair of boutique double sided headphones! You know, the major players in the headphones space have been really slacking. Innovative new start-ups run by passionate audiophiles are on the up and up! These have been getting awesome reviews. I'll put them to good use. Now for your gift: it's the [Partridge in a Stick Bug Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll receive the following buffs: +25% Convert Rate... +25% Capacity on the Cactus Field and Pepper Patch... And +5% Gifted Bee Pollen. But that'll have to wait. |- |Sun Bear |I'm just chilling.

''-Present Given-''

Really cool of you to think of giving a [Present] to a tourist like me! Guess as long as I'm here, I should participate in the festivities. Well, what'd you get me? ...(krumple krumple)... Haha! It's a Bee Swarm Simulator bumper sticker! This'll go great on the back of my RV. Another fine piece of my traveling memorabilia. And hey, I'm no jerk. Of course I got you something too: It's the [Steering Wheel Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +5% Pollen from Legendary Bees And +5% Ability Token Lifespan! That thing's one of a kind. Consider yourself lucky. I'm glad I stuck around! Merry Beesmas, as they say around here! |- |Honey Bee |Bzz zzz zzuh...

''-Present Given-''

Bzzz buz ZZ! ZZZZZ BZZ BZZZZ!!! ...(krumple krumple)... (You open up the [Present] for Honey Bee) (The box contains a singular honey token) BUZZZZZZZUH BZZZZZZZ! Bzz zz zz! (Honey Bee's eye ''[sic]'' open wide with joy) (You can tell it's very grateful) Bzzzz zzz buzz bz BUZ zz. (Honey Bee pulls out a platic ''[sic]'' bag full of honey) (Inside floats a crude plastic figurine of Honey Bee) Zzzz! (You can sense that with this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts:) (+25% Convert Rate) (+10% Epic Bee Pollen) (+10% Honey From Tokens) (And +1% Honey Per Goo) Bzz zuh Buzz buzz BuzzZuhz (Honey Bee smiles warmly) |- |Gummy Bear |A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee!

''-If the player does not meet the requirements-''

A box wrapped in colorful paper... a gift? You believe you're worthy of exchanging gifts with US? HAH We do not accept trifles from meager meat-based civilians. Prove yourself by completing our quest and we may reconsider.

''-If the player has completed his quest-''

What is that in your two hands, Gummy Soldier? A customary delivery... A gesture of GOO-d will. Gummy Bee and I permit you to open it for us. ...(krumple krumple)... AH! A bottle of cannon cleaner! Properly maintaining your Gummy cannon is essential to a successful invasion. We will be putting this to good use! In exchange, my gooey grunt, I give you this: The [Gummy Globe Ornament]! Let it serve as a constant reminder that better days WILL COME. And the unbearably bitter and salty states of all worlds will give way to a SWEET future. All worlds will be GOOnited when Gummy Bee and I are through. And with that ornament on your wooden plant, you'll receive the following boosts to aid in our GOO CRUCADE. +10% Capacity +25% Coconut Field Capacity +1% Super-Crit Chance And +10% GOO! Now go GOO UP the pathetic Beesmas festivities once and for all! |- |Bubble Bee Man |Bub bub bub

''-If the player does not meet the requirements-''

Ooooh... uh... Ok, well. Yeah, first, thanks. But uhhh no thanks. No. Just no. I mean, er... I'm the one whose supposed to make you give the gifts. You give them out, you spread that Beesmas cheer, that's on you. And, right. Ok so you're doing that now, but don't do it to me. I don't need gifts, like - What's the point? What? Have you given a present to everyone else yet?? Huh? Huh?? Huh? ... I didn;'t; [sic] think so

''-If the player has delivered everyone a present-'' Huhhhhh you did it. You actally did it You gave a [Present] to everyone else; And now you've got one left over Well ill be an offsale hat the madman. The legend. Good on ya good on y a Nd now its my turn. ...(krumple krumple)... this box contains nothing but 6 mirrors glued to each side I gaze inside the box and see myself from multiple angles i hardly recognize myself,., I wonder if this is really how peopple see me i Question if my left eyes pupil has always had white popping through like that I wonder why my nose consists of so few polygons (cough) I ask myself, why does my skin look like that I ask myself, if im an immortal honeyday god, why do i look so frail i feel it for the first time. The urgency of mortality The horror of corporeal embodiment--that i am only what i see, From a multitude of angles. that each mirror reflects just a small glimpse of that totality/ A totality that I cant deny and I don't know if like that. .. Thank you. This was the greatest gift of all' the gift of self-reflection............. ,..... Sorry, having a moment here .... So take my gift to you its,its the best thing I got it's. Well, just, juest go look at the tree.. And leave myself, alone, with the reflection of me merry besmas |}

==Trivia == During Beesmas 2021, players who had given a present to [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] before 01/06/22 would be refunded with their present due to a bug with the Bag of Honey Ornament's boost. Stick Bug, Gifted Riley Bee, and Gifted Bucko Bee require a {{Cost|Translator|||0}} before giving them a present. At some point, Onett could not be given a present immediately as he required the completion of the Star Journey questline to claim the reward. This is no longer the case, at least during the 2024 winter event. Gummy Bear was the only other NPC who required the player to complete his quest before giving him a present. On Christmas, Onett gave players a free present along with other prizes. The present was able to be obtained any day until the x2 event ended. To receive the gift, the player had to claim a hive during the x2 event. There were 11 presents in Beesmas 2018: 6 from Bee Bear, 3 from locations, 1 from Onett from the Beesmas x2 event, and 1 from the code "ByeBeeBear" (Expired). However, only 10 presents could have been used. Stick Bug was the only NPC who didn't give any field boosts when given a present. *When the Beesmas 2018 event ended, the present token in the 30 Bee Zone was replaced by an {{Cost|Enzymes}} token.

''-Present Given-''

Well, it's Beesmas again! We do it every year now. You know, Beesmas isn't originally a Bee Swarm thing. It was started out by Mah_Bucket and zKevin, out of their love for Bubble Bee Man presumably. Bee Swarm Simulator was involved in their 2018 Beesmas event. After that, it sort of became part of the Bee Swarm Sim lore too. It's convenient, because it references a real holiday without being too specific. For example, it doesn't matter if we celebrate Beesmas after the real Christmas. I mean, whose to say Beesmas doesn't actually take place in February, right? Hmm... Yeah OK... Anyways, what did you and Bee Bear bring me this year? ...(krumple krumple)... Wow! A whole basket of Korean skin care products! As I get older, skin care becomes more and more important. This is perfect! Remember to always wear sunscreen, even in the dead of winter. OK, now your gifts. The [Candy Cane Reindeer Ornament]! And some less important stuff. With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts: +25% Convert Rate; +25% Capacity on the Mountain Top Field; and +20% Pollen from Tools! Keep collecting [Ornaments] to get the most out of this year's Honeyday event! Now I'll get back to singing while you get back to making honey. Merry Beesmas! |- | Spirit Bear |Mmmm...mhmm...(she's murmuring to herself with her eyes close)...

''-Present Given-''

I've been counting [Snowflakes] all day as they fall onto the fields. (Yawn). Oh, it's quite hypnotic! I keep losing count because, well, it's like counting sheep. At one point, though, I counted. What was it... Over 50 [Snowflakes]? I lost count that time because of a Snow Storm. I mean, I can't keep up with that. ... Snow everywhere, like frosting on our Beesmas cake! Decorated with all those delightful contraptions this year. Like that wreath. Hehehh, Black Bear, bless his heart. Look at that Honey Wreath. I won't say more... Oh but Mother Bear's Gingerbread House! Oh, I like that one. ...(she's staring into the distance)... Is that a [Snowflake]? Or... Hmm. I'm tired of counting. I'm bored now. Why bother with something so mundane, in the most exciting time of the year! Bee Bear, oh that precious fool. Don't tell him I called him a fool. Not that he would mind. To think that we mere mortal bears could offend a honeyday deity. Anyways, that sweet, jovial bear, he brightens up the entire mountain in the darkest days of the year. How did we even make it through the winters before him? Well, I mean, I do remember... It wasn't so bad. We just celebrated, we just didn't focus so much on the bees. Not that you bees don't deserve it! Bee Bear is completely right about that. We celebrated the passing of the year in a more general sense. We still ate a lot of the same food, did similar customs, it just felt a little more... off the cusp. We still put ornaments on a tree, you see, we just didn't have a special name for it. Or did we? Hmmm... Was it... Oh, like I'll ever remember. Mother always had a tree, and we dolled it up for winter. Left it up much longer than we probably should have, we were never... punctual. But it was always so, so full of ornaments! Everyone was jealous of our tree. Perhaps the only time our hoarding tendencies were a source of envy. Hah! And things really took off as Beesmas became more and more of a thing. Mother couldn't help herself, any time she saw an ornament on sale. Mmhmm. And some of those - completely unnecessary, Mother. The only thing more imposing than our tree was the size of our debt. How did we even get approved for so many credit cards? Yaach... But it was worth it. You can't put a price on Beesmas Magic. Well, you can, sort of. Just take a look on Bee Bear's Catalog. But you understand what I mean. Those debts are long gone, and here I am countless years later and still reminiscing about our trees. Mother's taste for ornaments - they were well considered. ...(she's staring off into the distance)... ...31... Or was it? Drats. I've lost count again. I can't help myself! I just see the [Snowflakes] and I just start... But it's too hard! And it's boring. Let's do something else. What have you come to see me about, anyhow, dear? What's that you're holding - it's for me? Oh! A gift! Will you open it for Spirit Bear? My hands are full, you know. And sore. ...(You open the present for Spirit Bear)... ...(krumple krumple)... Oh no! Oh no no no! This - this is just too much! It's a Baby [you know who] Ornament! From the outer space show! Everyone's favorite little green alien, the tiny space wizard, in a replica of his floating crib. It's so cute I could cry! Thank you, dear, thank you! This is going on the top of my tree next year, the very top is where little [alien wizard] belongs. ... ..(she's staring off into the distance)... Mmhmm, the very top. ... OK, goodbye now. ... Oh! YOUR gift! Yes yes I have one for you! A few things, actually. Including my [Memory Match Ornament]! With that on the tree, well, I don't quite recall what it does. You can check the tree yourself. (Yawn). First, why not check out that strange [Snowflake] in the Dandelion Field. Merry Beesmas, dear! |- |Honey Bee | Bzz zzz zzuh... ''-Present Given-''

Bzzz buz ZZ! ZZZZZ BZZ BZZZZ!!! ...(krumple krumple)... (You open up the [Present] for Honey Bee) (The box is filled to the brim with honey) BUZZZZZZZUH BZZZZZZZ! Bzz zz zz! (Honey Bee's eye open wide with joy) (You can tell it's very grateful) Bzzzz zzz buzz bz BUZ zz. (Honey Bee pulls out a plastic bag full of honey) (Inside floats a crude plastic figurine of Honey Bee) Zzzz! (You can sense that with this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts:) (+10% Convert Rate) (+10% Capacity) (+5% Mark Duration) (And +10% Honey From Tokens) Bzz zuh Buzz buzz BuzzZuhz (Honey Bee smiles warmly) |- |Gifted Bucko Bee | I'm just happy it's Winter.

''-Present Given-''

Wait, don't tell me you've brought a [Present]? Of all the beekeepers I've met, you really are the coolest! One second, let me just try to unwrap this with my wings somehow... ...(krumple krumple)... Oh, it's a [Snow Tiara] Beequip! Well, this is a little awkward... Bucko Bees can't equip [Snow Tiaras]. But don't worry. I've got plenty of blue bee friends here at the HQ who will make great use out of this! Thanks! And now some gifts for you, including the [Snowman Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: (+25% Convert Rate) (+25% Capacity in the Blue Flower Field and Pine Tree Forest) and (+10% Blue Field Capacity!) Hope that helps! Merry blue Beesmas! |- |Gifted Riley Bee | Bucko Bee better not use that Snow Machine! It's TOO DANG COLD!

''-Present Given-''

NUH-UH! You didn't! You DID! Let me open it, let me open it! ...(krumple krumple)... OH. MY. GOSH! It's a bPad Air!, 4th generation!!! The newest model! Bubble Bee Man must have gotten my letter this year. He went all out! I can use this to play ROBLOX, and Bee Swarm Simulator! Man, now I feel silly. I got you a gift too, but it's not even in the same league. Hope you'll like it anyways. It includes the [Electric Candle Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts: (+25% Convert Rate) (+25% Capacity in the Rose and Mushroom Forest) and (+10% Pollen from Flames!) Merry Beesmas! Now if you'll excuse me, I've gotta set up my bPad, oh boy oh boy. |- |Stick Bug |You beekeepers are funny with your seasonal traditions. ''-Present Given-''

If you're having a tough year, remember things'll get better. Life is full of ups and downs. It's a bumpy ride, just gotta hang on tight. So, what did you bring me? ...(krumple krumple)... Hah! It's a wind-up "Get Stick Bugged" figurine. Yeah, of course I like that meme. Feels good to force even the non-beekeepers to hear my song when they least expect it. Speaking of, you better put this [Ornament] on the tree fast. |- |Gummy Bear |A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee! -''If the player does not meet the requirements-''

A box wrapped in colorful paper... a gift? You believe you're worthy of exchanging gifts with US? HAH We do not accept trifles from lowly MEATY FEET creatures. Prove yourself and we may reconsider.

''-Present Given-''

What is that in your two hands, Gummy Soldier? A customary delivery... A gesture of GOO-d will. Gummy Bee and I will permit you to open it for us. ...(krumple krumple)... OH! You've brought live ammunition. A case of hand GOO-nades! How EXPLOSIVELY sweet. I will put these to good use gumming up a village or two. KABOOM! In exchange, my gooey grunt, I give you this: The [Gummy Globe Ornament]! Let it serve as a constant reminder that better days WILL COME. And the unbearably bitter and salty status of all worlds will give way to a SWEET future. ALL worlds will be GOOnited when Gummy Bee and I are through. And with that ornament on your wooden plant, you'll receive the following boosts to aid in our GOO CRUCADE. +10% Capacity +25% Coconut Field Capacity +1% Critical Chance And +10% Goo! Now go GOO UP the pathetic Beesmas festivities once and for all! |- |Bubble Bee Man | Err... um.. ''-Present Given-''

Look, I'll ONLY take this if you've already given one to everyone else. Like, the whole point of Beesmas is that I'm giving gifts to others... Err.. Well, I'm using other people, to give gifts to the bees. No... I'm... I'm not using anyone, it's not like that. Bee Bear and I have a job (?) Basically, get other people to give gifts to eachother sic That's the "spirit" of Beesmas. Right? Right? Right? Uhh... Oh.. you did give a [Present] to everyone else? OK fine. I'll take this one then. ...(krumple krumple)... What is... is this a joke? Do you think this is funny? Is Beesmas some sort of joke to you? Look - we don't have to agree on everything, but Beesmas is like, my beliefs OK? And we are all entitled to our own beliefs, and we should all respect one another. Like, why would you even give this to me? Seriously, are you daft? Stuff like this is why you're on the Naughty List. Just... just take your rewards and get out of here. I would say Merry Beesmas, but why bother? ... Sorry... I guess I... overreacted a little... But, umm... Let's just leave it at that. |} [[Category:Removed Content]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Events]]

{{RemovedContent}} Presents returned in Beesmas 2021. They function the same as the years before that they have appeared in, but can now be given to the new NPC, [[Dapper Bear]]. Presents must be given to obtain [[Ornaments]] from NPCs, and they will be needed to be delivered to do quests from [[Bee Bear]].

===Ways to obtain=== Obtained by completing Quests from [[Bee Bear]]. Buying one from [[Bee Bear’s Catalog]]. * Receiving one (from Onett) upon claiming a hive first time after New Year's Day 2022. *Obtaining one from the Galentine's Shrine.

Happy Honeydays! |- |Mother Bear |The Honeydays bring the bees so much joy!

With this on the tree, you’ll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Strawberry Field And +10% Pollen from Bees! Now of you’ll excuse me, I’m going to go fill these up! |- |Brown Bear |Man, it's cold!

Stay safe out there, and Merry Beesmas. |- |Science Bear |Beesmas is amazing! But it sure keeps us busy.

Oh, of course! Time to exchange our gifts. Let’s see what you’ve brought me...Fascinating! A BI-84 scientific calculator! These reliable devices are the standard for universities. Despite being unchanged for over 15 years, they still sell for their original price! Anyways, now for your gifts! Some [Gumdrops], [Neonberries]...And the [Conical Flask] ornament! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you’ll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Pineapple Patch And +25% Convert Rate at the Hive! That ought to help make this Beesmas productive. Thanks again for all your help. Happy Honeydays! |- |Polar Bear |I'm just happy it's Winter.

Now for your gift Some [Enzymes], [Gingerbread Bears]... And the [Cast Iron Skillet] Ornament! Guess you'll be relieved to hear that I do in fact dabble in books, And I often turn to history as a primary source for inspiration. Thanks, cool stranger. Would you think it weird if I had some gifts waiting for you too? If you did - I wouldn't mind. The fragrance is pretty strong... but hey, smells like Beesmas. With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Dandelion Field, And +5% Nectar. You're not the only one who judges a book by it's cover. That's why I think we'll be good friends soon enough.

|- |Onett |Is it snowing? I can't tell from in this... cave..

Merry Beesmas, dear! |- | Honey Bee |Bzz zzz zzuh... ''-Present Given-''

But that'll have to wait. |- | Gummy Bear |A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee! -''If the player does not meet the requirements-''

In exchange, my gooey grunt, I give you this: The [Gummy Globe Ornament]! Let it serve as a constant reminder that better days WILL COME. And the unbearably bitter and salty states of all worlds will give way to a SWEET future. ALL worlds will be GOOnited when Gummy Bee and I are through. And with that ornament on your wooden plant, you'll receive the following boosts to aid in our GOO CRUCADE. +10% Capacity +25% Coconut Field Capacity +1% Critical Chance And +10% Goo! Now go GOO UP the pathetic Beesmas festivities once and for all! |- |Bubble Bee Man |😐 ''-If the player does not meet the requirements-''

Ooooh... uh... Ok, well. Yeah, first, thanks. But uhhh no thanks. No. Just no. I mean, er... I'm the one whose supposed to make you give the gifts. You give them out, you spread that Beesmas cheer, that's on you. And, right. Ok so you're doing that now, but don't do it to me. I don't need gifts, like - What's the point? What? Have you given a present to everyone else yet?? Huh? Huh?? Huh? ... I didn;'t; think so

''-If the player has delivered everyone a present-''

Wow... so you're really out of characters to give presents too [sic]... Kind of suspicious Not going to lie. I mean, uhhhhhhhhhh Thaaaaaaaanks... Friend... Just, er, could you open it for me I don't really have a body ...(krumple krumple)... Oh, it's a, it's a $10 Roblox gift card. I've never played ROBLOX. I'm a man, not a baby. I mean uh - I mean - that came out kind of mean... You're not a baby. You're, uh.. you're Bee Bear's special helper (cough) And thanks to you and your cool bee swarm™, everyone got a cool present this year. And uh, yeah. I guess the spirit of Beesmas is, it's a good thing right ... So, like, do you want this gift card? Actually wait, no I'll... I'm going to sell it... sorry, but thanks. Bye. |} [[Category:Removed Content]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Events]]

===Dialogue=== {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !NPC !Dialogue |- | Black Bear |Oh, hello there! ''-Present Given-''

What've you gotten me this year? I'll bet it's something special ...(krumple krumple)... Wow! 12 Honey-glazed donuts, with Beesmas sprinkles!! You know, they don't use the best honey on these things. Companies are always trying to cut cost. But I'm not complaining. I'll savor these for sure! Thank you so much! Now here's your present: it's the [Honey Jar Ornament]! With this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Sunflower Field and +5% Honey Per Pollen! Enjoy! And Happy Honeydays! |- |Mother Bear |The honeydays bring the bees so much joy! ''-Present Given-''

Oh! What's this? A present for me? You're the sweetest! ...(krumple krumple)... Oooh! An adorable Puppy Bee Pillow! The Puppy Bee and I share a special connection: we're both about bond with bees. That was very thoughtful of you! No [Reindeer Antlers] on it though. Maybe next year? wink wink Hehe. Well, I've also got some gifts for you: A [Gingerbread Bear}, ''[sic]'' some [Glitter]... And the [Stuffed Heart Ornament]! With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Strawberry Field and +10% Pollen from Bees! Can't wait to test my new pillow out tonight. Merry Beesmas! |- |Brown Bear |Man, it's cold! ''-Present Given-''

Maybe your present will help warm me up! Can't wait to find out. ...(krumple krumple)... Whoa! A $25 Ubear Eats gift card! I'm ordering some warm soup and hot cocoa right away. I hope they deliver to ROBLOX games... Thanks bud. Now check out what I got you, some [Royal Jelly], A [Glue]... And the [Royal Jelly Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Clover Field and +20% Pollen from "bomb" abilities! Happy Beesmas! |- |Panda Bear |Hmm... ''-Present Given-''

I can't help but feel like there's something wrong this Beesmas. Something... robotic and menacing. Let's exchange presents quickly. We might not have much time. ...(krumple krumple)... Nice! A bamboo baseball bat! This could help if things get sketchy. If that robot over there gets up to no good, I'll give it a few good WHACKS. Now you take this: the [Boxing Glove Ornament]. I got you a few gifts, including the [Boxing Glove Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll recieve the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Bamboo Field And +5% Bee Attack Power! Stay alert! I don't trust that Robo Bear... |- |Science Bear |Beesmas is amazing! But it sure keeps us busy.

''-Present Given-''

This is a good time to go ahead and exchange our gifts, though. Let's see what you brought me... ...(krumple krumple... Fascinating! A very peculiar sort of green [Cog]. You found it on the flowers you say? Hmm... Could this be related to the Robo Bear who recently appeared on the mountain? I'll have to investigate more. For now take these gifts: A [White Balloon], an [Atomic Treat]... And the [Conical Flask] ornament! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Pineapple Patch and +25% Convert Rate at the Hive! That ought to help make your beesmas productive. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to go run some tests. |- |Polar Bear |I'm just happy it's Winter.

''-Present Given-''

My cousin Bee Bear's been all about Beesmas for as long as I can remember. I used to worry about his obsession. But I've grown to accept it. At the end of the day, he brings joy to tons of beekeepers. I aim to do the same thing through my cooking. We aren't so different. Anyways, let's see what you brought me! ...(krumple krumple)... Oooh yeah! A cog-operated Blender! Finally, a blender that's not taller than I am. The one in the Badge Bearer's Guild is ridiculous. Do you know how hard it's been to make soups in ''[sic]'' smoothies in that thing? How many hours I've spent wiping that thing down? Well no more! This gift will change my life. Now for your present! Some [Oil], [Gingerbread Bears]... And the [Cast Iron Skillet] Ornament! With this on the tree, you'll receive the these boosts: +25% Convert Rate +25% Capacity in the Pumpkin Patch And +10% White Field Capacity! Well, good luck on the rest of your Bee Bear quests. Happy honeydays! |- |Dapper Bear |You're free to warm yourself up in my shop. ''-Present Given-''

Somehow I knew you'd get something for me this year. We're on the same page. I've been thinking about you too. I'll go ahead and open my gift now. ...(krumple krumple)... Ah hah, a funky little Bumble Bee pin for my lapel! I don't usually like accessories as gifts - I prefer to pick my own. But this one hits the right spot. Thank you! Now why don't you open mine? There's a few things in there: A [Ticket Planter], a vial of [Motivating Nectar]... ''[sic]'' And the [Potpourri Ornament]. It's filled with flowers and leaves I grew in my Planters. The fragrance is pretty strong... but hey, smells like Beesmas. With this on the tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Dandelion Field, And +5% Nectar. Hope you like it. I know I'll be flaunting this pin around for weeks. Thanks again, and Happy Honeydays. |- |Onett | 3 months of Beesmas! Yipee.

''-Present Given-''

A [Present]! What a surprise! I bet you're giving this to me because you've heard I give the best gifts back. That doesn't mean I don't appreciate it! Of course I do. Come on. Uhh... let's just continue. ...(krumple. krumple)... Wow!! A finger painting of Basic Bee! And there's a Rascal Bee! They look like they're fighting a... is that an Armored Aphid? OH! A Cogmower! Of course. This is going straight on my refridgerator. My gift's handmade too, but not quite as impressive. It's the [Candy Cane Reindeer Ornament]! +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity on the Mountain Top Field and +20% Pollen from Tools! I also got you an assortment of beans. No [Festive Bean] though... Anyways, good luck with Robo Bear. Thanks for the painting. Merry Beesmas! |- | Spirit Bear |Mmmmmhm... Lots of robots around all of a sudden Making a lot of noise. ... Whenever they walk around, I swear Sounds like an elephant falling down escalator. Not a very considerate sound, hm? ... And my ears aren't even that good Mmmhm...No good. I've never been a huge fan of machines. I don't like how they move so sharply. So abruptly, yet so precisely. There's no flow to it. It's a type of cold, calculated movement that could break your bones Without even realizing it! Imagine getting your fingers pinched in one of those cogs. Oooh, sends a shiver down my spine. And the noises! Achk. Just as sharp! Just as sudden! The types of noises that, sure, may be found in nature But only on rare occasions. Usually dangerous ones. Earthquakes. Thunderstorms. The culminated cries of accumulated forces. Not birdsong! Not background noise! ... I'm whining. I'll stop. Anyways, what brings you up here? What's that behind your back? Is it what I think it is? A [Present] for me! I was beginning to think that you forgot. Silly me! Will you open it for spirit bear? ...(krumple krumple)... Ooooo! What I it? ...A bracelet? No, no. Oooh, I see! A sleeping eye mask, shaped like a cloud! How precious! Oh, and so soft! As if I didn't sleep enough already, heheh. Thank you, dear. very thoughtful of you. I'll test it out as soon as you take off. ... Oh, but I can't leave you empty handed. I prepared a small basket of gifts for you Including the [Memory Match Ornament]! The one I won myself in a Memory Match tournament back in... Some time long ago, I don't remember exactly. It says on the ornament. With that on the tree you will receive the following boosts: +25% Convert rate +25% Capacity in the Stump Field And +500% Pollen! ... No, that can't be right. Sorry. Let me check. ... Ah. It's +5% Pollen from Bee Abilities. Still useful. (Yawn) Enjoy! Now if you'll excuse me... I'd like to try this mask out. |- |Robo Bear | (click click click click click) ''-Present Given-''

CHARITABLE GIFT DETECTED. I did not foresee this event occurring! >>Commencing Unwrapping Sequence ...(krumple krumple)... It appears I've been gifted a [Yellow Drive]! These are unfortunately incompatible with my motherboard. But I acknowledge and appreciate this gesture of camaraderie. In return I will grant you this: The [Digital Pet Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in Spider Field, +10% Pollen from Event Abilities and +5% Pollen from Duped Abilities! Thank you generous beekeeper. Enjoy your April! |- |Gifted Riley Bee |Bucko Bee better not use that Snow Machine! It's TOO DANG COLD!

-''Present Given-''

WHAT! A GIFT? No way! Youuuuuuuu Well hand it over! Come on! ...(krumple krumple)... Oh... my... gumdrops... A permanent Precise Mark! How did you get this?? Did it just, like, fail to despawn? Man, I know some beekeepers who would DIE for one of these. This is going to raise the Red HQ straight to the top! I got you something too. Not quite as OP though. It's the [Electric Candle Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll recieve these boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Rose Field and Mushroom Field, and +10% Pollen from Flames! Now let's get out there and heat up the Honeydays! RED ROCKS! |- |Gifted Bucko Bee |I'm just happy it's Winter.

''-Present Given-''

Well, if it isn't the coolest beekeeper around! You bringing me a [Present] makes you even cooler. Let's see what it is... ...(krumple krumple)... Well I'll be! An entire gallon of Comforting Nectar! No wonder that thing was so heavy. Soo... I happened to get you some Comforting Nectar as well.. That's just part of my gift though, so this isn't too awkward. The most important part is the [Snowman Ornament]! With that on the Beesmas Tree, you'll recieve the following boosts: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity in the Blue Flower Field and Pine Tree Forest, and +10% Blue Field Capacity! Thanks for the Nectar. Have a merry blue Beesmas! |- |Stick Bug |You flesh bugs are funny with your Beesmas traditions.

''-Present Given-''

Fun to watch though. The nymphs get a kick out of it as well. Ok, let's see what you've brought me. ...(krumple krumple)... Ah hah, clever! A [Robo Pass]! I guess it would be pretty cool to see how my nymphs and I fair ''[sic]'' against those wacky robots. But I unfortunately can't accept. The Robo Bear and I have an arrangement. Can't attack each other. Only you lucky beekeepers. It's the thought that counts, though. Thanks flesh bug. You keep that [Robo Pass], and take this as well: The [Partridge In A Stick Bug Ornament]. With that on the tree, you'll receieve the following buffs: +25% Convert Rate, +25% Capacity on the Cactus Field and Pepper Patch, and +5% Pollen. Put that up on the tree quick so we can have some fun. |- |Honey Bee | Bzz zzz zzuh... ''-Present Given-''

Bzzz buz ZZ! ZZZZZ BZZ BZZZZ!!! ...(krumple krumple)... (You open up the [Present] for Honey Bee) (The box is filled to the brim with honey) BUZZZZZZZUH BZZZZZZZ! Bzz zz zz! (Honey Bee's eye open wide with joy) (You can tell it's very grateful) Bzzzz zzz buzz bz BUZ zz. (Honey Bee pulls out a plastic bag full of honey) (Inside floats a crude plastic figurine of Honey Bee) Zzzz! (You can sense that with this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive these boosts:) (+10% Convert Rate) (+10% Capacity) (+5% Mark Duration) (And +10% Honey From Tokens) Bzz zuh Buzz buzz BuzzZuhz (Honey Bee smiles warmly) |- | Gummy Bear |A beekeeper approaches, Gummy Bee! ''-If the player does not meet the requirements-''

A box wrapped in colorful paper... a gift? You believe you're worthy of exchanging gifts with US? HAH We do not accept trifles from meager meat-based civilians. Prove yourself by completing our quest and we may reconsider.

''-If the player has completed his quest-''

All seasonal customs of you beekeepers will soon be replaced. A sweet, gooey-culture will envelope ALL seasons in time! Beesmas? NOPE! Halloween? DENIED! President's day? President's NO WAY! HAH! Every day will be Gummy Day. And all will know eternal sweetness. But I will accept your [Present], Gummy Soldier. For now... ...(krumple krumple)... Yes... YES! A 3lb Gummy Worm. This is satisfactory. Gummy Bee and I shall absorb it with haste to enhance our powers. Or perhaps I'll launch it out my Gummy Cannon! RAIN A WRATH OF WORMS UPON MY FOES! Yes, many delicious options. Now take this: The [Gummy Globe Ornament]! With that ornament on the pathetic tree of Beesmas, you'll recieve the following boosts: +10% Capacity, +25% Coconut Field Capacity, +1% Super-Crit Chance, and +10% GOO! USE IT WELL! |- |Bubble Bee Man |Bees arent real ''-If the player does not meet the requirements-''

..,. Let me get this straight You want to give a [Present], to me? Errrr.. do you know who I am? are you even aware of TO WHOM YOU ARE CURRENTLY SPEAKING?>? .. sorry So, like, Bee Bear didn't explain it very well this year but I'm basically the god of Beesmas OK, maybe "god" is puttin it too much, but I'm like, I'm the reason for Beesmas. Oth4er than the bees It's complicated but...... Basically it's a waste to give this to me. Right? Give it to someone real. who actually has a body. and can use it. If you end up with an extra after all that, er, maybe I'll take the extra one. but you wprobably wont until you beat rank 25 of the robot cake

''-If the player has completed Rank 25 of the [[Robo Party]]-''

You did it huh? You really did it? You gave a [Present] to every other eligible NPC in this game?? Man. Yowwza. Your,a. Your one of the good ones I guess we dont wanta this one to go to waste er Guess I'm the only one ;left so, hand it over ...(krumple krumple)... Wheres the gift? Theres nothing in here but bubble wrap that's the gift? Bubble wrap? Huh. Ok. I was right about you I... I really love bubble wrap That's how I got my name ........... not really... That was a lie Actually I've been lying a lot/ I don't really care about bubble wrap. But I kind of need some anyways. That's why I told Bee Bear to put blbble wrap in this [Present]. yup. Thats right I already knew what was in the [Present] And all the other ones. Like I said I'm like a Beesmas god I can see it all ... and that's that Pulled a fast one on you. Bet you believe in my now huh You better. Merry beesmas Stay out of trouble kids |} [[Category:Removed Content]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Events]]

... Huh? I'm up, I'm up. Hello. Good to you see you. [sic] Hmm... what? Wait. What's in your hands? Oh! What? Wait a second... (She looks around) Why have you got that? [sic] You could tell me it was October and I'd believe you. Although, I had a suspicion I had forgotten something this year... Hmm. Oh! Wait. (She reaches into her [Petal Bag]) Heheh, I hadn't forgotten at all! I've had a [Present] waiting for you in all along... How long has it been in there? So long I don't even remember what it is! To open this now... willy nilly... whenever... I thought the point of Beesmas gifts was that they were an annual tradition? The rhythms of the seasons, accentuated by the Honeydays, or other customs... Produces a familiar sway that acts as a point of reference, no? For our progress... For our growth... Mmmh. They give the structure to our lives upon which change can grow! Our daily, our monthly, our yearly routines establish themselves like vines on that lattice. So would we dare shake it up!? (Cough) Dare to exchange these NOW? And risk losing that rhythm? Might knock our petals off! Before you know it, you'll be just like me. Lost in a timeless, sleepy fog. No clue what month it is. ... docs.title: Pro Bear
docs.text:
{{Bear |image = Probear.png |type = Shop Bear |location = Pro Shop |bees = 10 |basecolor1 = #cdae37 |basecoloramount = 1 |shadecoloramount = 1 |shadecolor1 = #cdae37 |snoutcoloramount = 1 |snoutcolor1 = #cdae37 |torsocolor1 = #FF0000 |torsocoloramount = 1 |armscolor = #cdae37 |legscolor = #566325 |enableother = n }}'''Pro Bear''' is a [[:Category:Bears|bear]] who runs the [[Pro Shop]]. He is the second shop bear encountered by most players. His presence is not required to purchase [[items]] in the shop.

Pro Bear has a similar appearance to [[Noob Bear]] and [[Top Bear]]: yellow skin, red shirt, green pants, and a smiley face. The only difference between them is the colors of their clothing.

== Trivia == * Pro Bear is one of the four bears in the [[Brave Bee Gate|10 Bee Area]], the others being [[Science Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], and [[Tunnel Bear]]. * This bear, Noob Bear, Top Bear, and [[Shadow Bear]] are the only bears without a function whatsoever. * Behind Pro Bear, there is a [[Mazes#Pro Shop Maze|maze]] that has a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] and [[Sunflower Seeds|sunflower seed]] token and the maze also has a chance to spawn stickers.

The [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteor Shower Summoner]] used to be on top of the shop before being moved in the Trading Update to the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]].

This shop sells four [[Bags]], five [[Tools]], four [[:Category:Guards|Guards]], a [[:Category:Hats|Hat]], a [[:Category:Belts|Belt]], a pair of [[:Category:Boots|Boots]], [[Paper Planter|Paper Planters]], and the [[Parachute]].

== Trivia == * The [[Slingshot]] will sometimes undershoot the player near [[Panda Bear]] or in the middle of the [[Bamboo Field]]. If the Slingshot does not undershoot, it will regularly shoot the player in front of the shop's door. * There are two {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}} tokens, one of them on top of the shop at the end of a dark passage and one within inside the shop, the latter being hidden in the [[Mazes#Pro Shop Maze|Maze]] behind Pro Bear. When they spawned there, the feet of the chick would be visible. * With 18 items, the '''Pro Shop''' has the most purchasable items out of all of the shops. * Out of the three shops that have a shop bear, this is the only one that sells at least 1 type of guard.

docs.title: Public Sticker Board
docs.text:
The '''Public Sticker Board''' is located in the [[Hive Hub]], and allows players to add or take [[sticker]]s from it. There is a 22-hour cooldown for taking a sticker from the board and a 10-minute cooldown for adding a sticker to the board. The [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]] might occasionally require players to donate a sticker to the Public Sticker Board as well. This is a great way of obtaining stickers or removing spare stickers. ==Gallery== EmptyStickerBoard.jpg|An empty Public Sticker Board. Sticker board with stickers.png|An example of stickers on the Public Sticker Board. AboveTradeLimit.png|The popup that appears when a normal player tries to add a Play Button or Game Chat Icon sticker to the Public Sticker Board. FluorescentGiftBox2024.png|The Fluorescent Gift Box located behind the Public Sticker Board.

==Trivia== Play Button and Game Chat Icon stickers cannot typically be donated to the Public Sticker Board. This restriction does not apply to people who can give out these stickers. *If a player takes one of these two stickers from the Public Sticker Board, then it will become tradable, even if you aren't a content creator or Discord staff. During the Beesmas of Summer 2024, the [[Gift Boxes#2024 (Summer)|Fluorescent Gift Box]] was located behind the public sticker board. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Hive Hub]]

docs.title: Puffshroom
docs.text:
[[File:Puffshroom.jpeg|180px|A common Puffshroom.|alt=|thumb]] [[File:AllTimeTopDamageToASinglePuffshroomLeaderBOard.jpg|thumb|The Highest Damage to a Single Puffshroom leaderboard in [[Dapper Bear's Shop]] as of October 14, 2024.]]'''Puffshrooms''' are passive entities that can be spawned by harvesting [[planter]]s with brownish smoke or naturally every 30 minutes on the 15th and 45th minute past each hour on a random [[fields|field]]. Upon filling a Puffshroom's [[pollen]] meter, it is considered "defeated" and spreads to different fields in the form of one or more concentrated spores. These spores may either travel to a different area on the same field or travel to a different field entirely. Additionally, the size of the spore indicates the level of the Puffshroom that it will spawn.

==== Variants/Rarities ==== * Common/Normal (Soft/Pale Brown Cap, Beige Yellow Stem, common). * Rare (Silver/Gray Cap, Gray Stem, rare). * Epic (Gold/Yellow Cap, Pale Yellow Stem, very rare). * Legendary (Light/Pale Blue Cap, Baby Blue Stem, extremely rare). * Mythic (Purple Cap, Pale Purple Stem, exceptionally rare).

Once spawned, the first or the main Puffshroom will last 5 minutes before naturally despawning. A timer is shown above to see the remaining time to defeat it, to defeat the Puffshroom and get its rewards. The player/s is/are required to collect a certain amount of pollen (indicated by the pollen meter) within its vicinity until the meter is full. When the Puffshroom is defeated, it drops loots and turns into concentrated spores to spread to different fields. The loot is separate for all players, meaning that one player will not have the same as the other, the quality of the loot depends on the type, level, and the damage dealt to the Puffshroom before its defeat, if the player has not done any damage to it, it will only drop treats and honey.

Puffshrooms have a unique way of leveling up, as it heavily depends on the generation. The Puffshroom gains chances of leveling up when the field it goes by has not been touched by its ancestor; if an ancestor Puffshroom has touched the field, it will have a chance of its levels decreasing instead. The effect lasts up to 8 generations, and this effect will not be effective when it has reached more than 8 generations until it has been done again. If the Puffshroom reaches certain levels, it starts to have a chance of spawning a rarer variant. When it reaches higher levels, the chances of getting the rarer variants also increase.

Levels required for the rarity to gain a chance to spawn: * Common: Level 1+ * Rare: Level 5+ * Epic: Level 8+ * Legendary: Level 10+ * Mythic: Level 12+

== Spawning == Puffshrooms are guaranteed to spawn on the 15th and 45th minute of every hour in any random field (e.g. 9:15, 9:45, etc) (note that you might be using the time of a clock that is either delayed or advanced compared to the clock in-game). You can use the clock on the side of the [[Mountain Top Shop]] showing how long until Mondo Chick spawns; they spawn when the timer reaches 45:00 or 15:00. Similarly, during [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]], the timer of [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] can be used to determine the time.

A [[planter]] that reaches 95% growth has a chance of spawning a Puffshroom:

{|class="article-table" !Planter !Chance |- |{{Cost|Ticket Planter|||0}} |1/1 (100%) |- |{{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}} |1/1 (100%) |- |{{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}} |1/4 (25%) |- |{{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} |1/5 (20%) |- |{{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} |1/6 (16.67%) |- |{{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|||0}} |1/6 (16.67%) |- |{{Cost|Pesticide Planter|||0}} |1/6.5 (15.38%) |- |{{Cost|Tacky Planter|||0}} |1/7 (14.28%) |- |{{Cost|Red Clay Planter|||0}} |1/8 (12.5%) |- |{{Cost|Blue Clay Planter|||0}} |1/8 (12.5%) |- |{{Cost|Plastic Planter|||0}} |1/10 (10%) |- |{{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}} |1/10 (10%) |- |{{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}} |1/10 (10%) |- |{{Cost|Paper Planter|||0}} |1/30 (3.33%) |} A planter that will spawn a Puffshroom is indicated by clouds of brown smoke emitting from the planter.

== Drops == Puffshrooms have daily loot limits, similarly to [[Wild Windy Bee]]. The loot drops decrease the more you get and resets every day. They have their own specific loot, specific to each player, meaning loot cannot be stolen from other players. Puffshroom loot is also determined based on how much the player has contributed to defeating the Puffshroom. If a Puffshroom has been defeated and the player has not contributed to its pollen meter, it will only drop Honey tokens and [[Treats]]. On the contrary, however, more plentiful and rare rewards will be given the more the player contributes to the Puffshroom's pollen meter.

All abilities that can collect tokens except for [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] and [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Target Practice]] can collect Puffshroom loot. Not all items dropped by the Puffshroom can be dropped by all types; some of them can only be dropped by a specific rarity.

=== Guaranteed Drops === * {{Cost|Honey}} (Increased with [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]] and rarity). * Treats (Increments are based on the level).

=== Possible Drops === The types and quality of the drops depend on the rarity, level, and the damage dealt to the Puffshroom. The drops also degrade the more loot you collect from them. Treat and Honey are always dropped by a Puffshroom, with the amounts scaling from the level and damage dealt.

=== Puffshroom Blessing === [[File:Image 2024-05-23 183302549.png|90px|thumb|right]] Popping a rare+ Puffshroom also grants Puffshroom Blessing [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] to all contributing players. The number of stacks granted is depending on the Puffshroom's level and rarity: * Rare: x0.5 level * Epic: x1 level * Legendary: x1.5 level * Mythic: x2 level The number of stacks granted is further increased by x2 if it's popped on a field that haven't been visited by its ancestor.

Puffshroom Blessing grants +1~10% of the following buffs for 3 hours depending on the stacks, with max stacks of 100: * [[Instant Conversion|Unique Instant Conversion]] * [[Pollen]] * [[Capacity]] * [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey from Tokens]]

==Strategies==

  • The clouds of spores indicate where the Puffshrooms will go next.
  • Having a large team of players can help with collecting the required pollen faster.
  • Activating as many [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] as possible will help collection become optimal.
  • If the player has many materials, but doesnt wish to use more expensive ones like the [[Super Smoothie]], the recommended materials are: [[Oil]], [[Tropical Drink]], [[Blue Extract]] and [[Red Extract]].
  • Using the [[Red Field Booster]], [[Blue Field Booster]], [[Field Booster|Mountain Top Field Booster]], and the [[Coconut Dispenser]].
  • Using [[Glitter]] or [[Field Dice]] in fields where they spawn in can increase efficiency, but it is not recommended as it is generally a waste.
  • When the [[Coconut Clogs]] or [[Gummy Boots]] are equipped, using [[Coconut]]s will grant [[Passive Abilities#Coconut Haste|Coconut Haste]] and an additional stack of [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]], which helps when following spore clouds.
  • Using [[Windy Bee]]'s Tornado Ability can help collect heavy amounts of pollen from large groups of Puffshrooms.
  • Setting up [[Sprinklers]] near the Puffshrooms helps the flowers near the Puffshroom to regrow faster.
  • Puffshrooms that go to fields where the previous eight "generations" of that Puffshroom didn't travel to has a greater chance to level up.
  • Using [[Whirligig]]s can allow players to reach certain fields with Puffshrooms quicker, especially ones located at the [[Starter Zone]].
  • Using an {{Cost|Oil|||0}} or {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} increases movement speed, though the latter isn't recommended due to it's rarity.
  • Targeting higher level Puffshrooms can increase your chance of better rarities.
  • Listening to the spawn sounds of different rarities of Puffshrooms will help you identify them if you can't spot them. Defeating tough mobs that spawn before doing Puffshrooms prevents your bees from being distracted by the mob, such as the [[Mondo Chick]] and [[Coconut Crab]]. One of the best ways to get a large amount of Puffshrooms is to get them into either the Cactus, Pumpkin, or Pine Tree field. Then, assign one player to the each of the three fields, and "bounce" the Puffshrooms between those three fields. (This is commonly referred to as the "15 zone strat".) More fields, such as Rose, Strawberry, and rarely Mountain Top can be added if more players are present.

== Trivia ==

  • Its name is similar to the plant "[[w:c:plantsvszombies:Puff-shroom|Puff-shroom]]" in the [[w:c:plantsvszombies|Plants vs. Zombies]] (game) series, possibly being a reference to said franchise.
  • Puffshrooms are based on a real-life mushroom called [[Wikipedia:Calvatia gigantea|Calvatia gigantea]], which usually sport a similar structure and spread rapidly through spores.
  • Despite having a Level system, there is no way to "miss" a Puffshroom, unlike with most [[mobs]].
  • Puffshrooms emit faint, unique brown smoke particles, which are meant to be spores.
  • After completing the quest "Puffshrooms for Presents", [[Bee Bear]] mentions that Puffshrooms are an invasive species, implying [[Dapper Bear]] might have accidentally brought Puffshrooms to the game, just like how [[Sun Bear]] accidentally brought in the [[Bean Bug]]s and [[Chicks]] during the Egg Hunt events and how [[Spirit Bear]] brought the [[Coconut Crab]]. This is the only mob that is not based on an animal and the only one which requires pollen to defeat - sprouts do not count as a mob. Harvesting [[planter]]s can bypass the usual level restrictions for certain rarities. For example, a level 5 Legendary Puffshroom can spawn when harvesting a [[Blue Clay Planter]], when their minimum level is level 10. Defeating higher-tier Puffshrooms counts for quests which require specific types of Puffshrooms to be defeated. For example, defeating a Mythic Puffshroom would count towards a quest that requires a player to defeat a Common, Rare, Epic, or Legendary Puffshroom as well. Puffshroom rarities have an increased chance of spawning if it is a higher level. All Rarities of Puffshrooms have their own specific spawn sounds. For example, a Epic Puffshroom's spawn sound is lower pitched than the sound of a Rare Puffshroom. Puffshrooms are unable to be damaged during a [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. *[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] can spawn Puffshrooms of any rarity and level globally, just like how he can control [[Mythic Meteor Shower]]s, [[Snow Storm]]s, [[Night Bell]]s and more. ** On 12/28/2021, Onett spawned a global Level 30 Epic Puffshroom in the [[Sunflower Field]] with 2.68 trillion HP to troll people who complained that [[Stick Bug|Stick Bug's]] Beesmas quest was too hard. ** On 3/31/2022, Onett spawned a global Level 4 Legendary Puffshroom in the [[Dandelion Field]] while also summoning nighttime with a message in chat reading; "The Legendary Puffshroom ''[sic]'' in the Dandelion Field has summoned nighttime..." This was most likely done to help players that were still stuck on Bee Bear's final quest which required a Legendary Puffshroom to be defeated. *** Later that same day, he spawned multiple Legendary Puffshrooms in the Sunflower Field. According to Onett in one of his Discord messages, the Puffshrooms were supposed to be Common, but he accidentally spawned Legendary ones instead.

{{Tool |image =Pulsar.png |price = 125,000 |shop = Pro Shop |range = 29 |pattern = Surround |time = 1 |collectbase = 2 }} The '''Pulsar''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that can be purchased in the [[Pro Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|125,000}} |}

It collects 2 [[pollen]] from 29 surrounding patches in 1 second, which comes out to a base pollen collection rate of 58 pollen per second.

It has what looks to be a black orb with green smoke emitting from it and is surrounded by three black rings. Two of these rings have a small black orb connected to them, with one above and one to the right of the middle orb.

==Gallery== Hivesticker pulsar.png|The Pulsar's associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. ==Trivia== The Pulsar has a similar collection range as the [[Honey Dipper]] and the [[Porcelain Dipper]], only both of them have a slightly bigger collection range, and the Porcelain Dipper summons a large pillar of light every 10th swing that collects pollen. The Pulsar, [[Gummyballer]], and [[Sticker-Seeker]] are tied for the slowest tool in the game (in terms of how long the cooldown of each collection lasts). The Pulsar may possibly be the upgraded version of the [[Vacuum]]. *This is because pulsars are a type of neutron star (which have high gravity and suck stuff in, similar to a vacuum's function). {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

docs.text:
{{Field|image = PumpkinPatch2.png|fieldcolor = Assorted|bees = 15|width = 33|height = 17}}The '''Pumpkin Patch''' is a [[Fields|field]] located past the [[Honey Bee Gate]] and it lies right beside the [[Cactus Field]]. It is protected by the [[werewolf]].

This is a 17x33 field, containing 561 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of double and triple. {|class="article-table" !Flowers !White !Blue !Red !Total |- !Single |0% |0% |0% |'''0%''' |- !Double |14% |5% |5% |'''24%''' |- !Triple |43% |16% |17% |'''76%''' |- !Total |'''57%''' |'''21%''' |'''22%''' |'''100%''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[treat]], [[ticket]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], and [[glue]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Pumpkin Patch are [[Honey Bee]], [[Shy Bee]], [[Bear Bee]], and [[Photon Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Pumpkin Patch are [[Bomber Bee]], [[Hasty Bee]], and [[Gummy Bee]].

This field grants Satisfying [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

A level 1-20 [[Wild Windy Bee]] has a chance of spawning here.

Additionally, the largest pumpkin in the corner of the field seldomly makes a face before generating [[sparkles]] in the field.

== Obtaining Boosts ==

  • Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a Pumpkin [[Field Boost|Patch Boost]]. When it does, it will give +200% Pumpkin Patch pollen for 15 minutes. [[File:Pumpkin Patch Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Pumpkin Patch boost icon.]]
  • Using [[glitter]] in the field will add 100% Pumpkin Patch pollen onto the current boost if it isn't already maxed out.
  • Using [[Field Dice]], [[Smooth Dice]], or [[Loaded Dice]] may add +100% - 300% Pumpkin Patch pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out.
  • Pumpkin [[Field Wind|Patch Winds]] can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Pumpkin Patch conversion and give +5% instant Pumpkin Patch conversion and +20% Pumpkin Patch pollen for each stack. Pumpkin Patch Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times normally and can be boosted by up to 15x by using codes.
  • It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Pumpkin Patch Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.
  • Giving Polar Bear a [[Present]] gives the player Pumpkin Patch Boost x3

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Giving a [[present]] to certain [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]]: **[[Polar Bear]] gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x4 and other boosts and [[items]]. ** [[Onett]] gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x1 and other boosts and items. ** During Beesmas 2021, Polar Bear gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x3 and other boosts and items. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Tabby (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x1 + other stuff). ** ThnxCyasToyBox (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x3 and +100% Pumpkin Patch Capacity + other stuff). ** Xanthan (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x4 + other stuff). ** PumpkinOfJustice (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x7 + other stuff). ** PuppyPerk (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x2 + other stuff). ** TrickOrTreat (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x6 + other stuff). ** GravyCatFan (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x4 + other stuff). ** DarzethPack (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x3 + other stuff). ** Trying (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x2 + other stuff). ** MoreTime (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x3 + other stuff). ** BeeDay2019 (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x4 + other stuff). ** Leftovers (Gave Pumpkin Patch Boost x3 and Pumpkin Patch Winds x3 + other stuff). ** Boo swarm (Gives 4x Pumpkin Patch Boost + 15x Pumpkin Patch Winds + other stuff) * Purchasing a Pumpkin Patch [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 [[Field Capacity|Pumpkin Patch Capacity]], x1.25 Pumpkin Patch Pollen, x1.25 [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|Capacity]], and +50 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]].

== Gallery == hivesticker pumpkin patch stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * This [[Badges#Pumpkin Badge|field's badge]] and the [[Badges#Sunflower Badge|Sunflower Badge]] are used 3 times for chances in [[Memory Match]], the most out of any field badges. * There is a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} token behind the two pumpkins in the corner. * This is one of the 3 fields to have objects come to life. The others are [[Pineapple Patch]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. * Before the [[Updates#2018.04.27|4/27/2018 update]], the Pumpkin Patch had the same mix of [[flowers]] as the Cactus Field. * This field used to be the smallest field until the [[Stump Field]] was added. ** Due to the expansion of the Stump Field, this field has now become the smallest again (if one weren't to count the [[Ant Field]]). * This field is one of three fields to have the word "Patch" in their name instead of "Field," with the [[Pineapple Patch]] and [[Pepper Patch]] being the other two. * Prior to the 12/26/22 update, the pumpkins nearest to the [[Werewolf's Cave]] had collision. Their collision has since been removed.

It hatches out of a [[Eggs#Event Bee Eggs|Puppy Bee egg]], which is available in the [[Ticket Tent]] for {{Cost|Ticket|500}}.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Puppy Bee likes the [[Clover Field]] and dislikes the [[Rose Field]].

==Stats== Collects 25 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. Makes 280 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. +100% [[Energy]], +15% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +15 Gather Amount, +200 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +1 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +20% [[System Page#Bond From Treats|Bond from Treats]].

===Abilities=== '''[[Ability Tokens#Fetch|[Fetch]]]''' Creates a ball that collects tokens and increases pollen by 100% (+15% per [[Bond|Level]]) as you and Puppy Bee kick it to each other. Collection increases per kick. Combo hits to win [[Treat]]s. '''[[Ability Tokens#Puppy Love|[Puppy Love]]]''' Increases your bond with up to 10 nearby bees by 60 (+20 per lvl). Grants +10% Bee Movespeed and +50% Bee Gather Amount for 10 seconds (+1s per lvl).

===Reindeer Antlers Abilities=== (Puppy Bee can summon these abilities if it has the [[Reindeer Antlers]] [[Beequip]] equipped)

'''[[Ability Tokens#Fetch|[Reindeer Fetch]]]''' Replaces Puppy Bee's "[[Ability Tokens#Fetch|Fetch]]" ability. Puppy's ball will glow bright red, and every 3rd time Puppy hits it you'll receive "[[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Reindeer Guidance]]", which grants x1.01 Capacity for 15 minutes and stacks up to 10 times. Additionally, the ball has a small chance to spawn [[Gingerbread Bear]]s at high combos (max 1 per day). The chance is increased during [[Beesmas]] Events. '''[[Ability Tokens#Focus|[Focus]]]''' Grants +3% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]] for 20 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times. Critical hits increase pollen and damage by 100%.

==Trivia== When Puppy Bee came out on the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 Update]], it was on sale in the Ticket Tent for 250 tickets until September 22, 2018. * It takes 3 hits of the ball by the owner and 3 hits by the Puppy Bee (3 volleys) to drop a [[Treat|treat token]]. The more times the ball is hit in a row, the more treats are earned from the treat token (Doubled every time a combo is done, starting at 1, capping at 256). Once the treat token reaches the capped amount of treats, the ball will permanently stay light green and will not be able to produce any more treat tokens. It takes a total of 54 hits to reach the max amount of treats, and 60 to get 10x Reindeer Guidance. When a treat token of this kind is collected, even if more than 1 treat is earned from the treat token, it will always count as 1 treat token collected in quests. Puppy Bee was the first bee to be able to create treat tokens, the second being [[Festive Bee]] with its [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|festive gift]] ability. * Puppy Bee was likely made to be [[Tabby Bee|Tabby Bee's]] canine counterpart. Sometimes, the ball spawned by the fetch token can get stuck, allowing the player and Puppy Bee to easily pass it back and forth. Puppy Bee was the first [[Bees|Bee]] that has a 3D model on its face (its tongue). Puppy Bee, [[Bear Bee]], and Tabby Bee are currently the only bees that were sold at a discount for a limited amount of time. This bee, Bear Bee, [[Gummy Bee]], Tabby Bee, Festive Bee, [[Digital Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]] are the only Event bees that can be a [[First Edition Bee]]. First Edition Puppy Bee could have been obtained by buying it before September 22, 2018. * Treat tokens produced by Puppy Bee's fetch can be collected with a [[Ability Token#Token Link|Token Link]], similar to [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|Honey Gifts]]. Puppy Bee is the third bee to produce a token that has its face on it, the second being Tabby Bee, and the first being [[Rage Bee]]. This is the only bee that is able to raise the bond of other bees, through its puppy love token. * This bee, [[Vicious Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Cobalt Bee]], and Windy Bee are the only Event bees that don't have an 'enhanced' ability if gifted. The puppy love token glows when collected. Puppy Bee's wings clip through its ears. According to Bee Bear, Puppy Bee is a male. This and Festive Bee are the only bees that can produce gingerbread bears. * This bee, along with Festive Bee, are the only bees that have an exclusive Beequip for themselves. *During the Beesmas 2020 Event, players could purchase a special bundle for {{Cost|Robux|800}} in the [[Robux Shop]] that would grant them a Puppy Bee Egg, the special Reindeer Antlers Beequip specifically made for the Puppy Bee, and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|50}} as a bonus. If the player already had a Puppy Bee when they bought the bundle, they would get 500 tickets instead. *This makes Puppy Bee the only bee available to purchase in the Robux Shop twice. This bee, along with [[Tadpole Bee]], Tabby Bee, [[Lion Bee]], and Bear Bee are the only bees based on real animals. {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Event]] [[Category:Colorless]] [[Category:Bees]] [[zh-tw:小狗蜂]]

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Purplepotion.png |description = Grants x1.25 Capacity and the improved boosts of Red and Blue Extracts and Glue for 15 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second }} A {{Color|Purple Potion}} is a [[:Category:Crafted|craftable]] [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/6/2020 update]]. When used, it grants the following for 15 minutes: x1.25 [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|Capacity]]. x1.25 [[System Page#Convert Rate At Hive|Convert Rate At Hive]]. x1.5 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]]. x1.5 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]]. * x1.3 [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]]. * x1.3 [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]].

A Purple Potion buff cannot exist simultaneously along with {{Cost|Red Extract|||0}}, {{Cost|Blue Extract|||0}}, or a {{Cost|Glue|||0}} buff. If any of these buffs are active when a purple potion is used, they will be overridden. Using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} will override the buff, due to the Purple Potion being included in its craft.

Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 6th, 7th and 9th quest. By giving [[Science Bear]] a [[present]]. * As a reward from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * During [[Beesmas]], 5 Purple Potions can be obtained from donating strawberries to the [[Wind Shrine|Galentine Shrine]]. * 1 Purple Potion is rewarded as a bonus for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: {{Cost|Abstract Color Painting Sticker|||0}} ** {{Cost|Purple Fleuron Sticker|||0}} {{Cost|Royal Bear Sticker|||0}} **{{Cost|Royal Symbol Sticker|||0}}

==Trivia ==

  • It is one of four [[:Category:Consumables|consumables]] that can boost capacity, with the first being the {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|4=1}}, the third being the {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=1}} and the fourth being the {{Cost|Snowflake|4=1}} Prior to the purple potion being officially added to the game, there was a [[Glitches|glitch]] that caused it to be obtainable from King Beetle and Tunnel Bear early. The item could not be seen in the inventory, but could be donated to the Wind Shrine, where it had the appearance of a [[Egg#Basic Egg|basic egg]] and had no donation value. Donating one purple potion to the wind shrine can give winds ranging from 5x-9x for 4-6 red/blue fields.

docs.title: Quest Givers
docs.text:
[[File:Quest Completion.png|thumb|The exclamation mark that appears when a quest giver has a quest ready to complete or give out.]] '''Quest Givers''' are interactive [[:Category:NPC|NPC]] characters who give [[quests]] to the player to complete. In return, they give various rewards upon completion. There are a total of 13 quest givers in-game, excluding traveling quest givers.

When the player receives a quest from a quest giver, the following audio plays: [[File:Queststart.ogg]]

When the player completes a quest in a main questline, a message will appear, stating:

{{Notification||✅{Name of quest} is ready for {Quest Giver}!}}

If the player completes a repeatable quest, a message will appear, stating:

{{Notification||✅{Name of quest} is ready to turn in!}}

Along with this message, the following sound effect is also played:

[[File:Ring.ogg]]

This is to remind the player to go to the quest giver to claim their rewards. The message will also appear again whenever the player rejoins the game if they had not turned it in before.

When the player hands in a quest to a quest giver, a message will appear stating:

{{Notification||✅{Name of quest} Complete!}}

Afterwards, the following audio plays:

[[File:Questend.ogg]]

docs.text:
{{Stub}}{{Update}} [[File:QuestMenuIcon.png|thumb|85x85px|The icon for the Quest Menu.]] '''Quests''' are a major [[Mechanics|mechanic]] in [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. It allows the player to do tasks in order to receive various rewards that allow them to progress further into the game. Quests are not necessary for progression, but are highly recommended. There are a few exceptions, such as [[Science Bear]]'s [[Science Bear#Translator Quest List (15)|Translator]] questline, and [[Spirit Bear]]'s questline, which are required to complete to progress.

Quests can be obtained and turned in through conversing with various [[Quest Givers|quest givers]]. As of now, 8 active quest [[bears]], 3 [[:Category:Quest Bees|quest bees]], and [[Onett]] can give out quests. [[:Category:Traveling Bears|Traveling bears]] and other various creatures also give quests but were only available for a limited time in the game.

Quests have many different types of requirements, such as collecting various amounts of [[pollen]] from [[fields]], [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], [[goo]], [[Treats|treat]] tokens, defeating [[mobs]], crafting [[items]], obtaining [[badges]], finding [[Stickers]], and discovering [[Bees|bee]] types.

==Audio== The following audio plays when the player has received a quest: [[File:Queststart.ogg]]

The following audio plays when the player has completed and handed in a quest: [[File:Questend.ogg]]

The following audio plays when the player has just completed a quest or when the player joins a game with a completed quest not handed in: [[File:Ring.ogg]]

==Quest Bears== Quest Bears are quest givers that have an appearance of a bear. They are the most common variant of quest givers.[[Category:Pages that uses original tabber]] |-|Black Bear= [[File:Black.png|thumb|right]] [[Black Bear]] is likely the first quest-giver the player will encounter when they start the game. |-|Brown Bear= [[File:Brown.png|thumb|right]] == Quests == Brown Bear is an infinite quest giver. His quests scale up in difficulty the more you complete, with the reward also getting bigger the more difficult it gets. Each quest always rewards a [[ticket]], [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]], and increasing amounts of honey, depending on the current difficulty of the current quest. Certain thresholds may reward other items as well.

=== Scaling (<1000 quests) === Let x equal the minimum amount of pollen for the quest Let y equal the maximum amount of pollen for the quest

Amount of pollen required for a quest =

\{x ~ + ~ \{\{y ~ - ~ x\} ~ \times ~ \{{\frac{numberofquestscompleted}{1000}}\}^4\}\}

During his 2018 Beesmas visit, he stood by the [[Ant Gate]], while in his 2019 Beesmas visit, he stood to the right of the [[All-Time Top Honeymakers]] and in front of the [[Dandelion Field]].

docs.title: Radiation
docs.text:
[[File:Radiated_Mutated_Hive.gif|frame|A bee is radioactive when there is an orange and white ☢️ symbol on the right of the bee's slot, along with green particles.]] [[File:Radiated_Bee.png|thumb|A radioactive bee.]] '''Radiation''' is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that gives a temporary “radioactive” status to a [[Bees|bee]] that lasts for 11 minutes. Bees will stay radioactive regardless of any changes to their [[Hive Slot|hive slots]] during these 11 minutes.

When a bee is radioactive, it has a higher chance of gaining a [[mutation]] when using {{Cost|Bitterberry}}, {{Cost|Royal Jelly|}}, {{Cost|Moon Charm}}, or {{Cost|Star Jelly}}. It also allows the chance of a bee gaining a mutation by feeding it special treats. Certain radioactive bees can find [[sticker]]s in some fields.

Bees glow green when radioactive. The brightness of the bee is based on how much longer the radioactivity will last - the brighter the bee, the longer until the radioactivity ends. A radioactive bee's hive slot will also emit green particles.

==Ways of Obtaining== Feeding a bee a {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}} will make the bee radioactive. If a bee is mutated, it occasionally becomes radioactive. This has a chance to make surrounding bees radioactive as well. Global radioactivity events are initiated by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]]. At the end of Beesmas 2020, he put up a game-wide message, saying "☢️ Testing global radioactivity... ☢️", and caused many bees to become radioactive. Occasionally, a bee will randomly become radioactive without meeting any of the above criteria.

==Audio== [[File:Radioactivity.ogg|thumb|left|The sound effect played when a bee turns radioactive.]]
