docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}}[[File:Readyplayertwo bookcover.png|thumb|175px|The cover of the book the event is based off of.]] '''Ready Player Two''' was a Roblox event that began on November 23, 2020 and ended on November/December 2021. The event spans across seven games, including [[Bee Swarm Simulator]], where players must decipher each game's clues and obtain its badge along with the [[How to Program BASIC]] accessory to wear on their avatar.

==Event== '''NOTE''': The clues for 6 of the codes have been removed on 5/23/24 update, but you can still see the codes listed below here. [[The Computer]] can no longer be interacted with when wearing the [[Strange Goggles]] as of the [[Updates|05/23/24]] update. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed sortable" style="width: 100%" ! class="unsortable" ! |Code ! class="unsortable" ! |Riddle Source ! class="unsortable" ! |Reward |- | Troggles |[[Mother Bear]] |[[7-Pronged Cog]] x1, [[Clover Field]] Code Buff (+100% Clover Field Pollen, +100% Clover Field Capacity) |- |WordFactory |Onett's tweet |7-Pronged Cog x1, [[Pine Tree Forest]] Code Buff (+100% Pine Tree Forest Pollen, +100% Pine Tree Forest Capacity) |- |Millie |[[Wind Shrine]] |7-Pronged Cog x1, [[Sunflower Field]] Code Buff (+100% Sunflower Field Pollen, +100% Sunflower Field Capacity) |- |Luther |[[Onett|Onett (NPC)]] |7-Pronged Cog x1, [[Blue Flower Field]] Code Buff (+100% Blue Flower Field Pollen, +100% Blue Flower Field Capacity) |- |CarmenSanDiego |[[Elite Red Guard]] description |7-Pronged Cog x1, [[Rose Field]] Code Buff (+100% Rose Field Pollen, +100% Rose Field Capacity) |- |Jumpstart |Tutorial |7-Pronged Cog x1, [[Dandelion Field]] Code Buff (+100% Dandelion Field Pollen, +100% Dandelion Field Capacity) |- |Dysentery |[[Ant Challenge Info]] |7-Pronged Cog x1, [[Mushroom Field]] Code Buff (+100% Mushroom Field Pollen, +100% Mushroom Field Capacity) |}

Each code awards the player a [[7-Pronged Cog]]. They can be used to craft [[Strange Goggles]]. When equipped, the player needs to go to [[The Computer]], where they can now interact with it. Upon use, the player will see [[Digital Bee (NPC)|Digital Bee]]. Digital Bee acts as an NPC and will begin citing the first puzzle. Upon completing each puzzle, the player is rewarded with various items, and can go back to The Computer to receive the next puzzle. The puzzle guides are listed below. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! style="width:3%" |Puzzle ! style="width:40%" |Guide ! style="width:35%" |Example ! style="width:10%" |Reward |- |Puzzle 1 |Upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will flash 4 symbols, acting as a code. Go to the [[Dandelion Field]] and use your collector to reveal and change to the appropriate symbols left to right, with the first symbol closest to the [[Sunflower Field]]. If done right, a sound will play, and the symbols are replaced with happy faces. |Digital Bee signals '''? * ~ {'''. Therefore, the first symbol is '''?''', then '''*''', then '''~''', and last '''{'''. |1x [[Royal Jelly]], [[Honey]] |- |Puzzle 2 |After the first puzzle is done, upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will disappear, and begin teleporting around the Sunflower, [[Clover Field|Clover]], and [[Mushroom Field]]. At a field, Digital Bee will continuously flash 3 symbols. Then, you will have to uncover the hidden symbols with your collector and change them into the right sequence. When entered, the symbols will change into happy faces and a sound will play. |N/A |1x [[Royal Jelly]], 8x [[Gumdrops]] |- |Puzzle 3 |After the second puzzle is done, upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will flash 4 letters. The 4 letters are '''S'''unflower, '''D'''andelion, '''M'''ushroom, and '''C'''lover. In each of the 4 fields, a symbol can be revealed with your collector. In the order of the fields flashed by Digital Bee, reveal the symbols left to right in the [[Blue Flower Field]], with the first symbol nearest to the [[Basic Bee Gate|5 Bee Gate]]. If done right, a sound will play, and the symbols are replaced with happy faces. |Digital Bee will not just flash '''DSMC,''' but will flash other codes (e.g, '''MSCD or DMSC).''' just type the code correctly and you'll get the final puzzle finished! |1x [[Atomic Treat]], 8x [[Ticket]] |}

When the third and final puzzle is done, interacting with The Computer will award the game's event item, badge, and a [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|Star Jelly]].

docs.title: Red Cannon
docs.text:
[[File:Red cannon3.png|thumb|The Red Cannon.]] The '''Red Cannon''' is available for use once the player has discovered 25 [[Bees|bee]] types. It is located to the right of the [[hive]]s, next to [[Black Bear]], and near the [[Ticket Tent]] and the [[Blue Teleporter]] exit. It has a 5 second cooldown period.

If the player has the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]], they can use it in combination with the Red Cannon in order to efficiently navigate around the map due to its large range. It gives access to various places that were once tedious or impossible to access, such as the [[Star Hall]], going outside the map, or to collect most [[Royal Jelly]] tokens, like the one on top of the [[Mountain Top Shop]] and the one on top of the [[hive]]s.

If used without any [[Buffs & Debuffs|buffs]] or [[:Category:Gliding Tools|gliding tools]], the player will usually land in the middle of the [[Mountain Top Field]]; however, it has been known to undershoot (landing on the ramp up to the [[Lion Bee Gate]], into the [[Mushroom Field]], or very rarely, the fence on the border of the [[Sunflower Field]]) or overshoot (shooting the player outside the boundaries of the map). If the player has the [[Scythe]] equipped, the Red Cannon may only manage to shoot them into the [[Spider Field]] due to unknown reasons. This can also occur without the Scythe equipped. If this happens, simply jumping and pressing E at the same time will allow the cannon to shoot normally. If the player uses the Parachute or Glider and activates the cannon, the cannon will not launch them into the Mountain Top Field. Instead, they will lose momentum as soon as the cannon fires and continue gliding until they make contact with the ground.

== Trivia == * The Red Cannon is the only cannon that has a crosshair on it. * It is one of the four cannons in the game, the other three cannons are the [[Yellow Cannon]], [[Blue Cannon]], and [[Gummy Cannon]]. ** This is one of the three transportational cannons in the game, which the other two cannons are [[Yellow Cannon]] and [[Blue Cannon]]. * This cannon has the biggest range of all the cannons in the game. * It is the transportation method that requires the largest amount of discovered bee types to be used. * The Red Cannon has a cooldown of 5 seconds. While this is not normally possible to see during regular gameplay as the cannon launches the player too far to return in 5 seconds, the cooldown can be seen by using the Glider/Parachute glitch to stop all momentum as soon as the player exits the cannon. ** This cooldown is shared by all the transportational cannons. * On game release, the cannon could be used by discovering 20 bee types. In the [[Updates#2018.04.27|4/27/2018 update]], it was changed to 22 bee types. In the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], it was changed to 25 bee types and has remained that way since. * It is the only cannon to not launch the player into the [[Starter Zone]], it instead launches the player to the Mountain Top Field, as the cannon is already in the Starter Zone. * On the game release, players could launch themselves from the Red Cannon to the Mountain Top Field even if they didn't have 25 bees in their hive. This has been patched. * When combined with a Glider, this is commonly used as the best transportation method to go anywhere on the map.

{{Consumables |image = Red Extract.png |description = Grants x1.25 Red Pollen for 10 minutes. |cooldown = 1 second }} {{Color|Red Extract}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. The purpose of it is to use it as a material to craft [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]], or for a 10-minute boost that grants x1.25 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]]. The [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Items|buff]] cannot stack and will only reset its timer if you used a '''Red Extract''' when there is another one active. Using a {{Cost|Purple Potion|4=0}} or {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=1}} will override the buff. [[File:Red extract token bss.png|thumb|A red extract token.]]

== Ways to Obtain == * [[Crafting]] it via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Strawberry|50}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|10}} * Matching a pair of red extracts in [[Memory Match#Mega Memory Match|Mega Memory Match]] (worth 1 red extract) or [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]] (worth 3 red extracts). * As a reward from the [[Wind Shrine]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** {{Cost|Flying Rad Bee Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Round Rascal Bee Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Flying Festive Bee Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Little Scorpion Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Red X Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|AFK Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Small Flame Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Shrugging Heart Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Red Doodle Person Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Scythe Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract. ** {{Cost|Dark Scythe Sticker|||0}} rewards 1 red extract.

  • As a reward from the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]].

=== Drops === * As a drop from certain [[mobs]] ** [[Ladybug]] (Rare) ** [[Scorpion]] (Rare) ** [[King Beetle]] ** [[Aphid#Rage Aphid|Rage Aphid]] * Farming in the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Strawberry Field]], [[Rose Field]], or the [[Pepper Patch]] can rarely drop red extracts. ** A rare drop from [[leaves]] in the Mushroom Field, Strawberry Field, or the Rose Field. * As a rare drop from [[sprout]]s (the odds increase depending on the rarity of the sprout and if the sprout is located in red fields). * As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] (if [[Festive Bee]] is [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]) or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a rare gift from a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]]. * As a guaranteed drop from the certain [[planters]]: ** {{Cost|Red Clay Planter|||0}} ** {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|||0}} (Drops extra red extracts in red fields.) *** Planting the {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|||0}} in the Mushroom Field, then the Strawberry Field, then the Rose Field, then the Pepper Patch results in an additional {{Cost|Red Extract|100}} (unknown cooldown). *** Additionally, it has a small chance to drop {{Cost|Red Extract|100}} upon harvesting in any field. ** Planters harvested in red fields have a chance to drop red extracts.

[[File:RedBooster.jpg|thumb|220x220px|Red Field Booster|The Red Field Booster inside of the Red HQ.]]

The '''Red Field Booster''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] that provides a [[Field Boost]] to a random [[:Category:Red|red]] [[field]] for 15 minutes. The machine is located in the [[Red HQ]]. In order to use it, the player needs to have discovered 5 different red [[Bees|bee]] types. It has a cooldown of 45 minutes.

The following audio plays when the Red Field Booster has been activated:[[File:Fieldbooster.ogg]]

== Boosts == [[Mushroom Field]]: +300% [[Pollen]] [[Strawberry Field]]: +100% Pollen [[Rose Field]]: +100% Pollen [[Pepper Patch]]: +100% Pollen (only if player has 35+ Bees) == Gallery == RoseFieldBoostSparkles.png|A boosted Rose Field. RoseFieldBoost.png|The old Red Field boost icon. Mushroom Field Icon.png|The Mushroom Field boost icon. Strawberry Field Icon.png|The Strawberry Field boost icon. Rose Field Icon.png|The Rose Field boost icon. Pepper Patch Icon.png|The Pepper Patch boost icon.

== Trivia == * This is one of the three field boosters in the game, along with the [[Field Booster]] and the [[Blue Field Booster]]. ** The Red Field Booster has the same design as the Field Booster and the Blue Field Booster, the only difference being the colors. * The Red Field Booster, unlike the Blue Field Booster, is located near the entrance of the [[Red HQ]], while the Blue Field Booster is located on the second floor in the [[Blue HQ]]. * In an update, the Strawberry Field boost was nerfed from 200% to 100%. * Prior to the [[Updates#2024.05.23|5/23/2024 update]], this booster was not able to boost the Pepper Patch.

{{Stores|title1 = Red HQ|image1 = RedHQBeesmas2021.png|caption1 = Front view of the Red HQ.|row1 = Next to the Rose Field, above the Sunflower Field, and next to the Special Sprout Summoner}} The '''Red HQ''' is a large, red building with a portal, a shop, and other features. It is located next to the [[Rose Field]] and near the [[Special Sprout Summoner]]. It has a [[Riley Bee]] model above the entrance. To enter, the player must have discovered 4 different red [[Bees|bee]] types. The Red HQ is the red counterpart to the [[Blue HQ]].

On the roof, there is an enlarged [[Scythe]]. Unlike the actual Scythe, the one on the Red HQ doesn't emit flame particles.

== Interior == On the first floor, there are five things that can be interacted with: * A [[Red Teleporter]] that can teleport the player to the rock behind [[Science Bear]]. * The [[Red Field Booster]] that gives a 15-minute boost for either the [[Mushroom Field]] (3x), [[Strawberry Field]] (1x), [[Rose Field]] (1x), or the [[Pepper Patch]] (1x). * The [[All-Time Top Red Collectors]] and [[Daily Top Red Collectors]] [[leaderboards]], which show the top 100 players who have collected the most red pollen and the top 100 players who have collected the most red pollen in a day respectively. * A set of red [[items]] for sale. (See the 'Store' section below.)

There is a [[ticket]] token hidden near the back of the ceiling visible from the ladder. There are 3 possible ways to reach it: * Climb the Red Teleporter and jump/glide onto the token. * From outside the HQ, get on top of the All-Time Top Red Collectors leaderboard and then jump to the token. ** If it's too difficult to land on the leaderboard, the player may need to glide to the token instead. The player may need boots and/or the parachute/glider for some of these.

The player can climb two ladders to reach the other sections of the HQ. The first ladder leads to a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] token on the roof next to the base, as well as the [[Strawberry Dispenser]]. The second ladder leads to the top, where the player will find the [[Top Riley Bee Helpers]] Leaderboard and [[Gifted Riley Bee]], who requires a [[translator]] to be able to be communicated with. After the player gets a translator from Science Bear and uses it on Gifted Riley Bee, they can complete [[quests]] for them. The player will also find the [[Codes|code]] "ROOF" on the back side of the white facade, near the large Scythe.

== Store == There is a store in the Red HQ that sells nine [[items]]. To open the store, press E when ''not'' on the Red Teleporter, the Red Field Booster, or the Leaderboards.

== Music== When inside of the Red HQ, the song "vendor" plays.

[[File:Vendor.ogg]]

RedHQ WideAngle.png|The Red HQ prior to the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. RedHQ2021.png|The Red HQ prior to the 12/26/2021 update. File:RedHQShop.png|Red HQ's Shop.

==Trivia == [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] can target the player if they are close enough to the wall, next to the Rose Field. The Dark Scythe is currently the most expensive item able to be bought in the Red HQ. After the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], a glass roof was added, preventing players from jumping out from the side and into the Rose Field. As of the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the roof is no longer there, due to a new mechanic that teleported players back to spawn if they entered a restricted area. Bees (including Gifted Riley Bee) had no wings when viewed through the roof. This was because transparent parts seen through glass materials do not display properly, similar to the glass of the [[Porcelain Dipper]]. Moving into the red field booster just as the shop was opened would cause the [[Glitches#Shop Trap|Shop Trap glitch]]. The only way to reverse this is to disconnect and rejoin the game. If the player uses Shift-Lock, they have the ability to look through the white wall behind the Dark Scythe, revealing a pad with the number 250 on it. There is a [[Loaded Dice]]] token on the far end of the roof near [[Robo Bear]] which the player can obtain by jumping on top of the [[Top Riley Bee Helpers]], then jumping onto the roof, and then walk/glide to the token. Before Beesmas 2022, this token was on a rock next to the roof that the player could climb using Shift-Lock. *The Red HQ is also known as the "Red Clubhouse." If the player does not have 4 red bee types discovered, the top of their screen will say, "Discover 4 Red Bee types to enter the '''Red Clubhouse'''."

docs.text:
[[File:RedHQTeleporter.png|thumb|202x202px|The Red Teleporter pad in the Red HQ.]] [[File:RedTeleportDestination.png|thumb|270px|The destination of the Red Teleporter, behind Science Bear.]] The '''Red Teleporter''' is a portal located inside the [[Red HQ]]. When activated, it will instantly teleport the player on top of the rock located directly behind [[Science Bear]]. The transportation is one-way; thus, the destination teleporter cannot be used to travel back into the Red HQ.

To activate the Red Teleporter, the player must walk onto the white teleport pad and press the "E" key on their keyboard if they are on PC or Laptop. However, if they are on mobile, then they must walk onto the pad and tap on the button that appears at the top of the screen.

== Trivia == * Similar to its [[Blue Teleporter|blue counterpart]], the Red Teleporter used to use an animation where each of the rings would revolve in circles. However, this can get buggy since the rings will start to spin, but then they will slow down until they reach the point of completely stopping. * A {{Cost|Ticket|4=0}} token is located near the ceiling of the Red HQ. This can be collected by jumping up on top of the Red Teleporter, then jumping or parachuting to the token. Enhanced [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]], such as from [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|bear morph]], or [[:Category:Boots|boots]], is required to jump high enough. * The 7 circles on the Red Portal near Science Bear are solid, and with enhanced Jump Power, you can jump out of the map on some circles.

{{Consumables|description=Grants 4 hours of Refreshing Nectar. (Boosts: Red Pollen, Blue Convert Rate, Bee Ability Pollen)|cooldown=1 Second|cap=10|image=Refreshingvial.png}}

The {{Color|Refreshing Vial}} is a consumable [[Nectar Vial|nectar vial]] [[Items|item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2022.12.26|12/26/2022 update]]. Once used, it grants the player 4 hours of the [[Nectar|Refreshing Nectar]] [[Buffs & Debuffs|buff]] instantly. It can also be used to craft other [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]].

docs.text:
==Lobby== [[File:RetroSwarmChallengeNewLocation.png|thumb|The portal in the [[Brave Bee Gate|10 Bee Zone]] near [[Dapper Bear's Shop]].]] Upon entering the portal at the 10 bee zone (next to Dapper Bear's Shop), the player is teleported to a separate experience: "Retro Swarm Challenge ⚔️ [DEFENSE THE HIVES!!!!] v1.2(fixed)". Players spawn on a classic-styled island surrounded by smaller islands that contain multiple historic models. The main island had five entry cubes, a billboard containing information on how to play the minigame, and a Portal leading back to Bee Swarm Simulator.

When entering a cube, a twenty-five-second countdown will begin. Each cube has a maximum capacity of four players. As soon as a cube is full, the timer will rapidly decrease. Once the timer reaches zero, players will be teleported to the minigame.

RetroTutorial1.png|Team up into groups of 4 and defend your hive from waves of '''Slimes and Zombies! ''' Once 10 monsters reach the hive, it's game over. RetroTutorial2.png|A new round of monsters spawns every 2 MINUTES. OG Tokens are awarded for completing rounds 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. RetroTutorial3.png|START WITH '''NO HONEY''' AND YOUR BEES ARE ALL LOCKED AWAY RetroTutorial4.png|Collect Bricks 🧱 from defeating monsters, or purchase them with Honey. Use Bricks to unlock Bees and weapons RetroTutorial5.png|If you have no Bees left to unlock '''YOU CAN RENT BEES INSTEAD''' Use Bricks to level-up your rental Bees.

==Gameplay== [[File:Retro Swarm Challenge Area.jpg|thumb|The playing field for the {{PAGENAME}}. The hives are behind the player.]] The challenge takes place in a long, rectangular box. Players spawn in front of four claimable hives at the beginning of the map. The map contains four different fields (Mixed, Blue, Red, and White), a Shop on the left, and a large cave at the end. When using [[Glitter]] in these fields, the icon for the boost is the same icon as that of the [[Sunflower Field]] boost icon.

Below the Honey and Pollen bar, players can view their Bricks, the current round, the time remaining in the round, and the HP of the hives. On the right side of the screen, there is a server leaderboard showing each player's Brick, Honey, and Damage totals. Players begin with fifty Bricks, and the hives begin with ten HP.

The objective of the {{PAGENAME}} is to survive as many rounds as possible while defending the hives from monsters. In order to fight the monsters, players must unlock bees or buy weapons at the Shop to defeat them. Killing enemies drops Brick Tokens, which allow players to purchase more items.

Players keep their gear and bees from the main game, giving them a notable advantage if they have made significant progress. Players without bees have the option to rent and level up bees for Bricks.

When the HP of the hives reach zero, the challenge ends and players are rewarded based on their final scores.

=== Enemies === There are two types of enemies during the event: [[Slime]]s and [[Zombie]]s. Enemies gradually level up. Like [[mobs]], if a player's bee is a lower level than the enemy, their accuracy decreases by 50% per level.

[[Slime|Slimes]] move slowly in a straight line towards the hives, destroying flowers as they move through the fields, similarly to a [[Cogmower]]. As they increase in level, they grow larger, increasing their hitbox and health.

[[Zombie|Zombies]] also move towards the hives. Unlike Slimes, if a Zombie spots a nearby player, they target them instead. Zombies are not fast enough to catch up to the player. Critical hits are more effective against Zombies.

=== Bricks === {{Main|Brick}} Bricks are the Retro Swarm Challenge's main currency. They can be obtained by killing enemies, through [[Leaves]] on the fields, or by destroying [[Brick Bloom|Brick Blooms]]. All Bricks are collected through Brick Tokens.

Brick Blooms are retro-styled flowers that can spawn on any of the four fields. Their behavior is very similar to [[Puffshroom]]s. After a certain amount of pollen is collected in their radius, Brick Blooms burst into Brick Tokens. The tokens that spawn from Brick Blooms are both local and global, so players always receive tokens from them regardless of whether they helped to destroy it or not. Brick Blooms spawn on rounds, 1, 3, 7, 12, 18, and may continue spawning on higher rounds. The first Brick Bloom always spawns in the Mixed Brick Field. When a Brick Bloom is defeated, another one will spawn in a random field, one level higher. More bricks are rewarded when defeating higher level Brick Blooms. In higher waves, multiple Brick Blooms may be active at the same time.

At the Shop, Bricks are used for unlocking, renting, and levelling up Bees, as well as purchasing weapons and boosts. Furthermore, players have the option to convert their Honey into ten Bricks at a time at an exponentially increasing price.

There is a hidden shop located to the left of the cave that allows for Honey to be converted into 100 Bricks at once.

=== Shop === Players are able to purchase items and unlock or upgrade Bees for Bricks at the Shop. [[Category:Pages that uses original tabber]] |-|Weapons= {| class="fandom-table" !'''Image''' !'''Item''' !'''Cost''' !'''Description''' |- |[[File:Regular sword.png|128px]] | Classic Sword |10 Bricks |Swing to deal damage to monsters. Light attack deals 30 damage. Heavy attack deals 50 damage. |- |[[File:Trowel.png]] |Trowel |25 Bricks |Spend a Brick to build a wall that lasts up to 5 minutes. |- |[[File:SlingshotClassic.webp|128px]] |Slingshot |150 Bricks |Shoot to deal damage to monsters from a distance. Deals 30 dmg. |- |[[File:Firebrand.png]] |Firebrand |300 Bricks |Swing to deal heavy damage to monsters. Light attack deals 150 damage. Players without bees could rent one of three random bees to choose from. |- |[[File:Placeholder.png|128px]] |Level Up Rental Bees |10 Bricks (+10 after first and third purchase, +20 besides that) |Increases the level of all rental bees by one. Cannot be purchased by players who don't have any active rental bees. |- |[[File:Lego Brick.png|128px]] |100 Bricks |Honey |Price starts at 350,317 honey and increases exponentially. |}

=== Rewards === After the Challenge ends, a panel appears, informing the player of their total damage, bricks collected, rounds completed, and final score. The rewards are listed at the bottom of the panel. The scoring system is similar to that of the [[Stick Bug Challenge]], with rewards being based on the player's performance. Higher scores result in better rewards. The exact method of scoring is unknown.

Rewards may include three or four of the following items, with some rewards being locked behind a higher score:

Defendfieldsagainstretroswarms.jpeg|"Defend fields against retro swarms" – the classic event picture on the Roblox website. Turpentine drop.png|A turpentine drop from the Retro Swarm Challenge.

==During The Classic Event== {{RemovedContent}} [[File:RetroEventPortal.png|thumb|The portal to the Retro Swarm Challenge during The Classic.]] The Retro Swarm Challenge was Bee Swarm Simulator's custom experience for Roblox's 2024 "[[w:c:roblox:The Classic|The Classic]]" Event. It was first released on May 23, 2024 and hosted a total of 10 collectable Tix and 5 collectable Classic Tokens until May 28, 2024.

During the event, fifteen user-created experiences, including Bee Swarm Simulator, were selected to create a custom experience where players could earn special event badges to redeem unlockable prizes. Players had the opportunity to earn 10 badges for Tix and 5 badges for Tokens in each experience.

A Token was awarded on wave 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.

Three Tix could have been found by entering the square teleporters scattered around the lobby, Three additional Tix could have been found within the challenge's map.

Four Tix could have been found around the main map.

'''The Classic Event has ended; you can no longer obtain the Tix or Tokens.'''

== Strategies ==

  • It is recommended to have atleast 1 player that will be destroying [[Brick Bloom|Brick Blooms,]] so that the defenders can also grab the bricks from them and buy stronger weapons, buffs, and more bees to help defend.
  • During [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]], its recommended to have 2-4 players farming [[Brick Bloom|Brick Blooms]] so as much of them are destroyed as possible for the highest amount of [[Snowflake|SnowFlakes]], since they can drop up to 15+ snowflakes on higher levels.
  • The Rocket Launcher is a really powerful weapon, due to it's attack having "area of effect" damage, otherwise known as "splash" damage, which can be beneficial when zombies are grouped next to the slimes. It becomes even more powerful with a critical hit as it can one-shot zombies at lower levels and stil deal heavy damage to slimes. However, take caution when using it, as to not hit yourself or your own teammates as they can be flung across the map. Additionally, the Rocket Launcher should be aimed at the bottom of the slimes or in-between them. This is so you can maximize the number of slimes being hit at once, defeating them quicker.
  • There is a difficult tactic with the Rocket Launcher that allows you to fly across the map within a few seconds. By jumping and shooting the rocket below you before you hit the ground, depending on where you shoot it (slightly behind sends the player forwards; directly beneath sends the player up), you will be launched to the opposite direction. This is exceptionally useful for traversing the map if you cannot spare time or whirligigs when buying or traveling the map.
  • By launching yourself up with the Rocket Launcher, you can glide and land on one of the invisible walls or roof of the cave, giving you a very wide range of vision, additionally, this increases the Rocket Launcher's effectiveness to the fullest, as the rocket lands directly on top of the mobs, hitting as many mobs as possible with one rocket. This is quite difficult to pull off, and is generally not recommended for mobile players.
  • It is recommended that if possible, one or more people should have the Illumina after getting the rocket launcher. This is because on stage 15+ there will be certain slimes that will have a much higher level than the others, meaning the Rocket Launcher is ineffective against them. The Illumina does exceptional single-target damage. So after defeating the smaller slimes, the user can defeat the bigger ones.

== Trivia == The Retro Swarm Challenge used to be accessible at spawn in front of the [[Noob Shop]] but was later shifted to the [[Brave Bee Gate|10 bee zone]] in the 7/17/24 Beesmas update. The Retro Swarm Challenge has many references to classic Roblox content: The lobby utilizes many free models that were commonplace in many classic Roblox games, including the skyscraper from "[https://www.roblox.com/games/1501/ROBLOX-World-Headquarters Roblox World Headquarters]", a pillar from "[https://www.roblox.com/games/47324/Sword-Fights-on-the-Heights-IV Sword Fights on the Heights]", and a tower from "[https://www.roblox.com/games/1818/Classic-Crossroads Crossroads]". The event is inspired by classic zombie survival games, such as "[https://www.roblox.com/games/51955496/Build-to-survive-the-zombies Build To Survive The Zombies]". The zombies share the sound effects, models, and behavior of zombies summoned by the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/26421972/Zombie-Staff Zombie Staff] gear. *The announcements that appear at the start of waves are reminiscent of an old announcement script. The slimes are a nod to "[https://www.roblox.com/games/1845318/ATTACK-OF-THE-SLIMES-BUILD-TO-SURVIVE -<[ATTACK OF THE SLIMES: BUILD TO SURVIVE!!!]>-]" All the Gears available for purchase in the Shop are among the oldest Gears in Roblox. The enemies in the Retro Swarm Challenge are consistently referred to as "monsters" instead of mobs. [[Aphid]]s can still spawn during the Retro Swarm Challenge, albeit rarely. Some consumables, such as [[Purple Potion]]s, [[Stinger]]s, [[Glitter]] and [[Cloud Vial]]s can be used during the event. Others, such as Field Dice or [[Balloon]]s, are prohibited. * Players cannot edit their hive during the challenge, but they can convert pollen to honey. [[Codes]] can be used to obtain buffs during the challenge. Buffs that are obtained before entering will remain active. Any pollen remaining in the player's bag before entering the challenge will disappear, although any pollen obtained during the challenge will carry over to the main game after losing (only if the player’s bag is empty before the challenge). The Retro Swarm Challenge map is on the Main map, behind the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]], beyond the baseplate and tp wall. The same goes with the Hive Hub being on the main map. When a gifted [[Digital Bee]]'s Map Corruption ability activates, the server-wide announcement message will still be displayed even though the affected field is inaccessible. You can unequip a weapon or tool by selecting it in your inventory and accepting the prompt to unequip. This is useful for destroying brick blooms. Alternatively, you can put a weapon in your 1-6 hotbar to enable fast switch without prompting, and vice versa to equip your tool. Rocket Launcher's projectiles can collide with [[Amulet|Amulets]] and fling players, this has a small chance for the amulet hit to freeze in place or completely flung away. Rocket Launcher´s projectiles can be used to fling yourself, shooting close to your avatar and moving. *A [[Gingerbread Bear]] can be found next to the hives. This used to be next to the cave, but was replaced by the [[Gift Boxes|Aureolin Gift Box]]. *Attempting to use the Trowel without bricks will result in a message saying “You’re out of bricks!”. docs.title: Rhino Beetle
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Rhino Beetle |image =Rhino_Beetle.png |location = [[Clover Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], and [[Pineapple Patch]] |timer = 5 minutes (4 minutes 15 seconds with [[Gifted Bee|Vicious Bee's]] hive bonus) |hp = 10 (Lvl 1)16 (Lvl 2)22 (Lvl 3)34 (Lvl 5) |damage = 18 |points = 1 |bond = 5 |honey = 75 |level = 1-3, 5 }} The '''Rhino Beetle''' is a [[mob]] that defends four different [[fields]]. It is the blue variant of the [[Ladybug]].

This is one of the first mobs a player may encounter, as they are in 2 out of 5 of the [[Starter Zone|Starting Fields]] (the others being [[Ladybug]]s and the possibility of [[Aphid]]s, [[Wild Windy Bee]], and [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]).

It takes 5 minutes for a rhino beetle to respawn after being defeated (4 minutes 15 seconds with [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]). Defeating it gives 1 [[Battle Points|Battle Point]] and about 75 [[Honey]] spread across 4 honey tokens. Various other rewards are also possible with their probability increasing with [[Loot Luck]].

A Rhino Beetle's level can range from 1-5, depending on the Field that it spawns in.

== Locations == {| class="article-table" !Field !Quantity !Level |- |Blue Flower Field |1 |1 |- |Clover Field |1 (with 1 Ladybug) |2 |- |Bamboo Field |2 |2 (on left) 3 (on right) |- |Pineapple Patch |1 (with 1 [[Mantis]]) |5 |}

== Drops == Guaranteed: * 1 battle point * {{Cost|Snowflake}} (Increments of 1, 5 or 25) (Beesmas only) * {{Cost|Honey|~75}}

Possible: * {{Cost|Ticket}} (2% chance) (Loot Luck: + drop rate) (Increments of 1, 5, or 15) * {{Cost|Blueberry}} (Loot Luck: + drop rate) (Increments of 1, 5, or 10) * {{Cost|Gumdrops}} (Loot Luck: + drop rate) (Increments of 1, 5, 10, 25, or 50) * {{Cost|Treat}} (1-25) * {{Cost|Royal Jelly}} (Rare) * {{Cost|Blue Extract}} (Increments of 1 or 3 Rare) * {{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}} * {{Cost|Whirligig|||0}} (Rare) * {{Cost|Single Mitten|||0}} (Rare) (Exclusive to Beesmas only) * {{Cost|Bubble Light|||0}} (Rare) (Exclusive to Beesmas only) * {{Cost|Magic Bean|||0}} (Rare) * {{Cost|Micro-Converter|||0}} (Rare) * {{Cost|Neonberry|||0}} (Very rare) * {{Cost|Bumble Bee Egg|||0}} (Exceptionally rare)

== Strategies == * Rhino beetles behave similarly to most Mobs: it pauses to aim, then lunges. If the player stops to let them aim, then move, it will attack the spot where the Player used to be, not the Player's current location. * Some fields have objects that the player can try hiding behind, such as the stalks of Bamboo in the Bamboo Field. * The [[Glitches#Frozen Field Defenders|Frozen Field Defenders Glitch]] works very well against rhino beetles.

== Trivia == * The respawn timer for a rhino beetle currently counts down from 5 minutes. However, as with most mobs, a rhino beetle doesn't always respawn immediately after its timer runs out. (Usually a 5-10 second delay). * Rhino beetles are the most common mob, having five distinct spawning points. It also guards the most fields; being four. * There is a mob similar to the rhino beetle called the [[King Beetle]]. In fact, King Beetle is a hybrid, made up of a Ladybug and a Rhino beetle, as stated by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] on Discord. * It has the lowest health out of all mobs, with merely 10 health at level 1. * This is Onett’s favorite mob.

{{RemovedContent}} {{EventInfobox |image= ClassicLogo.png |duration= 5/23/2024 to 5/28/2024 |NPC= None |additions= [[Retro Swarm Challenge]] }} '''[[w:c:roblox:The Classic|The Classic]]''' was a Roblox event that spanned across multiple games. In each game, players had to earn 15 badges to contribute to overarching prizes in the main event hub. 10 of the 15 badges were awarded for collecting Tix (usually hidden around the map like in BSS) and 5 of the badges awarded Tokens for completing quests or achieving certain milestones.

==Overview== {{Main|Retro Swarm Challenge}}

The Retro Swarm Challenge is a round-based minigame where the main objective is to defend the hives from [[Slime]]s and [[Zombie]]s. In order to be successful, the player must save up Bricks to buy bees and weapons. The challenge subplace hosts 4 exclusive fields (Red, White, Blue and Mixed Brick Fields).

docs.title: Robo Bear Challenge
docs.text:
''This page is for the Robo Bear Challenge and only it. For the quest-giver and shop owner, see [[Robo Bear]].''

[[File:Robo bear challenge (Sharpest zoom in by beeswarmer791).jpg|thumb|Robo Bear Challenge with quests loaded]] The '''Robo Bear Challenge''' is a 5-minute challenge that can be started by talking to [[Robo Bear]]. Upon entering the challenge, the player receives 2 quests, which can be rerolled once for free in the whole run. Then, the player picks 3 bees from their hive, which can also be rerolled. After the 3 bees are chosen, all other bees that aren't picked in prior rounds or the current round are locked. The player is then allowed to purchase buffs/upgrades that cost {{Cost|Cog}}. After this, the player has 5 minutes to complete the quest that they have chosen. [[Mechsquito]]s, [[Mega Mechsquito]]s, [[Cogmower]]s, [[Cogturret]]s, are mainly spawned and [[Golden Cogmower]]s spawns at random fields during the challenge. Each 5 rounds completed gets to earn a new tier of [[Amulet#Cog Amulet|Cog Amulet]].

== Gameplay == [[File:Robo.jpg|thumb|280x280px|The starting of a Robo Bear challenge displays a quest selection screen]]

=== Before Starting === [[File:Image RBC bee choose.png|thumb|The upgrade selection menu. Comes after the Bee selection menu.]] To start the Robo Bear Challenge, the player must spend a [[Robo Pass]]. Once spent, the player receives 10 free {{Cost|Cog}} and a Quest Reroll. Then, the player has to select one of two quests. After this, the player will select one of the three selected bees in the player's hive (the player must select 3 bees in the first round and 2 bees in subsequent rounds) and can be rerolled at the expense of cogs. This expense increases as it is used more. The bees in the selection is shown their hive level, their gifted status, their equipped [[Beequip]] and their Mutation. After choosing the three bees, the player can purchase upgrades for cogs, there are three different upgrades the player can choose from and can also be rerolled for cogs that also has an expense increasing as it is used more.

=== After Starting === After starting the round, the player will receive the quest, the Robo Bear Challenge Debuff, and their selected bees. The unselected bees are shut down in the player's hive. The Robo Bear Challenge Debuff affects Capacity, Pollen from Tools, Pollen from Movement Collection, and Pollen from Coconuts. The player has 5 minutes to finish the quests. During the Challenge, the player is unable to harvest planters and use [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] Decorations. Upon completion of the quest, the round ends, and the player will receive cogs based on how many cogs the quest said it would give, along with bonus cogs depending on how fast the player finished the quest. The cogs from the Round Speed Bonus is given if the player completes the quest within 3 minutes and 45 seconds and the amount of cogs given is calculated proportionately. If the player has upgrades that grant bonus cogs, they will also be granted bonus cogs based on the total amount of cogs from all Upgrades. After a round is finished or if the challenge ends, all mobs exclusive in the challenge will be gone along with the upgrades and the Robo Bear Challenge Debuff. This process will repeat again in subsequent rounds, but the player can only select two bees to add on to the bees they already selected.

  • '''Upon reaching Round 5''', there is a guaranteed quest to that requires the Player to defeat 25 Mechsquitos and collect 1,600,000 of a certain color of Pollen. This Round grants the Player a [[Cog Amulet#Bronze Cog Amulet|Bronze Cog Amulet]] upon completion.
  • '''Upon reaching Round 10''', there is a guaranteed quest that requires the Player to defeat 10 Cogmowers and collect 60,000,000 of a certain color of Pollen. This Round grants the Player a [[Cog Amulet#Silver Cog Amulet|Silver Cog Amulet]] upon completion.
  • '''Upon reaching Round 15''', there is a guaranteed quest that requires the Player to defeat 10 Mega Mechsquitos and collect 2,000,000,000 of a certain color of Pollen. This Round grants the Player a [[Cog Amulet#Gold Cog Amulet|Gold Cog Amulet]] upon completion.
  • '''Upon reaching Round 20''', there is a guaranteed quest that requires the Player to defeat 20 Cogmowers and collect 60,000,000,000 of a certain color of Pollen. This Round grants the Player a [[Cog Amulet#Diamond Cog Amulet|Diamond Cog Amulet]] upon completion.
  • '''Upon completing Round 25''', the Challenge ends and grants the Player a [[Cog Amulet#Supreme Cog Amulet|Supreme Cog Amulet]] and the [[Cub Buddy|Robo Bear Cub Buddy]] (If not already owned) upon completion.

During and between rounds, cogs may be spent at [[Robo Bear's Shop]].

All cogs in the player's inventory are removed once the challenge ends, which happens when either the player hatches or transforms a bee, the timer of the challenge quest runs out, if the player leaves the game, or if the player presses the “Quit” button which appears on the challenge quest box. [[File:Rbcloading.ogg|thumb|250x250px|'''"Rbcloading", the theme that plays before starting a round in the challenge.'''|center]] [[File:Digitize.ogg|thumb|250x250px|'''"Digitize", the theme that plays upon starting a round in the challenge.'''|center]]

=== Mobs ===

Mechsquito Cogmower Cogturret Mega Mechsquito Golden Cogmower

== Tips ==

=== Pre-Round Preparations === * If you are aiming for a high score, you should '''use consumables''', such as Super Smoothies. You are also able to use field boosts and winds during a round. Even if you're not aiming for a high score, doing so can still be useful. ** Giving Onett a Present grants the Super Smoothie buff as well as a 3x Mountain Top Field buff. It also gives a free Robo Pass. * Attempt to '''save your quest rerolls''' or get the Reboot upgrade for an extra quest re-roll. Quest re-rolls are important if you get bad quests (i.e. being a red hive and getting two quests related to blue pollen, or a convert at hive quest). * Don't be afraid to '''save up cogs''' if the options are bad. They can be spent later on other re-rolls, upgrades, or drives. * '''Use the lock feature when necessary.''' If there is an upgrade that you need but cannot afford it, this feature will allow that specific upgrade to stay where it is until you select it. There is a lock beside each upgrade. * '''Prioritize attack bees''' such as Precise Bees, Spicy Bees, Vicious Bees, and Windy Bees. Vicious Bee is especially useful as it can attack entire swarms of mobs with Impale. Windy Bees provide excellent crowd control by damaging multiple mobs at a time with Tornado. * Digital Bee can freeze enemies and makes them receive more damage. * Avoid picking a "Convert at Hive" quest, unless your hive primarily consists of blue bees or the required amount is low.

=== Tips During Rounds === * '''Always keep on your toes!''' Mechsquitoes will apply Mechsquito Toxin on you, which reduces Pollen and Player movespeed. This can quickly accumulate in later rounds and severely hamper your collection. Mega Mechsquitoes can also do considerable damage to a still player. * '''Prioritize Cogturrets''' if possible. Cogturrets can make large swathes of the field dangerous with their rolling cogs, so try to stay near them so your Bees will attack them and take them down before they pile up and make the field impossible to navigate. ** In addition, Cogturrets only shoot their rolling cogs forward, to the left, to the right or backwards, so tracking where the rolling cogs will go and avoiding those spaces can be very helpful in dodging their cogs. * If the Cogmower/Cogturret spam is becoming too great, '''use Star Saw (if you have it).''' Star Saw circles around you for 30 seconds after activation, and while it's difficult to hit Mechsquitoes and Mega Mechsquitoes (owing to their flying hitboxes), Cogmowers and Cogturrets can easily be hit with it, allowing you to quickly take down these threats if the Bees are preoccupied with Mechsquitoes and Mega Mechsquitoes. * '''Finish the round quickly!''' A fast and decisive completion is key to a good run. As the round drags on, waves of enemies will pile up on each other, making them harder to clear. This in turn leads to a more cluttered field and a higher chance of death, ending in a death spiral that's sure to end in defeat (especially in later rounds). * If you're a Blue Hive or a mid-game Bomb Hive, make sure to use both Crimson and Cobalt Bee as the synchronize upgrade can save you. Also, in general there are a ton of upgrades that synergize around bombs and Crimson and Cobalt bee. * If you have any boost items active, such as [[Purple Potion]] or [[Super Smoothie]] when the round seems unbeatable, it is best to leave the challenge to give their buffs more time to be used in later sessions.

== Rewards == After the challenge ends, a message box displays the rewards. The number of rewards received tends to increase with a higher score. The rewards also increase in quality and quantity relative to the player's level. A higher level will also give players higher-tier Cog Amulets. The player will also only receive four rewards (other than the amulet) in varying quantities (except for the drive, which is guaranteed to have only one).

=== Rewards List === {| class="article-table" |- | {{Cost|Honey}} Potentially 1-2 items of the following types (has a chance to reward one more type of drive when completing the challenge): {{Cost|Red Drive}} {{Cost|White Drive}} {{Cost|Blue Drive}} {{Cost|Glitched Drive}} (Past completing round 10, chance increases the higher the round the challenge ended). Reaching Round 21 or higher guarantees {{Cost|Glitched Drive|1}} with a cooldown of 1 day. Beating Round 25 guarantees {{Cost|Glitched Drive|1}} and has a limit of obtaining with a cooldown of 1 day. Three of the following (The chance of getting certain items are affected by the round the challenge ended): {{Cost|Star Jelly}} {{Cost|Hard Wax}} {{Cost|Field Dice}} {{Cost|Smooth Dice}} {{Cost|Loaded Dice}} {{Cost|Whirligig}} {{Cost|Honeysuckle}} {{Cost|Micro-Converter}} {{Cost|Jelly Beans}} {{Cost|Glue}} {{Cost|Oil}} {{Cost|Neonberry}} {{Cost|White Balloon}} (Somewhat rare). {{Cost|Purple Potion}} (Somewhat rare). {{Cost|Super Smoothie}} (Rare). {{Cost|Atomic Treat}} (Very Rare) {{Cost|Bang Snap}} (Very Rare) {{Cost|Gold Egg|||0}} (Very Rare). {{Cost|Whistle|||0}} (Very Rare). {{Cost|Small Shield Sticker|||0}} (Very Rare). {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Mythic Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Turpentine|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Gifted Silver Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Gifted Diamond Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Robot Head Sticker|||0}} (Extremely rare). {{Cost|Pink Shades|||0}} (Exceptionally Rare). {{Cost|Demon Talisman|||0}} (Exceptionally Rare) {{Cost|Cub Buddy Voucher|||0}} (Unfathomably Rare). {{Cost|Gifted Mythic Egg|||0}} (Nearly Impossible) {{Cost|Pink Eraser||(Unkown)|1}} *{{Cost|Candy Ring||(Unkown)|1}} |}

===Amulets=== {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Requirement(s) !Amulet !Detail |- |Round 5 - 9 |[[File:BronzeCogAmulet.png|50px]] Bronze [[Cog Amulet]] |- |Round 10 - 14 |[[File:SilverCogAmulet.png|50px]] Silver [[Cog Amulet]] |- |Round 15 - 19 |[[File:GoldCogAmulet.png|50px]] Gold [[Cog Amulet]] |Access to crafting {{Cost|Glitched Drive}} |- |Round 20 - 24 |[[File:DiamondCogAmulet.png|50px]] Diamond [[Cog Amulet]] |Access to purchasing the [[File:Digital Bee.png|25px]] [[Digital Bee]] |- |Round 25 |[[File:SupremeCogAmulet.png|50px]] Supreme [[Cog Amulet]] |Challenge Completion and {{Cost|Robo Cub|||0}} skin (first time only) |}

==Trivia== * Almost all upgrades and their names in the Robo Bear Challenge have to do with actual software and software engineering processes, components, and procedures, like a robot. * There is a visual glitch where Cogs spent during a round or gained from Golden Cogmowers do not change the counter of Cogs on the quest menu on the right side of the screen. * When you complete a quest, you might briefly see a green 'Finish' button that's in the place of the 'Quit' button. It is unknown what purpose this button would have served, as the round automatically finishes once the quest(s) are completed. There is a glitch where after the timer ends, it disappears and the challenge doesn't end. In this period, you get infinite time to complete the quest. It is unknown why this glitch is caused, but it's most likely caused by lag. * If you attempt to use a royal jelly on a bee or hatch an egg in-between Robo Bear Challenge rounds, it will prompt you with the message: "⚠ Hatching or transforming a bee will end your Robo Bear Challenge. Continue?⚠". Choosing "Yes" will end your Robo Bear Challenge, and "No" will cancel it. When in the quest picking menu, your bees are frozen in place. If the player ended the session through disconnecting, the player will not obtain the amulet of the session until they claim their hive when they rejoined. You can obtain {{Cost|Cog}} outside of Robo Bear's Challenge. To do this, end RBC right after you kill a [[Golden Cogmower]], however the cogs won't transfer into the next challenge. When you complete a round your balloon blessing will refresh. TurboTobyTwo was the first player who triumphed the Robo Bear Challenge. While receiving a quest, the players movespeed is set to 0, meaning it's impossible for them to move. * If a bee isn't picked in the challenge, its gifted hive bonus, or any bonus on it's beequip doesn't apply. The final score is calculated with the following formula: ''Score ='' (''5000 * Rounds_Completed) + (1000 * Last_Round_Progress%) + (Total_Cogs_Earned)'' **If the player manages to triumph the challenge, the score formula is instead: ''125,000 + (Total_Cogs_Earned)'' * [[File:16 Micro-Converter RBC.png|thumb|220px|16 Micro-Converters obtained from the Robo Bear Challenge while the item's cap being 15.]]The Robo Bear Challenge can sometimes reward items with a quantity higher than its cap, for example: 16 [[Micro-Converter|Micro-Converters]] while its cap being 15. The player will still obtain the item normally, not exceeding its cap.

docs.title: Robo Bear's Party Cake
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} The '''Robo Bear's Party Cake''' is a [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]]-exclusive machine that was added in the second part of Beesmas 2022. It is accessible after completing [[Robo Bear]]'s Party Cake Quest and initiates a special challenge every 3 hours.

==Appearance== Before completing Robo Bear's quest, the party cake is only 3 metal trusses, stacked to make a pyramid, with an unlit olive green "5" candle on the top. The number changes every year to show how many years the game's been up.

After the quest is finished, the "number" candle is lit with neon lights and a blue outline. The cake layers are olive green with different colored frames, the bottom layer blue, the middle yellow, and the top purple. Candles and sparklers are placed on the corners, and Neon Sprinkles are placed around the front of each layer.

==Uses== After completing Robo Bear's quest, players will be able to start a [[Robo Party]] every 3 hours. The Robo Party spawns Party Mobs around the map for players to defeat, and in turn they can get rewards, including Robo Party Blessing. The Robo Party can spawn "Party" versions of the Mechsquito, Cogmower, Cogturret and Mega Mechsquito. Once a Robo Party has begun, a set number (that changes with the rank of the party) of Party Mobs spawn in random fields, and the players in the server have to defeat them all within 3 minutes. If they are successful, the player that summoned the party has their party cake increased by 1 rank and the players receive rewards, including Robo Party Blessing. If they do not complete it within the timer, the player that summoned it has their party cake decreased by 1 rank. Party mobs also have a chance to drop Robo Party Blessing tokens, with the chance increasing with the level of the Mob and the type of mob that is defeated.

==Rewards== Each rank completed for the first time rewards the player with an amount of Tickets equal to the level of the rank completed (Completing Rank 5 would reward 5 Tickets). Stingers and a type of [[Balloon]] are guaranteed for every rank completed for the first time. docs.title: Robo Bear's Shop
docs.text:
{{Stores |title1 = Robo Bear's Shop |image1 = RoboBear'sShop.png |row1 = Seen above Robo Bear.}}

'''Robo Bear's Shop''' is a [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Shops shop] run by [[Robo Bear]] located right of the [[Red HQ]], next to the [[Rose Field]]. This shop sells all of the [[drives]], and [[Digital Bee]]. It was added alongside the rest of Robo Bear's area in the [[Updates|12/26/22]] update.

Robo Bear's Shop is not the official name of the shop; it is only called this (assumably) because the owner of the shop is Robo Bear.

The formula for the price of each colored drive in honey is

P(n) = 250{,}000n^{2}

where ''n'' represents the ''n''th drive of that type to purchase (1st is 250,000, 2nd is 1,000,000, 3rd is 2,250,000, etc). The price for [[Glitched Drive]]s begins at ''n + 1''.

== Trivia == This shop, the [[Coconut Cave]] and [[Dapper Bear's Shop]] are the only shops not to use the [[Music|"Vendor"]] soundtrack when you enter it. If the Digital Bee was bought through a {{Cost|Robux|}} Pack, you will receive 1000 tickets when purchasing this (without the ticket requirement for purchasing).

'''Robo Bear''' is an [[:Category:NPC|NPC]] released in Beesmas 2022 update. It is located in the 15 Bee Zone, found next to the Red HQ and at the other end of the [[Rose Field]]. The main feature of Robo Bear is initiating the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. Before gaining access to Robo Bear, the player will be first given a quest to assemble the missing parts of Robo Bear being Red Drive, White Drive, Blue Drive, and Glitched Drive. The drives can be obtained in the following quests: * [[Science Bear]]: Repairing the White Drive * [[Dapper Bear]]: Bartering for the Blue Drive * [[Panda Bear]]: Ready For the Red Drive? * [[Science Bear]]: Corrupting the Glitched Drive When all requirements are met, the player can then access to talking to Robo Bear and initiate the Robo Bear Challenge at the cost of 1 Robo Pass, obtainable through the dispensers in the 30 bee zone.

During Beesmas 2022, players were able to complete the quest by purchasing a white drive in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]], completing Science Bear's Beesmas 2022 quest for a red drive, completing Dapper Bear's Beesmas 2022 quest for a blue drive, and completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] “Decorating For Drives” quest for a glitched drive.

=== Dialogues === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" !Dialogue |- |… .. . ! ERROR ! ERROR ! >>Insufficient [Drives] Robo Bear unit lacks necessary [Drives] for normal operation. To proceed, locate and install necessary [Drives] into unit. BEEEEP Commencing hibernation mode. Good Bye.

-Turning in-

. .. ... NECESSARY [DRIVES] DETECTED. Please install [Drives] into Robo Bear unit. ...cluchink...cluchink... [Drives] installed. Initiating Robo Bear routine. ZzzAp zzip >>SUCCESS. Welcome User. I am Robo Bear, the world's first Challenge generating automaton. I have been programmed specifically to push beekeepers to their limits. I am capable of generating over 6,459,542,340,244,001 unique combinations of Quests. I can simultaneously control up to 340 Robotic monsters using cog-based technologies. I can present any bee with obstacles they cannot overcome [ This may not apply to bees of digital nature ] And I am here to challenge you and your bees today. Using a [Robo Pass], you may participate in Robo Bear's Challenge. In it, you will complete rounds of random quests, with random bees selected from your hive. Each round has a time limit of 5 minutes. If you fail to complete a quest, the challenge ENDS. Each round consists of multiple steps: STEP 1>> Choose 1 of 2 randomly generated quests. STEP 2>> Pick some bees from a random selection taken from your hive. Note: Any bees you have not picked in the challenge will be DEACTIVATED until rounds ''[sic]'' ends. Deactivated bees will not assist you, and their Gifted Hive bonuses will not apply. STEP 3>> Purchase 1 or more Upgrades with [Cogs]. The Upgrades modify the stats of your swarm during all rounds of the challenge. If you cannot afford an Upgrade, you may LOCK it to purchase it in the future rounds. STEP 4>> Complete the quest in under 5 minutes! As you work on the quest, my mechanical minions will attack. They are optimally designed to push you to the brink of death. If you complete the quest, you will be rewarded [Cogs]. [Cogs] are used to purchase Upgrades, rerolls, and [Drives]. NOTE: [Cogs] are REMOVED at the end of the Challenge. Rounds will increase in difficulty until you are eliminated... Or: Until you complete round 25, in which case you are VICTORIOUS. Complete 5 rounds to earn a [Cog Amulet]. Every 5 additional rounds will increase the rank of the amulet. Please note: All honey made during rounds will not be saved. Please note: If you leave the game during a round, the challenge ends. You can leave BETWEEN rounds, however. Please note: During a challenge, you may not transform or hatch any bees. Even between rounds. >>INTRODUCTION SPIEL COMPLETE. I will dispense 1 [Robo Pass] when this conversation terminates. When you are ready to play, return to this Robo Bear unit. Good Bye. BEEEP |- | '''Initial talk (after completing "Repairing Robo Bear")'''

BEEP BOOP Welcome User to the Robo Bear Challenge Interface. How may I be of assistance? ''-Spend 1 [[Robo Pass]] to start Robo Bear's Challenge.-''

Initiating Challenge-Type: ROBO BEAR. > 3.. 2.. 1.. BEEEEEEEEEEP

''-Explain the rules.-''

LOADING: Robo Bear's Challenge Info. ...BEEP... Robo Bear's Challenge is a minigame consisting of multiple rounds. During each round, the player has 5 minutes to complete a random quest. After each round, players are rewarded [Cogs]. Bonus [Cogs] are earned for faster completion. Players can use [Cogs] to purchase upgrades that last for the duration of the challenge. At the start, all but 3 of the player's bees are deactivated. Deactivated bees will not assist the player, and their Gifted Hive and Beequip hive bonuses are removed. Pollen from tools and Capacity is also greatly reduced, but increases each round. Each round, the player may choose 2 bees to re-activate from a random selection. The player may use [Cogs] to re-roll bee and upgrade options. Robotic enemies will attack the player as the rounds progress. If the player fails to complete any round, the challenge ends. If the player leaves the game while a round is in progress, the challenge ends. Certain boosts, including ones from promocodes and Honeyday Events, are disabled during the rounds. Players are rewarded according to the number of rounds they complete. [Cog Amulets] are granted after completing a number of rounds: Bronze Cog Amulet: 5 rounds, Silver Cog Amulet: 10 rounds, Gold Cog Amulet: 15 rounds, Diamond Cog Amulet: 20 rounds, Supreme Cog Amulet: 25 rounds. After round 25, the player is VICTORIOUS. > End of rules beeb beeb GOOD LUCK.

''-Cancel.-''

==Trivia== Robo Bear is the second NPC in the game that can initiate a challenge, the first being [[Stick Bug]]. Robo Bear uses the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/82/Robot-Animation-Pack Robot Animation Pack]. Robo Bear is one of the few quest givers who own a shop, the others being [[Mother Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Gummy Bear]], and [[Bee Bear]]. Robo Bear's original face decal was made on 2/24/2019, eventually releasing on 12/14/2022 for [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]]. *Robo Bear is the only bear to publicly have its design changed from before release.

docs.title: Robo Party
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Cake.PNG|thumb|Robo Bear's Party Cake, used to summon a Robo Party.]] The '''Robo Party''' is a server-wide event where everyone in it has to defeat all the Party Robots scattered around the [[fields]]. To start a Robo Party, the player has to use a [[Robo Bear's Party Cake]], which is accessed by completing [[Robo Bear]]'s Beesmas Quest. The player can only start a Robo Party once every 3 hours. The Robo Party has a time limit of 3 minutes before the party is over. If all Party Robots are defeated, all participants will be rewarded with [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Other|Robo Party Blessing]], and the Player who used the Party Cake will be rewarded with items and can summon a Robo Party with a higher rank. If not all of the party mobs were killed, the player's rank for the Robo Party gets lowered. The Robo Party can also be summoned by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]].

If all the Party Robots are defeated, the player who used the Party Cake will get an amount of Robo Party Blessing equal to the rank that was finished (Completing Rank 5 would reward the player with 5 stacks of Robo Party Blessing).

TOC

==Mobs== The Robo Party has a ranking system, the higher the rank, the more mobs will appear, along with their level and health increasing. However, the Party Robot's drops and the challenge's rewards will slowly improve. There are four types of Mobs that are spawned during the event: Party Mechsquitoes, Party Cogmowers, Party Cogturrets, and Party Mega Mechsquitoes. Party Cogturrets will spawn on Rank 5, while Party Mega Mechsquitoes will spawn on Rank 15. == Strategies for Robo Parties == Using [[Stinger|Stingers]] will give x1.5 attack to your bees for 30 seconds. This can be very useful when killing high-level mobs like Party Cogturrets or Party Mega Mechsquitoes. If the amount of mobs are too overwhelming, use [[Passive Abilities|Star Saw]] (if you have it). Star Saw circles around you for 30 seconds after activation, and while it's difficult to hit Party Mechsquitoes and Party Mega Mechsquitoes (owing to their flying hitboxes), Party Cogmowers and Party Cogturrets can easily be hit with it, allowing you to quickly take down these threats if the Bees are preoccupied with Party Mechsquitoes and Party Mega Mechsquitoes. [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] provide excellent crowd control, especially since most mobs often come in pairs or packs (other than Party Mega Mechsquitos). Digital Bee can also stun many mobs at once and allow them to take extra damage via Mind Hack. Party Cogturrets will always shoot straight at where they are facing so you can avoid their attacks simply by not being in front of them. Party Cogmowers don't aim for the player, allowing players to easily sidestep them. Stand near the Party Mobs, this will allow your bees to lock on to the Party Mobs and quickly deal damage. Party Mechsquitos and Party Mega Mechsquitos aim for where the player is, not where the player will be. Because of this, moving around in circles will often result in them missing their attack. Always keep an eye on your health. While doing Robo Parties, it is easy to be too focused on killing the Party Robots, and not keep track of how much damage you've taken. **If you so happen to die, you can look around for fields with Party Robots when you respawn until your bees wake up.

==Trivia== The number on the Party Cake changes based on how how old the game is on that year The Party Cogturret is the only Party Robot without a Party Hat. It is not possible to have 2 Robo Parties happening at the same time. The Robo Party Blessing Icon is similar to Gifted [[Buoyant Bee|Buoyant Bee's]] Surprise Party ability token. *Coincidentally, the Party Hat spawned upon the ability being activated is similar to the one most of the Party Mobs wear. Every Party Mob behaves similar to [[Golden Cogmower]]s, spawning in random/specific fields, rather than either swarming the player or spawning in the field they're currently in.

docs.title: Robo Pass Dispenser
docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]], which does not cost anything and has a cooldown timer.''

[[File:Robo dispenser.png|thumb|The Robo Pass Dispenser.]] The '''Robo Pass Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] located in the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Zone]]. It gives one [[Robo Pass]] for 50 [[ticket]]s, which can be used to participate in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. Unlike the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]], there is no cooldown for this dispenser. Players cannot use this dispenser if they already have 10 or more Robo Passes.

== Trivia == * There used to be a free {{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}} token behind the Robo Pass Dispenser, this has been replaced with the [[Broken Drive]]. * This, the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]], the [[Free Ant Pass Dispenser]], and the [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]] are the only [[:Category:Dispenser|dispensers]] that don't have any visible faucets, and instead have a small compartment, like a vending machine that gives out [[ticket]]s. * This, the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]], and the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]] are the only dispensers that require tickets to use. * This, the Free Robo Pass Dispenser, the Free Ant Pass Dispenser, the Ant Pass Dispenser, the [[Coconut Dispenser]], and the [[Glue Dispenser]] are the only dispensers that do not grant [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] when used.

docs.title: Robo Pass
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Rpass.png |description = Used to activate [[Robo Bear Challenge|Robo Bear's Challenge]]. |cooldown = No cooldown |cap = 10 }} [[File:Free robo dispenser.png|thumb|The free Robo Dispenser (22 hour cooldown per Robo Pass)]] [[File:Robo dispenser.png|thumb|Robo Dispenser (50 tickets per Robo Pass)]] A {{Color|Robo Pass}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates|12/26/2022 update]]. The player must use one in order to participate in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. Players can only have a maximum of 10 Robo Passes in their inventory at a time unless purchased from [[Robux Shop|Robux packs]] or received from quests.

A robo pass can be used by talking to Robo Bear and initiating Round 1 of the Robo Bear Challenge.

==Methods of Obtaining== There is a [[Free Robo Pass Dispenser]] past the [[Bear Gate]] which can be used every 22 hours. There is also a [[Robo Pass Dispenser]] to the right of the Free Robo Pass Dispenser which gives a Robo Pass for {{Cost|Ticket|50}} with no cooldown. As a rare drop from [[Rhino Beetle]]s, [[Ladybug]]s, [[Spider]]s, [[Scorpion]]s, [[Coconut Crab]], [[Tunnel Bear]], [[King Beetle]], or [[Aphid#Armored Aphids|Armored Aphid]]s. There is a Robo Pass token hidden behind a rock in the [[Coconut Cave]]. There is a Robo Pass token on the green cog near the [[Star Hall]]. As a possible reward from the [[Ant Challenge]]. As a possible drop from [[Puffshroom]]s. As a stack reward for adding a certain Sticker to the Sticker Stack Robot Head Sticker rewards 1 Robo Pass. Party Robo Bear Sticker rewards 1 Robo Pass. *Purchasing the Reindeer Games Pack from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] for {{Cost|Snowflake|2,000}} and {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|200}} grants 10 Robo Passes and other items.

=== '''Outdated Ways''' === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | There was a Robo Pass token hidden behind the Robo Pass Dispensers. It was replaced by a Broken Drive token after Beesmas 2022 ended. There was a Robo Pass token hidden inside [[The Computer]] during Beesmas 2022. There was a Robo Pass token hidden inside the [[Beesmas Tree]] during Beesmas 2022. Defeating Level 4, 11, and 18 [[Snowbear]]s. As a first time reward from beating specific Robo Party ranks. The Digital Bee pack gave 10 Robo Passes + other items. The Mondo Robo Bundle gave 25 Robo Passes + other items. The Robotic Bundle in Bee Bears Catalog gave 10 Robo Passes, along with other items. From certain quests: Onett's Beesmas 2022 quest gives 3 Robo Passes. Riley Bee's Beesmas 2022 quest gives 1 Robo Pass. Bucko Bee's Beesmas 2022 quest gives 1 Robo Pass. Stick Bug's Beesmas 2022 quest gives 1 Robo Pass. As a reward from certain [[Gift Boxes]]: The Charcoal Gift Box gave 1 Robo Pass. The Obnoxious Gift Box gave 1 Robo Pass. The Tropical Gift Box gave 1 Robo Pass. *From giving {{Cost|Present}} in the Beesmas 2022 Event: Giving [[Stick Bug]] a Present gave 1 Robo Pass. Giving [[Onett]] a Present gave 1 Robo Pass. Giving [[Robo Bear]] a Present gave 1 Robo Pass. **Giving [[Gummy Bear]] a Present gave 1 Robo Pass. |}

==Gallery== File:RoboPassImage1.png|Ten Robo Passes in the Inventory Menu. File:RoboPassImage2.png|A Robo Pass Token in the 30 Bee Zone behind the Robo Pass Dispenser. File:RoboPassImage3.png|A Robo Pass Token on top of the green cog outside of the Star Hall. File:RoboPassImage4.png|Ten Robo Passes along with other items in the Robotic Bundle from Bee Bear's Catalog during Beesmas 2022. File:RoboPassImage5.png|A Robo Pass Token behind a rock in the Coconut Cave. ==Trivia== The Robo Pass took the longest time to get implemented out of all the items in the game, taking over 3 years after it was initially leaked on April 4, 2019. Unlike {{Cost|Ant Pass}}, a Robo Pass cannot be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]] and will not appear when attempting to select an item to donate.

docs.title: Rogue Vicious Bee
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Rogue Vicious Bee |image = Vicious Bee.png |location = [[Clover Field]], [[Spider Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Rose Field]], [[Mountain Top Field]], [[Pepper Patch]] |timer = 10-30 minutes |hp = Increases by level and if Gifted |damage = 40 (Normal), 50 (Gifted) |points = None |bond = Varies (50-350) |honey = Varies by the level and the damage output by the player |level = 1-12

}}''This page is for the rogue version of Vicious Bee. For the tamed version, see [[Vicious Bee]].''

'''Rogue Vicious Bee''' is a [[:Category:Mini Bosses|Mini-Boss]] that can spawn in the [[Clover Field|Clover]], [[Spider Field|Spider]], [[Cactus Field|Cactus]], [[Rose Field|Rose]], [[Mountain Top Field]], or the [[Pepper Patch]]. Rogue Vicious Bee has a high chance to spawn when it turns [[nighttime]], or can be manually spawned with a [[Night Bell]].

Rogue Vicious Bee has a small chance to spawn as a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] variant (roughly 1 in 30-40 chance, or 2.5-3.3% chance). When gifted, it has more health, higher attack rate, and more damage. In return, it rewards a much larger amount of [[Stinger]]s and honey. During Beesmas 2020, 2022, and 2024, it also had/has a small chance to drop [[Icicles]]. This did not apply in Beesmas 2021.

When it is summoned, a spike sound is played along with a short tune, indicating its presence. The player will need to find it hiding in a field with a small gray spike (golden if gifted) sticking out; it will attack if a player touches or goes near its spike. While in [[King Beetle's Lair]], a player can see a large spike if the Rogue Vicious Bee is in the Clover Field. Once the player walks close/onto this spike (whether silver or golden), the Rogue Vicious Bee will be summoned. This also damages the player if they walked onto the spike. Everyone in the server will receive a notification when a Rogue Vicious Bee attacks a player via a server-wide message: {{Notification|Vicious|⚠ [Gifted] Vicious Bee is attacking {Username} in the {Field Name}! ⚠|14}}

When it's defeated, a message announces: {{Notification|Honey|🎉 [Gifted] Vicious Bee has been defeated! 🎉}}

==Attack Pattern and Rewards== Rogue Vicious Bee attacks players by summoning spikes from the ground. It has two attack patterns - tracking and then attacking randomly. Rogue Vicious Bee sends out 3 spikes to each player in its range and faces the nearest player. After this, it sends out random spikes while spinning in a circle. After each volley of attacks, it moves to a different spot on the field. The higher the level the bee is, the greater the number of spikes summoned. Red circles indicate where a spike is about to appear. The spikes will do approximately 40 damage to players with no [[System Page#Defense|Defense]], and 50 if gifted.

Gifted Rogue Vicious Bee's spikes form quicker, allowing it to move more often. It also sends out 4 targeting spikes compared to 3.

Upon defeat, Rogue Vicious Bee drops stingers and [[Honey]]. Bees gain 50 [[Bond]] plus an additional 50 for every level of Rogue Vicious Bee above 2. The amount of honey rewarded is based on the total damage dealt to the bee. Stingers are awarded as long as the player deals any amount of damage to the bee, even if the player leaves the field before it is fully defeated and/or if they get killed. The higher the level of the Rogue Vicious Bee, the more stingers are yielded. A daily bonus of 5 Stingers is also given for the first Rogue Vicious Bee defeated that day, with a cooldown of 22 hours after the daily reward. [[File:Bss1.JPG|thumb|273px|Level 7-9 Vicious Bee rewards.]] Level 1-3: 1 stinger - Gifted: 6 stingers Level 4-6: 2 stingers - Gifted: 9 stingers Level 7-9: 3 stingers - Gifted: 12 stingers Level 10-12: 4 stingers - Gifted: 15 stingers *Chance to give icicle beequip during Beesmas event

Note that the number of stingers given does '''NOT''' change based on how many people are fighting them.

Additionally, during Beesmas, Rogue Vicious Bee can drop the icicles beequip when defeated. The chance of the beequip being obtained increases with the level of the Rogue Vicious Bee.

If Rogue Vicious Bee is in attack mode but there is nobody in its range, it will eventually despawn and a server-wide message will announce: {{Notification|Vicious|[Gifted] Vicious Bee left...}}

==Audio== The following audio plays when Rogue Vicious Bee has been summoned: [[File:Viccall1.ogg]]

The following audio plays when Rogue Vicious Bee has been defeated: [[File:Viccall2.ogg]]

==Tips== When hunting for hidden Rogue Vicious Bees, angle the camera so that it is aligned with the side of the field to make it easier to see spikes sticking out. * When it turns night, check all the fields Rogue Vicious Bee can spawn in, as night signals its possible appearance. * When fighting Rogue Vicious Bees, the player can AFK the fight by standing on something higher than the spikes. For example, the player can stand on a cactus if fighting in the Cactus Field. This works on all fields as long as what the player is standing on is more elevated than the field Rogue Vicious Bee spawned in, and close enough to the field that the Rogue Vicious Bee does not despawn. Rogue Vicious Bee may go out of range temporarily but will often move back into range of the player’s bees so they can defeat it. Spikes despawn after five minutes of appearance, allowing time for the player to get ready. When a Rogue Vicious Bee starts using tracking spikes, continue moving around the field. This will be indicated if it is looking at a player. When it starts attacking randomly, stop moving. The player should only move when a warning circle is directly under the character. The attack is indicated if it starts spinning. The spike hitboxes are smaller than the warning circle radius. This means that not much movement is required to dodge the spikes. The spike hitboxes are only on the base of the spike, meaning that it's possible to jump over it and without taking damage. *If a Rogue Vicious Bee is too difficult to defeat, other players that are in the server can help out. It may also be better to leave instead rather than just wasting time if you can't call out other players to help. * If a Rogue Vicious Bee spawns nearby, the player might hear a stabbing sound, similar to the Vicious Bee spikes sound effect.

A wild windy bee with Mondo Chick and a Gifted Vicious Bee.png|A Gifted {{PAGENAME}} with a Wild Windy Bee and Mondo Chick. Giftedviciousbee.png|A Gifted Vicious Bee being summoned and attacking a player. File:Vicious and Windy.png|A {{PAGENAME}} and a Wild Windy Bee in the Cactus Field. File:Vic bee under a field.png|A {{PAGENAME}} under a field. File:Screenshot 2024-08-02 210538.png|A Rogue Vicious Bee dropping Icicles

==Trivia== [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] are the only mini-bosses and [[Mobs]] that are also [[Bees]], Windy Bee’s counterpart being [[Wild Windy Bee]]. ** These are the only hostile mobs that have a bee counterpart. * Rogue Vicious Bee is the third boss that was added to the game. * Rogue Vicious Bee is the first "mob" in the game to not attack by colliding, as it uses a "special ability," being its spikes. It is the second mob to have varying levels, the first being [[Ants]], and the third, fourth and fifth being [[Stick Bug]], [[Stick Nymphs]] and Wild Windy Bee, respectively. * Rogue Vicious Bee and the [[Frog]] are the only mobs that are guaranteed to spawn by using an item, the {{Cost|Night Bell|}} and [[Box-O-Frogs|Box-o-Frogs]] respectively. * If the player exits the field while Rogue Vicious Bee is using its tracking attack, the base of the spike will be hovering in the air. When Rogue Vicious Bee is in tracking mode, it will face where its last spike was. If more than one player is fighting it, it will instead face a random spike. It will continue to attack the player even if they are outside of the field, but only if they are in close proximity to the field. * Rogue Vicious Bee's spikes are able to damage other mobs and have no damage cap. This can allow for a fast [[Mondo Chick]] capture as the Mondo Chick runs around into the spikes taking damage. * If the player touches the initial spike that sticks out of the ground of the field, they will take damage as if they are one of the bee's attacking spikes. This spike does not activate the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]]. * When it turns to night, even if Rogue Vicious Bee has recently spawned, there will still be a 1/3 chance of it spawning again. * Rogue Vicious Bee is slightly larger than all hive bees, including tamed Vicious Bees. When Rogue Vicious Bee leaves, it makes the same puff of smoke as when other mobs do when they are defeated. The same occurs if its dormant spike is not triggered and despawns. * Rogue Vicious Bee shines light directly under itself, unlike its tamed counterpart. The light is only visible at night. The player can angle their camera underneath the field in the location of a spike, where they can get a glimpse of Rogue Vicious Bee hiding beneath the field. It can also be made visible by clearing out the flower the spike is in. *There seems to be a [[Glitches|glitch]] where Rogue Vicious Bee's Gifted variant can spawn missing around 5% of its max health. * If the player collides with Rogue Vicious Bee by jumping into its body, they will take some damage. * [[Sun Bear]] mentions in his quest “Vicious Bee Begone” that he has had an encounter with a Rogue Vicious Bee.
