docs.text:
{{Field|image = RoseFieldRoboBear.png|fieldcolor = Red|bees = 15|width = 31|height = 20}}The '''Rose Field''' is one of the four [[fields]] located past the [[Honey Bee Gate]]. This field can be found near the [[Red HQ]]. It is protected by two [[scorpion]]s, one level 5, and the other level 6.

This is a 20×31 field, containing 620 [[flowers]]. The flowers are red and white, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

{| class="article-table" !Flowers !White !Red !Blue !Total |- !Single |2% |4% |0% |'''6%''' |- !Double |8% |36% |0% |'''44%''' |- !Triple |8% |42% |0% |'''50%''' |- !Total |'''18%''' |'''82%''' |'''0%''' |'''100%''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[strawberry]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|red boost]], [[Red Extract|red extract]], [[bitterberry]], and [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Rose Field are [[Rad Bee]], [[Rascal Bee]], [[Rage Bee]], [[Riley Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], and [[Vicious Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Rose Field are [[Puppy Bee]], [[Stubborn Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], [[Demo Bee]], [[Baby Bee]], and [[Diamond Bee]].

This field grants Motivating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

A level 5-7 [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has a chance of spawning here.

== Obtaining Boosts == [[File:Rose Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Rose Field Boost icon.]] * Using the [[Red Field Booster]] may give a Rose [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +100% Rose Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Rose Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the boost isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - 300% Rose Field pollen for 15 minutes based on the type used and based on its current stack before getting another one. * Rose [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Rose Field conversion, and give +5% instant Rose Field conversion and +15% Rose Field pollen for each stack. Rose Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times.

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Giving a [[present]] to [[Onett]] gave Rose Field Boost x1 and other boosts and [[items]] and giving [[Gifted Riley Bee]] a present gave Rose Field Boost x3 and other boosts and items during Beesmas 2021. * Redeeming certain expired codes. ** LateNightGumdrops (Gave Rose Field Boost x2 + other stuff).\ ** Discord100k (Gives Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** CarmenSanDiego (Activates Rose Field Code Buff + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gives a x1 Field Boost for all Fields + other stuff). ** PlushFriday (Gives Rose Field Code Buff + other stuff). ** Afternoon (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** GummyBoost (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** Reboot (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** TeraBriteFight (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** ThatGuyGift (Gave Rose Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** TeraTreasure (Gave Rose Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** BeeMine (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** 300mVisits (Gave Rose Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** August (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** Valentine (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 and Rose Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). ** RebootFriday (Gave Rose Field Code Boost + other stuff). ** 5mMembers (Gave Rose Field Boost x3 and Rose Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). * Purchasing a Rose Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] gave 1.25x Rose Field Pollen along with x1.5 Rose [[Field Capacity]], +10% [[System Page#Bee Attack|Bee Attack]], and +50 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]].

== Gallery == Screenshot 11.png|The part of the field that used to clip outside of the map. CurrentLookOfTheRoseFieldRJToken.png|The royal jelly token above Rose Field. hivesticker rose field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * This is one of six fields that [[fireflies]] travel to, with the others being [[Bamboo Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Spider Field]], and [[Strawberry Field]]. * Vicious Bee likes this field most likely because roses commonly have thorns on their stems. ** It is also the only blue bee to like a field of the opposite color. The only other bee to share this trait is [[Festive Bee]] and [[Pine Tree Forest]]. * This field was one of the fields which has a small section outside of the map. * There is a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] token next to this field in a small ledge, which can be accessed by walking a small path along the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]] wall. * This is the only field past the Honey Bee Gate to not be defended by the [[Werewolf]]. * After the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], treat tokens could naturally spawn in this field. This is the only field to be at a lower elevation than the gate leading to it. If a Rogue Vicious Bee spawns in this field, it can attack players inside the Red HQ with its spikes. *Stepping in the row of flowers closest to [[Robo Bear]] does not spawn the Scorpions.

docs.text:
''Not to be confused with the [[Free Royal Jelly Dispenser]], which does not cost anything, or the [[Royal Jelly Shop]].''

[[File:Royal Jelly Dispenser-0.png|thumb|240x240px|The Royal Jelly Ticket Dispenser beside the Clover Field.]] The '''Royal Jelly Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] that is located near the [[Clover Field]] and the [[Noob Shop]]. It requires {{Cost|Ticket|6}} to be exchanged for {{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}} and 10× [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]].

The dispenser has a cooldown of 3 seconds.

== Gallery == File:RoyalJellyTicketDispenser1.png|The Royal Jelly Ticket Dispenser ready to be used. File:RoyalJellyTicketDispenser2.png|The Royal Jelly Dispenser needed to be used 101 times for the BBM’s Naughty List quest. File:RoyalJellyTicketDispenser3.png|The rewards from the Royal Jelly Ticket Dispenser.

== Trivia ==

  • In terms of honey, the Royal Jelly Dispenser is very overpriced due to 1 royal jelly costing 1 million honey at the royal jelly shop, although if a player were to purchase 6 tickets from the mountain top [[Ticket Shop]], it would cost more than a million honey. The Royal Jelly Ticket Dispenser is one of three dispensers that require tickets to use, the others being the [[Ant Pass Dispenser]] and the [[Robo Pass Dispenser]]. Coincidentally, all three dispensers have a counterpart that gives their item for free, albeit with a much longer cooldown in between usage. The Royal Jelly Dispenser's free counterpart, however, requires [[Gifted Bee|gifted bees]] in order to become utilized. The Royal Jelly Dispenser, the [[Honey Dispenser]], the [[Strawberry Dispenser]], the [[Blueberry Dispenser]], the [[Glue Dispenser]], and the [[Samovar]] are the only dispensers that are required to be used for a [[Quests|quest]].

docs.title: Royal Jelly Shop
docs.text:
[[File:RoyalJellyShop.png|right|253x253px|The Royal Jelly Shop.]] ''Not to be confused with the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]].''

The '''Royal Jelly Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located on a rocky hill between the [[Rose Field]] and the [[Pine Tree Forest]], to the right of and just below the [[Blue Cannon]]. Players can purchase [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] in exchange for [[honey]].

The first royal jelly the player buys will cost 250,000 honey. Each subsequent royal jelly will cost an additional 10,000 honey, eventually reaching a maximum of 1,000,000 honey per royal jelly.

The formula for the price of one royal jelly is

P(n) = \begin{cases}250{,}000+10{,}000n & 0 \leq n < 75\\1{,}000{,}000 & n \geq 75\end{cases}

Where

n

is the amount of royal jelly already purchased.

Royal jelly can be purchased in increments of 1, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, 100,000, 1,000,000, 10,000,000, or 100,000,000.

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Completedsamovar.png|thumb|272x272px|The Samovar when completed.]] The '''Samovar''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] that was added in [[Beesmas]] 2021 and has returned in Beesmas 2022 and 2024. This machine can be unlocked by completing [[Dapper Bear]]'s Beesmas quest, and when activated, it rewards a random [[Nectar]] type and [[items]] near the cup. The Samovar has a cooldown of 6 hours.

If a player stands on the activation platform with Samovar without completing Dapper Bear's Beesmas 2021/2022 quest, the following message will appear: "''This strange thing is looking a little rusty...''"

== Drops == ''It is important to note that the Samovar lists how many times it was used '''previously''', not how many uses it is on currently.For example: If it says it has been used 24 times, then you are on the 25th use.''

Every time the Samovar is used, the amount of Nectar received will increase by 5 minutes, capping at 4 hours 12 minutes. {{Cost|Honeysuckle|}} increases by 1 each use, stopping at {{Cost|Honeysuckle|30}}.

The Samovar has a fixed cycle of rewards: {{Cost|Oil|||0}} -> {{Cost|Enzymes}} -> {{Cost|Gumdrops}} -> {{Cost|Glitter|||0}} -> {{Cost|Ticket Planter|||0}}. On the 25th use, the Ticket Planter is replaced with a {{Cost|Turpentine|||0}} as a 1 time reward (there aren't any further milestones at 50, 100, etc.). It will continue to cycle through the first 5 rewards afterward.

Guaranteed: * {{Cost|Honeysuckle|||0}} (Starts from 3, increases by 1 each use and caps at 30). * Random [[Nectar]] buff (Starts from 1 Hour, increases by 5 minutes each use and caps at 4 hours (4 hours and 12 minutes if you have the [[Ornaments|Potpourri]] ornament)).

Bonus drops: * {{Cost|Oil|1}} * {{Cost|Enzymes|1}} * {{Cost|Gumdrops|25}} * {{Cost|Glitter|1}} * {{Cost|Ticket Planter|1}} * {{Cost|Turpentine|1}} (25th use only).

== Gallery == SamovarIncompleteText.png|The text that appears if you have not completed Dapper Bear's quest. IncompleteSamovar.jpg|The Samovar before it is completed. Player collecting tokens from samovar.png|A player collecting tokens from the samovar. File:A turpentine token.png|A Turpentine token from Samovar

== Trivia == * This and the [[Robo Bear's Party Cake|Party Cake]] are currently the only Beesmas decorations not added in the Beesmas 2020 event. * It would take 36 uses to get the max amount of nectar from this machine. * The nectar collected from the Samovar will contribute to quests requiring a specific type of nectar. *The samovar would be used 284 times if you used it every 6 hours from the beginning of beesmas to the end of beesmas.

The {{Color|Satisfying Vial}} is a consumable [[Nectar Vial|nectar vial]] [[Items|item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2022.12.26|12/26/2022 update]]. Once used, it grants the player 4 hours of the [[Nectar|Satisfying Nectar buff]] instantly. It can also be used to craft other [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]] and [[tools]].

== Ways to Obtain == * Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 5th, 11th and 15th quests grants 1 Satisfying Vial and other items. * Using the [[Nectar Condenser]] to condense 12 hours of Satisfying Nectar. * Adding the Satisfying Nectar Icon to the [[Sticker Stack]] grants 1 Satisfying Vial.

docs.text:
{{Bear |image =Science.png |type = Quest Bear |location = Next to Yellow Cannon and below Red Portal |bees = 10+ |basecolor1 = #835c17 |basecoloramount = 1 |shadecoloramount = 1 |shadecolor1 = #684f24 |snoutcoloramount = 2 |snoutcolor1 = #825a16 |snoutcolor2 = #8a764a |torsocolor1 = #cacaca |torsocoloramount = 1 |armscolor = #9a6e2c |legscolor = #724d15 |enableother = y |othercolor1 = #6e6b53 |othercoloramount = 2 |othercolor2 = #9a9a9a |othername = Glasses }}'''Science Bear''' is a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]], and one of the eight permanent quest [[bears]] that can be accessed in the game, the others being [[Black Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], [[Polar Bear]], and [[Spirit Bear]].

He is the fifth quest bear to be reached in the game. To reach Science Bear, the player must have a minimum of 10 [[Bees]] to pass the [[Brave Bee Gate]].

Science Bear is located under the [[Red Teleporter]] destination, and next to the [[Yellow Cannon]] after going up the ramp between the [[Instant Converter]] and the [[Magic Bean Shop]].

== Quests == Science Bear's quests require defeating [[Mobs]], discovering bees, and collecting [[Pollen]], [[Goo]], [[Ability Tokens]], and [[Badges]]. In return, he will give [[Honey]] and a stack of ''[[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Science Enhancement]]'', which increases the player's bees' honey production rate by 25%. He may also give other items and crafting resources.

There are 16 quests in the initial series and 15 in the [[Translator]] series which is a total of 31 different quests. He gives a translator on the 21st, 26th, and 31st quest.

{{Stat/Science}}

=== Formulas === The formula for the Production Rate is as follows:

25(''n''+1)%, where ''n'' is the Level of Science Enhancement.

The formula for the {{Cost|Honey|}} per Second (Basic Bee) is as follows:

5(''n''+5)%, where ''n'' is the Level of Science Enhancement.

==Dialogue== Science Bear gives lots of information in his quest dialogues, so much that some of the information cannot be found anywhere else in-game! This is the info.

===Initial Series=== {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Quest !Dialogue |- |Preliminary Research |Science. What's so great about science? Science gives us technology. Technology leads to efficiency. And efficiency means more honey faster! By studying different types of bees... I believe we can gain insights into how they work, and use those insights to increase their productivity! If you help me by doing some research, I'll enhance your bee swarm! Here's what you'll need to do: Collect 20,000 White pollen... Collect 10,000 pollen from the Strawberry Field... Collect 10,000 pollen from the Bamboo Field... And, most importantly... Discover 5 types of bees! Report back when your research is complete.

''-During-''

There are two ways to discover new bees: 1) Hatching eggs. Basic Eggs have a small chance of hatching into special types. But Silver, Gold, and Diamond Eggs ALWAYS hatch into special types. 2) Royal Jelly. Jelly ''[sic]'' transforms your existing bees into different Rare, Epic, or Legendary types. Here's what I'll need to enhance your bees: Collect 20,000 White Pollen... Collect 10,000 Pollen from the Strawberry Field... Collect 10,000 Pollen from the Bamboo Field... And discover 5 types of bees!

''-Completion-''

Fascinating! So there are at least 5 types of bees! And each one seems to work and behave a bit differently. By studying these, I believe I can unlock some potential in your swarm! Hmm... ...(thinking)... AH HA! There we go! From here on out, your bees will be able to convert 25% more pollen to honey at a time. That brings the conversion efficiency bonus to 25%! Report back to me when you're ready to do more research. |- |Biology Study |Biology is the science that studies life. It helps us understand how all living things work! That includes bees, bears, and even flowers. Zoology is the branch of biology that studies animals... Entomology is a branch of zoology that studies insects... And melittology is a branch of entomology that studies bees! I use many branches of biology in my studies. But they all relate to honey making somehow! Here's what I need for my next experiment: Collect 30,000 Red Pollen... Collect 20,000 Pollen from the Clover Field... Defeat 8 Ladybugs... Defeat 8 Rhino Beetles... And, most importantly... Discover 6 types of bees! Report back when you're research is complete.

''-During-''

Each new experiment I do becomes more complex. As a result, they'll require more research from you! Here's what I need: Collect 30,000 Red Pollen... Collect 20,000 Pollen from the Clover Field... Defeat 8 Ladybugs... Defeat 8 Rhino Beetles... And discover 6 types of bees!

''-Completion-''

Fascinating! So there are at least 6 types of bees! Ah, and some very interesting notes on the behaviors of beetles. By studying these, I believe I can unlock some potential in your swarm! Hmm...(thinking)... AH HA! There we go! From here on out, your bees will be able to convert 25% more pollen to honey at a time. That brings the conversion efficiency bonus to 50%! Report back to me when you're ready to do more research. |- |Proving The Hypothesis |Scientific method allows us to reliably test things. By systematically observing and measuring things... We can see if my hypothesis is correct. My hypothosis ''[sic] ''is that if you do the following, I can enhance your bees! Collect 35,000 Blue Pollen... Collect 35,000 Pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Defeat 3 Mantises... Defeat 9 Rhino Beetles... And, most importantly... Discover 7 types of bees! Report back when your research is complete.

''-During-''

Each new experiment I do becomes more complex. As a result, they'll require more research from you. Here's the research I need from you this time: Collect 35,000 Blue Pollen... Collect 35,000 Pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Defeat 3 Mantises... Defeat 9 Rhino Beetles... And discover 7 types of bees!

== 2019 Egg Hunt Quest - Egg Hunt: Science Bear == {{RemovedContent}} {| class="article-table mw-collapsible" |- !Requirements !Reward |- | Collect 8,000 Pollen from the [[Pineapple Patch]]. Collect 4,000 Pollen from the [[Spider Field]]. Collect 2,000 Pollen from the [[Clover Field]]. Collect 100 [[Honey]] Tokens. |{{Cost|Honey|16,000}}{{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|3}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|50}}{{Cost|Jelly Beans|3}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter|5}} |} {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" |- !Dialogue |- |The tradition of hunting eggs in ROBLOX has a long history. It started all the way back in the distant year of 2008. Back then, eggs would drop from the sky and players would scramble to collect them. Over time, the Egg Hunt became a more structured event, far more fleshed out. Last year, for example, there was an elaborate exploration-based platforming game... With pretty complex movement controls, and many intricate worlds to explore! This year, we have the pleasure of being a part of a collective Egg Hunt effort, In which different games across ROBLOX provide small challenges, each rewarding a unique egg! Here on the mountain, we're giving ours away in exchange for 3 [Marshmallow Bees]. And if you complete this simple quest, I've got one for you! Collect 8,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 4,000 pollen from the Spider Field... Collect 2,000 pollen from the Clover Field... And collect 100 Honey Tokens! ''-During-''

ROBLOX is unique in all that it combines. It's at once a game engine, game platform, and social media network. It's this unique combination that makes an event like this year's Egg Hunt possible. Collect 8,000 pollen from the Pineapple Patch... Collect 4,000 pollen from the Spider Field... Collect 2,000 pollen from the Clover Field... And collect 100 Honey Tokens!

''-Completion-''

The history of ROBLOX's Egg Hunts is fascinating and reflects this history of ROBLOX as a whole. As it evolved from a simpler sandbox building game with a focus on physics simulation, Into the prominent gaming and social media platform we know today, The Egg Hunts became more polished and larger in scope as well! This year's collective Egg Hunt highlights many different players made games, Reinforcing the idea of ROBLOX as a versatile engine, with a diverse community of developers. In theory at least, heh! Good work. These are for you. |}

==Trivia== Science Bear uses the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/619533495/Superhero-Animation-Pack Superhero Animation Pack]. He had the fewest number of quests out of the permanent [[bears]] before the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]]. He is the only bear to have "discovering bee types" as a requirement for completing his quests. Science Bear is the only bear to give a quest that requires to obtain a certain bee. The quest "Beesperanto" requires you to obtain a Carpenter Bee. Science Bear, [[Bee Bear]], [[Spirit Bear]], [[Black Bear]], and [[Brown Bear]] are the only bears to require pollen from the [[Mountain Top Field]]. Science Bear is the 3rd to last quest bear on the map, the second being [[Polar Bear]] and the last being [[Spirit Bear]]. Just like [[Panda Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Black Bear]], and [[Bee Bear]], he is self-aware that he is in the game; during the 'Costs of Computation' quest, he remarks that actual beehives contain thousands of [[bees]], but simulating ''that'' would crash the servers; and if the player talks to him after finishing all of his quests, he tells them to wait for more updates. In 'Mark Mechanics', he states that Pheromones are 'simulated in this game' through Mark abilities. Also, in 'Meticulously Crafted', he says “the device that you’re playing this game on”. Science Bear is based on the [[Wikipedia: Spectacled Bear|spectacled bear]]. Additionally, Science Bear wears goggles. Another word for "goggles" is "spectacles". He's one of the two bears to give a unique ability after every quest, the other being [[Polar Bear]]. He's one of the three quest givers to give an ability after every quest, the other two are Polar Bear and [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]. Science Bear is [[Onett (Developer)|Onett's]] least favorite bear to write dialogue for because of his long script, as indirectly referenced during the Star Journey 2 quest. Science Bear is the only bear to give [[translator]]s. Science Bear originally had 11 quests, which was increased to 16 in the [[Updates#2018.4.27|4/27/2018 update]]. This was bumped up to 26 in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. Subsequently, it rose to 31 in the [[Updates#2018.12.19|12/19/2018 update]]. [[File:ABA1CDAC-2749-45FF-966B-7FC610B5371C.jpeg|thumb|309px|The rewards the player get if they had completed Epistemological Endeavor before the nerf.]] *A few of his quests have gotten nerfs over the game's lifespan. The quest "Epistemological Endeavor" was nerfed in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]]. If the player completed the "Epistemological Endeavor" quest before its nerf, upon entering the game, they would receive a message rewarding them with 100 [[ticket]]s and 10 [[Magic Bean|magic beans]]. The quest "Corrupting the Glitched Drive" used to require collecting 2,048 duped ability tokens. This was nerfed to 1,024 duped tokens in the [[Updates#2024.01.12|01/12/2024 update]]. In one of his quests, Science Bear gives a [[Codes|code]] "GumdropsForScience", which gives 15 [[gumdrops]]. He is the third [[Quest Givers|quest giver]] that requires players to defeat [[Tunnel Bear]], the first being [[Panda Bear]], the second being [[Onett]] and the fourth being [[Bubble Bee Man]]. Many of the [[honey]] rewards for Science Bear's quests are based around important mathematical constants, such as pi (quests 1 & 31), e (quest 13), powers of 2 (quest 26), the square root of 2 (quests 7 & 25), phi (quest 10) and the square root of 3 (quest 11). He is the first bear that requires the player to collect pollen from the [[Ant Field]], the second being Black Bear. 'Beesperanto' (quest) is a portmanteau of the words ''bee'' and ''Esperanto'', which is a language made in the 19th century with the intention of being easy to learn and a way for people of different cultures to communicate easily. In the quest "Breaking Down Badges", Science Bear says that [[Badges#Sunflower Badge|Sunflower Field Badges]] give more [[Honey Per Pollen]]. However, as of the [[Updates#2019.04.17|4/17/2019 Update]], Sunflower Field badges grant capacity bonuses. He is the first bear to wear accessories, with his glasses and lab coat. Other bears that also do this include [[Sun Bear]] with his sunglasses, his [[Mondo Belt Bag]], and his [[Beekeeper's Boots|Beekeeper Boots]], and [[Spirit Bear]], with her [[Petal Wand]] and her [[Petal Belt]]. He, Panda Bear, Black Bear and [[Spirit Bear]] are the only bears to mention/have a code. In total, he gives 210 [[Ticket]]s in his quests. His quests often require blending with the blender, collecting goo, collecting pollen from a number of fields, and defeating mobs. In the quest "Subsidised Agriculture", Science Bear says that oil increases bee and player movespeed by 25%, but it has been changed to x1.2 bee and player movespeed. Science Bear's Beesmas 2020 gift, the BI-84 calculator, is a reference to the TI-84 calculator produced by Texas Instruments. After starting Science Bear's Corrupting The Glitched Drive quest, as long as the 'Collect 1024 Duped Tokens' part is incomplete, Science Bear will indefinitely corrupt fields. After that part is finished, Science Bear will stop corrupting fields. Science Bear is the first and only bear that requires you to collect pollen with specific tools, being the [[Spark Staff]], and the [[Porcelain Dipper]]. Players who collected more than 1,024 duped tokens before the nerf were compensated with ~33 Million Honey and 25 Tickets upon joining the game after the update.

{{Tool |image =Scissors.png |price = 850,000 |shop = Pro Shop |range = 1 |pattern = Single |time = 0.5 |collectbase = 60 |specialmultiplier = None }} The '''Scissors''' are a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that can be purchased at the [[Pro Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|850,000}} |}

The Scissors collect all [[pollen]] from the patch in front of you in 0.5 seconds. It has a maximum base pollen collection rate of 120 pollen per second.

==Gallery== Hivesticker scissors.png|The {{PAGENAME}}' associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. ==Trivia== The Scissors are an enhanced version of the [[Clippers]]. The main difference in appearance is that the Clippers are smaller and have yellow handles while the Scissors have red and blue handles. This is one of the four [[items]] in the game that can cut the vines in front of the parkour leading to [[Commando Chick's Hideout]], the others being the Clippers, the [[Scythe]], and the [[Dark Scythe]]. This and the [[Spark Staff]] are the only tools that collect all the pollen from the flowers that they hit. This and the Clippers are the only tools that collect pollen from a single flower. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

docs.text:
{{Tool |image =Scooper.png |price = 0 |shop = Noob Shop |pollen = 2 |pattern = Line |collectbase = 2 |range = 2 |time = 0.8 }}The '''Scooper''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that new players automatically receive at the beginning of the game, along with the [[Pouch]].

It collects 2 [[pollen]] from 2 patches in front of it with a speed of 0.8 seconds, which equals a base pollen collection rate of 5 pollen per second.

It can be equipped in the [[Noob Shop]].

== Appearance == The scooper resembles a shovel with a grey blade and circular handle with a brown pole presumably made of wood.

== Gallery == Hivesticker scooper.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]].

== Trivia == * This tool is currently the least effective tool at collecting pollen, because its base statistics are lower than any of every other tool in the game. * The [[Super-Scooper]] is the upgraded version of this. It can be purchased in the [[Pro Shop]]. * This is the only tool in the game that doesn’t cost any [[honey]]. * This is the third slowest tool in the game, surpassed by the [[Honey Dipper]] and [[Pulsar]]/[[Gummyballer]]. * This, the [[Pouch]], and a {{Cost|Basic Egg|4=0}} are the only items that the player starts off with when joining the game for the very first time.

The Scythe collects 8 [[pollen]] from 7 patches in 0.47 seconds and collects x2 pollen from [[:Category:Red|red]] [[flowers]]. Every 20th swing spawns a [[flame]]. Its average base pollen collection rate is 158.45 pollen per second: 238.29 from red flowers and 119.14 from white and blue flowers. It emits fire particles at the blade.

==Gallery== Hivesticker scythe.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. ==Trivia== This is one of the three [[items]] in the game that can cut the vines in front of the [[Obstacle Courses#Commando Chick Hideout Obby|parkour]] leading to the [[Commando Chick's Hideout]], the other two being the [[Scissors]] and the [[Clippers]]. There is a model of the Scythe on top of the Red HQ. The [[Codes|code]] "Roof" is next to it. The surface of the Scythe is reflective, which is why it becomes dark during [[nighttime]]. Its [[:Category:Blue|blue]] counterpart is the [[Bubble Wand]]. This is the fastest tool in the game (in terms of how long the cooldown of each collection lasts). Similarly to the Bubble Wand, it is the second cheapest item in Red HQ in terms of honey, behind the Red Guard. This is the only tool that has the ability to damage mobs {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Red]]

docs.title: Shadow Bear
docs.text:
[[File:RobloxScreenShot20230730 140033303 (2).png|thumb|265x265px|An image of Shadow Bear, along with where the Diamond Egg token is.]] '''Shadow Bear''' (also called '''Dancing Bear''' or '''30 Bee Bear''') is located inside the [[Bear Gate|30 Bee Area]], under the platform where [[Onett]] is. It is floating just above the floor, similar to [[Gummy Bear]]. There is a {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} token in front of it. Unfortunately, the floor around it is made of a shadow substance that kills you instantly, no matter how much [[System Page#Defense|defense]] you have.

To reach the egg token, equip either the [[Parachute]] or the [[Glider]] and make sure your [[Bags|bag]] is empty so you don't lose any [[pollen]]. * If you're using the Parachute, go up to where the ramp meets the platform. Jump to the side and immediately deploy the parachute. Make a beeline to the front of Shadow Bear where you can just make out the sparkle of the token. * If you're using the Glider, jump off the ledge where the ticket token is located, and then glide straight to the diamond egg token. * Whichever way, you will die eventually, but that's okay, as you get to keep the diamond egg in your inventory.

It may be easier to use the Parachute as it is slower than the Glider, so you can focus more on the location of the diamond egg.

== Trivia == * If the player is in a laggy server, it is possible for them to walk on the floor and grab the diamond egg. *Before the 2021 Beesmas Event, you can rapidly jump on the floor and grab the {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} without dying. Currently, this method is patched. * Shadow Bear is the largest of all the [[:Category:Bears|bears]]. It looks just like [[Tunnel Bear]], except for its greater size and it does not chase you. * It is the only bear who has no function - it doesn't give quests, it doesn't run a [[:Category:Shops|shop]], and it doesn't protect an area. [[Noob Bear]], [[Pro Bear]], and [[Top Bear]] have no function, but they run shops. * Shadow Bear, [[Spirit Bear]], all [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddies]], and [[Stick Bug]] are the only NPCs who use a dance emote (/e dance, /e dance2, and /e dance3 are types of Roblox dances, Shadow Bear is using /e dance3). Other bears can do /e wave, which is also an emote. * Shadow Bear, [[Tunnel Bear]], and [[Snowbear]] are the only faceless bears. * Shadow Bear could possibly be the Giant Bear that [[Black Bear]] alludes to in his "Solo On The Stump" quest.

[[Category:Bears]] [[Category:NPC]]

docs.title: Slime
docs.text:
{{Mob|image=Slime.png|title=Slime|location=Retro Swarm Challenge|timer=N/A|hp=100 base; Increases by level|bond=None|honey=None|level=1-30 (Increases by round)|damage=?|points=None}}

The '''Slime''' is a mob exclusive in the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]]. Its level varies on the round of the challenge.

== Behavior == The '''Slime''' moves constantly towards the hive, depleting flowers under it. Stuns also cannot stop the mob from moving forward, with only the trowel's walls being able to halt the movement of the mob. Slimes increase in size as they increase in level.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |100 |- |2 |200 |- | 3 |300 |- |4 | 400 |- |5 |500 |- | 6 |600 |- |7 |700 |- |8 |800 |- |9 |900 |- |10 |1,000 |- |11 |1,250 |- |12 |1,500 |- |13 |1,750 |- |14 |2,000 |- |15 |2,500 |- | 16 |? |- |17 |4000 |- |18 |6,000? |- |19 |9,000 |- |20 |10,000 |- |21 |12,000 |- |22 |14,000 |- |23 |16,000 |- |24 |18,000 |- |25 |20,000 |- |26 |17,500 |- |27 |20,000 |- |28 |22,500 |- |29 |? |- |30 |30,000 |} ==Drops==

*{{Cost|Brick}}

==Tips== Slimes along with Zombies are mainly in hordes. It is advised to use crowd-controlling bees like [[Digital Bee]] and [[Vicious Bee]], as Mind Hack and Impale can help out massively, especially in the later rounds where Slimes and Zombies start increasing in level and health drastically. Remember that Slimes can damage you simply by coming into contact with you. If you are not careful and become too reckless, you can die very quickly to hordes. The Rocket Launcher is also a very good weapon against slimes as it can deal damage to multiple slimes at once. Try upgrading from the normal sword to the Firebrand as soon as possible. There is a MASSIVE damage boost that comes with this, and you'll be able to kill low to mid-level Slimes with ease before they even get a chance to sufficiently damage you. The Illumina is an even bigger help, but it may start becoming irrelevant by the time you reach round 20 or 21. Swords as a whole start becoming futile by round 20/21 as the Slimes increase in health and spawn in larger numbers. By this point, it is advised that you buy bees that are preferably at the level that the Slimes are, which is most likely too much to handle for early and midgame players. A slime’s hitbox is in its center, or the darker green sphere in its middle. Because of this, larger slimes can be completely immune to sword attacks if the sword can’t hit the center of the slime. You can use the Trowel to temporarily block Slimes from approaching the hives. This can prove to be extremely useful if you or your team are unable to clear out a horde of Slimes. You can use the [[Passive Abilities#Star Amulet Passives|Star Saw]] to defeat hordes of Slimes.

== Gallery == [[File:Slime19Level.jpg|frameless|250x250px]]

==Trivia== *The slime is based on the ROBLOX game Defend the Statue. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]]

docs.title: Slingshot
docs.text:
[[File:Slingshot2.png|thumb|The Slingshot.]] The '''Slingshot''' is a [[:Category:Transport|transportation]] device available to the player once they have discovered 8 different [[Bees|bee]] types. It is located next to the [[Clover Field]] and usually quickly transports the player past the [[Brave Bee Gate]] and right in front of the [[Pro Shop]], it may undershoot and cause the player to land in front of [[Panda Bear]].

== Trivia == * If the player has 8 different bee types but doesn't have 10 bees in their [[hive]] yet, they will be always be teleported back to the spawn pad if they try to pass the Brave Bee Gate. This used to be a method to pass the Brave Bee Gate. [[File:Slingpand.png|thumb|270x270px|A player being launched towards Panda Bear.]] * The cause of the different destinations is described by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] as "noob scripting". To increase the chance of launching to the Pro Shop (the intended destination), jump onto the pad; to increase the chance of launching to Panda Bear (the "it's a feature, not a bug" destination), walk onto the pad instead. * This is the only non-cannon transport device that launches the player. * There is a smaller version used as a weapon in the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]].

{{Consumables |image = Smooth Dice.png |description = Boosts 2 random fields for 200% pollen for 15 minutes. |cooldown = 2 seconds }} The {{Color|Smooth Dice}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] that was added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/21 update]]. When used, it will boost 2 random [[fields]], each granting 200% pollen [[field boost]]s. Using this item while there is another dice boost active replaces the last dice boost duration.

docs.title: Snow Machine
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Snow Machine2.png|thumb|169px|The snow machine.|alt=The snow machine.]] The '''Snow Machine''' is a machine added in the [[Updates#2020.12.25|Beesmas 2020]], 2021, 2022 and 2024 Event. It's usable after completing [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Gifted Bucko Bee's]] Beesmas quest. The snow machine has only one primary purpose, which is to summon a [[Snow Storm]] across the map.

When a player uses the snow machine, the following message would appear: {{Notification||❄ {Username} has activated the snow machine! ❄|19}}

This machine has a cooldown of 2 hours before the player can use it again.

If a player stepped on the pad before completing Gifted Bucko Bee's Beesmas Quest, a red text box would appear on top of the player's screen saying: "''The Snow Machine is missing some integral parts...''"

== Appearance == The snow machine looks like a machine with a green light situated on top of the [[Blue HQ]]. Before completing Gifted Bucko Bee's quest, the light would be red, the inside of the machine appearing empty and hollow, except for the wire netting on the back. After completing the quest, 2 fans will be installed in it. Activating it shoots out snowflake particles as well.

== Gallery == Unfinished Snow Machine.png|The snow machine before completing Gifted Bucko Bee's Beesmas 2021 quest. Unfinished Snow Machine Message.png|The pop-up that appears when attempting to use it before completing Gifted Bucko Bee's Beesmas 2021 quest. Snowmachine complete.png|A front view of the snow machine after completing Bucko Bee's Beesmas Quest. Notice that a fan is present. Snowmachine complete front.png|The back of the snow machine after completing Bucko Bee's Beesmas 2021 Quest. Snow Machine Activated.gif|The Snow Machine activated.

== Trivia == * The snow machine is the third machine to summon a server-wide event, the first being the [[Honeystorm|Honeystorm summoner]] and the second being the [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteor Shower summoner]].

docs.title: Snow Storm
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Snowstorm.png|right|frameless|200x200px|An active Snow Storm.|alt=An active snow storm.]] A '''Snow Storm''' is a server-wide event that can be summoned by using the [[Snow Machine]] or randomly in the game. It is similar to a [[Honeystorm]], but spawns {{Cost|Snowflake||}} instead. A Snow Storm lasts for 20 seconds.

When a player uses the Snow Machine to summon a Snow Storm, a server-wide announcement states: {{Notification||❄️ {Username} has activated the Snow Machine! ❄️|18}}

{{Cost|Snowflake}} will start to fall rapidly from the sky on every field. There is no audio at the beginning of a Snow Storm, unlike a Honeystorm or [[Mythic Meteor Shower]].

When a Snow Storm is randomly summoned, the message states: {{Notification||❄️ A Snow Storm has begun... ❄️}}

== Gallery== File:Snowstormfog.png|The white fog of a Snow Storm. File:Natural snow storm.png|A naturally occurring Snow Storm. docs.title: Snowbear Summoner
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} [[File:Snowbear Summoner2.png|thumb|183x183px]]The '''Snowbear Summoner''' is a Beesmas exclusive machine in Beesmas. It would be located next to the [[Basic Bee Gate]], [[Highest Snowbear Level]] leaderboard, and [[Spider Field]]. It can be used after completing [[Panda Bear]]'s Snowbear quest. It has a cooldown of 90 minutes before being able to be used again to avoid instant farming or overcrowding of [[Snowbear]]s in the Spider Field.

If a player attempts to use the summoner without completing Panda Bear's snowbear quest, the following message will appear: '''Last year's Snowbear is already complete! But it's starting to melt...'''

==Appearance== The Snowbear Summoner is a snowman-shaped summoner. Without completing [[Panda Bear|Panda Bear's]] quest, it is just 3 snowballs stacked on top of each other, 2 snowballs as the ears and 2 sticks as the hands with no decorations. If the player completes Panda Bear's Snowbear quest, it will have a top hat, 3 black buttons for the torso of the snowbear, 2 black buttons for the eyes, and 1 giant black button as the nose.

==Usage== The Snowbear Summoner summons a snowbear onto the Spider Field, which at first use, spawns a level 1 snowbear. The message when a player steps on the pad will be: 'Summon a level Snowbear.' For example, if a player has defeated a level 4 snowbear, the "" displayed on the message will be level 5. After each defeat, the level will increase by 1 the next time the player spawns a snowbear.

== Gallery==

Pandabearsnowbearsummonerincomplete.png|The Snowbear Summoner's appearance before the player completes the "Panda Bear's Snowbear" quest. Pandabearsnowbearsummonercomplete.png|The Snowbear Summoner's appearance after the player completes the "Panda Bear's Snowbear" quest.

==Trivia== This was the first machine that can summon a [[:Category:Bears|bear]] manually by the player. ** However, this was the second feature mechanic to summon a mob manually. The first one being summoning [[Stick Bug Challenge|Stick Bug]]. It was the first mechanic to summon a [[Mobs|mob]] that has a defined level into a specific field, which is the Spider Field. *The cooldown of the Snowbear Summoner is not affected by owning a [[Vicious Bee|Gifted Vicious Bee]] because you had to summon it, unlike regular mobs who automatically respawn.

docs.title: Snowbear
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} {{Mob |title=Snowbear |image=SnowBear.png |location=Spider Field |timer=90 minutes (when summoned) |damage=36 (Contact), 60 (Snowball) |level=Starts from 1, increases by 1 level after every defeat. |hp=Increases with level }} The '''Snowbear''' is a [[:Category:Mini Bosses|Mini-Boss]] that can be summoned every 90 minutes (1 hour and 30 minutes) at the [[Snowbear Summoner]] after completing [[Panda Bear]]'s Beesmas quest. When summoned, it spawns in the [[Spider Field]], and players have 60 seconds (1 minute) to defeat it. If 60 seconds has passed without enough damage done to it, it will despawn (melt). All players' bees can attack another player's Snowbear, but the player that summoned it would receive more rewards. ==Attacks== Snowbear has two different attacks: * Contact – If a player makes contact with Snowbear, it deals a base damage of 36. Snowbear does not track players; instead it moves randomly through the field hitting players along the way. *Snowball Hurl – Snowbear hurls a snowball at a player who is in, or around, the [[Spider Field]]. This snowball deals 60 base damage and applies the [[Buffs & Debuffs#Debuffs|"Frozen" Debuff]] to the player who gets hit by the snowball for approximately 2.5 seconds, applying ×0 [[System Page#Movespeed|player movespeed]] and [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]], as well as ×0.2 [[Stats#Speed|Bee Movespeed]]. [[File:Frozen.png|thumb|90px|The Frozen effect icon. (Ice Cube from BFDI's Asset)]]

==Health== From level one to level ten, its health increases non-linearly so that at level 10 the Snowbear has 100,000 health.

From level 10, every time the Snowbear levels up it gets +5,000 health. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" !Level!!Health |- |1||250 |- |2||1,500 |- |3||5,000 |- |4||6,000 |- |5||20,000 |- |6||40,000 |- |7||45,000 |- |8||50,000 |- |9||70,000 |- |10||100,000 |- |11||105,000 |- |12||110,000 |- |13||115,000 |- |14||120,000 |- |15||125,000 |- |16||130,000 |- |17||135,000 |- |18||140,000 |- |19||145,000 |- |20||150,000 |- |21||155,000 |- |22||160,000 |- |23||165,000 |- |24||170,000 |- |25||175,000 |- | 26||180,000 |- | 27||185,000 |- | 28||190,000 |- | 29||195,000 |- |30||200,000 |}

==Drops== * [[Bond]] (100 – ???) (increased by [[System Page#Bond From Battle|Bond from Battle]], and level). *{{Cost|Ticket}} (Equal to level). * {{Cost|Snowflake}} (1 – ??? scales with Snowbear level). Guaranted drops per kill of specific levels: [[Category:Pages that uses original tabber]] 2022/2024=

{| class="article-table" !Reward !Level |- |{{Cost|Robo Pass}} |4 |- |{{Cost|Hard Wax|3}} |5 |- |{{Cost|Thumbtack|||0}} |7 |- |{{Cost|Bang Snap|||0}} |8 |- |{{Cost|Invigorating Vial|||0}} |10 |- |{{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}} |11 |- |{{Cost|Swirled Wax|3}} |13 |- |{{Cost|Icicles|||0}} |15 |- |{{Cost|Caustic Wax|3}} |17 |- |{{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}} |18 |- |{{Cost|Snow Tiara|||0}} |20 |- |{{Cost|Robo Pass|||0}} |23 |- ||{{Cost|Invigorating Vial|||0}} |24 |}

|-|2021=

{| class="article-table" !Reward !Level |- |{{Cost|Soft Wax|3}} |3 (?) |- |{{Cost|Single Mitten|||0}} |5 |- |{{Cost|Hard Wax|3}} |7 |- |{{Cost|Snowglobe|||0}} |10 |- |{{Cost|Swirled Wax|3}} |13 |- |{{Cost|Icicles|||0}} |15 |- | {{Cost|Caustic Wax|3}} |17 |- |{{Cost|Snow Tiara|||0}} |20 |}

{| class="article-table" !Reward !Level |- |{{Cost|Single Mitten|||0}} |5 |- |{{Cost|Snowglobe|||0}} |10 |- |{{Cost|Icicles|||0}} |15 |- |{{Cost|Snow Tiara|||0}} |20 |}

Every time Snowbear loses a quarter of its health, it drops {{Cost|Snowflake}} around the Snowbear's current position, which only the player that summoned it can pick up (they can also be picked up with Token Links, Cub Buddy, Tornado and Target Practice). Additional snowflakes can also spawn in the field randomly, instances of which aren't unique to any player thus unable to be picked up by Ability Tokens. Adding up to a total of {{Cost|Snowflake|22}} per quarter lost.

==Strategies== Every time the player defeats the Snowbear, its health increases (e.g. 20,000 health at level 5), thus making it stronger and harder to defeat in a short amount of time. High-level bees that can do a good amount of damage are recommended.

Its reload time for using a snowball is short, so if it catches the player in ice, it may be able to keep them frozen by using the snowball attack on them repeatedly. The snowball will still do damage while the player is frozen, and the player will die if they get hit multiple times. If they have a [[glider]] or [[parachute]], they can use it to dodge the snowballs. If they get frozen, immediately after thawing, they can jump away and use the glider to prevent being frozen a second time. It is also a good idea to try and stay behind the Snowbear, as it takes time for it to turn around.

It is also recommended to have another player have their bees attack a high-leveled Snowbear.

==Tips== Use {{Cost|Oil}} to increase the [[System Page#Bee Movespeed|Bee Movespeed]], and {{Cost|Tropical Drink}} to increase [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]]. {{Cost|Super Smoothie}} are also an option, as they increase both stats. However, they are expensive, so it is not recommended to use them unless you are far into the game and/or the Snowbear is very high-level. Certain items like [[Demon Mask]] and [[Fire Mask]]'s passive abilities, [[Windy Bee]]'s tornado ability, [[Frog]]s and [[Spicy Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Inferno|Inferno]] ability ignore enemy levels meaning they will always deal damage regardless of the Snowbear's level. Have multiple bees with high attack such as [[Lion Bee]] or [[Vicious Bee]]. * Use {{Cost|Stinger}} to multiply the bee's attack by ×1.5 for 30 seconds. If you have the [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]] passive, you can use it to deal more damage. Bees that can generate battle ability tokens are a must-have. It is recommended to have multiple [[Rage Bee]]s or Spicy Bees, in order to get more [[Ability Tokens#Rage|Rage Tokens]]. Vicious Bee is important, as it can deal massive damage with [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]]. Digital Bee is useful, as it can stun and make it take more damage with its [[Ability Tokens|Mind Hack]] ability. Bees that can generate [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] tokens, such as [[Looker Bee]]s, [[Commander Bee]]s, [[Music Bee]]s, and [[Puppy Bee]] (with [[Reindeer Antlers]]) can help greatly. Music Bee can generate [[Ability Tokens#Melody|Melody]], which increases critical power. Melody can also be generated by bees that have the {{Cost|Toy Horn|||0}} or the {{Cost|Kazoo|||0}} equipped. [[Precise Bee]]s generate [[Ability Tokens#Target Practice|Target Practice]] tokens, which grants [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Precision]], increasing [[System Page#Super-Crit Chance|Super-Crit Chance]]. High-leveled bees are useful for landing hits on high-leveled Snowbears. Precise Bees can be very useful against high-leveled Snowbears, as their attacks never miss if the Snowbear is one level higher (two if Gifted). The Snowball attack will land sooner than the actual snowball, so to prevent being frozen by seemingly nothing, try to keep moving while remaining in range of the Snowbear. In addition, if a snowball comes your way, do not run away in the direction of the snowball, as you will likely be frozen. Instead, run towards the left or the right of it. * [[Gifted Bee]]s have 50% more attack than normal bees, making them useful for fighting Snowbears. * Having other players in the server to help the player is also a viable strategy. * Use Gifted Bees that increase bee attack, critical chance, critical power, super-crit chance and bee movespeed, such as Gifted Looker Bee, Gifted [[Brave Bee]], Gifted Rage Bee, Gifted Commander Bee, Gifted [[Ninja Bee]], Gifted Lion Bee, Gifted [[Tabby Bee]] and Gifted [[Precise Bee]]. Use {{Cost|Jelly Beans}} to get the green Jelly Bean token, which boosts Critical Chance. Equip accessories that can boost the attack of the player's bees, primarily guards and masks, such as Fire Mask and Demon Mask. Use [[Onett's Lid Art]], [[Honeyday Candles]], [[Gummy Beacon]], and the [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]]'s [[Honey Wreath]] as three of the Beesmas decorations summon 3 extra bees and the Honey Wreath will summon 1 extra bee for a certain amount of time. With the [[Coconut Canister]], a player can intentionally activate the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]] to gain a ×1.25 bee attack boost for 10 seconds while also being immune to damage. Do note that having the Emergency Coconut Shield active does not make a player immune to freezing. *Try to stack battle buffs such as focus and precision to their maximum before spawning the Snowbear.

==Gallery== Snowbear Summoner2.png|The Snow Bear Summoner. File:SnowbearDespawns.jpg|Snow Bear Despawns/Melts (Note: Only appears when you are close to Snowbear). File:Snowbeardefeat.png|The message that appears when defeating a Snowbear. File:Snowbear.png|Snowbear in Mushroom Field. File:Captura de pantalla 2024-12-24 114025.png|Snowbear in Strawberry Field.

==Trivia== Snowbear uses the Cartoony Animation Pack. The icon for the Frozen debuff is the asset for [[w:c:battlefordreamisland:Ice Cube|Ice Cube]] from the animated show [[w:c:battlefordreamisland:Battle for Dream Island (series)|Battle for Dream Island]]. Snowbear and [[Stick Bug]] are the only hostile mobs that can be directly summoned by players. They are also the only mobs whose cooldowns are not affected by [[Vicious Bee|Gifted Vicious Bee's]] Gifted Hive Bonus. Snowbear is the fourth mob to be removed from the game, after the [[Chicks|Chick]], Spotted Chick, and Hostage Chick. It's also the only mob to return after being removed. *Snowbear's leveling up mechanic work similarly to Stick Bug and [[Wild Windy Bee]]. It's also the only mob that has a changing size, which also increases by leveling. This can make it the largest mob in the game. * Snowbear is the first and only mob able to freeze a player. * Snowbear and [[Tunnel Bear]] are the only hostile mobs that are bears. Similar to [[Tunnel Bear]] and [[Shadow Bear]], Snowbear has no face and uses one texture. This is the fourth mob to not drop [[Ability Tokens#Honey Gift|Honey Tokens,]] with the first three being the [[Coconut Crab]], [[ants]] and the [[Cave Monster|cave monsters]]. This, the [[Naughty List]] (plus the quest related with it), [[Festive Nymph]]s, and {{Cost|Snowflake}} were the only Beesmas 2020 content that was extended. Although a majority of the game refers to this mob as '''Snowbear''', the message the player gets when they fail to defeat Snowbear says "'''Snow Bear'''". * This, [[Tunnel Bear]] and [[Shadow Bear]] are the only faceless bears. There was a glitch which causes the Snowbear to go idle, and it does not move around or attack the player. The cause of this glitch is unknown. * Snowbear has its own [[Cub Buddy]] skin, the {{Cost|Snow Cub|||0}}, which was the final reward for [[Bee Bear]]'s 2021 [[Beesmas]] quest. However, unlike its counterpart, the Snow Cub skin has a face and a carrot for a nose, and uses the Ninja Animation Pack. There is a glitch which causes Snowbear to spawn inside the mushroom field. The cause of this glitch is unknown. Digital bee´s mind hack ability can make it teleport to Mushroom field and Strawberry Field. Although spawning in a field with no stuff, Snowbear has collision. *Snowbear's top hat is a retextured version of the '''[https://www.roblox.com/catalog/80293983/Psychedelic-Top-Hat Psychedelic Top Hat]'''.

docs.title: Snowflake
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Snowflake.png |description = Sends a cool, soothing breeze to all the players on the server (Melts after Beesmas!). |cooldown = 3 seconds }} A {{Color|Snowflake}} is a limited-time [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2020.12.25|12/25/2020 update]]. It's only available during the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas event]] and is removed and unusable outside the event.

When used, it grants 9 seconds of the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Items|Cool Breeze]] buff that increases various stats. The buff effect scales with duration with minimum of '1%' at <1 second duration and maximum of '100%' at 15 minutes duration:

+10% ~ +25% [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]] At [[Hive]]. +5% ~ +25% [[Pollen]] From [[Tools]]. +5% ~ +25% Bee Gather Pollen. +1% ~ +5% [[Honey Per Pollen]]. +1% ~ +10% [[Loot Luck]]. x1.25 [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|Capacity]] (the capacity always remains the same).

Along with {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}, it could also be used to buy various items from [[Bee Bear’s Catalog]].

==Ways to Obtain== *As a drop from a [[Sprout|Festive Sprout]].

===The methods below are no longer possible.=== Opening certain Gift Boxes across the map: ** The Gilded Gift Box gave 50 snowflakes. The Kitsch Gift Box gave 10 snowflakes. The Midnight Gift Box gave 50 snowflakes. The Festive Gift Box gave 50 snowflakes. Opening the Sky Blue Gift Box and Peppermint Gift Box. The former gift gave 20 snowflakes while the latter gave 50 snowflakes. Purchasing the [[Robux Shop|Snowey Starter Pack]] for 400 Robux. * Purchasing the Reindeer Puppy Pack for {{Cost|Robux|800}} after receiving the [[Reindeer Antlers]] from Bee Bear's Catalog. (Gave a refund of 7,500 Snowflakes). Purchasing the Nighttime Nectar Pack in the [[Robux Shop]], granting 500 snowflakes and other items. Snowflakes received from Festive Sprouts outside Beesmas event will not appear in player's inventory. *As a reward from Beesmas [[quests]]. [[Black Bear]]'s [[Honey Wreath]] Quest rewards 10 snowflakes. Breaking [[Brick Bloom|brick blooms]] in the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]]. Catching fallen snowflakes on [[field]]s. During [[snowstorm]]s, snowflakes fall much more often, averaging around 20 per field. Players can use the [[Snow Machine]] to summon snowstorms after completing [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Gifted Bucko Bee’s]] Beesmas quest. As a drop from the following [[mobs]]: [[Rhino Beetle]]. [[Mantis]]. [[Spider]]. [[Stick Nymph]]. [[Aphid#Diamond Aphid|Diamond aphid]]. [[Wild Windy Bee]]. [[Festive Nymph]]. [[Mondo Chick]]. Reducing [[Snowbear]]'s health by quarters drops snowflakes that everyone could collect and snowflakes for the player that summoned it. *Opening certain [[Gift Boxes]] across the map: ** The Cerulean Gift Box gives 40 snowflakes. ** The Fluorescent Gift Box gives 50 snowflakes. ** The Minty Gift Box gives 10 snowflakes. ** The Glass Gift Box gives 50 snowflakes.

== Gallery == Melting Snowflake message.png|The message the player gets when they attempt to use a snowflake after Beesmas. 100% Snowflake boosts.png|The Cool Breeze buff at 100%. Snowflakes.png|Snowflakes in the inventory.

==Trivia== Snowflakes are one of four [[:Category:Consumables|consumables]] that can be used to increase capacity, with the first being the {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|4=0}}, the second being the {{Cost|Purple Potion|4=0}}, and the third being the {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=0}}. Snowflake and {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|4=0}} are the only consumables that '''directly''' grant buff(s) to all players in the server. Before March 1, 2021, the snowflake description claimed that it would melt after Beesmas. After Beesmas 2020 ended, the additional message was changed to "Melts this week - use them up fast!". * Snowflake's buff, unlike many other item buffs, does not contain its own name. Instead its buff is called "[[Buffs & Debuffs#From Items|Cool Breeze]]". This may be because snowflake is not being the only source of the buff, as it can also be obtainable from [[Ability Tokens#Snowglobe Shake|Snowglobe Shake]] ability token which is generated from bees equipped with {{Cost|Snowglobe|4=0}} beequip. From using the snowflakes alone, it required at least 129 snowflakes to attain 100% Cool Breeze buff. This is because the buff decreases while the snowflakes are being used. However, multiple players using snowflakes could have sped up the process, decreasing the minimum needed. Attempting to use a snowflake after Beesmas will prompt the message, "The Snowflake melts immediately..." Thus, snowflakes are useless outside of Beesmas. For any Beesmas before 2024, the only way to see snowflakes after Beesmas was to keep them in the hotbar at the bottom of the screen. If removed from the hotbar, players could no longer see their current number of snowflakes, as they were hidden from their inventory, although a player still had them until Onett wipes it next beesmas. Keeping snowflakes in the hotbar didn't save them from being wiped, but it could always be just kept there. However, after the completion of Beesmas 2024, all snowflakes were set to zero. They still appear if kept in the player's hotbar, but they can't be used. After Beesmas is over, snowflakes will still drop from Festive Sprouts. However, they will not appear in the player's inventory when collected. Before Beesmas 2021, Cool Breeze buff used to give +5% ~ +50% Convert Rate At Hive, +1% ~ +25% Pollen From Tools, +1% ~ +25% White Pollen, +1% ~ +25% Blue Pollen, and +1% ~ +10% Loot Luck, and x1.25 Capacity. The noticeable differences with the current Cool Breeze are: Convert Rate At Hive used to have half the minimum value and double the maximum value. Pollen From Tools used to start at 1% instead of 5%. It used to increase White Pollen and Blue Pollen and not Bee Gather Pollen and Honey Per Pollen. {{CurrencyNav}} {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Beesmas]] [[Category:Currency]] [[Category:Consumables]]

docs.title: Soft Wax
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Softwax.png |description=A squishy hunk of beeswax. Has a 100% chance to slightly improve a bee’s Beequip.}} {{Color|Soft Wax}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] and a type of [[Waxes|wax]] added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]] that can be used on a [[Beequip]] to boost its stats. Upon usage, it has a 100% chance to slightly improve the Beequip's stats. Soft wax has [[Beequip#Stats, Waxes, Chances|upgrade value]] of 1.

It also can be used for crafting items and tools, such as [[planter]]s, and other types of wax, such as, {{Cost|Hard Wax|||0}}, {{Cost|Swirled Wax|||0}}, and {{Cost|Caustic Wax|||0}}. These can all be made in the [[Blender]].

When giving soft wax to a bee's Beequip, a message pops up saying:

{{Notification|2=The Wax has Improved the Beequip!}}

docs.title: Spark Staff
docs.text:
{{Tool |image =Spark_Staff.png |price = 60,000,000 |shop = Mountain Top Shop |range = 81 |pattern = Collects from the 3 flowers that yield the most pollen |time = 0.5 seconds|collectbase = 30 |whitemultiplier = 1.2 |redmultiplier = 1.2 |bluemultiplier = 1.2 }} The '''Spark Staff''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that was added in the [[Updates|4/5/2019 update]]. It can be bought in the [[Mountain Top Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|60,000,000}} |}

The Spark Staff collects all [[pollen]] from the 3 fullest nearby [[flowers]] in 0.5 seconds and increases it by 20%. It has a maximum base pollen collection rate of 210 pollen per second. However, the nearby flowers may not be full, so it doesn't always reach its complete potential.

The following audio plays when the Spark Staff collects pollen:[[File:Sparkstaffuse.ogg]] ==Gallery== Hivesticker spark staff.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. Zap1.png|The visual collecting effect of the Spark Staff. ==Trivia== This is the only tool that makes a sound every use. It is also the only tool that can collect pollen while in mid-air and the most expensive tool without an ability. This is the only tool in the Mountain Top Shop that neither have an ability nor make a specific "shape" when collecting pollen. This and the [[Scissors]] are the only tools that collect all pollen from the flowers they hit. This is the only Tool that can collect all the pollen from more than 1 flower. This tool uses the same model as the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/27860496/Nova-Wand "Nova Wand"], which is an official Roblox gear that can be bought for {{Cost|Robux|1,000}}. This tool is needed for [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] [[Drives|Drive]] questline. Collecting 16,777,216 pollen with this tool is required for "Repairing The White Drive." Collecting 33,554,432 pollen with this tool is required for "Corrupting The Glitched Drive." This tool is often considered as one of the worst tools in the game by the community. The oldest version of the tool is known to not have the pollen increase of the current one. The previous version of the tool is known to have 15% pollen increase instead of the current 20%. *This is one of the (if not the) smallest tool in the game, barely being visible in the players hand unless the camera is zoomed in. {{Items}} [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Items]]

docs.title: Sparkles
docs.text:
[[File:Sparkles.png|thumb|A patch of flowers that has sparkles.]]'''Sparkles''' are an effect applied to certain patches of [[flowers]] that yields a token containing {{Cost|Honey}}, random [[treats]] corresponding to the [[Fields|field]] it is in, {{Cost|Moon Charm}}, or rarely {{Cost|Ticket}}, {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}}, {{Cost|Neonberry|4=0}}, {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}}, or {{Cost|Glitter|4=0}} when harvested. When enough [[pollen]] is collected from a sparkling flower, it will yield a token for any player to collect. If it isn't collected within 10 seconds, the token will disappear.

The largest plants in the [[Sunflower Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], and [[Pumpkin Patch]] will occasionally generate a face and blow bubbles 3 to 5 times on their respective fields, creating 13 patches of pollen that sparkle. The [[Blue HQ|Blue HQ's]] Bubble Wand blows bubbles on the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Mushroom Field]], [[Blue Flower Field]], and [[Clover Field]] in a similar fashion. Individual [[fireflies]] that spawn during the [[Day/Night Cycle|night]] also leave behind sparkles on flowers they were on as they are chased off.

== Gallery == C938AE13-DB0F-425E-855A-B6DCEB4C55C9.png|Face in the Pumpkin Patch. E857DA3F-8E6E-4609-96B4-A46ED03F6D04.png|Face in the Sunflower Field. BubbleWandSpit.png|Face on the giant bubble wand on The Blue HQ. PineappleSpitFace.png|Face in the Pineapple Patch. Sparkles.PNG|The sparkles left by fireflies. E8657830-EAC1-4DD2-A93A-935AA75D5C72.jpeg|The face in the Pumpkin Patch closing its eyes before fading away. Screenshot (88).png|Pineapple face blowing sparkles. Sparkle in mid-flight with a tail.png|Sparkle in mid-flight leaving a trail. File:Mushroom spit.png|Sparkles prior to the 9/28/2019 update. == Faces == Plant Face (Blinking).png Plant Face (Inactive).png Plant Face (Active).png == Trivia == * In the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]], the change to the size of the Clover Field was not taken into account, so the [[Bubble Wand]] model on the Blue HQ could sometimes produce sparkles in the area where there are no flowers. * Prior to the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], sparkles covered 4 flowers instead of 13. * In the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], the chances of sparkles being created were doubled. * The Bubble Wand model on the Blue HQ can leave sparkles right under the largest mushroom in the Mushroom Field, making it difficult to collect the rewards. * Sparkles used to be called '''spit''' by the community, which came from the various faces looking like they were spitting upon the field. [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] later on named this effect "sparkles" like it is today.[[File:Sparkletificated.png|thumb]] The verb form for sparkles is ‘sparkletificate’. * When disappearing, the eyes on a face close before fading away. * Spirit Bear mentions the sparkles in her dialogue before you receive her 8th quest, remarking how the Sparkles are "gross" in terms of how they were created by the faces. [[Category:Mechanics]] [[zh-tw:火花]]

docs.title: Special Sprout Summoner
docs.text:
[[File:SpecialSproutSummoner.jpeg|thumb|The Special Sprout Summoner.]] The '''Special Sprout Summoner''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] located near to the [[Red HQ]] and [[Sunflower Field]]. It allows players who have discovered all 8 [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bee]] types to summon either a rare, epic, legendary, supreme, gummy, or a moon [[sprout]] in a random [[Fields|field]] (except [[Coconut Field]] or [[Pepper Patch]]), and can only be used every 16 hours. It was added along with sprouts in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]]. It is decorated with a rare sprout that gives off particles.

Once used, the game will announce: "🌱 {Username} has planted a(n) [Rarity] Sprout...🌱"

== Trivia == * The Special Sprout Summoner and the [[honeystorm]] summoner are the only machines that require discovering Legendary bee types to be used, with this summoner requiring 8 and the honeystorm summoner requiring 4. ** Similarly, the [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteor Shower summoner]] requires 3 [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]] types discovered to be used. * Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], it was originally a normal sprout summoner, which was called the Sprout Summoner. It had the appearance of a normal sprout. The player only needed to discover 7 Legendary bees, as at the time there were only 7 Legendary bees. Its cooldown was only 8 hours and it had a chance to summon normal sprouts. ** [[Magic Bean]]s also did not exist back then, so this summoner was the only way for a player to summon a sprout manually. * The Special Sprout Summoner cannot summon a normal sprout after the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]].

docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Spicy_Bee.png |image-gifted= SpicyBee_Gifted.png |description = Some like it hot - this bee likes it scorching. Even the honey it makes is spicy. |rarity = Mythic |color = Red |energy = 20 |speed = 14 |attack = 5 |skincolor1 = #cf2013 |skincolor2 = #2e0600 |skincolor3 = #cf2013 }} '''Spicy Bee''' is a [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]].

Spicy Bee’s favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Strawberry}}.

Spicy Bee likes the [[Pepper Patch]]. It dislikes the [[Stump Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 14 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 300 [[honey]] in 2 seconds. * +220 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +50% Convert Speed, +4 Gather Amount, +4 [[System Page#Bee Attack|Attack]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +25% [[Flame#Flame Duration|Flame Duration]].

=== Abilities === '''[[Ability Tokens#Inferno|[Inferno]]]''' Summons a ring of 6 [[flame]]s, then summons 2 [[Fire Bee]]s that last for 15s (+1s per Level) with levels equal to 2 less than this bee's level. If Gifted, each Fire Bee has a 10% (+1% per Level) chance of being Gifted as well. However, the gifted Fire Bees from inferno '''DO NOT''' grant their gifted hive bonus. '''[[Ability Tokens#Rage|[Rage]]]''' Grants your bees +1 attack for 45s. Stacks up to 4 times. [[Ability Tokens#Flame Fuel|'''[🌟Gifted Ability: Flame Fuel]''']] For 15 seconds, Spicy Bee tosses oil into any flames that spawn, causing them to last 50% longer and instantly convert 50k pollen and (10 + 5 per Field Boost stack)% of your [[hive|Hive's]] [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]]. Unless converted to a [[Flame#Dark Flames|dark flame]], Spicy Bee won't throw oil into flames currently on the field. '''[[Passive Abilities#Steam Engine|[Passive: Steam Engine]]]''' This bee’s [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]] and gather speed drastically increases up to 100% with [[Buffs & Debuffs#Flame Heat|Flame Heat]].

{{Stat|pollen = 14|pollentime = 4|honey = 300|honeytime = 2|color = red|rarity = mythic}}

== Gallery == Spicy Bee Face.png|Spicy Bee's Face. Ol spicy.png|Spicy Bee's first face. Spoicy.png|A level 10 Spicy Bee hive slot. A level 10 gifted Spicy Bee hive slot.jpg|A Level 10 Gifted Spicy Bee Hive Slot. Inferno.png|Inferno token. NewInferno.png|Spicy Bee's Inferno Ability. Flame Fuel.png|Flame Fuel token. Bee Swarm Simulator Beesmas 2019.jpg|Tadpole Bee with Spicy Bee, Vector Bee, [[Basic Bee]], and [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddies]] in the game thumbnail. TheSoupy.png|Spicy bee toy.

==Trivia== Spicy Bee, [[Tadpole Bee]], [[Fuzzy Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]] and [[Digital Bee]] all have four different [[Ability Tokens|Abilities]], the most for any [[Bees|Bee]]. This bee and [[Rage Bee]] are the only bees with the Rage Ability. Spicy Bee’s gifted form is similar to Rage Bee’s gifted form and rage aphids. This bee and Tadpole Bee are the only Bees who can summon other entities. This is the only bee that can summon other Bees. This bee was originally going to be themed like a train, hence the Steam Engine passive ability, train sounds the tokens make and exhaust pipes on the bee's body[https://discord.com/channels/427553293862961153/427573109600550919/654002596050239546 Discord message] from Onett. While Steam Engine is active, Spicy Bee will emit a continuous trail of steam. This bee, along with Vector Bee, Buoyant Bee, and Precise bee emits light when gifted. Unlike other gifted bees, the star on top of a gifted Spicy Bee is a different color to the star on its side, with a green star on the top and 2 black ones on the side. This is the only Mythic bee to have completely whole numbered base [[stats]]. The Fire Bees summoned by its Inferno ability cannot convert pollen in the player's hive. At launch, this bee was insanely broken because of a typo. It was supposed to have each flame converting 1% of the player’s total conversion, but instead it converted 1% of their capacity. X-Flame converted 29% of the player's capacity ([[Demon Mask]] was required). It was quickly noticed and nerfed to the regular stats it has. When Gifted, Spicy Bee's exhaust pipes emit more steam. Spicy Bee and [[Puppy Bee]] are the only bees to like one field. If Spicy Bee is level 1 or 2, the Fire Bees will be level 1 instead of two levels below. This is because there is no level 0 or negative levels. ==References== {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Bees]] [[Category:Red]] [[Category:Mythic]] [[zh-tw:火辣蜂]]

docs.title: Spider Field
docs.text:
{{Field|image = Newspiderfield.png|fieldcolor = White|bees = 5|width = 28|height = 26}} The '''Spider Field''' is a [[Fields|field]] located past the [[Basic Bee Gate]] and lies between the [[Strawberry Field]] and [[Bamboo Field]]. The field is protected by the [[spider]].

It is a 26x28 field, containing 728 [[flowers]]. The flowers are all white, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

{ class="article-table" !'''Flowers''' !White !Red !Blue !Total - !Single 10% 0% 0% '''10%''' - !Double 80% 0% 0% '''80%''' - !Triple 10% 0% 0% '''10%''' - !'''Total''' '''100%''' '''0%''' '''0%''' '''100%''' } '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[bitterberry]], [[treat]], [[honey]], [[ticket]], [[enzymes|enzyme]], and [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Spider Field are [[Brave Bee]], [[Commander Bee]], [[Rage Bee]], [[Shocked Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], [[Vector Bee]], and [[Tabby Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Spider Field are [[Basic Bee]], [[Honey Bee]], and [[Baby Bee]].

This field grants Motivating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is placed here.

A level 2-4 [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] has the chance of spawning here.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a Spider [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +200% Spider Field pollen for 15 minutes. [[File:Spider Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Spider Field Boost icon.]] * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Spider Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% Spider Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Spider [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Spider Field conversion and give +5% instant Spider Field conversion and +20% Spider Field pollen for each stack. Spider Field Winds can stack up to a total of 13 times. * It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Spider Field Boost, it can boost the field by +5% to +30% depending on the amulet rarity.

===The methods below are no longer possible.=== * Giving a [[present]] to [[Onett]] gave Spider Field Boost x1 and other boosts and [[items]] and giving a present to [[Dapper Bear]] during Beesmas 2021 gave Spider Field Boost x3 and other boosts and items. Purchasing a Spider Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] gave x1.5 Spider [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Spider Field Pollen, -5% Monster Respawn Time, and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]]. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** Tabby (Gave Spider Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** BANNED (Activates Spider Field Code Buff + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gives Spider Field Boost x1 + other stuff). PlushFriday (Gives Spider Field Code Buff + other stuff). WeekExtension (Gives Spider Field Boost x3 + Spider Field Winds x10 + other stuff). ** LateNightGumdrops (Gave Spider Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** GummyBoost (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** ThnxCyaBoost (Gave Spider Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** AceUnhatched (Gave Spider Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** CantSleep (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** 1mFavorites (Gave Spider Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** MayRuTreats (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** ByeBeeBear (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** Reboooot (Gave Spider Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** RebootCloud (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 and Spider Field Winds x3 + other stuff). ** FuzzyReboot (Gave Spider Field Boost x3, Spider Field Winds x3, and Spider Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). ** NewMic (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 + other stuff). WintersEnd (Gave Spider Field Code Buff + other stuff). *Discord100k (Gave Spider Field Boost x3 + other stuff).

== Gallery == hivesticker spider field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * The Spider Field is the only field where all of the flowers are white. This also makes it the only field where all of the flowers are the same color, as there are no fields that are entire blue or red. * There is a {{Cost|Ticket|1}} hidden in the middle of the spider cave. * This is one of six fields where fireflies can land, with the others being Bamboo Field, [[Cactus Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Rose Field]], and Strawberry Field. * There is a [[Glitches|glitch]] that occurs at the Spider Field where amulets and cub buddies are spotted without an owner. This happens when a player left the server at the Spider Field. * This field is one of [[Black Bear|Black Bear's]] favorite fields, as mentioned in his dialogue. * This field, the [[Stump Field]], the [[Hub Field]], and the [[Mountain Top Field]] are the only fields that are not named after a plant or a fruit. * The Spider Cave, the Stump Field's Cave, and the [[Coconut Cave]] have the exact same cave decoration. * This field, along with Clover Field, Cactus Field, Rose Field, Mountain Top Field, and Pepper Patch are the only fields in which a Rogue Vicious Bee can spawn. * This is one of the only two fields named after the mob(s) that reside within the field. The other being the [[Ant Field]], with the multiple types of [[ants]]. * This field has a row of flowers inside the mountain wall that's normally not visible, but you can still collect pollen in that area, kind of like how the flowers in the [[Bamboo Field]] that go through the ramp aren't visible normally, but you can still collect those flowers.
