docs.title: Spider
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Spider |image =Transparent_spider.png |location = [[Spider Field]] |timer = 30 minutes (25.5 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee) |hp =100 |damage =20 |points = 10 |bond = 40 |honey = 1,000 |level = 4 }} ''Not to be confused with [[Cave Monster]], a similar-looking mob.''

The '''Spider''' is a level 4 [[Mobs|mob]] that can only be found in the [[Spider Field]].

It takes 30 minutes for the spider to respawn after being defeated (25 minutes 30 seconds with a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]). Defeating it gives 10 [[Battle Points]] and {{Cost|Honey|1000|4=}} spread across as 5 {{Cost|Honey||4=}} tokens. Various other rewards are also possible with their probability increasing with [[Loot Luck]].

== Locations == {| class="article-table" !Field !Quantity !Level |- |Spider Field and its surrounding area bordering the [[Strawberry Field|Strawberry]] and [[Bamboo Field]]s and the [[Basic Bee Gate]]. |1 |4 |}

== Drops == Guaranteed: * 10 battle points. * 1000 honey (increased by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]).

Possible: * {{Cost|Ticket}} (25% chance, Loot Luck: + drop rate) (Increments of 1, 3, 5, 10, or 25). {{Cost|Bitterberry}} (Increments of 1, 3, 5, or 33). {{Cost|Gumdrops}} (Loot Luck: + drop rate). {{Cost|Royal Jelly}} (Increments of 1 or 5). {{Cost|Treat}} (Increments of 1, 5, or 25). {{Cost|Pineapple}} (Increments of 1, 3, 33, or 333). {{Cost|Field Dice}} (Increments of 1, or 5). {{Cost|Glue}} (Somewhat Rare). (Increments of 1, 3, 5, or 10). {{Cost|Enzymes}} (Somewhat Rare). (Increments of 1, 3, 5, 10 or 25). {{Cost|Snowflake}} (Increments of 3, 33, 333) (Beesmas only). {{Cost|Magic Bean|4=0}} (Somewhat rare). {{Cost|Robo Pass|4=0}} (Somewhat Rare). {{Cost|Bubble Light|4=0}} (Rare) (Beesmas only). {{Cost|Stinger}} (Very Rare) (Increments of 1, 3, or 5). {{Cost|Star Jelly}} (Extremely rare). {{Cost|Forward Facing Spider Sticker|4=0}} (Extremely Rare) {{Cost|Snow Tiara|4=0}} (Extremely rare) (Beesmas only). {{Cost|Diamond Egg|4=0}} (Exceptionally rare). {{Cost|Gold Egg}} (Exceptionally rare). {{Cost|White Balloon|4=0}} (Exceptionally rare). *{{Cost|Black Balloon|4=0}} (Exceptionally rare).

== Strategies == * One way to keep idle while defeating the spider is to stay on the first block in the [[Obstacle Courses#Bamboo Field Obby|Bamboo Obby]] - the spider will try to lunge towards the player, but it will be stopped by the block. The player can also stand near the edge of the [[Vicious Bee Egg Claim]]. * The [[Glitches#Frozen Field Defenders|Frozen Field Defenders Glitch]] can be used to kill the spider easily, just like any other normal mob. * Another method is to charge at the spider, then jump and glide over the spider, though this will require the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]].

== Trivia == * This, the [[Mantis]] and the [[Werewolf]] are the only mobs that can attack players outside of their designated fields. * There is a {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}} token located within its residence (which is the Spider Cave). * The Spider gives more {{Cost|Honey||4=}} and gives better rewards than [[Mantis|Mantises]] and [[Scorpion]]s despite them being in higher-tier fields. * The Spider is tied with the [[Werewolf]] as the regular mobs with the least amount of spawn locations, as they both only have one. * Unlike real-life spiders, who have eight legs and six/eight eyes, the spider only has six legs and four eyes. It also appears to have a head and thorax, despite spiders and other arachnids having a cephalothorax. This is joked about in the Forward Facing Spider [[Stickers|sticker]]'s description, which reads: ''"Not enough legs to technically be a spider."'' * Two creatures similar to the spider in appearance called [[Cave Monster]]s are found inside the [[Werewolf's Cave]]. However, they have vastly different stats. * Spiders have a faint red glow under their eyes, but it’s mostly visible at night. {{MobNav}} [[fr:Araignée]] [[ru:Паук]] [[Category:Mobs]]

{{Bear|image = Spirit bear333.png |type = Quest Bear |location = In between the Coconut Field and the Pepper Patch, in front of the Extreme Memory Match. |bees = 35 |basecoloramount= 2 |basecolor1 =#6f6f6d |basecolor2 =#5d5e5b |shadecoloramount = 1 |shadecolor1 =#70706e |snoutcoloramount = 1 |snoutcolor1 =#393a35 |torsocolor1 =#939586 |torsocoloramount = 1 |armscolor =#656663 |legscolor =#555653 |enableother = no}} '''Spirit Bear''' is a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]] and is one of the eight permanent quest [[bears]] that can be accessed in the game, the others being [[Black Bear]], [[Brown Bear]], [[Mother Bear]], [[Panda Bear]], [[Science Bear]], [[Dapper Bear]], and [[Polar Bear]]. She holds a [[Petal Wand]] and wears a [[Petal Belt]]. The player must have 35 [[bees]] or more to get access Spirit Bear. She is located between the [[Coconut Field]] and the [[Pepper Patch]], and in front of the [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]], she has a total of 30 quests she can give to players, no repeatable quests.

Her [[Quests]] are one of the hardest quests to complete and take much longer to complete than the ones given by [[Science Bear]] or [[Onett]], as the later quests will require billions of [[Pollen]], Grandmaster [[Badges]], and huge amounts of [[Ability Tokens|Tokens]] collected. The main rewards from her quests are [[Spirit Petal]]s, which are granted every ten quests. In total, the player can obtain three, one to donate to the [[Wind Shrine]] (to get the [[Windy Bee]] or a [[Star Treat]] if the player already obtained a [[Windy Bee]] through buying it in an expired Some of the information she gives is not found anywhere else in the game. {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Quest !Dialogue |- |Spirit's Starter | Doesn't the mountain look nice from up here? Oh yes, this is the best spot to watch from. Watch all you beekeepers and your bees. So so busy! Not like me! I'm retired. I take it easy! Hmm... oh you - you're not who I thought. Have we met, honey bun? Oh, what's it matter. I'm Spirit Bear, and you're another beekeeper. It's happened before, and it's happening again. You need my guidance to reach the next level of beekeeping. I've got some time to give it to you! Since you've got that many bees you must know the drill. Hmm... ...Did you know? I planted the sunflowers in the Sunflower Field, you see. Well, my sister, she was the one who wanted sunflowers. For the bees, and also for the seeds, she loved to snack on the seeds. I used to like them too, hmm, but over time I grew sick of them. Quite a nasty habit - the shells get everywhere. (Cough) I planted the sunflowers, many more than you see today. The dandelion field ''[sic]'' used to be covered in them as well. I did most of the work, my sister, she wasn't much of a gardener. Hmm... Oh, yes. What is it you needed? That's right! That's right, alright. A quest. As if you weren't busy enough! Well, I've got plenty. And plenty other things store ''[sic]'' for you once you've finished. Things they don't make anymore, mind you. Quite special things, magical things. You believe in magic, don't you? Heheh! What's it matter, now. My sister, she wasn't as spiritual as I am. She didn't believe in magic, not in the same way as I do. Well, I used to tell her, that's why her plants would shrivel up. She wasn't in tune with the magic of nature, thus she never knew what they needed. Not quite like me. I can feel it, hear it - what the plants need. Even before they need it! Oh yes, I'm quite special in that way. Years ago, so many years ago, there was a terrible drought. I was the only one who felt it coming! I planned ahead, stockpiled. I became quite wealthy that year, for a while, anyhow. Hmm... oh right. Quests can seem so tedious, so meaningless, don't you agree? Why? why why why? Why in this field, why that color of flower? What's it all for? Well, child, if I told you now, you wouldn't be satisfied. I wasn't satisfied! As a cub I hated nothing more than questing. But the quests work on you as you work on the quests. They're more than a means of making honey. Do you believe what I'm saying? Hehe! What's it matter. Quests will come to you and you'll take them how you will. ...Whats ''[sic]'' that? Oh, my quest? You want a quest from me? Hmm, give me a second dear. ... There you go, right in there. Right in your Quest Menu. Go on now, go on. Spirit Bear need a little quiet time... ...(She appears to have fallen asleep)...

''-During-''

(Somehow she's standing in her sleep) ...sticky ...stubborn... (Why not let her rest while you complete her quest?)

''-Completion-''

(Yawn) Not in the honey pot! Take it outside! Oh! There you are, dear. ...Oh yes, your quest. It's complete - give me just a second. ... ...(Her eyes close, she begins to smile)... ... ...(She may have fallen asleep)... OK! Ok, ok. (Yawn) Oh, it's so hard to stay awake on sunny days like today. Yes... the sun, in my old age I've begun to appreciate it more. Warms you up down to your bones! But it's not good for your skin, no no no. You: stay out of the sun when you can. Protect yourself from wrinkles. Too late for me! Hah... What's that? Oh, you're too kind. Now, for your reward: Do you know about [Glitter]? You ought to know about it by now. In any case, it's exceedingly rare. Very important for a beekeeper. [Glitter] boosts pollen in a field you're standing in by 100%! Maybe, more importantly, it can be used to extend Field Boosts, Like those you get from [Field Dice]. Well, as I'm sure you've noticed, it's rather hard to come by. But those who know, they know... I know! Heh hee. Yes I know. [Glitter] to me is like Honey to you! I'd say I'm a [Glitter] Grandmaster. Glit-ah glit-ah! Falls down to us from the moon! Or rises up from the depths below! Too heavy or too light, to stick around for long. Unless... They used to sell this stuff for 5m Honey a pouch. That was a lot back then, I'll have you know. Not for me, of course. For others, yes. ... You look so familiar... Your bees.. no, no they don't look that familiar. Anyways, here you are. Let's keep busy, hmm. If you complete just 9 more quests, I'll give you a [Spirit Petal]. You've heard of them, surely. You've got 35 bees. Don't you read the wiki? Well you'll need these [Spirit Petals] to craft the items I'm wearing: The [Petal Wand] and the [Petal Belt]! The magic of nature itself can be channeled through them... To fire Petal Shurikens all around you! Like some sort of gardening ninja! When those fly through your bees, the bees instantly convert some pollen to honey. Exceedingly useful. Practically a necessity, even. I am the only one with [Spirit Petals] as far as I know. I've got plenty. Inherited them years ago. I take good care of them. It's my duty to preserve them and distribute them to beekeepers like you. LIKE you. Not you. Not yet, dear. 9 more quests for the 1st one. |- |The First Offering | The Wind Shrine: a beautiful - mystical - icon of the mountain. Older than most things here - older than me! Can you believe it? Not as old as some things. But older than most things. And through it, we maintain a living bond with a certain past. All of us - the bears, the bees, the Robloxians or whatever you are... Blow through time like petals in an evening's breeze. The Shrine stands sturdily, solemnly... As a constant reminder of that fleeting dance. It also acts as a convenient time gate, and item sink, for the sake of this game. Donate something to the Wind Shrine, and many things could happen. Usually it will stir up the winds spawning Clouds and providing perks to certain fields. But it also acts as the means of obtaining a [Windy Bee Egg]. Windy Bee - oh, you could say it's a favorite of mine. An unpredictable creature difficult to grasp. So delicate yet so powerful! And certainly the most beautiful, yes yes. Are you listening to us now, Windy Bee? ... Don't be coy! Not with me! ...(She tosses a handful of dried petals into the air)... ...(She watches them intently as they swirl and fall)... ... Heheheh! Alright then. Swirl away like the rest of them! ...(The petals blow away into the fields)... Look, one's stuck to Black Bear's head. Don't tell him! Right - why don't you give the Wind Shrine a try? But Galentine's Day is a whole other type of magic - and just as fun! The magic of loooove! Yes yes I know. Love isn't as much fun as toys and gifts. But Spirit Bear likes what she likes, and every year she likes seeing a dolled up Wind Shrine on Galentine's Day. Frankly, I don't care about the winds of love. Took down my sails ages ago (although I got good use out of them). But I do very much care about keeping things pretty around here. ... Tell you what, if you decorate the Wind Shrine, I'll give you something special. My Winter Memory Match membership info! Heheh. You can't play Winter Memory Match without a membership, and you can't get new ones! I'm grandfathered in. Winter Memory Match is a true delight. The prizes are outstanding, from my experience. If you want to play Winter Memory Match, all you need to do is liven up that Shrine. Hearts and bows, and a fresh coat of paint. It'll be just lovely! (Cough) Excuse me, dear. I'm not feeling so well. I'm not sick. When you get to my age some days are just coughing days. ... You wouldn't subject an old coughing bear the the fumes of Galentine's Day paint, though, would you? I didn't think so. Oooh, you're a real sweetheart. So go on now! Go make the Shrine pretty for Spirit Bear! And who know, maybe the Galentine's Shrine will help you find a little sweetheart of your own! Heheh. Oh, I'm just teasing you. No room for romance in the busy life of a honeymaker. Isn't that right? (Cough) Ach. ''-During-'' N/A

''-Completion-'' (Yawn) Well noone told me about her- (Grunt) Oh it’s you! I’m feeling much better. The coughing. I mean. Just had to drink more water. The cool winter air is a just a bit too dry. Mmhmm. Ahhh, but Beesmas makes it all worth it. I do imagine that back in the day, we must have begun celebrating just for that reason. The winter is so miserable! Short, dark days. Dry air, chilling us to our bones. We needed those festivals to get us through! ... Yes, Beesmas is a true delight. I hope it never ends. ... What’s that? Galentine’s Day? No, dear. It’s Beesmas now. Galentine’s Day isn’t until February. What? Really? Oh! Where did the time go? Oh, but does Beesmas really have to end? Who says the festive magic can’t last all year long? Huh? I said that? Don’t put words in my mouth, dear. Although, now that I hear you say them, they do make some sense. Well then, if it’s nearly Galentine’s Day, we’ll need to decorate the Wind Shrine. Oh! You’ve done it already? Taking initiative yourself, how refreshing! Let’s take a look then. How lovely! Much nicer than when I do it myself. You perfectly captured the essence the lovestruck by Cupid’s gale. Are you really sure that you haven’t been bitten by a love bug yourself? Heheh. (Yawn) Well, thank you for dolling up the Shrine! I’ll be admiring it all Galentine’s Day. So long, dear! ... What’s that? You want to know what the decorations do? They inspire lovey dovey feelings when you look at them, that’s all. What did you expect? They’re just decorations. Although, there was an old wive’s tale about donating [Strawberries] to the Galentine’s Shrine. Apparently it can bring true love. Just a silly superstition, unless... ... Well goodbye now! ... Huh? My Winter Memory Match password? Like I would never tell you. Oh? Oh, did I tell you I would tell you my password if you decorated the Wind Shrine? That does sound a bit like something I would say... Eh... Why not. But keep it a secret! (She leans over and whispers the login credential on your ear) Wait... wait no. That’s my online banking info. Or was it? No, that wasn’t it. Hold on a moment, dear. (She searches through your Petal Belt) (She pulls out a folded piece of paper) This must be it. Hmm... yes, yes. This is my Winter Memory Match info. (She leans over and whispers the login credential on your ear) Got it? Good! You can find the Winter Memory Match near Honey Bee. Go collect [Snowflakes] to play and give it a try! |} |-|2019= == Beesmas 2019 Ornament Quest == {{RemovedContent}} {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !'''Quest''' !'''Requirements''' !'''Reward''' |- |Spirit Bear's Ornament | * Collect 100,000,000 White [[Pollen]]. * Collect 50,000,000 Pollen from the [[Pine Tree Forest]]. * Collect 2,500 Honey Tokens. * Collect 100 Tokens from Festive Gifts. * Match 15 Pairs in [[Memory Match|Memory Match Games]]. * Donate 500 Sunflower Seeds to the [[Wind Shrine]]. * Collect 150 Tokens from Wild Windy Bee. |Starts Memory Match (upon receiving quest)

  • Strawberry Badge - Master
  • Bamboo Badge - Master
  • Pumpkin Badge - Hotshot

100,000,000 Honey5x Ticket10x Cloud VialMemory Match [[Ornaments|Ornament]] |}

{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Quest !Dialogue |- |Spirit Bear's Ornament |Look at you... You must be freezing! I'm a bit chilled myself but goodness, How do you people survive without any fur? You should put on a coat. There's got to be an affordable coat in the ROBLOX catalog. Really, though. Coats should be free. Goodness. It's ostensibly a season of giving and charity and look at you - You beekeepers are running around in the snow with hardly anything on. Everyone should get a coat on Beesmas. A nice warm coat. At least your shoulders are warm under those "guards", hah. Hmm... What's that? [Ornament]? Oh, believe me dear - you don't want to get me started on [Ornaments]. I've got more [Ornaments] than I've got [Glitters]! That's right, I've been collecting them for ages. I'm keeping my mother's tradition alive. She was an [Ornament] hoarder, mmhmm. And I'm thankful for it because we always had the most beautiful tree! Even compared to my more well-to-do friends. Yes. You don't need much money, you've just got to keep an eye out. (Cough) Let me tell you, as you age, you'll appreciate [Ornaments] even more. Each one is a perfectly encapsulated memory. A physical memory that won't give out! Not like the ones in here (She taps your head with her [Petal Wand]) Those don't last. Half of them aren't even real! But an [Ornament] can't lie, it's just a piece of glass... or plastic. The nice ones though, the "breakables" as mother used to call them, Those ones are made of glass. And even those are more durable than the thoughts in your head. Mmhmm. And people say memories last forever... pfft. Not if you don't have something tangiable ''[sic]'' to keep them alive. Placing them back on the Beesmas tree each year, that's the best way to do it. ...(Yawn)... How's our tree doing this year? How many presents have you been able to open? Ah, I just love it all! What a brilliant idea, Beesmas! Oooh, and that Bee Bear! What a gift he is himself! The magic of Beesmas, now you're speaking my language! Heh, these festivities never grow old to me. Mmhmm, Merry Beesmas dear! Go on now and get yourself something warm to wear! ... Oh - right. My [Ornament]. Ah, but which one?? They're all so special to me... Which memory do I want to share this year, hmm? Hmmm... Well, why don't you go on and complete my quest for now. I'll pick out the perfect [Ornament] while I wait. Collect 100,000,000 White pollen... Collect 50,000,000 pollen from the Pine Tree Forest... Collect 2,500 Honey Tokens... Collect 100 Tokens from Festive Gifts... Match 15 pairs in Memory Match... Donate 500 [Sunflower Seeds] to the Wind Shrine... And collect 150 Tokens from Wild Windy Bee. Here, I'll give you a head start:

''-During-''

N/A

''-Completion-''

(Yawn) You bug-eyed brats, take the coal and act happy about it- Oh! There you are dear. Ach! You must be freezing! How can you stand it out there in the snowy fields like that? Put on a coat, dear! Do you WANT to catch a cold? ...(Achoo!)... AH! And you're spreading it to me... At my age, goodness, this could be the end of me. I hope you're happy. (She stares sternly at your bees) And you let your keeper go out like that? Tssk. ... Oh, I'm just playing with you, dear. With all this sun it actually get's ''[sic]'' quite warm out here, when you're working up a sweat. Swinging that collector around and what not. Still, get yourself a coat. ... Oooo. You've finished my [Ornament] quest? Ah, but I still haven't decided which [Ornament] to put on the tree... I'm sorry, dear. To be honest, as soon as you left I immediately fell asleep. OK, well, it can't be that hard... ... ...(She closes her eyes)... ... ... ... Aaah. I know. (She reaches around in her [Petal Belt]) 🎵 Fa la la la la ~ Luh-la... La... Laaaaaaa~ 🎵 Here it is: My [Memory Match Ornament]. One of my rarest! It was only given to the top 100 Memory Match players of 1983! I just made the cut! I was 99th! Spent a pretty penny grinding those matches out. Yes, even back then I was wealthy but the top 100, It's more competitive than the Global Top Honeymaker board! It was definitely worth it, though. This [Ornament] - gorgeous. With this on the Beesmas Tree, you'll receive the following boosts: +10% Capacity; +25% Convert Rate while at the Hive; x1.25 Pollen from the Dandelion Field; And x1.25 Pollen from the Stump Field. Careful now, don't break it. Can't get another like it. Mmm. Well now, certainly my [Ornament] quest gave you leagues more trouble than the others, So far, at least. But it was worth it dear! Why? The gift boxes from this point on, that's why! What's inside them? Whose to say? ... ...(She leans in and whispers)... ...they're worth it... Go on now! Open those presents and have yourself a very, very merry Beesmas. |}

== Trivia == * She is one of the two female bears in the game, the other being [[Mother Bear]]. * You can get to her without 35 bees by using the [[Red Cannon]], then using the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]] to glide over, then make sure you have high ping so you are able to talk to her before you get kicked out of the 35 bee zone. * Her idle animation comes from the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/48/Elder-Animation-Package Elder Animation Package]. * She quite often refers to her sister, another bear who was very close to her. * She, [[Stick Bug]], the [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddies]], Bee Bear and [[Shadow Bear]] are the only NPCs that dance. * She is the second NPC to hold a tool, the first being [[Onett]], which makes her the only bear holding a tool. * She is the third NPC to wear a belt, the other two being [[Sun Bear]] and [[Onett]]. ** Spirit Bear, Sun Bear, and Dapper Bear are the only [[Bears]] to wear accessories, Spirit Bear and Sun Bear being the only bears to wear [[:Category:Accessories|in-game accessories]]. * Spirit Bear is based off of [[Wikipedia:Kermode bear|Kermode Bears]], which are sometimes referred as spirit bears. ** Kermode bears are a rare subspecies of the black bear. * She mentions the [[Bee Swarm Simulator Wiki]] in the quest "Spirit's Starter". * Both she and [[Science Bear]] have [[items]] that are only obtainable from their quests, which are [[Spirit Petal]]s and [[Translator]]s respectively. * The [[Codes|Code]] "BeesBuzz123" is her account's password on her own website, proven from her dialogue in "QR Quest". * She, [[Panda Bear]], [[Black Bear]], [[Gummy Bear]] and [[Science Bear]] are the only bears that mention/have a code. * It is possible to glitch into Spirit Bear and get a quest from her. The player has to jump on the [[Windy Bee]] statue on top of the [[Windy Bee Gate|35 Bee Gate]] and glide or jump to her, or, if the player has enough ping, climb up the big rock left of the gate and nearest to the [[Coconut Field]] and talk to her. * She has the most words per quest in her dialogue, at around 2,000 per quest, even surpassing Science Bear with the most words per quest dialogue. ** She has around 21 thousand words in her whole dialogue. * She and [[Dapper Bear]] are the only permanent quest bears to not have a [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]]. * All of Spirit Bear's quests require collecting an increasing amount of white pollen. (With the exception of her Beesmas quests.) * Spirit Bear is the second bear to require the completion of another bear's quest, the first being [[Bee Bear]] and [[Sun Bear]] being third. * Spirit Bear is the only quest giver that can summon [[Nighttime]], a [[Wild Windy Bee]], and a [[Snowstorm]]. However, Spirit Bear, along with [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]], are the only quest givers that can summon a [[Honeystorm]]. ** According to [[Bee Bear]], [[Bubble Bee Man]] can also summon honeystorms.[[Honeystorm]] * She is self-aware that she is in a game, as she mentions "game balance'' in ''Sway Away." ** This could be because of multiple reasons, such as her saying "Ol' Stumpy", her mentioning the wiki you are viewing this on, or her age. * She is the only permanent quest giver that requires the player to play [[Memory Match]]es. * She is the only permanent quest giver that requires the player to use the [[Wealth Clock]] for her quests. * Spirit Bear refers to the Stump Snail as ''Ol' Stumpy''. This may be a reference to the youtuber [https://www.youtube.com/user/ThnxCya ThnxCya] as he references it as ''Ol' Stumpy'' too. * Sources confirm that she's a 1983's Memory Match tournament champion, and that explains why she gives quests that require players to play [[Memory Match]]. * Some of her quests give items upon receiving the quest. These items include: [[Jelly Beans]], [[Royal Jelly#Star Jelly|Star Jelly]], [[Glitter]], [[Magic Bean]]s, [[Coconut]]s, [[Pineapple]]s, [[Sunflower Seed]]s and [[Gumdrops]]. * Her favorite holiday is Galentine's Day. * Her sleep talking during the quest "Do You Bee-lieve In Magic?" is probably a reference to the image of [[Basic Bee]] winking that can be found at the end of the White Tunnel, hinting to the code "Wink". * In the 2021 Beesmas Quest, when she tells the player where to get [[Nectar|Satisfying Nectar]], she mentions the wrong fields; The [[Dandelion Field]], the [[Bamboo Field]], and the [[Pine Tree Forest]] is where the player can get [[Nectar|Comforting Nectar]], not [[Nectar|Satisfying Nectar]]. * In her first quest, Spirit Bear reveals that she planted the Sunflowers in the [[Sunflower Field]]. ** The Sunflowers were requested by her sister, who loves to snack on [[Treats#Sunflower Seed|Sunflower Seeds]].

  • The dialogue of her quest "Witness Grandeur" reveals she has known [[Brown Bear]] since he was a cub.

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Spirit Petal-1.png |description = A delicate flower petal used in rituals. |cooldown = N/A }} {{Color|Spirit Petal|Spirit Petals}} are a special [[crafting]] material that can be used as one of the ingredients to craft the [[Petal Wand]] and the [[Petal Belt]]. It can also be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]] to allow the player a chance of obtaining a [[Windy Bee]] (or a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}}, if player already had [[Windy Bee]]) when donating {{Cost|Cloud Vial}}. Note that players are only able to donate one {{Cost|Spirit Petal||4=1}} with {{Cost|Cloud Vial}} to the Wind Shrine to get a chance to obtain a Windy Bee, as the other two are strictly to be used for crafting the [[Petal Belt]] and [[Petal Wand]].

There are {{Cost|Spirit Petal|3}} that are given every 10th [[Spirit Bear#Quests (30)|Spirit Bear quest]], first one being Sway Away, second being Tickle The Wind, and third being Spring Out Of The Mountain. [[File:A sprit petal on inventory.jpg|thumb|A {{Cost|Spirit Petal||4=1}} inside the player’s Inventory.|alt=]]

docs.text:
{{Consumables |image = Sprinkler builder.png |description = Use while standing in flowers to place a Sprinkler. |cooldown = 1 second |cap = }} '''Sprinklers''' are items that can be placed in [[fields]] by players to help with [[Flowers|flower]] regeneration. They can be bought in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]], accessible by obtaining 15 [[badges]] of any kind. There are five sprinklers in the game: the [[Basic Sprinkler]], the [[Silver Soakers]], the [[Golden Gushers]], the [[Diamond Drenchers]] and [[The Supreme Saturator]]. They all look similar; a simple sprinkler that stands up from the ground beneath the flower the player is standing on. The material the sprinkler is made of is based on the tier color. (The only exception to this is The Supreme Saturator, which has a giant golden sprinkler sticking through a neon blue bear head.) The higher level the sprinkler is, the more players can place (with the exception of The Supreme Saturator) and the more effective it can be. Sprinklers can't be placed in the [[Hub Field]]. [[File:Sprinkler shop.webp|thumb|All five sprinklers in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]].|300px]] The Basic Sprinkler is unlocked as soon as a player is able to enter the Badge Bearer's Guild. However, the Silver Soakers require 10 Hotshot badges, the Golden Gushers require 10 Ace badges, the Diamond Drenchers require 10 Master badges and The Supreme Saturator requires 10 Grandmaster badges.

Players cannot place their own sprinklers within 8 flowers of each other. However, they can place their sprinklers right next to a different player's sprinkler. When they place their sprinkler too close to another one of theirs, the player gets a message that says: {{Notification|Red|Cannot place sprinklers this close to eachother ''[sic]''|19}}

However, if the player places the sprinkler in mid-air, they can override this error and plant sprinklers as close as they wish. This is a glitch known as the [[Glitches#Close Sprinklers Glitch|Close Sprinklers Glitch]].

Note that what players are able to buy is actually a sprinkler ''builder'', which is a permanent tool that players can access via the eggs/items tab whenever they like. Players can activate it by placing the item on the bottom middle of their screen and clicking it (or their corresponding hotkeys, if the player is on a PC). If a player places more sprinklers than they can place, the oldest one will be removed. A sprinkler that is placed in a field will stay there until the player who placed it removes it by placing it elsewhere, or until the player dies or leaves the game. {| class="article-table" ! ! style="text-align:center" | Basic Sprinkler[[File:Basic Sprinkler.png|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" | Silver Soakers[[File:Silver Soakers.png|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" | Golden Gushers[[File:Golden Gushers.png|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" | Diamond Drenchers[[File:Diamond Drenchers.png|40px]] ! style="text-align:center" | The Supreme Saturator[[File:Supreme Saturator.png|40px]] |- |'''Count'''(How many can be placed at once) |1 |2 |3 |4 |1 |- |'''Radius'''(How far the sprinkler reaches) |7 |7 |8 |8 |16 |- |'''Power'''(How much pollen the flower increases by) |7 |7 |8 |9 |10 |- |'''Rate'''(How often the sprinkler activates) |5 sec |4.5 sec |4.5 sec |4 sec |1 sec |- |'''Setup'''(How long it takes for the sprinkler to build) |6 sec |5 sec |5 sec |4 sec |3 sec |- |'''Badges'''(the number and tier of badges need to unlock) |10 Cadet(Tier 1) |10 Hotshot(Tier 2) |10 Ace(Tier 3) |10 Master(Tier 4) |10 Grandmaster(Tier 5) |- |'''Cost''' in {{Cost|Honey}} |1,111,111 |22,222,222 |333,333,333 |4,444,444,444 |55,555,555,555 |}

docs.title: Sprout
docs.text:
''Were you looking for [[Magic Bean]]?''

[[File:Sprouttransparent.png|thumb|The sprout model.]]

A '''sprout''' is a plant that spawns in the center of a [[Fields|field]]. Sprouts emit a bright yellow beacon that reaches the sky, and have a counter at the base of it representing a [[pollen]] amount. When players collect pollen, or when a [[Clouds|cloud]] is on the field, the number counts down and it gradually grows taller. Once the pollen counter reaches 0, it sends out shockwave and scatters various tokens throughout the field. If no interaction with a sprout happens for more than 5 minutes, it will despawn.

== Spawning == Sprouts can spawn randomly around the map and can also be planted using {{Cost|Magic Bean}}. It can also be summoned by using the [[Special Sprout Summoner]] near the [[Red HQ]], by anyone who has discovered all eight [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary Bee]] types, once every sixteen hours.

When a sprout spawns, it will broadcast a server-wide message: {{Notification|Honey|🌱A (Rarity) Sprout has appeared...🌱}}

If a player has planted a sprout, the message would read: {{Notification|Honey|🌱 {Username} has planted a (Rarity) Sprout...🌱}}

If Sticker Sprouts are about to spawn in [[Hive Hub]], the message will read: {{Notification|Sticker|🌱 Sticker Sprouts are about to spawn in the Hive Hub...🌱}}

When the Sticker Sprout has spawned in the Hive Hub, the message will read: {{Notification|Sticker|🌱 A Sticker Sprout has spawned in the Hive Hub...🌱}}

Sprouts cannot spawn or be planted in the [[Ant Field]].

== Variants == There are ten different variants of sprouts: Sprout (Green) (Common) Rare Sprout (Silver) (Rare) Epic Sprout (Gold) (Very Rare) Legendary Sprout (Teal) (Extremely Rare) Supreme Sprout (Luminescent green) (Unfathomably Rare) Moon Sprout (Only available during nighttime (common), luminescent blue during both night and day) Gummy Sprout (Translucent pink) (Very Rare) Sticker Sprout (Spawns only every 3 hours in the [[Hub Field]], or a extremely rare chance when planting a magic bean in the Hub Field) (Rainbow, colors shifting) Festive Sprout (Planted by {{Cost|Festive Bean}} or [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] (White and Red stripes) Debug Sprout (Can only be planted by [[Onett]]) (Black) The amount of pollen needed for the sprout for it to be harvested depends on the rarity of the sprout and the field it's in.

== Drops == === Location Specific Drops === Depending on where the sprout is planted, the drops spawned can vary in amounts or may drop certain items. A sprout in a [[:Category:Red|red]] field yields 4 times more {{Cost|Strawberry}} than in any other field. No {{Cost|Blueberry}} will spawn. A sprout in the [[Strawberry Field]] will yield twice as many strawberries than sprouts in other red fields. A sprout in a [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] field yields 6 times more blueberries than in any other field. No strawberries will spawn. A sprout in the [[Sunflower Field]] yields 7 times more {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}} than in any other field. A sprout in the [[Pineapple Patch]] yields 7 times more {{Cost|Pineapple}} than in any other field. A sprout in the [[Windy Bee Gate|35 Bee Zone]] yields 20% more rewards than sprouts in other areas. It also requires significantly more pollen to pop. A sprout in the [[Coconut Field]] yields {{Cost|Coconut}} and {{Cost|Tropical Drink}} in addition to other treats. *Other fields may produce more regular {{Cost|Treat}} than any other treats depending on the field.

=== Drops Table === The higher tier the sprout is, the more tokens spawn when fully harvested. The possible drops and amount of pollen needed for the sprout for it to be harvested are listed in the table below.

(An '''X''' in a category means that the specified sprout doesn't spawn that item.)

==Tips== * Various items, abilities, and equipment can boost player movespeed, helping to collect tokens more efficiently before they despawn. Using {{Cost|Oil}} grants 1.2x player movespeed. Equipping the [[Hasty Guard]] grants 1.1x player movespeed. Having [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|haste]] can increase the player's [[System Page#Movespeed|movespeed]] up to 2x. [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste producing bees]] are the primary source of this buff. The Honey, Treat, Strawberry, and Blueberry [[Dispensers]] give 5 stacks of Haste. The [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] gives 10 stacks of Haste. If the player and has either the [[Coconut Clogs]] or the [[Gummy Boots]] equipped, they can have a coconut fall on them and grant the player a short burst of [[Passive Abilities#Coconut Haste|Coconut Haste Surge]]. [[Bear Bee|Bear Bee's]] {{Cost|Bear Morph}} [[Ability Tokens|ability]] can significantly increase player movespeed as well. The Free Royal Jelly Dispenser gives a stack of Haste+. [[Tadpole Bee]] and the {{Cost|Box-O-Frogs}} can summon [[frog]]s that collect sprout tokens. The [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]] can collect massive amounts of sprout tokens. [[Windy Bee|Windy Bee's]] {{Cost|Tornado}} can also collect massive amounts of sprout tokens. *{{Cost|Cub Buddy}} can also collect sprout tokens.

==Trivia== If a {{Cost|Festive Bean|||0}} is planted by a player, the {{Cost|Festive Blessing}} and {{Cost|Beesmas Cheer}} buffs are only obtainable by the player that planted it. If the sprout is planted by Onett, anyone can collect the tokens. Gummy Sprouts are the only sprouts that are translucent. Most sprout notifications are displayed in gold, but a few have unique displays: Gummy Sprouts have a light purple notification. Supreme, Moon, and Debug Sprouts have gray notifications. Festive Sprouts have a red notification. Sticker Sprouts have a rainbow notification. Many of the treat drop statistics are mentioned in Spirit Bear's dialogue. Sprouts were originally called "Seedlings" when they were released and then the name got changed in the [[Updates#2019.12.23|12/23/2019 update]]. Its original message was "🌱A Seedling has sprouted...🌱" The Supreme Sprout previously required half the [[pollen]] that a Legendary Sprout would need. It now requires 50% more pollen than a Legendary Sprout. Since the [[Updates#2019.12.23|12/23/2019 update]], Onett has been able to plant sprouts server-wide throughout the game. They can be planted under unique names. Supreme Sprouts were formerly named "Mythical Sprouts" before the 12/23/2019 update. If the player turned in [[Stick Bug#Egg Hunt 2019 Quest|Stick Bug's Egg Hunt 2019 Quest]], Stick Bug spawned an Epic, Legendary, and a Supreme Sprout. The "[[Special Sprout Summoner]]" was formerly called "Sprout Summoner", and it would plant any type of sprout randomly except for Debug, Festive and Sticker Sprouts. The Debug Sprout is the only sprout that does not drop honey tokens. If a sprout spawns before a player joins the server, the sprout and the sprout's pollen counter will be invisible to that player, however it can still be popped by the player. On mobile, there is a glitch where the sprouts in the server are invisible and can't be popped by the player. Sticker Sprouts are the only sprouts that grow on their own (without clouds). It loses about 1M pollen per second, even if no one is collecting in the Hub Field. If the player who spawned the sprout leaves before the sprout has popped, the sprout will not spawn anything. The debug sprout is the only type of sprout that cannot be planted by a player (besides Onett, who can plant them at will.) Sprouts are mentioned by [[Sun Bear]] to only exist on the Mountain. As he mentions “I've been all around the world, and I've never seen ANYTHING like those before.” If the player is lagging, they may see the pollen number on the sprout become negative for a brief moment when they pop it. Supreme Sprouts and Moon Sprouts are the only sprouts that glow. The following [[Sticker]]s can spawn after popping a Sticker Sprout: Happy Fish Green Plus Sign Green Check Mark Giraffe Tiny House Yellow Umbrella Pizza Delivery Man Coiled Snake (Uncommon) Baseball Swing (Uncommon) Launching Rocket (Uncommon) Traffic Light (Uncommon) Green Circle (Uncommon) Window (Rare) Simple Skyscraper (Rare) Orphan Dog (Rare) Interrobang Block (Rare) Theatrical Intruder (Rare) Desperate Booth (Rare) Grey Shape Companion (Rare) Evil Pig (Rare) Waving Townsperson (Rare) Tough Potato (Rare) Uplooking Bear (Very Rare) Alert Icon (Very Rare) Thumbs Up Hand (Very Rare) Peace Sign Hand (Very Rare) Built Ship (Very Rare) Sitting Green Shirt Bear (Extremely Rare) Panicked Science Bear (Extremely Rare) Yellow Sticky Hand (Extremely Rare) AFK (Extremely Rare) Shining Halo (Extremely Rare) Robot Head (Extremely Rare) Grey Diamond Logo (Extremely Rare) Prism Painting (Extremely Rare) Banana Painting (Extremely Rare) Flying Rad Bee (Unbelievably Rare) Flying Ninja Bee (Unbelievably Rare) Flying Brave Bee (Unbelievably Rare) Flying Photon Bee (Unbelievably Rare) Bear Bee Offer (Unbelievably Rare) Saturn (Unbelievably Rare) Taunting Doodle Person (Unbelievably Rare) Pearl Girl (Unfathomably Rare) **Abstract Color Painting (Unfathomably Rare)

The '''Star Amulet''' is an [[amulet]] that can be purchased in five different tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Supreme) from machines in the [[Star Hall]]. They grant buffs to the owner and always increase [[capacity]] as they go up a tier. Higher tier amulets grant more and better buffs. Diamond and Supreme Star Amulets also have additional [[Passive Abilities#Star Amulet Passives|Star Passive]] abilities. The more [[gifted bee]] types the player has discovered, the more likely the stats from the Star Amulets will be at maxed value.

Each Star Amulet requires the user to have a certain number of gifted bees discovered. After the user generates a Star Amulet, the user must wait 1 second to generate another one.

If the player disconnects while deciding to keep old or replace a Star Amulet, they will have another chance to keep old or replace when they rejoin a server.

When the player generates a Star Amulet, the following audio plays (The sound pitch when creating a Star Amulet decreases when going up in tiers): [[File:Amulet Generation Star.ogg|center|frameless|180x180px]]

==== Supreme Star Passives ==== The Supreme Star Passives are the main feature of Supreme Star Amulets. There are 6 passives that the player can get, with a 1/6 chance of getting a specific one. There is also a 1/50 chance to get another passive, resulting in two passive abilities. If the player has 500B honey or more when generating an amulet, they can choose to spend 500B to guarantee a double passive. If a double passive is generated, there is a 1/15 chance of getting a specific combination (1/6 * 1/5 * 2). This means there is a 1/750 chance to get a specific pair of passives from generating an amulet overall (1/15 * 1/50). The player can only have a maximum of two passives from a Supreme Star Amulet at a time. Listed below are the possible passives:

{ class="wikitable mw-collapsible" style="text-align:center" ! scope="col" '''Buff's Name''' ! scope="col" '''Icon''' ! scope="col" '''Passive Description''' - '''Guiding Star''' [[File:GuidingStarIcon.png Every 250th Boost Token summons a Guiding Star over a random field for 10 minutes, Granting x2.5 Pollen, Capacity and Convert Rate to the player who spawned the star, and x1.25 pollen, capacity and convert rate to all other players in the field. Chooses 1 of the 5 fields you have collected the least from. While active, the star pollinates 15 (+1 per gifted bee type) flowers every 15 seconds. Having this passive on your amulet will permanently grant you x1.25 Capacity. (Cooldown: 5m). - '''Star Shower''' [[File:StarShowerIcon.png Every 40th Boost or Mark Token causes 10 shooting stars to fall on the field, which collect and instantly convert 30 pollen (+50% per Gifted Bee Type, +100% per Field Boost stack) from 5 flowers. Catching a shooting star grants a stack of Inspire, and instantly converts pollen equal to 1m +200% of your Convert Total. Having this passive on your amulet will permanently grant you x1.25 Capacity. (Cooldown: 30s) - '''Gummy Star ''' [[File:GummyStarIcon.png Using [[Gumdrops]] while in a Field has a 2% chance to summon a Gummy Star (automatically summoned if 75 gumdrops are used without a Gummy Star appearing) which grants x2 White Field Capacity and +10% Goo Conversion for 45s. The Gummy Star grows as you collect Goo, granting bonus Goo (up to x4) the larger it gets. After 45s, the Gummy Star pops, scattering Honey Tokens equal to +1.5% per Gifted Colorless Bee Type of the Goo collected and Gumdrops Tokens over the field (increases with goo collected). Having this passive on your amulet will permanently grant you x1.25 White Field Capacity. (Cooldown: 60s) - '''Pop Star''' [[File:PopStarIcon.png Every 30th Boost Token summons a Pop Star which grants +10% Instant Blue Conversion and x2 Blue Pollen for 45s. When Pop Star is activated, it automatically grants 2 minutes of "Bubble Bloat". While the Pop Star is active, every one of your Bubbles popped causes the star to grow, which increases the Blue Pollen by 1% (up to x4.5) and grants 4s of "Bubble Bloat" (1s if Bubble is not yours, 6s if the Bubble is gold) which increases Blue Field Capacity and Convert Rate at Hive by up to x6 for 2.5 hours. When it ends, the Pop Star spawns a number of Bubbles over the field that increases with the number of Bubbles popped. Having this passive on your amulet will permanently grant you x1.25 Blue Field Capacity. (Cooldown: 60s) - '''Scorching Star ''' [[File:ScorchingStarIcon.png Every 30th Boost Token summons a Scorching Star for 45s, which grants +50% Instant Flame Conversion, +5 Conversion Links, and x2 Red Pollen and Convert Rate. Standing near Flames causes the star to grow, increasing the bonus Red Pollen and Convert Rate up to x5 and the number of Conversion Links up to 30. When the star expires, it instantly converts all pollen in your container. Having this passive on your amulet will permanently grant you x1.25 Red Field Capacity. (Cooldown: 60s) - '''Star Saw''' [[File:StarSawIcon.png Every 3rd Stinger you use is free and summons a Star Saw for 30s. It circles around you, damaging enemies (equal to 15% of your Total Attack, with accuracy equal to the average bee lvl of your hive not including summons), collecting Tokens, and collecting and instantly converting 3 pollen (+0.5 per 100 Attack Total) from 5 flowers 10 times a second. The saw converts additional pollen in your container equal to the amount it gathers. }

GuidingStarHover.png|A Guiding Star hovering over the Stump Field. StarSawSpinning.gif|A Star Saw spinning around a player. StarPopping.png|A Star popping behind a player.

==Trivia== The Supreme Star Amulet Generator takes the place of the original spot taken by Diamond Star Amulet Generator, only a bit more moved back. The Diamond Star Amulet and Supreme Star Amulet are the only two amulets in the game that can have or always have passive abilities on them. * The Diamond Star Amulet can only give 2 types of [[Passive Abilities|passives]], being Guiding Star and Star Shower.

The Supreme Star Amulet is the only Star Amulet added after the original release of Star Amulets. It was introduced in the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]], while the others were released in the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]]. *The Star Amulets used to require the gifted bee types in the player's [[hive]]. However, this was changed to only requiring discovering gifted bee types when the Supreme Star Amulet was added in the game.

  • The Supreme Star Amulet is the only Star Amulet that can have double passive abilities.

  • The Diamond Star Amulet is the only Star Amulet that has received a buff after its release. ** In the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]], Diamond Star Amulets got a 1/100 chance of getting a passive when generated.

The star of the Supreme Star Amulet passive abilities rotates counterclockwise around the player. The background audio of Supreme Star Amulet passive abilities plays 3 times for Gummy and Scorching star, 1.5 times for Pop star and 7 times for Star Saw.

  • An [[Ant Pass]] token is located behind the Supreme Star Amulet Generator. ** It used to be behind the Diamond Star Amulet Generator before the Supreme Star Amulet Generator took its place.

  • The Star Shower passive functions similarly to [[Science Bear|Science Bear's]] [[Beesmas Lights]]. The audio for obtaining a Star Amulet was the same audio for completing the [[Ready Player Two]] ROBLOX event (if the player has ALL the event badges). When the Star Shower Passive is activated, the big star that indicates the area that the stars will fall has a slightly stretched top. If a player dies while Scorching Star, Pop Star, or Gummy Star is active, the star will continue to hover wherever the player dies. It will be without the star’s model and will not follow the player, but it will still play its tune. It will also continue giving the buffs that the passive grants. If the player has between 490 billion and 500 billion honey, it is still possible to buy the offer of granting a guaranteed double passive on a Supreme Star Amulet, costing only 490 billion. In some cases, if the player has activated Pop Star and reaches the time limit, sometimes it will activate another Pop Star buff. However, it won't count the number of popped bubbles. The Diamond Star Amulet has a 1/1,000,000 chance of giving a Star Cub Skin.

docs.title: Star Hall
docs.text:
[[File:StarHall.PNG|thumb|268x268px|The entrance of the Star Hall.]] [[File:Starhall.png|thumb|271x271px|The interior of the Star Hall.]] The '''Star Hall''' is located on the roof of the [[Noob Shop]]. Players can reach it using the [[Parachute]] or the [[Glider]] after using a [[Red Cannon|cannon]]. They can also glide down from the [[Lion Bee Gate]]. If the player has enough [[System Page#Jump Power|Jump Power]], they can glide from the rock that is above [[Brown Bear]] to the edge of the Star Hall or jump off the top of the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] that is next to the [[Clover Field]], the player can also use the stockings decoration during beesmas and glide to the edge of the star hall.

Outside of the Star Hall, there is a [[Royal Jelly]] token to the right of the gate and a Green Cog with a [[Robo Pass]] token to the left of the gate. Inside, it has five types of [[Star Amulet]] Generators, an [[Ant Pass]] token (located behind the Supreme Star Amulet Generator), and the Royal Jelly Dispenser. '''Royal Jelly Dispenser''': Allows players to claim {{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}} per [[Gifted Bee]] in their [[hive]] and activates the [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste+]] boost. This boost lasts for exactly 60 seconds after using the machine. Naturally, players need at least one Gifted Bee in order to use the machine. It does not cost anything to use the machine, but there is a 22-hour cooldown. '''Bronze Star Amulet Generator''': Players must discover 5 Gifted Bee types (not gifted bees in hive) to use this machine. It costs 25 million [[honey]] to generate a Bronze Star Amulet. '''Silver Star Amulet Generator''': Players must discover 10 Gifted Bee types (not gifted bees in hive) to use this machine. It costs 50 million honey to generate a Silver Star Amulet. '''Gold Star Amulet Generator''': Players must discover 20 Gifted Bee types (not gifted bees in hive) to use this machine. It costs 250 million honey to generate a Gold Star Amulet. '''Diamond Star Amulet Generator''': Players must discover 30 Gifted Bee types (not gifted bees in hive) to use this machine. It costs 1 billion honey to generate a Diamond Star Amulet. '''Supreme Star Amulet Generator''': Players must discover 40 Gifted Bee types (not gifted bees in hive) to use this machine. It costs 10 billion honey to generate a Supreme Star Amulet and an option to spend 500 billion honey to guaranteed two Supreme Star Amulet [[Passive Abilities]].

== Music == [[File:Starhall.ogg]]

== Trivia == [[File:Antpassinstarhall.png|thumb|220x220px|The ant pass at the back of the Star Hall. Now behind the supreme star amulet generator.]] * The room gets its name from the [[music]] playing inside it: "[https://www.roblox.com/library/2062483297/starhall starhall]". * The cog outside the Star Hall is a hint to the in-game [[Codes|code]], "Cog". * This room contains 5 of the 6 Amulet Generators in the game, the last one being the [[Moon Amulet Generator]]. * Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the Royal Jelly Dispenser inside the Star Hall gave out {{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}} per Gifted Bee type, rather than the number of gifted bees you have. * Before the [[Updates#2020.04.06|4/6/2020 update]], the [[Ant Pass]] token used to be behind the Diamond Star Amulet Generator. This is because of how the Diamond Star Amulet Generator sat in the location of the Supreme Star Amulet generator before the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]]. * The Supreme Star Amulet Generator is currently the only Amulet Generator in the Star Hall that has not been released with the Star Hall itself, as the generator was released in the 6/6/2020 update. * In order to use the Supreme Star Amulet Generator, the player must discover at least 2 Gifted [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic]] bee types (if not counting [[Bear Bee]]),because there are only 38 non-mythic bee types (one Mythic bee type if including Bear Bee). * The sound pitch when creating a Star Amulet decreases when going up in tiers. * An ant pass can be found at the back of the Star Hall before the [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Updates#2020.06.06 6/06/2020] update * If the player jumps on top of the Supreme Star Amulet Generator, the player can partly glitch outside the roof.

docs.title: Star Treat
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Star Treat.png |description=Turns a bee into a Gifted bee! }} [[File:Giftedvectorbee.png|thumb|280px|The text that appears in the chat when a bee turns gifted via a treat.]]A {{Color|Star Treat}} is a special type of [[Treats|Treat]] that, when fed to a [[Bees|bee]], raises its [[bond]] by 1,000, along with the bee transforming into its [[Gifted Bee|gifted form]]. It is the only treat in the game which is guaranteed to turn a bee gifted. It is also one of the only ways to get gifted [[Bees/Event|Event bees]], including {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} and {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

== Ways to Obtain == * Buying it with {{Cost|Ticket|1,000}} inside the [[Ticket Tent]]. * Playing [[Memory Match#Night Memory Match|Night Memory Match]]/[[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]]/[[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]] (exceptionally rare). * Given by the [[Wind Shrine]] if you already have a [[Windy Bee]] after buying the [[Robux Shop|Windy Bee Pack]].

=== Drops === * An exceptionally rare drop from the [[Mondo Chick]], [[Coconut Crab]], and [[Fireflies]]. * Capturing [[Commando Chick]] for the 100th time guarantees a star treat. * An exceptionally low chance of dropping from [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteors]]. * An extremely rare drop from {{Cost|Festive Planter}}.

=== Quests === * Completing all of [[Onett|Onett's]] quests, [[Mother Bear|Mother Bear's]] quests, and [[Panda Bear|Panda Bear's]] quests. * Completing 750 [[Brown Bear]] quests rewards a star treat. Every 500 quests after the 750th Brown Bear quest also rewards a star treat. Additionally, his 1000th quest grants the player 5 Star Treats.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Buying the Gingerbread Cub Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] (1 if the player didn't have a cub buddy, 2 if they already had one.) * An extremely low chance of getting it from [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]]. * Completing the 15th [[Bee Bear]] quest rewards a star treat if the player already owns a cub buddy. * An exceptionally rare drop from [[Festive Nymph]]s. * An extremely rare drop from the [[Stockings]]. * By opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]: ** The [[Gift Boxes|Mondo Gift Box]] gave 1 star treat + other items during Beesmas 2020, 2021 and 2022. * Buying it from Bee Bear's Catalog for {{Cost|Snowflake|10,000}}. |}

== Trivia == * This and the {{Cost|Atomic Treat|4=0}} give the most [[bond]] (1,000 bond) out of any treat, followed by a single {{Cost|Neonberry|||0}} and {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} (500 bond), then {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} and {{Cost|Moon Charm}} (250 bond). * The star treat, along with {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}} are the only treats that cannot be obtained from sprouts. * The star treat formerly gave 100 bond instead of 1,000. * Feeding a Star Treat to a gifted [[Bear Bee]] has a 1/3 chance to spawn a Bear Bee Offer sticker.

docs.title: Stats
docs.text:
[[File:stats.jpg|thumb|The stats for a Basic Bee.]] [[File:Screenshot_2018-07-11_at_9.48.02_PM.png|thumb|A bee's level up page.]] ''This page is for stats that apply to bees. For stats that apply to the player, collecting pollen, and the [[hive]], see [[System Page]].'' '''Stats''' (short for statistics) refer to the aspects of each [[bee]] that are the basis for how that bee performs. Certain stats increase with higher [[bond|levels]].

== Rarity == '''Rarity''' refers to how often bees of each category can be expected to be generated from [[eggs]] or [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]]. Bees of greater rarity tend to be of higher stats and possessing their own unique ability, but rarity itself does not have any bearing on performance. An [[Bees/Event|Event]] tier of bees are aquired through their unique obtainment method.

== Color == '''Color''' affects a bee's ability to gather [[pollen]] from [[flowers]], improving their Gather Amount by 50% when collecting from flowers of a matching color. [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] and [[:Category:Red|Red]] are the only colors of bees that have this bonus. [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] bees do not experience any boost to Gather Amount, even from white flowers.

== Bond == '''[[Bond]]''' is a stat to determine if a bee has enough "experience" to level up. The following methods can affect experience:

  • Treats
  • Collecting Pollen
  • Bond from battle
  • Puppy Love
  • Digging in to the [[Beesmas Feast]] during Beesmas.

== Energy == '''[[Energy]]''' represents the number of times a bee will gather pollen from a flower and attack [[mobs]] before returning to the [[hive]] to rest (30 seconds to fully recharge upon entering the hive)

  • Spawning [[Ability Tokens]] does not cost a bee any energy
  • The energy of all bees in a swarm can be increased with stacks of ''[[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Polar Power]]'' from [[Polar Bear]]'s quests, or from an energy [[mutation]]
  • Energy is increased by 5% for each level above 1
  • Resetting yourself will cause bees to go back to the hive, but they will not recharge their energy
  • An ''energy reset'' can be achieved by reseting again when bees are inside of the hive after a prior reset

The formula for energy is: ''Base Energy * (1 + .05 * (Level - 1)) * Polar Power + Energy Mutation''

== Speed == '''Speed''', short for '''Bee Movespeed''', is how fast a bee moves and performs actions (contrary to its name). Speed indrectly affects all basic processes of a bee such as:

  • Gathering
  • Attacking
  • Sipping nectar in a planter
  • Converting at hive.

Bees move at approximately 1.5 times their move speed when not close to their owner and 0.5 of their move speed when returning to the hive to rest. The speed of all bees in a swarm can be increased by [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Ninja Bee|Ninja Bee's]] hive bonus, [[Ability Tokens#Beesmas Cheer|Beesmas Cheer]], [[Badges#Playtime Badge|Playtime Badge]], [[oil]], [[Super Smoothie|super smoothies]], and activating [[Passive Abilities#Coconut Haste|Coconut Haste]].

The formula for Bee Movespeed is: ''Base Bee Movespeed * (1 + .03 * (Level - 1)) * (1 + Ninja Bee Hive Bonus + Playtime Badge Bonus)''

== Attack == '''Attack''' is how much damage the bee will do when fighting mobs. Attack remains constant at all levels, but can be boosted through various [[:Category:Accessories|accessories]], [[items]], [[amulet]]s, certain [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|gifted hive bonuses]] and ability tokens. Gifted bees have 50% more attack.

The formula for a bee's Attack is: (Base Attack Damage + Attack Buffs) * Attack multiplier (* 1.5 If the bee is gifted)

== Gather Amount == '''Gather Amount''' describes how much pollen a bee will collect from a flower and how quickly it does so. The amount collected increases by 10% for each level above 1. Gather amount may be increased with; amulets, certain Gifted Bee bonuses, [[Robux Shop|Gamepasses,]] or items.

The formula for Gather Amount is: ''Base Gather Amount * (1 + .10 * (Level - 1)) * Gifted Multiplier''

== Production Amount == '''Production Amount''' describes how much pollen a bee will convert into [[honey]] at the hive and how quickly it does so. The amount converted increases by 10% for each level above 1.

The formula for Production Amount is: ''(Base Production Amount + Production Amount) * (1 + .10 * (Level - 1)) * Conversion Rate * Gifted Multiplier'' == Mutations == '''[[Mutation]]s''' are a bonus granted through feeding bitterberries to a bee when they are under the '''radioactive''' effect. Mutations can grant bonus:

  • Attack
  • Convert Amount
  • Gather Amount
  • Energy
  • Bee Ability Rate
  • Bee Movespeed
  • Critical Chance
  • Instant Conversion

== Gifted == '''[[Gifted Bee|Gifted]]''' is a bonus granted through feeding a bee's favourite treat, star treat, gingerbread bears, aged gingerbread bears. This stat grants:

  • Multiplier to gather amount, convert amount, and bee attack all together by 1.5x
  • Ability to spawn - [[[Ability Tokens|Inspire]]] tokens
  • A gifted hive bonus (only once for each bee)
  • A gifted ability (if the bee has one)
  • A new appearance

docs.title: Stick Bug Challenge
docs.text:
The '''Stick Bug Challenge''' is a boss fight feature that lasts 10 minutes. It is primarily activated when a player talks to [[Stick Bug]] and starts the challenge but can also initiate when a player begins [[Spirit Bear]]'s "Dancing With Stick Bug" [[Quests|quest]], when [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] chooses to activate it globally, and during [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas]] when completing Stick Bug's Beesmas quest or giving him a present. Starting the challenge by yourself requires having given a [[translator]] to Stick Bug, and either costs 50 [[ticket]]s or can be started for free once every 36 hours/1.5 days. The option to pay 50 tickets will be unavailable if the challenge can be started for free. The challenge takes place across the entire server and can be participated in by anyone. Giving a [[present]] to Stick Bug or starting the Egg Hunt quest will also start the challenge (if a translator has been given to Stick Bug). [[File:BB610AB5-580B-434C-841D-40796C058263.jpeg|thumb|200px|This message that pops up when Onett is about to start the Stick Bug Challenge.]]

When the challenge starts, a message in the chat appears, saying: {{Notification|Stickbug|⚠️ {Username} has started the Stick Bug Challenge! ⚠️|17}} Then, Stick Bug spawns in the [[Sunflower Field]]. If Onett summons Stick Bug, it would say: {{Notification|Stickbug|⚠️ Onett has started the Stick Bug Challenge! ⚠️|18}} During the challenge, Stick Bug moves around to different fields and fights players using various attacks. After players deal enough damage to Stick Bug, it will go to a different field, leaving a circle of rewards behind. When Stick Bug moves to different fields, it gains more health, becomes faster, gets better attacks (e.g. more [[Stick Nymph]]s will spawn) and gains a level. During the challenge, a brown window on the side of the screen shows how long the Stick Bug Challenge will be active, what level and which field Stick Bug is in, and how many points the player has obtained so far.

Stick Bug will only appear in the [[Sunflower Field]], [[Clover Field]], [[Strawberry Field]], [[Bamboo Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]] or [[Mountain Top Field]]. Stick Bug always starts in the Sunflower Field. When Stick Bug moves to a different field, a message in the chat will appear, saying:{{Notification|Stickbug|⚠️ Stick Bug's headed to the {Field Name}! ⚠️}}

==Attacks== Stick Bug will attack in many different ways.

===Normal Behavior and Sequence=== Stick Bug will run towards one of the players in the field regularly and before initiating an attack. Getting hit by him will deal damage to the player. Stick Bug's movement speed, his stick nymphs, and his speed in using his attacks increase with his level. He uses a fixed sequence of attacks, with the arrangement of: * Splinter Trap * Spinners * Flailing Sticks * Summon Stick Nymphs * Stick Totem * Flailing Sticks * Hide * Stick Flail Stick Bug uses certain attacks when he reaches certain levels. But he will use the attack in the same pattern.

===Flailing Sticks=== Stick Bug moves with /e dance, and a large red warning circle appears around him with a radius of about 6 [[flowers]], after a few seconds, he will flail sticks and deal damage (Damage scales from his level). Flails only deal damage by one time and the player cannot be damaged by the same flail again. After a moment, he will summon a few [[Stick Nymph]]s around himself. The number of Stick Nymphs deployed depends on the emote he used. He will either use: /e dance /e dance2 */e point

===Stick Nymphs=== {{Main|Stick Nymph}} Stick Bug moves with /e dance3 and a large red warning circle appears with a radius of about 6 flowers. After a few seconds, he will wave, and a horde of stick nymphs are summoned inside the red circle. The movement speed, amount of stick nymphs spawned, and the stick nymphs' level are based on Stick Bug's level, increasing as he has higher levels.

If the player had completed Stick Bug's beesmas quest past 2020, there is a chance that he will instead summon a special variant called [[Festive Nymph]]s. They have the same attributes as normal stick nymphs but drop better loot.

===Spinners=== 3 or 4 (depending on Stick Bug's level) red warning circles appear on the field, they will always be located near the corners of the field, and the spinners have a radius of about 3 flowers. After a while, he will deploy rotating one-bladed flails on the red circles, the speed of the rotations gradually increases as Stick Bug levels up. As Stick Bug reaches higher levels, he will initiate this attack more than once, stacking more than a single blade in a single spot at once. The deployed flails disappear after a while.

===Hiding=== After his attack sequence is finished, he will stand still and hide in the field. He becomes 2 dimensional and can be seen by shadows in the flowers. Stick Bug cannot be targetable in this phase; to get him out of the 2d form, players must collect pollen in the affected flowers on his 2d forms. The requirement increases by his level. After putting it down to 0, he will become 3d again and stand still before restarting his attack sequence.

===Splinter Trap=== [[File:Splinter Trap.png|thumb|155px|The Splinter Trap effect on the player.]] Upon hiding, Stick Bug leveling up, or during a level 12+ Stick Bug. Stick Bug stands still for a short time and uses /e point, after that. Players who contributed to attacking Stick Bug during the current level will become targeted by this attack and get put on by a splinter trap on top of their head/s. The Splinter trap decreases the players' movespeed and jump power by 25% and damages the player by 3 per second.

When a player is trapped in twigs, they will receive a message in the chat, saying:{{Notification|Vicious|You've been trapped in twigs! Collect pollen to remove them.|16}} Note that the splinter trap icon is the same as the [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste+]] icon.

===Defense Totem=== When Stick Bug reaches level 6 and above, Stick Bug will build a defense totem based on a nearby field. When the totem is active, Stick Bug receives 25% defense, decreasing the damage he receives by the same amount. Stick Bug can stack them up to 3 times (75% defense) and will not use this attack when there are 3 consecutive totems active. To destroy the totem, the player/s must collect pollen in the field of the defense totem. Upon destroying a totem, the totem will drop rewards. Dropping: {| class="article-table" |- |{{Cost|Honey}}{{Cost|Treat}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly}}{{Cost|Gumdrops}}{{Cost|Pineapple}}{{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}{{Cost|Oil}}{{Cost|Enzymes}} |}

Stick Bug builds a totem in the following fields. Note that the fields he summons the totems are based on the field he is currently standing in: [[Mushroom Field]] [[Dandelion Field]] [[Blue Flower Field]] [[Spider Field]] [[Stump Field]] [[Pine Tree Forest]] *[[Rose Field]] A server-wide message is sent when he uses this attack, saying: {{Notification|Stickbug|⚠️ Stick Bug has built a Defense Totem in the {Field Name}! ⚠️|15}}

== Path== After Stick Bug's health is depleted, it will drop loot and then move to another field. The field that Stick Bug moves on to next depends on the field it is currently in. These are all the possible outcomes. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" !Current Field !Possible Fields to go |- |Sunflower Field |Clover FieldStrawberry Field |- |Clover Field |Sunflower FieldBamboo Field |- |Strawberry Field |Sunflower FieldBamboo FieldCactus FieldPumpkin Patch |- |Bamboo Field |Clover FieldPineapple Patch |- |Pineapple Patch |Bamboo FieldMountain Top Field |- | Cactus Field |Strawberry FieldPumpkin PatchMountain Top Field |- | Pumpkin Patch |Strawberry FieldCactus FieldMountain Top Field |- |Mountain Top Field |Sunflower FieldClover FieldBamboo FieldStrawberry FieldPineapple PatchCactus FieldPumpkin Patch |} == Tips== In this section, there will be some tips to progress further in the Stick Bug Challenge.

Make sure there are no mobs to distract the players' bees, like the [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]], before starting the challenge. * Level up your bees. Bees with a lower level than Stick Bug would most likely miss its attacks. Try to get as many strong players on the server as possible. A way of communicating with other players, like voice chat, can be used. The more players that are doing the challenge, the faster Stick Bug will level up. Stickbug has a pattern after landing on a field, which is Flailing sticks then attacking the player. Level 12+ Stickbug has a different pattern than Level 1-11 , doing 2 Spinner attacks first then attacking the player. Try to use most optimal paths to save time traveling between fields. The Bamboo Glitch can help stun the stickbug. To do this, go to the stairs in Bamboo. Certain equipment can be very useful in the challenge. Many gears boost bee attack in some way. The [[Fire Mask|Fire]] and [[Demon Mask]]s boost multiple helpful stats, like bee attack and defense, as well as spawning many flames with their passives. The [[Gummy Mask]]'s Gummy Morph passive greatly boosts [[Gummy Bee]]'s stats, including attack. The [[Dark Scythe]] can create Dark Flames, which boost Super-Crit Power. The flames themselves also deal more damage. ** The [[Coconut Canister]] has two useful passives, being Inspire Coconuts and Emergency Coconut Shield. When activating the Emergency Coconut Shield, it grants 100% defense and x1.25 bee attack for a few seconds. Try to make the most of these boosts, like using the invincibility to escape or using the increased attack to do lots of damage. It should be activated later on in the challenge. Activating it early would be a waste. Before the Stick Bug Challenge, the shield should be intentionally activated so that there is no risk of it activating early. The [[Glider]] and boots can help with navigating the map or escaping tough situations. The [[Coconut Clogs]]/[[Gummy Boots]]' Coconut Haste Surge can prove useful in a pinch. There are many bees that are recommended for the Stick Bug Challenge. Some bees, like [[Lion Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], [[Spicy Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]] and [[Windy Bee]] have high attack stats, passive or abilities that do lots of damage. Vicious Bee, Windy Bee and Spicy Bee abilities are helpful for dealing with both Stick Bug and Stick Nymphs as they deal damage to every mob within their range. [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Ability_Tokens#Impale Impale] abillity can be used the moment Stick Nymphs are summoned to increase it's efficiency. [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Ability_Tokens#Tornado Tornado] pathing can't be controlled, but you still can lure Sticks Nymphs into it. *Bees with helpful gifted hive bonuses like [[Brave Bee]], [[Looker Bee]], [[Commander Bee]], [[Rage Bee]], [[Brave Bee]] or [[Precise Bee]] will increase damage output. Certain abilities from bees can grant useful buffs. Precise Bee's Target Practice can boost Super-Crit Chance. Multiple bees have Focus, which boosts Critical Chance. Music Bee's Melody boosts Critical Power. Rage Bee and Spicy Bee have Rage, which boosts attack. Haste-producing bees are also helpful in traversing the map and dodging attacks. Flame Heat gives additional +5% to +25% Bee Attack Digital Bee's [[Ability Tokens|Mind Hack]] can stun the Nymphs and Stick Bug. *All [[Gifted Bee|gifted bees]] have x1.5 attack over their non-gifted counterparts. Certain mutations can grant attack or ability rate bonuses. Certain beequips can grant useful bonuses or abilities. * Many items can be used to further enhance helpful stats. Using {{Cost|Stinger}} will boost bee attack by 1.5x for 30 seconds. Using stingers activates Star Saw, which can deal lots of damage to both Stick Bug and the Stick Nymphs. *The player can use {{Cost|Oil}} to increase movespeed, and {{Cost|Tropical Drink}} to increase the chance for critical hits, each for 10 minutes. {{Cost|Super Smoothie}} can also be used for both improved buffs and an additional +1% Super-Crit Chance. {{Cost|Coconut}} will deal lots of damage when landing on Stick Bug or any Stick Nymphs. Besides using the coconut item, the two Coconut Canister passives can also summon coconuts. Try to save {{I|Invigorating Nectar}}[[Nectar|Invigorating Nectar]] for an additional x1.01 to x1.10 bee attack. The bee attack depends on how much time the nectar has left. When Stick Bug builds a defense totem on a nearby field, send the teammate(s) who can deal with it the fastest. For example, if a totem is built in the Blue Flower Field, the player with the best blue pollen collection should be sent to take the totem down. If the defense totem is in the Stump Field, send somebody who has taken down the [[Stump Snail]] recently instead of somebody with a Stump Snail still in the field. Stick bug totems can be safely dealt with when Stick Bug hides into flowers, as in this state it's not able to build more and Stick Nymphs are very likely to despawn by player's return to field. One teammate can try to lure the Stick Nymphs away from the other players so that their bees will not be distracted by them. Place [[sprinklers]] in the field in which Stick Bug is currently in. Since flowers (especially in low-level fields) tend to "drain" quickly, this puts players at risk of dying from the Splinter Trap or losing time when Stick Bug is hiding in flower patches. [[Clouds]] can also help with flower regeneration. Lag may be an issue for players, so making optimizations, like reducing the graphic settings, could help in the challenge. Stand at higher areas like the ramp at the [[Pumpkin Patch]]. Stick Nymphs will not be able to reach these places, and most of Stick Bug's attacks will not hit. [[Sticker Stack]] may be useful for challenge, if it has Bee Movespeed, Critical Power, Super Crit Power or Bee Attack buffs, otherwise it would be insignificant. Vector Bee and Precise Bee can help a lot with pollen collection when stickbug it's in 2d form. * * * * *

==Points and Health per Level== Points earned are equal to the amount of damage dealt to Stick Bug multiplied by its level squared (for example, 2,000 damage against a level 6 Stick Bug would be worth 2,000 * 6 * 6 = 72,000 points). Sometimes the player may gain a few extra points.

==Trivia == * There is a glitch that when Stick Bug runs into the walls of the ramp next to the Bamboo Field, he will get stuck and not be able to move, then teleport back into the field after a few seconds. Players can use this to their advantage and deal extra damage to Stick Bug without risk of dying. There is another, similar glitch where Stick Bug will hit the boundary right up against the [[Clover Field]] and fall over for a couple seconds. If the challenge ends during the [[Day/Night Cycle|night]], normal [[music]] will start to play instead of the night music. * The splinter trap icon is the same as the Haste+ icon. When beginning the quest "Dancing With Stick Bug" a Stick Bug Challenge will begin saying "⚠ {Username} has started the Stick Bug Challenge! ⚠", opposed to saying that Spirit Bear began the challenge. Even when the player beginning the quest "Dancing With Stick Bug" has completed Stick Bug's Beesmas Quest, Festive Nymphs will not spawn. The second in-game message that played before the first Stick Bug Challenge was "Stick Bug will spawn in the Sunflower Field. Work together to defeat him and level him up. The higher the level, the better the rewards." If players join a server that has already started the challenge, the stat file will say Stick Bug is level 1, but when Stick Bug is defeated again, the level in the stat file will return to normal. Giving [[Stick Bug]] a present will start a Stick Bug Challenge. Completing Stick Bug's Beesmas 2020/2021/2024 Summer and Winter quests will also start a Stick Bug Challenge. There is a [[Glitches#Invisible Splinter Trap|glitch]] where if the player dies while having the splinter trap activated, it will still keep the effect and damage the player until they die again. **The pollen counter is still there though, and you can remove them by collecting pollen, it is just invisible. * When Stick Bug jumps to another field, it maintains its hitbox and can still damage players.

''This page is for the Stick Bug NPC. For attack behaviour and the actual challenge, please see [[Stick Bug Challenge]].'' {{Mob |title = Stick Bug |image =Stick_Bug_Transparent_PNG.png |location = On top of the tallest mushroom in the [[Mushroom Field]]. |timer = Every 36 hours or anytime with 50 tickets |hp = Increases by level |damage = Increases by level |level=1 - No Limit }} '''Stick Bug''' is a [[:Category:NPC|NPC]] found on the tallest mushroom in the [[Mushroom Field]], next to the [[Top Stick Bug Fighters]] Leaderboard. It is accessible by using the [[Red Cannon]]/[[Yellow Cannon]]/[[Blue Cannon]] with the [[Parachute]]/[[Glider]], or using the [[Beekeeper's Boots]] and jumping from the second mushroom to the one with the {{Cost|Royal Jelly|4=0}}. Players will need a {{Cost|Translator|4=0}} to talk to Stick Bug, where they can then ask it to start the [[Stick Bug Challenge]]. Stick Bug then appears as a boss [[Mobs|mob]] and always spawns in the [[Sunflower Field]] first. Upon defeat, it flees to a random field from this list: * [[Sunflower Field]] * [[Clover Field]] * [[Strawberry Field]] * [[Bamboo Field]] * [[Pineapple Patch]] * [[Cactus Field]] * [[Pumpkin Patch]] * [[Mountain Top Field]]

The player can start the Stick Bug Challenge for free every 1 and a half days (1d, 12hr),or by initiating it anytime for 50 [[Ticket]]s, or by giving Stick Bug a [[Present]] during the 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2024 Beesmas Event.

When the challenge ends, the player will be awarded an [[Stick Bug Amulet|amulet]] depending on their score (''More information in the [[Stick Bug Amulet]] page'').
