If this occurs, it will either be in the [[Dandelion Field]], the Mushroom Field, or somewhere in between. ** Another glitch is on the [[Brave Bee Gate]] ramp, where walking to the bottom of the ramp and on the corner of the Bamboo Field will cause Stick Bug to briefly get stuck there when it tries to follow the player. * In Beesmas 2019, Stick Bug gave the most honey when given a present ({{Cost|Honey|33,333,333}}), the next being [[Panda Bear]] at only {{Cost|Honey|5,000}}. * If Stick Bug moves to the Mountain Top Field, it has a chance of falling and getting stuck in the Pineapple Patch or Pumpkin Patch. * Stick Bug and Wild Windy Bee are the only mobs that are impossible to kill, as depleting all of their HP will only level them up and regain their HP. * Stick Bug waves when the challenge ends. * Stick Bug is one of the three NPCs that requires a translator to interact with, the others being [[Gifted Riley Bee]] and [[Gifted Bucko Bee]]. * Stick Bug's boss fight theme became part of the popular bait-and-switch meme "Get stickbugged lol", which spread far from the BSS Community. ** Stick Bug is aware of this meme, indicated by his Beesmas 2020 dialogue for receiving a present. * In [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] dialogue, she states that Stick Bug scared her as a cub, which indicates that Stick Bug has been around for a long time. * Stick Bug's Beesmas 2022 Quest originally gave {{Cost|Caustic Wax|1}}, no {{Cost|Swirled Wax}}, no {{Cost|Ticket Planter}}, and {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|1}}. This was soon buffed to {{Cost|Caustic Wax|3}}, {{Cost|Swirled Wax|1}}, {{Cost|Ticket Planter|1}}, and {{Cost|Invigorating Vial|2}}. * As stated by [[Spirit Bear]], Stick Bug loves [[Pineapple|pineapples]]. * Stick Bug is the only NPC, who needs a [[translator]], but he doesnt give permanent quests. * During [[Updates#2024.07.17|Beesmas 2024]], [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] would start a Festive [[Stick Bug Challenge]] at random every few days. * During the [[Updates#2019.04.17|Egg Hunt 2019 Event Update]], Stick Bug would plant an Epic, Legendary, and Supreme Sprout after finishing its [[Egg Hunt 2019|Egg Hunt]] quest. ** This makes Stick Bug the only NPC able to spawn sprouts. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Multiplayer Bosses]] [[Category:NPC]] [[Category:Quest Giver]] [[Category:Stick Bug Challenge]] [[Category:Requires Translator]] [[Category:Starter Zone]]

docs.title: Stick Nymph
docs.text:
[[File:Stick bug fly.png|thumb|A Stick Nymph]] [[File:Sticknymph.png|thumb|A Stick Nymph from the side.]] The '''Stick Nymph''' is a [[Mobs|Mob]] that is summoned by [[Stick Bug]] during the [[Stick Bug Challenge]].

Stick Nymphs will follow the player closest to them and will deal damage if they touch a player. Despite their low stats, Stick Nymphs are almost always in large groups, often overpowering weaker players.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |50 |- |2 | 70 |- |3 |110 |- |4 |170 |- |5 |250 |- |6 |350 |- |7 |470 |- |8 |590 |- |9 | 730 |- |10 | 870 |- | 11 |1,050 |- |12 |1,210 |- |13 |1,410 |- |14 | 1,610 |- |15 |1,810 |- |16 |2,030 |- | 17 |2,270 |- |18 |2,510 |- |19 |2,770 |- | 20 | 3,030 |- |21 |3,270 |- |22 |3,570 |- | 23 |3,870 |- |24 |4,170 |- |25 |4,490 |- |26 |4,790 |} == Drops ==

Stick Nymphs will drop 5 random tokens in a pentagonal formation when defeated.Rewards can include:

  • {{Cost|Honey}} calculated by the formula 200x, with x being the stick nymph's level.
  • {{Cost|Gumdrops}}.
  • {{Cost|Pineapple}}.
  • {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.
  • {{Cost|Treat}}.
  • {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}}.
  • {{Cost|Oil|||0}} (Rare).
  • {{Cost|Magic Bean|||0}} (Rare).
  • {{Cost|Enzymes|||0}} (Rare).
  • {{Cost|Star Jelly}} (Very Rare).
  • [[Sticker|Walking Stick Nymph Sticker]] (Extremely Rare)

==Gallery == Tons of level 3 4 stick nymphs.PNG|The health bars of a group of levels 3, 4, and 5 Stick Nymphs. Screen Shot 2021-04-29 at 9.13.41 PM.png|Stick Nymphs below a player. Basix updore.PNG|Stick Nymphs featured in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25]] update thumbnail. File:StickNymphUnderMap.png|A Stick Nymph under the Pineapple Patch.

==Trivia==

Stick Nymphs can follow the player out of the [[Fields|Field]] and can either go through some objects, be obstructed by them, or go into certain locations, such as the [[King Beetle Lair|King Beetle's Lair]], which is not always the same as what the player cannot go through. This can allow the player to exploit them and deal damage from afar. Stick Nymphs, just like [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]] and the [[Festive Nymph]]s, lose health every second, Mondo Chick always loses 333 health per second, but Stick Nymphs and Festive Nymph's health devours faster when their level is higher, and is possible to be defeated naturally unlike Mondo Chick who only has 300 health left when reaching 15 minutes. If their health drains to 0 without the players, they still will drop rewards. Stick Nymphs can jump, but if you get on a platform higher enough where they couldn't reach you and away enough from them, they cannot jump into you. Stick Nymphs and Festive Nymph are the only mobs that can be summoned by another mob. These are two of 18 mobs that cannot spawn naturally, as in the player cannot simply walk in a field and fight it, the other mobs being the five types of [[Ants]], [[Snowbear]], Stick Bug, the five [[Robo Bear Challenge]] Mobs, and the four [[Robo Party]] mobs. Stick Nymphs were the first mob to drop tokens upon defeat. Stick Bug doesn't count because Stick Bug is impossible to defeat, as knocking Stick Bug down to 0 health will only raise its level by 1 point and reset its health to full in the process. Whenever Stick Nymphs spawn in the [[Strawberry Field]], there is a glitch where they can go up the ramp. *Stick Nymphs may take away some health upon respawning after the player's death if there are large amounts of them on your body. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Stick Bug Challenge]]

==Trivia == The Sticker Planter continuously alternates between different colors, which can be tuned down in the [[Settings]]. Out of the four single-use planters, the Sticker Planter is the only one of them to have a cap of 25. This, the {{Cost|Ticket Planter|4=1}} and the{{Cost|Paper Planter|4=1}} share the same base models. They also share the same outline for their decals. It is tied with the Ticket Planter for the second-best Nectar multiplier in the game, behind the [[Festive Planter]] at x3. It is one of four single-use planters in the game, the others being the Festive Planter, the Ticket Planter and the Paper Planter. This and the Ticket Planter are the only planters that will always spawn a [[Puffshroom]] at full growth. **Additionally, this is the only planter to always spawn at least a Rare Puffshroom. {{Planters}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Planter]] [[Category:Consumables]]

{{Inaccurate}} [[File:StickerPrinter.png|The Sticker Printer.|alt=The Sticker Printer.|thumb]] The '''Sticker Printer''' is a machine past the [[Lion Bee Gate]]. It is located to the right of the Instant Converter next to the [[Mountain Top Field]]. The Sticker Printer costs [[egg]]s (excluding Bee Specific Eggs) to print [[stickers]].

==Mechanics== The printer can print stickers depending on the type of egg donated, and the quality of the type of stickers from the printer is also affected by the type of the egg inserted. The types of [[Sticker#Sticker Index (being finished 1/13/24-1/14/24)|Hive Skin]], [[Sticker|Cub Skin]] or [[Sticker]] chances can be checked when clicking on an egg before using it to print a sticker.

The Printer will print one sticker upon use and has a cooldown of 1 hour before it can be used again. File:StickerPrinterMenu.png|The menu of the Sticker Printer. File:Sticker printer animation.gif|The Sticker Printer spinning.

docs.title: Sticker Stack
docs.text:
[[File:The sticker stack while activated..jpg|thumb|The Sticker Stack while activated]] [[File:Smile sticker icon.png|thumb|The icon located on top of the Sticker Stack.]]The '''Sticker Stack''' is located in the [[Honey Bee Gate|15 Bee Zone]] next to the [[Pine Tree Forest]] and the [[Honey Bee (NPC)]]. It allows players to donate a [[Sticker#Sticker Index (being finished 1/13/24-1/14/24)|Sticker]], Hive Skin, [[Cub Buddy|Cub Skin]] or Voucher and receive a boost and item depending on the sticker you donated. The boost lasts for 15 minutes (+10 seconds for every sticker donated, maximum 1 hour.) Each type of sticker can only be donated once.

== Usage == To use the Sticker Stack, step into the podium in front of it and open the menu. The player can then choose to either pay 25 tickets or use a sticker that hasn't been stacked yet to activate the stack. Both ways lead to activating the sticker stack, granting the sticker stack buff with the duration and buffs depending on the past stacked stickers (15-minute base duration with an extra 10 seconds for each sticker stacked, 1-hour maximum duration). Stacking an unused sticker for activating the machine will grant a new buff depending on the stacked sticker and an extra 10 seconds duration to the buff permanently for future activations and the sticker that was stacked cannot be used to stack again. Upon stacking a sticker, the player will be granted rewards also depending on the sticker stacked.

docs.title: Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine
docs.text:
''This article is about the quest giver. For the tool, see [[Sticker-Seeker]].''

[[File:StickerQuest Giver.png|thumb|209px|The Sticker Quest Giver and the Sticker-Seeker leaderboard.]] The '''Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine''' is a [[Quest Givers|quest giver]] in the [[Hive Hub]]. To interact with it, the player must own and have the [[Sticker-Seeker]] equipped. {{Hover|The player must also have a total of 15 bees hatched to interact with the machine.|Note that the player can enter the Hive Hub without any bees by joining a friend, but the machine itself requires the player to have 15 bees to be interactable.}}

It has infinite quests, but only has confirmed milestone rewards until quest 600.

== Quests == Obtaining and turning in [[Quests]] from this quest giver require the player to have the Sticker-Seeker equipped. Usually, 3 requirements are given, but starting at rank 100, there are always 4.

For the requirements listed below, let ''X'' represent the player's rank, or the number of quests completed plus one (with lowercase x representing the player's rank - 1), and ''Z'' be the number of Stickers from whatever requirement the player has to obtain. These are all of the possible requirements: {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Quest !Requirements |- |🔎 Sticker-Seeker: Rank ''X'' | * Find 2 \times (1.045)^x (rounded to the nearest integer; capped off at 5, 6 on rank 500+) [[Sticker#Seeker Stickers|Seeker Stickers]] Hidden ''[sic]'' in [any number of any bee zones, which can also include shops, or HQ's]. (Guaranteed) * Collect 98534.26 \times (1.01488)^x with the [[Sticker-Seeker]]. (Guaranteed) * A random number of requirements from the following. The number of requirements given starts at 1, and increases by 1 every 100 quests (these requirements also increase every 150 quests): ** Collect 2 \times (1.014)^x (rounded to the nearest whole integer) [[Sticker|Rainbow Sticker Tokens]]. ** Collect ''Z'' Stickers spawned by your [[Tools|Tool]] while Gathering. ** Collect ''Z'' Stickers found by your [[Bees]] while Gathering. ** Collect ''Z'' Stickers from [[Puffshroom]]s. ** Collect ''Z'' Stickers from [[Planter]]s. ** Collect ''Z'' Stickers from HQs. ** Collect ''Z'' Stickers from [[Sprout]]s. ** Collect a Sticker from [[Leaves]]. ** Collect a Sticker from [[Fireflies]]. ** Collect a Sticker from [[Wild Windy Bee]]. (A sticker found by a tamed [[Windy Bee]] also works.) ** Collect a Sticker from the [[Public Sticker Board]]. ** Collect ''Z'' Rainbow Sticker Tokens. ** Donate ''Z'' Stickers to the Public Sticker Board. ** Print ''Z'' Stickers with the [[Sticker Printer]]. ** Discard ''Z'' Stickers. *Add [''X''/2] Stickers to the [[Sticker Stack]]. (Guaranteed every 10th rank.) |}

== Ranks == A player's rank is the amount of Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine's quests they have completed. Ranks are also the way the [[Top Sticker-Seekers]] leaderboard is measured, and increases every time a player completes a quest. The higher the rank, the better the rewards. For example, a player is more likely to get Sticker Planters when they have achieved further ranks than players with a Rank of 5. Quest requirement amounts also scale to the ranks.

== Rewards == Every quest reward always includes {{Cost|Honey}}, a {{Cost|Ticket|||0}}, {{Cost|Royal Jelly}}, and a random [[Sticker]], as well as many other possible rewards, including {{Cost|Sticker Planter}} (in which you are guarenteed one every 111 quests and a random chance to get an one on normal quest) or [[Balloon]]s. Both are determined by the Rank, or number of quests the player has completed. Every once in a while, the player reaches a Rank milestone, which rewards an [[Egg]], like a {{Cost|Silver Egg|||0}} at the 25th Rank completion. It has a very low chance to give a basic color hive, but it is possible in any rank.

{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !Rank !Milestone Reward |- |25 |{{Cost|Silver Egg|||0}} |- |50 |{{Cost|Gold Egg|||0}} |- |75 |{{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} |- |100 |{{Cost|Gifted Silver Egg|||0}} |- |150 |{{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|||0}} |- |200 |{{Cost|Gifted Diamond Egg|||0}} |- |300 |{{Cost|Mythic Egg|||0}} |- |400 |{{Cost|Star Egg|||0}} |- |500 |{{Cost|Gifted Mythic Egg|||0}} |- |600 |{{Cost|Gifted Silver Egg|3}} |}

== Gallery == File:Sticker Seeker Quest interaction with no bees.jpg|thumb|The 15 bee requirement (shown after you get Sticker Seeker) on the Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine.

== Trivia == * It is the only [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]] that does not have any dialogue and does not notify to talk to the Machine again after quest completion. * The Sticker Quest Giver is the fourth randomized [[Quest Givers|Quest Giver]] to give [[egg]]s at certain milestones, the other three being [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Brown Bear]]. * The quests it gives always includes the requirements "Collect {amount} of Pollen using [[Sticker-Seeker]]," and "Find 2-7 Seeker-Stickers hidden in {zones}." * Sometimes, a quest requirement can get so long you can’t see part of it. ** Progressing in the requirement a bit may fix this problem. * When having the Sticker-Seeker equipped and standing on the pad with the machine in front of it, normally there is a message saying “Your Sticker-Seeker quest is in progress…” (if you have not yet completed the quest). However, after standing on the pad for a few seconds, it changes to the next egg reward, and at what rank you will obtain it. * The Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine has 8 Stickers on it. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Hive Hub]] [[Category:Quest Giver]]

docs.text:
A '''Sticker''' is a collectible item added in the [[Updates#2024.01.12|01/12/2024 update]]. They can be placed on the player's [[hive]] by dragging them from the [[Sticker Book]] as cosmetics, stacked on the [[Sticker Stack]], [[Trading|traded]] for other stickers, [[Beequip]]s, and/or hive skins and for the beesmas quests.

Each sticker has a unique method of obtainment. Certain stickers are awarded from achievements, which can only be accomplished once per player, while others spawn on walls around the map, are obtained by the [[Sticker Printer]], and many other ways.

Stickers will not activate their stack boosts when placed on a hive and can only be added once to the Sticker Stack.

There is a limit of 50 stickers on a hive at once, and you cannot place stickers on the spawn pad, or bee section of your hive.

==Sticker Book== [[File:Sticker Book UI.png|thumb|The Sticker Book menu, with the base amount of capacity.]] [[File:Smile sticker icon.png|thumb|The icon for the Sticker Book.]] The Sticker Book can be found at the top of the inventory, and holds every sticker the player obtains. On the top right, you can view either the [[#Sticker Inbox|inbox]] or [[#Sticker Index|index]]. Below this, there are options to upgrade capacity, "Peel All" (peels all hive stickers on the player's hive), and "Sort" (sorts out the stickers by the order they appear in the Sticker Index).

Each slot can hold one sticker. Clicking on a sticker reveals a popup to the right of the book containing details about the sticker. This includes the name, sticker type, total number of that type of sticker in the book, if it's in the [[Sticker Stack]], the description, the Stack Boost, and the Stack Reward. From there, you can also choose to discard the sticker, which removes it from the Sticker Book permanently, or you can choose to peel if off of your [[Hive]]. The peel button will be disabled if the sticker is not on the player's hive. The popup can be closed with the exit button or by clicking the sticker again, but the sticker will still be selected. When a sticker is selected, an X appears in the top left corner of the sticker icon, giving the player another method to discard the sticker. Stickers can be moved by dragging a sticker to another slot. If there is already a sticker in that slot, the two stickers will be swapped.

===Storage=== Every player starts off with 16 slots to fill and can obtain additional slots by purchasing/upgrading them with [[ticket]]s, giving an additional 8 slots each upgrade. The slots can be increased to up to 400 slots.

Each time upgrading also increases the upgrade cost. Starting from 20 tickets on the first upgrade, and keep increasing until reaching the cost limit: 1,000 tickets (at which point player is currently at 112 slots or higher).

This table below lists the cost (in tickets) for each storage upgrade and each with the total/cumulated costs from all previous upgrades. '''''Do note that this table only lists up until 120 slots, in which every upgrade after that cost 1,000 tickets. If you want to find the total cost for the upgrades beyond, you can use the following formula:([slots-112]\times 125)+4420 (number of slots must not be less than 112)''''' {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ style="white-space:nowrap;" | Extra Slots Costs !{{Cost|Ticket}} !Total Cost !Total Storage |- |20 |20 |24 |- |50 |70 |32 |- |90 |160 |40 |- |140 |300 |48 |- |200 |500 |56 |- |270 |770 |64 |- |350 |1,120 |72 |- |440 |1,560 |80 |- |540 |2,100 |88 |- |650 |2,750 |96 |- |770 |3,520 |104 |- |900 |4,420 |112 |- |1,000 |5,420 |120+ |- |}

===Sticker Inbox=== If all the slots are filled up, every sticker obtained will instead be added to the inbox. Stickers in the inbox ''cannot'' be placed on the hive and public sticker board, donated to the Sticker Stack, or traded. The inbox contains 200 slots, and this number ''cannot'' be changed. The inbox works the same as the [[Beequip]] inbox, allowing for players to store their 200 most recent stickers for a 48-hour time period before they are discarded automatically and permanently. If a player does not want a certain sticker to be deleted, they have to remove a sticker from their sticker book in order to keep the sticker or upgrade their slots to hold more. Stickers on the hive ''do not'' count toward an empty slot. To remove a sticker from your sticker book or sticker inbox, click on the box the sticker is in and click the discard button.

===Sticker Index=== The Sticker Index contains every sticker, Cub Skin, and Hive Skin in the game, and documents whether or not one is in the [[Sticker Stack]]. If a sticker has been placed in the Sticker Stack, it will have a green checkmark (✅) at the bottom right of its icon, and in the sticker's popup its "In Stack" status will be changed to "Yes". If you discard a stacked sticker from your sticker book, it will still remain stacked in the index.

{{StickerIndex}}

==Hidden Stickers== [[File:Hiddensticker.png|thumb|A Rubber Duck Sticker hidden right behind [[Onett]].]] Some stickers can spawn around the map and are able to be collected by clicking on them. Along with the sticker itself, they also reward 1 [[ticket]] when collected.

Hidden stickers spawn daily, and last for 7 days before despawning. The maximum number of hidden stickers on the map at once is dependent on the player's bees, ranging from 1 sticker at 0 bees to 7 stickers at 40 bees.

===Seeker Stickers=== Seeker Stickers are a special type of hidden sticker which appear around various locations of the map. They are only visible while the [[Sticker-Seeker]] is equipped, and obtainable while a [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine]] quest is active. They are also usually easier to find than regular hidden stickers, as they can even be next to each other, but they can be in the same spot as the ''hidden'' stickers. The number that spawn and where depend on the requirements of the quest. They do not give rewards when collected, but progress [[Sticker-Seeker Quest Machine|Sticker-Seeker]] quests with rainbow notification appears saying "You found a hidden Sticker-Seeker! Just ''X'' more to go." Or if all of them have been found, "You found all of the hidden Seeker-Stickers!"

== Trivia== Many stickers and their descriptions are direct references to things not present in Bee Swarm Simulator. The Auryn Sticker makes reference to the 1984 film "[[Wikipedia:The NeverEnding Story (film)|The Neverending Story]]", based on the 1979 novel "[[Wikipedia:The Neverending Story|The Neverending Story]]" by Michael Ende- which has an amulet with the same name. The image, however, is exclusive to the film, as the image used in the book (and on the cover and jacket of the original hard cover) is a simple oval made of two snakes eating each other's tails. Because of this, the Sticker also makes a possible reference to "Natro Macro", a popular macro which uses the same symbol as Auryn; hinting at how the use of Natro Macro is probably the most common method of the sticker's achievement. The Banana Painting is a direct reference to the 1967 album ''The Velvet Underground & Nico,'' which has this picture as its album cover. The cover is a painting by Andy Warhol (whose signature can be seen in the lower right corner). The first track on the album is called "Sunday Morning". Some stickers are references to famous ROBLOX games, those being: Waving Townsperson - ''Welcome To Bloxburg!'', Interrobang Block - ''Lucky Blocks'', Cop And Robber - ''Jailbreak'', Grey shape companion - the ''Pet Simulator'' series, Orphan Dog - ''Adopt Me!'', Evil Pig - ''Piggy,'' Theatrical Intruder - ''Break In (Story)'', Desperate Booth - ''Pls Donate,'' Pizza Delivery Man - ''Work at a Pizza Place'', and lastly: Built Ship - ''Build a Boat For Treasure''. The Grey Diamond Logo Sticker is also a reference to the Roblox logo, with it's description, 'Fueling Ingenuity. Or something like that.' being a joke about the Roblox slogan, '''Powering Imagination'''. The Pearl Girl Sticker is a reference to the famous painting "Girl With A Pearl Earring" by Johannes Vermeer. The Prism Painting is a reference to the 1973 album cover of "The Dark Side of the Moon" by Pink Floyd, with the original artwork having been created by George Hardie. The description of the Cool Backpack sticker, "Worn by self-sufficient folk", is a reference to the community inside joke surrounding Blue Backpackers and loot-stealing. The "Royal Symbol" is a reference to the "Love Symbol" created by the musician ''Prince'', who changed his name to a very similar symbol in 1993. This symbol differs in that the curl is upward, whereas the Prince symbol curls downward. The original symbol was largely inspired by Carmen Electra, who was a dancer for Prince at the time. The Black Star sticker is a direct reference to the 2016 album ''Blackstar'' by David Bowie. The title track begins with the lyric "In the villa of Ormen"- Ormen being a village in Norway. The Red Doodle Person is a reference to artwork created by famous graffitist Keith Haring. Classic Kilroy is a reference to a famous doodle found throughout WW2 and considered the first meme ever. Killroy With Hair may refer to a famous variant of the original Kilroy but with pupils and hair. Young Elf is a sticker that references the 2013 meme, Gnome Child. Nessie is a direct reference to the popular nickname of the Loch Ness Monster, a Scottish mythical creature that is said to live in Loch Ness in the Scottish Highlands. Doodle S is a reference to a famous, simple drawing of an S that has been given the nickname "The Cool/Universal/Super/Middle School ''S''" The Wishbone sticker is a reference to a Thanksgiving tradition of having two people grab each end of a wishbone and pulling it apart for good luck. ** Taunting Doodle Person being a reference to the meme "Oh Yeah Woo Yeah." Shrugging Heart most likely is a reference to an artwork for an album called "Un Verano Sin Ti" created by rapper and singer, Bad Bunny. Moai is a reference to humanoid sculptures referred to as "Moai" found on Easter Island. Orange Step Array is most likely a reference to Roblox Obbies. Prehistoric Hand is a reference to many caves with prehistoric art of people's hands and/or a famous cave called Cueva de las Manos. Prehistoric Boar is most likely referring to a 45,000-year-old Indonesian cave painting that may be the oldest known animal art. Ionic Column Top, Middle, and Base are referencing an architecture style that originated from Greece. The quote "Definitely not Doric" is possibly a joke about the confusion between an Ionic and Doric column. The star sign stickers: Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, and Sagittarius are astrological signs that are determined by your birth date. Checking where to find each sticker will give a certain period of time that it's obtainable, being the same time period for whatever sign it correlates to. The quotes refer to the personality traits of those in each sign. The color of the star sign stickers are also based off the power colors of the zodiac signs. Abstract Color Painting is a direct reference to Mark Rothko's famous painting, White Center (Yellow, Pink and Lavender on Rose). The mushroom stickers: White Button, Fly Agaric, Porcini, Oiler, Morel, Chanterelle, Shiitake, and Black Truffle are all references to real mushrooms. The descriptions give insight on either the mushroom's looks or what they are commonly known/used for. The leaf stickers: Cordate, Cunate, Elliptic, Hastate, Lanceolate, Lyrate, Oblique, Reniform, Rhomboid, and Spatulate are all referencing real types of leaf patterns. ** Blowing Leaf's description is a reference to a lyric in Bob Dylan's song "Blowin' In The Wind", the running chorus being "The answer my friend, is blowing in the wind". The Green Circle, Blue Square, and Black Diamond stickers are direct references to ski trail difficulty ratings, green circle being the easiest, blue square is intermediate, and black diamond indicates an advanced/difficult trail- hence the respective sticker descriptions of "For novice skiers", "For the skiers in between", and "Not for novice skiers." ** Yellow Sticky Hand is a reference to a famous toy called a "Sticky Hand" that became popular in the 1980's. The description for Dark Flame is referring to a chemical reaction when burning cream of tartar. When lit on fire, the flames will become the color purple just like the design of the sticker. The description for Coiled Snake "Don't tread on this" is a reference to the Gadsden Flag which also displays a coiled snake in the center of the flag and a quote on the bottom saying "DONT TREAD ON ME" The Festive Pea is a reference to the Seasonal Attack Pea from Neopets It takes 4 extra clicks to donate hive skins and cub buddies to the Sticker Stack. This is to prevent accidental donations of these high value items. The existence of a Flying Windy Bee sticker is hinted through Spirit Bear’s Beesmas 2024 present dialogue. The username of a player will appear in a different font on their hive if that user has the Wavy Festive Hive Skin, Wavy Doodle Hive Skin, or Icy Crowned Hive Skin equipped.[[File:Image 2025-01-24 122951201.png|thumb|Onett confirming it won't spawn in the Mushroom Field.]] The Yellow Walking Wiggly Person Sticker can't spawn on the Mushroom Field. *This is likely due to the stems possibly obstructing the selected flower. docs.text:
[[File:RobloxScreenShot20190926 200721995 (3).png|thumb|275px|The Stinger Shop.]] The '''Stinger Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located behind the [[Ant Gate]] that sells {{Cost|Stinger}} for {{Cost|Ticket|10}} each. Stingers are purchasable in increments of 1, 10, and 100.

It has pictures of stingers on the sides and a red circular base with a white top. Unlike other shops with a similar appearance, it does not have a decoration on the top. It also contains a black semicircle with a grey separator as the vending mechanism, which seems to make it a rotary dispenser.

{{Consumables |image = Stinger.png |description = Grants your bees x1.5 attack for 30 seconds. |cooldown = 1 second }} '''Stingers''' are an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]]. When used, it will grant x1.5 [[Bee Attack|Bee attack]] for 30 seconds. It can also be used to obtain [[Vicious Bee]] (costs 250 stingers). Stingers are also used in many [[crafting]] recipes.

== Ways to Obtain == * Defeating [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] always grants stingers. The number of stingers dropped depends on the Rogue Vicious Bee's level, and whether it is gifted or not. * A rare drop from a [[Aphid#Rage Aphid|Rage Aphid]], [[Aphid#Armored Aphid|Armored Aphid]], [[scorpion]], or [[spider]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** Flying Brave Bee rewards 3 stingers. ** Walking Stick Nymph rewards 3 stingers. ** Coiled Snake rewards 3 stingers. ** Dark Flame rewards 5 stingers. ** Cyan Hilted Sword rewards 10 stingers. ** Red Wailing Cry rewards 3 stingers. ** Tough Potato rewards 3 stingers. * Capturing certain amounts of [[Commando Chick]]s: ** 3 captures give 1 stinger and other [[items]]. ** 12 captures gives 3 stingers and other items. ** 30 captures gives 10 stingers and other items. ** 40 captures gives 10 stingers and other items. * By giving a present to: ** [[Stick Bug]] (Rewards 25 Stingers) * Buying one for 10 tickets in the [[Stinger Shop]]. * A rare drop from [[leaves]] in the [[Cactus Field]]. * Shivering certain [[badges]] in the [[Wind Shrine]] by donating certain items (Battle, Clover, Spider, Cactus, and Rose badge rewards Stinger + other stuff). * Donating 10 or less ant passes to the wind shrine may also give a large amount of stingers. * Completing certain [[quests]] ([[Black Bear]], [[Gifted Riley Bee]], and [[Spirit Bear]]). * Winning it from the [[Memory Match#Mega Memory Match|Mega]], [[Memory Match#Night Memory Match|Night]] or [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme]] [[Memory Match]]es. * Very rarely, as a [[Cub Buddy]] gift. * As a drop from [[Planter]]s harvested in the [[Cactus Field]] or [[Rose Field]]. * Fully growing [[Red Clay Planter]] in [[Clover Field]], [[Spider Field]] and [[Cactus Field]] (in that order) rewards {{Cost|Stinger|10}} (2 weeks cooldown).

=== Looting from Rogue Vicious Bee=== The Rogue Vicious Bee can be summoned by touching or being close to a spike in a field. It has a higher chance of spawn during the [[Day/Night Cycle|nighttime]], and is guaranteed to spawn when using a [[Night Bell|night bell]]. Depending on the level, if it’s gifted, and if it’s the first defeat of the day, a Rogue Vicious Bee can drop 1-20 stingers.

====If Regular==== {| class="sortable mw-collapsible article-table" |+ !Level !{{Cost|Stinger}} |- | Level 1-3 | 1 |- |Level 4-6 | 2 |- | Level 7-9 | 3 |- |Level 10-12 |4 |}

====If Gifted==== {| class="sortable mw-collapsible article-table" |+ !Level !{{Cost|Stinger}} |- |Level 1-3 |6 |- |Level 4-6 | 9 |- |Level 7-9 | 12 |- |Level 10-12 |15 |}

A daily bonus of 5 stingers is also given for the first Vicious Bee defeated that day, with a cooldown of 22 hours after the daily reward. This also applies to Gifted Vicious Bees, having their own separate daily bonus.

There are 6 fields where the [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] can spawn at. They are: [[Clover Field]]. [[Spider Field]]. [[Cactus Field]]. [[Rose Field]]. * [[Mountain Top Field]]. *[[Pepper Patch]].

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | Certain event quests gave stingers: ** Receiving [[Brown Bear#Egg Hunt Quest 2020|Brown Bear's Egg Hunt 2020 quest]] gave 5 stingers and other stuff. The 20th Bee Bear's quest gave {{Cost|Stinger|100}} and other stuff. By giving a [[present]] to: [[Panda Bear]] or [[Stick Bug]] during the 2018 Beesmas Event. ** Panda Bear during the 2022 Beesmas Event. * Opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]: The Midnight Gift Box gave 6 stingers + other stuff during the 2021 Beesmas Event. ** The Charcoal Gift Box gave 10 stingers + other stuff during the 2022 Beesmas Event. Buying bundles in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]: ** The Night Bundle gave 25 stingers and other items for 1,000 [[Snowflake]]s. The Anti-Ant Bundle gave 50 stingers and other items for 1,000 Snowflakes. The Robotic Bundle gave 100 stingers and other items for {{Cost|Snowflake|2,500}} and 50 [[Gingerbread Bear]]s. Purchasing certain packs from the [[Robux Shop]]: Purchasing the September Star Special for 3,500 robux gave 100 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Stars and Spikes offer for 1,500 robux gave 100 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Colossal Crafts Pack for 3,400 robux gave 200 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Extreme Extract Pack for 1,200 robux gave 100 stingers and other items. ** Purchasing the Winter Wonder Pack for 3,400 robux gave 200 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Spikey Spring Basket offer for 2,700 robux gave 250 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Gooey Goodies Pack for 800 robux gave 100 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Silent Night Special for 800 robux gave 100 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Precise Pack for 1,700 robux gave 150 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Honeyday Mega-Haul for 4,500 robux gave 500 stingers and other items. Purchasing the Mondo-Robo Bundle for 4,500 robux gave 500 stingers and other items. ** Purchasing the Cyber Monday Special for 800 robux gave 50 stingers and other items. As a guaranteed reward from defeating all party mobs of your [[Robo Party]]. Redeeming codes: Mocito100T (Gives 3 stingers and other stuff). 1MLikes (Gives 1 stinger and other stuff). **DarzethDoodads (Gives 1 stinger and other stuff). |}

==Trivia== The old hotkey for stingers, 'U', was removed a few days after the 9/10/2018 update because people were repeatedly unintentionally using them. 3 stingers are used to activate the [[Star Amulet|Supreme Star Amulet]] passive, "[[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]]". The passive also refunds 1 stinger.

{{RemovedContent}} The '''Stockings''' are a [[Beesmas]]-exclusive machine that can be unlocked after completing [[Brown Bear]]'s Beesmas quest. They were introduced on [[Updates#2020.12.25|Beesmas 2020]] and always returned on Beesmas even since. The Stockings is located at the bottom of the hill that Brown Bear is on, next to the [[Clover Field]]. When used, they spawn a random [[Beequip]], as well as 2 random items in front of the stockings. It has a 1 hour cooldown.

Every time the player uses the Stockings, they can only get 1 of each item, excluding gumdrops and moon charms. docs.title: Strange Goggles
docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}}{{Accessory |image1 = Strange Goggles.png |description = This futuristic looking headset doesn't seem to do very much... |cost = 77 [[Honey]], 1 [[Micro-Converter]], and 7 [[7-Pronged Cog]]s. |stats = +77 Capacity+7% Defense }} {{Quote|This futuristic looking headset doesn't seem to do very much...}} The '''Strange Goggles''' was a [[:Category:Hats|Hat Accessory]] that was added in the [[Updates|11/23/2020 Update]]. It could be bought from the [[Noob Shop]] until it was removed in the [[Updates|7/17/2024 Update]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|77}}{{Cost|Micro-Converter|1}}{{Cost|7-Pronged Cog|7}} |}

This accessory was made for the Ready Player Two event in [[Bee Swarm Simulator]]. As such, it is very distinct from other accessories in this game. and it required 7 [[codes]] to be redeemed. The codes to obtain all 7 of the {{Cost|7-Pronged Cog}} are: Dysentery, Luther, Millie, CarmenSanDiego, Jumpstart, Troggles and WordFactory. Upon equipping this item, the player was able to interact with [[Digital Bee (NPC)]] in [[The Computer]].

== Stats ==

  • +77 [[Capacity]].
  • +7% [[System Page#Defense|Defense]].

==Gallery== Strange Googles Stats.png|The stats of the Strange Goggles along with the crafting costs. Player with goggles.png|A player wearing the Strange Goggles.

== Trivia == * This is the cheapest item in the game in terms of honey besides the [[Pouch]] and [[Scooper]], which are automatically received for free. * This is the only item that doesn't show up in the item/gear bar at the top of the screen. * This is the first item that is required to enter a specific area, the second being the [[Propeller Hat]] and the [[Hiking Boots]]. * While wearing these and doing the [[Digital Bee (NPC)|Digital Bee]]'s quests, the objective field will occasionally "Glitch" with brightly colored textures appearing on the Field decorations. This is purely cosmetic and does not affect gameplay. * This is the third hat that has been made unobtainable, the first and second being the [[B.B.M. Mask]] and the [[Mondo B.B.M. Mask]]. Unlike the other two, this one’s completely removed, meaning you cannot re-equip it.

docs.title: Strawberry Dispenser
docs.text:
[[File:StrawberryDispenser.png|thumb|The Strawberry Dispenser.]] The '''Strawberry Dispenser''' is a [[Dispenser]] located in the [[Red HQ]]. It can be accessed by climbing the ladder inside of the Red HQ, or by jumping on the fence near the [[Special Sprout Summoner]]. When used, it grants the player [[Honey]], [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] x5, [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Red boost]] x10, and 1 [[Strawberry]] for every [[:Category:Red|Red]] [[bees|Bee]] in the player’s [[Hive]].

It has a cooldown of 4 hours.

If the player doesn't have any red bees in their hive, it will not grant any strawberries.

The player must be in the [[Bee Swarm Simulator Club]] in order to use this.

== Chart == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Bees !Honey !Bees !Honey |- |0-1 |500 |26 |26,600 |- |2 |600 |27 |28,000 |- |3 |1,000 |28 |29,600 |- |4 |1,600 |29 |31,200 |- |5 |2,200 |30 |32,800 |- |6 |3,000 |31 |34,600 |- |7 |3,800 |32 |36,200 |- |8 |4,600 |33 |38,000 |- |9 |5,400 |34 |39,600 |- |10 |6,400 |35 |41,400 |- |11 |7,200 |36 |43,200 |- |12 |8,400 |37 |45,000 |- |13 |9,400 |38 |46,800 |- |14 |10,400 |39 |48,800 |- |15 |11,600 |40 |50,600 |- |16 |12,800 |41 |52,600 |- |17 |14,000 |42 |54,400 |- |18 |15,200 |43 |56,400 |- |19 |16,600 |44 |58,400 |- |20 |17,800 |45 |60,400 |- |21 |19,200 |46 |62,400 |- |22 |20,600 |47 |64,400 |- |23 |22,000 |48 |66,600 |- |24 |23,600 |49 |68,600 |- |25 |25,000 |50 |70,800 |} == Trivia == * The only time this dispenser appears in a quest is in [[Science Bear]]'s ''"The Power of Information"'', in which it requires the player to use this machine 3 times. * This dispenser gives the same honey per bee as the [[Blueberry Dispenser]]. * This is one of three dispensers that give [[Treats]] in the game with the other two being the [[Treat Dispenser]] and the Blueberry Dispenser. * This is one of four dispensers requiring the player to be part of the Bee Swarm Simulator Club with the others being the [[Honey Dispenser]], the Treat Dispenser, and the Blueberry Dispenser.

docs.title: Strawberry Field
docs.text:
{{Field|width = 22|height = 26|image = StrawberryFieldBeesmas2021.png|fieldcolor = Red|bees = 5}}The '''Strawberry Field''' is a [[field]] located past the [[Basic Bee Gate]], to the left of the [[Spider Field]], and beside the [[Vicious Bee Egg Claim]]. This field is protected by 2 [[ladybug]]s; one of which is level 2 and the other level 3.

It is a 22x26 field, containing 572 [[flowers]]. The flowers are red and white, in sizes of single, double, and triple.

{ class="article-table" !'''Flowers''' !White !Red !Blue !Total - !Single 5% 15% 0% '''20%''' - !Double 18.75% 56.25% 0% '''75%''' - !Triple 1.25% 3.75% 0% '''5%''' - !'''Total''' '''25%''' '''75%''' '''0%''' '''100%''' } '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The random generation percentages, however, are precisely accurate, as they are taken directly from the game's source code.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], [[Strawberry]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Red Boost]], [[Red Extract]], [[Bitterberry]], [[Ticket]] and [[Royal Jelly]] tokens while collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Strawberry Field are [[Fire Bee]], [[Riley Bee]], and [[Shy Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Strawberry Field are [[Cool Bee]], [[Bubble Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], and [[Windy Bee]].

This field grants Refreshing [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is placed here.

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Red Field Booster]] may give a Strawberry [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +100% Strawberry Field pollen for 15 minutes. [[File:Strawberry Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Strawberry Field boost icon.]] * Using [[glitter]] in the Strawberry Field will add 100% Strawberry Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if the boost isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add 100% - 300% Strawberry Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out and also what type of dice is used. Strawberry [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Strawberry Field conversion, and give +5% instant Strawberry Field conversion and +15% Strawberry Field pollen for each stack. Strawberry Field Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times. The field can be boosted by the [[King Beetle Amulet]]. If it has a Strawberry Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% up to a max of +100% pollen.

===The methods below are no longer possible.===

Giving a [[present]] to certain NPCs: [[Gifted Riley Bee]] gave Strawberry Field Boost x3 and other boosts and [[items]]. ** [[Onett]] gave Strawberry Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. Purchasing a Strawberry Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Strawberry [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Strawberry Field Pollen, x1.25 [[System Page#Red Bomb Pollen|Red Bomb Pollen]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]]. Redeeming certain expired codes: Friday (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x5 + other stuff). SugarRush (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x3 + other stuff). FruitMachine (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x1 + other stuff). Berlin (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** 1mFavorites (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x1 + other stuff). WikiHonor (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x3 + other stuff). *JollyJelly (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x3 and Strawberry Field Winds x3 + other stuff). ** FestiveFinale (Gave Strawberry Field Boost x3 and Strawberry Field Winds x2 + other stuff) ** WeekExtension (Gives Strawberry Field Boost x3 + Strawberry Field Winds x10 + other stuff) ** 1MLikes (Gives Strawberry Field Boost x1 + other stuff).

== Gallery == hivesticker strawberry field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

==Trivia==

This is the third smallest field in the game, outranked by the [[Stump Field]] and [[Pumpkin Patch]]. There is a strawberry token behind the biggest strawberry in the top left of the field. This is one of six fields that [[fireflies]] can travel to during [[Day/Night Cycle|nighttime]], with the others being [[Bamboo Field]], [[Cactus Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Rose Field]], and Spider Field. [[Mother Bear]] states that finding strawberry tokens are much more common in this field than in any other field. According to [[Spirit Bear]], the Strawberry in the field were planted from seeds imported from Sweden. She also states that [[sprout]]s in this field spawn the most strawberry tokens, 8 times more than normal sprouts. If you run towards the strawberry on the corner fast enough, you may glitch inside of the strawberry. If this happens you will have to reset your character, rejoin the game, or use a {{Cost|Whirligig|||0}}. *This the only red field that gives [[Nectar|Refreshing Nectar]].

docs.title: Strawberry
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Strawberry.png |description=Increases your bond with a bee by 25. }} A {{Color|Strawberry}} is a type of [[Treats|Treat]] that can be fed to a [[Bees|bee]] to raise its bond by 25. However, when fed to a [[Rascal Bee|Rascal]], [[Rad Bee|Rad]], [[Rage Bee|Rage]], [[Riley Bee|Riley]], [[Baby Bee|Baby]], [[Stubborn Bee|Stubborn]], [[Shy Bee|Shy]], or [[Spicy Bee|Spicy]] Bee, the amount of [[bond]] they gain is doubled. These bees also have a small chance of becoming gifted when fed strawberries, though this only happens with a 0.0125% (1 in 8,000) chance for [[Bees/Rare|Rare bees]], 0.01% (1 in 10,000) chance for [[Bees/Epic|Epic bees]], 0.0083% (1 in 12,000) chance for [[Bees/Common|Common]] and [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary bees]], and 0.00417% (1 in 24,000) chance for [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bees]] per Strawberry.

== Ways to Obtain == * There is a strawberry token hidden behind the largest strawberry in the corner of [[Strawberry Field]]. * From using the [[Strawberry Dispenser]] near the [[Red HQ]]. * As a reward from the [[Ant Challenge]]. * Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]: ** 15MMembers (Gives 15 strawberries + other stuff). * As a reward from [[Memory Match|memory matches]]. * As a stack reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** {{Cost|Pink Cupcake Sticker|||0}} rewards 50 strawberries. ** {{Cost|Pale Heart Sticker|||0}} rewards 50 strawberries. *Digging in to the [[Beesmas Feast]].

=== Drops === * Farming in the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Strawberry Field]], [[Rose Field]], [[Cactus Field]], and the [[Pepper Patch]]. ** Harvesting [[Leaves]] in these fields may also yield strawberries. * As a drop from [[Ladybug]]s, [[Scorpion]]s, and [[King Beetle]]. * As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a gift from a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]]. * As a reward for completely growing any kind of [[Sprout]] except for Moon, Gummy, and Debug sprouts. ** Planting a sprout in the [[Mushroom Field]], [[Rose Field]], and [[Pepper Patch]] yields 4x more strawberries than other fields. Planting a sprout in the [[Strawberry Field]] yields 8x more strawberries than other fields. * Harvesting [[Sparkles]] (higher chances in red fields). * As a drop from [[Puffshroom]]s in red fields or fields with high amounts of red flowers ([[Clover Field]], [[Cactus Field]], and [[Mountain Top Field]]). * As a drop from planters (besides {{Cost|Tacky Planter|||0}}, {{Cost|Blue Clay Planter|||0}} and {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}}), most likely in red fields. ** The {{Cost|Red Clay Planter|||0}} always drops strawberries upon harvest at full growth.

=== Quests ===

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * As a drop from [[Chicks#Hostage Chick|Hostage]] and [[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted]] Chicks. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** 10mMembers gave 10 strawberries + other stuff. ** 5mMembers gave 5 strawberries + other stuff. ** FourYearFiesta gave 4 strawberries + other stuff. ** 1MLikes gave 1 strawberry + other stuff. |} ==Crafting Uses== Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Strawberry|750}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Strawberry}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |3 |{{Cost|Pineapple|3}}{{Cost|Blueberry|3}} |[[File:Gumdrops.png|center|80px|link=Gumdrops]]{{Color|Gumdrops}} |- |50 |{{Cost|Royal Jelly|10}} |[[File:Red Extract.png|center|80px|link=Red Extract]]{{Color|Red Extract}} |- |50 |{{Cost|Honey|2,200,000}}{{Cost|Blueberry|50}} |[[File:Hiking Boots.png|center|80px|link=Hiking Boots]][[Hiking Boots]] |- |50 |{{Cost|Honey|750,000}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|1}}{{Cost|Stinger|1}} |[[File:Red Guard.png|center|80px|link=Red Guard]][[Red Guard]] |- |50 |{{Cost|Honey|5,000,000}}{{Cost|Red Extract|3}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|5}}{{Cost|Stinger|5}} |[[File:Elite Red Guard.png|center|80px|link=Elite Red Guard]][[Elite Red Guard]] |- |100 |{{Cost|Honey|30,000,000}}{{Cost|Red Extract|10}}{{Cost|Glue|5}}{{Cost|Stinger|25}} |[[File:Riley Guard.png|center|80px|link=Riley Guard]][[Riley Guard]] |- |500 |{{Cost|Honey|100,000,000}}{{Cost|Red Extract|50}}{{Cost|Enzymes|25}}{{Cost|Glue|15}} |[[File:Fire Mask.png|center|80px|link=Fire Mask]][[Fire Mask]] |}

docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Stubborn Bee.png |image-gifted = StubbornBee Gifted.png |rarity = Rare |description = A hard-headed bee who can't be bossed around. It tells others where to go. |energy = 20 |speed = 11.9 |attack = 3 |color = Colorless |skincolor2 = #fdffbc |skincolor1 = #1b2b36 |skincolor3 = #1b2b36 }} '''Stubborn Bee''' is a Colorless [[Bees/Rare|Rare bee]].

Stubborn Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Strawberry}} .

Stubborn Bee likes the [[Dandelion Field]] and the [[Clover Field]]. It dislikes the [[Rose Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 pollen in 6 seconds. * Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * -15% [[Stats#Speed|movespeed]], +25% convert speed, +2 [[Stats#Attack|attack]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +15% [[Ability Tokens|Ability Token]] Lifespan.

== Abilities == * '''[[Ability_Tokens#Mark|[Pollen Mark]]]''' Marks a random area on the [[Fields|field]] for 7 seconds (+0.25s per level) that increases all pollen up to 50% while you stand in it. Stacks up to 3 times.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 4|honey = 80|honeytime = 3|rarity = rare|color = Colorless}}

== Gallery == RobloxScreenShot20181210 140947152 (2).png|A Gifted Stubborn Bee hive slot. StubbornFace.png|Stubborn Bee's face. File:64F9ECAE-FDAE-4986-91B9-EE19CAA2B037.jpeg|A Stubborn Bee hive slot. File:Hivesticker drooping stubborn bee.png|The Drooping Stubborn Bee [[sticker]].

== Trivia == * Stubborn Bee was one of the two bees added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], the other being [[Carpenter Bee]]. * Stubborn Bee and [[Looker Bee]] are the only Rare bees added after the game launch. The gifted hive bonus (+15% ability token lifespan) used to be broken. The player could have a Gifted Stubborn Bee in their hive, but the ability token lifespan would not apply. This was fixed on an unknown update in February 2021. Stubborn Bee is the only Colorless Rare Bee that does not have its own [[:Category:Guards|guard]] in the [[Pro Shop]]. This is because it was added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018]] update, after the guards were added.

docs.title: Stump Field
docs.text:
{{NonRectangularField |image = StumpFieldBeesmas2021.png |fieldcolor = Blue |bees = 10 |flowercount = 563 Flowers }}The '''Stump Field''' is a [[field]] that was added in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]] and is located past the [[Brave Bee Gate]] next to the [[Pineapple Patch]]. It is home to the [[Stump Snail]] who more or less protects the field by slowly pacing around the circumference of the trunk.

This field contains 663 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, and the only natural size is triple.

{| class="article-table" !Flowers !'''White''' !'''Red''' !'''Blue''' !'''Total''' |- !Single |0% |0% |0% |'''0%''' |- !Double |0% |0% |0% |'''0%''' |- !Triple |19% |6% |75% |'''100%''' |- !Total |'''19%''' |'''6%''' |'''75%''' |'''100%''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[honey]], red [[Ability Tokens#Boost|boost]], blue boost, [[Treat#Treat|treat]], [[gumdrops|gumdrop]], [[glue]], [[Magic Bean|magic bean]], [[ticket]] and [[Blue Extract|blue extract]] tokens when collecting [[pollen]].

[[Bees]] that like the Stump Field are [[Bumble Bee]], [[Exhausted Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], and [[Gummy Bee]]. Bees that dislike the Stump Field are [[Hasty Bee]], [[Baby Bee]], and [[Spicy Bee]].

This field grants Motivating [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

== Obtaining Boosts == [[File:Stump Field Icon.png|thumb|75px|The Stump Field Boost icon.]] * Using the [[Blue Field Booster]] may give a Stump [[Field Boost]], if the Stump Snail is on respawn cooldown. When it does, it will give +100% Stump Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Stump Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes if it isn't already maxed out. Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% - +300% Stump Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out and is based on the type of dice used. Stump [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of +20% instant Stump Field conversion and give +5% instant Stump Field conversion and +10% Stump Field pollen for each stack for 30 minutes. Stump Field Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times. It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]], which boosts the field by +10% to +65% depending on the amulet's rarity. All Shell Amulets are guaranteed to give this buff. Activating the [[Passive Abilities#Guiding Star|Guiding Star]] passive can summon a guiding star to this field if it is one of the player's five least collected fields.

===The methods below are no longer possible. ===

Giving a [[present]] to [[Onett]] gave Stump Field Boost x1 and other boosts and [[items]]. Using [[Onett's Lid Art]] could summon a guiding star to this field. Purchasing a Stump Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Stump [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Stump Field Pollen, x1.1 [[System Page#Goo|Goo]], and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]] for 30 minutes. Redeeming certain expired codes: MoreTime (Gave Stump Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** 2MFavorites (Gave Stump Field Boost x2 + other stuff). Reboooot (Gave Stump Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** Willgoold (Gave Stump Field Boost x1 + other stuff). GravyGoodies (Gave Stump Field Boost x1 + other stuff). RobziRampage (Gave Stump Field Boost x1 + other stuff). **FrozenBugReboot (Gives Stump Field Code Buff and Stump Field Boost x4 + other stuff).

== Gallery == hivesticker stump field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * During the [[Stick Bug Challenge]], if [[Stick Bug]] is at the Pineapple Patch, [[Mountain Top Field]] or [[Bamboo Field]], it will be able to create a [[Stick Bug Challenge#Defense Totem|Defense Totem]] in this field. * Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], the Stump Field was originally a more balanced colored field. It was updated to act as a blue-oriented counterpart to the [[Pepper Patch]]. * This is the first field the player will encounter that only has triple flowers naturally, the second one being the [[Mountain Top Field]]. Third being the [[Coconut Field]] and fourth being [[Pepper Patch]]. * This is the only field where gumdrops can be obtained from [[leaves]]. *This and the [[Hub Field]] are the only non-quadrilateral fields in the game. ** Before the 1/12/2024 Update, the Stump Field was the only non-quadrilateral field in the game. * This is the only blue field where [[Blueberry|blueberries]] cannot spawn naturally. ** This field is also the only blue field that has red flowers. * This, the Ant Field and the [[Hub Field]] are the only fields where [[Wild Windy Bee]] cannot spawn in nor fly to. ** However, [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] can summon Wild Windy Bees in this field. If they are defeated, they will fly in place until their timer is up as there is no flight pattern programmed for Stump Field Windy Bees. * This, the [[Coconut Field]], the [[Pepper Patch]], the [[Ant Challenge|Ant Field]] and the [[Hub Field]] are the only fields that were added after the game's first release. * The Stump Field, the [[Coconut Field]], and the [[Spider Field|Spider Field's]] caves have the same appearance. ** No special rewards can be found in the Stump Snail's Cave, unlike the [[Werewolf's Cave]] and the [[Coconut Cave]], making it closer to the Spider Field's cave. * There is a [[glue]] token between the large pineapple and the base of the stump. * According to [[Black Bear]], there used to be a gigantic tree that blocked the sunlight and didn't let the plants and flowers grow. Then one day, a huge bear came and cut the tree down. A field then grew on the stump of the tree, which many assumed is what the Stump Field is. It is unknown which bear cut the tree down in the first place. * This field is one of three fields with no decorations in it, indicating what field it is. The other two fields to do this are the [[Ant Field]], the [[Mountain Top Field]] and the [[Hub Field]]. ** This field gets its name from the stump it sits on top of instead. * During Beesmas 2019 and 2020, there was an [[Obstacle Courses#Mythic Present Obby|obby]] in a hole to the left of the Stump Field. Completing the obby would lead to the [[Gift Boxes|Purple Gift Box]]. ** This has been replaced by [[Dapper Bear's Shop]]. * This is the only field that can be completely covered by a sprinkler, that being the [[The Supreme Saturator|Supreme Saturator]]. * This [[Field]] is currently the third smallest field in the game, only being behind the [[Pumpkin Patch]] and the [[Ant Field]]. * There is a glitch where you can place a planter on the outer rim of the field outside of any flowers. ** Harvesting a planter utilizing this glitch will have the loot tokens spawn on the closest flowers in the field.

{{MapNav}} [[Category:Fields]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Blue]]

docs.title: Stump Snail
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Stump Snail |image =Stump_Snail_GeplagtesSkelett.png |location = [[Stump Field]] |timer = 96 hours (4 days), 81.6 hours (3.4 days) with Gifted Vicious Bee. |hp = 30,000,000 (30 million) |damage = 30 |points = 500 |bond = 2000 |honey = 30,000,000 |level = 6 }}The '''Stump Snail''' is a level 6 [[mob]] that occupies the [[Stump Field]]. With 30,000,000 health, it idly moves along the circumference of the field, posing no direct threat but dealing 30 damage upon contact.

Like the [[Commando Chick]], the Stump Snail's health is saved, allowing players to defeat it in multiple sessions until it is fully defeated.

Once defeated, it takes 96 hours (4 days) to respawn. If the player has the [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]], the time is reduced to 81 hours and 36 minutes (3.4 days).

== Drops == {| class="article-table" !Guaranteed |- |[[Shell Amulet]] (at least bronze){{Cost|Glue|8}}{{Cost|Star Jelly|1}}{{Cost|Honey|30,000,000}} |} {| class="article-table" !Possible |- |{{Cost|Ticket|50-250}}{{Cost|Glue|8-100}}{{Cost|Star Jelly|1-10}}{{Cost|Glitter|1-10}}{{Cost|Oil|1-5}}{{Cost|Enzymes|1-10}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly|10-1,000}}{{Cost|Treat|25-10,000}}{{Cost|Sunflower Seed|10-500}}{{Cost|Pineapple|10-500}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|100-2,500}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|1-25}}{{Cost|Neonberry|1-100}}{{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|5-25}} (Beesmas only){{Cost|Gold Egg|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Gifted Silver Egg|||0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|||0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Gifted Diamond Egg|||0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Star Egg|4=0}} (Nearly Impossible){{Cost|Mythic Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Right Facing Stump Snail Sticker|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Basic Green Hive Skin|||0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Left Gold Swirl Fleuron Sticker|||0}} (Unfathomably Rare){{Cost|Right Gold Swirl Fleuron Sticker|||0}} (Unfathomably Rare) |}

== Tips/Strategies ==

  • Having bees oriented toward fighting, such as [[Rage Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], [[Lion Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], [[Precise Bee]] and [[Spicy Bee]] will help defeat the Stump Snail faster.

  • Two additional [[Fire Bee]]s from [[Spicy Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Inferno|Inferno]] and [[Frog]]s from [[Tadpole Bee]]'s [[Ability Tokens#Summon Frog|Summon Frog]] may be summoned to deal further damage.

  • [[Precise Bee]] can deal more damage and provides [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical]] and [[Critical Hits#Super-Crit Chance|Super-Crit chance]] to increase bee damage.
  • The player should wear equipment that boosts the bee attack, notably the [[Fire Mask|Fire mask]] or [[Demon Mask|Demon mask]]. ** If the player has the [[Gummy Mask|Gummy mask]], they can intentionally trigger [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]] to boost [[Gummy Bee]]'s attack for 10 seconds.
  • A player with the [[Coconut Canister]] can intentionally trigger the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]] to receive 10 seconds of ×1.25 Bee Attack.
  • When AFK, a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]] is recommended as it is capable of collecting tokens the player would otherwise miss. It will always manage to collect your Impale tokens had you not been afk and picked them up yourself.
  • [[Stinger]]s greatly boost attack, [[Oil]] increases [[Stats#Speed|Bee Movespeed]], and [[Tropical Drink]]s increase critical chance by 5%.
  • During the [[:Category:Beesmas|Beesmas 2020]], [[:Category:Beesmas|2021]], 2022, and summer 2024 events, the summoned bees from [[Onett's Lid Art]], [[Honeyday Candles]], and [[Gummy Siege]] could be used to attack the Stump Snail.

==Trivia == * It is one of two [[mob]]s where the damage dealt to it is saved over multiple sessions, the other being [[Chicks#Commando Chick|Commando Chick]]. * Stump Snail, [[King Beetle]], and [[Stick Bug]] are the only mobs that can drop [[amulet]]s. ** Stump Snail is the only mob that is guaranteed to drop an amulet. * This is the only mob that guarantees to drop [[glue]] upon defeat. * As of the [[Updates#2019.02.01|01/02/2019 update]], the Stump Snail, [[Rogue Vicious Bee]], King Beetle (only if it drops a [[King Beetle Amulet]]), and [[ants]] are the only mobs that do not drop tokens when defeat; instead the loot directly goes to the player's inventory. ** Even though the Stump Snail does not drop tokens, the total amount of honey rewarded is still increased by [[System Page#Honey From Tokens|Honey From Tokens]]. * [[Spirit Bear]] refers to the Stump Snail as "Ol' Stumpy," which may be a reference to Youtuber [https://www.youtube.com/user/ThnxCya ThnxCya] as he is also known to refer to the Stump Snail as "Ol' Stumpy." * It is possible to damage other players' snails with [[Passive Abilities#Gathering Flames|Flames]]. * Stump Snail originally had 25,000,000 health prior to the [[Updates#2019.04.05|04/05/2019 update]]. The change was due to most bees' attacks being buffed in said update. * Stump Snail has the most health and the longest respawn time among all mobs. * Previously, there was a bug where the Stump Snail would spawn at a lower position than usual, causing it to bob up before falling under the field. ** On rare occasions, it would fall significantly beneath the map beyond the player's bees' attack range. During such occurrences, bees would be unable to focus on it, flying up and down and rendering its defeat unrealistic. ** This has since been patched. * This is one of the three hostile mobs that require multiple days to respawn, the others being [[Tunnel Bear]] and [[Coconut Crab]]. * When a player leaves the field, the snail returns to its cave without a specific target. In this state, it can damage any player that comes into contact with it. * Only the head of a stump snail can deal damage. *If the player is in the middle of a round of [[Robo Bear Challenge]], the player's bees will not target Stump Snail. This is likely so the player can collect pollen from the Stump Field for the challenge's quests without having to worry about the snail distracting their bees. However, the snail will still spawn and can damage the player.

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}} {{Bear |image = Sun.png |type = Traveling Bear |location = Near Daily Top Honeymakers leaderboard (previously where the Ant Challenge is now) |bees = None |basecolor1 = #211b19 |basecoloramount = 1 |shadecoloramount = 2 |shadecolor1 = #695030 |shadecolor2 = #1f1917 |snoutcoloramount = 1 |snoutcolor1 = #685b4b |torsocolor1 = #241e1c |torsocoloramount = 2 |torsocolor2 = #8f7656 |armscolor = #382f2b |legscolor = #332c29 |enableother = y |othercolor1 = #1a1817 |othercoloramount = 2 |othercolor2 = #7d7c7b |othername = Sun Glasses }}

'''Sun Bear''' is a [[:Category:Traveling Bears|traveling bear]] who appeared during special events. He is one of the four temporary [[Quest Givers]], the others being [[Bee Bear]], [[Gummy Bear]], and [[Bubble Bee Man]].

He made five appearances. His first visit was from April 27, 2018, to May 13, 2018. He gave 12 quests with rewards including the [[Belt Bag]] and a final reward of a [[Mondo Belt Bag]]. His second visit was from September 10, 2018, to October 8, 2018. He gave 14 quests with rewards including the [[Basic Boots]], the [[Hiking Boots]], and the [[Beekeeper's Boots]]. His third visit was from September 28, 2019, to October 28, 2019. He gave 10 quests themed around [[Bean Bugs]], with a final reward of 250 [[Ticket]]s. His fourth visit was from April 6, 2020 to May 21, 2020, for the [[Egg Hunt 2020|Roblox Egg Hunt 2020]]. His fifth visit was in August 1, 2024 for the [[The Games|Roblox "The Games"]] event, later the bear stayed in the game for sometime and at October 29, 2024, he received a new quest line. He left from his fifth visit on April 30, 2025, the same day 2024 Winter Beesmas ended'''.'''

'''''NOTE: Sun Bear's [[:Category:Belts|Belt Bags]] and [[:Category:Boots|Boots]] can now be crafted with [[Honey]] and other [[Crafting|Ingredients]].'''''

{{Quest/SunBear}}

== Trivia== He was the only traveling bear to not introduce his own [[Bees/Event|event bee]]. In the quest ''''Focus Feature'''', Sun Bear said to defeat a [[Werewolf]] instead of 3 [[Spider]]s. The [[Badges#Ability Badge|Ability Badge]] is represented by him in the game's description. * After his spring visit, the belt bags can be bought in [[Pro Shop]] ([[Belt Bag]]) and the [[Mountain Top Shop]] ([[Mondo Belt Bag]]). During his spring visit, there was a [[Ticket]] behind Sun Bear’s RV. When Sun Bear went away, the ticket stayed there for a little time, but now it's gone. Sun Bear uses the [https://web.roblox.com/catalog/734338331/Knight-Animation-Package Knight Animation Package]. Sun Bear says that only [[Rage Bee|Rage]], [[Exhausted Bee|Exhausted]], and [[Music Bee|Music]] Bees spawn [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]], but [[Shocked Bee]] does as well. This was fixed a few days later. In his second visit ([[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 Update]]) and his third visit ([[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 Update]]), his RV had a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Phoenix Flag of Phoenix] bumper sticker on the back. During his first visit, Sun Bear was shown to be wearing the [[Mondo Belt Bag]], which he gave at the very end of his quests. During his second visit, he was shown to be wearing both the Mondo Belt Bag and [[Beekeeper's Boots]], which he gave at the end of his quests. Sun Bear gives {{Cost|Ticket|48}} throughout all his quests with the ticket token that was behind the RV. During the quest ''''Sun Bear's Scavenger Hunt'''', he says 3 more quests are needed to be completed to get the [[Beekeeper's Boots]], when it is actually 4 quests. However, [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] could have done this on purpose, because Sun Bear was completely surprised by [[Rogue Vicious Bee|Vicious Bee]] in his dialogue, and gives you a quest around this. He was the first [[:Category:Traveling Bears|traveling bear]] added to the game, with [[Gummy Bear]] being the second and [[Bee Bear]] being the third. The item prices of his rewards after his visit are: [[Basic Boots]] are 4,400, [[Hiking Boots]] are 2,200,000, Beekeeper's Boots are 15,000,000, [[Belt Bag]] is 440,000, and [[Mondo Belt Bag]] is 12,400,000 [[Honey]]. He was the only [[:Category:Traveling Bears|traveling bear]] who never gave an egg on his last quest. He and [[Bubble Bee Man]] were the only [[:Category:NPC|NPCs]] to give an [[:Category:Accessories|Accessory]]. It was hinted that Sun Bear is from Arizona, this is from the [[Codes|Code]] "'''Arizona'''", and the City of Arizona flag that was on his RV the second and the third visit. During the quests in his third visit, it is revealed that the reason he had [[Bean Bugs]] was that he was taking them to Orlando for an unknown reason. In the quest ''''Total Focus'''', Sun Bear said to collect 200 [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus Tokens]] before you received the quest, but he didn't say to collect 200 Focus Tokens after you received the quest. * For the ''''Total Focus'''' quest, after you finish the dialogue with Sun Bear, a [[Memory Match]] game will start automatically for free. He stated only [[Basic Bee]] doesn't generate tokens, but [[Brave Bee]] doesn't as well, even though both of them can generate [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire tokens]] when they are [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]. To complete every quest on his third visit, you must collect 3835 tokens from [[Bean Bugs]]. * It was possible for his trapped Bean Bug to jump out of its cage. It was also possible for the player to go in and out of the [[Bean Bugs|Bean Bug's]] cage. Onett has stated that Sun Bear isn't welcome on the mountain anymore for accidentally releasing [[Bean Bugs]] and the [[chicks]]. It seems as if Sun Bear was unbanned in 2024 with his visit during [[The Games]]. In “Boot Lootin” Sun Bear mentions that he has been to a desert before. In “Light Up The Night” Sun Bear mentions that he prefers [[Day/Night Cycle|Nighttime]] to Daytime, as he is able to relax. Sun Bear likes [[Mantis|mantises]]. Referring to them as ‘cool’ in his quest “Show Me The Honey”. Sun Bear mentions in his quest “Vicious Bee Begone” that he has had an encounter with a [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] while going to visit [[Brown Bear]]. *In his quest “Total Focus” Sun Bear mentions that he transports ‘exotic things’ around in his RV as a job.

{{Field |image = Newsunflowerfield.png |fieldcolor = White |bees = None |width = 20 |height = 33 }}The '''Sunflower Field''' is one of the five [[Starter Zone|starting]] [[fields]] that any player can visit upon starting the game. There are no [[mobs]] that protect this field.

This is a 20×33 field, containing 660 [[flowers]]. The flowers are white, red, and blue, in sizes of single and double.

{| class="article-table" !Flowers ! colspan="2" |White ! colspan="2" |Red ! colspan="2" |Blue ! colspan="2" |Total |- !Single |409 |''{{Hover|62%|61.97%}}'' |99 |''15%'' |85 |''{{Hover|12.9%|12.87%}}'' |'''593''' |'''''{{Hover|89.8%|89.84%}}''''' |- !Double |42 |''{{Hover|6.4%|6.36%}}'' |11 |''{{Hover|1.7%|1.67%}}'' |14 |''{{Hover|2.1%|2.12%}}'' |'''67''' |'''''{{Hover|10.2%|10.15%}}''''' |- !Triple |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |0 |''0%'' |'''0''' |'''''0%''''' |- !Total |'''451''' |'''''{{Hover|68.3%|68.33%}}''''' |'''110''' |'''''{{Hover|16.7%|16.67%}}''''' |'''99''' |'''''15%''''' |'''660''' |'''''100%''''' |} '''Note: The flowers in fields are randomly generated, so the flower counts above may not be 100% accurate. The percentages should be roughly correct, however.'''

This field can spawn [[Sunflower Seed|sunflower seed]], [[ticket]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|red boost]], [[Ability Tokens#Boost|blue boost]], [[oil]], and [[Magic Bean|magic bean]] tokens when gathering [[pollen]].

This field grants Satisfying [[Nectar]] when a [[planter]] is planted here.

[[Bees]] that like the Sunflower Field are [[Basic Bee]], [[Baby Bee]], [[Hasty Bee]], and [[Exhausted Bee]]. The only bee that dislikes the Sunflower Field is [[Looker Bee]].

== Obtaining Boosts == * Using the [[Field Booster]] may give a Sunflower [[Field Boost]]. When it does, it will give +300% Sunflower Field pollen for 15 minutes. * Using [[glitter]] will add 100% Sunflower Field pollen onto the current boost for 15 minutes, if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Using [[Field Dice|field dice]], [[Smooth Dice|smooth dice]], or [[Loaded Dice|loaded dice]] may add +100% Sunflower Field pollen for 15 minutes if the current boost isn't already maxed out. * Sunflower [[Field Wind]]s can be obtained through the [[Wind Shrine]] or [[codes]]. They have a base of 20% instant Sunflower Field conversion and give +5% instant Sunflower Field conversion and +25% Sunflower Field pollen for each stack. Sunflower Field Winds can stack up to a total of 15 times. * It can be boosted by the [[Shell Amulet]]. If it has a Sunflower Field Boost, it can boost the field by +1% to +27% depending on the amulet rarity. Giving a Present to Black Bear grants 3x Sunflower Field Boost + other stuff. Having an active [[Autumn Sunhat]] Beequip with a Sunflower Field Pollen Hive Bonus (+18% to +24% base, up to +44% with Waxing) *Having an active [[Lei]] Beequip with a Sunflower Field Pollen Hive Bonus (+3% to +5% base, not guaranteed, up to +25% with Waxing)

=== The methods below are no longer possible. === * Giving a [[present]] to certain [[Quest Givers|NPC]]s: [[Black Bear]] gave Sunflower Field Boost x5 and other [[items]] in Beesmas 2018. *** In Beesmas 2020, he gave Sunflower Field Boost x3 and other items. *** During Beesmas 2021, he gave Sunflower Field Boost x3 and other items. [[Onett]] gave Sunflower Field Boost x1 and other boosts and items. * Purchasing a Sunflower Field [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Market Boost]] from the [[Boost Market]] will give x1.5 Sunflower [[Field Capacity]], x1.25 Sunflower Field Pollen, x1.05 Pollen, and x1.25 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate at Hive]]. * Redeeming certain expired codes: ** AccentMaster (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Gives Sunflower Field Boost x1 + other stuff) ** 100mVisits (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x6 + other stuff). ** Gel (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** Reboot (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x6 + other stuff). ** SaleEnd (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** ThatGuysCrew (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x6 + other stuff). ** 12HourGeneral (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x3 + other stuff). ** 1mFavorites (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x1 + other stuff). ** NoobashaBonus (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** Trying (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x4 + other stuff). ** 300mVisits (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** 2mFavorites (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** Poke (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x5 + other stuff). ** ClubBasket (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x2 + other stuff). ** Market (Gave Sunflower Field Market Boost + other stuff). ** FuzzyFarewell (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x3 and Sunflower Field Capacity x3 + other stuff). ** BillionVisits (Gave Sunflower Field Winds x10 + other stuff). ** FourYearFiesta (Gave Sunflower Field Boost x4 and Winds x15 + other stuff). ** Millie (Activates Sunflower Field Code Buff + other stuff). == Gallery == SunflowerFieldBoostSparkles.png|The Sunflower Field prior to the addition of Mother Bear. SunflowerSpitRolled2.png|The sunflower's face producing sparkles. Sunflownight.png|The Sunflower Field at [[Day/Night Cycle|night]]. SunflowerFieldTheGames.png|The Sunflower Field during [[The Games]]. File:Sunflower Field Icon.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Field Boost|boost icon]]. File:Hivesticker sunflower field stamp.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker|field stamp]].

== Trivia == * This is the only field in the game where the player can find sunflower seeds that spawn naturally, without the need of [[sprout]]s. * This is the first field [[Black Bear]] assigns a [[Quests|quest]] to. * The [[Badges#Sunflower Badge|Sunflower badges]] and the [[Badges#Pumpkin Badge|Pumpkin badges]] are used 3 times for chances in [[Memory Match]], the most for any field badges. * [[Stick Bug]] will always spawn here when the [[Stick Bug Challenge]] is activated. Stick Bug may return after moving to other fields. * This was the second-biggest field in the game, the biggest one being the [[Clover Field]]. After the [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]], this isn't the case anymore. ** Similar to why the Clover Field was shrunk, this field was decreased in size to make room for [[Mother Bear]] and the [[Treat Shop]], which can be found at the end of the field. * This field along with the [[Pineapple Patch]] and the [[Pumpkin Patch]] are the only fields where an object may come to life and shoot sparkles. * Once in a while, a face will appear on the sunflower closest to the [[Basic Egg Shop]], where it will proceed to shoot magic onto a group of 13 random flowers (in diamond formation), thus generating sparkles. Flowers with sparkles will give random rewards such as [[honey]], treats, and sunflower seeds. (The sparkles are just like the [[Fireflies|firefly]] sparkles.) {{MapNav}} [[Category:Fields]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Colorless]] [[Category:Starter Zone]] [[zh-tw:向日葵田地]]
