{{Consumables|image = Super Smoothie.png|description = Grants the improved boosts of many consumable items combined for 20 minutes!|cooldown = 20 minutes|}} The {{Color|Super Smoothie}} is a [[Crafting|craftable]] [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] added in the [[Updates#2020.06.06|6/6/2020 update]]. When used, it grants the following for 20 minutes: x1.5 [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|Capacity]]. x1.6 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]]. x1.6 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]]. x1.6 [[System Page#White Pollen|White Pollen]]. x1.4 [[System Page#Bee Gather Pollen|Bee Gather Pollen]]. x1.4 [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]]. x1.5 [[System Page#Convert Rate|Convert Rate]]. x1.5 [[System Page#Hive Convert Rate|Convert Rate At Hive]]. * +20% [[System Page#Instant Conversion|Instant Conversion]]. +1% [[System Page#Super-Crit Chance|Super-Crit Chance]]. +6% [[System Page#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]]. x1.25 [[Stats#Speed|Bee Movespeed]]. x1.25 [[System Page#Movespeed|Player Movespeed]]. {{Cost|Red Extract}}, {{Cost|Blue Extract}}, {{Cost|Glue}}, {{Cost|Oil}}, {{Cost|Tropical Drink}}, {{Cost|Purple Potion}}, or {{Cost|Enzymes}} buffs cannot be active simultaneously along with {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=1}}. If any of these buffs are active, when a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=1}} is used, they will be overridden.

== Ways to Obtain== * [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Neonberry|3}} ** {{Cost|Star Jelly|3}} ** {{Cost|Purple Potion|3}} ** {{Cost|Tropical Drink|6}} * Purchasing deals in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]: ** {{Cost|Super Smoothie|50|4=}} are included in the 50 Super Smoothies Pack ** {{Cost|Super Smoothie|10|4=}} are included in the Triumphant Turp Pack * As an extremely rare drop from defeating certain [[mobs]], such as the [[Coconut Crab]] or [[Tunnel Bear]]. * As an extremely rare drop from [[Mythic Meteor Shower]]s. * As a reward from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]]. * As a very rare drop from [[planter]]s. ** {{Cost|Plastic Planter}} have a rare chance of dropping {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} in any field, 36 days cooldown. ** {{Cost|Paper Planter}} have a very rare chance of dropping {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} in any field, 36 days cooldown. ** {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|4=1}} drops 10 Super Smoothies when harvested from the [[Bamboo Field]], 36 days cooldown. ** {{Cost|Candy Planter}} have a low chance to drop {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1-3|4=1}}. * As a reward from certain [[quests]]: ** [[Dapper Bear]]'s "More Than Myth" (#15) gives {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} and other items. ** [[Science Bear]]'s "Corrupting The Glitched Drive" gives {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} and other items.

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * Purchasing certain [[Robux Shop|Robux]] offers: ** Purchasing the Jumbo June Pack for {{Cost|Robux|1,700}} gave {{Cost|Super Smoothie|10|4=}} and other items. ** Purchasing the Honeyday Mega-Haul for {{Cost|Robux|4,500}} gave {{Cost|Super Smoothie|25|4=}} and other items. ** Purchasing the Festive Frenzy Haul for {{Cost|Robux|1,700}} gave {{Cost|Super Smoothie|10|4=}} and other items. ** Purchasing the Magical Mythic Pack for {{Cost|Robux|800}} gave {{Cost|Super Smoothie|5|4=}} and other items. * Giving a {{Cost|Present|||0}} to [[Onett]] during 2020, 2021 and 2022 Beesmases activated the buff. * Completing [[Onett|Onett's]] [[Beesmas]] 2020 Quest rewarded {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} and other items. * [[Spirit Bear]]'s [[Galentine Wind Shrine|Galentine's Shrine]] quest (Beesmas 2020) gave {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} and other stuff upon completion. * Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Mondo Gift Box]] gave {{Cost|Super Smoothie|3|4=}} + other items. * Completing Bee Bear's 10th quest rewarded {{Cost|Super Smoothie|3|4=}}. * Sun Bear’s “⌛Waiting With Sun Bear (6/6): Still Stranded” gives {{Cost|Super Smoothie|1|4=1}} and other items. * Bee Bear’s “Cheering Up Gloomy Cub (5/5): Anything???” gives {{Cost|Super Smoothie|5}} and other items. * Buying the 50 Super Smoothie Bundle from [[Bee Bear’s Catalog]] during Beesmas 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2024 for {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|500}}. * Completing 10th and 20th [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] Beesmas 2022 quests give 3 and 1 accordingly. * Redeeming certain expired [[codes]]: ** 3YearParty (Activated the buff + other stuff). ** RebootFriday (Activated the buff + other stuff) ** FourYearFiesta (Activated the buff + other stuff). ** boo swarm (Activated the buff + other stuff). ** 1MLikes (Activates the buff + other stuff). ** WalmartToys (Activates the buff + other stuff). * As a rare reward from [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]].

|}

==Trivia==

  • This is one of the four [[:Category:Consumables|consumable]] items that increases capacity, with the others being {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee}}, {{Cost|Purple Potion}} and {{Cost|Snowflake}}. {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=}} were once misspelled as "Super Smoothy". The {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=1}} is the consumable that gives the highest number of different buffs in the game. {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=}}' raw ingredients cost: {{Cost|Neonberry|12}} {{Cost|Coconut|60}} {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|600}} {{Cost|Strawberry|5175}} {{Cost|Pineapple|6450}} {{Cost|Blueberry|5175}} {{Cost|Royal Jelly|1035}} or {{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|1.04B|1,035,000,000}}}} {{Cost|Magic Bean|9}} or {{Cost|Ticket|180}} {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=}}' raw ingredients cost (excluding {{Cost|Gumdrops||4=}}' and {{Cost|Moon Charm||4=1}}'s downgrading): {{Cost|Neonberry|12}} {{Cost|Coconut|60}} ** {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|600}} ** {{Cost|Strawberry|450}} ** {{Cost|Pineapple|600}} ** {{Cost|Blueberry|450}} ** {{Cost|Moon Charm|225}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|810}} or {{Cost|Honey|810,000,000}} ** {{Cost|Magic Bean|9}} or {{Cost|Ticket|180}} ** {{Cost|Gumdrops|450}} or {{Cost|Ticket|150}}
  • The {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=1}} is one of the items that cannot be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]]. ** The {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=1}} is also the only craftable item that cannot be donated to the [[Wind Shrine]].
  • [[Bee Bear]] calls this the "ultimate boost granting beverage" in his 2021 Beesmas quest, "Quality Cousin Time". ** The only other mention of a smoothie is by [[Polar Bear]] and his "Thick Smoothie" quest.
  • The {{Cost|Super Smoothie||4=1}} used to have +7% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]] and no [[Critical Hits|Super-Crit Chance]].

docs.text:
{{Tool |price = 40,000 |shop = Pro Shop |pollen = 5 |pattern = Line |time = 0.5 |collectbase = 4 |image =Super_Scooper.png |range = 5 }} The '''Super-Scooper''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that can be purchased in the [[Pro Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|40,000}} |}

It collects 4 [[pollen]] from 5 [[flowers]] in a line every 0.5 seconds, which comes out to a base pollen collection rate of 40 pollen per second.

== Appearance == The Super Scooper is the advanced version of the [[Scooper]]. Its blade is noticeably bigger than the Scooper and has a more rectangular shape along with it's blue and yellow scheme. The handle is the same grey as the Scooper with dark red in the middle. The pole is dark red and has 6 yellow and blue attachments on it. The player holds the Super Scooper so that it appears to be pointing upwards.

==Gallery== Hivesticker super-scooper.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

{{RemovedContent}}[[File:Swarmingegg.png|thumb|The Swarming Egg of the Hive.]] The '''Swarming Egg of the Hive''' is a cosmetic hat that could have been obtained from completing the quest from [[Sun Bear]] during the Roblox [[Egg Hunt 2020]] event. As it is a Roblox hat, players can wear it on their avatar for display. The [[Easter Eggs#Statue of Onett|Onett statue]] on top of the [[hive]]s and the [[Onett|quest giver Onett]] wore the Swarming Egg of the Hive during the event. It could have been obtained from April 7 to April 28, 2020, during the three-week duration of the event. ==Gallery== SwarmingEggTexture.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s texture. Like the [[Flight of the Bumble Egg]] and [[How to Program BASIC|How To Program BASIC]], the Swarming Egg of the Hive does not give any special boosts and is just a Roblox hat that was limited.

{{Beequip}}

The {{Color|Sweatband}} is a [[Bond|level]] 5 [[Beequip]]. It has an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement. ==Possible Stats== {{BeequipStatsTable}} ==Ways to Obtain== As a very rare drop from harvesting the {{Cost|Tacky Planter|||0}}, {{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}}, and {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}}. Completing Robo Bear's Winter 2024 Beesmas quest gives 1 Sweatband and other items. == Gallery == File:Sweatband1.png|A Sweatband in Dapper Bear's Shop next to a Bandage and a Paperclip. File:Sweatband2.png|A Sweatband equipped to a Shy Bee. File:GlitchedSweatband.png|A glitched Sweatband. ==Trivia== It is one of the first beequips added that is obtainable outside of Beesmas. This beequip was released on the [[Updates|2022/04/01 update]]. This is currently one of the only non-event beequips that does not give an extra ability token on its stats. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Beequips]] [[zh-tw:止汗帶]]

docs.title: Swirled Wax
docs.text:
{{Consumables |image=Swirled Wax.png |description=A spiraled hunk of beeswax. Used to redetermine the stats of a Bee's Beequip. }} {{Color|Swirled Wax}} is an [[:Category:Inventory|inventory item]] and a type of [[Waxes|wax]] that can be used on a [[Beequip]] to reroll its stats. Beequips with higher potential have a greater chance of having better stats when rerolled. Swirled Wax has [[Beequip#Stats, Waxes, Chances|Upgrade Value]] of 0.

When used on a Beequip, it will change its stats. If the Beequip has waxes used on it, it will alter the enhancements as well.

When a Swirled Wax is applied to a Beequip, a message pops up saying:

{{Notification||The Wax altered the Beequip's stats}}

Sometimes, the stats won't show any changes when you use a swirled wax; most of the time, you only need to rejoin to fix it.

==Ways to Obtain== * [[Crafting]] it via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Hard Wax|3}} ** {{Cost|Soft Wax|9}} ** {{Cost|Purple Potion|6}} ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|3333}} Purchasing the [[Robux Shop|Royal Winter Wonder Haul Pack]] for {{Cost|Robux|4500}} gives 25 Swirled Wax. As a reward from [[Memory Match#Winter Memory Match|Winter Memory Match]]. Purchasing deals in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]: 1 Swirled Wax is included in the Candlewax Bundle. 10 Swirled Wax is included in the Musical Mega-Bundle. *10 Swirled Wax is included in the Triumphant Turp Pack. * As a stack reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** Auryn rewards 1 swirled wax. ** Pearl Girl rewards 1 swirled wax.

=== Drops === As a rare drop from a Epic Puffshroom. An uncommon drop from a Legendary Puffshroom, and a common drop from a Mythic Puffshroom. As a very rare drop from [[Aphid|Diamond Aphids.]] 3 swirled wax are guaranteed to drop when [[Snowbear]] is defeated at level 13. As a drop from certain [[planter]]s. Planting a {{Cost|Plastic Planter|||0}} in the [[Coconut Field]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Candy Planter|||0}} in the [[Cactus Field]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Blue Clay Planter|||0}} in the [[Spider Field]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Red Clay Planter|||0}} in any field has a rare chance of dropping one, with higher chances in the [[Stump Field]], [[Sunflower Field]], [[Pine Tree Forest]], [[Bamboo Field]] and possibly the [[Blue Flower Field]]. The cooldown time seems to be 7 days. However, Swirled Wax from Pine Tree Forest is guaranteed with a 7 day cooldown. Planting a {{Cost|Tacky Planter|||0}} in the [[Pumpkin Patch]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Pesticide Planter|||0}} in the [[Strawberry Field]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Heat-Treated Planter|||0}} in the [[Blue Flower Field]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Hydroponic Planter|||0}} in the [[Mushroom Field]] guarantees one every month. Planting a {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} in the [[Strawberry Field]] guarantees one every month. {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}} has a high chance of dropping one Swirled Wax in any field. **{{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}} may drop 5 Swirled Waxes with one every month.

===Quests=== [[Dapper Bear]] gives a {{Cost|Swirled Wax|}} on the following quests: ** Dapper Bear's "Means of Mutation" (#5) gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Dapper Bear's "The Long Haul" (#10) gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items. ** Dapper Bear's "The Trick To Tickets" (#11) gives 1 Swirled wax and other items. ** Dapper Bear's "Solitarily Steadfast" (#14) gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Dapper Bear's "More Than Myth" (#15) gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Dapper Bear's "Barter For The Blue Drive" gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Dapper Bear's "Dapper Bear's Samovar" gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Mother Bear's "Waiting With Sun Bear (5/6): And Mother Bear. Again" gives 1 Swirled Wax and other items.

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | During the Beesmas 2020 event, Riley Bee's Honeyday Candles always gave 1 Swirled Wax whenever using it. Giving presents to certain NPCs: Gifted Riley Bee gave 1 Swirled Wax and other stuff during Beesmas 2020 and 2021. * Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] "Snow Cub Reformation (3/5)" 2021 Beesmas quest rewarded the player with 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Completing [[Dapper Bear|Dapper Bear's]] 2021 Beesmas quest rewarded the player 1 Swirled Wax and other items. Opening the Jubilant and Mythic [[Gift Boxes|Gift Box]] gave 2 Swirled Waxes and other items. Buying the Festive Frenzy Haul in the [[Robux Shop]] gave 25 Swirled Waxes. [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] "Red and Blue Beesmas" in Beesmas 2022 gave 1 swirled wax and other items. [[Stick Bug|Stick Bug's]] Beesmas quest 2022 gave 3 swirled waxes and other items. * [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] Beesmas quest 2022 gave 3 swirled waxes and other items. During the [[Beesmas]] 2021 and 2022 events, using Riley Bee's [[Honeyday Candles]] had a 1.63% chance to give 3 Swirled Wax. As a guaranteed drop from a level 13 [[Snowbear]] during Beesmas 2022. Purchasing the Candlelight Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] 2022 gave 10 Swirled Waxes + other items. *Purchasing the Mondo Robo Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|4500}} gave 25 Swirled Waxes + other items. |}

==Tips== Having as many active planters on corresponding fields that can make them drop swirled waxes can help get them. Try to do puffshroom with other strong players, as it can maximize the potential of the puffshroom's levels and amounts summoned. *Make sure to do the [[Honeyday Candles|honeyday candles]] as much as possible.

==Crafting Uses== Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Swirled Wax|250}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Swirled Wax}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |25 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|750B|750,000,000,00}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|75}}{{Cost|Red Extract|750}}{{Cost|Hard Wax|150}}{{Cost|Turpentine|1}} |[[File:Heat-Treated Planter.png|center|80px|link=Heat-Treated Planter]]{{Color|Heat-Treated Planter}}

|- |50 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|5T|5,000,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|100}}{{Cost|Glitter|100}}{{Cost|Soft Wax|250}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|25}} |[[File:Petalplanter.png|center|80px|link=Petal Planter]]{{Color|Petal Planter|||0}} |- |75 |250 [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] quests completed{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|1500}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|150}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Comforting Vial|3}} |[[File:Tide_Popper.png|center|80px|link=Tide Popper]][[Tide Popper]] |- |100 |{{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|100T|100,000,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Magic Bean|500}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|100}}{{Cost|Caustic Wax|100}}{{Cost|Turpentine|25}} |[[File:The Planter Of Plenty.png|center|80px|link=The Planter Of Plenty]]{{Color|The Planter Of Plenty}} |}

==Trivia== This is the first wax to be added to the game. It was added in Beesmas 2020 while the rest were added in Beesmas 2021. This wax, {{Cost|Soft Wax|||0}} and {{Cost|Debug Wax|4=0}} are the only waxes guaranteed to change a Beequip's stats. Before the 12/26/21 update, this item had no favor when donated to the [[Wind Shrine]]. Swirled Wax used to have a limit of 5, but the limit was removed in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/21 update]]. Before the 12/26/21 update, Swirled Wax did not have a wick in its icon design. This is the only wax that was not included in the Waxy Bundle. Swirled Wax's raw ingredients cost: {{Cost|Honeysuckle|90}} {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|900}} {{Cost|Pineapple|4050}} {{Cost|Strawberry|3600}} {{Cost|Blueberry|3600}} ** {{Cost|Bitterberry|99}} ** {{Cost|Neonberry|18}} *{{Cost|Royal Jelly|4602}} or {{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|4.60B|4,602,000,000}}}} {{Items}} [[Category:Inventory]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Waxes]] [[Category:Crafted]] [[Category:Consumables]]

docs.title: System Page
docs.text:
''This page is for stats that apply to the player, collecting [[pollen]], and the hive. For stats that apply to [[bees]], see [[Stats]].'' [[File:SystemPageIcon.png|thumb|The icon for the System Page.]][[File:1-12-2024 update settings menu.png|thumb|A small part of the System Page.]] The '''System Page''' is shown by clicking the cog in the menu bar. It is in between the [[Badges]] page and the [[Robux Shop]] page. Here, the player can redeem [[codes]], send [[Trading|Trade Requests]], view the [[Leaderboards|Global Leaderboard]], use the [[Cub Console]], turn on and off in-game [[music]], toggle Pollen Text, Abbreviate Pollen, allow Trade Requests, display and hide other players' [[bees]], toggle Reducing Strobing Vfx, and toggle Auto-Jelly. Turning off all in-game music only silences the music, not the sound effects (such as the sounds of [[Ability Tokens]] and obtaining [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary]], [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic]], [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]], and [[Bees/Event|Event]]). You can mute all sound by turning off the in-game sound on the Roblox menu.

== Character Stats == The tab also lists many of the player's active stat values, though not all of them. The following values are listed and explained: === Convert Amount === Boosts the base conversion of your bees before multipliers by a certain amount.Example: A [[Basic Bee]] with 20 Convert Amount will convert {{Cost|Honey|100||0}} in 4 seconds instead of {{Cost|Honey|80||0}} in 4 seconds.It can be boosted with [[amulet]]s, the [[B.B.M. Mask]], the [[Honey Mask]] and certain [[:Category:Belts|belts]]. This stat was formerly named 'Conversion Amount' until it was changed in the [[Updates#2019.12.23|Beesmas 2019 update]].

===Convert Rate === Boosts your bees conversion by the following percentage.Example: A Basic Bee with 200% Convert Rate will convert {{Cost|Honey|160||0}} in 4 seconds instead of {{Cost|Honey|80||0}} in 4 seconds.It can be boosted with amulets, {{Cost|Enzymes|||0}}, {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|||}}, {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||}}, [[Buffs & Debuffs#From NPCs|Science Enhancement]], the Conversion Buff, the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Other|Honeyday Event buff]], the [[Badges#Honey Badge|Honey Badge]], [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Diamond Bee]], the Yellow [[Jelly Beans|Jellybean]], Jellybean Sharing Bonus, certain [[Sticker|Stickers]] in the [[Sticker Stack]], some [[Beequip|beequips]] and most [[Bags]]. This stat was formerly named 'Conversion Rate' until it was changed in the Beesmas 2019 update.

===Convert Rate At Hive=== Boosts your bees’ conversion by the following percentage at the [[hive]]. This stat can stack with Convert Rate.Example: A level 1 Basic Bee with 200% Convert Rate and 200% Hive Convert Rate will convert {{Cost|Honey|320||0}} in 4 seconds while converting at the hive, but it will only convert {{Cost|Honey|160||0}} outside of the hive.It can be increased with the [[Badges#Pumpkin Badge|Pumpkin Badge]], Bubble Bloat and certain items. This buff was used to be "Hive Convert Rate" until the 12/26/21 update.

===Bonus Convert Amount=== Increases the base conversion of the player's bees. It can be increased by certain amulets and items. ===[[Loot Luck]]=== Loot Luck is a passive attribute that increases the chances of receiving rewards from defeated [[mobs]]. It can be increased with [[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|Baby Love]], the [[Badges#Clover Badge|Clover Badge]], [[Baby Bee|Baby Bee’s]] Gifted Hive Bonus and certain items.This stat was formerly named 'Luck' until it was changed in the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]].

===[[Critical Hits#Critical Chance|Critical Chance]]=== The chance of your bees hitting stronger or collecting more pollen. More accurately - by how big your Critical Power is.Example: A Basic Bee with 50% Critical Chance will hit with increased damage half of the time.It can be boosted with amulets, {{Cost|Tropical Drink|||}}, [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]], the [[Jelly Beans|Green Jellybean]], Gifted [[Commander Bee]] and certain items. Currently, the highest critical chance a player can have at a time is 88%.

===[[Critical Hits#Critical Power|Critical Power]]=== This stat multiplies how strong a Critical Hit will be. It applies to fighting and pollen collecting.Example: Basic Bee with 300% Critical Power (on critical hit) will hit with the power of 3 Basic Bees (3 damage).It can be boosted with the Ant Amulet, [[Ability Tokens#Melody|Melody]], the [[Badges#Battle Badge|Battle Badge]], Gifted [[Tabby Bee]], Gifted [[Looker Bee]] and with certain items. The calculated max Critical Power is 695%.

===[[Critical Hits#Super-Crit Chance|Super-Crit Chance]]=== The possibility for a critical hit to Super-Crit. Super-Crits deals 33% more damage and collect twice as much pollen as a regular critical hit, and are instantly converted. When a hit is a Super-Crit, there will be a purple color indicating the damage and the '''!''' sign next to it. It can be boosted by having a Gifted Precise Bee, Tabby Blessing, Precision, a precise mark, the Bruteforce upgrade in the [[Robo Bear Challenge]], purchasing Bloxiade in the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]], or using a {{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}}. The max possible Super-Crit Chance you can have at a time is 53% (assuming you are in the Robo Bear Challenge).

===[[Critical Hits#Super-Crit Power|Super-Crit Power]]=== The amount pollen is multiplied by when performing Super-Crits (after applying Critical Power). Super-crit attacks are only increased by 33% as much as Pollen Super-crits. It can only be boosted by the [[Whistle]] and Kazoo Beequips, a [[Cog Amulet]] or temporarily boosted by the [[Dark Scythe]].

=== Bee Ability Rate=== Increases the speed at which the player's bees create [[Ability Tokens]].Example: If it takes a bee about 20 seconds to produce a token, with 20% Bee Ability Rate, the bee is likely to take ~16 seconds to produce the token.Bee ability rate can be boosted by Star Amulets, Motivating Nectar, certain masks, items, bee mutations, and Beequips.

===[[Pollen]]=== Increases pollen from all sources (both from [[bees]] and [[:Category:Tools|tools]]).Example: With 100% pollen, the player can collect 1,000 pollen, and with 110% pollen, it will able to collect 1,100 pollen from the same amount of time and [[flowers]].It can be increased with amulets, [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]], [[Ability Tokens#Inspire|Inspire]], Baby Love, [[Ability Tokens#Mark|Pollen Marks]], the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Other|Honeyday Event buff]], from [[Clouds]], Gifted Basic Bee, Gifted Bear Bee, the [[Jelly Beans|Periwinkle Jellybean]] or with certain items.

===White Pollen=== Boosts your white pollen collection. It can be increased with amulets, {{Cost|Tropical Drink|||}}, {{Cost|Marshmallow Bee|||}}, [[Ability Tokens#Boost|White Boost]], the [[Badges#Spider Badge|Spider Badge]], the [[Badges#Coconut Badge|Coconut Badge]], Gifted [[Shocked Bee]], the [[Jelly Beans|White Jellybean]], Wind Boosts, or with certain items.

===Red Pollen=== Boosts your red pollen collection. It can be increased with amulets, {{Cost|Red Extract|||}}, [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Red Boost]], [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Passives|Flame Heat]], the [[Badges#Strawberry Badge|Strawberry Badge]], Gifted Rad Bee or with certain items.

===Blue Pollen=== Boosts your blue pollen collection. It can be increased with Amulets, {{Cost|Blue Extract|||}}, [[Ability Tokens#Boost|Blue Boost]], with the [[Badges#Bamboo Badge|Bamboo Badge]], Gifted Cool Bee or with certain items.

===Bomb Pollen=== Boosts your pollen collection from all bombs.Example: If the player collects 5,000 pollen with a Buzz Bomb token, with 200% Bomb Pollen they will collect 10,000 pollen from the same flowers.It can be increased with Amulets, [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Ability Tokens|Bomb Combos]], Gifted Bomber Bee, Festive Mark, Black Jelly Bean or with certain items.

===Buzz Bomb Pollen=== Boosts your pollen collection from Buzz Bombs and [[Ability Tokens#Fuzz Bombs|Fuzz Bombs]]. It can be increased with amulets, Gifted Demo Bee, or with certain items.

=== Red Bomb Pollen === Boosts your pollen collection from Red Bombs. It can be increased with Amulets, Gifted Rascal Bee, Festive Mark or with certain items.

===Blue Bomb Pollen=== Boosts your pollen collection from Blue Bombs. It can be increased with Amulets, Gifted Frosty Bee, or with certain items.

===[[Bubble#Bubble Pollen|Bubble Pollen]]=== Boosts your pollen collection from [[bubble]]s.Example: If the player collects 5,000 pollen with a bubble, with 200% Pollen from Bubbles they will collect 10,000 pollen from the same flowers.It can be increased with Gifted [[Bubble Bee]], [[Cog Amulet]], [[Bubble Mask]] or the [[Diamond Mask]].

===[[Flame#Flame Pollen|Flame Pollen]]=== Boosts your pollen collection from [[flame]]s created by bees, [[Ability Tokens|ability tokens]], and [[Passive Abilities|passive abilities]].Example: If the flames collect 1,000 over time, with 200% Pollen from Flames they will collect 2,000 pollen from the same flowers.It can be increased with Gifted [[Fire Bee]], [[Cog Amulet]], or the [[Demon Mask]].

===Bee Gather Pollen=== Boosts pollen collection for all bees.Example: With 200% Bee Gather Pollen, Basic Bee will collect 20 pollen in 4 seconds.It can be increased with amulets, {{Cost|Glue|||}}, Gifted [[Music Bee]], the [[Robux Shop|x2 Pollen from Bees Gamepass]] or with certain items.

===Tool Pollen=== Boosts your pollen collection from your tool.Example: With 100% (base) Pollen From Tools, the player will collect 1,000 pollen with their tool at once. With 125% Pollen From Tools player will collect 1,250 pollen with their tool at once at the same place.It can be increased with amulets, {{Cost|Glue|||}}, Gifted [[Carpenter Bee]], with the [[Badges#Stump Badge|Stump Badge]] or with certain items.

===[[Instant Conversion]]=== Instantly converts your pollen when you are collecting pollen on a field.Example: a Basic Bee with 50% Instant Conversion that collects 10 pollen will make half of it instantly convert into {{Cost|Honey|||0}}. You will have {{Cost|Honey|5||0}} and 5 pollen, so you can collect more pollen.It can be boosted with amulets, {{Cost|Enzymes|||}}, the [[Badges#Dandelion Badge|Dandelion Badge]], the [[Badges#Cactus Badge|Cactus Badge]], Gifted [[Photon Bee]], [[Ability Tokens#Festive Blessing|Festive Blessing]] buff, or with certain items.

===Instant White Conversion=== Instantly converts white pollen you collect, in addition to Instant Conversion. It can be boosted with amulets, the [[Badges#Pineapple Badge|Pineapple Badge]], Gifted [[Windy Bee]], or with the [[Coconut Canister]].

===Instant Red Conversion=== Instantly converts red pollen you collect, in addition to Instant Conversion. It can be boosted with amulets, Flame Heat, the [[Badges#Mushroom Badge|Mushroom Badge]], Gifted [[Crimson Bee]], or with certain items.

===Instant Blue Conversion=== Instantly converts blue pollen you collect, in addition to Instant Conversion. It can be boosted with amulets, the [[Badges#Blue Flower Badge|Blue Flower Badge]], Gifted [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Diamond Mask]], or with certain items.

===Instant Bomb Conversion=== Instantly converts pollen collected by the player's bomb. It can be temporarily boosted by standing in a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|festive mark]], or can be permanently increased by owning a Gifted [[Demon Bee]].

===[[Flame#Instant Flame Conversion|Instant Flame Conversion]]=== Instantly converts pollen collected by the player's summoned flames. It can be boosted by having the Demon Mask equipped, or you can temporarily get 50% Instant Flame Conversion by triggering the [[Passive Abilities#Scorching Star|Scorching Star Passive]].

===[[Bubble#Instant Bubble Conversion|Instant Bubble Conversion]]=== Instantly converts pollen collected by the player's popped bubbles. There are currently no ways to obtain it.

===[[Honey Per Pollen]]=== Allows you to make more {{Cost|Honey|||0}} from the same amount of pollen, which works on conversion, [[Instant Converter]]s, {{Cost|Micro-Converter|||}}, and Instant Conversion.Example: With 200% {{Cost|Honey|||0}} Per Pollen, a player will make 2,000 {{Cost|Honey|||0}} from 1,000 Pollen.It can be increased with the [[Moon Amulet]], the [[Wealth Clock]], the [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Badge]], Gifted [[Gummy Bee]] or Nectar.

===Honey At Hive=== Increases the {{Cost|Honey|||0}} you convert when converting at hive. You can boost this stat with Satisfying Nectar and Balloon Blessing. [[Diamond Bee]]'s Shimmering {{Cost|Honey|||0}} directly multiplies this stat.

=== Movespeed=== Movespeed of your character in studs. It can be increased with amulets, {{Cost|Oil|||0}}, [[Ability Token#Haste|Haste or Haste+]], [[Ability Token#Bear morph|Bear Morph,]] [[Passive Abilities#Coconut Haste|Coconut Haste]], Gifted [[Hasty Bee]], or with [[:Category:Boots|boots]].

===Movement Collection=== Allows the player to collect [[pollen]] when walking on [[flowers]]. The player can get this boost from wearing [[:Category:Boots|boots]] or from a [[Moon Amulet]]. The higher the movement collection, the greater amount of pollen the player collects from walking on flowers. This boost also collects [[goo]] if the player walks on any goo patches.

===Jump Power === Jump power of your character in studs. It can be increased with [[Ability Token#Bear Morph|Bear Morph,]] all boots (except for the [[Basic Boots]]), or the [[Propeller Hat]]. The minimum jump power is 55 and the maximum jump power is 97.

===Defense=== Reduces the damage that you take.Example: If a mob deals 50 damage, with 50% Defense it will deal 25 damage instead.It can be increased with the [[Shell Amulet]], [[:Category:Hats|hats]], or with [[:Category:Guards|guards]]. Having 100% defense means that you take no damage and can be achieved by activating the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|emergency coconut shield]] passive. The maximum defense without the emergency coconut shield is 60%. This is achieved by having the [[Demon Mask]] or [[Diamond Mask]] (+35%), both the [[Crimson Guard|Crimson]] and [[Cobalt Guard]]s (+10% each), and +5% on a Shell Amulet. Defense was originally Damage Reduction.

===Bond From Treats=== Gives additional [[bond]] for your bees when you give them [[treats]].Example: If you feed 100 normal treats (1,000 total bond) to your bee, with 125% Bond From Treats it will grant 1,250 bond instead.It can be increased with the [[Moon Amulet]] or with Gifted [[Puppy Bee]].

===Bond From Battle=== Gives additional bond for your bees when you are defeating a [[mob]].Example: Normally, [[scorpion]]s give 15 bond for each of your bees when you defeat it. With 150% Bond From Battle, your bees will receive 22.5 Bond instead.It can be increased with amulets.

===Honey From Tokens=== Boosts {{Cost|Honey|||1}} that you receive from all {{Cost|Honey|||1}} giving tokens (Honey Gift, Honey Gift+, [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]], mob loot, [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|Coin Scatter]], [[Honeystorm]], and others).Example: A level 2 [[Diamond Bee]] will give {{Cost|Honey|2,000||1}} with its Honey Gift+ token. With 200% {{Cost|Honey|||1}} From Tokens, it will give {{Cost|Honey|4,000||1}} instead.It can be increased with amulets, Gifted [[Honey Bee]], or with certain items.

===[[Bee Attack#Regular Bee Attack|Bee Attack]]=== Makes all your bees, regardless of their colors, deal more damage per hit. It will add one bee attack (Damage) per bee attack stat that you have. Example: With +4 Bee Attack, Basic Bee will attack with the power of 5 Basic Bees (Base Attack + Bee Attack multiplier).It can be increased with amulets, with [[Ability Token#Rage|Rage]], or [[Brave Bee]], or with certain items buffs and beequips.

===[[Bee Attack#Red Bee Attack|Red Attack]]=== Same as Bee Attack, but applies only for Red bees. It can be boosted with amulets or certain items.

===[[Bee Attack#Blue Bee Attack|Blue Attack]]=== Same as Bee Attack, but applies only for Blue bees. It can be boosted with amulets or certain items.

===[[Bee Attack#Colorless Bee Attack|Colorless Attack]]=== Same as Bee Attack, but applies only for Colorless bees. It can be boosted with amulets, or certain items.

===[[Bee Attack#Bee Attack Multiplier|Attack Multiplier]]=== Multiplies attack of all bees, but with a percentage. It can be increased with Amulets, {{Cost|Stinger|||}}, Flame Heat, [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Field|Emergency Coconut Shield]] , Gifted Rage Bee or the [[Demon Mask]].

===[[Goo]]=== Multiplies all collected goo. It can be increased with the Shell Amulet, [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Morph|Gummy Morph]], [[Gummy Mask]], [[Gummy Boots]], [[Passive Abilities#Gummy Star|Gummy Star]], or [[Gummyballer]].

=== Goo Conversion=== Instantly converts pollen equal to the goo gathered, which can convert all the pollen gathered (effectively serving as 100% Instant Conversion) with a high enough Goo Conversion % and Goo multiplyer. It can be increased by amulets, Gummy Mask, Gummy Morph, or Gummy Star.

===[[Capacity|Capacity Multiplier]]=== Gives additional pollen storage by the amount of the percentages.Example: If your backpack can hold up to 200,000 pollen, with 200% Capacity Multiplier, your backpack can hold up to 400,000 instead.It can be increased with amulets, [[Badges#Sunflower Badge|Sunflower Badge]], [[Badges#Quest Badge|Quest Badge]], [[Bumble Bee]]'s Gifted Hive Bonus, [[Buoyant Bee]]'s Gifted Hive Bonus and with certain items. If your capacity multiplier is a decimal percentage, it doesn't show the decimal and rounds the number, but the rounding doesn't affect your capacity.

===[[Field Capacity|White Field Capacity]]=== Gives additional pollen storage by the number of percentages based on the percentage of white flowers in a field.

Example: If you have 15,000,000 Capacity (With Capacity Multiplier) and your White Field Capacity is 180%, your total capacity if in the Spider Field is 27,000,000. It can be increased with things like the [[Gummy Mask]], Exhausted Bee's Gifted Hive Bonus, [[Polar Bear]]'s Ornament and other inventory items. If your capacity multiplier is a decimal percentage, it doesn't show the decimal and rounds the number, but the rounding doesn't affect your capacity.

===[[Field Capacity|Red Field Capacity]]=== Gives additional pollen storage by the number of percentages based on the percentage of red flowers in a field.

Example: If you have 15,000,000 Capacity (With Capacity Multiplier) and your Red Field Capacity is 150%, your total capacity if on a field with all flowers being red is 22,500,000. It can be increased with things like [[Demon Mask]], Riley Bee's Gifted Hive Bonus, [[Gifted Riley Bee|Gifted Riley Bee (NPC)]] Ornament, the Rose Badge and other inventory items. If your capacity multiplier is a decimal percentage, it doesn't show the decimal and rounds the number, but the rounding doesn't affect your capacity.

===[[Field Capacity|Blue Field Capacity]]=== Gives additional pollen storage by the amount of percentage based on the percentage of blue flowers in a field.

Example: If you have 15,000,000 Capacity (With Capacity Multiplier) and your Blue Field Capacity is 200%, your total capacity if on a field with only blue flowers is 30,000,000. It can be increased with buffs like Bucko Bee's Gifted Hive Bonus, [[Gifted Bucko Bee|Gifted Bucko Bee (NPC)]] Ornament, the Pine Tree Badge, and other inventory items. If your capacity multiplier is a decimal percentage, it doesn't show the decimal and rounds the number, but the rounding doesn't affect your capacity.

===Convert Total=== The total convert amounts of all of your bees combined (after conversion modifiers).

===Gather Total=== The total gather amounts of all of your bees combined (before pollen modifiers). ===Ticket Chance=== A stat boost which increases chances of obtaining {{Cost|Ticket|||}}, can be obtained through the [[Moon Amulet]], Festive Wreath, and the now unobtainable ticket chance gamepass.

===Attack Total=== The total attack of all of your bees combined (after attack modifiers).

==Auto-Jelly Settings== [[File:3CDE71CC-E05C-4EAA-A98E-BD3E71C85BCB.jpeg|thumb|right|The Auto-Jelly settings.]] [[File:AutoJellyReminder.png|thumb|The message when an auto-jelly setting is on.]] The '''Auto-Jelly Settings''' can be found at the bottom of the System Page. There are options for {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||}} or {{Cost|Star Jelly|||}} to auto roll until the requirements are fulfilled. It can be used to help players obtain a bee they desire quickly. There are options for the requirement the jelly will roll into:

Until Legendary: Jellies will auto roll until you get a [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary]] or [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic]] Bee. Until Mythic: Jellies will auto roll until you get a Mythic Bee. Require Gifted: Jellies will auto roll until you get a [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] or Mythic Bee. Require Mutation: Jellies will auto roll until you get a [[mutation|Mutated]] or Mythic Bee. Multiple options can be turned on at a time, whilst also making the auto jelly stop on the combined requirement.Example: When the Legendary and Gifted options are turned on, the jellies will auto roll until you get a Gifted Legendary Bee. When the Legendary, Gifted, and Mutation options are turned on, the jellies will auto roll until you get a Gifted Legendary Bee with a Mutation.

If the Until Legendary option or both the Until Legendary and Until Mythic options are turned on, it will auto roll until you get a Legendary Bee or Mythic Bee. If only the Require Gifted option is turned on, it will auto roll until you get a Gifted Bee or a Mythic Bee. If only the Require Mutation option is turned on, it will auto roll until you get a Gifted Bee or a Mutated Bee. If both the Require Gifted and Require Mutation options are turned on, it will auto roll until you get a Gifted Mutated Bee or Mythic Bee.

If the Mutation option is turned on, but the bee you selected isn't radioactive, a pop-up after using a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} will say that you can't auto-roll {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||}} for mutation. Unless the bee is radioactive, you will have to use the {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||}} one at a time.

When using a {{Cost|Royal Jelly|||0}} on a bee with an auto-jelly option enabled, a reminder appears after the message that the auto-jelly option is on. [[File:Extremelyrareautojelly.png|thumb|The extra warning pop-up when selecting extremely rare options.]] If you turn on the following options, an extra pop-up will warn the player that the options they selected are very rare: Mythic and Gifted. Mythic and Mutation. Mythic, Gifted, and Mutation. Legendary, Gifted, and Mutation. [[File:Autostarjelly.png|thumb|An extra warning pop-up that appears when you try to auto-jelly with star jellies.]] When using a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||1}} on a bee, another pop-up will appear, reminding the player that an auto-jelly setting is on and will use as many star jellies as it needs in order to fulfill its requirement. This pop-up will appear even if only the Until Gifted option is turned on. If you are using the Require Gifted option with {{Cost|Star Jelly|||}}, you will still receive the warning, but nothing will happen.

docs.title: Tabby Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Tabby_Bee.png |image-gifted = TabbyBee_Gifted.png |rarity = Event |color = Colorless |energy = 28 |energylabel = more |speed = 16.1 |attack = 4 |skincolor1 = #f99d28 |skincolor2 = #634927 |skincolor3 = #f99d28 |description=This affectionate bee was raised by cats. It becomes a better worker as it warms up to you}}'''Tabby Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] that hatches out of a {{Cost|Tabby Bee Egg|4=0}}, which is currently available in the [[Ticket Tent]] for {{Cost|Ticket|500}}.

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite Treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}, or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Tabby Bee likes the [[Spider Field]] and [[Clover Field]]. It dislikes the [[Cactus Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 160 [[Honey]] in 3 seconds. * +50% [[Energy]], +15% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +25% Convert Speed, +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], up to +1680 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], up to +100 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +50% [[System Page#Critical Power|Critical Power]].

Unlike other bees, this Bee has a unique perk: its stats increase permanently with the collection of tabby love tokens. At 1,000 Tabby Love, this bee has the best Conversion Rate in the game, with its gather amount being surpassed by only [[Digital Bee]]. Its maximum stats are: * Collects 110 Pollen in 4 seconds. * Makes {{Cost|Honey|1760}} in 3 seconds. * Collects 88 Pollen from 3 lines of 4 flowers with Scratch (1,056 pollen).

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Scratch|[Scratch]]]''' Collects 7 (+1 per lvl) Pollen from 3 lines of 4 [[Flowers]]. If Gifted, Scratch always does Critical hits. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Tabby Love|[Tabby Love]]]''' Permanently grants Tabby Bee +1% Gather Amount, Convert Amount, and pollen from Scratch. Stacks up to 1,000 times. ** If at max stacks, Tabby Love grants Tabby Blessing, giving +1% Critical Chance and +25% Critical Power for 20 seconds (+2s per level). If Gifted, it grants Tabby Blessing+, which adds +1% Super-Crit Chance as well.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 4|honey = 160|honeytime = 3|rarity = event}}

== Gallery == Tabby.PNG|Tabby Bee's old hive slot design. Gifted Tabby Bee hive.PNG|A gifted Tabby Bee hive slot. TABBY.png|Tabby Bee's face decal TabbyGoodbye.png|The notification that appeared when the Tabby Bee sale ended. Tabby Love Token Repicture2.png|Tabby Bee's tabby love token. TabbyIcon.png|Tabby Love as a buff on the player bar. Scratch Token Repicture.png|Tabby Bee's scratch token. Picture1.png|Tabby Bee's scratch. First edition tabby.png|A [[First Edition Bee|First Edition]] Tabby Bee.

== Trivia == * When Tabby Bee was added, the maximum tabby love stack was mistakenly set to 500. This mistake was fixed in a later update. * The price of Tabby Bee was 250 tickets when it was originally released. * There used to be an [[Easter Eggs#Tabby Bee Block (Removed)|Easter Egg]] behind the hives, which was a block with a distorted photo of Tabby Bee on it. It was removed around 2 June 2018. This was possibly a hint for one of the [[codes]], more specifically, "Meow", which gave five tickets before it expired. * Tabby Bee is one of three bees to have an official plush on the [https://shop.beeswarm.com/ Official Bee Swarm Simulator Website], the others being [[Basic Bee]] and [[Vicious Bee]]. * Because of a timer glitch that stopped players from buying it early, Tabby Bee returned on sale between June 2 and June 6, 2018. * Tabby Bee was the third Event bee to be added to the game, after [[Photon Bee]] and [[Bear Bee]] respectively. * This bee, Bear Bee, [[Gummy Bee]], [[Puppy Bee]], [[Festive Bee]], [[Windy Bee]], and [[Digital Bee]] are the only Event bees which can be a first edition bee when hatching them during its first release in-game. * Tabby Bee, Bear Bee, Gummy Bee, Festive Bee, Photon Bee and [[Tadpole Bee]] are the only bees to have a gifted bonus that affects their signature ability. * The player’s tabby love stack will not be removed if the player transforms Tabby Bee in any way. * Before the May 23, 2024 update, if the player already had max Tabby Love stacks and collected another one, it would neither increase the existing buff nor have any effect. * Tabby Bee is a reference to [[Onett (Developer)|Onett's]] real-life cat named Sam. This is hinted in one of [[Onett|Onett's]] dialogues in his star journey [[quests]], and later confirmed on Discord. * Tabby Bee, along with Basic Bee and [[Rascal Bee]], are Onett's favorite bees. * Tabby Bee is mentioned in [[Panda Bear]]'s dialogue during his Ultimate Ant Annihilation 1 quest. Like Tabby Bee's description, he said that Tabby Bee was raised by cats. * Tabby Bee is one of the few bees based off from animals other than just bees, the others being [[Lion Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], Puppy Bee, and Bear Bee. Tabby Bee, despite having a 50% energy increase compared to Basic bee listed in its stats, has a base energy of 28, which is only comparable to a 40% energy increase. Tabby Bee can have the highest conversion rate in the game (If it has Max Tabby Love). * This was one of the few bees that could have been summoned from [[Onett's Lid Art]]. ** If a Tabby Bee from Onett's Lid Art produced a tabby love token, the buff would not be removed after the Tabby Bee despawns.

docs.title: Tadpole Bee
docs.text:
{{Bee |color = Blue |rarity = Mythic |image-orig = Tadpole_Bee.png |image-gifted = TadpoleBee_Gifted.png |description= A tiny amphibious bee who wants to become a frog when it grows up. |energy= 10 |energylabel= less |speed= 11.2 |attack= 1 |skincolor1=#45c496 |skincolor2=#2197A5 |skincolor3=#45c496 }}'''Tadpole Bee''' is a [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]].

Tadpole Bee’s favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Blueberry}}.

Tadpole Bee likes the [[Pine Tree Forest]] and [[Stump Field]]. It dislikes the [[Cactus Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 6 seconds. * Makes 120 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. * +40 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], -20% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], -50% Gather Speed, and [[Energy]]. * 🌟[[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +25% [[Bubble]] Duration

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Blue Boost|[Blue Boost]]]''' Grants x1.2 pollen from Blue [[Flowers]] for 15 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Summon Frog|[Summon Frog]]]''' Summons a [[frog]] that lasts for 20s (+2s per Level). Frogs can make [[bubble]]s after every few hops, or after collecting a token with their tongue. They also attack nearby enemies with attack equal to 5x this bee's attack. **If Gifted, this has a 10% (+2% per Level) chance to summon a Gifted Frog instead, which has increased tongue range, Token gathering and attack speed, 50% more attack, has a chance to summon [[Bubble#Golden Bubbles|golden bubbles]], and can hit [[balloon]]s with its tongue to convert pollen to Honey Tokens. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Baby Love|[🌟Gifted Ability: Baby Love]]] '''Grants x2 pollen and +50% [[Loot Luck]] for 30 seconds. Loot Luck increases your chance of obtaining prizes from defeating enemies. * '''[[Passive Abilities#Gathering Bubbles|[Passive:]] [[Bubble#Gathering Bubbles|Gathering Bubbles+]]]''' 65% chance (85% if Gifted) to spawn a Bubble when gathering. If any player touches it, it pops, collecting 4 Red/6 White/8 Blue pollen (+15% per Gifted blue bee type, +5% per bee level) from 29 nearby flowers and causing them to replenish.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 6|honey = 120|honeytime = 4|rarity = mythic|color = Blue}}

== Gallery == Giftedtadpolehiveslot.png|A Gifted Tadpole Bee hive slot. Tadpole Bee Face.png|Tadpole Bee's face. Bssbeesmas2019cover.png|Tadpole Bee with Spicy Bee, Vector Bee, [[Basic Bee]], and [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddies]] in the game thumbnail. Summon frog ability token..png|A “Summon Frog” token. SummonedNormalFrog.png|A summoned normal Frog. SummonedGiftedFrog.png|A summoned Gifted Frog.

== Trivia == * The Tadpole Bee, [[Lion Bee]], [[Tabby Bee]], [[Bear Bee]], and [[Puppy Bee]] are the only [[bees]] to represent realistic animals. ** The Tadpole Bee is the only Mythic bee that represents a realistic animal. * Tadpole Bee and [[Baby Bee]] are the only bees with the Baby Love ability. ** Tadpole Bee and [[Baby Bee]] are also the only bees that appear smaller than the normal bee size. * Tadpole Bee and [[Windy Bee]] are the only bees with 2 gifted bonuses, excluding other Event Bees who enhance their ability. * Tadpole Bee, [[Vector Bee]], [[Fuzzy Bee]], [[Spicy Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]] and [[Digital Bee]] are the only bees with gifted exclusive abilities. * This bee and [[Spicy Bee]] are the only bees who can summon other entities. ** This is the only bee that can summon a [[mobs|Mob]]. * Tadpole Bee and [[Bubble Bee]] are the only bees with the Gathering Bubbles passive ability. * Tadpole Bee, [[Fuzzy Bee]], [[Spicy Bee]], [[Buoyant Bee]], and [[Digital Bee]] all have four different [[Ability Tokens|Abilities]], the most for any bee. * Tadpole Bee used to be the only bee in the game that had a decimal base attack (0.5). * Tadpole Bee is the only Mythic bee that has its Gifted-exclusive ability token shared with another bee. * Along with [[Vector Bee]] and [[Spicy Bee]], Tadpole Bee was one of the first [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic Bees]] to be introduced to the game. * A [[Egg#Specific Bee Eggs|Tadpole Bee Egg]] could be obtained by giving [[Bubble Bee Man]] a [[Present]] during the Beesmas 2020 event. ** Tadpole Bee is the second mythic bee to have an egg of its own, the first being [[Fuzzy Bee]]. * Tadpole Bee is one of the 8 other bees with a unique trail. * Tadpole Bee is the blue counterpart of [[Spicy Bee]]. * Tadpole Bee and [[Fuzzy Bee]] are the only Mythics, when gifted, to not have any glowing parts.

docs.text:
{{RemovedContent}}[[File:TheComputer.png|thumb|The Computer.]]'''The Computer''' is a green screen located between the [[Windy Bee Gate]] and the [[Red HQ]]. It was the core part of the [[Ready Player Two]] event. It has an ellipsis (...) written on it and can no longer be interacted with, despite still being there.

== Interior == When interacted with when wearing the [[Strange Goggles]], the player would see [[Digital Bee (NPC)|Digital Bee]] appear and give the player certain puzzles to complete in order to get the [[How to Program BASIC]] cosmetic hat. Only after the player finished all puzzles given by Digital Bee, the player would then be able to enter the computer to receive a {{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} and Robo Pass (Pass only available during Beesmas 2022) as a reward with the [[How to Program BASIC]] cosmetic floating in Digital Bee's original spot. When inside, the music, overflowin4, that plays in the 30 Bee Zone and 35 Bee Zone is also played here.

== Puzzles == '''Note: The table below shows the guides to completing the three puzzles from Digital Bee. However, these are no longer accessible in the game and remain for archival purposes.''' {| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! style="width:3%" |Puzzle ! style="width:40%" |Guide ! style="width:35%" |Example ! style="width:10%" |Reward |- |Puzzle 1 |Upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will flash 4 symbols, acting as a code. Go to the [[Dandelion Field]] and use your collector to reveal and change to the appropriate symbols left to right, with the first symbol closest to the [[Sunflower Field]]. If done right, a sound will play, and the symbols are replaced with happy faces. |Digital Bee signals '''? * ~ {'''. Therefore, the first symbol is '''?''', then '''''', then '''~''', and last '''{'''. |1x [[Royal Jelly]], [[Honey]] |- |Puzzle 2 |After the first puzzle is done, upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will disappear, and begin teleporting around the Sunflower, [[Clover Field|Clover]], and [[Mushroom Field]]. At a field, Digital Bee will continuously flash 3 symbols, '''& ~ '''. Then, you will have to uncover the hidden symbols with your collector and change them into the right sequence. The combination is always:Sunflower = '''&'''Clover = ''''''Mushroom = '''~'''When entered, the symbols will change into happy faces and a sound will play. |N/A |1x [[Royal Jelly]], 8x [[Gumdrops]] |- |Puzzle 3 |After the second puzzle is done, upon interacting with The Computer, Digital Bee will flash 4 letters. The 4 letters are '''S'''unflower, '''D'''andelion, '''M'''ushroom, and '''C'''lover. In each of the 4 fields, a symbol can be revealed with your collector. In the order of the fields flashed by Digital Bee, reveal the symbols left to right in the [[Blue Flower Field]], with the first symbol closest to the [[Basic Bee Gate|5 Bee Gate]]. If done right, a sound will play, and the symbols are replaced with happy faces. |Digital Bee flashes '''DSMC'''.Dandelion shows ''''''Sunflower shows '''&'''Mushroom shows '''?'''Clover shows '''~'''Therefore, the right combination in this example is '''*&?~'''. |1x [[Atomic Treat]], 8x [[Ticket]] |}

{{RemovedContent}} {{EventInfobox |image= The Games Logo.png |duration= 8/01/2024 to 8/11/2024 |NPC= [[Sun Bear]] |additions= [[Golf]] minigame. Includes golf courses in the [[Sunflower Field|Sunflower]], [[Dandelion Field|Dandelion]] and [[Blue Flower Field|Blue Flower]] fields. }} '''[[w:c:Roblox:The Games|The Games]]''' was a Roblox event that spanned across multiple games. In each participating game, players could earn 8 [[badges]] to contribute to overarching prizes in the main event hub.

In Bee Swarm Simulator, 5 of the 8 badges were awarded for collecting Shines, and 3 of the badges were awarded Silver for completing quests.

==Overview== {{Main|Sun Bear}} Sun Bear arrived at the mountain and brought ⛳ [[Golf|golfing]] to the mountain. He had 3 quests required for the event, each one rewarding a Silver, which contributes to prizes in The Games event hub.

The 5 Shines were located in the following locations: On top of Sun Bear's RV Inside the [[Ticket Tent]]. Inside the [[Noob Shop]]. Next to the flower in the [[Blue Flower Field]]. *To the right of the [[Beesmas Tree]].

docs.title: The Supreme Saturator
docs.text:
{{Sprinkler |title1 = The Supreme Saturator |image1 = TheSupremeSaturatorOriginal.png |requires = 10 Grandmaster Badges |cost = 55,555,555,555 Honey |description = The ultimate sprinkler. Nobody knows how it works or where it came from. |count = 1 |radius = 16 |power = 10 |rate = 1 second |setup = 3 seconds }}'''The Supreme Saturator''' is the highest tier [[Sprinklers|sprinkler]] available for purchase in the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]]. To unlock it, the player must obtain 10 different [[Badges|Grandmaster badges]]. Once the player unlocks it, they can purchase it for 55,555,555,555 (~55.5 billion) [[honey]]. Its description reads, “The ultimate sprinkler. Nobody knows how it works or where it came from."

The Supreme Saturator is a single sprinkler. Its radius extends to 16 [[flowers|flower]] tiles, its rate is 1 second, and its power is 10. This adds up to 8042 [[pollen]] per second, outperforming four [[Diamond Drenchers]] (1809 [[pollen]] per second) by over 340% (4.44x as effective).

== Audio == When a sprinkler is placed in a field, the following audio plays: [[File:Sprinklerbuild.ogg]]

When a sprinkler regenerates flowers, the following audio plays: [[File:Sprinklerwater.ogg]]

== Gallery == TheSupremeSat.gif|The Supreme Saturator regenerating flowers.

== Trivia == * The shape of The Supreme Saturator resembles the head of a [[bear]]. * The Supreme Saturator is currently the most expensive sprinkler in the game. * Before the [[Updates#2021.12.26|12/26/2021 update]], The Supreme Saturator was the second most expensive [[Items|item]] in terms of [[honey]] in the game (excluding [[Hive Slot|hive slots]]), only behind the [[Gummy Boots]]. [[File:Capture.PNGd.PNG|right|thumb|200px|SDMittens obtaining The Supreme Saturator.]] * SDMittens was the first player to buy The Supreme Saturator. She purchased it on September 19, 2018, and an in-game message appeared in every server in order to congratulate her on the achievement. The message said: "Wow! SDMittens has unleashed THE SUPREME SATURATOR on the mountain!" * This is the only sprinkler capable of completely covering a single field; those being: ** The [[Stump Field]]. ** The Mixed, Blue, Red and White [[Retro Swarm Challenge|Brick Fields]]. ** Theoretically, it could also cover the [[Hub Field]] as well.

docs.title: Ticket Planter
docs.text:
{{Planter |image1=Ticket Planter.png |description=Grows in about 2 hours of playtime. Grants Tickets and spawns a Puffshroom! |reusable=No |grow=~2 hours |item=[[Ticket]] |nectar=x2 Refreshing x2 Comforting x2 Satisfying x2 Motivating x2 Invigorating |growbonus=- |pollen=50,000 Pollen |pollenbonus=- }}A {{Color|Ticket Planter}} is a single use [[planter]] that always drops [[ticket]]s when harvested. It's also guaranteed to spawn a [[Puffshroom]] at 100% growth.

Fully grown Ticket Planters gives at least {{Cost|Ticket|10}} upon harvesting.

== Ways to obtain == * [[Dapper Bear]] gives 3 Ticket Planters if the player speaks to him for the first time. * If the player completes Dapper Bear’s quests and they already got Beequip slots from Bee Bear in previous years, they get a Ticket Planter for each Beequip slot. * As a rare reward in Retro Swarm Challenge. * As a rare drop from [[Sprout|Sticker Sprouts]]. * As a Stack Reward for adding certain stickers to the Sticker Stack: ** {{Cost|Dapper From Above Sticker|4=0}} rewards 1 Ticket Planter.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * By completing [[Gifted Riley Bee]]'s 2021 Beesmas Quest. * By buying certain items/bundles from [[Bee Bear's Catalog|Bee Bear’s Catalog]]: ** Buying the Festive Bundle for 5,000 [[Snowflake]]s and 100 [[Gingerbread Bear]]s during Beesmas 2021 granted 10 Ticket Planters. ** Buying the Ticket Planter for {{Cost|Snowflake|100}}. * Opening certain [[Gift Boxes]]: ** Opening the Gilded Gift Box gave 1 Ticket Planter and other items. ** Opening the Jubilant Gift Box gave 4 Ticket Planters and other items. ** Opening the Vibrant Gift Box gave 1 Ticket Planter and other items. ** Opening the Obnoxious Gift Box gave 1 Ticket Planter and other items. ** Opening the Soothing Gift Box gave 2 Ticket Planters and other items. * Using the code "2Billion" gave 1 ticket planter and other stuff. * Purchasing certain Robux packs: ** Purchasing the Cyber Mondo Monday Pack for 800 robux gave 10 Ticket Planters + other stuff. ** Purchasing the 15 Ticket Planters offer for 400 robux gave 15 Ticket Planters. * By completing some of [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 2021 and 2022 Quests. * By buying the ticket planter from Bee Bear's Catalog. * As a drop from [[Robo Party]] mobs. * As a reward for completing your Robo Party. * As a drop from Dapper Bear's [[Samovar]] (Dropped after every 5th use, except the 25th). |}

== Drops ==

{| class="article-table" !Possible Drops List |- |{{Cost|Ticket}}{{Cost|Soft Wax}}{{Cost|Royal Jelly}}{{Cost|Strawberry}}{{Cost|Pineapple}}{{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}{{Cost|Blueberry}}{{Cost|Honeysuckle}}{{Cost|Oil}}{{Cost|Enzymes}}{{Cost|Field Dice}}{{Cost|Whirligig}}{{Cost|Neonberry}}{{Cost|Moon Charm}}{{Cost|Bitterberry}}{{Cost|Stinger}}{{Cost|Gumdrops}}{{Cost|Glue}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Hard Wax|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Super Smoothie|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}} (Rare){{Cost|Caustic Wax|||0}} (Very rare){{Cost|Gold Egg|||0}} (Very rare){{Cost|Turpentine|||0}} (Extremely Rare) |}

== Gallery == File:TicketPlanterNew.png|A newly placed Ticket Planter. File:Ticket Planter 100%.jpg|A fully grown Ticket Planter. File:Pasd.png|A degraded Ticket Planter in a field. File:Sparklingticketplanter.png|A shining Ticket Planter, boosted by a {{Cost|Glitter|||0}} File:TicketPlantersInventory.jpg|Ticket Planters in a player's inventory. File:TurpentineTicketPlanter.png|A {{Cost|Turpentine|||0}} gained from a ticket planter. File:Ticket Planter Token.png|A Ticket Planter token.

== Trivia ==

  • This is one of the two planters that is guaranteed to spawn a [[Puffshroom]]. The other is the {{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}}.
  • This, the {{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}} and the {{Cost|Paper Planter|||0}} share the same base model. ** They also share the same outline for their decals.
  • It is one of two planters that mentions an in-game item in its name, the other planter is the {{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}}.
  • It gives the second-best nectar multiplier in the game, 2x, behind the [[Festive Planter]] with 3x.
  • It is one of 4 single-use planters, the others being the {{Cost|Paper Planter|||0}}, the {{Cost|Festive Planter|||0}} and the {{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}}.
  • This, the {{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}} and the {{Cost|Paper Planter|||0}} are the only one-use planters in the game that can be obtained infinitely.

docs.text:
[[File:TicketShop-0.png|thumb|200px|''The design of the Ticket Shop.'']] ''This page is for the shop that sells tickets. For the shop that sells items for tickets, see the [[Ticket Tent]] page.''

The '''Ticket Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located outside the [[Mountain Top Shop]] to the right of the [[Field Booster]]. It sells [[ticket]]s for [[honey]] in increments of 1, 10, 100, and 500 tickets. It has a similar appearance to other shops like the [[Basic Egg Shop]], [[Royal Jelly Shop]], [[Stinger Shop]] and the [[Treat Shop]], but has a ticket on top, along with its icon on the front and sides. If you buy a ticket, the price to buy another will go up. The maximum tickets you can purchase in total is 50,000 at the max price of 47.3T honey for 500 tickets.

The shop also contains a black semicircle with a grey separator as the vending mechanism, which seems to make it a rotary dispenser.

== Trivia == * After the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], the cost formula was changed. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Shops]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]]

docs.title: Ticket Tent
docs.text:
{{Stores |title1 = Ticket Tent |image1 = TicketTent2021.png |row1 = Behind the [[Red Cannon]] }}''This page is for the shop that sells items for tickets. For the shop that sells tickets, see the [[Ticket Shop]] page.''

The '''Ticket Tent''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located behind the [[Red Cannon]] and near the [[hive]]s. It sells six types of [[Bees/Event|event bees]], [[Egg#Silver Egg|silver eggs]], [[Egg#Gold Egg|gold eggs]], [[Egg#Diamond Egg|diamond eggs]], [[Egg#Mythic Egg|mythic eggs]], and [[Star Treat|star treats]]. They can only be purchased with [[ticket]]s, hence its name. There is also a [[Royal Jelly|royal jelly]] token on top of the Ticket Tent.

== Prices ==

Covers flowers in goo to grant you bonus honey! |- |[[File:Cub Buddy.png|80px|center]]{{Color|Cub Buddy}} |2,000 |A baby bear who follows you around, collecting Tokens and occasionally granting gifts! |}

== Gallery == File:Image 2024-10-10 140310517.png|A player standing out of bounds, next to the Ticket Tent.

== Trivia== The only bee in this shop that could be obtained without tickets (for a limited time) was [[Festive Bee]]. This used to also apply to [[Gummy Bee]], which is now permanently available for 2500 [[gumdrops]]. The Royal Jelly token on top of the Ticket Tent was mentioned by [[Sun Bear]] in his dialogue. Buying a [[Treat#Star Treat|star treat]] from here is one of the only ways to obtain star treats without Robux. Before the [[Updates#2018.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], if the player had the [[Badges#Goo Badge|Goo Hotshot Badge]], they could go up to the Gummy Bee on top of the tent and use gumdrops to enter [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. However, this mechanic was moved to the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] when it was added. The wings on the gifted Photon Bee's model are not transparent, while the giant Festive Bee and Puppy Bees' wings are. Additionally, the wings of the Festive Bee model aren't solid, while the wings of the Puppy Bee and Gifted Photon Bee models are. The Photon Bee is also the only model that is in [[Gifted Bee|gifted]] form. When the Ticket Tent was implemented, the most expensive item was the star treat, costing 1,000 tickets. However, after the Beesmas 2019 event ended, the most expensive item was the Cub Buddy, costing 2,000 tickets. After the 5/23/2024 update, Mythic Eggs now cost the most, at 2,500 tickets. Like the [[Noob Shop]] or [[Pro Shop]], [[Chicks#Spotted Chick|Spotted chicks]] could spawn here during the [[Egg Hunt 2020]] event. [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddies]] used to be sold in this shop, but after the 5/23/2024 update, this is no longer the case. *It is possible to see the back of the Ticket Tent by going out of bounds behind the [[Coconut Field]].

docs.title: Ticket
docs.text:
[[File:Ticket symbol.png|thumb|The {{Color|Ticket|4=1}}.|124x124px]] {{Color|Ticket|Tickets}} are a form of [[:Category:Currency|currency]] added in the [[Updates#2018.4.27|4/27/2018 update]]. They can be used to purchase certain [[items]].

==Ways to Obtain== [[File:TicketShop-0.png|thumb|The [[Ticket Shop]].]] The player can obtain {{Cost|Ticket}} as a reward for acquiring [[badges]]. Collecting badges gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}} for earning Cadet badges, {{Cost|Ticket|10}} for earning Hotshot badges, {{Cost|Ticket|15}} for earning Ace badges, {{Cost|Ticket|25}} for earning Master badges, and {{Cost|Ticket|40}} for earning Grandmaster badges. In total, {{Cost|Ticket|2375}} can be obtained from Badges. ({{Cost|Ticket|2335}} if not counting the currently impossible Sticker Stack Grandmaster Badge.) The player can buy {{Cost|Ticket}} from the [[Ticket Shop]] with {{Cost|Honey}}, located outside the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. The price increases with every {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}} bought. Some [[:Category:Bears|bears]] give {{Cost|Ticket||4=}} as rewards for completing certain [[quests]]. Redeeming certain valid [[codes]]: 38217 (Gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}}). Bopmaster (Gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}}). Crawlers (Gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}}). Roof (Gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}}). Connoisseur (Gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}}). Wax (Gives {{Cost|Ticket|5}} + other items). * Buying them from the [[Robux Shop]] for {{Cost|Robux}}: 1 for 10 ( {{Cost|Robux|10}} per {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}}) 100 for 400 ( {{Cost|Robux|4}} per {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}}) 510 for 1,700 ( {{Cost|Robux|3.33}} per {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}}) ** 1,800 for 4,500 ( {{Cost|Robux|2.5}} per {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}}) The [[Wealth Clock]] gives {{Cost|Ticket}} every hour after interacting with it, and increases incrementally every hour, stopping at the fifth (1 ticket first time, 2 second time, 3 third time, 4 fourth time, and 5 fifth time and onwards). They can spawn as a potential match from Normal, Mega, Night and Extreme [[Memory Match]]es. Clicking on any Hidden [[Sticker]] grants {{Cost|Ticket|1|4=}} each (excluding seeker-stickers). Adding certain [[Sticker|Stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]] grants {{Cost|Ticket}}. *As a Reward for being in the top 100 of any daily leaderboard, ranging from 25, 50 to 100 {{Cost|Ticket||4=}} depending on the leaderboard.

=== Drops=== As a drop from [[Planter|planters]]: The number of {{Cost|Ticket}} it can potentially drop depends on the type of planter. {{Cost|Ticket Planter|||}} always drop {{Cost|Ticket|10+|4=}} when harvested at full growth. As a common drop from [[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteors]]. There is a chance of getting a {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}} as a reward for defeating [[mobs]]. The probability depends on the type of mob as well as the player’s Loot Luck. [[Tunnel Bear]], [[Stump Snail]], and [[King Beetle]] are guaranteed to grant {{Cost|Ticket}} upon defeat [[Wild Windy Bee]] will yield a limited amount of {{Cost|Ticket}} per day. The [[Commando Chick]] will always drop {{Cost|Ticket|1|4=}} upon being captured. *** Capturing it for the 25th time gives {{Cost|Ticket|100}}. Through a {{Cost|Cub Buddy|4=0}} gift. * [[Puffshroom|Puffshrooms]] drop {{Cost|Ticket||4=}} (the rarer the Puffshroom, the more it gives). * [[Honeystorm]]s are guaranteed to spawn {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}} tokens. * As a Retro Swarm Challenge Reward. * As a rare drop from [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gifts]]. * As a [[Sprout]] reward, besides Moon and Debug variants (the rarer the sprout, the more {{Cost|Ticket}} it will yield; rare sprouts and above guarantee {{Cost|Ticket}}). [[Sparkles]] may yield {{Cost|Ticket}}. Very rarely, [[flowers]] may generate a {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}} token. The base probability is around 1/1000 (0.1%), however it does increase with [[Loot Luck]] and [[System Page|Ticket Chance]]. *Activating a [[Golf#Targets|target]] rewards {{Cost|Ticket}} and other items.

=== Token Locations=== On top of the biggest pineapple in the [[Pineapple Patch]]. Grants {{Cost|Ticket|3}}. In the back of [[Red HQ]], near the ceiling (the best way to get it seems to be to get x5 [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]], climb on top of the [[Red Teleporter|teleporter]], jump up and walk on the edge of the leaderboard, and then glide to the {{Cost|Ticket||4=1}}. The enhanced jump ability granted by certain [[:Category:Hats|hats]], [[:Category:boots|boots]], and/or the [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|bear morph]] will also help). * Next to the Glider inside the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. On a platform in the [[Obstacle Courses#Cloud Obby|Cloud Obby]], fairly high above the [[Pine Tree Forest]] and [[Pumpkin Patch]]. Grants {{Cost|Ticket|5}}. (Jump off the tip of the red shoulder guard of the [[30 Bee Gate]], then glide or parachute down to it). On a small ledge between the [[Lion Bee Gate]] and the [[Brave Bee Gate]]. Grants {{Cost|Ticket|5}}. The player must use the slingshot and move to the left. Parachute at the right moment to land on the rock. Alternative: Jump down from in front of the Lion Bee Gate. A Parachute/Glider can be helpful, but not absolutely necessary. * Behind the red shoulder guard of the [[Bear Gate]] (i.e. inside the 30 Bee Area). Grants {{Cost|Ticket|10}}. On the awning over [[Mother Bear|Mother Bear's]] area. (Easily reached from the ramp that leads to the [[Honey Bee Gate]]). On top of the [[Ant Gate]]. Grants {{Cost|Ticket|5}}. Behind the [[Honey Dispenser]] in the [[Obstacle Courses|Lava Obby]]. Upon entering, immediately turn right. Grants {{Cost|Ticket|3}}. This replaced one of the [[Plastic Egg]] locations. Underneath the [[Basic Bee Gate]] ramp, where [[Honey Bee (NPC)|Honey Bee]] used to be. Grants {{Cost|Ticket|3}}. docs.title: Tide Popper
docs.text:
{{Tool |image=Tide_Popper.png |price= (Needs to have 250 Gifted Bucko Bee quests completed) 1,500 Blue Extracts, 150 Stingers, 150 Tropical Drinks, 75 Swirled Waxes, 50 Super Smoothies, 3 Comforting Vials, {{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}} |shop= Blue HQ |pattern= Spike |range= 22 (19 in this image) |time= 0.4 (with tidal surge), up to 1 second (with no tide power) |collectbase= 13 |specialmultiplier= ? }}

{{Quote|quote=Pierce through flowers and bubbles with torrential waves. Ramps up the more you pop, then unleashes tidal waves in a violent surge. Splash Balloons with tall waves to earn Tide Blessing.}}

The '''Tide Popper''' is a [[Tools|tool]] that can be crafted in the [[Blue HQ]]. The player needs to have completed at least '''250''' [[Gifted Bucko Bee]] quests to unlock it. {| class="article-table" ! Crafting Ingredients |- | {{Cost|Honey|{{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}}}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|1,500}}{{Cost|Stinger|150}}{{Cost|Tropical Drink|150}}{{Cost|Swirled Wax|75}}{{Cost|Super Smoothie|50}}{{Cost|Comforting Vial|3}} |}

  • Tide Popper's raw ingredients cost: ** {{Cost|Blueberry|165,000}} (75,000 for Blue Extracts, 67,500 for Blue Extracts for Purple Potions for Waxes, 22,500 for Blue Extracts for Purple Potions for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Strawberry|90,000}} (67,500 for Red Extracts for Purple Potions for Waxes, 22,500 for Red Extracts for Purple Potions for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Gumdrops|90,000}} (67,500 for Glues for Purple Potions for Waxes, 22,500 for Glues for Purple Potions for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Neonberry|1,950}} (1,350 for Purple Potions for Waxes, 150 for Super Smoothies, 450 for Purple Potions for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Royal Jelly|459,975}} (1,500 for Royal Jellies, 3,000 for Tropical Drinks, 144,000 for Enzymes, 144,000 for Oils, 40,500 for Soft Waxes, 40,500 for Purple Potions, 249,975 for Swirled Waxes, 15,000 for Star Jelly for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Stinger|150}}. ** {{Cost|Coconut|4,500}} (1,500 for Tropical Drinks, 3,000 for Tropical Drinks for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Pineapple|57,500}} (15,000 for 300 Enzymes for Tropical Drinks, 6,750 for Enzymes for Soft Waxes for Hard Waxes for Swirled Waxes, 6,750 for Enzymes for Soft Waxes for Swirled Waxes, 30,000 for Enzymes for Tropical Drinks for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Sunflower Seed|57,500}} (15,000 for 300 Oils for Tropical Drinks, 6,750 for Oils for Soft Waxes for Hard Waxes for Swirled Waxes, 6,750 for Oils for Soft Waxes for Swirled Waxes, 30,000 for Oils for Tropical Drinks for Super Smoothies). ** {{Cost|Honeysuckle|6,750}} (3,375 for 675 Soft Waxes for 225 Hard Waxes for Swirled Waxes, 3,375 for 675 Soft Waxes for Swirled Waxes). ** {{Cost|Comforting Vial|3}} (works out to 36 hours of nectar). ** {{Cost|Glitter|450}} (150 Star jellies for Super Smoothies). Note: There may be a few inaccuracies with calculations.

Every 3rd swing releases a wave of water that collects pollen, pops [[bubble]]s, and converts pollen when a bee is hit by the wave.

When a bubble from the player is popped by any means, it grants a stack of "Tide Power" (2 stacks if it was a [[Bubble#Golden Bubbles|golden bubble]]), which grants faster tool swinging speed and stronger waves. Higher stacks grants a stronger buff.

When Tide Power reaches 495 stacks or greater, each swing of the tool will release a large wave. When Tide Power reaches 500 stacks, it is replaced with "Tidal Surge". It lasts for 10 seconds and grants x2.5 to x1.5 tool swinging speed (starting at x2.5 and gradually decreasing until it reaches x1.5), and every swing releases a large tidal wave. Popping a bubble during a Tidal Surge extends the duration of it.

Activating a Tidal Surge grants 1 minute of "Tide Blessing". Whenever a tidal wave hits a Balloon of the player's, it causes the balloon to convert up to 8% of your Convert Total into Honey Tokens worth x2.5 that (these tokens can not be collected by token link) and if the balloon is golden, grants 10 seconds of Tide Blessing. Tide Blessing stacks up to 4 hours, and grants up to x1.2 Blue Pollen, Honey From Tokens, Convert Rate at Hive, Pollen from Bees, and Pollen from Tools.

[[File:Tidal Surge.ogg.ogg|thumb|The sound that plays when Tidal Surge is activated.|313x313px]]

== Gallery== Hivesticker_tide_popper.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]]. Tide popper shop.png|The Tide Popper in the Blue HQ shop. Tide popper glitch.png|The warning sign about the Tide Popper glitch. Waves.png|Waves released by tide popper. Huge Wave.png|Huge Waves released by Tide Popper during Tidal Surge. Tide Power Icon.png|Tide Power buff. Tide Blessing Icon.png|Tide Blessing buff. Tidal Surge.png|Tidal Surge buff. Screenshot 2023-04-19 11.06.38.png|A player holding the Tide Popper.

== Trivia== The Tide Popper was originally called the "Aqua Popper". Its red counterpart is the [[Dark Scythe|Dark Scythe,]] which is sold in the [[Red HQ|Red HQ,]] and its white counterpart is the [[Gummyballer]], which is sold in [[Gummy Bear's Lair|Gummy Bear’s Lair]]. If a wave is as high as a balloon, it can make the balloon convert pollen without Tidal Surge. This is the only blue tool that doesn't multiply the amount of blue pollen. It has the same case as the [[Dark Scythe]]. There is currently a glitch that makes the player holding the Tide Popper have black trails. This is tied with the Dark Scythe for being the fifth most expensive item in the game, both having a cost of {{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}} Honey. In front of the Tide Popper and Dark Scythe is the [[Petal Planter]], costing {{Hover|5T|5,000,000,000,000}} Honey, [[Coconut Belt]] costing 7.5T Honey, the Gummyballer, costing {{Hover|10T|10,000,000,000,000}} Honey, and [[The Planter Of Plenty]], costing {{Hover|100T|100,000,000,000,000}} Honey. If the ingredients for the item were to be crafted, the total cost would be {{Hover|2.5T|2,500,000,000,000}} Honey, 6,750 [[Honeysuckle]]s, 112,500 [[Treat#Sunflower Seed|Sunflower Seeds]], 641,250 [[Pineapple]]s, 528,750 [[Strawberry|Strawberries]], 603,750 [[Blueberry|Blueberries]], 450 [[Magic Bean]]s, 4,500 [[Coconut]]s, 150 Stingers, 7,425 [[Bitterberry|Bitterberries]], 1,950 [[Neonberry|Neonberries]], and 411,150 [[Royal Jelly|Royal Jellies]]. On December 28, 2021, the Tide Popper was obtainable through an exploit that was able to give you the Tide Popper, the same going for the Gummyballer and Dark Scythe. This was later patched by Onett and everybody who used the exploit would get a full reset on their account. On 1/01/2022, there was a [[Glitches|glitch]] where if the Tide Popper was viewed in the shop, it would cause the game to freeze and not let the player exit. There was a glitch allowing players to buy the Tide Popper without completing 250 Gifted Bucko Bee quests. If the Tide Popper was bought without doing 250 Gifted Bucko Bee quests, the item could be equipped after doing 250 Gifted Bucko Bee quests. This was also the case with the [[Dark Scythe]]. *After the [[Updates|05/23/2024 update]], the Tide Popper needs {{Cost|Comforting Vial|3}} and 150 Stingers, more than the previous 0 and less than the previous 200 (respectively) before.
