docs.title: Tools
docs.text:
'''Tools''' are items that can gather [[pollen]]. Some tools have special abilities that help assist in gathering pollen, while some collect better from certain colored [[flowers]], which include white, red, and blue. All tools can be boosted through the [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]] stat. The newest tool in the game was the [[Sticker-Seeker]]. There are currently twenty tools in the game.

Every player starts out with the [[Scooper]]. Better tools can be bought from different [[:Category:Shops|shops]]. The [[Noob Shop]] sells the cheapest tools, ranging from 0 - 14 thousand [[honey]]. The [[Pro Shop]] follows with tools ranging from 40 thousand - 1.5 million honey, while the [[Red HQ]] and [[Blue HQ]] both have 2 tools each that can range from 3.5 million honey - 2.5 trillion honey. The [[Mountain Top Shop]] has the fourth most expensive tools, with prices that range from 20 million - 150 million honey. The [[Petal Shop]] has the third most expensive tool at 1.5 billion honey. Currently, the most expensive tool in the game is the [[Gummyballer]], which can be bought for 10 trillion honey and other various [[Crafting|crafting materials]] in the [[Gummy Bear's Lair]]. Unlike any other tool, the Gummyballer can directly take [[goo]] off a field.

The player can auto-click their pollen collector by holding down the mouse button on a computer. On a mobile device, holding on an open part of the screen does the same. Using [[Glue]] gives a 10-minute boost that grants x1.25 pollen from tools and bees. Using a [[Purple Potion]] can also give x1.25 [[System Page#Capacity Multiplier|Capacity]], x1.25 [[System Page#Convert Rate At Hive|Convert Rate At Hive]], x1.5 [[System Page#Red Pollen|Red Pollen]], x1.5 [[System Page#Blue Pollen|Blue Pollen]], x1.3 [[System Page#Pollen From Bees|Bee Gather Pollen]], and x1.3 [[System Page#Pollen From Tools|Pollen From Tools]] for 15 minutes. There is also a glitch for computer in which holding down click then Ctrl + Esc or Alt + tab automatically uses your tool, but clicking the screen removes it. This can also be achieved by moving the mouse outside of the boundaries in windowed mode, but it can only be done on the launcher version of the app. If the player presses backspace while a tool is equipped the tool will fall into the ground and the player appears to have no tool in their hand.

Twenty tools are currently available in the game:

Scooper Rake Clippers Magnet Vacuum Super-Scooper Pulsar Electro-Magnet Scissors Honey Dipper Bubble Wand Scythe Sticker-Seeker Golden Rake Spark Staff Porcelain Dipper Petal Wand Tide Popper Dark Scythe Gummyballer [[Category:Tools]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Gameplay]]

{{Bear |image = TopBear.png |type = Shop Bear |location = Mountain Top Shop |bees = 25 |basecolor1 = #b89924 |basecoloramount = 1 |shadecoloramount = 1 |shadecolor1 = #b89924 |snoutcoloramount = 1 |snoutcolor1 = #b89924 |torsocolor1 =#ffffff |torsocoloramount = 1 |armscolor = #9f851f |legscolor =#c6d77a |enableother = n }}'''Top Bear''' is a [[bear]] who runs the [[Mountain Top Shop]]. Like other Shop Bears, Top Bear's presence is not required to make any purchases in the shop.

Top Bear's appearance is yellow skin, white shirt, green pants, and a smiley face. Top Bear is similar to [[Noob Bear]] and [[Pro Bear]], as the only difference between them is the colors of their clothing.

== Trivia == * Top Bear is the only NPC in the [[Lion Bee Gate|25 Bee Zone]]. * This bear is one of the six bears without any function quest-wise, the other five being [[Noob Bear]], [[Pro Bear]], [[Shadow Bear]], [[Tunnel Bear]] and the [[Snowbear]]. ** This bear, Noob Bear, Pro Bear, and Shadow Bear are the only bears without a function whatsoever. Unlike the other Shop Bears, Top Bear was introduced in [[Updates#2018.07.11|7/11/2018 update]], whereas the other two Shop Bears were already present when the game was released. This means that the Mountain Top Shop was once not run by any bears. Before the [[Updates#2019.09.28|9/28/2019 update]], players were able to cause a [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] to damage or even kill Top Bear if they stood near him. This was later patched in said update, where the bear was given infinite health.

docs.title: Trading
docs.text:
[[File:Trading Frame.png|thumb|Two players trading in the trading menu.]] '''Trading''' is a mechanic added in the [[Updates|1/12/2024 update]], which allows players to trade [[Beequip]]s, [[Cub Buddy|Cub Buddy Skins]] and [[sticker]]s. The trade request menu can either be opened by going to [[System Page|settings]] or walking over a player's hive and accepting the prompt for a trade request. You can add or remove an item by interacting with the button in the top left corner of the item. When ready, both players select the accept button before waiting 5 seconds. Once the 5 seconds are over, the trade menu closes, and both players receive their items and get taken to the items' stats.

Trading can be done an unlimited number of times to an unlimited number of players. But you cannot trade with multiple players at a time. A player has to accept or decline a trade request before being able to get a trade request from the same player again. You can also change whether you can receive trade requests by going into settings and finding "Allow trade requests". A player can be ineligible to receive trade requests for either not having unlocked trading yet or having their trade requests disabled. The requirements for unlocking trading are:

20 [[Bees]] [[Badges#Playtime Badges|Playtime Cadet Badge]] (8 hours of playtime) If a player is unable to receive trading requests, one of two messages will appear depending on which reason it is. If they don't have trading unlocked, then: "[{Player} has not unlocked trading (20 Bees and Playtime Cadet Badge)]" else if it's because they have trading requests disabled: "[{Player} has disabled trading]". If the player decides to cancel a trade, both players keep their items, and the trade menu closes before a popup appears telling both players that the trade has been cancelled.

== Tips == '''Beware of scams involving cross-trading and trust trades.''' Make sure that the items traded are of similar value before accepting the trade. '''Make fair and cancel unfair trades.''' If you make an unfair trade, or if the other player makes an unfair trade, it is likely that the trade will be cancelled, and you should cancel an unfair trade. *'''Use the item inspector.''' You should use the item inspector to your advantage to make sure the item's balanced (if you are also a collector) also take the item's rarity into consideration. The item inspector is a must in ensuring that Beequips have the stats that you are looking for.

==Gallery== Tarrorws2.png|The trading arrows that appear whenever you initiate a trade with a player. Tradesent.png|A player sending a trade request to another player. Player would like to trade.png|The pop-up that shows up when another player sends you a trade request. Send trade request.png|The menu that pops up when the player would like to trade with another. Tradecompleted.png|Both players agreeing upon a successful trade. Completedtrade.png|A trade being completed. Canceledtrade.png|A trade being cancelled. StickerCannotBeTraded.jpg|The pop-up that appears if an unqualified player attempts to trade a Gamer Chat Icon or Play Button sticker. NoCubBuddy.png|The pop-up that appears if a player tries to trade a cub skin to another player who has not unlocked a Cub Buddy. Tradelocked.png|A player's trading being locked because of requirements.

==Trivia== *The item inspector in the trading menu is the only official way to see the methods of obtainment for the Play Button and Gamer Chat Icon stickers, as they do not appear in the Sticker Index. [[Category:Mechanics]]

{{Consumables |image = Translator.png |description = A device used to decipher languages you don't understand. |cooldown = N/A }} {{Color|Translator|Translators}} are [[:Category:Inventory|inventory items]] that allow the user to speak with [[Gifted Riley Bee]], [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], and [[Stickbug|Stick Bug]].

To use a translator, the player needs to talk to the [[:Category:NPC|NPC]] they want to use the translator on. The NPC will talk to the player in its language. It will then prompt the player the option to give the translator to the NPC or leave. Clicking on the option to give the NPC the translator will allow the player to talk and receive quests from the NPC.

Translators are single-use - once the player gives an NPC a translator, the translator will be taken away from their inventory, but the player will be able to speak with them forever. If the player accidentally uses a translator on an NPC, they can leave the game as the translator only gets taken away after the player finishes speaking to that NPC.

All three translators can only be obtained from [[Science Bear]]. He rewards the player with a translator after completing the following quests: "Limits of Language", "Beesperanto", and "Epistemological Endeavor" (which are the 21st, 26th and 31st quests).

== Trivia == The player can acquire a total of three translators throughout the game so that they can speak to all three of the NPCs that require them. Without translators, it is impossible to take quests, receive rewards, talk or give presents to [[Gifted Bucko Bee]], [[Stick Bug]], and [[Gifted Riley Bee]]. Translators were originally implemented in the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]] when [[Science Bear]] received an additional 10 quests. Only two were available at that time, as the third could only be obtained in Epistemological Endeavor, which is Science Bear's last quest. His last 5 quests weren't added until [[Updates#2018.12.19|12/19/2018]], thus making the total amount of translators available 2 at the time. There is a 5 quest difference between each translator, Limits of Language being the 21st quest, Beesperanto being the 26th, and Epistemological Endeavor being the 31st. This is one of the two unique items that can only be obtained while completing a [[:Category:Bears|bear]]’s questline, the other being {{Cost|Spirit Petal}} from [[Spirit Bear]]. This is one of the only items that can be given to an NPC, the other item being {{Cost|Present}}. Trying to give Gifted Riley, Gifted Bucko, or Stick Bug a present without giving it a translator will result in the regular dialogue being displayed. {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Inventory]]

docs.text:
[[File:Treatdispenser.png|thumb|The Treat Dispenser.]] The '''Treat Dispenser''' is a [[dispenser]] located between the [[Pineapple Patch]] and the entrance of the [[Pro Shop]]. It allows members of the [https://www.roblox.com/My/Groups.aspx?gid=3982592 Bee Swarm Simulator Club] to collect a number {{Cost|Honey||4=0}}, {{Cost|Treat||4=}}, {{Cost|Pineapple|1|4=}}, and [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] x5 every hour. The number of {{Cost|Treat||4=}} varies, depending on the number of [[bees]] the player has.

If a player tries to use the Treat Dispenser without being in the group, they will get a prompt saying they must join the Bee Swarm Simulator Club.

[[File:Treat-removebg-preview.png|thumb|right|225x225px|The Treat Shop in-game.]] The '''Treat Shop''' is a [[:Category:Shops|shop]] located to the left of [[Mother Bear]]. A player can buy treats in increments of 1, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, 100,000, 1,000,000, 10,000,000, 100,000,000, 1,000,000,000 and 10,000,000,000.

{{Consumables |image=Treat.png |description=Increases your bond with a bee by 10. }} A {{Color|Treat}} is a type of [[Treats|treat]] that can be fed to a [[Bees|bee]] to raise its bond by 10. They are the easiest '''treat''' to obtain but are not the favorite treat of any bee. They can also be used to craft the [[Honey Mask]] where 9,999 '''treats''' are needed. [[File:Treat token.png|thumb|A treat token.]] == Ways to Obtain == * Using the [[Treat Dispenser]] near the [[Pro Shop]]/[[Pineapple Patch]] (Like the [[Honey Dispenser]], this requires being a member of the [https://www.roblox.com/groups/3982592/Bee-Swarm-Simulator-Club#!/about BSS Club]). * Buying from the Treat Shop next to under Mother Bear's awning for {{Cost|Honey|100}} per treat and capping out at {{Cost|Honey|10,000}} per treat. * As a reward from [[Memory Match|memory matches]]. * As a stack reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** The Fork And Knife rewards 500 treats.

=== Drops === * Farming in the [[Dandelion Field|Dandelion]], [[Mushroom Field|Mushroom]], [[Clover Field|Clover]], [[Spider Field|Spider]], [[Cactus Field|Cactus]], [[Pumpkin Patch|Pumpkin]], [[Coconut Field|Coconut]], or [[Stump Field|Stump]] Fields. ** Drops from [[leaves]] in these fields may also yield treats. * A relatively high chance of dropping from [[Rhino Beetle|rhino beetles]], [[ladybug]]s, [[spider]]s, [[mantis]]es, [[scorpion]]s, [[Werewolf|werewolves]], [[aphid]]s, [[Stick Bug]], [[Stick Nymph]]s, [[Tunnel Bear]], [[King Beetle]], and [[Stump Snail|stump snail]]. * A guaranteed drop from [[Mondo Chick]]s. * 2nd and 3rd capture of [[Commando Chick]] rewards 2 and 5 treats respectively. * "Playing" [[Ability Tokens#Fetch|Fetch]] with [[Puppy Bee]]. * As a drop from a [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift]] or [[Ability Tokens#Festive Mark|Festive Mark]]. * As a gift from a [[Cub Buddy|cub buddy]]. * As a reward for completely growing any kind of [[sprout]] except for Gummy and Debug sprouts. * Harvesting [[sparkles]]. * As a drop from [[Puffshroom]]s. * As a drop from Planters, which include: ** {{Cost|Plastic Planter}} ** {{Cost|Candy Planter}} ** {{Cost|Red Clay Planter}} ** {{Cost|Tacky Planter|}} * Activating certain [[Target|targets]] grants a small amount of treats. * Using Beesmas Feast during Beesmas Will give treats and other items.

=== Quests === Black Bear gives treats on the following quests: Get Red-y gives 100 treats. One Stop On The Tip Top gives 200 treats. Blue Mushrooms 2 gives 300 treats. Pretty Pumpkins gives 400 treats. Black Bear, Why? gives 500 treats. Bee A Star gives 1,000 treats. The [[Egg#Mythic Egg|Mythic Egg]] questline gives treats on all quests, at a sum of 195,500 treats. '''Treats''' are items which grant [[bond]] to [[bees]]. There are currently twelve different types of treats.

To feed treats to their bees, players must go to their [[hive]] and open their item menu. The player must then drag the treat from the menu and to the cell of the bee to be fed, and then either type in the number of treats to feed that bee, use all of the selected treats or if possible, feed the number of treats needed to level up the bee. If the player is feeding a bee their favorite treat, gingerbread bears, or aged gingerbread bears, there is an "Until [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]]" option that automatically rolls until the bee becomes gifted, similar to using [[System Page#Auto-Jelly Settings|auto-jelly]]. The player cannot feed other player's bees.

==Notes== *According to [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]], the chance to get a Gifted bee from feeding favorite treats varies depending on their rarity. The chances are 1 in 8,000 for [[Bees/Rare|Rare bees]], 1 in 10,000 for [[Bees/Epic|Epic bees]], 1 in 12,000 for [[Bees/Legendary|Legendary]] and [[Bees/Common|Common bees]], and 1 in 24,000 for [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bees]].

[[File:Capture1136.png|thumb|400px]]

==Trivia== A singular star treat or atomic treat gives the most [[bond]] (1,000 bond), followed by a single neonberry and aged gingerbread bear (500 bond), then gingerbread bears and moon charms (250 bond). Before the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], when asked to feed strawberries or blueberries to a [[Bees|bee]], the plural was incorrectly spelled as "Strawberrys" and "Blueberry" instead of "Strawberries" and "Blueberries." ** However, when using fruit to craft gumdrops, for example, it is still spelled as "Blueberrys" and "Strawberrys." Despite being mentioned by Spirit Bear as once being a Blueberry Field, the Blue Flower Field doesn't seem to yield more blueberries than other blue fields. * Treats, pineapples, strawberries, and blueberries are the only treats that can be obtained from dispensers. There is a [[Glitches|glitch]] in which dragging an item that is not a treat (ex: magic bean, gumdrops) to the bee causes the hive slot to turn red. [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] has said that bees don't actually eat the treats, instead, they take them as gifts and hide them in [[fields]] for others to find, though Mother Bear says to feed a treat to a bee in her first quest. Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], moon charm tokens from [[fireflies]] didn't glow. * Before Beesmas 2019 ended, star treats were the most expensive [[Items|item]] in the [[Ticket Tent]], at the price of 1,000 [[ticket]]s. Since then, the cub buddy went on sale for 2,000 tickets. The mythic egg is currently the most expensive item after the removal of cub buddy from the Ticket Tent, at 2,500 tickets. Before the [[Updates#2019.02.01|2/1/2019 update]], [[Puppy Bee|Puppy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Fetch|Fetch]] treat and [[Ability Tokens#Festive Gift|Festive Gift's]] treat tokens were the only treats that the player could collect with [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]]. A normal treat resembles a [[Basic Bee|Basic Bee's]] face. A star treat is the only treat that cannot be obtained from sprouts. The star treat formerly gave 100 bond instead of 1,000. * The pineapple used to be the only treat to have 9 bees favorite it, with other treats having 8 or less bees. ** Currently, the strawberry is the only treat to have 8 bees favorite it, as the other treats now have 9 bees. The bitterberry resembles the real-life ''solanum mammosum'', also known as a fox head or a nipplefruit. The moon charm is the only item that gives bond that can be crafted in the blender. * Donating treats like blueberries and strawberries to the Wind Shrine can help get certain colored field winds, depending on the color of the fruit. Before the 12/26/21 update, any type of treat (besides neonberry) could only be given to a bee by 1, 50, or all/level up {number of treats}. At the end of [[Bee Bear]]'s quest, "By Golly, Get Jolly," Bee Bear states that star treats have a favorite song as a joke. If the player tries to feed a bee using an input that isn't a number, only one treat gets fed to the bee. The Sunflower Seed is the only main treat that cannot be accessed through shops or dispensers.

docs.title: Tunnel Bear
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Tunnel Bear |image =TunnelBear.png |location = [[White Tunnel]] |timer = 48 hours (2 days), 40 hours 48 minutes (1.7 days) if Gifted Vicious Bee is in the player's hive. |hp = 10,000 |damage = 1,000 |points = 200 |bond = 1,000 per bee |honey = 5,000,000 |level = 9}}''Not to be confused with [[Shadow Bear]], a similar-looking bear inside the [[Bear Gate|30 bee gate]].''

'''Tunnel Bear''' is a hostile level 9 [[:Category:Bosses|boss]] [[mob]].

Tunnel Bear spawns in the [[White Tunnel]]. The entrance to the White Tunnel sits underneath the [[Instant Converter]] near [[Science Bear]].

Tunnel Bear respawns every 48 hours (2 days), but it can instead respawn every 40 hours and 48 minutes (1.7 days) if [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]] is in the player's hive.

== The White Tunnel == {{Main|White Tunnel}} To enter the White Tunnel, go to the Instant Converter near the [[Pineapple Patch]]. Players can either jump through the chimney on the top or go in the right end of the Instant Converter and then drop down into the chute. Alternatively, players can climb up the hill to the [[Yellow Cannon]]/Science Bear and jump down from there.

Upon entering the White Tunnel, players will land in a small entryway with two green walls and two white walls. One of the white walls looks semi-transparent. Go through the semi-transparent white wall to find the tunnel. You have to move a little bit after going through the white wall as Tunnel Bear will quickly drop down through the roof near the entrance. The walls will also gradually get narrower, making it harder to turn back as players head deeper into the White Tunnel.

If Tunnel Bear does not appear and instead a countdown timer floats in mid-air, then that means the player will need to wait for the countdown on the respawn timer to finish before battling Tunnel Bear again.

To exit the White Tunnel, stand on top of the Teleport Pad and use it. The Teleport Pad will teleport the player on top of the Instant Converter near the [[Sunflower Field]]. The Teleport Pad looks like a flat gray circle that sits in the middle of the White Tunnel.

==Basic Strategies== Tunnel Bear possesses 10,000 health and can instantly kill players if they touch/get too close to Tunnel Bear ("Too close" is not the same as "touching," as the hitbox is bigger than its body). However, Tunnel Bear moves very slowly at a constant speed without ever speeding up, and on a very predictable path as it heads straight towards the player's location. Because of this, players could follow the recommended strategy of walking in front of Tunnel Bear and staying just close enough for their bees to keep attacking while leading it down the tunnel.

When entering the tunnel, keep Tunnel Bear near the beginning of the White Tunnel and keep close to one of the walls on the sides (this will only slow the bear a little bit because now he has no collisions), and occasionally jump around Tunnel Bear. This alternative will only work at the beginning (before the exit) because the White Tunnel narrows down the further players go down it, trapping them if they travel too far in. However, this should be the chosen strategy for the first defeat as to ensure getting the gifted egg. If the player's bees are mostly level 9, they will not have to jump around it, as their bees will most likely kill it first.

When Tunnel Bear spawns, players will only get 2 minutes and 30 seconds to defeat it. The timer is directly above its head, showing how much time remains for players to defeat it until it despawns. Note that it takes Tunnel Bear less than two and a half minutes to traverse the entire length of the White Tunnel.

If the player defeats Tunnel Bear too late, some items may appear outside of the tunnel past the winking eye face. This isn't an issue however, as Tunnel Bear's tokens automatically collect before they despawn.

If needed, the player can pre-activate [[Ability Tokens#Rage|Rage]], [[Ability Tokens#Focus|Focus]] and precision using the [[Pineapple Patch]] enemies or [[Stump Snail]] in the [[Stump Field]] to get certain bees to spawn the tokens.

==Drops== Note that unlike the other mobs, Tunnel Bear drops its tokens in a straight line when it is defeated.

Note: Players can possibly get more than one of a single type of drop (for example, ''50 treats'' and ''500 treats'' from the same defeat). Likelihood of all of these drops increases based on [[Loot Luck]]. {| class="article-table" |- |{{Cost|Royal Jelly}} (Increments of 5, 10, 20, or 50){{Cost|Ticket}} (Increments of 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, or 100){{Cost|Gumdrops}} (Increments of 25-250){{Cost|Treat}} (Increments of 15-50, 100, 500, 5000, or 50,000){{Cost|Sunflower Seed}} (Increments of 50-500){{Cost|Pineapple}} (Increments of 50-500){{Cost|Micro-Converter}} (Increments of 1, 5, or 10){{Cost|Bitterberry}}{{Cost|Enzymes}} (Increments of 1, 3, 5, or 10){{Cost|Oil}} (Increments of 1, 3, 5, or 10){{Cost|Magic Bean}} (Increments of 1, 3, 5, or 10){{Cost|Moon Charm}} (Increments of 5, 20, 40, or 100){{Cost|Robo Pass}} (Uncommon){{Cost|Ant Pass|4=0}} (Uncommon){{Cost|Glitter}} (Somewhat Rare, Increments of 1, 5, 10, or 25){{Cost|Star Jelly|4=0}} (Rare){{Cost|Loaded Dice|4=0}} (Rare){{Cost|Diamond Egg|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Gifted Silver Egg|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Gifted Gold Egg|4=0}} (Very Rare){{Cost|Baby Bee Egg|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Gifted Diamond Egg|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Black Balloon|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Night Bell|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Purple Potion|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Basic Black Hive Skin|4=0}} (Extremely Rare){{Cost|Super Smoothie|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare){{Cost|Star Egg|4=0}} (Exceptionally Rare){{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} (Beesmas Only, increments of 1 or 5){{Cost|Beesmas Tree Hat|4=0}} (Beesmas only){{Cost|Black Diamond Sticker|4=0}} (Unbelievably Rare){{Cost|Black Star Sticker|4=0}} (Unbelievably Rare){{Cost|Bear Bee Voucher|4=0}} (Nearly Impossible)

==Tips to Defeat== '''Own bees with a high [[Bee Attack|attack]] stat.''' Bees such as [[Cobalt Bee]], [[Brave Bee]], [[Crimson Bee]], [[Demon Bee]], [[Vicious Bee]], [[Lion Bee]], [[Riley Bee]], [[Bucko Bee]], [[Precise Bee]], [[Spicy Bee]], and [[Rage Bee]] deal higher amounts of damage than other [[bees]], making them more useful when fighting Tunnel Bear (or any other [[mob]]). '''Own bees that boost fighting stats.''' Some specific bees will raise the effectiveness of the entire [[hive]], either by boosting Attack ([[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] Rage Bee or Gifted Brave Bee), by boosting [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]] (Looker Bee, [[Music Bee]] or Gifted [[Commander Bee]]), by boosting [[Critical Hits|Critical Power]] (Gifted [[Looker Bee]], Gifted [[Tabby Bee]], or Music Bee) or by boosting [[Critical Hits#Super-Crit|Super-Crit]] Chance and Power (Gifted Precise Bee). '''Own bees that create [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] tokens.''' [[Music Bee]], [[Rage Bee]], [[Exhausted Bee]], and [[Shocked Bee]] possess the Token Link ability. Equipping the [[Paper Angel]] [[beequip]] on a valid bee teaches it Token Link as well. If a token appears too close to Tunnel Bear, use the Token Link instead of going back to get said token. That way, the player will not risk dying to Tunnel Bear. '''Have high [[energy]] bees.''' Bees such as [[Photon Bee]] and [[Exhausted Bee]] have endless energy, and [[Bumble Bee]], [[Shy Bee]], Lion Bee, [[Buoyant Bee]], [[Fuzzy Bee]], Precise Bee, [[Vector Bee]], [[Gummy Bee]], and [[Vicious Bee]] have at least double the energy of a typical bee. If the player's bees have low energy, then their bees will most likely go to sleep after just a few attacks. One method to refill essential bees' energy levels is to fight mobs until they go to sleep and recharge, as this will increase the player's odds of defeating Tunnel Bear faster. The player can also use the [[Glitches#Sleepy Bees|sleep glitch]] so their bees start with their max energy. Completing [[Polar Bear]]’s quests can also help increase bee energy. '''[[Bond|Level]] up bees to Level 9 or higher.''' Bees with a lower level than the mob will most likely miss when they attack. Bees with levels much lower than the level of the mob will have a higher chance of missing their attacks on the mob. Bees with an equal Level or higher Level than the mob will never miss it. During Beesmas 2020 and 2021, bees summoned when gandering at [[Onett's Lid Art]], using [[Honeyday Candles]], or using the [[Gummy Siege]] might be able to help defeat Tunnel Bear. '''Stay logical.''' If players know that they cannot beat Tunnel Bear with the length of the tunnel, or if they keep dying, they should not keep trying to continue battling it. Instead, they should focus on getting better bees and equipment that can help them defeat it. The player should also wait until they can defeat it fast enough before it reaches the end of the tunnel since the tokens can despawn outside of the tunnel. '''Move a distance from the start of the White Tunnel.''' Tunnel Bear can drop down at unexpected moments, instantly crushing players upon impact. If they make sure to keep a safe distance, Tunnel Bear will instantly start walking toward the player once he gets down. '''When Tunnel Bear gets to low health, do not do risky actions.''' Whenever Tunnel Bear gets to low health, DO NOT attempt to go for [[Ability Tokens|tokens]], such as rage tokens that sit near Tunnel Bear. Just keep going until it is defeated. * '''Keep a safe distance away from the Tunnel Bear.''' Players often die because they do not keep their distance. The farther players stay away from Tunnel Bear, the more space they get to collect tokens, but they should not stay out of the range that bees attack within, or the bees will stop fighting and just follow the player. '''Know a method.''' If players decide to do the turn around method, they should remember to avoid going past the Teleport Pad or back into the drop location since the Teleport Pad will prevent players from successfully turning around, while the entryway will cause Tunnel Bear to despawn. '''Own a [[Cub Buddy]].''' Cub Buddies can help by collecting tokens, so owning a Cub Buddy can let the tokens that sit behind Tunnel Bear get collected in order to make the battle easier. Players can also use the alternative strategy, though it's riskier. '''Use [[stinger]]s.''' This is not recommended, as players should save them for Vicious Bee, but stingers can help to get the last bit of damage needed before Tunnel Bear despawns. '''Have a Vicious Bee.''' Having a Vicious Bee is helpful, as its [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]] can deal massive amounts of damage to Tunnel Bear. '''Equipping the [[Fire Mask]] or [[Demon Mask]].''' Both [[:Category:Hats|masks]] boosts the player's [[Bee Attack|bees' attack]]. '''Get attack [[mutation]]s.''' Players can either feed [[Treat#Atomic Treat|atomic treats]] to guarantee a mutation, or feed [[Treat#Neonberry|neonberries]] first to make it [[Radiation|radioactive]], and then use [[Treat#Bitterberry|bitterberries]] to have a higher chance of mutating a bee. '''Empty your bag.''' If the player is going to try and defeat it, there's a chance they might die and lose their pollen. The player should empty their bag before attempting to defeat Tunnel Bear as a precaution. '''Let your bees tell you how far to stay from Tunnel Bear.''' When the player's bees are far enough away to head back to the player, they should move a bit closer. The bees can help determine how far away the player is from collecting tokens. *'''Abuse a glitch method.''' When Tunnel Bear drops down into the tunnel, purposely walk to the left side of the tunnel. When Tunnel Bear attempts to follow you, his arm will clip into the wall, and as a result he will become stuck. This makes it extremely easy to defeat Tunnel Bear.

==Trivia== Tunnel Bear uses the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/56/Cartoony-Animation-Package Cartoony Animation Pack]. When Tunnel Bear despawns, it will use /e wave and disappear. This occurs when the player dies, when the timer runs out, when the player goes back to the entrance or leave. Tunnel Bear will also use /e wave when stunned by [[Digital Bee|Digital Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Mind Hack|Mind Hack]]. Tunnel Bear possesses a hitbox a bit wider than its body, so players may not touch Tunnel Bear and still die (this acts similarly to [[King Beetle|King Beetle's]] yellow "aura"). Since the [[Updates#2019.04.05|4/5/2019 update]], the despawn timer was added. This makes it much more difficult to defeat since players now cannot defeat the boss by circulating the tunnel numerous times with a low [[System Page#Bee Attack|attack]] rate. * Tunnel Bear despawns at the end of the [[White Tunnel]]. Sometimes, a [[Glitches|glitch]] can happen where Tunnel Bear can spawn on top of the tunnel. * Tunnel Bear is occasionally able to be seen leaping into the tunnel from outside of the map. Tunnel Bear is 1 of the 5 bosses in the game, the others being King Beetle, [[Stick Bug]], [[Coconut Crab]], and the [[Chicks#Mondo Chick|Mondo Chick]]. Tunnel Bear got added as the first of three [[bears]] in the game that acts hostile to players, with [[Gummy Bear]] as the second and [[Snowbear]] as the third. [[Shadow Bear]] does not count because it does not kill players, the floor does. Tunnel Bear serves as the second [[:Category:Bosses|boss]] added to the game. Tunnel Bear (1,000 damage) and [[Cave Monster|cave monsters]] (10,000 damage) are the most powerful [[mobs]] in the game in terms of damage, as they can instantly kill players upon contact, the only exception being if the [[Passive Abilities#Emergency Coconut Shield|Emergency Coconut Shield]] is active. Tunnel Bear takes the second most amount of time to respawn with [[Stump Snail]] being the first. Tunnel Bear, [[Onett]], and Gummy Bear acted "Naughty this year”, as stated by [[Bee Bear]] during Beesmas 2018. * Tunnel Bear looks exactly the same as Shadow Bear. However, Shadow Bear does not act hostile to other players and it is much larger than Tunnel Bear in terms of width and length. Tunnel Bear, Shadow Bear, and Snowbear are the only faceless bears. Tunnel Bear's location is revealed by [[Panda Bear]] in his quest "Ultimate Ant Annihilation 5". ** Tunnel Bear and King Beetle are the only mobs that have a place that are only revealed by Panda Bear. There is a chance that one of Tunnel Bear's arms can clip outside the tunnel walls, which significantly reduces its walk speed and/or renders it completely immobile, making it easier to kill.

In previous versions, Tunnel Bear would fall face down, slamming its face into the ground after spawning at the top. Then it will stand up and chase the player. This is one of the two things in the game that drop loot in a straight line, the other being ''[[Mythic Meteor Shower|Mythic Meteors]].'' **Additionally, this is the only mob that drops loot in a straight line. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Bears]] [[Category:Mobs]]

{{Consumables |image = Turpentine.png |description = A strong solvent that can remove all Waxes from a bee's Beequip. |cooldown = |cap = 25}} {{Color|Turpentine}} is a craftable inventory [[Items|item]] added in the [[Updates|12/26/2021 update]]. It is used to remove all [[waxes]] from a [[Beequip]].

Turpentine have a maximum cap of 25. Obtaining while having more than 25 turpentines will not add them to the player's inventory unless received through [[quests]], redeeming [[codes]], or purchasing them in the [[Robux Shop]] through limited-time offers.

== Ways to Obtain ==

  • [[Crafting]] via [[Blender]] for: ** {{Cost|Super Smoothie|10}} ** {{Cost|Caustic Wax|10}} ** {{Cost|Star Jelly|100}} ** {{Cost|Honeysuckle|1000}}
  • As an extremely rare drop from an Epic [[Puffshroom]], a very rare drop from a Legendary Puffshroom and an uncommon drop from a Mythic Puffshroom.
  • As a very rare drop from any [[planter]]. ** {{Cost|The Planter Of Plenty|||0}} has a ~10% chance to drop a Turpentine. ** {{Cost|Petal Planter|||0}} has a ~1% chance to drop a Turpentine.
  • As a reward for reaching the Top 25 Daily [[Leaderboards|Leaderboard]] for [[Retro Swarm Challenge]].
  • As a very rare reward from the Retro Swarm Challenge.
  • As an extremely rare reward from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]].
  • From the following [[:Category:Beesmas Decorations|Beesmas Decorations]] available only during the [[:category:Beesmas|Beesmas event]]: ** Brown Bear's [[Stockings]] has an exceptionally rare chance to drop a Turpentine. ** Dapper Bear's [[Samovar]] drops a Turpentine on the 25th use. ** Completing [[Robo Party]] on rank 45 and 50 for the first time gives the player who started it a Turpentine and other rewards.
  • As a reward for [[Stick Bug|Stick Bug's]] Beesmas quest.
  • Purchasing the Triumphant Turp Pack from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] gives 1 Turpentine + other items
  • By purchasing the Royal Winter Wonder Haul for {{Cost|Robux|4,500}} gives 1 Turpentine + other items.

===Outdated Ways=== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | As a reward from completing [[Stick Bug|Stick Bug's]] Beesmas 2021, 2022 and 2024 (Summer) Quest (Gave 1 Turpentine + other items). * Opening the [[Gift Boxes|Mondo Gift Box]] during Beesmas 2021, 2022 and 2024 (Summer) (Gave 1 Turpentine + other items). From Purchasing the Hefty Honeyday Bundle in [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] (Gave 1 Turpentine + other items). By purchasing certain packs from the Robux Shop. ** Purchasing the Mondo Robo Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|4,500}} gave 1 Turpentine + other items. ** Purchasing the Gifted Giga-Bundle for {{Cost|Robux|4,500}} (gave 1 Turpentine + other items). From purchasing the Merry Mondo Bundle in [[Bee Bear’s Catalog]] (Gives 1 Turpentine + other items) |}

The '''Tutorial''', also nicknamed '''Help''' gives information on the game and its aspects. For new players, it opens automatically once the game loads. Established players can turn off the tutorial by simply closing the window - the game will remember that setting next time it is started. The tutorial can be reopened by pressing the red circle with a question mark on it, located at the top right.

PagearrowLeft.png|Left Tutorial arrow. PagearrowRight.png|Right Tutorial arrow. ==Trivia== *The riddle on the now removed 38th page of the Tutorial (>> ☺ These educational games make learning fun. Hop into them and it's begun!) is a hint toward the [[Codes|code]] "Jumpstart". [[Category:Bee Swarm Simulator]]

docs.title: Updates
docs.text:
{{Tabber |2025.04.30 | * Beesmas Winter 2024 removed. ** Sun Bear and the Golf minigame also removed from the game. * A new chat system was implemented after Roblox ended support for their legacy version. ** In-game chat notifications are no longer yellow, and instead stylized to match the notifications that appear on the bottom right (highlighted background, text color). *** As there is no rainbow text highlight, sticker notifications have a blue background in chat.

|2024.12.25 | * Honeyday boost! Granted to the player upon claiming a hive. * Added the Royal Winter Wonder Haul pack to the [[Robux Shop]], introducing two new items: ** Item: {{Cost|Nectar Shower Vial|||0}}, which grants 4 hours of every [[Nectar]] type to everyone in the player's server. ** Hive Skin: {{Cost|Icy Crowned Hive Skin|||0}} * Updated the {{Cost|Debug Wax|||0}} decal to be unique. |2024.12.17 | Bee Swarm Simulator is participating in ROBLOX's "[[w:c:roblox:Winter Spotlight|Winter Spotlight]]" event, as well as kicking off Beesmas for the second time this year! 🎄 Beesmas is back! Talk to Bee Bear, deliver presents, and spread the festive spirit to earn the Roblox Winter Spotlight Tokens! ❄️

  • [[Winter Spotlight]] ** [[Bee Bear]] returns with some Roblox event exclusive quests! Complete all 3 of his quests to receive a regular token for the Winter Spotlight. ** Open the third [[Gift Boxes|Gift Box]] to receive the elite token for the Winter Spotlight
  • Winter Beesmas 2024 ** Returning traveling bear: [[Bee Bear]]! After completing the Winter Spotlight quests, Bee Bear has more Beesmas themed quests to offer. ** Returning Beesmas quests: NPCs give out a special Beesmas quest. When completed, a [[:Category:Beesmas Decorations|special Beesmas decoration]] is completed, which the player can use. Completed Beesmas quests are needed to open [[Gift Boxes]] ** Returning items: {{Cost|Snowflake}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}, [[Ornaments]], and {{Cost|Present}}! Presents can be collected, which can be given to NPCs in exchange for their ornament, which they can view on the Beesmas Tree. *** New Beesmas ornament available for [[Sun Bear]]! Give hie a present in order to earn the Steering Wheel ornament. ** Returning shop: [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]
  • New item! {{Cost|Choose-A-Mythic Egg|4=0}}, allows you to choose which [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic Bee]] hatches!

|2024.10.29 | * Beesmas 2024 removed.

|2024.08.01 | Message from Onett: Bee Swarm Simulator is participating in ROBLOX's "[[The Games]]" event. [[Sun Bear]] has arrived and brought ⛳ golfing to the mountain. Currently, he has just the 3 quests required for the event, each one rewarding an event "Silver" (the currency being used in the event hub). But I have plans to add more quests sometime next week, as well as the ability to give him a [Present].

|2024.07.17 | Beesmas in July! Bee Bear returns for Beesmas 2024 and has brand new, sticker-themed quests. * Beesmas 2024 ** The update released as a soft launch on July 17th. The game page and icon were later updated with new icons the on July 23rd. ** Returning traveling bear: [[Bee Bear]]! Bee Bear makes his seasonal return with 20 quests, awarding a special item every 5 quests. *** Every 5 quests rewards a {{Cost|Sticker Planter|||0}} and a {{Cost|Star Jelly|||0}}. *** The 10th quest rewards the {{Cost|Wavy Festive Hive Skin|||0}} *** The 15th quest rewards a [[Cub Buddy]] (or a {{Cost|Cub Buddy Voucher|||0}} if player already owns a Cub Buddy). *** The 20th quest rewards the {{Cost|Doodle Cub|||0}}. ** Returning Beesmas quests: NPCs give out a special Beesmas quest. When completed, a [[:Category:Beesmas Decorations|special Beesmas decoration]] is completed, which the player can use. Completed Beesmas quests are needed to open [[Gift Boxes]] ** Returning items: {{Cost|Snowflake}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}, [[Ornaments]], and {{Cost|Present}}! Presents can be collected, which can be given to NPCs in exchange for their ornament, which they can view on the Beesmas Tree. ** Returning shop: [[Bee Bear's Catalog]] ** New [[Sticker]]s! * Misc. ** Gamepasses have now been converted into [[Sticker#Voucher|vouchers]], and can be traded or redeemed. Each voucher is able to be obtained in-game without {{Cost|Robux}} through extremely rare means. ** The [[Retro Swarm Challenge]] portal was moved next to [[Dapper Bear's Shop]]. ** [[Bubble Bee Man]]'s Beesmas quest grants two new items: *** {{i|Caustic Wax}}{{Color|Debug Wax}}, guaranteed to upgrade the Beequip it is used on. *** {{Cost|Nectar Tester|||0}}, grants the player 24 hours of every nectar.

|2024.05.23 | Bee Swarm Simulator is featured the [[Roblox: The Classic]] event, which added a new challenge to the game. In addition, many balance changes were implemented.

'''An in-depth summary has been provided by Onett, and the exact text has been transferred onto the page here.''' Testing these changes and adjustments: Misc additions: * Retro Swarm Challenge: Part of the Classic Events. Team up in groups of 4 and defend the hives from waves of Slimes and Zombies. Once this has been tested and the event is over, I'll rebalance and adjust it and add main game rewards (currently only rewards the Classic event tokens. Won't be awarded on the test realm). ** Somewhat similar to Robo Bear Challenge, you start with all bees locked and unlock them with a currency, Bricks. ** Bricks are also used to purchase classic Weapons and power ups. ** Earn Bricks from defeating classic mobs, popping Brick Blooms, or purchasing them with Honey earned during the challenge. * New Beequips: Demon Talisman, Camphor Lip Balm, Autumn Sunhat, Rose Headband, Pink Eraser, Candy Ring. Obtainable in Dapper Bear's Shop, as rare drops from Planters, or as rare rewards from Robo Bear Challenge, Stick Bug Challenge, or Ant Challenge. * Some new Stickers and Hive Skins Unique Instant Conversion: * All instances of this new type of Instant Conversion are applied independently of all other IC. For example, if you have 2 items that each grant 50% Unique Instant Conversion, it will instantly convert 50% of all incoming Pollen twice, to have an effective total of 75% Instant Conversion. * Unique IC is granted by Coconut Belt's Combo buff, Clouds, Puffshroom Blessing, some Beequips, and Refreshing Nectar (5%-20% Unique IC replaces 1%-10% Bee Ability Pollen). Coconut Belt added: * Costs 7.5T Honey, 500 Coconuts, 1,500 Tropical Drinks, 150 Hard Wax, 150 Purple Potions, 3 Refreshing Vials and 3 Turpentine. * Coconut Belt inherits Petal Belt's Petal Storm ability if you own the Petal Belt. * Coconut Belt's ability, Combo Coconuts, causes every 40th Coconut you spawn (from the item or Coconut Canister abilities) to be a Combo Coconut. ** When a Combo Coconut is caught, it is kicked and falls again. *** If caught within the blue center ring on its first drop, the Coconut will always fall onto the field it spawned in until it despawns. *** Otherwise, the Coconut will alternate between falling on your field and the field of another player in the server (if there is one). ** Every time it's caught, the falling speed increases, giving players less time to react to it. ** When caught, it gains stacks of Combo Coconut Combo equal to: *** 1 stack by default. *** +1 bonus stack if caught in a field different from where it was last caught. *** Between +1 to +4 bonus stacks depending on how long it has been since the coconut was caught in a field with the same color classification as the current field it's being caught in. **** Color Classification means: Red/Blue/White/Mixed. **** Essentially, juggling the coconut between different color fields causes the stacks to ramp up faster. *** +10 bonus stacks if the catcher is another player who has not yet caught this coconut, in a field with a color classification that the coconut has not yet been caught in. ** In short, it can increase by up to 11 stacks per catch, and scales faster if 2 or more players are juggling it between different colored fields. ** Combo Coconut's buff maxes out at 100 stacks, and grants the following for 30 seconds: *** Between 25% to 75% Unique Instant Conversion. *** Between x1.1 to x1.5 Pollen. *** Between +1% and +50% Pollen. *** Between +1% and +50% Red/White/Blue Pollen. *** Between +1% and +50% Bee Attack. *** Between +1% and +50% Honey From Tokens. ** Whenever the Combo Coconut is caught, it sets the catcher's Coconut Combo buff to the coconut's current combo. If the player's buff is already higher than the coconut's stacks, it refreshes the player's buff instead. ** When the Coconut is missed, it grants it's buff again to any player who caught it at least once. ** Combo Coconuts cannot usually fall onto the Ant Field. If the passive is triggered while in the Ant Challenge, 1 Combo Coconut will fall, but catching it will not cause it to fall again. Cub Buddy / Voucher system change: * Added Cub Buddy Voucher, a tradable sticker that can be redeemed for a Cub Buddy (by players who don't already have one). * If you already own a Cub Buddy, receiving a Cub Buddy from Bee Bear's 15th quest or purchasing a Cub Buddy in the Robux shop will instead give you a Cub Buddy Voucher. Ticket Tent changes: * Cub Buddy removed from the Ticket Tent. * Silver Egg added to the Ticket Tent for 50 Tickets. * Diamond Egg added to the Ticket Tent for 400 Tickets. * Mythic Egg added to the Ticket Tent for 2500 Tickets. * Gold Egg price increased to 100 Tickets. Misc rebalancing: * Petal Shuriken conversion has been rebalanced. Was 10k + 7% of the bee's convert amount. Now is 10k base, +6% of the bee's convert amount, + an additional 6% per Field Boost Stack of the field you're standing in. Example: 10k + 30% Convert Amount at x4 Field Boost. * Tide Popper's wave conversion when hitting a bee has also been changed to scale with Field Boost stacks, similar to Petal Shurikens. Leaderboard changes: * Reduced number of Sticker rewards for most boards now that the a large Sticker supply has been established. For example: Stamps are now given to the top 25 instead of the top 100. * Every Daily Leaderboard now rewards between 25 to 100 Tickets to all top 100 players (in addition to any Sticker rewards). * Added Glowering Gummy Bear as reward for #1 Daily Top Gummy Soldier. * Daily Bomb Pollen board removed. * Daily Ant Field Pollen board was removed (This was invisible and not intended to be implemented). * Daily Windy Bee Tokens board added. Rewards Tornado Sticker to the top 10. * Daily Aphid Exterminators board added. Rewards Wavy Cyan Hive Skin to the top 5. Beequip changes: * Festive Wreath and Puppy's Reindeer Antlers are now normal Beequips that can be traded, destroyed, and have Caustic Waxes applied. If they are in your Permanent Beequip storage, they will remain there until you take them out, but cannot be put back in. I might remove the Permanent Beequip feature altogether. * Festive Wreath level requirement increased to 10. * Lowered the Equip Limit of Elf Cap, Poinsettia, and Icicles to 2 (from 3). * Increased capacity hive bonuses of Beret and Festive Wreath. Instant Conversion / Field Winds Changes: * Reduced Field Conversion from Winds to range from 20%-50% (from 25%-67%). Trying to rebalance Instant Conversion in general by adding it to other sources. * Every stack of Field Winds now grants +1% White Pollen (which applies to any field). For example: 5x Bamboo Field Winds + 5x Strawberry Field Winds {{=}} +10% White Pollen Nectar changes: * Refreshing Nectar changed to grant between 5% to 20% Unique Instant Conversion (replaces +1% to +10% Bee Ability Pollen). * Doubled the starting amount of Convert Rate granted by all Nectars (maximum amount remains the same). * Doubled the starting amount of Pollen multiplier granted by all Nectars (max remains the same). * Invigorating Nectar's minimum Bee Attack multiplier increased to x1.02 (from x1.01). Consumable changes: * Honeysuckles: Increased the amount of Pollen converted * now causes every bee to instantly converts pollen equal to double their Convert Amount multiplied by 1 + # of the active field's boost stacks over a short period (~5-10 seconds, depends on number of active bees). * Increased drop rates of Honeysuckles for all Planters and added Honeysuckles to all Memory Matches. * Whirligigs now grant increased Convert Rate at Hive for 20 seconds. Starts at +100% and scales down to +1% as the timer runs out. * Tropical Drinks now also grant +10% Instant Conversion. * Super Smoothie's Instant Conversion raised to +20% (from 12%). * Coconut adjustments: ** Reduced the radius to 13 (from 15). ** Falling duration increased to 2.5 seconds (from 2s). ** Amount converted into Honey Tokens on hit now scales by 25% with each Field Boost stack (base value is still your Convert Total). ** Collects pollen from 29 flowers (down from 49), but collects 25 pollen (up from 15). ** Coconuts now deal 10 damage + 5% of your Attack Total + [5% of the enemy's HP capped at 500] (changed from 75 Damage + [10% of the enemy's HP capped at 500]), ** Coconuts can now pop Bubbles (and Fuzz Bombs). Field Booster changes: * Reduced the cooldowns of all 3 Field Boosters to 45 minutes (from 1 hour). * If you have 35+ bees, the Red Field Booster may boost the Pepper Patch. * If Stump Snail is on cooldown, the Blue Field Booster may boost the Stump Field. Flame changes: * Flames spawned by a bee or a bee's abilities now gain +10% pollen per bee level. Dark Flames retain the level of the original Flame that was converted. * Flame base Pollen collection per second changed to 4 Red / 2 White / 1 Blue (from 6/3/1). * Flames no longer scale with number of Red Bees in the hive unless they were spawned directly by the player (through Scythe, X-Flame or Ignite). * Attack from Flame Heat increased to +5%-+25% (from +2%-20%). * Flames spawned by bees now deal 10 + 25% of the bee's base attack per second (change from 15 damage). Base attack in this context means it does not apply the player's Bee Attack Multipliers. It does include: bee type's base attack, bee's gifted bonus, bee's mutations and beequips, and the player's additive bee attack stats/hive bonuses. * Dark Flames now deal 50% more damage than regular flames (changed from flat 25 damage). * Gathering Flames+ trigger chance increased to 65%, 85% if Gifted (from 55%, 75% if Gifted). Bubble changes: * Bubbles spawned by a bee or its abilities now gain +5% pollen per bee level. Bubbles from Frogs will scale with the source Tadpole Bee's level. * Bubble base lifespan reduced to 4 seconds (from 6.5s. Bubble Bombs erroneously said it was 8s). (Note that Tadpole Bee's new Gifted Hive bonus is +25% Bubble Duration) * Gold Bubble pollen multiplier changed to +100% per Field Boost Stack (from flat x1.5). Examples: No Field Boost {{=}} x1 Gold Bubble Pollen. 3x Field Boost {{=}} x3 Gold Bubble Pollen. * Gold Bubbles now have 100% Instant Conversion (unless they go into a Balloon). * Fixed a bug causing Gold Bubble's Honey Tokens to not count pollen that went into a Balloon or was instantly converted. This was often making the tokens worthless. * Reduced the chance for a Gold Bubble to spawn a Honey Token to 10% (from 20%). * Gathering Bubbles+ trigger chance increased to 65%, 85% if Gifted (from 55%, 75% if Gifted). Puffshroom changes: * Defeating a Rare+ Puffshroom grants Puffshroom Blessing stacks equal to 50% the level of the Puffshroom to all players that contributed. ** Stacks are multiplied x2 for Epic, x3 for Legendary, and x4 for Mythic. ** Puffshrooms popped on fields that haven't yet been visited by the Puffshroom's lineage gain x2 Stacks. ** Grants between +1%-+10% Unique Instant Conversion, Pollen, Capacity, and Honey From Tokens. Max stacks is 100. Lasts 2 hours. * The amount of Honey and regular Treats dropped by Puffshrooms has been greatly increased, from around x2 at lvl 1 and x4 at lvl 24. * Increased the daily loot limits of some of their drops. Mutation changes: * New Mutation type: Critical Chance (from 1% to 3%). Applies to gathering, attacks, and abilities. * New Mutation type: Movespeed (from 2 to 6 base movespeed). * New Mutation type: Instant Conversion (from 8% to 20%). This is a Unique IC applied to the bee's gathering and abilities. * All 3 new Mutation types have the same rarity as Ability Rate. * Increased the maximum Gather Amount that can be granted by additive Gather Amount mutations to 10 (from 6). * Increased the maximum Convert Amount that can be granted by additive Convert Amount mutations to 80 (from 50). * Increased the maximum Base Attack mutation to +2 (from +1). * Increased the maximum multiplicative Attack mutation to +20% (from +15%). Badge changes: * Dandelion Badge bonus changed to +3/6/9/12/15% Honey At Hive (from +1/2/3/4/5% Instant Conversion). * Cactus Field badge bonus changed to +1/2/3/4/5% Instant Conversion (from +5/10/15/20/25% Bomb Pollen). * Hive Hub Badge bonus increased to +2/4/6/8/10% Instant Gifted Bee Conversion (from 1/2/3/4/5%). * Spider Field Badge bonus decreased to +10/15/20/25/30% White Pollen (from +10/20/30/40/50%). * Mountain Top Master requirement lowered to 100 T (from 1 Q). * Battle Points Grandmaster requirement lowered to 500k (from 1m). * Ability Grandmaster requirement lowered to 5 million tokens (from 10m). Supreme Star Amulet passive changes: * Pop Star now activates after collecting 30 Boost tokens (changed from 30 Bomb tokens). * Scorching Star now activates after collecting 30 Boost tokens (buffed from 30 Red Boost tokens specifically). * When Scorching Star expires, your container is now instantly converted. * Star Shower's instant convert amount now scales with Field Boost stack, an additional +100% Convert Total per Field Boost Stack. * Getting a stack of Inspire from Star Shower now contributes to triggering the Inspire Coconuts passive of the Coconut Canister. * Guiding Star Aura now also grants x2.5 Convert Rate to the player who summoned it and x1.25 Convert Rate to other players in the field. Mask changes: * Fire Mask Container Space multiplier increased to x1.5 (from x1.25). * Fire Mask changed to have +15% Bee Attack (from +2 Red Bee Attack). * Bubble Mask lowered to have x1.25 Bubble Pollen (from x2). (Reduced due to new Bubble level scaling) * Bubble Mask no longer has +15% Instant Blue Conversion. * Bubble Mask now gains x1.25 Blue Field Capactiy. * Bubble Mask's Bubble Bombs now spawns 25 Bubbles every 25 Bombs and has a 2 minute cooldown (changed from 3 Bubbles every 7 Bombs with no cooldown). * Bubbles from Bubble Bombs now correctly have 8s base duration (last twice as long as Bubbles spawned from bees/frogs/Bubble Wand). * Demon Mask Instant Red Conversion increased to 20% (from 15%). * Demon Mask now also requires 1 Invigorating Vial to craft. * Diamond Mask lowered to have x1.5 Bubble Pollen. (Reduced due to new Bubble level scaling) * Diamond Mask now also requires 1 Comforting Vial to craft. * Gummy Mask now also requires 1 Satisfying Vial to craft. Boot changes: * Movespeed changes: ** The game's base player movespeed has increased to 20 studs per second (from 18), and the speed of boots has been adjusted: ** Basic Boots decreased to 4 (from 5). Effective change is +1. ** Hiking Boots decreased to 5 (from 6). Effective change is +1. ** Beekeeper's decreased to 6 (from 8). No effective change. ** Coconut Clogs decreased to 7 (from 10). Effective change is -1. ** Gummy Boots decreased to 8 (from 10). No effective change. * Hiking Boots now grants +1 Bee Attack. * Beekeeper's Boots now grants +1 Bee Attack. * Beekeeper's Boots Bee Gather Pollen bonus increased to +25% (from +20%). * Coconut Clogs changes: ** Coconut Clogs no longer grant x2 Pollen from Coconuts (could be confused with Coconut Field pollen). ** Coconut Clogs no longer grants x1.5 Convert Rate At Hive. ** Coconut Clogs Pollen bonus increased to +15% (from +10%). ** Coconut Clogs now grant x1.15 Coconut Field Pollen. ** Coconut Clogs changed to grant +2 base Bee Attack instead of +5% Bee Attack multiplier. ** Coconut Clogs Movement Collection increased to 14 (from 12). ** Coconut Clogs crafting cost increased by 1 Refreshing Vial. * Gummy Boots changes: ** Gummy Boots no longer grants x2 Convert Rate At Hive. ** Gummy Boots Pollen bonus increased to +20% (from +10%). ** Gummy Boots changed to grant +3 base Bee Attack instead of +10% Bee Attack multiplier. ** Gummy Boots Movement Collection increased to 16 (from 15). ** Gummy Boots crafting cost increased by 1 Motivating Vial and 1 Satisfying Vial. Backpack/Container changes: * Red/Blue Port-O-Hive Changes: ** Red/Blue Port-O-Hives Capacity increased to 400,000 (from 375k). ** Red/Blue Port-O-Hives now grant +10% Red/Blue Bee Convert Rate. ** Red/Blue Port-O-Hives no longer grant +1 Red/Blue Bee Attack. ** Red/Blue Port-O-Hives now cost 2 Red/Blue Extracts and 2 Soft Wax. * Porcelain Port-O-Hive changes: ** Porcelain Port-O-Hive Capacity increased to 600,000 (from 500k). ** Porcelain Port-O-Hive now grants x1.25 Convert Rate At Hive. ** Porcelain Port-O-Hive no longer grants +10% Red/Blue Pollen. ** Porcelain Port-O-Hive no longer grants +1 Bee Attack. ** Porcelain Port-O-Hive now costs 3 Glitter, 3 Soft Wax, and 10 Moon Charms. * Coconut Canister changes: ** Coconut Canister now grants x1.5 Convert Rate At Hive. ** Coconut Canister now grants +25% Coconut Field Capacity. ** Stacks of Inspire from Star Shower, Falling Beesmas Light, or any other non-Token source now contribute to triggering the Inspire Coconuts passive. ** Coconut Canister no longer grants +10% Pollen. ** Coconut Canister no longer grants +1 Bee Attack. ** Coconut Canister's crafting cost increased by 100 Coconuts and 2 Refreshing Vials. Other Equipment changes: * Mondo Belt Bag now has +1 Colorless Bee Attack. * Mondo Belt Bag now has +10% Buzz Bomb Pollen. * Mondo Belt Bag crafting cost increased by 1 Soft Wax. * Petal Belt Loot Luck increased to +101% (from +100%). * Riley Guard now has +10% Red Bomb Pollen. * Bucko Guard now has +10% Blue Bomb Pollen. * Dark Scythe's cost reduced by 50 Stingers and increased by 3 Invigorating Vials. * Tide Popper's cost reduced by 50 Stingers and increased by 3 Comforting Vials. * Gummy Baller's cost reduced by 500 Gumdrops and increased by 3 Satisfying Vials. Robo Bear Challenge changes: * Round Speed Bonus cogs buffed to be given if completed within 75% of the round duration (up from 50%). The bonus cogs are increased proportionately. * New Rare Upgrade: Multithread. Allows non-Battle Ability Tokens (Bombs, Boosts, etc) to be created during Battle. -1 Cog Per Round. (Max 1) * Upgrade changes: ** Subscribe changed to grant x1.1 Event Bee Pollen instead of x1.1 Event Bee Ability Pollen (now also includes gathering). ** Botnet buffed to also grant +1 Cogs Per Round. ** White Noise buffed to x1.5 Buzz Bomb pollen (from x1.25). ** Router buffed to x1.3-x4 Field Pollens (from x1.25-x3.5). ** Wifi buffed to x1.5-x6 Field Pollens (from x1.25-x3.5). ** Nullify nerfed to x0.8-x0.6 Pollen (from x0.85-x0.75). ** Crypto nerfed to x0.8-x0.5 Pollen and Container Space (from x0.85-x0.55). ** Sharpen nerfed to x0.9-x0.5 Capacity (from x0.95-x0.75). * Cog Amulet changes: ** Added Flame, Bubble, Bee Gather, and Event Bee pollen bonuses to Bronze Cog Amulets. ** Increased Flame, Bubble, and Bee Gather pollen bonus amounts generated on new Silver+ Cog Amulets. ** Replaced Event Bee Ability pollen with Event Bee pollen on newly generated Cog Amulets (Still applies to abilities, but now also includes their gather pollen). Digital Bee and Duped Ability changes: * Field Corruption's Duped Ability pollen multiplier increased to x1.1-x3 (from x1.01-x2). * Field Corruption's Duped Ability Instant Conversion increased to +20%-90% (from +1%-75%). * Field Corruption's Ability Duplication Chance lowered to 8%-20% (from 10%-25%). * Digital Bee's Ability Duplication Chance hive bonus per 10 Glitched Drive enhancements increased to +0.03% (from 0.02%). * Digital Bee's Ability Duplication Chance hive bonus now gains +0.5% upon maxing out all drives. * Digital Bee's Map Corruption duration now increases by 15s per lvl (up from 10s). * Digital Bee's Map Corruption max possible corruption increased to 300 (from 250). * Digital Bee's Map Corruption max corruption for other players increased to 100 (from 50). It's now always 1/3rd what the source player receives (up from 20%). * The average base delay between Digital Bee spawning Smile Tokens has been increased to 22 seconds (from 18 seconds). At max Glitched Drives, this means average delay has increased to 14 seconds (from 10). ** Note that the first Smile Token Digital Bee creates will always be created after half the average of the base delay (This has always been the case). * The lifespan of Duped Ability Tokens has been lowered to 200% of base token's lifespan + 5% per Digital Bee's level (from 200% + 10% per Digital Bee's level). * Smile Tokens' gather multiplier has been decreased to +50% per Duped Token collected (from 50% + 50% per Duped Token Collected. The description incorrectly said it was 100% + 50% per Duped Token collected before.) * This is a breakdown of Smile Token's collection equation, since it's convoluted: ** Smile Token's formula uses 50% of Digital Bee's base gather amount (gather amount before any multipliers) as the real gather power (how much raw pollen is taken from flowers). Base gather amount consists of: Bee Type gather amount, bee's additive mutation, bee's additive beequip bonuses, and gather amount from White Drives. ** Smile Tokens then multiply pollen collected by all multipliers, which consists of: player's bee gather pollen multiplier * Digital Bee's level bonus * Digital Bee's gifted bonus * Digital Bee's multilicative gather mutation * Digital Bee's Beequip gather multipliers * (1 + 0.5 * number of Duped Tokens collected). ** The gather amount you see when you click Digital's hive slot shows base gather amount * all multipliers. Cloud changes: * Clouds now also grants 10% Unique Instant Conversion (20% if you have Gifted Windy Bee). * Windy Bee's Rain Cloud duration now increases by 10s per lvl (up from 5s). * Clouds will no longer contribute to a Sprout's growth unless a player is standing in the field. Bee Gifted Hive Bonus changes: * Lion Bee's bonus changed to +5% Gifted Bee Pollen (from +2 Colorless Bee Attack). Applies to gathering and abilities. * Rage Bee's bonus changed to +10% Bee Attack (from +1 Attack). * Fire Bee's bonus changed to x1.25 Flame Pollen (from +50% Flame Pollen). * Bubble Bee's bonus changed to x1.25 Bubble Pollen (from +50% Bubble Pollen). * Bomber Bee's bonus changed to x1.1 Bomb Pollen (from +15% Bomb Pollen). * Shocked Bee's bonus changed to x1.1 White Pollen (from +20%). * Rad Bee's bonus changed to x1.1 Red Pollen (from +15%). * Cool Bee's bonus changed to x1.1 Blue Pollen (from +15%). * Tadpole Bee's bonus changed to +25% Bubble Duration (from +10% Blue Pollen, +25% Instant Bubble Conversion). * Festive Bee's bonus changed to x1.25 Convert Rate at Hive (from +15% Red Pollen). * Demon Bee's bonus increased to +20% Instant Bomb Conversion (from +15%). * Hasty Bee's bonus decreased to +15% Player Movespeed (from +20%). * Stubborn Bee's bonus decreased to +15% Ability Token Lifespan (from +20%). Other Bee Changes: * Crimson and Cobalt Changes: ** Fixed an bug causing Crimson and Cobalt's Pulses to not scale pollen +10% per level. Also fixes bugs causing it to not scale with Bee, Event Bee, or Event Bee Ability pollen multipliers. ** If Crimson or Cobalt are Gifted, their Pulses now also cause bees to instantly convert pollen equal to 25% of the bee's Convert Amount when it hops to them. The Convert Amount is multiplied by number of Field Boost stacks. This applies to the Pulses generated by their matching guard passives as well. ** Crimson and Cobalt Bee's Bomb Sync abilities now also grant +10% Red/Blue Pollen and +10% Red/Blue Instant Conversion while active. ** Crimson and Cobalt Bee now have 5% base Critical Chance and +10% Instant Conversion. Applies to their own gathering and abilities. * Puppy Bee's Puppy Love now grants +10% Bee Movespeed and +50% Bee Gather Amount for 10 seconds (+1s per level). It also grants twice as much bond as before, but activates around half as frequently. * Gifted Photon Bee's Beamstorm now increases White Pollen it collects by an additional 100% (x3 multiplier instead of x2). * Photon Bee now has 20% base Instant Conversion. Applies to its own gathering and abilities. * Diamond Bee's Shimmering Honey bonus honey increased to 25% + 2.5% per lvl (from 20% + 2% per lvl). * Tadpole Bee no longer has a x0.5 Attack debuff. Frogs now deal x5 Tadpole Bee's damage (down from x10, no effective change). * If Tabby Bee is at max Tabby Love, collecting a Tabby Love grants +1% Critical Chance and +25% Critical Power for 10s (+1s per level). If Gifted, grants +1% Super Crit Chance as well. * Demon Bee now has 10% base Instant Conversion (20% if Gifted). docs.title: Vacuum
docs.text:
{{Tool |image =Vacuum.png |price = 14,000 |shop = Noob Shop |pattern = Surround |time = 0.8 |collectbase = 2 |range= 13 }} The '''Vacuum''' is a [[:Category:Tools|tool]] that can be purchased in the [[Noob Shop]].

{| class="article-table" !Crafting Ingredients |- |{{Cost|Honey|14,000}} |}

It collects 2 [[pollen]] from 13 surrounding [[Flowers|flower]] patches every 0.8 seconds and has a base pollen collection rate of 32.5 pollen per second.

==Appearance== The vacuum cleaner is easily the most complex of the tools in the [[Noob Shop|noob shop]]. It looks like the standard vacuum, a brownish bag with a grey handle connecting to the suction colored grey, black, and 2 yellow squares at the front, resembling lights.

==Gallery== Hivesticker vacuum.png|The {{PAGENAME}}'s associated [[Sticker#Stickers|sticker]].

==Trivia== This is the third most expensive item that can be purchased in the Noob Shop, behind the [[Canister]] and the [[Helmet]]. This tool has a similar collection range as the [[Honey Dipper]] and the [[Porcelain Dipper]], the only difference being that both of them have a bigger collection range, and the Porcelain Dipper summons a pillar of light every 10th swing that collects pollen. *This tool is based off the household appliance known as the ''[[Wikipedia:Vacuum cleaner|Vacuum cleaner]].'' {{Items}} [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Tools]]

'''Vector Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Mythic|Mythic bee]].

Vector Bee's favorite type of treat is {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}}.

Vector Bee likes the [[Spider Field]] and the [[Coconut Field]]. It dislikes the [[Pineapple Patch]].

== Stats == * Collects 18 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. * Makes 144 [[Honey]] in 2.72 seconds. * +4 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]], +8 [[Stats#Gather Amount|Gather Amount]], +16% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +32% Convert Speed, +64 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +128% [[Energy]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +15% Mark Duration.

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Mark|[Pollen Mark+]]]''' Marks a large random area on the [[Fields|Field]] for 8 seconds (+0.25s per Level) that increases all pollen by 50% while that player stands in it. Stacks up to 3 times. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Triangulate|[Triangulate]]]''' Draws a triangle between the player, the bee, and the token. After 3s, it collects [[Ability Tokens|Ability tokens]] and 10 pollen (+2 per Level) from all [[Flowers]] inside. All Marks within the triangle increase the pollen by 50%. If the triangle contains a Pollen Mark, it gains x2 White pollen. If the triangle contains a Honey Mark or Festive Mark, it gains 50% instant conversion. If the triangle contains a Precise Mark, it always deals critical hits. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Mark Surge|[🌟Gifted Ability: Mark Surge]]]''' Causes all of the player's active Marks to collect 7 Pollen (+10% per Level) from all flowers in their radius. Extends the duration of the Marks by 1s (+0.1s per Level). Each mark can perform up to 5 surges. When a Honey Mark or Festive Mark surges, the Pollen is Instantly Converted. **When a Precise Mark surges, it always does Critical Hits.

{{Stat|pollen = 18|pollentime = 4|honey = 144|honeytime = 1|rarity = mythic}}

== Gallery == Vector Bee Face.png|Vector Bee's Face. VectorHiveGt-Pm-Rd-11.gif|A Gifted Mutated Radioactive Vector Bee hive slot. Giftedvectorhiveslot.png|A Gifted Vector Bee hive slot. GIDVector.png|Gifted Vector Bee in the darkness. Triangulate.png|Triangulate token. RobloxScreenShot20200101 050632134.png|A Triangulate token in action. Mark Surge.png|Mark Surge token. File:Hivesticker 4-pronged vector bee.png|The 4-Pronged Vector Bee [[sticker]].

== Trivia == * Vector Bee's stats follow a [[Wikipedia:Geometric Progression|Geometric Progression]] pattern, where each number is double the amount of the previous number. * Vector Bee is the only Mythic bee to not share any of its abilities with other bees. It is also the only Mythic Bee to not have a [[Passive Abilities|Passive Ability]]. * Vector Bee is the only [[Bees|bee]] to have a different skin pattern on each of its sides. * Vector Bee's design is heavily inspired by mathematics. ** Its relation to trigonometry is implied in its description and the triangular motifs on its head. ** Vectors reference Euclidean vectors, objects with magnitude and direction. A triangle can be composed of three vectors. ** Triangulation is a method to determine the location of a point through forming triangles from known points. * Vector Bee, [[Spicy Bee]], [[Precise Bee]] and [[Buoyant Bee]] emit light when they are gifted. * Vector Bee shares similar color schemes with [[Brave Bee]]. * Triangulate is [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]]'s favorite ability, due to the fact that he thinks it's satisfying. * Mark Surge token is considered by the game as "mark" token despite what the ability does doesn't create mark like what all other mark tokens do. This means the collection of Mark Surge token counts toward some quests, [[Passive Abilities#Coin Scatter|Coin Scatter passive ability]], and anything that requires the collection of "mark" tokens. ** Triangulate, however, is not considered as "mark" ability token. ** In a similar fashion Fuzz Bombs ([[Fuzzy Bee|Fuzzy Bee]]'s ability token) and Bomb Sync ([[Cobalt Bee]] and [[Crimson Bee]]'s ability token) are not considered "bomb" ability tokens,and Honey Mark isn't considered as "honey" token, unsurprisingly.

docs.title: Vicious Bee Egg Claim
docs.text:
[[File:Viciousbeeeggclaim.png|alt=|thumb|The Vicious Bee Egg Claim.]] The '''Vicious Bee Egg Claim''' is a platform found between the [[Spider Field]] and [[Strawberry Field]] that lets the player exchange 250 [[stinger]]s for a [[Egg#Event Bee Eggs|Vicious Bee egg]]. The platform is decorated with a large Vicious Bee and a "⚠️ WANTED ⚠️" sign. The pad's color is black, and the number "250" is printed on it, indicating that the player needs 250 stingers to claim a Vicious Bee egg. This exchange can only be done once per player. When the player walks on the platform and they do not have 250 or more stingers, a message on the top of the screen shows “Turn in 250 Stingers to Claim a Vicious Bee (Number of stingers/250)".

== Claiming the Egg == If a player doesn't have 250 stingers and attempts to claim a vicious bee, the platform prompts the player with "Turn in 250 Stingers to Claim a [[Vicious Bee]]". If they have claimed the Vicious Bee egg but have more than 250 stingers and attempt to claim a vicious bee, the game will prompt them with "You've Already Claimed a Vicious Bee". Whenever a player purchases the Vicious Bee egg, the [[Rogue Vicious Bee]] victory jingle is played and a server-wide announcement is made: {{Notification|Honey|🎉 {Username} has tamed a Vicious Bee 🎉}}

== Gallery == ViciousBeeClaimPrompt.JPG|The prompt to claim a Vicious Bee. RobloxScreenShot20181105 183728662 (2).png|A player claiming a Vicious Bee Egg. Screenshot 89.png|The message players get when they step on the Vicious Bee Egg Claim Pad if they have already claimed a Vicious Bee. ViciousBeeEggClaim.png|Vicious Bee Egg Claim.

== Trivia == * There used to be a [[Glitches|glitch]] where players could obtain 2 Vicious Bee eggs. This glitch has been patched as of the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]]. * This is one of the two egg claims, the other being the [[Gummy Bee Egg Claim]] for [[Gummy Bee]]. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Egg Claims]]

docs.text:
{{Bee |color = Blue |rarity = Event |image-orig = Vicious Bee.png |image-gifted = ViciousBee Gifted.png |description = This cold-blooded bee takes great pleasure in inflicting pain. |energy = 50 |energylabel = more |speed = 17.5 |attack = 9 |skincolor1 = #0e141e |skincolor2 = #2f4e66 |skincolor3 = #0e141e }} ''This page is for the tamed version of Vicious Bee. For the hostile version, see [[Rogue Vicious Bee]].''

'''Vicious Bee''' is a [[:Category:Blue|Blue]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]]. It can be claimed for {{Cost|Stinger|250}} at the [[Vicious Bee Egg Claim]].

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite treat, and the only way to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|4=0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Vicious Bee likes the [[Cactus Field]] and the [[Rose Field]]. It dislikes the [[Dandelion Field]].

==Stats== Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 4 seconds. Makes 80 [[Honey]] in 4 seconds. +150% [[Energy]], +25% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +8 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. 🌟 [[Gifted Bee|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: -15% Mob Respawn Time.

=== Abilities=== '''[[Ability Tokens#Impale|[Impale]]]''' Summons spikes (1 per level) to damage enemies equal to 5% of their current health (Increased by Vicious Bee's attack. [Reduced damage if larger than 1000]). Creates a honey token per enemy hit (worth 50 honey plus 50 per bee level). Multiple spikes on the same target deal less damage. Impale can damage [[mobs]] that target other players but will not target other players' [[Tunnel Bear]], [[King Beetle]], [[Stump Snail]], or [[Coconut Crab]]. If gifted, Impale has +1 level of accuracy. '''[[Ability Tokens#Bomb|[Blue Bomb+]]]''' Collects 10 pollen from 29 surrounding blue [[Flowers]] (+10% pollen per Level). Combo with other bombs to increase power.

==Gallery== GiiftedViciousBee Slot.png|A Gifted Vicious Bee hive slot. ViciousFace.png|Vicious Bee's face. ViciousBeeEggClaim.png|The Vicious Bee Egg Claim. NighttimeUpdateIcon.png|Vicious Bee with [[Basic Bee]] and [[Puppy Bee]] in an older version of the game's icon. Impale Token Repicture2.png|An impale token. Impale Token.gif|A 3D Impale token. File:Vicious Bee Egg in the inventory.png|A Vicious Bee Egg. File:Nymphimpale.png|Stick nymphs being attacked by a Gifted Vicious Bee's impale.

==Trivia== Vicious Bee's base attack was previously 7 before it was increased to 8 in the 12/26/21 update. Gifted Vicious Bee's impale ability gets golden-colored spikes, instead of the normal colored (gray) ones. The Impale ability does more base damage when gifted due to the +50% gifted attack bonus. The attack bonus is applied to the bee itself, but it indirectly increases the amount of damage Impale does—though this is not a significant buff due to the majority of Impale's attack scaling off of mob health. Vicious Bee is the only [[Bees|Bee]] who can summon an [[Ability Tokens|Ability Token]] that directly attacks enemies. ** This bee and [[Precise Bee]] are the only bees who have abilities that directly attack the enemies, namely Impale and [[Passive Abilities#Sniper|Sniper]] respectively. ([[Digital Bee]]'s Mind Hack ability doesn't count since it doesn't directly attack enemies). Vicious Bee is one of three bees to have an official plushie on the [https://shop.beeswarm.com/ Official Bee Swarm Simulator Website], the others being Basic Bee and [[Tabby Bee]]. Vicious Bee is the only blue bee that likes the Rose Field. It may like the Rose Field along with the Cactus Field due to the fact that roses and cacti have thorns on them. The [[Rogue Vicious Bee|Rogue Version]] can also spawn in both of these fields. * Vicious Bee and [[Windy Bee]] are the only bees with a hostile variant. It would cost the player 2500 [[Ticket]]s if they were to buy all 250 stingers from the [[Stinger Shop]] to get a Vicious Bee, which makes it the most expensive event bee to get by spending tickets. Vicious Bee, [[Ninja Bee]], and Cobalt Bee are the only blue bees that don’t like [[Blueberry|Blueberries]]. Vicious Bee, [[Bear Bee]], [[Gummy Bee]], Windy Bee, and [[Digital Bee]] are the only Event bees that cannot be purchased in the [[Ticket Tent]]. These four bees, along with [[Festive Bee]] and Puppy Bee, are also the only Event bees that could have been obtained without spending tickets. Gummy Bee was in the Ticket Tent at one point, however. Vicious Bee, Cobalt Bee, Crimson Bee, and [[Photon Bee]] are the only event bees that can't have a 1st Edition Flag. [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] has stated that the reason a [[First Edition Bee|First Edition]] Vicious Bee does not exist is because there is no room for a 1st Flag on its back with the spikes.[https://discord.com/channels/427553293862961153/427553293862961155/506287555231088658] Discord message from Onett Vicious Bee, the [[Stick Bug Amulet]], and the Spider Field [[Boost Market|Market Boost]] are the only sources of the -% Mob Respawn Time stats. *According to [[Black Bear]]'s dialogue during his [[Quests|Quest]] "Black Bear, Why?", Black Bear dislikes this bee. ==References == {{BeeNav}} [[Category:Bees]] [[Category:Event]] [[Category:Blue]] [[zh-tw:惡毒蜂]]
