docs.title: Waxes
docs.text:
'''Waxes''' are [[:Category:Inventory|Inventory Items]] that were added in the [https://bee-swarm-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Updates#2021.12.26 12/26/2021] Update. They are used by players to modify the stats and abilities of [[Beequip]]s. There are currently 4 different Waxes, and each Wax can affect a Beequip differently. The player can only use up to 5 Waxes on a Beequip, so if the Player would like to use more Waxes on a Beequip, they must use a [[Turpentine]] on the Beequip to remove the waxes. Doing this will change the stats back to the original ones the Beequip had. Waxes can also be used to craft [[Planter]]s, [[Tools]], and better waxes in the [[Blender]].

==Wax Types== There are currently five wax types listed below: Soft Wax|Soft Hard Wax|Hard Caustic Wax|Caustic Debug Wax|Debug Swirled Wax|Swirled

== Use in Quests ==

  • [[Dapper Bear]] requires the player to collect or use waxes in the following quests: ** A Good Infection (#3) requires the player to collect 10 Soft Waxes. ** All About Appearances (#4) requires the player to use {{Cost|Soft Wax|5}} and 1 Hard Wax. ** The Long Haul (#10) requires the player to use 10 Hard Waxes. ** Ongoing Maintanence (#13) requires the player to use 50 Soft Waxes.
  • [[Science Bear]] requires to player to obtain waxes in the following quests: ** Repairing The White Drive requires the player to obtain 12 Soft Waxes. ** Corrupting The Glitched Drive requires the player to obtain 12 Hard Waxes.
  • [[Bee Bear]] requires to player to collect or use waxes in the following quests: ** Finishing The Festive Planter (#10) requires the player to collect 10 Soft Waxes. ** Upgrading The Honeydays (#13) requires the player to use 5 Soft Waxes. ** Cogs For The Cub Buddy (#15) requires the player to use 5 Hard Waxes. ** Peppermint Preparation (2/5) (#17) requires the player to collect 30 Soft Waxes. ** Peppermint Preparation (3/5) (#18) requires the player to use 1 Swirled Wax. ** Peppermint Preparation (4/5) (#19) requires the player to collect {{Cost|Hard Wax|30}} and 5 Caustic Waxes.
  • [[Bubble Bee Man]] requires to player to collect, use, and destroy Beequips with waxes in the following quests: ** B.B.M's Naughty List (Beesmas 2021) requires the player to collect {{Cost|Soft Wax|555}} tokens and use 9 Caustic Waxes. ** BBM's Naughty List (Beesmas 2022) requires the player to destroy 31 Beequips with Caustic Waxes.

docs.title: Wealth Clock
docs.text:
[[File:Wealth Clock.png|thumb|205x205px|The Wealth Clock.]] The '''Wealth Clock''' is a [[:Category:Machines|machine]] that boosts [[System Page#Honey Per Pollen|Honey Per Pollen]] and grants [[ticket]]s to the player. The Wealth Clock is located next to [[Brown Bear]], the entrance to [[Commando Chick's Hideout]] and the [[Honeystorm|Honeystorm Summoner]].

To use the clock, the player will need to have discovered 5 types of [[bees]]. The clock can only be used every hour of playtime. Each use grants x1.01 Honey Per Pollen, which stacks up to 5 times, with a maximum of x1.05 Honey Per Pollen. The Wealth Clock is also able to award {{Cost|Ticket}}, starting at 1 for the first use, increasing the amount of tickets awarded by 1 for every subsequent use until capping at {{Cost|Ticket|5}}, on which the Wealth Clock will only produce {{Cost|Ticket|5}} per use. Every subsequent use will award the player {{Cost|Ticket|5}}. Every time it does, it will say the following:

(First four times)

{{Notification||[🕒 The Wealth clock has powered up... 🕒]}} {{Notification||[It increases Honey made from pollen by #%.]}} {{Notification||[It printed a Ticket/# Tickets!]}} {{Notification||[Come back in 1 hour and it'll print #!]}} {{Notification||[Remember, it resets if you leave the game.]}} {{Notification||[+# Ticket (from Wealth Clock)]}}

(Fifth Time Onward)

{{Notification||[🕒 The Wealth clock is fully powered! 🕒]}} {{Notification||[It prints 5 Tickets per hour!]}} {{Notification||[Remember, it resets if you leave the game.]}} {{Notification||[+5 Tickets (from Wealth Clock)]}} == Sound Effect == [[File:WealthClock.ogg]]

== Notes == * There is a 15-minute grace period (can be offline for 15 minutes) until the Wealth Clock buff resets. This means the player can exit and rejoin, while still maintaining the boost, as long as they join within the 15-minute grace period. ** However, if the player joins in that period of time, the Wealth Clock cooldown will reset back to an hour. *** This can be evaded by abusing a bug. If you enter the hive hub and leave the game, the wealth clock will not reset. * The player can obtain wealth clock boost by redeeming certain [[codes]]: ** There are currently no available codes that grant the wealth clock boost.

== Trivia == * The Wealth Clock is located where the Honeystorm Summoner used to be. * As of the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], it increases the number of tickets it prints each interval. It will also start printing tickets the moment the player starts using it, but the player has to be in the server for 1 hour to use it instead of the previous 30 minute cooldown. * The amount of tickets granted by the Wealth Clock is based on the player's current stack of the Wealth Clock buff rather than how many times the player has used it (e.g if the player has 1 stack of the Wealth Clock buff and then uses the Wealth Clock for the first time, it will grant 2 tickets instead of 1). * The [[Badges#Playtime Badge|Playtime Badge]] is represented by the Wealth Clock. * The Wealth Clock has a 1/250 (0.4%) chance to spawn an {{Cost|Hourglass Sticker|||0}} in the [[Clover Field]].

docs.title: Werewolf's Cave
docs.text:
''You might have been looking for [[Cave Monster]].'' [[File:Newwerewolfexterior.png|alt=|thumb|200px|The exterior of the Werewolf's Cave.]] [[File:Newwerewolfinterior.png|alt=|thumb|200px|The interior of the Werewolf's Cave.]] The '''Werewolf's Cave''', located beyond the [[Honey Bee Gate]], sits between the [[Cactus Field]] and the [[Pumpkin Patch]]. It is home to the [[werewolf]] and two spider-like creatures called [[Cave Monster]]s inside of it that will try to kill you. There is a {{Cost|Gold Egg|||0}} token at the end of the cave. 

To get the gold egg easily, prepare items or gear that give haste, such as [[:Category:Boots|boots]], [[:Category:Guards|guards]], {{Cost|Oil|||0}}, [[Ability Tokens#Bear Morph|Bear Morph]], and stacks of [[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]] and/or Haste+. Afterwards, make a run for it, jumping the whole way to avoid getting killed. Extra boosts, however, are not required nor needed. If you are lucky, you may be able to get the golden egg through jumping. Sometimes, there is a [[Glitches|glitch]] where the cave monsters don't spawn or they are lagging, and in that case, it is easy to get the gold egg without preparation. Getting Haste+ by using the [[Royal Jelly Dispenser]] in the [[Star Hall]] or by using [[codes]] can help, and another option is to defeat the cave monsters in the cave, and then get the gold egg, though that solution can be hard. If you have [[pollen]] in your [[Bags|bag]] and wish to keep it, you can exit the cave using a {{Cost|Whirligig|||0}} to exit the Werewolf's Cave safely.

[[File:MTsprout-WWcave.png|thumb|200px|A sprout in the Mountain Top Field, as seen from the cave.]] If there is a [[sprout]] in the [[Mountain Top Field]], its light beam is visible inside of the Werewolf's Cave. If there's a cloud on the Mountain Top Field, the rain might be visible. Honeystorms, snow storms, and mythic meteor showers are also visible while inside the cave.

{{MapNav}} [[Category:Locations]]

docs.title: Werewolf
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Werewolf |image =WerewolfBSS.png |location = [[Cactus Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]] |timer = 60 minutes (1 hour) (51 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee) |hp = 250 |damage = 35 |points = 25 |bond = 75 |honey = 5,000 |level = 7 }}The '''Werewolf''' is a level 7 [[mob]] found only behind the [[Honey Bee Gate]]. Unlike other mobs, it defends three fields instead of one: the [[Cactus Field]], [[Pine Tree Forest]], and the [[Pumpkin Patch]]. He spawns at the entrance of the [[Werewolf's Cave]], in between the Cactus Field and the Pumpkin Patch.

It takes 1 hour for the werewolf to respawn after being defeated (51 minutes with [[Gifted Bee|Gifted]] [[Vicious Bee]]).

==Locations== {| class="article-table" !Field !Quantity !Level |- |Entire level containing the [[Cactus Field]], [[Pumpkin Patch]], and [[Pine Tree Forest]]. |1 |7 |}

==Drops== Guaranteed: 50 [[Battle Point|Battle Points]]. {{Cost|Honey|50000}} (Increased by Honey From Tokens). 750 [[Bond]]. Possible: {{Cost|Ticket}} (increments of 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20 or 25) (50% chance) ([[Loot Luck]]: +drop rate). {{cost|Gumdrops}} (increments of 1, 3, 5, 10 or 15) (Loot Luck: +drop rate). {{Cost|Treat}} (increments of 5, 10, or 50). {{Cost|Sunflower Seed}} (increments of 5, 10, 50, or 250). {{Cost|Pineapple}} (increments of 1 or 20). {{Cost|Royal Jelly}} (increments of 1, 5, 10, and 25). {{Cost|Micro-Converter}} (Increments of 1 and 5). {{Cost|Glue}} (Somewhat rare) (increments of 1, 3, 5, 10, and 25). {{Cost|Oil}} (Somewhat rare). {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear|||0}} (Somewhat rare) (Beesmas only). {{Cost|Robo Pass}} (Rare). {{Cost|Pinecone|||0}} (Rare) (Beesmas only). {{Cost|Star Jelly}} (Very Rare). {{Cost|Loaded Dice}} (Very Rare). {{Cost|Night Bell|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Diamond Egg|||0}} (Extremely Rare). {{Cost|Gifted Silver Egg|||0}} (Exceptionally Rare).

==Strategies== The main strategy players use is to have something in the way between them and the werewolf. The main things players use are the bigger cactus or the smaller pumpkin. The werewolf will bounce off the object when he tries to attack, making killing him easy.

The run-and-jump method also works: like most Mobs, the werewolf gets confused while the player is in the air and will lunge at the point the player was when they jumped, not where they’re at after they jumped.

The [[Glitches#Frozen Field Defenders|Frozen Field Defenders Glitch]] works well against the werewolf.

Players can also just go through the Honey Bee Gate, then quickly run behind the Pine Tree nearest to the [[Badge Bearer's Guild]]. Then, if he goes back to the cave, just walk beside him and then run back behind the tree. The player should keep doing this until they defeat him.

==Trivia== This mob and the [[spider]] are the only regularly-respawning mobs that can attack players beyond the field they spawn in. This is the only normal mob to defend three fields (Cactus Field, Pumpkin Patch and Pine Tree forest). The werewolf uses the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/132574130/White-Fang "White Fang Package"] on the Roblox Catalog. This was the first non-bug/arachnid mob added into the game. The player can earn more than one egg after defeating the werewolf; for example, he can drop 5 [[Egg|Silver Eggs]] at once. This is the second strongest normal mob in the game, only beaten by the estimated health of the [[Cave Monster|cave monsters]]. Among the normal mobs, the werewolf is the one that spawns the least frequently, at 1 hour after every defeat. This is the first mob in which the respawn timer is 1 hour or more, the other 7 being [[Stump Snail]], [[Snowbear]] and all other [[:Category:Bosses|bosses]]. *If you run inside the Werewolf's Cave, you would be faced with a tunnel, which, if you cross, rewards you with a gold egg. However, the cave is guarded by the previously mentioned cave monsters that you will have to rush past to reach the egg.

{{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]]

docs.title: Whirligig
docs.text:
{{DISPLAYTITLE: Whirligig}} {{Consumables |image = Whirligig.png |description = Teleports you and your bees back to your hive and briefly increases Convert Rate. |cooldown = 3 minutes |cap = 100 }} {{Color|Whirligig|Whirligigs}} are inventory [[items]] added in the [[Updates#2021.12.26|Beesmas 2021 update]]. Using one simply teleports the player and their [[bees]] back to their [[hive]], as well as temporarily increasing Convert Rate.

Whirligigs have a limit of 100. Obtaining any while having more than 100 whirligigs will not add them to the player's inventory, unless they are obtained through [[quests]] or [[codes]].

Attempting to use a Whirligig without claiming a hive will prompt the message: "You must claim a hive to use a Whirligig."

==Ways to Obtain==

  • A common drop from the [[Robo Bear Challenge]].
  • A reward from [[Retro Swarm Challenge]].
  • As a rare drop from [[mobs]] such as [[Rhino Beetle]]s and [[Mantis]]es.
  • As a drop from certain [[Planter]]s. ** Planters harvested in [[Pine Tree Forest]] have a higher chance to drop whirligigs than other [[fields]]. [[Petal Planter]] gives the most whirligigs, although [[Blue Clay Planter]] has the highest chance of dropping them.
  • As a Stack Reward for adding certain [[stickers]] to the [[Sticker Stack]]: ** The Launching Rocket rewards 10 whirligigs. ** The Simple Mountain rewards 10 whirligigs.

=== Outdated Ways === {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ |- | * As a reward from quests. ** Bee Bear's Bringing On Beesmas (#1) - x5 Whirligigs. ** Bee Bear's Very Merry Berries (#7) - x2 Whirligigs. ** Bee Bear's By Golly, Get Jolly (#9) - x10 Whirligigs. ** Bee Bear's Merry Mushroom Mania (#12) - x10 Whirligigs. ** Bee Bear's Cub Buddy Beckoning (#15) - x5 Whirligigs. * In secret locations, such as inside the [[Beesmas Tree]]. * As a reward from finishing your own [[Robo Party]]. * As a drop from Robo Party mobs. * Completing [[Bee Bear|Bee Bear's]] 8th, 10th, and 15th quest. (10, 10 and 25 for those accordingly) * As a reward from the Whirling Bundle from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. * Buying the Starter Sampler Pack from [[Bee Bear's Catalog]]. * Opening certain [[Gift Boxes]] across the map: ** Beige Gift Box gave 10 whirligigs and other items. * Hitting the [[target]] on the right wall in the [[Blue Flower Field]] next to the King Beetle's Lair rewarded 3 whirligigs. |}

== Crafting Uses == Total required for all in-game equipment: {{Cost|Whirligig|0}} {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table" |+ ! style="text-align: center" |{{Cost|Whirligig}} !Other ingredients ! style="text-align: center" |Result |- |1 |{{Cost|Soft Wax|1}}{{Cost|Red Extract|1}}{{Cost|Blue Extract|1}} |[[File:Field Dice.png|center|80px]]{{Color|Field Dice}} |- |3 |{{Cost|Field Dice|3}}{{Cost|Oil|3}}{{Cost|Soft Wax|3}} |[[File:Smooth Dice.png|center|80px]]{{Color|Smooth Dice}} |}

== Trivia == Using a whirligig during an [[Ant Challenge]] will teleport the player to the starting platform after teleporting to the hive, thus putting an end to the challenge. This is also one of the ways to exit the [[White Tunnel]] other than defeating or being killed by [[Tunnel Bear]], leaving and rejoining the game, and using the gray plate at the middle of the tunnel. They are based on maple tree seeds (nicknamed whirligigs), which, when falling, spin, thus traveling further from the tree. This may have inspired the whirligig's mechanic of teleporting or rather "carrying" you back to your hive. Before the [[Updates|12/26/22]] update, Whirligigs had a cooldown of 5 minutes. *If the player has the [[Buffs & Debuffs#Debuffs|Frozen debuff]] (from [[Snowbear]]), the whirligig will only teleport the player's bees. ** This may also occur if the player is lagging.

docs.title: White Tunnel
docs.text:
[[File:TunnelInterior.png|thumb|289px|The interior of the White Tunnel.]] The '''White Tunnel''' is a hidden location behind the [[Brave Bee Gate]] that can be entered via the [[Instant Converter]] near the [[Pineapple Patch]] and [[Stump Field]] and exited by standing on a platform in the middle of the tunnel. It is home to [[Tunnel Bear]]. It does not contain any [[items]], but it does have a picture of a winking [[Basic Bee]] face at the end of the tunnel, hinting towards the [[Codes|code]] "Wink" (valid). The farther down the tunnel you go, the narrower the tunnel becomes. This makes exploiting Tunnel Bear harder as you can only "turn around" at the beginning of the tunnel, elongating the fight. [[File:Whitetunnelentrances.png|alt=|thumb|220px|The two ways to get into the White Tunnel.]]

== Entrances == There are two ways to enter: by jumping into the top of the instant converter, or by hopping up into the right side of the converter. To use the first method, either hop up on one of the shorter parts of the converter, then jump into the chute at the top, or if you don't have enough jumping power to do that, go up to the [[Yellow Cannon]] and jump down from there, or jump on the converter from the ledge beside it.

Another way to enter is to glide to the walls of the map (in the direction of [[Stump Field]]), and then hop over to the gap in the ground, which is an alternate way of entering the White Tunnel.

There is an exit platform about a third of the way down the tunnel that will teleport you on to the top of the Instant Converter next to the [[Sunflower Field]]. [[File:Screenshot 2023-03-31 170856.png|alt=The alternate entrance to the White Tunnel that does not involve using the Instant Converter.|thumb|The alternate entrance to the White Tunnel that does not involve using the Instant Converter.]]

== Music == When in the tunnel, the following audio plays:[[File:Crawlers.ogg]]

This [[Music|audio]] is known as "Crawlers" and also plays inside the [[King Beetle's Lair]] and the [[Commando Chick's Hideout]]. [[File:Screenshot 2024-01-27 at 8.21.26 AM.png|thumb|The alternative entrance from inside the tunnel]]

== Gallery == Screenshot 2019-05-04 at 7.11.03 PM.png|The previous version of the tunnel. Screenshot 17.png|The green platform covering the tunnel. TunnelAltEntrance.png|A player entering the alternate entrance to Tunnel Bear's lair. Screenshot 16-0.png|The outside of the tunnel. Winking Basic Bee.png|The winking [[Basic Bee]] face at the end of the tunnel. Tunnel Bear-0.png|Tunnel Bear in the White Tunnel. Tunnel Bear's Respawn timer.PNG|Tunnel Bear's respawn timer.

== Trivia == * The winking bee at the end of the tunnel is the same winking bee picture in a previous [[Bee Swarm Simulator]] thumbnail. * Before the [[Updates#2018.09.10|9/10/2018 update]], the tunnel could also be entered by going outside the map and finding the spot on the top of the tunnel where Tunnel Bear enters it. The update buried the tunnel under green grass (white snow during Beesmas) to make it more tunnel-like, so this entrance is now much harder to find. However, the cover is non-collidable so you can pass through it. * Before the [[Updates#2018.11.25|11/25/2018 update]], the width of the tunnel was the same throughout the entire tunnel, instead of getting narrower. * To enter through the alternate entrance, you would have to jump over the wall behind science bear. Best way to do this is to use the Wind Shrine to get on the wall, then make your way over.

docs.title: Wild Windy Bee
docs.text:
{{Mob |title = Wild Windy Bee |image = Windy Bee.png |location = All Fields except the [[Stump Field]], [[Ant Field]]. and the [[Hive Hub]]. |hp = 500 base; Increases by level |damage = 40 (contact) Minimum 1/0.5s; Increases on every defeat and the proximity between the player and the tornado. |points = None |level = 1-No limit }}''This page is for the Wild version of Windy Bee. For the tamed version, see [[Windy Bee]].''

The '''Wild Windy Bee''' is a [[:Category:Mini Bosses|Mini-Boss]] that spawns in the [[Dandelion Field]], [[Pineapple Patch]], [[Pumpkin Patch]], [[Mountain Top Field]], and [[Coconut Field]].

During the [[Beesmas]] event, Wild Windy Bee could also spawn in the [[Clover Field]], [[Spider Field]], [[Bamboo Field]] and [[Pepper Patch]] in addition to the [[fields]] that it normally appears in.

A Wild Windy Bee may spawn naturally every two in-game [[Day/Night Cycle]]s or from an offering to the [[Wind Shrine]]. If the first line of dialogue from offering to the Wind Shrine is “A sudden breeze sweeps the {item} into the sky" a Wild Windy Bee will spawn in a random field. If the player does not touch the cloud Wild Windy Bee is in for 3 minutes, it will de-spawn.

It can also be spawned by receiving [[Spirit Bear|Spirit Bear's]] "Tickle The Wind" [20] [[Quests|Quest]] that summons 3 Wild Windy Bees at Mountain Top Field, by completing Spirit Bear's "Space Oblivion" [24] quest that summons a single Wild Windy Bee, And by receiving Spirit Bear's "Spring Out Of The Mountain" [30] Quest that summons a single Wild Windy Bee.

When a Wild Windy Bee spawns, the player needs to find a floating [[Clouds|Cloud]] over a field with Windy Bee inside. It will be camouflaged inside the cloud and have a distinct white trail. Touching the Wild Windy Bee in time will initiate the fight. The starting level of Wild Windy Bee upon discovery is random but can only go up to level 6 (unless spawned by [[Onett (Developer)|Onett]]).

When Windy Bee starts its attack, all players on the server receive the message: "☁️ (Player Username) found Windy Bee in the (Dandelion Field/Pineapple Patch/Pumpkin Patch/Mountain Top Field/Coconut Field) (Clover Field/Spider Field/Bamboo Field/Pepper Patch Only for Beesmas)! ☁️". When the Windy Bee's HP reaches 0, the bee will drop rewards and immediately move to a random field, excluding the [[Hub Field]], [[Ant Field]], and [[Stump Field]]. It leaves successively better rewards behind each time it's forced to move. When it leaves the map after its 5-minute timer elapses, the server states: {{Notification|Gray|☁️ Windy Bee is fleeing... ☁️}}

If the chimes on the Wind Shrine moves continuously from left to right, it indicates that Wild Windy Bee is on the map, either camouflaged in a cloud or fighting in the open.

You can see its level on its wings, much like the bees in your hive.

== Attack Pattern and Rewarding== Wild Windy Bee uses 2 different attacks. Its first attack is summoning 3 tornados that wipes [[Pollen]] off the field and deals damage every 0.5 seconds. The damage dealt depends on the proximity between the tornado and the player, plus the number of times Wild Windy Bee is defeated. The duration and speed of the tornadoes also depend on the number of times Wild Windy Bee is defeated. This attack can damage other mobs. The damage will vary from 1-20. This attack will happen first, then cycled after 3 Wind blows.

Wild Windy Bee's second attack is forming a gust of wind that blows players away with great force in a rectangular area. It will deal no damage, but the player(s) will be flung away if caught in the rectangular area, unable to deal damage for some time. A red attack indicator is shown for about one second to show where Wild Windy Bee is about to attack. The direction of attack depends on Wild Windy Bee's current position and the position of a randomly targeted player on the field. The size of the attack is based on how far the edge of the field is from where Wild Windy Bee is looking. If Wild Windy Bee cannot detect any players on the field, it will attack in a random direction. This attack is cycled in after Wild Windy Bee finishes the tornado attack.

Upon defeat, Wild Windy Bee leaves behind a cloud in the middle of the field that regrows flowers and gives +25% pollen for 10 seconds (+50% pollen if you have a Gifted Windy bee) for 10 seconds if you stand under the cloud(s) and gets refreshed while under the clouds. Its also grants +10% Unique Instant Conversion. A ring of tokens then appears underneath Windy Bee like [[Stick Bug]], and each player gets their own loot ring unless the player does not deal enough damage. Afterward, Windy Bee flies off to a different field. Wild Windy Bee will continue doing this for 5 minutes before fleeing.

Every time Wild Windy Bee is defeated, it levels up with more health, similar to Stick Bug. It also has a higher chance of dropping Cloud Vials and rarer items.

==Health per Level == The formula to tell how much health Wild Windy Bee has per level is:

(level ^ 2 * 250) + 250

''Note: This table only goes up to level 25. If you want to go beyond that, use the formula shown above. However, do not add more to this.'' {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" !Level!!Health |- |1||500 |- |2||1,250 |- |3||2,500 |- |4||4,250 |- |5||6,500 |- |6||9,250 |- |7||12,500 |- |8||16,250 |- |9||20,500 |- |10||25,250 |- |11||30,500 |- |12||36,250 |- |13||42,500 |- |14||49,250 |- |15||56,500 |- |16||64,250 |- |17||72,500 |- |18||81,250 |- |19||90,500 |- |20||100,250 |- |21||115,500 |- |22||129,250 |- |23||140,500 |- |24||152,250 |- |25 |164,500 |}

==Path== After the Wild Windy Bee's health is depleted, it will drop loot and then move to another field. The field the bee moves on next depends on the current field it is standing by. These are all the possible outcomes. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" !Current Field!!Possible Fields to go |- |Sunflower Field||Mushroom FieldDandelion FieldCoconut Field |- |Dandelion Field||Clover FieldRose FieldSunflower FieldBlue Flower Field |- |Mushroom Field||Sunflower FieldStrawberry FieldCoconut Field |- |Blue Flower Field||Bamboo FieldSpider FieldCoconut Field |- |Clover Field||Dandelion FieldMushroom FieldBlue Flower FieldBamboo Field |- |Spider Field||Dandelion FieldStrawberry FieldBamboo FieldCoconut Field |- |Strawberry Field||Sunflower FieldSpider FieldCactus FieldRose Field |- |Bamboo Field||Spider FieldPineapple Patch |- |Pineapple Patch||Mountain Top FieldClover Field |- |Cactus Field||Pumpkin PatchPine Tree ForestMountain Top FieldCoconut Field |- |Pumpkin Patch||Cactus FieldPine Tree ForestMountain Top Field |- |Pine Tree Forest||Cactus FieldPumpkin PatchMountain Top Field |- |Rose Field||Sunflower FieldDandelion FieldStrawberry FieldCoconut Field |- |Mountain Top Field||Pineapple PatchCoconut FieldPepper Patch |- |Coconut Field||Dandelion FieldSunflower FieldClover FieldPepper Patch |- |Pepper Patch||Sunflower FieldRose FieldCoconut FieldDandelion Field |}

==Drops== Every time Wild Windy Bee is defeated, the following rewards may be dropped. Defeating Wild Windy Bee too many times in a day will greatly weaken drops. The value of drops depends on how much damage the player deals to it (For example, If a Wild Windy Bee has 1000 health, two players are fighting it and one deals 200 damage and the other 800, the second player would get better rewards).

{ class="sortable mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" {{Cost }

==Tips== * When summoning one, 5 - 10 Field Dice/3-5 Oils/5-10 Glue is the best way if the player wants a cheap but reliable way. ** Other options include: 1 Star Jelly, 3-5 Glitters. Before summoning one, the player should make sure to defeat any tough mobs and bosses beforehand that would make fighting the windy bee much harder, particularly the [[Coconut Crab]] and [[Mondo Chick]]. [[Nectar]]s such as Invigorating Nectar grants x1.01 - x1.10 Bee attack and Motivating for 1% - 5% Bee Ability Rate. * Equip accessories that improve bee attack, such as the [[Fire Mask]] or the [[Demon Mask]]. Equipping [[Coconut Clogs]] or [[Gummy Boots]] gives an extra 5% and 10% bee attack each. You can use [[Stinger]]s for an extra 1.5x bee attack, though if you don’t have a Vicious Bee it is not recommended. Use {{Cost|Oil}} and/or {{Cost|Tropical Drink}} for 1.2x player and Bee Movespeed and +5% [[Critical Hits|Critical Chance]]. Use {{Cost|Super Smoothie}} for both improved Movespeed, Bee Movespeed, Critical Chance and Super-Crit Chance. Though it's not recommended due to its expensive crafting recipe and its rarity. Try and build up a {{Cost|Focus}} stack before starting the battle as critical chance improves the chances of a critical hit, increasing attack damage. Try and build up a precision stack before starting the battle as precision grants Super-Crit chance that are 33% stronger than a critical hit and also reduces the cooldown for your Precise Bees to attack again by 75%. You can also collect {{Cost|Melody}} to gain 100% critical power for 30 seconds. The player can use the sound effects created by the windy bee to tell what attack it is going to execute next. It will also start using a wind gust attack after summoning three tornadoes. During the wind gust attack, the player should go into an open space to avoid the attack easily. If possible, stand on decorations and ramps around the field to gain some height. This makes the windy bee think there is no one in the field and it won't target the player. Going out of the field but near the Wild Windy Bee prevents it's tornadoes from causing damage to the player although it's wind gust attack still works. Since the tokens from Wild Windy Bee have a relatively long lifespan, the player should follow the Windy Bee to it's next field first, and then collect the rewards using a [[Ability Tokens#Token Link|Token Link]] or get hit by a bullet or hitting all targets from [[Precise Bee|Precise Bee's]] target practice. *Use the [[:Category:Transport|Transportation Devices]] to get to certain fields quicker.

==Gallery == WindyBeeCoconut.png|A cloud with Wild Windy Bee inside in the [[Coconut Field]]. Whirlwind.png|A tornado summoned by Wild Windy Bee in the Clover Field. RobloxScreenShot20200324 054248231.png|The Wind Gust attack. RogueWindyFoundMountainTop.png|The message when someone finds a Wild Windy Bee. WildWindyBeeFleeingMessage.png|The message when Wild Windy Bee leaves the server when the timer reaching 0 secs. Wild windy and stick bug.png|A Wild Windy Bee with [[Stick Bug]]. 2Windy.PNG|Multiple Wild Windy Bees on the Mountain Top Field spawned by Spirit Bear. RobloxScreenShot20200321 015620398.png|A Wild Windy Bee in a cloud growing a [[Sprout|moon sprout]]. RobloxScreenShot20200321 051646723.png|A Wild Windy Bee with a [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]. Capture d’écran (116).png|Wild Windy Bee in the cloud seen from the front. WildWindyLootCircle.png|The circle of loot Wild Windy Bee drops when defeated. Windy gang.png|Onett summoning Wild Windy Bees at the end of Beesmas. A wild windy bee with Mondo Chick and a Gifted Vicious Bee.png|A Wild Windy Bee with Mondo Chick and a Gifted Vicious Bee. WindyBeeDestroyerofWorldsFullHP.png|Wild Windy Bee- Destroyer of Worlds at full HP WindyBeeDestroyerofWorldsHQ.png|Wild Windy Bee- Destroyer of Worlds but higher quality WindyBeeDestroyerofWorldsMessage.png|Wild Windy Bee- Destroyer of Worlds spawn message The Windy Gang Clean-up Crew of Beesmas 2022.png|The Windy Gang Clean-up Crew during Beesmas 2022. Three windy bees.png|Another image of three Wild Windy Bees. eurmom.jpg|An image of two Wild Windy Bees.

== Trivia == * The player can tell if a Wild Windy Bee is in a field when the wind chimes of the [[Wind Shrine]] are continuously moving (and if there wasn't a recent donation). * If the timer ends before it generates reward tokens, it will leave without making any rewards. However, if it has already started producing them, it will finish spawning them as Windy Bee flees. Like [[Mythic Meteor Shower]]s and [[Puffshroom]]s, the quality of its rewards are affected by the law of diminishing marginal utility. The more times the player receives loot from Wild Windy Bees in one day, the worse the rewards gradually get. Windy Bee and [[Vicious Bee]] are the only bosses/mobs that are [[Bees]], Vicious Bee’s counterpart being [[Rogue Vicious Bee]]. Unlike Rogue Vicious Bee, the Wild Windy Bee does not have a gifted variant. * Similar to Rogue Vicious Bee's [[Ability Tokens#Impale|Impale]] attack, the tornado can deal damage to other mobs. *[[Onett (Developer)|Onett]] would sometimes spawn Wild Windy Bee in fields, including fields where it wouldn't naturally appear, usually to help grow [[Sprout]]s that he also spawns. ** If Onett spawns them in the [[Stump Field]], the Windy Bees freeze in the air upon defeat until the timer is up, as they are not programmed to fly to any other field from Stump Field. At the end of Beesmas 2020, Onett spawned a couple of Wild Windy Bees called "The Windy Gang". The Windy Gang made a return in Beesmas 2021, spawning a festive sprout and appearing in the [[Mountain Top Field]]. [[Black Bear]] mentioned this bee in one of his dialogues before it was added to the game, where he said "A powerful bee destroyed fields with gusts of wind." This is the only mob/enemy that can knock players back. This is the fifth [[Mobs|Mob]] to have non-fixed levels, the first four being [[Ants]], [[Stick Bug]], [[Stick Nymph]]s and [[Festive Nymph]]s. It is possible to damage a Wild Windy Bee while it is summoning rewards, by using flames. This, along with the [[Commando Chick]] and [[Snowbear]] are the only Mini-bosses that drop loot in a circle. This, [[King Beetle|King beetle]] and [[Commando Chick]] are the only mobs that drop loot only in the center of the location they are in, even when they are not close to the center. When Wild Windy Bee flees, it will face all players in the server before flying off. This most likely explains why when Wild Windy Bee flees, it starts to move in random directions. If the player collides with Wild Windy Bee's body by jumping into it, they will take some damage. *Windy bee will not leave a cloud behind if the field has reached it's cloud limit. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Mini Bosses]] [[Category:Multiplayer Bosses]] [[Category:Bees]]

[[File:WindShrine.png|thumb|225px|The Wind Shrine.]] [[File:Buginess.png|thumb|A bug that happens with the Wind Shrine when the chimes go too high up.|224x224px]] [[File:Obraz 2023-12-30 165548097.png|thumb|225x225px|Sometimes, one or more chimes disappear due to a bug when they move too high up.]]

The '''Wind Shrine''' is located beyond the [[Windy Bee Gate]], next to the [[Pepper Patch]]. It allows players to donate items to it in exchange for rewards such as [[Field Wind]]s and [[honey]]. The Wind Shrine has a cooldown of 1 hour between each donation. Donating [[Cloud Vial|cloud vials]] after donating a [[Spirit Petal]] is currently the only way to obtain a [[Windy Bee]].

The Wind Shrine also indicates if a [[Wild Windy Bee]] is active in one of the [[fields]]. If the chimes are continuously moving around and nobody has donated recently, a Wild Windy Bee will be somewhere around the map. [[File:Moving shrine.mp4|thumb|254x254px|A video of Wind Shrine moving.]] The following audio plays when a player has donated something to the Wind Shrine:[[File:Windchimedonate.ogg]]

==Usage== Upon interacting with the shrine, it says "Would you like to make an offering to the Wind Shrine?" If the player clicks on the dialogue, a window pop-up will appear, in which it allows the player to donate any amount of almost any item in their inventory to the shrine. Upon doing so, a message follows, with the chimes moving around swiftly. If the player cancels the donation, it instead says "You canceled the donation."

If the player interacts with the Shrine during cooldown, it says "You may only donate to the Shrine once per hour. Come back in x: y." (x = minutes, y = seconds)

If the player wants to donate multiple items at once, they can hold down the "+" button. The rate at which the amount of that certain item increases the longer the "+" button is held down.

===Favor=== Favor is a [[Mechanics|mechanic]] that affects the player's rewards from the Wind Shrine. Favor is increased by donating items. A spirit petal is '''not''' required to be donated to start increasing favor.

All donations grant favor (5,000 [the value of one Cloud Vial] + the favor value of the items donated), which means that donating rarer items such as [[egg]]s will grant more favor. Below is a list of most items that can be donated to the shrine and their favor values.

Favor can be roughly estimated by the messages received when the player is rewarded winds or is donating cloud vials for a Windy Bee.

===Obtaining a Windy Bee=== '''To get the Windy Bee from the Shrine, players must first donate a spirit petal to it.''' After donating a Spirit petal, any Cloud Vial donated gives the player a chance to obtain a Windy Bee Egg. The player's chance to obtain the Windy Bee Egg depends on how much favor the player has with the shrine.

If the player receives a Windy Bee Egg, the Wind Shrine will display the following message: "And it calls back to you!". The Windy Bee victory jingle will play, and server-wide message will appear in the chat, reading "🎉 [Player] has tamed a Windy Bee! 🎉", but if it fails, the message will instead read, "But it doesn't respond..." [[File:RobloxScreenShot20201012 223413205.png|thumb|The message that pops up if a player has successfully tamed Windy Bee.]]

If the player had purchased a Windy Bee Egg from the [[Robux Shop]], they would get a [[Star Treat|star treat]] in place of a [[Egg#Specific Bee Eggs|Windy Bee Egg]].

===Badge Shivers=== Badge shivers are rewards that are linked to the player's [[Badges]]. The player can shiver a badge when they have the required badges by donating certain items. Shivering a badge does not do anything to the badge itself, only granting certain rewards if you have certain badges. Donating more items at a time gives a higher chance of shivering the related badge. Some badge shivers may require multiple badges or certain tiers of badges. Other badges cannot be shivered, or they are currently unknown. Below is a list of all known badge shivers. Each shiver can only be performed once. == Field Winds == When you donate certain items to the shrine, you have a chance to summon Field Winds. The winds are random and not guaranteed. The more of the item you donate and the higher your favor, the better chance you have at getting a high stack of winds. Many of these are unknown, and fields with no text in the donation column means it is unknown. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table" !Field !Donation |- |Dandelion Field |Bitterberries, Moon Charms, Tropical Drinks |- |Clover Field |Magic Beans |- |Sunflower field |Sunflower Seeds, Moon Charms, Oil, Tropical Drinks |- |Blue Flower Field |Blueberries, Blue Extract, Purple Potion, |- |Mushroom Field |Strawberries, Red Extract, Purple Potion |- |Strawberry Field |Strawberries, Red Extract, Purple Potion |- |Spider Field |Bitterberries, Moon Charms, Neonberries, Tropical Drinks |- |Bamboo Field |Blueberries, Blue Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Pineapple Patch |Pineapples, Moon Charms, Enzymes, Tropical Drinks |- |Stump Field |Gumdrops, Glue, Blue Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Cactus Field |Magic Beans |- |Pumpkin Patch |Magic Beans |- |Pine Tree Forest |Blueberries, Blue Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Rose Field |Strawberries, Red Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Mountain Top Field |Tickets, Basic Eggs |- |Pepper Patch |Strawberries, Red Extracts, Purple Potion |- |Coconut Field |Coconuts, Moon Charms, Tropical Drinks, Sunflower Seeds |- |Hub Field |N/A |}

  • Generally, the color of item you donate correlates with the color of field you get.
  • Purple potion has bias to get a large stack in red or blue fields. Generally, it is recommended to donate a purple potion for boosting.
  • Eggs often give a large stack in most of the fields. The rarer the egg, the better and more winds.
  • Swirled wax tends to give 7-8x white field winds.
  • Gifted Gold Egg often gives 7-9x winds.
  • Gifted Diamond Egg often gives 10-11x winds. *

==Donations== The shrine will grant different rewards depending on the item donated. All donations will grant Honey and favor (both of which increase based on the amount donated), but other effects may vary. A list of possible outcomes is written below. [[File:Spirit Petal Rewards.png|thumb|The rewards from donating a Spirit Petal to the Wind Shrine.]] Summoning clouds on fields and granting field winds. Summoning a [[Wild Windy Bee]]. Summoning [[Bean Bug]]s and granting a [[Jelly Beans|Jelly Bean]]. Granting badge rewards. Enabling the player to receive a [[Windy Bee]] and granting other rewards. This refers to when you donate the [[Spirit Petal]], which can only be done once, which grants 500 [[Treat]]s, 1 [[Star Jelly]], 5 [[Enzymes]], 5 [[Oil]]s, 5 [[Red Extract]]s, 5 [[Blue Extract]]s, 5 [[Tropical Drink]]s and 5 [[Magic Bean]]s. Failing to obtain a [[Windy Bee]] and granting [[Treat]]s. Succeeding to obtain a [[Windy Bee]]. Granting [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Galentine's Blessing]], and other rewards. *Granting 7 Jelly Beans ([[Ready Player Two]] Event, although still possible as of 2/18/2025).

Certain items are more likely to have certain effects. For example, donating eggs other than Basic Eggs and Honey Bee Eggs will always grant field winds and donating Star Jellies or Field Dice is likely to summon a Wild Windy Bee. Some items also have biases when granting field winds, such as [[Purple Potion]]s being more likely to grant field winds for colored fields. Donating a diamond egg (or blue extracts) has a higher chance of granting winds for blue fields.

'''Keep in mind that the rewards are somewhat random, as offering the same donation twice in the same amount may have a different result. However, more items in the donation can grant better rewards.'''

==Responses== After donating an item, the Wind Shrine will display different messages, depending on the item donated and the player's favor.

==Galentine Shrine== [[File:Galentine Wind Shrine.png|thumb|250px|The Galentine Shrine's appearance.]] [[File:Buff.png|thumb|The Blessing icon.]]

The Galentine Shrine can be obtained after the player completes [[Spirit Bear]]'s Beesmas 2020, 2021, 2022 or 2024 quests. It is the Wind Shrine decorated specifically for Galentine’s Day. There are five hearts, a large red bow on the top, and a smaller white bow between two hearts. The Wind Shrine's two 'pillars' are also coated in pink paint.

If the player donates {{Cost|Strawberry}}, there is a chance (increased chance when donating more strawberries, with a 100% chance if the player donated 50,000 or more '''at once''') for the player to receive several rewards and the [[Buffs & Debuffs#From Areas|Galentine's Blessing buff]] which lasts for 2 days:

{{Tabber |2024, 2022 and 2021|{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table" !Buffs !Rewards {{!}}- {{!}} * +50% Capacity * +15% Instant Bee Ability conversion * +50% [[Rose Field]] pollen * +50% [[Blue Flower Field]] pollen * +50% [[Sunflower Field]] pollen * +5% ticket chance * +5% Loot Luck * +1% Super-Crit Chance {{!}}{{Cost|Present|1}}{{Cost|Jelly Beans|10}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|5}}{{Cost|Honeysuckle|25}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|50}}{{Cost|Ticket Planter|1}} {{!}}} |2020|{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table" !Buffs !Rewards {{!}}- {{!}} * +50% Capacity * +20% Instant Bee Ability conversion * +10% Instant Bubble Conversion * +50% [[Rose Field]] pollen * +50% [[Blue Flower Field]] pollen * +50% [[Sunflower Field]] pollen * +5% ticket chance * +5% Loot Luck {{!}}{{Cost|Present|1}}{{Cost|Jelly Beans|5}}{{Cost|Purple Potion|5}}{{Cost|Gold Egg|1}}{{Cost|Gumdrops|25}}{{Cost|Ticket|25}} {{!}}} }}

{| class="article-table" !Dialogue |- |A swift, warm gale blows out from the Galentine's Shrine...You feel the tingle of butterflies in your stomach...Your bees buzz in a plitter patter of delight!What's come over you and your swarm? Could it be love?❤Happy Galentines Day!❤ |}

==Trivia == * The Wind Shrine is based on a percussion instrument, the wind chimes. * According to [[Spirit Bear]], the Wind Shrine is one of the oldest standing monuments in the game. She also mentions that it is even older than she is. She also says that the Wind Shrine gives you different responses depending on your favor. [[File:Error .png|thumb|The pop-up that appears when a player has less than 35 bees and attempts to donate to the Wind Shrine.]] Using the Wind Shrine is the only way to obtain a [[Windy Bee]], other than buying it in {{Cost|Robux}} Shop when it was first released. * If the player donates something, but disconnects before the rewards fade out, the next donation will give the rewards of the last donation and set a cooldown of 1 hour. This will not happen if at least one reward is collected from the Wind Shrine.[[File:Refund.webp|right|thumb|Obtaining 8 oil from a refund.]] If a player happens to reach the Wind Shrine without having 35 [[bees]] and tries to donate an item, a message will come up saying "Error: Player does not have 35 bees. Please show Onett. (Version {Server version})". {{Cost|Super Smoothie}}, {{Cost|Translator}}, [[Sprinklers|Sprinkler Builders]], certain [[Egg#Specific Bee Egg|Specific Bee Eggs]] (all except for [[Egg|Honey Bee Egg]]), [[Royal Jelly#Specific Bee Jelly Variants|Specific Bee Jellies]], {{Cost|Spirit Petal}} (if the player has already donated one), {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}}, {{Cost|Snowflake}}, [[Balloon|Balloons]], [[Planter|Planters]], [[Robo Pass|Robo Passes]], the {{Cost|Beequip Case|||0}} and {{Cost|7-Pronged Cog}} are items in the player's inventory that cannot be donated. [[File:WindShrineError7.png|thumb|The pop-up that appears when someone tries to donate 0 items.]]When donating 0 of something (e.g. 0 tickets), a message will appear saying "Error: Player does not have selected quantity of items. (Version {Server version})", or "Error: Cannot donate 0 items."[[File:Cannotdonate0.webp|thumb|right]] The chimes on the Wind Shrine are collidable, and running into them will cause them to move. The Galentine Shrine is a possible reference to the Parks & Recreation episode “Galentines Day” According to [[Spirit Bear]], an [[Instant Converter]] was supposed to take the spot of the Wind Shrine. Donating any amount of {{Cost|Jelly Beans}} for the first time will always give 7 in return. *The chimes (especially the right one) can sometimes get stuck on the top of the Wind Shrine. This is uncommon.

docs.title: Windy Bee Gate
docs.text:
{{Bee Gate|title1 = Windy Bee Gate|image1 = GreenWindyGate.png|caption1 = The Windy Bee Gate.|mobs = * [[Coconut Crab]]|bears = * [[Spirit Bear]]|shops = * [[Coconut Cave]] * [[Petal Shop]]|fields = * [[Coconut Field]] * [[Pepper Patch]]|extras = * [[Wind Shrine]] * [[Daily Top White Collectors]] * [[All-Time Top White Collectors]] * [[Memory Match#Extreme Memory Match|Extreme Memory Match]] * [[Coconut Dispenser]] * [[Mazes#Blue Maze|Blue Maze]] *[[Fastest Crab Slayers Leaderboard]]}}The '''Windy Bee Gate''', or the '''35 Bee Gate''', is a gate that requires 35 [[bees]] to unlock. It is located on the right of the [[Ticket Tent]] and [[Red Cannon]]. It gets its name by the large [[Windy Bee]] figure on top of it.

Inside this Gate is the [[Coconut Field]], the [[Pepper Patch]], [[Spirit Bear]], [[Wind Shrine]], the Extreme [[Memory Match]], and two Shops, the [[Petal Shop]] and [[Coconut Cave]]. The [[Petal Shop]] sells the [[Petal Wand]], [[Petal Belt]] and the [[Petal Planter]]. while the Coconut Cave sells the [[Coconut Canister]], [[Coconut Clogs]] and [[Coconut Belt]].

==Music==

The following soundtrack "[[Music#Overflowin4|overflowin4]]" plays past this gate:[[File:Overflowin4.ogg]]

==Trivia == This gate is the first and currently the only gate in the game that has an [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] representing it. This gate, along with the [[Bear Gate]], are currently the only gates that require purchasing [[Hive Slot|hive slots]] to pass. The gate also plays the same music as the Bear Gate. This gate gives access to the blocked off area in the [[Mazes#Blue Maze|Blue Maze]] through the [[Petal Shop]]. This gate is the only place where sprouts can't appear naturally or be planted with the [[Special Sprout Summoner]]. *The sprouts planted by a player require more pollen to grow than in other locations for better loot and guaranteed more drops.

docs.text:
{{Bee |image-orig = Windy_Bee.png |image-gifted = WindyBee_Gifted.png |description = An ethereal bee as powerful and unpredictable as the weather. |rarity = Event |color = Colorless |energy = 20 |speed = 19.6 |attack = 4 |skincolor1 = #f2ffff |skincolor2 = #f2ffff |skincolor3 = #f2ffff }} ''This page is for the tamed version of Windy Bee. For the hostile version, see [[Wild Windy Bee]].''

'''Windy Bee''' is a [[:Category:Colorless|Colorless]] [[Bees/Event|Event bee]] that hatches from a {{Cost|Windy Bee Egg|4=0}}, which can be obtained from donating {{Cost|Cloud Vial}} after previously donating a {{Cost|Spirit Petal|||0}} to the [[Wind Shrine]].

Like all other Event bees, this bee does not have a favorite Treat, and the only ways to make it gifted is by feeding it a {{Cost|Star Treat|||0}}, {{Cost|Gingerbread Bear}} or {{Cost|Aged Gingerbread Bear}}.

Windy Bee likes the [[Dandelion Field]] and the [[Coconut Field]]. It dislikes the [[Bamboo Field]] and the [[Strawberry Field]].

== Stats == * Collects 10 [[Pollen]] in 3 seconds. * Makes 180 [[Honey]] in 2 seconds. * +40% [[Stats#Speed|Movespeed]], +50% Convert Speed, +25% Gather Speed, +100 [[System Page#Convert Amount|Convert Amount]], +3 [[Stats#Attack|Attack]]. * 🌟 [[Gifted Bee#List of Hive Bonuses|Gifted Hive Bonus]]: +15% [[System Page#Instant White Conversion|Instant White Conversion]], x2 Boosts From [[Clouds]].

=== Abilities === * '''[[Ability Tokens#Boost|[White Boost]]]''' Grants x1.2 pollen from White [[Flowers]] for 15s. Stacks up to 10 times. * '''[[Ability Tokens#Rain Cloud|[Rain Cloud]]]''' Summons a Cloud in a different field that lasts for 60s (+10s per level). Clouds make flowers grow and grant +25% Pollen and 10% Unique Instant Conversion to nearby players (50% Pollen and 20% Unique IC if the player has a gifted Windy Bee). If another player's Windy Bee spawns a cloud in the field the player is on, a message will appear announcing "🌧️ [Username]'s Windy Bee summoned a Cloud in this field. 🌧️" * '''[[Ability Tokens#Tornado|[Tornado]]]''' Consumes your "[[Ability Tokens#Haste|Haste]]" stacks to summon a Tornado which damages enemies and collects [[Tokens]] and Pollen as it roams the field. Lifespan, speed, and damage are increased by the number of Haste stacks spent and bee level.

{{Stat|pollen = 10|pollentime = 3|honey = 180|honeytime = 2|rarity = event}}

Windycover.png|Windy Bee on the game's icon along with Spirit Bear and Basic Bee. Wd.jpg|A player obtaining a {{Cost|Windy Bee Egg|||0}} from the Wind Shrine. == Trivia == * It was formerly available to purchase for {{Cost|Robux|800}} until the deadline, October 27 of 2019. ** This was the 3rd bee available to be bought for Robux; the second being [[Festive Bee]] and the first being [[Bear Bee]]. * There is a gate dedicated to it, known as the [[Windy Bee Gate]] or the 35 bee gate. * This, and [[Vicious Bee]] are the only bees to have a hostile variant. * This bee, [[Music Bee]], [[Vector Bee]], [[Tadpole Bee]], [[Spicy Bee]], Fuzzy Bee, Buoyant Bee, Festive Bee and [[Digital Bee]] are the only bees with three different ability tokens, the most of any bee. * This bee, [[Ninja Bee]], [[Shy Bee]], and Fuzzy Bee are the only bees that have only one skin color. * This bee is the only bee to have the same skin color when it turns [[Gifted Bee|gifted]]. * This bee and Puppy Bee are the only event bees that don't have an 'enhanced' ability when gifted. * This bee is the only bee to have 2 gifted bonuses, excluding other Event bees who enhance their ability. * Currently, this bee, Bear Bee, [[Gummy Bee]], Digital Bee and Vicious Bee are the only event bees that can't be bought in the [[Ticket Tent]]. * This is the only Event Bee to dislike 2 fields. * This, along with Buoyant Bee, are the only bees to be able to produce a White Boost token. However Buoyant Bee only produces it through Surprise Parties. * The Tornado ability, [[frog]]s, [[Puppy Bee|Puppy Bee's]] [[Ability Tokens#Fetch|Fetch]] ability, the [[Cub Buddy]] and [[Passive Abilities#Star Saw|Star Saw]] are the only entities that can pick up [[items]] outside of personal tokens for the player. * This bee and Festive Bee are the only non-gifted bees that have tinted wings. * This bee was hinted at during the [[Black Bear]] quest "Black Bear, Why?" when he says this: "Vicious Bee isn't the only bee that causes trouble! One time, I saw a strange bee destroy a whole field with powerful gusts of wind! I wonder if there are any other mysterious bees roaming free out there?" * At one point, a model of a Windy Bee could be found outside the map, alongside with a model of a Vicious Bee. * Supposedly, Windy Bee likes the [[Dandelion Field]] because dandelion seeds 'go wherever the wind takes them'.

docs.title: Yellow Cannon
docs.text:
[[File:Yellowcannon2.png|thumb|130x130px|The Yellow Cannon.]] The '''Yellow Cannon''' is available for use once the player has discovered 12 [[Bees|bee]] types. It is located on a hill accessible from the [[Brave Bee Gate]] next to [[Science Bear]] and the [[Red Teleporter]] exit. It has a 5 second cooldown period.

If the player has the [[Parachute]] or [[Glider]], they can use it in combination with the Yellow Cannon to perform a few shortcuts around the map as well as collect [[Royal Jelly]] tokens formerly inaccessible, such as the one in the [[Dandelion Field]], on top of the [[hive]]s, on top of the [[Noob Shop]] near the entrance of the [[Star Hall]] and the one near [[Brown Bear]].

== Trivia ==

  • This is one of the four cannons in the game, which the other three cannons are [[Blue Cannon]], [[Red Cannon]], and [[Gummy Cannon]]. ** This is one of the three transportational cannons in the game, which the other two cannons are [[Blue Cannon]] and [[Red Cannon]].
  • If used without moving, the player will land on the spawn platform, but can be slightly shifted off of it due to Roblox physics.
  • The Yellow Cannon has a cooldown of 5 seconds. While this is not normally possible to see during regular gameplay as the cannon launches the player too far to return in 5 seconds, the cooldown can be seen by using the Glider/Parachute glitch to stop all momentum as soon as the player exits the cannon. **This cooldown is shared by all the transportational cannons. {{MapNav}} [[Category:Transport]] [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Machines]] [[fr:Canon Jaune]]

docs.title: Zombie
docs.text:
{{Mob|title=Zombie|image=Zombie.png|location=Retro Swarm Challenge|timer=N/A|hp=80 base; Increases by level|bond=None|honey=None|level=1-30 (Varies by round)|damage=?|points=None}} The '''Zombie''' is one of the mobs exclusive in the [[Retro Swarm Challenge]].

==Behavior==

Zombies go in one direction towards the hives. Unlike the Slime, Zombies prioritize chasing the first nearby player to get into its aggression zone and will keep chasing the player until it dies or if the player it is pursuing is out of range.

== Health per Level == {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed fandom-table" !Level !Health |- |1 |50 |- |2 |150 |- |3 |200 |- |4 |250 |- |5 |300 |- | 6 |350 |- |7 |400 |- |8 | 500 |- |9 |600 |- |10 |700 |- |11 |900 |- |12 |1,000 |- |13 |1,100 |- |14 | 1,300 |- |15 |1,500 |- |16 |1,800 |- |17 |2,500 |- |18 |3,000 |- |19 |5,000 |- |20 |7,000 |- |21 |9,000 |- |22 |11,000 |- |23 |12,000 |- |24 |14,000 |- |25 |15,000 |- |26 |16,500 |- |27 |17,000 |- |28 |18,000 |- |29 |20,000 |- |30 |25,000 |} ==Drops== *{{Cost|Brick}}

==Tips== Zombies are essentially just [[Slime]]s but much easier to deal with. They can be easily led off track and effectively stopped for good if the round consists purely of Zombies. Much of the same tips for Zombies also apply for Slimes. The most important and useful tip is to realize how Zombies function. They move in a straight line but can be distracted by players if they approach close enough. This massively reduces the threat and power of Zombies. Zombies almost always spawn in hordes. It is advised to use crowd-controlling bees like [[Digital Bee]] and [[Vicious Bee]], as Mind Hack and Impale can help out massively, especially in the later rounds where Zombies start increasing in level and health drastically. Remember that Zombies can damage you simply by coming into contact with you. If you are not careful and become too reckless, you can die somewhat easily to hordes. However, you should note that unlike Slimes, Zombies don't increase in size the higher level they are, meaning that dying to them is much less likely. Try upgrading from the normal sword to the Firebrand as soon as possible. There is an massive damage boost that comes with this, and you'll be able to kill low to mid-level Zombies with ease before they even get a chance to sufficiently damage you. The Illumina is an even bigger help, but it may start becoming irrelevant by the time you reach round 20 or 21. Swords as a whole start becoming futile by round 20/21 as the Zombies increase in health and spawn in larger numbers. By this point, it is advised that you buy bees that are preferably at the level that the Zombies are, which is most likely too much to handle for early and midgame players. You can use the Trowel to temporarily block Zombies from approaching the hives, but this isn't very useful unless you're also dealing with Slimes (this allows you to prioritize Slimes, which cannot be steered toward the player, unlike Zombies). [[Passive Abilities#Star Amulet Passives|Star Saw]] can easily target hordes of Zombies. {{MobNav}} [[Category:Mobs]]
